Chaotic. Lectures sometimes hard to follow. He consistently made mistakes in class & with PollEv questions. Exams were not proofread, unclear questions, & he refused to admit he was wrong or give back points for questions that his students, TA, & even boss agreed were wrong. Very difficult to work with, but activities & participation part of grade.

Genuinely think its a major disservice that this is the only biochemistry teacher offered by northeastern. does a horrible job at explaining concepts during lectures but tests on specific topics that are densely worded. becomes defensive and rude when questions are asked and blames students for gaps in knowledge. avoid at all costs.

He's nice, very passionate. Not the best at explaining. Pretty fair grading (almost entirely based on multiple choice midterms and final), fair questions on the test and will give the class credit if multiple options could be correct. Lots of opportunity to talk 1:1 (not that his explanations are super helpful lol)
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: My issue arises with his tests and ridiculous ego. Puts things on the exams he said not to know. He refuses to own up to his mistakes. Called us "ignorant" and "lazy" after one of the exams when he asked us to provide feedback and he instead decided to attack. He put an answer that was factually incorrect and refused to admit he made a mistake.

Sosnik has NO respect for students or their time and makes heavily weighted confusingly worded exams that he refuses to take feedback on. Screams at students asking questions during exams. Zero ability to teach lecture material but tests on specific concepts. Refuses to provide guidance or any study material for exams. Avoid this prof at all costs.

I have had Professor Sosnik twice, and let me tell you, this guy does not teach effectively. He is HORRIBLE at answering questions- makes you feel like an idiot if you're confused. The tests are like trick questions because he thinks he's being a hard teacher, but in reality they are just unclear and unfair. Does not take student feedback well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's a nice guy & willing to help in office hours or 1:1. Not the best at explaining things always. Wish he guided us more about what to study for exams. Grading is balanced with exams, easy reading quizzes, and a few small assigments. Lab reports are a lot. Wording of exam problems is weird (doesn't make his own) but nice about regrading them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He has a fair grading scheme, but I would say that his wording on the midterms is a bit bizarre sometimes. Felt like the exams didn't always test on the material we learned in class, I think he got his questions from a different prof
Did not expect much and still got disappointed

Very knowledgeable and professional professor. I loved the lectures, most interactive I have ever experienced in a CS classroom. My only issue is his assignments are really time consuming. He should give less work. However, I did learn a lot from them.

Taking classes with Professor Marpaung and Professor Mitra at Northeastern University feels like facing Shaquille O'Neal and Kobe Bryant in their prime an unstoppable duo when it comes to deterring GPAs. Both are highly knowledgeable and demanding, but their tough grading and high expectations make earning top marks a real challenge.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is the worst professor to ask questions. the hw are confusing so i asks for clarification every time he say "read the specification" I'm like would i ask that question if the homework wasn't so confusing. i ask because the wording is confusing in the homework and he tells me to go back and reread the hw. other than that hes a great professor

The course is challenging but satisfying! I finally understood what program design truly means. There are multiple sections of this course. They all cover the same material. Mitra's lectures are by far the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great course! Learned a lot. If you attend lectures you will pretty much know how do the assignments and labs. A lot of people don't come to class thinking the material is easy and then they lose a lot of points in the homeworks.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Grading is arbitrary, and lectures do not cover what is on the hw. The professor heavily uses hidden autograder tests that students cannot see, and many grade marks are unfairly lost as a result. Hw's are poorly written with many typos and missing details, and are often misaligned with what the autograder expects. TA's are antagonistic.

I had experience working in industry before taking this course. But even then I came across concepts that were completely new to me. I felt like this course made me reflect on how I used to code before. While Prof. Mitra is quite organized and gives great lectures, I wish he worded his assignments less ambiguously. Overall the course is great!
CS5010 is one of my favorite classes. It made a better programmer. I took the course with Shesh and Mitra. Both were pretty great professors and very accesible.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I found this course quite useful. Mitra makes the lectures interesting. The assignments are the most valuable thing about the course. I also learned concepts I hadn't heard about before like mutation testing. Definitely recommend this class.

Rubrics are a surprise after you submit the assignment, lose points if you don't have exact test cases and way too many points are determined by code structure. Asked him to look at a regrade and he just denied it without saying anything.

This class helped me understand and appreciate the agile process. The tools we learned are very relevant. I found the lectures on security and threat modeling very useful as I hadn't done anything like this before. One of the better courses I have taken at Northeastern.

The class is very well organized. It dives deep into modern software development practices. I found the the module on threat modeling super useful. The assignments and the group project really help you apply the concepts and not just learn the theory. Highly recommend this class with Mitra

Prof. Mitra's lectures in PDP are fantastic! I love the way he engages with the students in a respectful and interactive way. I learned so much by just going to the lectures and reading the notes. Taking PDP helped me do well in my internship interviews.
PDP with Mitra is a very satisfying experience. I though I knew Java but this class really helped me understand what clean code means. Definitely recommend taking this class!
Terrible Professor. Do not take him. Doesn't even let you choose your own teammates for projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really useful if you want to learn full stack development

Class was taught well, I understood everything presented and enjoyed the assignments. Some assignments were stressful in terms of deadlines, but the content was very digestible. Grading criteria for assignments were harsh, but they have aided me in writing comprehensive tests in the future.
Worst professor I have ever had. He thinks lots of content makes him a good professor, but it really makes the experience terrible for everyone. He killed morale in the class on day #1.

Joydeep Mitra is by far the best professor to take PDP with. The class is inherently difficult because of all the work, the lectures are pretty straight forward though. The school work is a bit annoying but if you put the time in you shouldn't have a problem getting at least B in PDP. PDP does suck though.
Best CS Professor at Northeastern. I loved learning about ALUs.
Learned a lot and gained MERN stack experience. Mitra benches more than you.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Worst course.Overwhelming workload with project-like assignments, exams, class activities, & final project. Instructor reads from slides without ensuring student understanding. Significant portion of grades lies on last week's performance, with 25% for project & 35% for exam. If you don't perform well in final week, grades will significantly drop.

Only take this course if you want to lose your sanity. Extremely boring and unhelpful lectures with 5% for attendance. Assignment every 2 weeks which are no where related to class slides. A pen and paper based midterm exam where he expects us to pretend to be a compiler. The exam was lengthy and unable to finish within time.

DO NOT TAKE HIS CS5500. The whole class is doing MERN stack web development, using JavaScript the whole time. Yes, you can learn a lot - by yourself! So many lecture notes and theories, none of them help you do the project - which is the homework. The course content is so tough, the project is so heavy, and pen-paper exam for coding?? INCREDIBLE

Classes are EXTREMELY boring. Exams are hard. The assignments are all connected together so if you screw one up, you screw them all up. He's not very friendly. The exam grading is very strict. The course overall sucks. I have lost all interest in full stack development. Don't ever take this course under this professor.

probably the worst class I have taken at northeastern. he packs assignments and exams to the absolute maximum and he was confused when the class average was a D- on the midterm and refusing to curve it. assignments take a very long time because he wants everyone to know web dev, and is not even teaching 5500, he randomly started teaching 5610.

Doesn't really care about the overall performance of students. Very strict grader and conducts pen-paper style exams (Students have to read the code and write answers on a sheet). Even after the exam, he won't allow you to see or discuss the grading.

Additionally, his lectures are poorly designed, covered entire full stack dev in just 2 lectures!

As a first-year international student, this class made an already tough transition even harder. This class lacked real content, and grading was inconsistent. Not helpful at all. Explore other sections if you can.

I think Professor Parker means well, but Thanos thought he was a savior. Save yourself, and do whatever you must to escape the annoying and constant hell that would await you if you took Professor Parker. Run. If you can't run, walk. If you can't walk, crawl. If you can't crawl, transfer. If you can't transfer, find Jesus.

SAVE your time and do not TAKE HIS CLASS. His grading is based on feelings and he's an egotistical shiny bald headed man who thinks he knows it all about business. He doesn't count wellness days as a valid absence unless someone died. Nothing you do will get an A unless u give him head. PLEASE don't ruin your college experience and dont take him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I hoped the green line would hit me so I didn't have to go to his class. He doesn't even know what he wants to see in the projects and will critique everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Over-hated in my opinion. He's a good guy, wants to be tough on you to get you ready for the real business world. He's very business smart, but not that tech savvy. If you put in extra effort with your group project then you can get an A-. Chances are you get screwed and you get a B though.

He is sadistic and grades very randomly and strictly for no reason. He doesn't count wellness days as a valid absence and doesn't care if you are genuinely sick. He seems unsatisfied no matter how much work you put in. Don't take him.

Don't take if you care about your grades. Doesn't grade assignment and then keeps saying he will grade but then assigns another assignment. he should stop assigning more things until hes graded everything. He once cancelled class and then told us because of that missing day we dont get a review session for our next quiz.

If you want a un-athletic, slightly intelligent, and shiny bald headed man to talk AT you not TO you about business, this is just the course for you. I received a C as my final grade for the course, and heres why: he's self centered, I don't like bald people, & HE CAN'T TEACH. Short and sweet, DO NOT take this course. The KP shall NOT be validated.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: While I like the Ken as a person as he likes his students and pushes them to become better business people, he doesn't know how to grade and give proper feedback. He'll give one thing of feedback and deduct points for it, then say "oh it's just a suggestion! No need to actually change it!". An A IS IMPOSSIBLE!!!!! If you care abt ur GPA, DROP!
Bro was straight buggin yo. Class dummy hard and lectures odeeeeeeee. Man F this guy won't teach u NUN. Ya heard
He's overall pretty chill, sometime a bit demanding for no reason. Mixed feelings but overall, he did curve the grades at the end.
Without this course, my school's life experience would be 7/10, but now it is 1/10 thanks to him! I would be happier if I knew that this course was NOT REQUIRED sooner and immediately dropped it.

He is a terrible teacher, does not give any feedback, and when you ask for feedback, he is unclear and says that you are competing with everyone else for an A. Gives big assignments without much time to do them, and doesn't give any instruction on how to complete them well. Don't take this class its NOT required. Nothing you can do will get an A.
Not a good first impression of Northeastern, is a hard grader because he doesn't specify what he wants from his students but expects them to go "above and beyond".

egotistical businessman that peaked in college. all he does is talk ab himself and how he doesn't believe in grades so idk why he chose to be a professor. you'll never get an A. Freshmen this class isn't even required so don't bother wasting your credits and GPA with this prof.

Cancelled class 6 times over the course of the semester. Class average on the first exam was a 45% because KP made up questions and did not proof read the exam. Never once provided a substantive lecture on brand management, every class felt like a fight with him about grading. Severely outdated. Hmmm... Do yourself (and GPA) a favor and avoid!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So bad in grading

I was only taught one lecture by him this semester. Class consisted of him talking about himself, complaining about his life, him giving us meaningless busywork, and class arguing about his grading policy. Sure he gives you a rubric, but he also has a different imaginary set of expectations that you magically have to follow in order to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: KP is a very experienced businessman. He tells helpful anecdotes about business and some of his assignments are about really interesting topics. However, get ready to do more group projects than you've ever done in your life and get ready to receive Bs on everything with no feedback. His ego is huge, he is rude to students, and he can't use Canvas.

There are no rubrics so he just makes up grades. HE DOES NOT GIVE As. If you want higher than an 89 on assignments or projects you better be ready to cure cancer. So many assignments in class that would take hours to do outside of class yet never collected some of them so it was a waste of time. You do everything in groups that you don't pick.

Ken is a tough one. Very hard grading because he is very smart and does not tolerate not trying hard at something. He hates the idea of grades and thinks they don't matter which leads to a lack of timeliness and care when it comes to his grading. He cares a lot about teaching, but maybe a little too much...
tough but good

Parker is a great guy with a good personality. He does spend a lot of time talking about himself, but I do think that his stories were interesting. If you pay attention in class and do the right type of studying you'll be okay, and have a good time. Class is weighted mostly on 3 exams and 2 semester-long group projects.

Prof Parker is a tough grader, and has stated in class that GPA is not very important. However, you learn a lot from him. He has a wealth of experience in the marketing field and a way of telling personal stories that captivates interest. If you have grit, enjoy participation, and value learning over an easy A, then Professor P is a solid choice.

Single worst teacher at northeastern. He spends the entire class talking about himself and his supposed business ventures. Has very unclear grading guidelines and so one must ask for him to tell you your grade since the one on canvas is never correct. He then just seems to make up a grade on the spot, and appears to do the same with final grades.

Likes to yap about himself. Most of his "career experience" is irrelevant to the material in class and especially on  the exams. If I wanted someone to yap at me for 1.5 hours, I would eat dinner with the Kardashians.

Grading criteria is UNCLEAR+INCONSISTENT. Study guides are UNHELPFUL for exams, containing LARGELY IRRELEVANT information. FRQs NEVER yield full credit and are W/O explanation. There's a high emphasis on participation. However, when participating, prepare to NEVER BE RIGHT. As all mighty Ken is always "right". CONDESCENDING+CONCEITED+EGOTISTICAL.

FOR BUSN 1101. Class is very lecture-heavy, and it's not required, prob best to avoid based off that. Lot's of long homework where the only way you get an A is to go "above and beyond." Group projects can be fun, and take up 5-10hrs/wk. If you came in with AP credits, take it, if not, take a required course.

You will not learn anything from the professor. I  do not feel that I learned anything besides the bike simulation, which any professor could assign. Blames lack of teaching as a different approach.I thoroughly enjoy the concept of marketing but after Professor Parker, I feel less motivated.

Very tough grader. Felt like I didn't learn much, exams were insane as questions had 7 vague multiple choice answers and were picked from random places in the book. Your pretty much guaranteed to finish in between an 80-90 no matter what you do.

Most reviews on Professor Parker are extreme. Yes he is a harsh grader, and the study guide does not relate to the exams. Class is like a business and he expects you to work hard and give each assignment your all if you participate and go to office hours you will do fine if you are looking for an easy class this is not the class you should take.

BUSN1101 at Northeastern. Ken Parker has no rubric for assignments and is a harsh grader for no reason. Thinks his class is more than it is. You can write an essay on a small prompt homework and get an 85 for no reason. Wild asl.

do not take under any circumstances, I had to take him because the class is my requirements. Doesn't teach, we have class 4 days a week and he teaches two days and let us do projects for the other two days, grades obscurely without explanation. crazy how northeastern is still letting him teach
He does nothing but talk about himself the whole class. He's also very creepy. You can get a good grade in the class if you flatter him but thats about it

Does not teach. Haven't learned a single thing from the text book. Thinks he is teaching real life material but is simply just rambling. No students are prepared for the quizzes/exams. Should not be a teacher.
Very tough grader, and claims a B is a good grade. In class, assignments can actually be fun but HW isn't clear, and professor expects unreasonable amounts of effort outside of class.

Grades based off of no clear criteria and will pit you against ur classmates in the group project for participation points. Introverted people are at a heavy disadvantage in this class. Teaches based on field experience which is never relevant to class topics and tests heavily based on book. Believes powerpoints are the pinnacle of learning. 0/5

Huge ego and he thinks he knows all but does not. Did not teach course content for more than one hour the whole semester. Expects you to know it for the exams that the department makes. Takes a long time to grade. My grade in this class is not bad, but this class caused me so much stress with the group projects that he assigns the groups.

Does not grade anything so you don't know your grade until the end. Do so many assignments and he gives unfair grades. Doesn't teach in class and just talks but attendance in mandatory. Barely accessible outside of class because he is so busy. Exams are hard and have tricky questions. I would not take again.
It is so difficult to get an A in this class. Even if you put a lot of effort into the assignments, it isn't enough.

I literally wish I changed marketing classes if I knew I would be in this class. He spends most of his time talking about himself and doesn't teach marketing 80% of the time. I mostly taught myself for the exams and even then he is the harshest grader. You won't ever know what he wants. I would not take again, the most frustrating class ever.

Loves to tell stories, so be prepared to hear about his background experience. He has a lot of experience within the field which is cool, but lectures can be boring. Emphasizes participation and group work, and exams a pretty easy because he gives you cheat sheets. Go to class because he gives free test questions.

The professor begins the class by saying, "grades don't matter." He mostly talks about his experience rather than sticking to the syllabus. As a result, his course only covers a minuscule amount of textbook material. Furthermore, the assignments lack specific instructions. Finally, he just responds "ok..." to all student comments.

The professor is really good in this office hours. Very patient while explaining concepts and makes sure that you understood the concepts. His lectures are really helpful only if you read the book beforehand
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I did not go to the lectures at all; they were completely useless imo. I would highly recommend just taking notes from the textbook on your own time before class. It's flipped-classroom design so he doesn't teach the material itself, he only does practice problems.

reviews.comment:
Have him for the lecture part of physics. I am currently writing this review right now in the middle of a lecture.

Great teacher, very animated, but I will say that most of the learning comes from doing his homework. 

He posts the lecture slides before the lecture which is helpful. I wish I could say more with the character limit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I don't have strong feelings about professor Kelley; his lectures are alright. Attendance is not mandatory, but there is a small online assignment which is intended to be completed during lecture time.

Professor Kelley is clearly passionate about physics and has a lot of enthusiasm. I had him for lecture and ils. As someone who is not a fan of physics at all, I think he was approachable and i like that he posts everything on canvas. Sometimes his voice would be hard to understand, but not to a great extent
Professor Kelley was a decent professor. His lectures are relatively easy to understand, if a bit dull at times. No major issues.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not good at explaining anything at all he was more supplemental to the textbook rather than the other way around. Always gave backwards answers to questions and assumed everyone understood concepts rather than really explain his process when going through questions. I would not take again.

[I hate this class so much = biased] 
There is SO. MUCH. work and except the first unit I had absolutely no idea what was going on. Tom Kelly is very enthusiastic and clearly loves physics, but unfortunately (for someone who does not enjoy the subject) was not able to help me learn anything new bc he doesn't make any sense. Avoid if u can. :(
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I do not understand Tom's current rating. I have taken him for both physics 1 and 2. I have always heard that he was the better professor. However, after a year of classes with him I disagree. It may be the class layout, but at the end it felt like I was only going to get the equations I needed then I would teach myself the rest. Tom is overrated.

He's your average teacher, nothing exceptionally good or bad. The course is already horrible with tons of work whoever you get, but the professor makes it manageable. He's definitely better than some other professors. He's also a nice guy and accommodating with extensions and other things like that.

Had him for both physics 2 and E&M. Much better at teaching E&M, I think he has difficulty teaching the easier topics. Go to his office hours, he takes notice of people actively trying to do well and will reward you for it.

Great teacher. Lectures were engaging and so informative. Office hours were great; I went many days in a row and he was more than happy to answer all of my questions. Overall: awesome, enthusiastic, brilliant guy. Expects a lot of his students, but provides them with adequate preparation. Would recommend!

If you like ridiculously enthusiastic professors, this is your guy. Personally I found that he kind of drained my energy, and his lectures were a lot more entertaining than they were useful. Also has a tendency to answer questions with a 10-second-long shrug and a perplexed face. Overall not terrible, I'd take him if all the other options were bad.

One of the best professors I have ever had.  I absolutely despised physics, but this guy kept me from failing.  Kept great office hours, and made difficult material understandable.  Knows how to breakdown topics so that the least of us could grasp them.  Good guy, great teacher, wish the rest of the physics department was this good.

He genuinly wants all of his students to understand the material. I thought physics was going to be awful for me, but I survived because of him. There are plenty of opportunities to get your grade up, and he is super helpful when you don't understand something.

He really should read his rating for a wake-up call. In class, he explains materials way harder than they should be. Another problem is that he often makes mistakes in his own quizzes. I have had to ask him for details in the problem, which was frustrating. Basically, he is smart for his own good but not smart enough to teach students.

Awesome guy, useless professor. Spends way too much time during lecture going off on tangents that have nothing to do with the lecture. He knows his stuff, but is awful at communicating it to us students. Quizzes/Exams are hard but not impossible, ILS is much more helpful for understanding the material than the lectures are.

Almost universal agreement throughout the class: this guy cannot teach. The physics department's technology is also not very good. Buy the e-text as it will become your professor. Honestly better to take a nap than to go to this guy's lectures.
DONT TAKE HIM

Prof Kamarthi genuinely wants you to succeed. He opens day one with that and means it. Logical concept order, great TAs, fun free-form final project. Midterms pull directly from practice problems he flags explicitly, plus grade recovery opportunities. Harder to fail than get an A if you show up, pay attention, and give some genuine effort.
Great
Excellent teacher
This assignment for you is really useful, sometimes the instruction in class he couldn't explain intuitively.

The class sizes are too high to be managed by professor. All the lectures are on PPT including mathematical proofs of algorithms which makes it hard to follow. Professor makes the efforts to make everything easy for students.
Lectures are interesting at start of the the semester. Eventually gets bored.
He is good and respects your work.
Excellent teaching and provides multiple ways of solution to easyily understand.
Great educator, remarkable experience. Arabic coaching on point. Business teaching not too great. Chinese classes are exceptional.
Really good professor he knows his information really well, I would recommend anyone to attend his classes. Classes are well structured and interesting.
Lectures are very long and boring

Took his class last semester. Doesn't teach anything. A 9$ Udemy course thought me more than his class. He is a nice person but not a great professor. I hope he takes into account his bad reviews and teaches better.

Very systematic course and Kamarthi teaches it that way. Goes through a cycle of concepts, introduction of equations, practice problems, homework assignments based on concepts learned in class. Kamarthi is a very good professor. A bit dry at times but that could be because material is also dry. Would recommend.
He cares about his material and students. He is knowledgeable.

Moody and unorganized. Grading has no consistency. If he likes you it will help. Doesn't cover material well. Dives into detail on stuff he knows well but barely skims over stuff he hasn't spent time to learn. Very little passion for teaching.

Most boring professor I ever had in my life. Lectures are painfully boring, he has no motivation and zero passion for the subject. Crazy amounts of work and very useless guy in terms of preparation for homework. Avoid at all costs.
Mr. Kamarthi was thorough in his preparation for the classes, he graded fairly and he encouraged student participation.
Top professor at NEU

Horrible. I worked in manuf. on co-op before this class, and i was excited to get into some more details. But his lack of communication and poor teaching left me stunned. Stay away from this class if you can. Who gives students a packet of computer code 20 minutes before class is over and says "learn this for tomorrow's midterm"? Way to 'teach' us.

Prof Kamarthi was a really nice guy. But the student (IE's) treated him like crap, they complained about everthing. The Tests were straight out of the problems sets he would go over in class and post solutions to on blackboard. What more could you ask for. Course was not what i expected from description but i did Enjoy the lab. Really nice guy!
Very good professor, Knows the subject and has descent personality. I would love to take a course with him again.
Good preparation for the stuff that he teaches...and not too bad homework too. I'd say he is too decent a teacher to be true.

This class is so easy. All of the tests are open note, online, and at home. There are two other big assignments and video-based quizzes, but all are really easy. You have to go to class or else you won't know what is going on because her presentations don't cover all of the material. I always looked forward to this class so definitely take it!
Her quizzes and tests sometimes reflect the opposite of what she says during her lectures. However, she is amazing and you can sacrifice a few points for her teaching.

If you guys are even a little bit sus about social psych... take her. I showed up to every class and while I didn't need to, I had a good time. She's very passionate about the subject and tells a lot of personal stories that may crack ya up. She doesn't answer emails often which may be a bit weird but just take her I promise it's easy and shes nice

Her class is so intriguing but always involves info that are not relevant to the class. Although there is no attendance, you'll need to be in class and take notes, or otherwise, you cannot get the correct answer from the slides. She gives a lot of extra credits, so this class should be an easy A course.
If you just takes notes you'll do good. Just go to class and pay attention.

Are you breathing? Do you have a pulse? Then you can get an A in this class. Spikes rambles quite a bit, but the material is there as long as you go to class and take good notes. And if you want another thousand points added to your grade, ask about Mattie Jo.

I love her. She is very funny and energetic. She gave out many extra credit opportunities and her exams were online with open notes. Her notes are a bit lacking and doesn't record her lectures but overall I loved her class. Homework was pretty easy but hard to understand at times but if you do it right you get a 100.
show up with a pulse and take notes and you'll get an A, all exams are open note and she gave 20 points of extra credit throughout the semester

Professor Spikes's class is one of the easiest ones I have taken in college. Her lectures are engaging, and she provides all of the test information within the lectures. The class consists of two open-note exams, two open-note quizzes, and two written assignments, all fairly easy. She also gives 20 points of easy extra credit.
VERY easy A. Showed up to class twice. Lots of extra credit. Exams are open note and pretty self explanatory.

What a sweet woman. I enjoyed every class with her and especially loved when she brought her daughter. Class could get a bit redundant sometimes but nothing worth complaining about. Easy A with minimal effort!! Loved her so much.

This was my 2nd class with Spikes and she's amazing, the class is based on a group project you complete throughout the semester and all of the assignments build to a final presentation about an organization you built with your team and how you implemented the various assignments from before, it sounds like a lot but it is fairly easy
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Epitome of a hot mess - both her and the course.  It's a crazy ride through the semester. Lack of teaching efficiently is made up for by extra credit so minimum win?

Professor Spikes was overall a very engaging professor. She kept going in circles and re-explaining the same topic repeatedly, until you absolutely lose track of what she was saying. That being said however, she cares about her students and has a lot of different projects and extra credit opportunities. Tests are async and open book and open note.

Professor Spikes is a great professor, super engaging, a truly caring individual, and very knowledgable about social psych. Attendance isn't mandatory but she leaves blanks on the slides so it's in your best interest to attend and take good notes. All exams and assignments are online, take-home, and not too difficult, I enjoyed this class a lot!

Professor Spikes is a knowledgeable but polarizing instructor. While her lectures are engaging, the exams are notoriously difficult and she can be unsympathetic. Attendance is vital, and Unstuckstudy proved helpful for exam prep.

Easy A. All of her tests and quizzes are online and take home.Lecture slides are incomplete so you MUST attend class and take notes because her exams are based off lecture and the textbook. You don't really have to do the chapter readings because exams are open note/book. She does play a lot with the wording in her exams.  Exams are multiple choice

Enthusiastic about the topic and cares about the class. Leaves blanks on the slides so going to lecture is necessary to complete her open note tests. Assignments were easy but since she creates her own questions they are sometimes worded weirdly. She takes a while to grade but is overall a good professor.

I loved having professor Spikes for social psych. She is ready for class every single day and is very personable and very enthusiastic about what she teaches and applies it to real world situations she has experienced. Attendance isn't mandatory but the slides only give you so much information so it's vital you go to class. Tests are also open note

she's great at keeping you engaged in class but sometimes lectures can get carried away. I didn't show up to 2 classes and fell extremely behind. Tests and quizzes are all online but solely on the content she says in class (no on the lecture slides), so you have to show up. Gave easy extra credit and little homework, and one presentation.

Tests are basically only on her lectures and you can't find the notes outside of class. Besides that, there were 2 exams and 2 quizzes all online, 3 applied learning assignments, extra credit, and no final exam. Not too hard, just annoying when you miss class. I'd take her again just because the class will be better now that I know how she operates

Professor Spikes is a very enthusiastic and knowledgeable teacher. The class was very lecture based with online/open-note quizzes and tests. Attendance is important because there are parts of the slides that can only be filled in by what she says in class. She also offered a lot of extra credit and bonus points which was nice.

Attendance wont affect grade but i said yes cuz she leaves the notes empty so you gotta show or you wont know whats going on. 
The textbook helps but it isn't vital to what she has on exams, the notes are.
Unsympathetic tho, I missed an exam as i was in sick and she didn't let me make it up till i fought her on it for a week. I had a hospital note

This is a pretty easy class. Professor Spikes is organized, lenient, and luvs using her daughter as examples (srry if I spelled that wrong). Lovely person who gives out online open note quizzes which u can take at home. Assignments aren't even that difficult, just some SAR to the video she makes you watch. There's also no final exam for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I never went to class and got an A+! Interesting lectures from when I did go and the quizzes/tests were based on what she said in lecture so make sure to go sometimes! She gives tons of extra credit!! Great professor, relatively easy class!

Professor Spikes is an amazing professor and is passionate about what she teaches. The most important part of doing well in her class is going to lectures. Her slides are great but she leaves blanks purposefully on them that get filled in with what she says in class. I am definitely going to take another class with her this year.

This was one of my favorite classes to attend. She provides plenty of extra credit opportunities, writing assignments are graded super fairly (just put in effort), and test questions come directly from the lecture and the book. Attendance is the most important part of this class - the rest will come easily! She is super kind and accessible as well!

Prof. Spikes is the worse professor in the psych department. Not at all understanding. Attendance mandatory, doesn't record lectures and doesn't complete information on slides to make sure people attend. reviews.comment: Really enjoyed this class

reviews.comment: Professor Spikes is a good professor. She gives good lectures, and exams are online and open notes. Still, she can be confusing at times, and exams are weirdly worded. She seems passionate about her job but can be too much at times. Still, it was a very easy class.

The questions on her exams are poorly worded and oddly very detailed so while the class itself isn't hard, the exams are. When we review exams after we take them, she's always so weirdly defensive and blaming others..? Like other people said, she presents herself as understanding and nice when she really isn't. This class felt like a waste.

Professor Spikes presents herself as approachable and kind when in reality she is the opposite. Her tests are worded poorly, her lectures are rambling, information is out of date, and "office hours" feel more like an interrogation. A single small mistake can result in you failing an assignment. If you want to learn, don't take her class.

reviews.comment: worst prof ive ever had. extremely difficult to understand in lectures and on assignment details. Will take off so many points without explanation and will ignore you if you ask for clarification.

She has no idea what she is doing. Her whole class is based on tests. And the questions on the tests are so poorly worded that it is almost impossible to do well. SHE IS SO UNHELPFUL! She doesn't care about her students at all and is an INCREDIBLY TOUGH GRADER! She is trying to make you fail. Worst teacher I have ever had.

THE WORST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD!!!! SHE IS SO RUDE AND UNHELPFUL. Literally so rude and refuses to meet with people if they have questions. She is mean and not accommodating. I email her asking for help and she basically tells me to figure it out. DO NOT TAKE HER!
Questions on the tests are worded VERY poorly and make no sense. Inconsistent with textbook and lectures. Lectures are all over the place and hard to follow.

Professor Spikes is funny and will provide lots of examples for concepts - very helpful. She will also give back points on quiz questions that most of the class gets wrong - also helpful. Her class only had three tests and two assignments without extra credit, so there's that. However, if you attend lectures and take notes you'll be just fine.

She has serious pauses in lectures and sometimes students ask questions and she gives very vague answers.Her ppt is always missing important information. The course grade includes three tests and one assignment. The test time is unreasonable. There is no extra credit, and the final grade is determined by test. If you want an A, avoid her!

Nice person. Easy grader. But man oh man did she pick the wrong profession. She is just bad at explaining concepts, no other way to say it. If you want to actually learn more abt the concept she is teaching, avoid her. If you want an easy A, take her class.

In her online classes, she does not record her lectures so make sure you are paying attention. Even though her tests are open notes, her power-point slides do not have all the information you need. She was very sweet to my class and would go over the tests if there was any confusion and would even give us points back. I loved having her!

- Inconsistent with textbook and lectures
- Questions on the tests are worded VERY poorly and if you ask why, she gets upset/rude
- Textbook reading every week is heavy, tests don't line up with textbook

Possibly the worst professor I've ever had, including elementary, middle, and high school. Incoherent speaker, contradicts herself constantly. Lectures are legit all over the place. Every test she gives she messes up on at least two questions, then blames "technology" for her mistakes. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS!

reviews.comment: She is caring but her grading is completely unfair and I feel like she picks grades out of a hat. I got depressed.

She is a hilarious professor, but her personality does not make up for her poorly worded exams, inconsistent grading, and random assignments. She gives many chances for extra credit, partial credit back, and office hours, but we should not have to rely on these things to bring our grades up when she can word the questions properly from the start.
She has zero consistency in anything that she does. Test questions are poorly written and open ended assignments are graded on imaginary criteria.

Spikes was energetic and made it clear that she was excited to teach the subject every class. Tests could be confusing because they could be worded weirdly or contain really specific details from the book. However, she was usually open to extra credit, rewording questions, and working with students 1:1. She definitely cares about her students.
Professor Spikes is all over the place. Every class session starts late due to her having technical issues. Exams are really easy and open-book.

She carries a charismatic and uplifting attitude into class. Most of her lectures are causal and loose, but she sticks to her agenda in the end. Also, her lectures involve a very in-depth understanding of the science of Social Psychology from both a theoretical and application perspective. The quizzes involve critical thinking so pay attention.

Professor Spikes is so funny and chill! She does go off topic sometimes to talk about family, but she still manages to stick to her agenda. Her quizzes are mainly on topics discussed in class and are based on critical thinking, but as long as you attend and take notes, its not too bad.

By far the worst professor I have had at Northeastern. She is very disorganized and always makes mistakes in her slides and exam questions. reviews.comment: She was so disorganized and offputting. I went into it really interested to learn about social psych and by the end of the semester, I was mostly frustrated and disappointed. Sorry, but it's time to put her out to pasture.

Presentation heavy, need to take good notes on lectures to pass. She talks very slow and is off topic a lot. But taking notes is important because there is some info that is important. Professor Spikes is absolutely hilarious. However, her lectures are often disorganized and go off-topic. Her tests are based on class material, so make sure to show up to class. She also gives out a lot of extra credit, so show up for that too. You don't need to read the textbook to get an A, but you should skim through it for the take-home tests.
Prof. Spikes is hilarious and keeps class interesting. She genuinely cares about her students and the course material.

I don't know why there are so many negative reviews. Professor Spikes is genuinely nice teacher who cares about the material she is teaching. She also really wants her students to learn and is very understanding. She is flexible and will work with you to make sure that you do well in her class and enjoy the material.

Horrible speaker. You might not think this matters, but her inability to speak her thoughts coherently makes her lectures not make sense. She just rambles on out of order or just reads off of her powerpoints. If you ask a question, she will just say "it's in your textbook". Her powerpoints are vague and confusing. Professor Spikes is probably the worst teacher I've ever had. She knows nothing about the material she's teaching. She simply reads off the powerpoint slides and if you ask her a question about the material, she'll deflect it because she doesn't know anything about Social Psych. The only way you'll learn anything is by reading the textbook.

Worst teacher Ive ever had. This class was extremely disorganized. Often sent multiple emails in a row changing course content. I had to teach myself all the information using the textbook and whatever random notes she gave us in class.

reviews.comment: She is hilarious and she gives a lot of extra credit. I really enjoy her lectures, however, you do have to read a lot to get a good grade on the tests.

This entire course was sporadic, scatter brained & poorly outlined. The students often had no bearing of the material that would be on the exam between required readings and lectures. reviews.comment: She is really funny but sometimes she talks too much

Karen is a wonderful professor. Despite the fact she doesn't provide visuals, her note outlines are VERY helpful! If you write down everything she says verbatim you will do really well on the exams (or if you get notes from a classmate who does this you'll be fine). Don't show up 10 minutes late to class if you do come - she WILL call you out.

Professor Spikes is infectiously enthusiastic about the material she teaches. The lecture outlines make it so much easier to take notes and know what's important to learn, although she doesn't post study guides.  Tests can be tricky, but she throws out questions that most students get wrong and grades the article critiques generously.

I loved Professor Spikes! My favorite professor. I have her for two of my Psychology Classes back to back and I never get bored. She is funny and makes the class enjoyable. She also lets everyone share their opinion and very open to questions. Her lecture outlines are so helpful and write word to word of what she says. Tests are easy as well!

Shes really nice&funny. She has already made the outline for you and you just need to go to class and fill them out as shes talking. WARNING! Write notes down word for word, on the test shell use what she said on the outline, and in order to get full credit on the test try write things as SHE said them.
She gives really helpful lecture outlines, which is all she grades on, so you don't really need the book.
Really funny, down to earth professor. You must attend lectures if you want to pass the tests at all since all the tests are based directly off the notes from lectures.

Lectures were way too long considering Prof Spikes just reads off of a lecture outline. If you ask a question she'll reword your question for an answer. Doesn't use power points, and the humor gets really old and distracting. Studied for 40 minutes before each exam and didn't go to class, passed. Super easy. She's nice, it's just a weird atmosphere

Come to class and take notes because exams are lecture-based.  She's a very entertaining person, but the class lacked depth and inspiration. She would hand us all of the information and explain things with silly examples...  And yet I couldn't expect an A because the quizzes were so poorly worded!  Really dampened my interest in psychology.

Come to class and take notes, because the tests are based on lectures.  She is entertaining and funny, and her information is pretty straight forward.  However, I felt that the class lacked depth; that dampened my interest in psychology.  Also, the poor wording on the quizzes made it difficult for me to predict my grade despite studying well.

As long as you come to class every day and pay attention, you'll get an A. She provides lecture notes for each class, where you just fill out everything while she's talking. For the exam, she tells you exactly what will be on the exam and what specific numbers and figures you need to know. Professor Spikes is super enthusiastic and friendly as well
Easy class. Really interesting. She makes it fun. For the exams you just need to study what she tells you to study and you'll be fine.

Spikes tries to be funny and make the class laugh rather than actually teaching. She relies on the lecture outlines completely. I missed a quiz because I couldn't get back into the city after the bombing and she refused to let me make it up and gave me a zero unless I came back in the summer to take it. Easy if you do it exactly her way.

Had her for developmental (honors) and social. both classes are easy and have no finals. prof. spikes is also really funny. not exactly the best teacher ever, but she provides lecture outlines that are very relevant to the tests

Easiest class of all time. People who say that they don't like her lecture style are jacked up (as she would say). She knows her information well and knows how to make it interesting. You'll get an A if you take notes (which she makes VERY easy to take). She's a very nice person and I find her hilarious.

Spikes should not be anywhere near a classroom. class is funny at times but terribly annoying and frustrating the rest of the time. She does not know her subject, relies on cheat sheets to teach since she doesn't know the material. class is unchallenging, so easy. She does an excellent job at ruining one of the most passionate subjects in psych ...

I hadKaren Spikes  for social psych and she is a wonderful teacher. She is very helpful and hilarious. She gives plenty of extra credit. She is very strict with getting to class on time and she also doesnt like to receive unnecessary emails. I loved her class and I would definitely recommend her.

Professor Spikes is seemingly impressive. However, if you actually analyze her lecture style, you will realize that she is simply trying to be funny, and not exactly aiming to foster real learning. Initially I felt that her lectures were great, but I realized, that was just due to her southern accent being funny. I would not recommend her class.

The most inept prof here. Easily intimidated, highly unread on the subject, degrading in her teaching & boring. She plagiarizes the entire course from the book. If you want an easy A & don't mind paying 4k for what is a true insult & disgrace to proper learning, you'll fit right in. For anyone here that seeks the slightest challenge, look elsewhere

Prof. Spikes is awesome! She is really helpful and makes the class really interesting. You'll get good grades as long as you go to class, read what she tells you to and review your notes/attend the review session.  HIGHLY recommend.

I received an A in this class, but it was no thanks to Spikes. Plainly put, she is a complete lunatic. Its almost like she hates her students and she treats them like they are worthless. She is just rude and completely unhelpful. I would not take her again.

Professor Spikes is awesome! I highly recommend taking her, she really wants you to do well and gives you EXACTLY what you need to study for the tests. Her tests (in Psych of Women anyway)are all multiple choice and not difficult if you read the materials she suggests. Highly recommended, A++++

SPIKES IS AWESOME! I love her class. She makes the material easy to understand and interesting. She's funny & will make you want to go to class. She hands out note packets and tells you what parts of the book to focus on. She cares about her students & is incredibly helpful!

Spikes is a great professor.  She's so much fun and always makes class interesting.  She provides you with exactly what material you need for the tests and is very clear.  She is hilarious and makes every class fun.  She tries to get you out early when possible and is real fair in grading.  She cares about her students and is a great lady! :)

I have taken I/O, Develop., Social, & Psych of Women w/ Prof. Spikes. She is an exceptional teacher. Some people complain about her classes being a waste of time or not challenging.But she teaches you to be self disciplined &learn on your own so you can have discussions. I have learned alot from her courses. She is thorough &  to the point.

Took 4 of her classes. Don't take any of them if you are looking for DEEP discussion. HOWEVER - she makes class time effortless and funny and if you're looking for a leisurely 4 credits, take hers. Don't be fooled by her style - you need to study! Nice professor, surface-level information.
BEST TEACHER EVER!!!!!!!!

Her class is very straightforward - she hands out packets and reads off of them, occasionally filling in a sentence.  I hate this style.  It feels like I'm in middle school.  She is also not very good at answering questions probing further - often either deflecting the question to the class or just repeating the question in her answer.

Social Psych. She's a very kindhearted, intelligent and funny woman....but maybe not the most efficient professor. often gets off topic and wastes a lot of lecture time. she's a very easy professor and a lot of fun otherwise!

Professor Spikes teaches Develop., Social, Psych of Women and I/O. I've taken the first 3 and they were 3 of my favorite classes. She makes the material worth learning and her humor adds a lighter mood to the usual boring lectures. Her courses usually has 3 exams, not sure if that's changed. I/O I hear is horrible. Definitely take 1 of her classes!

Don't listen to these negative reviews. If you're laid back and have half a brain you'll love this class. If you require the teachers help for elementry school material then yeah dont take her. Spikes is a good teacher, she may be flighty sometimes but at least shes honest. In class she acts like shes just hanging out with friends.

I/O Psych.  All the notes you need are on the handouts. She's fun and a huge character, but you may learn more from the book.  The only reason I didn't have an A was  I couldn't get the hang of her tests; most MC only have 2 choices. She likes the "none of the above" answer too.
Great Teacher

I took all of Spike's classes. She hands out study guides, and you just fill in the blanks as she speaks. She's nice, funny, and experienced in the field. If you study you will get an A. but you have to go to class to get the notes.

The class is very easy. Professor Spikes is fun, and I do not find her offensive at all. If you want to be challenged and learn alot, I would not recommend this class. But if you want a fun and easy class that will get you some credits, this class is great.

This class is seriously the biggest waste of my money and time.  Karen is a HORRIBLE teacher and does not challenge you what so ever. If you like to just pay for a degree and not actually learn maybe this class is for you. She is super offensive and makes you watch terrible emotional movies with little application.  What a WASTE!
Interesting class. Spikes keeps class fun and the tests are very straight forward.

Knows material well, but does not come to class prepared to teach it.  She's absurdly offensive and inappropriate sometimes to the point where you may want to just walk out of the class.  The class was essentially common sense and not in any way intellectually challenging.  Try to take it with someone else if at all possible.

She's so amusing, and making class fun. Her psych 101 class is hysterical. I never opened the textbook once. Just memorize the study guides thoroughly and you'll get an A. The tests are T/F and multiple choice. She legitimately will tell you what's on the test a few days before. I feel like most of the material is common sense.

I just finished my 3rd course with her and she is awesome!  If you go to class and take notes on the outlines she gives you it is hard to not get an A.  She keeps you entertained and engaged in lectures.

This class is offensively bad. If you have ever been unprepared for a presentation and figured you would just B.S. through it with the little knowledge you have, you know what Karen Spikes feels like every day. All she does is read off of a packet, even then she doesn't seem to know what is happening. Horribly ambiguous test questions as well.

Fantastic professor.  Best teacher i've had at NU.  this is a good class, she types up the notes for you, tells you ahead of time what is on tests and what reading needs to be done specifically.  great teacher, knows her stuff keeps you listening!
Incompetent. Doesn't seem to have any knowledge of the subject despite having a PhD. Can't answer questions without getting confused and frustrated.

Interesting class and very easy, but she is so unorganized it's really frustrating. She just expected that we didn't do our homework every time she assigned something! You can tell being a professor is far from her main priority.

This is one of the best teachers I have ever had in my entire life. She teaches well, gives you typed notes, she is hilarious and class is very interesting. Class is not easy and you do have to try to get an A.  She is very clear and prepares you very well for the test. You will leave this class with the knowledge necessary to be an amazing parent.

Spikes is awesome.  She tells you everything you need to know for the exams and tells you what to avoid studying.  She's from the south and jokes around a lot in class.  She's a riot.  Take her class.

Just completed my second class with Professor Spikes and I would definitely take more if I could. I completely disagree that she is not a "real" professor. She's very knowledgeable of the subjects and integrates learning into a more relaxed and interesting environment. I've definitely learned more in her classes than in some boring lectures.

I disagree with the comment below me. Spikes is an incredible teacher. I have her for Developmental right now and I've learned so much about the subject. She's funny, keeps the class alive and appreciates our opinions. There's only 3 exams, no midterm or final. Notes are type written for you and she gives extra credit at the end. She's awesome.

Professor Spikes is probably one of the greatest teachers' i've had, no BS. She gives type written handouts and prepares you very well for her exams. Btw there is no midterm/final. I dont consider it an easy class, you do have to put effort into taking notes and understanding the material. I'm definitely taking her Social Psych class next semester.

She was an awesome professor.  The class wasn't boring which might have had to do with taking it during the summer.  Grading system is set up in a way where you can easily get an A.  2 writing assignments and 2 tests.  Definitely take here for Intro to Psychology.
Excellent!

Best professor for PSY U101. This was my third time taking this course and she is better than both of the other professors (Snyder, and a guest professor). Attend all classes, follow along with her outlines, and interact to get an easy A+.

Great prof with an easy-going/humorous personality. Her lectures are interesting, extremely helpful notes.  I've really learned a lot from her. Pay attention in class and use her notes, sometimes the textbook to help you understand the materials, and you'll do well on exams!

This woman has no place in the classroom.  She is meant for the business world and should have stayed there.  Her classes consist of handing out an outline and then reading it to you and filling in some trivia she brings up.   Unwilling to help you with office hours or missed tests, her time is too valuable....
I really enjoyed this class. As long as you show up to class and fill in the outlined notes, the tests will be pretty easy and straightforward. She is a good teacher and she is pretty amusing.

I didn't buy the book or study and made an A. She doesn't seem to be very bright at all and is condescending to anyone who provokes a subject beyond the text. I many times believed that she didn't know what she was talking about and became extremely confused and aggravated when questioned. If you know how to read you're qualified for her position.

Her class is ridiculously easy, but she does include questions on that test that she expects you to read from the book the night before (the only time you use it) and has never discussed in class.  She can also be pretty disrespectful...she's funny, but sometimes you really want to **** her out.
Very easy professor. She prints and gives out handouts for all her lectures. Her tests are really easy and she always cuts down the reading to almost none. Very easy going and willing to help.
Very easy class, super nice professor. Someone interesting subject; however, most of the material is common sense. I definitely enjoyed this class though, and the easy A.
Very fun and interactive despite going through two foot surgeries.

took her developmental psych class last yr and loved the class. easy A. lots of fill-in-the-blank outlined notes. anything on the tests, she's gone over in class and adds a few bonus questions in, too. research project was easy and graded fairly. animated teacher. passionate about subject. go to class, its worth it. take her for yourself and see :)

Nice southern lady.  Very funny, i love going to her clases. Show up for classes, keep handouts. Fair, easy tests if u study a bit. Makes you want to go to her class. I took her for two classes and i'm taking her for another.
i love her......she is an awesome prof who really has all her material together and organized. doesn't test you on random crap like some other psych prof at northeastern

Horrible. How did this woman get a teaching degree? 1) Her developmental psychology class is more of a How-To Guide to Parenting. She doesn't discuss the material in any sort of scientific light. 2) She is far to easily intiidated by her students. No Comments

Retard.  She may have gotten her degree in Psych, but she received her Masters in diarrhea mouth.  She gives you the lecture outlines, which the tests are on.  Easy teacher, but not a good one.  Hates confrontation. As a biology major who's intersted in Neuroscience, I take offense that a professor such as this has slipped throught the cracks.  F-
One of the greatest professors in this school -- full of energy. She makes class fun, and she knows what she's doing.  Just respect her and she'll bend over backwards for you.
No Comments
It's an easy class if you go.  Don't miss her hand outs cuz she won't give you more until test day.  Tests are easy.  This was my 2nd class with her.  She's great

Completely incompetant. Her idea of a lecture is read aloud fill-in-the-blank notes. Unwilling to help; during her office hours she complained about my visit. For a class with mostly frosh, she had no idea what we were capable of; assigning difficult research. You'll pass only bc of mindless tests.

This is the 2nd class I have taken with her and I plan to take more. She really knows how to teach and this is such an easy class. She gives a lot of extra credit. People who don't like her just aren't doing well in her class. If you just study the notes, it's really easy. Take her.

I've taken every class she's offered. She's awesome!!! Anyone who can take a class with her, make sure you do it. There aren't too many professors as cool as she is. She swears and everything in class. Always talking about her crazy family...She's just a lot of fun!!!
Hands out fill in notes for each section and explains exactly what is on every test. Very energetic and keeps you entertained and interested.
