But expects you regurgitate his perspective on exams, so show up if you want an A. Boring lectures ONLY. They're outdated and sometimes repugnant. Used M*A*S*H as contemporary example once. Personal politics interferes with quality.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lecture-heavy course on what is sometimes outdated material. Unfortunately, little feedback/criteria is given for assignments, so you won't know your grade or what you're doing incorrectly. Hard to get in contact with via email but made himself available to students via office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Mayer taught an outdated, untruthful, and sometimes inappropriate Mass Media and Politics course. For most lectures, he went over an hour talking nonstop, never pausing for student input. The only graded assignments were the midterm, final, and an optional paper. Prepare for a conservative perspective and content 30 years out of date.

Avoid this guy. Mayer is smart but is awful at teaching. Class is exclusively lectures in which he regurgitates what is on the Canvas slides. You will have to teach the material to yourself. There are only 4 total assignments so you cannot afford to mess anything up. He grades very hard and will find ANYTHING to take points from. Take someone else.

Class is purely lectures with little participation or group discussion. Lectures are boring and sometimes lack important details (which are on midterm/final). Only 4 assignments the entire course so if you do poorly on one you need to do amazing on everything else to finish with a good grade. Office hours are helpful though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures and slides were so boring and hard to pay attention to. Only 2 graded assignments, then the midterm and final. The final is worth 40%. He is very knowledgable, with high expectations. He is also very old-school and not tech savvy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable. Lectures well and provides real world examples for everything. If you're coming in with a basic understanding of American Government you do not need to attend lectures. Will occasionally say something very suspicious, but is overall a nice guy.

Just lectures the entire class period little participation or interaction. Can be extremely boring however he is nice enough and is knowledgeable and the class is extremely easy if you put in just a little effort. The midterm and final do make up 75% of the grade though and the last 25% is only a couple assignments.

He does not take accountability, has an awful attitude, grades far too difficulty, and is extremely bad at accommodating people regarding disabilities, etc. He also forces purchase of newest editions of book. Heavy reading, awful lectures, do not waste your time.

Professor Mayer is an amazing lecturer. He is interesting and great at structuring information that helps when studying for his exams. Personally, I don't like when my classes have few grades and rely heavily on the midterm and final but I know a lot of people in his classes preferred this. If you are a confident test taker than go for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Do not take American political thought unless it is required for your degree. the work load isnt impossible, but the quality of work he expects for an A is unattainable unless you participate a ton. There are only like 4 grades the entire semester and he takes a long time to get them back. I wouldnt take this class again

Professor Mayer is adorable and SO knowledgeable on what he teaches. I have now taken two classes with him, and intend on taking more of his classes if I can. If you show up to class and take notes, you WILL get an A fairly easily. He is a clear lecturer and interesting to listen to for a 100 minute period, and he is really nice and accomodating.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Mayer is not prepared to be teaching from a virtual setting. Lectures were boring and grade was made up of three tests. Took over a month to get exams back. Was upset his class was too easy this semester and blamed the TA. Accidentally released final exam questions to the entire class before the exam. Purposely gave worse grades on final.

Professor Mayer gets a bad rep in my opinion. He is a conservative professor but doesn't let his views affect lecture in my opinion. I don't agree with his beliefs, but it's refreshing to not have a liberal professor teaching their views to students as facts. Class is easy and he is a stand up guy. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great lecturestake solid notes and you'll be good for exams. However, there were only 2 graded assignments for this class with an optional 3rd, which was daunting, and he didn't give good good feedback on the work. I was worried about taking this class as a first year, but I made it out fine even after skipping a couple classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Does a commendable job towing the line between his own political views and objectively teaching the course- and what he doesnt know about the course material isnt worth knowing. That said, his accessibility and email response rate need improvement; he isnt always at his office hours when the syllabus says he will be. Otherwise very good prof.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Was fine. Easy intro level class. Maybe he would be more interesting in a less basic class. Don't buy the textbook you don't need it.

Prof. Mayer is an excellent professor. I have taken two classes with him and both topics were thoroughly explained. If you genuinely do not take this class because he's one of the last conservatives on campus, consider a change in major. Very interesting, intelligent guy. Engage with him and it'll be worth your while.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Typical lecture style class. Professor Mayer clearly explains the material, so if you take notes you will do fine. Don't bother with the Logic of American Politics book, use your notes and you'll have all the information you need. You'll need Debating Reform for the recitations though.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: My fave thing about Dr. Mayer is that he's adorable (like how old people are adorable). He stutters a lot and wears sweaters that match the shirt he wears under and he draws TERRIBLY. Pretty much just take notes all class; he likes to give stats/graphs too. We had 1 piece of hw all semester. DON'T BOTHER GETTING THE TEXTBOOK. It's all in the notes.

The year is not done but American Government is a great class that Mayer lectures very well for. Lectures do not have Powerpoints but are clear and he makes what he's talking about interesting. There are very few assignments but his format and content at least for the midterm are unbelievably vague.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great guy, knows his subject very well. He has well thought-out lectures, and although he assigns readings most of the test material is from the lectures themselves. Only a midterm and a final exam, but he's a fair grader and gives you time to study. Lectures are long, but super interesting if you pay attention. Great professor all around.

great professor- definitely my favorite at northeastern. the lectures are really clear and well organized and the exams are a direct reflection of the material covered. it's very fair, no suprises. mayer made what could have been a very boring 100 minutes a very interesting time. i really don't have any criticisms, great guy, great class, period.

Mayer is a teacher's teacher. The guy clearly loves his job, and sitting in lecture with him is a pleasure. He class is all about connected historical narratives that are easy to comprehend. Tests can be somewhat quizzically graded, but you still learn a lot. I'd recompensed him for any class but quant.

He loves teaching this class, People who don't like him, are just cranky because you don't appreciate the awesomeness that is William T. Mayer. Super Clear, great guy, character, just an awesome teacher, super fair. I admire him greatly and he is very intelligent - Am Pol Thought

Mayer is the man.  Attendance not required but why would you want to miss class with this guy?  He is THE most fairest grader/professor ever.  Aside from being extremely intelligent,  his classes are very interesting.  Study like crazy two days before each test and you got a A or a B.

ok teacher. grades based on a midterm and a final, no attendance necessary, not really necessary to read the texts because he goes through things in class. pretty organized so easy to take notes, just listen in class and you'll do fine. funny guy, but not the most interesting nor intriguing class
good teach

he was awful. i attended every class, took down every note, restated what he said and more on the exams and got graded POORLY along with others. kids who didn't show up got good grades, unfair. boring as hell. will never take another class with him.. class was based on midterm+final. marked things wrong that he said were right in lecture.. AWFULLL.

Yes he's a dork, BUT he knows his stuff. Lectures are straight forward and his notes are clear as air.  Attending class makes it easy to pass without reading the "required" texts. NO HOMEWORK OR PAPERS. Take notes and regurgitate them on exams and you'll do well.

Listen up chumps... Mayer is the man. You can complain all you want, but until you've gotten one of his priceless gambling analogies, a show of his rightwing fury over Bill and Hillary, or some sarcastic response that solidifies his place amongst the academic elite, you just haven't lived. Give the man a B+; except when teaching Quant; that's a C-.

This is simple. He's rude to the point where its almost funny. NEVER take quant. tech. with him because he openly admits he hates teaching the class. BUT his other classes are easy, he's an easy grader, doesn't care if you're there or not, and makes the tests easy because by his own admission he hates grading/paper work.
Interesting class if you read the material. Gives clear notes so you know what to expect on the exam. Pretty easy grader too.
Get over the fact he's conservative- he's extremely smart, and unless you're a total cretin, you should easily pass this class.  It's very interesting, and if you take notes, the tests are a breeze.

Boring+Republican. Stutters like mad. Knows his stuff tho. only midterm and final for grades. I didn't buy the book, and never read anything for the class. If you go to class and takes notes, you'll do okay. Not particularly polite or helpful, but grades easy.If its between him and someone bad, take him. I hear hes not good w/ quant tech.

I'll make it simple. He's one of the worst teachers a Northeastern. Almost funny how rude he is. Way to many things to get into so the bottom is never take this class.For poli sci majors, try to wait until somebody else teaches it. During the first class,he made it obvious he didn't want to teach the class, so don't expect any extra effort from him

I can't figure out why this guy is allowed to teach this class. The class is the worst class I've ever taken. He doesn't make any sense and grades way too tough. Seriously, he'll yell at you for asking questions. Normal? Basically picture this; he's like that mean grade school principal you had. Terrible class, don't take it.
Light course load, only midterm and final.  But I didnt learn as much as i would have liked. His teaching style is a little lame.  If its between him and something you know sucks, take him.

DO NOT EVER TAKE THIS CLASS. He's rude, and very unhelpful. The subject would be simple, but his notes are unorganized and his examples and explanations do not make sense. This is the worst class I've ever taken in my life. Seriously. Unless you're a political science major, NEVER TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!!!!!!!!

Okay, my last review was removed so maybe I was a little too truthful and descriptive, I'll tone it down. He's difficult to tolerate and he teaches a boring subject (Quant Tech) I apologize if I offend anyone but its a tough class solely due to the professor and his "Sicilian" accent. Unless you're Poli Sci major, avoid at all costs.
No Comments

Worst Class Ever.  He went over things about fifty million times and it was sooooo boring.  The final should have been easy but there was stuff that we had never gone over in class.  I would have liked the class so much better with any other professor.

Worst Class Ever.  He went over things about fifty million times and it was sooooo boring.  The final should have been easy but there was stuff that we had never gone over in class.  I would have liked the class so much better with any other professor.
hes a smart man, but not helpful at all, was very unclear, and added things on the final that we never learned.
I loved this class. Not the most exciting teacher, but very smart and helpful. Note: He's a Republican.

Very boring but organized notes. Literally no work, just midterm and final, most reading can be skipped too. A nice class to get a decent grade in that should be simple for most politically inclined students
No Comments
TOTAL DORK, the type u beat up for milk money..big blak was cool tho, Xcept 4 da Pru deal...meyer is a total nerd but since he is my neighbor its OK...lawn MOWERS FOR LIFE GEEK

To warn you you will be bored to tears, but it's worth it for the limited amount of work and easy exams, for the most part the reading is unnecessary, easy A
Difficult class, lots of reading, and an impossible final.  What can i say except i might have learned something...and gotten a B, stupid ****

This guy was awesome. Class was engaging, and he made it easy to learn. All exams were online, including the final (They were extremely difficult, though, so don't think that just because it is online you can get away with anything). But overall, a great guy, and I learned a lot.

Amazing professor!! He explains concepts very clearly with many examples. Also applies finance to future careers as well. Class consisted of homework, 2 miderms, and a final. All were online with difficult questions, but he graded very fairly. I recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at Northeastern. He explains concepts clearly and makes even difficult topics easy to understand. He goes over the basics to ensure no one feels lost. Exams are fair and manageable if you pay attention in class. He is also very understanding and accommodating if you miss work due to a family emergency.
Breaks down concepts so that all his students understand. Always asking questions to engage students. Very accessible during his office hours and beyond. Great professor.
Prof is always happy to help with homework during office hours and always accessible to clear doubts

Tbh he overcomplicates a lot of the math, i ended up teaching material to myself cause he is not great at actually explaining the concepts. If you stick to the textbook and study a LOT for the exams you'll be fine. His class averages a B+ and he curves, which is nice. Just sad I didn't learn much from him.
Honestly, he goes pretty fast. I think he teacher directly out of the textbook. He's chill and understanding, his midterm and final were hard but at least takehomes.
Best professor I've had so far. He wants his students to succeed. Very knowledgeable and engaging and always available for support. Hilarious!!
The best professor for FINA2201!! He is hilarious and genuinely cares for his students and wants everyone to succeed.

The curve is insane and you're guaranteed a B if you submit everything, however, that's because its really difficult to do well on each exam and they're the only thing that really matters. overall most people felt really positive about him and a B+ or A- is totally attainable.
Always accesible to help students. Truly wants the students to learn.
He wants his students to succeed in his class and is very passionate about Finance. If you ever need help or have questions he will make time for you to ensure you understand the content.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great person who truly cares about his student's succeeding. He is always more than happy to answer any questions students may have, and thoroughly goes through problems in class. Professor Mukherjee also makes an effort to help students outside of class time and is always willing to work with you. Highly recommend!

Professor Mukherjee is one of the nicest people I have ever met. He is super caring, and truly wants his students to succeed. He is very knowledgable of the finance industry and would 100% recommend any class that he is teaching.
This guy is the literal GOAT. My favorite professor at Northeastern. Super nice, super knowledgeable about finance industry, overall just a great guy. Could not recommend him more.

AMAZING professor. Explains things as much as you want him to. Homework gives a good idea of what tests will look like and has multiple attempts most of the time. Lectures are easy to keep up with and he simplifies things to make you understand. Always available for questions & clarification. Wants you to learn. 100% recommend taking him.
Sick guy, very clear and makes class great. Easy tests and homework.
Nice guy, assumes kids are smarter then they are though. Will happy answer any questions you have during lecture, but it takes a couple tries to get him to really break down the issue you're having.

reviews.comment: He's a very good teacher. Super understanding and caring. Tests are not that hard, but they are proctored.

Depending on the student I am sure he is great. He's okay but if you ever go to office hours can be rather unhelpful most the time, he is one of those people who is so smart he get what you aren't understanding. There's way worse profs for this course. Best recommendation is to just bring your cheat sheets to him before the exams and ask advise.

professor lupi is the definition of punctual, it can be a little overwhelming at times but he teaches exactly what you need to know and in the best way possible. show up to lectures and do your homework and youll be completely fine, the class is not very difficult
Lupi is a very nice guy, and if you go to office hours can be quite helpful. But, the midterms are out of 25 points (same as quizzes) and everything was graded ridiculously hard
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were incredibly boring, and fast paced. He gave zero conceptual explanation of new topics. Studying for tests was just memorizing the steps for each problem. I feel like i learned nothing, if you want to understand the material take prasanth. midterm MCQ questions test you on edge cases that he mentioned once and never showed up again.

Boy oh boy... where do I begin... Bob Lupi is a great teacher if you pay attention to his lectures. He makes the material digestible and easy to learn. HW is not mandatory but quiz problems are basically the same as the HW problems, so do them anyways. Great course and great professor, even though he might seem grouchy. Also the textbook is goated.

Hard to follow during lectures, but extremely good during office hours. I am not sure whether he or the TAs grade quizzes and tests, but the grading is the harshest I have ever seen. Also, he enjoys questions that you have never seen before, and you need a deep conceptual knowledge to figure them out mid quiz/test.

Bob Lupi is probably the best LinAlg/DiffEQ teacher at Northeastern right now. He's straightforward in lectures. Does not use slides; teaches straight from the chalkboard. Quiz every week (DO THE OPTIONAL HW PROBLEMS HE GIVES! Matches quizzes/exams really nicely). Drops the 2 lowest quiz grades. Pay attention in the lecture because he can go fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great dude, learned a lot from him, the best professor i've had at NEU

He is a very efficient professor. Goes extremely fast and is very thorough in his teaching but he doesn't like slowing down. Moody and his contacts freak me out a little but he is extremely effective. Take his class, he will help you understand the material.

Lupi made a confusing class very easy. I showed up everyday and was able to get an A in the class. He is very knowledgeable and will answer any questions you have. The quizzes are just like practice problems in lecture and lie the homework problems
Decent class. I took it in the summer, so it was very test heavy. Homework is optional but is good for practicing for the quizzes. Go to lectures = good grades.

Took bob for diffy q, fantastic professor. Clearly knows what hes talking about and comprehensively goes over exact content/problems that are present on quizzes and exams. Cut and dry homeworks are very similar to problems on tests, highly recommend.

seems like a run-of-the-mill tenured teacher but he will sit down with you during office hours(GO!!!!), lays out the information in digestible portions in class, and is a very articulate and fantastic teacher.

Very boring class. The quizzes and tests are fine, but the TAs this semester are pretty harsh, and the average for each assessment tends to be around 75. I dislike his teaching style because he literally just goes through example questions. I understand why he does this, but he never gives higher-level conceptual overviews for anything.
Smartest guy ever and lectures are very easy to follow

Bad at empathizing with students, gives poor explanations to questions that leave you more confused. Unless you have an intuitive understanding of the topics already he is very bad at bridging the gap and helping students understand.

Lupi is a good teacher, and by far the best option available for this class. His lectures are FAST and can get monotonous, so make sure you keep up, but the lectures are also very to the point and give you what you need for the quizzes/exams. A word of advice: USE OFFICE HOURS IF YOURE CONFUSED! I did not and got a C :)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lupi is amazing! He explains concepts really well, and has a great sense of humor. Only critique I have is sometimes his lectures get a bit monotonous. The quizzes are easy (although I only rarely got a 100), and I only did homework an hour before to prep for it. Final was very long but not bad at all (worth 40% of grade though).

Such an amazing, simple, and organized professor! He gives plenty of examples throughout class as well as posting optional homework practice questions (with answers) and when it comes to the weekly quizzes, they are very straightforward. He can seem a bit scary to approach but he's a great guy.

Professor Lupi was great for a basic math class. Lectures are concise, and he doesn't try to "trick" students. He sometimes came off as condescending but in good spirits. There are quizzes each week, and the lowest two are dropped. If you go to class and review in-class and homework problems, you should never have an issue with the quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super clear, organized, and gives a lot of resources to practice. Loved the class structure and he gives the opportunity to drop your 2 lowest quiz grades. Don't ask him a question that's on the syllabus though...
Lupi was great. He was very direct with what we needed to know, taught well, and prepared us for every exam. The weekly quizzes were never bad, and we had two drops. Awesome professor!
Lectures were clear and understandable and tests and quizzes were fair. Best professor I've had for any class ever, wish I'd had him for Calc 2 and 3.

This is my king. Spends every second leading up to weekly quizzes just drilling the material and giving you practice problems. Midterms are a very clear reflection of the final. Posts so much extra practice with solutions.

Lupi was fine until before one of our last quizzes, he collected our formula sheets that had some printed information and some information we had to write ourselves, and proceeded to RIP THEM UP IN FRONT OF OUR FACES. There was a new sheet on the back of the quiz, but not written the same way mine was obviously since I had made mine catered to me.

Professor Lupi is genuinely the best math professor at Northeastern. His lectures are so effective in teaching such difficult concepts, and he goes really fast, but they are so useful. I rarely struggled with understanding concepts in his class, and his quizzes and tests are fairly straightforward too; highly recommend him!

Lupi is a solid professor. Each lecture builds off the other, and things are nominally explained once, so do not miss a single moment of a lecture. If you go to the lecture, take notes, do the homework, and do the practice exams, you will be fine. He seems tough on the surface but is a nice guy.

He is the best math teacher I've had so far. He is very clear on how to do the math and is accessible via email or office hours. He literally made me like math again after a terrible calc 3 teacher. I would do the homework if you want an A, but it's not required. Show up to class, pay attention, and do the homework; you'll do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are very straightforward. He briefly explains the concept then goes directly to practice problems for the rest of class. Homework is optional, but the quizzes are pretty much exactly like the homework and in class problems. Grade is only based off tests and attendance is optional, but the lectures build off of each other

Professor Lupi's lectures were clear and organized. He respected our time and was not afraid to let class out early to coordinate with the lesson plans. Lots of examples done throughout class and homework was optional but very helpful. Quizzes and exams contained the same types of problems found on the homework. Probably the best math prof I've had
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lupi is amazing at teaching Math2341 - there was never a concept I did not understand because of him. Definitely take him periodt.

Prof lupi is a good teacher. He explains things well. sometimes, he seems to zoom through problems very quickly, but will clarify if asked. I don't recommend skipping because in this class things snowball fast
Lectures were boring and hard to follow. He didn't give any practice quizzes/tests. Was kind of rude when people asked questions.

Pretty standard math class at NEU. Very easy to follow lectures. Very nice guy overall. Never does too much content in one class. Most quizzes are copies of the practice quizzes but with the numbers changed. Linear can be a hard subject but this course doesn't go too far in depth.

Lupi is an amazing prof. His lectures are very straightforward and the examples he goes over are usually reflected on the quizzes. If you take good notes and do the homework, this class should be pretty doable. Go to office hours if confused, he's super helpful.

Professor Lupi is a pro at this. His lectures are so fluid and clean and he doesn't waste any time. He doesn't really teach much about the theory or conceptual stuff but I think that is better because you only learn what you have to learn. Definitely one of the best options for diffeq. Exams are relatively easy so are quizzes.
Clear cut teaching methods - easy to understand. Explains in a clear fashion. Cares that you understand the material

This guy knows one of the hardest math subjects from the top of his head and really checks in with students on homework problems or questions before a quiz. His pace was really well and lets other know what to expect on the quizzes or exams. Great professor for Diff Eq

Professor Lupi does an amazing job of explaining difficult math concepts in a very clear and easy to understand way. His quizzes are straightforward and easy if you do the homework, and there's nothing unexpected on them. If you go to the lectures, take good notes, and do the short homeworks, you will be totally fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lupi is pretty good. He gives clear lectures and assignments but never explained a deeper context, more of a plug-and-chug class, which made it harder for me (though easier for some im sure). Sometimes came off a little condescending but this class is pretty straightforward, especially if you do the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Lupi is a great professor--his lectures are clear and he goes over many example problems that mirror how he structures his tests. He does tend to call on the same students, but that's really only because they volunteered answers multiple times.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Lupi was overall a super chill and amazing professor. He did a ton of practice during class and made sure we understood everything before the quizzes/exams. He didn't look at the Zoom chat too much, but he was always clear with his work and expectations.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great class. His lectures are very example-driven, which I personally find helpful. If you feel comfortable doing the problems in lecture / on the homework, then quizzes and exams shouldn't be an issue. Also, he has a great fashion sense

Lupi is a perfect professor for math. He moves quickly but is extremely thorough, and he's always willing to pause and answer questions. I highly recommend attending every class and writing down everything he writes on the board, as each lecture is packed with info. Though he goes quickly and gives lots of information, I never found it unmanageable

I love Professor Lupi! He's great at explaining things and always makes sure students understand the material. If you have a question he'll always answer it fully and thoroughly. He really cares about his students and is really accommodating. He also wears awesome sweaters every class.

Was the best math prof Ive had before COVID19 sent us home. He gives great lectures that are concise and clear. He makes everything set up so his practice problems in class are what you see on quizzes and tests. Often lets us out early. Grade professor (wasnt that helpful for online but in-person hes top-notch)
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I love professor Lupi! He's a bit quiet and he has to warm up to the class, but he is a really great teacher. When I was stuck on something, he was really patient and helped me through it in office hours. One of the best math teacher's I've ever had.

just like for every other math class, you should do the homework. lupi does his job as a professor (which I guess makes him above average) but I've had plenty of better professors. he's kind of awkward as a person and talking to him is weird. although I did learn in his class, I attribute most of it to the homework, not his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Lupi is a very good professor. His lectures are always clear and he moves at a good pace. He is a very fair grader, and his class does not require too much outside work.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lupi boils complex math ideas into simple and repetitive math operations. He can answer almost all your questions. His quizzes and homework are very reasonable and they definitely prepare you well for the final. All you need to do to succeed in this class is just to go to classes and do his homework. He is also very accessible outside of class.
Goes too fast, harsh grader. Won't take again.
He teaches good.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Lupi is a Mathematical GOD. One of the greatest Professors at Northeastern hands-down, take him and you won't regret it. Succinct, easy to understand, accessible, willing to help and work with you- made Differential Equations easy! Quick grading turnaround also a plus.

Lupi is such a great teacher. I had him over the summer and I loved this class. I definitely could've done better but that was my fault. He made the class really easy and understandable. Just do the homework and you're prepared for the quizzes. He genuinely wants what's best for his students.

reviews.comment: Lupi is the man. I took differential equations with McOwen and dropped the class after the first midterm - I was doing so bad. Lupi boils down the material to a level that is easy to understand and grades very fairly. Doing the assigned homework is crucial to success, and quizzes and exams are straightforward if you study.

reviews.comment: Gives very clear, detailed notes. Can be a bit condescending when people ask questions, but he clearly knows his stuff. Your grade may depend on the TA your class has, as they're a bit inconsistent with grading. Some take off more points than others for the same mistake, but if you bring it to Lupi's attention he's pretty good at clearing it up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Lupi explains the process of differential equations very clearly. He gives clear step-by-step procedures and all quizes match examples he does in class. However, he doesn't really explain anything conceptually. Not a good choice if you want conceptual understanding, amazing choice if you just want to learn the procedure & material. Easy A.

Very well-versed in the materials and efficient with the notes & class time. Fair testing, and went over proofs satisfyingly. Could have explained the concepts more though- the class was very computational and things were introduced often in a "memorize this" sort of way. Liked his style and honestly wish he talked about himself some more!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: My biggest challenge with this class was the fact that there were about 100 students in one class.

Great professor. I wish I could take him again but he only teaches this class. He tells you theory, then examples, then you practice the same stuff for homework, then you already know how to do all the problems on the exams and quizzes. This is how a math class should be: clear and understandable. You have to go to class; just write down everything
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lupi is the best prof I've ever had. He explains things very clearly & step by step. He cares about his students, but I can see how some see him as a harsh guy; he's just straight forward but tbh its kind of amusing in class. He's ALWAYS prepared, shows you everything you'll come across on hw, quizzes, & exams. He's known to best for diff equ prof

Lupi is the best math teacher I have ever had. He is clear and concise in his lectures and his examples are the hardest things you'll see beyond the occasional homework problem (that has a video). The weekly quizzes are helpful (and from the hw), and if you do better on the final than one of the midterms, he'll replace the midterm grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Lupi is a solid professor for straight up learning the material. Has very organized lectures, is very efficient with time and sets you up well for the quizzes and tests. Can come across as a little cocky and cruel, but will still help you out if you request it. Doing homework really helps on the tests and quizzes as well, as he will point out.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Lupi is one of the best professors I've had.  I'm not a math major and DiffEq was one of my favorite classes last semester.  His lectures are fast-paced but very straightforward.  His office hours are a huge help.  Every problem I remember seeing on tests was either an example or in the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Go to the classes, he explains everything you need to know and you don't have to read the textbook as long as you have your notes. His example problems 99% of the time cover all of the types of problems you will ever see, and that 1% is covered by the video solutions to the textbook problems. Nice class, a good break from Calc 3.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fast pace but as long as you attend class and do homework, there's nothing to worry about. Very straightforward professor
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Super helpful and does tons of practice problems in class to really enforce the material. the curriculum itself is a bit fast paced but he does a good job of making sure that you learn it all. The class does require a bit of effort though.

Bob Lupi is an excellent professor. His class is exactly what you want in a math class: straightforward grading expectations, quality lectures and accompanying notes, and help available when you need it. If you make the effort to go to his class it is not hard to nail the quizzes every week and do well on the exams. Highly recommend him!
Fun guy, seems to actually care
He knows how to teach. The quizzes like homework and examples he gave in class. Go to class, you can get an A.
Favorite professor. Favorite class. You can't beat Bob Lupi. Guy knows his stuff. If you come to class, you get an A

Prof Lupi knows how to teach. One of the best math professors I've had to date and he will stop the class to make sure a student understands. If you go to class, you'll understand. He explains it well and the quizzes are like problems he does in class.

Excellent guy, excellent professor. He is clear and concise and willing to explain anything twice in his lecture. The quizzes and exams are on par with the rest of the course, he is a pretty lenient grader. Best math professor I've had at Northeastern.
He could be very abrupt with students. But he knows the material. Textbook used if you miss class or want to do the homework. Much more doable class than Calculus 3.

Im majoring in mech engineering and minoring in math so ive take a lot of math classes. lupi is one of the best math professors ive ever had in my life. concise, clear, freakin smart, freakin easy, excellent at teaching, excellent at explaining, knows his stuff, very helpful and his quizzes are mad easy. very lenient grader. AMAZING PROF.
He's very helpful and flexible. He gives good in class notes. Easy weekly quizzes. Homeworks are optional. A bit overrated tho when it comes to clarity, but I recommend him.
I wish we did more derivations of formulas. But all in all, he was a great teacher. Maybe a little boring if math isn't your thing. Very smart and patient.
Great Teacher. Made subject matter really clear and didnt try to trick you on any quizzes. Always willing to take questions even stupid ones. Definitely want to take a class with him again.
This guy is the man. I wish i had him for all my calc classes. Very clear, knows his stuff, helps you get your grade up if you need. Very clear on what is expected on quizzes and tests.
Best Calc. teacher ever.  The material in calculus 2 is difficult, but Lupi is a great lecturer.

Helpful, knowledgeable, provides a lot of examples, quizzes are kinda tricky, grades leniently, midterm & final are doable, sometimes he makes things complicated on the board, but still overall as a good professor.

Extremely efficient and clear.  Come to class and expect to pay close attention for greatest benefit. Quizzes and classes are both fair and short.  He ends class early for some of the easier stuff, but only if everyone claims that they understand.  He knows he's a good teacher, so don't expect sympathy if you skip class and fail.

Extremely efficient: Gives you a quick run down of the material, does a bunch of examples, quizzes you every week. Great at explaining things; some of the quizzes were a little hard though. Overall great prof., especially if you're not great at calc but need to take it.
Great Professor. One of the best that I have had at Northeastern so far. He makes everything very easy.

He is a very good teacher, although his personality is a little dry. His notes are extremely useful and necessary. He provides plenty of examples to help guide you through the class. Don't skip class or you will fall behind. The class is not easy but his teaching makes it fairly straight forward and doable. Good teacher, would recommend.
By far, without a doubt, the best professor at Northeastern. Makes everything seem so easy.

He enters room. Answers homework questions. Does new examples. Allows class to try new examples. Assigns homework. Lets everyone out early if it was clear to everyone. Bang bang bang, super-clear, very effective.  Best math teacher possible.

I took calc 3 with him... He is very reasonable and patient... Just attend his classes and ul be fine... One of the better Math teachers... Quizzes are similar to homework assignments and if u think ur unfairly graded speak to him and he give u a good explanation or give u more partial credit...
Excellent professor. He always provides clear example of the subjects.

an AMAZING teacher! Best math teacher in the dept that i've found so far. organized, fast paced, easy to understand, outlines the subject, and basically awesome. homework collected, weekly quizzes, 1 midterm + 1 final. VERY HELPFUL! TAKE THIS CLASS!
Very fast paced and extremely informational.  Everything is broken down and organized in a fashion that is easy to learn a difficult subject.  Nice & helpful.

This teacher explains math in the most simple way possible, and is always willing to answer your questions. However due to his complete and total lack of personality, if you ask a stupid question he will make you feel like a stupid person. Tests and quizzes are difficult, but should be no problem if you do the homework and listen to him in class
No Comments
Lupi is awesome! Lots of notes, but they help a bunch. Not a lot of homework, not strict either. Easy quizes because they're basically all hw problems. Tests are tough but fair. Fair grader, too.

Lupi seems kinda austere, but he knows his stuff, and if you take good notes and pay attention, you'll know it too.  Helpful with homework, and fairly so at office hours, but know exactly why you're going before you do.  A no-bull teacher, and a fairly easy A.
One of the best. Can take difficult material and make it bearable. Pleasant, helpful, and clearly wants his students to learn. Register early, his classes fill up quickly.

Excellent calc teacher. very enthusiastic about teaching. examples are very good and help with the weekly quizzes. if you do the homework assignments its easy to get a 100 on every quiz. the midterms and final were reasonable too.
very nice, very helpful, tends to talk quite fast while giving a lot of notes
Great teacher, makes me actually go to class.

Explains mathematical concepts very well and his expectations are clear.  I never once had to turn to the book to learn the material; he taught all the important things in class.  If you pay attention and do the homework you'll be fine.
Extremely helpful and always very fair with quizzes and tests; homework optional only counted towards if a grade is borderline; highly reccomended as a professor

LUPI IS THE MAN - he explains everything really well and is very helpful in aiding people who don't understand the material. If you do the work, the class isn't very hard and there's never a lot of work. RECCOMENDED
not bad teacher but avoid if possible

Soukos is passionate about his subject but a bad teacher. Take any other biology class and save yourself. The class topics are very interesting, but it is all memorization not learning. He talks down to us, gives us 175 slides to study for an exam, and expects us to do well. I felt uncomfortable coming to class, and attendance was mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had. Thinks that he's better than everyone around him and will talk down to you. His class is a waste of time. Once tried to talk to him but he spent 20 minutes boasting about how “straightforward” he is. Lectures are useless and boring and exams are just based on random bits of information he expects you to memorize.

By FAR the worst professor I have ever had. Class is structured terribly, lecture slides are stolen straight from Google images. Teaches nothing, just expects us to memorize random bits of information with no context. Extremely condescending and very often wrong about simple things. Didn't even teach the second half of the course.

Grading criteria was not adhered to. Graded 1/3 of the total assignments, and overall grade was given "to adjust for the number of As in the class." Regularly boasts about his intelligence and achievements in class.
He is an amazing Professor who made me love Business/Professional Speaking. His classes are fun, and I loved the entire in-class activities. I recommend 100%
Professor was very nice but lectures were not very engaging. Most of them felt very basic however we did have some interesting class activities and in-class speeches were overall good practice.
Practice your speeches and show up to every class. He has hidden extra credit for hidden in assignments and lecture slides. Very lenient with grading and late assignments.

Professor Nwogwugwu is really really amazing! He's so kind & caring, & genuinely wants us to grow & become better speakers. The class wasnt that hard necessarily, & Professor makes it enjoyable. Despite being at 9:50am I still really enjoy this class & look forward to it during the week. HIGHLY RECOMMEND YOU TAKE HIS CLASS EVEN IF ITS NOT REQUIRED.

Great professor and classes are super fun and engaging, but attendance is optional. Grades for speeches are mostly based on how well you can memorize the information and convey it clearly. Lots of work with speeches/interviews every other week with assignments, and journal entry's added to the mix. Wish he was clearer with grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super easy and understandable lectures. The speeches that you have to perform will drive you nuts, it's super stressful to be memorizing all of the details that you prepare for. You will be worried basically throughout all of the speeches. Even the job interviews, it will literally fear you. The whole class is basically fear of your grade.

I would definitely say take this over the summer (before fall of freshman year) or summer (after freshman year). Very light class compared to the other presentation requirement classes. I heard public speaking online is very light as well. Persuasion and Rhetoric has three exams, so don't do that. There's five speeches in this class.

The class was pretty easy overall. He's super nice and the assignments aren't hard at all. The only frustrating part was that he posted assignments really close to the due date or didn't clearly say when they were due, which made it a little stressful. There are 4 individual speeches, one group speech, a mock job interview, and a final project.
He was a loving professor who wanted the best for us.

honestly this class was easy, but i respected daniel as a professor. this was his first year at northeastern, so i believe he will evolve into the dedicated professors northeastern cultivates with time. his lectures were humorous, he did not grade speeches hard and was accommodating when i had to miss class for dr. appointments.

he was a humorous instructor and had interesting personal experiences , he didn't create a syllabus until three weeks into the session. After then, he did not follow the syllabus.He would point out errors in our work during grading, but he never instructed us to complete the task in a certain manner in the assignment instructions they were vague.

His classes were common sense, boring lectures, except on speech days. We only had 4 speeches, so every other day was a lecture. He posts speech assignments very late, sometimes the day before they are due, and the due dates didn't match up at ALL with the syllabus. However, very easy to do well and you only really need to attend on speech days.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good class if you're very interested in the topic, but lectures aren't always the clearest and there's a lot of open endedness through the homework. Biggest part of the grade was group podcasts but we never got any feedback or grades on them on canvas. Definitely meet with him out of class if you want to have any idea what your grade is.

I took LARC 2340, super interesting course but it is homework heavy, with many readings and podcasts you have to listen to. None the less, its a super interesting course and i learned alot, and enjoyed it so much!

Nicholas is always available if you need help outside of class. The course becomes more challenging toward the end when the Story Map is due, but Nicholas prepares you well weeks in advance and is an excellent guide to help you complete it successfully and do well.

I took is Native American Resistance Clas(doesnt pop up for some reason)Really nice guy. Seems a little nonchalant sometimes but thats not a bad trait for a professor. Is really helpful and a really lenient grader. Just about anything can be a perfect score for him. Graded on a weekly podcast reflection and film-one pager among other assignments.

Did not really care for this class. It is interesting stuff if you are passionate about it but he isn't very clear during lectures and he isn't very organized with the material. You have no idea what grade you are going to get until grades come out. participation and attendance definitely matter. we did take a few field trips which were okay.

Nice guy but not very clear. The lectures are good if you're invested in the topic, but don't take his class if it's for a random elective. His intentions are good, but timelines for assignments shifted a lot and in general the guidelines/projects were so open ended people would get lost. Definitely go to class and participate during discussions.
He's nice, like dad vibes! Just put in the effort, and you'll be fine.

Lectors were very interesting as he would incorporate current marketing examples in almost every class. He was extremely understanding and helped his students succeed. He replied quick to concerns on email and was always available for office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hard class, if you want a GPA boost, pass, but if you want a good professor and to learn a lot, take this class. Around 100 mins of studying per week, give or take. Great guy, hard class, and not easy, but I enjoyed it.
He has no care for students

This class is challenging but rewarding. Nace is a very passionate and kind teacher who wants to see all of his students succeed, and is always willing to provide help if needed. Quizzes aren't difficult if you prepare well, and the final project is really fun. Work hard and come to class, and you will get an A. Would absolutely take him again!

The bad reviews don't capture him accurately. He is a very relaxed teacher, and if you need help or guidance, he will provide it. Quizzes aren't that difficult, and you should be fine if you do basic reading. Marketing is common sense; don't overcomplicate it, and you will get an A. I would definitely take him again.

PLEASE IGNORE THESE REVIEWS!!! Professor Nace is one of the most amazing professors I have had so far at Northeastern. He deeply cares about his students and how they're doing in his class. He responds very quickly to emails and has time to talk after class. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
HW assignments every Friday and an hour-long simulation every week. So give or take around an hour and a half of homework per week. Quizzes are easy, the final is take-home and online.

I swear every good rating on here he wrote himself cause the amount that he brings up his Rate My Professor is insane, especially the first week. reviews.comment: (For BC)... David Nace is the Goat... tough class but rewarding if you try. Exams were difficult but I learned a lot about marketing... important to do well on group projects/participate. Has inspired me to possibly pursue a career in marketing/advertising.

Overall you'll learn a lot but he does make an intro class a lot harder than it needs to be. Also don't really like his stance on GPA as he thinks it doesn't matter.

Prof nace is a nice guy but not a good teacher. His quizzes aren't THAT bad, but his final was crazy hard and everyone ik bombed it. I think he genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed, but he needs to brush up on some things lol.

passionate guy who tries his best to keep lectures engaging by encouraging class participation. He writes his own tests and quizzes, which are pretty hard as you can study for hours on end, but the quiz will be on something else entirely. I liked his class in general though.

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this professor. He's incredibly engaging—his lectures are so interesting I don't even need my laptop. One of the best professors I've had!

Professor Nace is very passionate about the field of marketing, and his lectures are engaging at times. People are overreacting about the difficulty of the course. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

Class is hard for no reason. It's an entry-level class, and it shouldn't be this hard. Nobody is getting an A in my class. He also says he will keep the average grade around B and curve down if the average is higher than B. Be ready to read 40 pages textbook for each class and extremely hard exams.

changes the syllabus every once in a while. Class is difficult for no reason. wouldn't take again for a marketing class

Dave Nace is the GOAT. He's lecture-heavy, but he engages you in the lectures and asks questions. He gets to know each person and really cares about you. I don't entirely agree with the other reviews. His lectures were engaging (stories, etc.), and I walked away feeling I knew more than prior to starting the course. Professor Nace was an amazing guy, very personable and lots of experience, but his class was very challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I feel it is fair to mention it was his first time teaching the course. HOWEVER, personally, I would NEVER take a course with Nace again. Ton of homework that is honestly just nonsense. Hes unclear on what he even wants from us and assigns random group work. Also, if you miss a couple of classes you have to drop the class. Bad prof. Do NOT take him

What are you people geeked for? David Ober was such a sweet and fun professor to be around. This is coming from someone who does not like English in the slightest. Not good, his teaching style is so flawed and does not make sense on why were writing like another author instead of training our own unique style of writing.

grading based on attendance in this day and age is crazy, not a w, find another professor guys
his grading strategy is iffy, not my cup of tea
only cares about attendance
didn't like this professor

Professor Ober is a nice guy, the class was just painfully boring and most of the work felt a bit redundant. He grades mostly for effort and completion so if you do all of the work and put effort into it you will be fine.

reviews.comment: Gives so much homework compared to other teachers

Good teacher but prepare for lots of homework. Each class has a reading and/or writing assignment due. There are a lot of group writing assignments in class. Learned a lot about writing and improved my drafting abilities but some of the work felt excessive.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: You will have to read a lot but it's honestly not bad, plus the reading he assigns are actually pretty interesting. Overall, I liked his class and totally recommend it for first year writing.

reviews.comment: A lot of work so after every class you have something to complete. Personally didn't find the class super helpful, but great atmosphere in class. Just do all of the homework and you will get a good grade. Don't worry about reading everything he assigns just skim a few pages and write a solid response. Such an easy and nice teacher. I literally got a 100.

reviews.comment: he's a great professor! there may be lots of reading and discussions but he's super helpful, kind, and is definitely one of the better writing professors. trust me guys they can definitely be worse, so why not actually learn something during a course like this?

Professor Ober was a pretty great English professor I thought. Graded essays very fairly, and provided rubrics that gave enough detail to let you know what to do, but enough flexibility to allow for some creativity in writing style. He was not heavy on grammar for ENGW3306, but I imagine things may be different for more writing intensive courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I am currently in College Writing with Prof Ober and it has really been an awesome college writing class. A lot of our class is discussion based, and he does an awesome job prompting us with questions and sparking good discussion topics. He's really such a sweet man and actually chooses interesting readings/activities, & work load is not bad!

He's decent at teaching. At times he can be boring, but he does try to get everyone involved and he's a chill guy. Course material is very boring though. Professor makes us read A LOT. honestly i skimmed through most of it since it was too much and very boring but you will be forced to discuss so at least skim the readings. you cant not do them.

reviews.comment: Nice guy, very helpful. Very reading heavy, but you can sort of get by without reading too much! Lots of talking to peers and reviewing others' work. Had some freedom in what to write about, but often had to stick to difficult topics like "panopticism".
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GROUP PROJECTS
