reviews.comment: Tests are very difficult and based on critical thinking. She's reluctant to help during office hours and seems unenthusiastic about teaching kids based on student interactions. I've heard dozens of complaints from fellow peers as well. Avoid if you can. If you have to take her, study hard and prepare to do worse than you think you will.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Super test heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is the main reason I wish RMP allowed 0 as an option. Honestly, it's a disgrace that she's still teaching after so many students have had the same issues with her. The entire course is memorizing every word she says, tests contain random specific details from one lecture, and you'll have to rewatch lectures after every class. -100/10

This class is pure memorization. I did not learn a single thing, really unenjoyable experience. do not recommend. teacher is nice enough but the way she structures her class is absolutely horrid. she is aware of the unfavorable reviews on ratemyprof yet still remains delusional and does not take the very real criticism into account.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you have MSPS, buckle up and get ready for a crazy semester. Don't get me wrong- she is a smart woman. She is also very detail oriented, highly specific, and she has very high expectations. Tests are crazy hard- you need to actively study for at least 10 hours to get an A. She goes through lots of material in very little time, so pay attention!!

If I could give Potts-Santone a zero, I definitely would. She makes no effort to help her students whatsoever, and will get annoyed during office hours. Her tests are insanely specific and it is clear she takes pride in watching her students struggle. Averages for tests are almost always around a low C and are never curved. Study as much as you can
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you have to take Potts-Santone's class I am so so sorry. Every day is the same- listening to her read lecture slides to you and expecting you to copy down every word. If you don't type up an exact transcript of each class, it'll be hard to do well on tests. 3 midterms + a final, no homework- just study. Make sure to rewatch every Panopto video.

Tests are heavily lecture-based, each lecture is roughly exact 65 mins long and easy to get lost Tests are pure memorization, so if you are not a good memorizer, it's hard to get a high score on exams. The whole course's grade is merely based on 4 tests: 3 mid-terms (60%), and a final (23%). No curve! Even the average of the class is really low
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I would say that Gen Bio 2 material is a lot easier than Gen Bio 1 stuff, so you can expect the tests to be a little easier. If you want to do good on tests, I suggest you look at the recorded Panopto lectures + study guide she makes and take notes/make flashcards using them both. Lectures were boring for me. Take advantage of the extra credit.

Do not take this class unless you absolutely have to! It's a boring class with a dull teacher. Lots of memorization. The entire semester, it didn't really feel like I was actually learning anything, just memorizing stuff and answering questions for a grade. Seriously, stay far away from this class, and avoid having this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If I could give her a 0/5, I would. Horrible class. All you do is learn about random organisms, and spit out really really specific facts about them on her tests. reviews.comment: Your grade is based on 3 exams and a final. No curve! Lectures are all basically her talking nonstop for 65 minutes. Tests are ridiculously specific. Boring class, waste of time

reviews.comment: Terrible professor, tedious class! Her lectures are stale and her tests are too specific. reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had! Go to her office hours! She's extremely helpful and accommodating. Especially if you're registered with the DRC, she's the professor to have! She's very understanding and really cares. I wish all of my professors were like her!! Lectures cover a lot of material but she's enthusiastic and interesting to listen to

Dr. Potts-Santone is clearly knowledgeable. However, her lectures, are poorly organized for the high level of memorization and specificity she demands. The final grade is almost entirely based on 4 tests, including the final. Very little application of knowledge. She claims she wants everyone to do well but also doesn't curve a 46% average exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I dislike Professor Potts-Santone's lecture style. It can get boring and she expects you to memorize all the lecture material for the exams. The exam questions are often confusing and more focused on application. She does give extra credit, which is pretty decent. The textbook could be helpful if you need a supplement to the lectures.

I loved Dr. Potts-Santone. I practically lived in her office hours and asked question after question, but it paid off. When you put in the effort, she will reciprocate and help you a lot. NOT an easy class by any means, but that does not mean that she's a bad prof. As long as you do what she recommends and study ahead of time, you'll be fine.

I believe in my heart that she is not a bad person. That said, she has a tendency for self-importance and condescension. The structure of her class suggests that she values conformity and mindless memorization more than learning. Prepare for extremely dull lectures in which she regurgitates facts and leaves little room for thought or analysis.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hated her, really doesn't help when you go to her because you are struggling. Makes it more hard on you to feel like you can pass. Doesn't give practice and exams are packed with applying and not definition. You learning from rewatching her recordings.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Potts-Santone is a very sweet and fun lady outside of class. Expect to work hard for exam grades! She is very clear about wanting test averages to be around 75. She is always available for office hours. Easy to skip class and watch the recorded lectures. Reading the textbook is not mandatory but will help a ton! Quizzes are all easy 100s.

Tests are very difficult and take HOURS of studying, purely memorization. Potts-Santone is so sweet and really cares about her students and their success, although this class was difficult for me and I barely got a C, I would definitely take again. She gives multiple quizzes based off of articles, so essentially opennote and online, per semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great understanding of the material, awful conveyance. She obviously has an incredible grasp of what she's talking about, but lord alive she can't tell you anything with sense. reviews.comment: While this was a diffcult class Dr. Potts Santone made it interesting with her excitement for the topic and interesting stories. You have to take notes and understand the lectures to even get a B in this class but overall I really enjoyed her teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Potts-Santone is one of those professors who take pride in how many students she can fail a semester. reviews.comment: It was my first time taking a biology class and she made me hate biology forever

Mary Sue was one of the best lecturers I've ever had. You could tell she really knew what she was talking about. Her tests were very straightforward and the content was fair. She also had a lot of extra credit opportunities.

This is a hard class but tegrity is a savior. She's a great teacher and is very knowledgable, you just have to put in the work and essentially memorize every word she says. tests can be tricky so start studying at least two weeks before the exam. you can't be lazy with this class
Lots and lots of memorizing
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Her tests are ridiculously hard. Don't take this class unless you have to, but she's the only professor who is teaching it.

I didn't even have her for a real class, I had her for my Intro to my major course, but I will actively try to avoid taking an actual course under her in the future. She advised us not to trust RateMyProf when choosing classes but I think it's because her score is so poor. She's disorganized and tried to be relatable, but it came off as annoying.
Lectures are heavy content, but at least she records them so that you can access later. You'll have to work to get a good grade in this class, but as long as you show some effort, it should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Speaks too fast and goes off on a tangent too much. Can be unreasonable when it comes to grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Make sure to re-check the information she gives during lectures because some of them seem to be incorrect. Her tests are really hard so even if you think you know biology, you don't.

Dr. Potts-Santone is absolutely lovely! She is incredibly knowledgeable about her subject and her lectures are very in-depth.  Tests are difficult, but they are very fair, there's just a lot of information to remember.  What I really love about her class is how she applies the information she teaches to medicine and current scientific data.

She gives a LOT of information during lectures, but uploads everything to tegrity. Tests are very fair. You know exactly what to expect, though some questions are tricky. So long as you review the tegritys and memorize what you're supposed to, you should do fine. Overall really enjoyed her class, she's very knowledgeable & material is interesting.

She talks a mile a minute, and every second is relevant to the topic. She gives an outline of the topic on a powerpoint, but there is so much more she talks about, and it pops up on the exams. She doesn't care for memorization; rather, she cares for how you apply the concept. She uses Tegrity which is super helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Took this class even though I had AP Bio credit. It was way harder than expected but she is a really good lecturer. She never stutters and goes over everything in such detail. The way to pass is to memorize literally everything she says. Good luck
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hated this class, tests are super hard and questions are unclear. Don't take if you don't have to.

Dr. Potts-Santone was a good professor. She lectures intensely but puts up recordings on Tegrity.  She grades fairly but only 3 exams in the class(plus few other assignments). She isn't too approachable but emails quickly. Recommend the class if you like the material and are good at memorizing large chunks of information.

The tests are pretty tough and very detailed, there is a lot of memorization required. She gives you chances to get points during the semester with online quizzes and random bonus points for coming to class (usually 3 per exam). Posts recorded lectures online which is VERY helpful because she talks too much and too fast during lecture.
Had her for Human Parasitology - tests are super intense, lots of memorization, super detailed PPTs, but she's a nice professor
Avoid her at all costs. She actually made me hate Biology.

Go to class. She posts her lectures online but its helpful to go to class because 1. You can get the information twice that way and 2. she gives bonus points randomly throughout the semester. Her tests are very tricky even though she says she doesn't want to trick you, so study often. Her class is hard but worth it.

She isn't really that bad. She uploads a recording of all her lectures with the powerpoints online which is extremely helpful if you don't feel like going to class at 8am or if you want to brush up before a test. She also gives extra credit questions if you go to class. Her tests are fine if you actually study.

If you ever have to take her class, good luck guys cause you will need it. Her tests are really tough and you really have to know the topics really well because she is really specific with her questions. Her multiple choice questions are really hard and the answer is really hard to find because the answers are really close to each other.
Awful Presenter. Just goes through powerpoints with clusters of information which is organized terribly. A lot of random facts about parasites thrown in the middle.

I used to like Biology before I joined this class. While she is clear in her manner of speaking her tests so far have been hard. She posts all of the lectures on Tegrity. Class is very boring and monotone and she does not stop talking for 60 minutes straight. Her tests are not easy. You can't just know the material and pass the test. Dont take her.

She is a good teacher and can present a lot of information clearly. However, she presents a ton of info. I took Gen. Bio and it probably should have been MicroBio. She spends a lot of time on specific details that are not all necessarily on the test.

I really loved the class and she was great at teaching it but theres a ton of information to learn so you need to start studying early for the exams! Two tests, cumulative final, and some assignments throughout the semester. Book was helpful but not totally necessary and definitely go to class.

Great prof, crystal clear directions and assignments, gives extra credit! Has office hours, go to them! The tests really aren't so bad, you just HAVE to attend class (not everything is in the tegrity) and read the textbook! As long as one puts medium effort, you should do fine. The lectures are extremely helpful. She knew me by name out of 150 kids

Oh, Potts. Very likable as a professor but as far as teaching style, it's straight reading off of the (quite pretty) lecture slides. Her study guides give you a pretty good idea of what will be on the test, but bet your butt that she will throw in tangent things that you would not be able to locate in the lecture notes. Study hard, kids.

She's a nice person but she doesn't hand out grades for free. She requires you to know every specific detail she covered, and her tests are full of trick questions. That being said, she does give bonus points for showing up to class.

Honestly avoid Potts-Santone at all costs. She is a robot. She reads off the slides and thats that. Her tests are 60 multiple choice you have an hour and not a second longer. Good Luck! For some reason its not good enough to know the material you have to be able to figure out her trick questions and riddles too! This class is made to weed kids out.

Dr. Potts Santone was absolutely one of the best, most organized and inspiring teachers I've ever had.  It's clear she puts time and thought into preparing her lectures- she made the material  accessible and fascinating.  I looked forward to going to class!  Tests and scope of material covered are difficult but fair- be ready to study!

Talks really fast during lecture, but records and posts every class via tegrity. DO NOT RELY ON TEGRITY! She gives extra credit sometimes to those who show up to her class on a given day because so many people make the mistake of relying on tegrity and those are typically the ones who don't do well. Her tests are tough,  but shes very approachable.
Her tests are really vague. You are expected to know every tiny detail about everything. Be prepared to work

Prepare to have slides with barely any information on them and then writing 2 paragraphs worth of information and terms in lecture that she doesn't put anywhere (including the textbook). When material becomes a little more difficult for some reason she becomes extremely disorganized. Notes are unreliable and the textbook is unreliable. Good luck
Use Tegrity

She really knows her stuff and is really excited to share that material with you. At first, I was angry w/ all the material we had to learn for 1 exam, then I woke up and realized that I am in college = Hard Work.  Test questions are like riddles, wrapped in enigmas- they are not direct at all. That being said, really know all material. Use Tegrity

Hands down the worst teacher I have ever had. Her tests are not clear at all. She does not scale even when the test averages are are in the 60's. She doesnt care about her students at all and makes it seem like she likes to see you struggle. I would not recommend her to anyone.

Very clear and helpful professor. Posts all of her lectures on tegrity so it's not that harmful if you don't go to class. Tests are straight from lectures and some references to the textbook. Overall, challenging but fair class. You get a good grade if you put in effort

Keeps the lectures interesting. Sometimes she only has 8 AM classes, but she posts everything on Tegrity, unless it's not working. Tests are VERY wordy. 63 extremely wordy MCQs in less than an hour. Fair distribution of grades. 25% goes to lab (which is easy in BIO2)

She's a very smart, clear teacher who doesn't just give away As - her exams are tricky, you have to really understand the material.  That being said, if you do the work you'll do well.  I love her lectures.

I had her a few years ago (pharmacy), and looking back on old tests, they were terribly fair. Anyone who wants to succeed as a pharmacy major will get used to this type of test, or fail. It can be a bit of a transition, but She is a lot better than what's coming- she speaks clear English, uses a good textbook, and reviews everythi
Her tests are very wordy and hard to think through. You have to study. BUt her Tegrity classes online are useful. Overall she was okay.

Tests are very confusing and you have to figure out what the question is asking before you can answer. You can tell she doesn't write her own test and probably uses a test generator. You have to really work hard which can be difficult with a heavy course load.

Her tests are very wordy and confusing. The material itself is not that hard, but the test itself is like a riddle that you have to solve to figure out what each question is actually asking. Each answer also has multiple parts to try and trip you up. Lecture is very fast paced and it is easy to fall back. Plan on using the textbook a lot!
Tests are very hard. Questions are very wordy and hard to understand. Study for the next test 2-3 days after the previous test. Use office hours and e-mail.

She is a really great instructor and knows her stuff.  Study early Sometimes she goes off on tangents and it becomes hard to distinguish what information is important.  You do not need to attend class, TEGRITY = AMAZING.  She is really nice and readily available for help and is always timely with email responses even on weekends.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
i went to class all first semester and got a c- in bio 1, went to class maybe 3 times 2nd semester, got a b- in bio 2. you dont need to go to class, but study for the tests use tegrity and the book.

had for both Gen Bio 1 & Gen Bio 2...at first the class size, information and her expectations might overwhelm you but I learned so much from taking this class. The book helps to reinforce her lectures but Bio 2 was more about the lectures. Her tests are tricky but after awhile you learn to distinguish what she chooses to put on tests.

She's a really nice lady and helpful if you go to her and ask questions. she does a lot for her students and grades the tests within a few hours sometimes. Her tests are really hard esp in BIOL2 but if you study a lot you can still get a good grade because she helps a lot by dropping and averaging lowest tests and quiz grades

Had her for general bio 1 and 2. You need to put a lot of effort into this class, but its worth it, and you will learn a lot. Very knowledgeable.  I would print out a copy of the powerpoint slides and take notes on them while rewatching the lectures on tegrity on blackboard.  After that is done, skim the book. A lot of work, but it will pay off.

Had her for BIO 1 and 2. Prof is super knowledgeable... Lectures can sound repeated and boring sometimes. Tests are very wordy- come prepared! Use textbook, studyguides, online book website flashcards to help study... Lots of effort = good grade.
Her tests are very confusing. she gives out quizzes and she does not curve grades. Very strict.

ok, honestly i had her for both bio 1 and 2 and all i can say is the more often i skipped class the better I did, find a way to study that works, and use it, she has no mercy for you if you forget anything.

Invert. Zoology is very hard. Very exacting and strict grading, no curve. Half the test is take-home, so it's easy to get a passable grade, but the in  class portion is very hard. Very nice and friendly. There is a LOT of material in the class; even at a seeming breakneck pace, we were still behind. Hope you know some Latin; vast amt of terminology

The only thing that is a drag is the 8am time slot.  but she is very clear and knowledgeable about biology!  its definitely possible to get an A, just take the time to really study.  It's college, it's obv not going to be easy but you will learn a lot!
amazing teacher. she kept the topic interesting at all times. you must attend class if you would like to do well, but she made everything interesting
very hard class, lots of information.  Seems very mean and cold in beginning, but if you go see her in office hours shes a really kind woman. dont miss class.
very hard

pretty good teacher even though lectures are extremely boring. be prepared for a rough semester if you have her at 8am, not the most pleasant thing to wake up to. her tests are very hard, and need a good few days of studying for a decent grade.

I was hard for me to sometimes follow him in class because he has a tendency to go through his lectures fast (usually finishing class before the class time is over yet still covering everything we need to know) but the notes he writes on the board make up for it 100% I even had friends from other classes borrow my notes!

Marco is a very clear in his lectures and doesn't waste time asking his students to solve problems individually in class. He moves quickly and spends the majority of the time in the class with his back turned writing on the black board, so be prepared to take a lot of notes. He also often will let you out of class early!
It;s a really easy class and he is a super chill professor. He gave us extra credit because he accidentally put something on our midterm that he said wouldn't be there.
He is a great professor, who cares about his students and is helpful in office hours and by email.
Great teacher but dont except any curve from him as the other sessions have two already and we have none
Awesome Prof. Definitely recommended.

While everyone I knew in other classes struggled all year, my class had very little trouble. Everything he explained made perfect sense and was very interesting and thus easy to remember and reapply. Taking good notes is extremely helpful and he makes it very easy, I just wrote down what he wrote on the board and I had everything I needed later.

Professor Marco Rainho or just Marco is an amazing professor. For someone who had to retake Calc 3, I'd say he made everything understandable and had analogies that made this class bearable. He is always helpful at office hours and makes sure you understand the content. Scaling your final grade is not his forte, You get what you earn :)

The digital textbooks (by Massey) are extremely confusing. Rainho bases his lectures off the books, but explains the material in his own clear way. I've never been exceptional at calculus but I really enjoyed his class. He keeps it fun. He provides homework but doesn't require it, so I guess that's nice if calc comes easy to you (unlike me!)
Very good overall, though in first few weeks he definitely rushed the material and didn't pay much attention to students. Later in the course this stopped, and he was fine.
Great math teacher overall! Funny, approachable, intelligent, and clear.

I love him! He has a dry, sarcastic sense of humor, and you'll hear him say "probs" and "funsies." The class itself takes a lot of effort, but he makes the class more entertaining. He doesn't like the book and complains that he has to follow it, but I like his methods better. Overall, awesome teacher!

Really chill teacher, has a great sense of humor and explains material well. Goes a bit fast though so you have to be attentive, took him only one week to know the name of each student in class. He is really helpful if you need extra help and quizzes are not too hard.

I am totally a Humanities student and math was never my thing, but Marco's class was one of my favorites at Northeastern. He not only speaks English as his first language (rare, I know) but is very clear in his lessons, friendly, and helpful. A great sense of humor and a serious dedication to knowing his students sealed the deal for a great class.

Rainho is pretty chill. He's sort of new so he bases his notes off of the textbook. His tests' difficulty are reasonable and he is very approachable for help. Rest assured, his first language is English and he has rather nice handwriting.

One of my favorites, even though he's new. Has a sense of humor and always willing to explain something again if you ask. He tries to get to known his students, he actually bothers to learn names which is appreciated.
This is his first year, he's cool. Calc 3 is hard though :(
Easy class if you have prior calc 1 knowledge, but if not get ready to self learn. She respectfully does not teach well and you have to self teach pretty much everything.

Just saw a review here that said that the people who gave negative reviews didn't put in the work which is not true. The class wasn't impossible by any means but as another review said, she just lectures and doesn't teach. You'll be fine if you take the class but you will have to do some of the teaching yourself. She is boring tho fyi

She is very nice but her study materials were unhelpful, she would put things on the study guide that weren't even on the test, and word the test problems much differently than the study guide. She also moves very fast in class, so if you didn't take calc in high school I would avoid this class. But if you study you have a chance at doing well.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrid experience. Prof was unhelpful and extremely demanding with no flexibility. Office hours were not useful, and it was hard to get help. Exams were especially tough, and quizzes and tests were graded harshly with frequent mistakes. Many students dropped the course. I would strongly not recommend. Take class with anyone else, steer clear of her

Professor Bai is great! Although she's not the most engaging, she teaches calc clearly with plenty of examples in class. Most negative reviews are from those who didn't put in the effort. You have to study to do well on the tests, but it's genuinely not that hard. I recommend her for sure.
grades were hidden by prof. poor communication. not very friendly, often was rude. final worth 40% of grade and tests worth 30% of grade. rest of that is quizzes, homework, and project.
ACTUALLY PMO SO BAD!!!!! We can't see our grades on Canvas so I have to calculate them myself! HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO KNOW HOW IM DOING IN THE CLASS AND DO IMPROVE WHEN I CANNOT SEE MY GRADE!

Very nice lady, but lectures were just her doing problems with no explanation. If you didn't do calc in high school then I wouldn't suggest this teacher. Your grade depends on quizzes and tests, with homework barely contributing to your grade. Gave study material, but the practice problems did not meet the difficulty of the problems on the test.

she doesnt know how to teach. all she does is examples on the board and we copy it down. she doesnt explain what she is teaching. she doesnt understand that we dont know the material. the other day I asked her a question, she came to me to help and then got mad when i still couldnt understand after she tried to "help". you have to teach yourself.

her class isnt the worst thing i've ever had but your grade is almost entirely made up of tests. her class is unbelievably boring. she talks so slow and has no energy or enthusiasm whatsoever. her lecture are fine but im not learning much from it. if this is your only option it is not sadie piatt bad, but i would get someone else if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor is very kind. There are a total of 8 quizzes, and the lowest one will be dropped. The grade is mainly based on exams and quizzes, which is not very good for people who are not great at taking exams. If you have any questions, just ask, and you can also find her during office hours. I think it's very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Weekly quizzes but they weren't super difficult if you went to class and did the problems on the textbook. Also drops the lowest quiz, but don't trust the bad ratings very fair teacher IMO.

She was one of the first professors to make me retain math. She's super kind and understanding. Weekly quizzes were helpful in testing understanding. I don't know why she gets bad ratings because she's always super clear and knowledgeable.

The lectures were very unclear and did not help me learn the material. The course relied heavily on constant quizzes without providing the instruction needed to prepare for them. Expect to teach yourself most of the content, and it will be especially difficult if you do not already have a solid calculus background.

I don't understand the negative reviews! She is very patient and open to answer questions.  As someone who isn't naturally great in math, I found this class one of the best I've taken. The lectures were pretty clear to me, and she repeats old concepts. Quizzes based on the homework assigned so they tend to be pretty fair.

She does not care about her students, when I went to office hours she was very rude and when I did not understand something she said "how can you not understand?? these are the most basic things" she isn't very kind i would avoid her.

She is not bad at all, super sweet and explains things well. Don't be afraid to ask questions in her class or go to office hours, she's very approachable and wants everyone to do well! If you struggle with math it can be hard, but she's not the issue. Only graded harshly on the group project

Just not a good teacher overall and her grading policy is awful. Would never take her class again if I had the opportunity as well as she is very difficult to understand because of her broken english.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super easy if you did calc in high school. The teacher is nice but her lectures are useless, i stopped going after a while. Quizzes almost every week but she takes them exactly from homework, just changes the numbers. If you do the exact homeworks she assigns the day before you will do very well.
The quiz she gives out have nothing to do with what she teaches. She also gives out quizzes every week which is insane. Never take her unless you wanna suffer through a sem.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very hard to understand with her heavy accent and she doesn't make sure the students understand the material. The pace she teaches at is too fast for students to learn and it isn't efficient. Her grade policy is god awful and I never want to have a professor like her again.
Terrible at explaining concepts

Super bad experience. Her lecture videos doesn't help at all and I literally have to spend extra time seeking resources outside of the classroom. Also doesn't respond to emails. Don't take her class unless you want a miserable semester

By far the worst class that I have taken at Northeastern. She cannot teach (its not the accent, she just cannot teach) She's constantly giving a test and she does not spend time helping students, and if you do, she won't actually help you. Horrible professor, unless your a math whiz don't take her class unless you hate yourself.

Straightforward lectures, was sweet and willing to stop and further break down a problem in class. Gave a good amount of study material for quizzes and tests. Available during office hours. Would sometimes host a class on Zoom.

This class if very manageable and actual first teacher to teach me how to use my calculator! Professor Bai provides study guides that are very similar to the exam. We have a group project that you can resubmit for better grade. There are 7 exams but she drops your lowest quiz AND test score! Caring professor and accessible outside of class!
tests you on stuff you never learned. good luck if you're in her class and aren't a math whiz. wish i had another prof. this sucked
One of the worst professors I have taken a class with at Northeastern. I have no idea why she is still teaching with all those negative reviews here.

There are weekly quizzes for this class and the class is too long for what you learn every class. Sometimes we just sit there waiting for the time to end instead of her letting us leave. She is really bad at explaining the concept and the only helpful resource are the videos posted on how to do the lessons but it's not even her videos.

Very, very, very poor teacher. Don't take this class unless you want to have a miserable semester and not learn absolutely anything. Hard to understand her because of her accent and she does not know how to teach.
she is the worst

Guys if you're not willing to study/ put in effort dont come to college lol. I agree it's easier if you've taken calc before but all the resources for you to learn are given to you. She's a little frustrating but math is math and if you study you'll be fine. Go to her office hours
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is getting a lot of hate on here but her class is not hard if you put in effort, not only in class but if you don't understand knack is a great resourse. There are quizzes every week but if you attend class and ask questions you should be fine. She's very nice and caring and always willing to answer questions and responds to emails fast.

I feel lost in this class. Vantage will cost you $139. Hard to reach outside of class, but there's no point anyways. I wish the “keys” she posted included steps instead of just the answer. I'm so lost lol

Honestly, if you're anxious about math or calc, this class is HARD. I am struggling so much. She doesn't answer questions directly, instead says "we covered it in class." The final (cummulative) is worth 40% which I think is abismal. Idk if all professors are teaching the concepts she is, but it honestly all seems more complicated than it should.

Do not take if you've never taken pre-calc or calc before. She's hard to understand and moves onto different topics really fast. Quizzes (no calculator) are in the first 15 mins of class and tests are 45 mins. The examples done in class jump from 0 to 100 on the actual tests. I've never felt so dumb as much as I do sitting in that class...
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: honestly, what was that?? Idk why no one tells you about how bad she is, it really is impossible to learn anything in this class because of how she teaches. I wish I had read the comments here before taking a class with her.

Honestly made calc so easy to understand. I think the lectures were very well explained, and we did plenty of examples to solidify learning. Definitely need to pay attention and practice, but I never felt overwhelmed by the workload or difficulty of the course.
If I had not taken calculus in high school I would have no idea what her lectures were about. She is a very nice person, but her lectures were near impossible to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: terrible at teaching w/ a heavy accent. goes too fast. If you leave for 5 mins she literally jumped 5 topics ahead. Quizzes every week, She moves onto the next topic before the quiz. Some of the things on the quizzes isn't even taught. Grade only depends on exams. Office hours didn't help. She includes Calc 2 & 3 into a Calc 1 course for business.

Dr. Bai is very caring, wants to see her students succeed in class, and she uploads the lecture notes on Canvas. Not a difficult class if you've taken Calc in high school. Quizzes every week (40% of your grade), 20 points each, 1 midterm and 1 final exam. However, she moves too fast on important topics sometimes. All/most exams graded by her TA.

if you've taken calc before, it is very doable and honestly shouldn't be that hard. Her lectures were useless to me so I stopped going and relied heavily on the textbook to learn. Her quizzes are usually 15 minutes and 5 questions. Grade is heavily relied on the weekly quizzes and final.

Professor Bai is a really sweet and caring professor. Unfortunately, I just failed to understand her lectures, even as someone who took calculus in high school. She goes really fast and I can never write notes fast enough to keep up with her. If you zone out for even a second, she's already explained two topics and moved onto the next.
she seemed really nice, but the way she explained things didn't make sense to me. I'm also not very math-minded, but for a very low-level course this seemed unnecessarily difficult

please. incoming economics freshmen. DONT TAKE THIS!! i beg you. I know at least 10 people who dropped this class. shes so sweet, but you will not do well unless you are a math whiz who aced ap calc bc in highschool. Drop it and take it with a different professor in a different semester. DO YOURSELF A FAVOR!!!! I have no idea how anyone did well.

I don't know who writes the good comments in here but none of the classmates/people I know who took a class with her liked her and her teaching style. Very hard to follow during the lecture and not accessible outside of classes.

Taking calc with her will be your worst nightmare if you have never taken calculus before/if you are an international student. Professor has a very hard to understand accent, so you have to do a lot of self-learning. She covers the material in class very quickly and you can't join the class online; wouldn't help you if you are struggling in class.

Rekha is a very good professor, I would say I am willing to take her course again so many time. I like her teaching style, she will show you the definition of sth and then go through enough examples to help you understand it. I like her class so much. I could say she inspired me a lot on math, and I change my major to math after taking her class.
NEVER TAKE HER - literally the worst professor to take this class with

She's nice but her lectures are unclear. If you've taken calculus before, you'll do well. If you haven't, prepare to do a lot of self-learning. The directions for the final presentation are unclear. She told my group we did it wrong, so the other groups changed their projects according to what she told us, but still told them they did it wrong.

Class was very easy given I've taken Calc previously. She goes in depth with her lectures and very good at explaining. One group project and she drops the lowest test and quiz, great for keeping your grade up. textbook homework for every unit, good practice. FINAL IS WORTH A LOT (40%) !!!!

I Love Her teaching ways, which first tell you the formulas then bring you some exercises, this can help me understand how those principles works and remember them. Also, although she has several paper test, you have the chance to drop one of the tests which you receive the lowest grade.

She makes this class 100000% harder, and it's impossible to understand what she is talking about during her lectures most of the time. I have to study everything by myself because she cannot explain what she teaches clearly.
Classes are basically copying things from the board but not really engaging.  As a professor, she wasn't helpful at all, I had to study by myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Bai was very sweet, but I had no idea what she was talking about most of the time. Her lectures tended to be very confusing and she was not always clear when answering questions. A majority of your grade is based on a midterm and final exam, which I found to be pretty unfair. There was a quiz once a week that were a small % of your grade

Professor Bai is a clearly enjoys teaching calculus for business. She goes through some of the topics very quickly and without many explanations, but she always completes a worksheet with the students and is totally opened and patient when receiving a bunch of questions. The grade consists of a group project, five tests, homework and a final exam.

Only take this class if you've taken calculus before because her lectures will only make sense to you that way. Otherwise, she just teaches the basics and then goes 0 to 100 in her examples. For the group project, she doesn't give helpful feedback and will just tell you what's wrong. She's not sympathetic whatsoever toward extensions/ makeup exams.

This professor is so sweet and caring. Her lectures are very informative and she goes through a great amount of examples that helps you really understand the topics. Because she does a lot of examples you also hardly ever open the textbook. She also creates a pdf with review material for each exam which touches on all topics for the upcoming exam

If you have taken Calculus before and you can teach yourself, then you should not go to her class unless for exams. She has a thick accent that you cannot understand what she is saying most of the time and i know for sure if I did not take Calculus in my senior year of highschool, I would have definitely failed this class.

Very straight-shooting teacher. Works lots of examples in class, and gives very straightforward lectures. Not a super showy personality in the classroom, but she's interesting to talk to after class if you'd really like to. Classic good teacher, would take again. (Can be a bit harsh grading quizzes, but she drops the lowest 2)

I have taken calculus before, but her lectures were very clear and helpful. Great syllabus with clear expectations and tons of practice problems. She always asks if we have questions or need her to slow down. Easy homework and fair tests. Easy group project.

Explains every topic very well, but to a basic level. You will often find yourself understanding the very basics of how to do something, but need to figure out the depths of it on your own. Provides plenty of practice and is very nice in and out of class. If you try you will do well, even without attending class more than once a week.

Lectures are very boring but helpful if you're having trouble in the class. 5 tests (drops lowest test), 1 semester long group project, and 1 final. Very easy class if you've taken any kind of calc class before, but may be difficult if not. Not much feedback on tests. In my opinion, it was more valuable to self-study than attend her classes.
She is a good professor but teaches at a really fast pace. She gives a lot of tests which are not that hard if you study a lot. She covers a lot in one class so don't skip any classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Taking Rekha Bai's class was one of the worst things ever. Half of the time, you cannot understand her words because she doesn't use the mic and she writes poorly on the chalkboard. She also gives tests with problems that were so far from the difficulty we learned. Beware of the semester long group project and a lot of tests. Final worth 40%.

Professor Bai was a great lecturer who clearly explained all the material you needed to know. If you needed clarification, it was explained in the textbook or by going to her office hours. She provided review material for every test that made it very easy to know what you needed to know to be prepared. There is also a semester long group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She does not explain things clearly. Uses a chalkboard and erases with her hand making it impossible to take notes. Her tests are often and extremely difficult if you havent been crunching for a week. Her classes are all but interactive and, when asked for an extension, she refused.

I took her Calculus - Business/Economics course as a part of NUAccelerate. Her lectures are mind numbing and the examples she explains are far from the difficulty of the homework. I basically taught myself the entire curriculum. Furthermore, she includes a semester long group project with vague instructions doesn't provide any clarification or help

Professor Bai is a nice person, but she is awful at explaining. If you are good at Calc or have previous knowledge, then this might not be too bad. However, if you are average at Calculus, do not take the class with her. Moves quickly, explains badly and very confusing. Do not recommend.

Professor Bai is the best math professor I've ever encountered. She is very helpful and willing to answer any questions. Her lectures are very clear and homework are relatively easy. She gives very clear instruction on quizzes and exams. Be sure to practice the questions in her "class pak" then you will definitely achieve high score.

Really nice but awful at explaining. The lectures are so easy but the homeworks and the quizzes are so much harder. Wouldn't recommend if you have not taken calc in highschool or struggle with math in general.

I took this class through NUStart. The material was okay considering it was Calculus and I had taken a precalc course in high school. Either way, she is very nice but can be hard to understand. Her teaching style is not my favorite. I only passed because I went to many office hours with her, TA's and an another tutor.

I'm not sure why her recent ratings are low, but Professor Bai is sweet and interpersonal throughout the lectures despite the online format due to COVID-19. Textbook reading isn't needed as she provides ppt slides and worksheets (which the tests/quizzes are based on) and there aren't any graded hw assignments. Doing textbook problems will save you
Long and boring lecture. Depend on yourself
She is the best professor to take for 1231. She very good explaining and as long as you pay attention you should get an A-/A.

Overall, she's nice, but her class can be very boring because she lectures at the board the whole time. Her explanations can be confusing at times, but if you work hard and make an effort it's an easy A. There are quizzes every single week and the homework is all online but isn't due until the end of the semester.

Took the course as a 2nd year and my class was mainly freshmen. they were sometimes really rude to her, but Professor Bai was a sass master and shut them down. She was very willing to give one-on-one help and allowed you to correct mistakes in your group project for points back. I enjoyed her teaching so much that I took her for MATH 1231 as well.

Rekha is one of the best math professors I've ever had! She is easy to understand, although she can be quiet at times. She has students do problems in class -- they aren't for credit, but they help. She is very available in office hours and is kind to students; she'll really put in extra effort to make sure you understand. Quizzes are reasonable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: NICE PROFESSOR BUT MAKES THE COURSE SEEM HARDER THAT IT IS.

Precalc with her was honestly a huge waste of my tuition money. Yes the class is easy, but maybe a little too easy that it makes it hard to take it seriously and stay on track. She is very condescending if you are a weak math student, and won't reply emails or provide extra help to students outside of very limited office hours.
This class was a show up, sleep for 100 min, and get an A. I couldn't stay awake in the class, and the professor stretches out about 15 min of material for the full class time.

I saw some people mentioning her strong accent, but it's really not a big deal. She's very nice and really chill. On the rare occasion that people jokingly express being stressed in the class, she'll just calm everybody down. Also, she's really thorough when introducing mathematical concepts.

This is my second class with Professor Bai. I think she has a very specific teaching style which works for some people and not for others. Fortunately, she worked for me really well. She gives many quizzes but they are short and she will tell you exactly what to expect. I think she is a great teacher for some but not for others.
This class was comically easy. If you have a calc requirement, definitely take Rekha. There's no reason you shouldn't get an A in this class.

Rekha Bai talks in a pretty thick Indian accent, but if you pay attention relatively well and go to class most of the time it is an easy A. Quizzes are assigned regularly, and the lowest quiz grade is dropped, so it is easy to bring your grades up. Would recommend taking math with her if you are a business or econ major!

Very unhelpful for those who struggle with math, doesn't reply to emails. Yeah, there tends to be the students who are more math savvy who pretty much just fly through the class and grades in success. She is dull, difficult understand and approach, and has no personality to try and be more approachable. Her explanations are unclear.
A little hard to understand at first but you get used to her after a while. She is very very helpful and sweet. Loved her!!
Great teacher! She's a little hard to understand at first, but pay attention in class and do all the homework (not graded) and you'll do very well

She might not be the best orator, but her classes are well organized. Though it seems like she just got off the boat she has a lot of experience. She's approachable, open to questions and brings clarity to the subject.
GREATTTT Professor

Definitely a good teacher who cares for her student's success and who, despite her strong accent and monotonous voice, explains everything very well. Average grader and has lengthy office hours. Just do the work, revise the material several times and you'll do well.

Ok. I hate the class but with her its easy yet very boring. No need to do the hw or anything. Key to succeeding would be to master the guide and practice problems they make you buy. Do it the night before and you are set. Quizez are easy, Mid terms are okay but the FINAL is challenging to say the least.

She is a solid teacher. Not exactly interesting or the best but definitely teaches you the material. Pay attention, come to class, and if you need it schedule office hours because she doesnt exist on campus otherwise. I suggest read the book if you dont understand then ask in class. She likes questions. She has an accent-meh.

She teaches in a very organized, logical sequence, but does not mind stopping to address questions. She provides time for in class practice and circulates to make sure that everyone can do the work, even if they do not ask for help. She always graded quizzes in a timely fashion and very fairly. She is also flexible, moving the quizzes around.

Ms. Bai was a good teacher, she made everything very clear while she taught. You really only need the book for half of the class so if you can just share with someone in class you're golden. The final is cumulative so you need to make sure you study hard. Overall an easy class.
She is a tough teacher, she WILL make you work a lot and she has a difficult accent to understand. Nevertheless, her class was fun and interesting. Likes to assist students in case they struggle.
Overall a good teacher. could be a lot clearer and more caring. If you are not doing well in the course, don't expect her to help you at all, so work really hard.
Has an accent. Very nice lady and will help you. Like 7 quizes she drops the 3 lowest. Final and midterm are hard but an overall easy class. Great Prof!

She'll like you and make an effort to help you if you show up everyday. she was really mean to the kids that didn't show up. She likes students that work hard even if your not particularly skilled. Hard to understand.

I usually struggle in math, but Prof Bai was very clear and made sure I knew the subject matter. She gives you review the day prior to a quiz and it is almost identical to the quiz itself. drops the lowest two quizzes. One of the best math teachers I've ever had.
Great professor. Small accent but she is nice and understands where your coming from. Teaches well.
If you've taken high school calculus this class is a breeze.  She's a nice lady too, and you can probably get away without buying the book.

An extremely easy class if you do her review worksheets. They are practically copies of the actual quiz. She's a very nice lady, but the class is far from exhilarating....pretty boring in fact. But hey, can Calculus really be exciting?
easy class, amazing professor...

Her accent is not hard at all to understand. She is a really great professor and will gladly help you if you need it. Her quizzes are very fair - you get a review before each one that is exactly like what will be on the actual quiz.
Nice lady, if you go to class, it's easy to get an A. A little bit hard to understand her accent, but not too bad. Her quizzes are exactly like her quiz reviews.

If you have to take a calc class i would definitely recommend Bai! The project was easy and the quizzes were exactly like the quiz review she gives you for homework. I had a solid A in the class until the final, which i failed and brought me down to a B. The final is 40% of your grade and is MUCH harder than you will think.

Prof. Bai is a sweet, quiet Indian woman (slight accent, no problem).  If you want to learn real calculus, then this class is not for you.  Besides the few basic calculus concepts, I often felt like it was 10th grade algebra and not college calculus.  However, since the course is required, get Bai, it's an easy class made easier by an awesome prof.
professor Bai was a great teacher just do the class packet cuz thats basically all the quizzes are based on. Her final is hard and its worth 40 percent of your grade

Great math teacher. Nice woman, who wants you to do well. Takes attendance. Uses the textbook, but you really don't need to buy it. I stopped looking at it after the first few weeks.  Course only gets semi-difficult towards the end when the actual calculus begins.  Distribution was... 15% group project, 30% quiz, 15% midterm, 40% final.
Nice professor, very helpful, easy, clear, no homework.
she's a great teacher. EXCEPT for one thing. you better be damn certain that you do well on the final. my avg in the class was an 82.2 but my overall grade was a D+ because of my final.

Awesome professor. Wants her students to do well in the class. I never had a problem understanding her. I wasn't that interested in taking calc at first and it ended up being my best class this semester.
Great teacher, not totally easy, but no really really hard, i liked her overall!

Amazing woman.  She's a truly caring teacher who knows how to convey her material.  I paid attention, did my homework and got an A.  I don't see what everyone is talking about with her accent.  She's just as understandable as anyone I've ever talked to and I don't know one person in my class who had trouble comprehending her.

good teacher, has an accent but still understandable. sometimes move a little fast but just ask her to slow down. quizes alwasy exactly what she says they will be. so far as a frosh, best teacher ive had

She was a teacher that yes, did have an accent, but i didn't find it to be a problem, while she did move fast it was a fairly reasonable pace, her tests were always what she said they were going to be, no bull, overall good teacher
I've never liked math, but calculus is easily my favorite class this semester b/c prof. bai makes it simple and clear- plus she's really nice and can be funny! I love those quiz reviews
couldnt be any easier- gives practice quizzes that are the exact format of tests, even for midterm/final.  lets you drop 2 worst grades.  very nice woman.
All the quiz reviews are pretty much the same as the quizs you get.  She goes over anything you need help in during class and is very helpful.  Plus she's really nice.
Excellent teacher. Goes slow and makes sure all students understand material. Goes over quiz material, project is easy and lectures are clear.

i could not undestand a word she said, i had to change classes, and besides, she moves extremely quickly, i was doing bad becuase of her accent, and her rapid explanations and assumptions that everyone knows what they are doing.
Quizzes were easy, but I still learned stuff from her class. She is soft spoken, but covered all the material needed to do well on the final, great teacher.
The class is boring, shes a straight-forward teacher. You have to remember to practice doing the problems and pay close attention the 1st 2 weeks, or else the class is a struggle.
great teacher.... quizes, midterm, and final are exactly like the practice versions she gives you... hard to understand but very helpful
a little hard to get used to but an easy 100
Very Easy Class. Very Easy Teacher. Practice quizzes are exactly like actual quizzes. Honestly this is the easiest calculus class that you will ever take!!
Test and quizes are the same as practice quizes she gives out in class.Class is boring as hell and the group project sucks

She can't speak very good english, but she knows what she's talking about.  The practice quizzes are EXACTLY like the real quizzes, which rules.  She is fair and she doesn't take attendance.  I have never taken calc before, and I'm doing well!
This class would have been a whole lot easier if she spoke fluent english. Class is pretty easy. Gives you practice quizzes that are the same as the quiz you take.

IF you have trouble with your grades and try to email her do you get a response NOOOOOOOOOO definetly not cool
Nice teacher. Clear and understandable. Easy quizzes and always prepares you before tests.
The instructor did an excellent job, and the course is very effective. professional and knowledgeable.

Among the best in the Information Systems department. His CSYE 6225 class is widely popular. His teaching methods are effective and engaging, with a strong balance between hands-on work and foundational concepts. His industry expertise is outstanding. I just finished his class and highly recommend him for this course.
A lot of practice. Homework and assignments are very useful. Good course for learning the basics and intermediate level of cloud computing.
Good course. I took it online. Heavy and paced out well.
Thank you. great course. great professor.
Two exams. 120 questions for the final. 10 assignments. 10 quizzes. Mainly public cloud with AWS and private cloud with Pextra (his company). I would take the course again with him for sure.

Was recommended by the WeChat group to take 6225 with Professor Alomari. I did the class online (I am in Arlington). The syllabus builds a strong foundation in cloud computing. During the final exam, I realized how much I learned. Many homework and many quizzes. Two exams (mid and final). He gave us early access to Pextra. teachings was nice.

professor is founder of pextra. he is very knowledgeable in cloud computing not only AWS stuff. His approach make hands-on very easy to follow. in easy terms understanding of virtualization and cloud computing. recommended. just did the final exam and I realized how much I learned as I was doing the exam. very wide range of topics we did.
Just finished the final exam. 120 questions in 100 minutes. This course was Epic. Professor and teaching is nice.

I took CSYE6225 online with professor Alomari even though it is offered in Boston in person. One of best courses syllabus in all campuses. The syllabus has wide range of topics between private and public cloud. Multiple HW. Free access to AWS and to Pextra. He is so knowledgeable and kind at same time. 100% recommended.

CSYE 6225 is a must have with a lot hands-on. Prof Alomari teaching this course is so engaging. You learn linux, public and private cloud, virtualization, and even architecture. He give access to private cloud Pextra and AWS. Many assignments and quizzes. He is one off the most knowledgeable in this topic and very caring and help us a lot.

This is my second course with Dr. Alomari.He designed the LLMOps class and gave us a full textbook that he made and all the slides. He is always prepared and supportive. I also took CSYE 6225 with him. We had weekly project updates with others in class asking questions. Was excellent experience. I respect his work and appreciate him a lot.

I took DAMG7245 with Professor Alomari. It is heavy on AWS Glue and Sagemaker. Many hands-on labs and a lot of practice. Almost half of each class is practice. Provides us with options for projects and extra credit. His expectations are a little high. He prepared all material and did a fantastic job. Definitely recommend any course he teaches.
The teachings were very nice

The course (big data analytics) was very intense. Too many assignments including labs from three courses of AWS Academy. As long as you do you assignments each week, it is manageable. The professor is very knowledgeable and professional. He allows late assignments when asked. A lot of AWS handson Glue and Sagemaker.

I took DAMG 7245 with Dr. Alomari. We just took our final exam. It was really a tough course but useful. Over 15 assignments. some on AWS academy. some on Glue and Sagemaker. I worked really hard. He prepares his own material. no textbook. Also gave us access to three AWS academy courses. Even though  it was intense but no regrets.

I just completed CSYE6225 with Professor Alomari. First, this course is a must have with him. He mixes the course between knowledge and practice. I never expected I will be able to use cloud resources this fast and with the breadth of services we learned.He also gave us access to his company private cloud software. Add to this that he is very nice

I took cloud computing course with Professor Alomari based on recommendations and I definitely recommend this course. This course has both lectures and hands-on. Almost each class was half dedicated for hands-on. Labs and assignments are heavy but definite worth it. I learned a LOT. HWs are demanding but very useful. Great Prof and very kind.

I took CSYE6225 with Professor Alomari. Be ready to learn and practice. Very information heavy but very spaced throughout the semester. He also keeps taking survey and adjust things based on the feedback. Always share the feedback with all of us. Never seen a professor so well organized and knowledgeable. He has a lot of industry experience.

Had no experience cloud and after I took this class, I feel I learned a lot. Professor Alomari is supper efficient. Very well organized. prepares own slides. He also took feedback using google forms multiple times and adjusted based on our feedback. I registsred another course with him next semester. I would take any course he offers.

By far the best. I took cloud computing with Professor Alomari in Silicon Valley campus. His passion really shows. Second half of each lecture is hands-on work. He prepares the material and shares the slides. Quizzes, labs, midterm, and final. An optional project (extra credit). I would take any class he offers.

I took the cloud computing course CSYE6225 with Professor Alomari, and he was outstanding. His passion for the subject really shows. He prepared his own slides and did hands-on demos every week. The assignments varied in difficulty, which helped me learn a lot. too many easy quizzes. A must take course. Only in person in Oakland.

Does not care about cheating; doesn't even show up to his own exams. People cheat heavily on the exams and it leaves the kids who actually do the work themselves at a disadvantage and regret not cheating. Wastes lecture time.
The website has censored my last 5 attempted comments. drop out gg
Does 1 problem per class, would cancel class right before an exam, and just very uncaring and rude. Probably one of the worst profs I've had here

There is 1% actual lecture/instruction and you are expected to learn based on him racing through one problem per class. He has no respect for the amount of tuition we pay and thinks ending class early or cancelling classes before exams is beneficial, when I think all anyone would want is more instruction time.

Speeds through problems without actually explaining things, and then ends class early or gives us random days off. Also made the midterm the day we get back from spring break, despite cancelling the last day of class before spring break. He refused to let us take the test before spring break for no real reason. Otherwise, is nice and entertaining

He was just flat-out mean. I would ask questions, and he would say, "That's a bad question" and then move on. The Tas were nice enough, but they were scared of him because he was just mean to them. Never take him for statics if your life depended on it. Rude, uncaring, and truly only wants to see you fail. He will provide nearly zero exam prep and will ramp up the difficulty on exam day ten fold. Run as far as you can.

I have never had such a rude and uncaring professor during my entire undergrad education. He did a horrible job at making the exams and their grading reflective of class material and when any concern was brought to him, responded with hostility. Yusti knows his stuff but also expects you to understand the material hes talking about instantly. One practice problem per topic is shown in class, then you do the homework that is much harder. reviews.comment: Assignments were straightforward, basically exactly what we did in class. Attendance isn't graded, but you will fall behind if you don't show up. His teaching style is fine. My main issue is that he made the final exam unnecessarily long and changed the format without telling us. He is much nicer to *certain* students over others…

Avoid this professor for as many classes as possible. Yusti gives false hope but offers no real support—lecture notes are never uploaded, the material is disorganized, and the exams are absurdly difficult. You'll be left teaching yourself while struggling to meet impossible expectations. Terrible experience.

Prof Tusti is very funny and the only professor I've had who started every class by engaging in a social way w the students. his teaching style involves a lot of doing out examples, and there is a lot of homework

Professor Yusti knows a lot about the material but teaches in a way that does not encourage questions. He expects everyone to understand the first time and is an extremely tough grader. Exams are very difficult, and hard to complete in the given time. He is very intimidating.

His lectures are sloppy overall and don't have structure. He does not explain concepts well and relies examples to have students understand what is going on. He has redeeming moments where his explanation of ideas is superb, but these moments are often few and far between.

Professor Yusti is very hard. I feel as if he knows this is a weed-out class and treats it as such. He really treats the class as sink or swim. He knows the concept is difficult, and he doesn't try to make it easier. He will tell you one trick and then move on without expanding on it.

Claims to have all the information needed on Canvas but examples and homework show no written, step-by-step solutions. The book answers the same questions in a different method. He refused to give the class detailed solutions after being asked multiple times, he even agreed to give them then claimed he was talking about just answers.

He wants to connect with students but fails to teach his subjects clearly. He spends class time speeding through example problems but doesn't generalize them enough so you can apply them to HW and quiz problems easily. I recommend avoiding this professor if you can. Nice guy, just not the best teacher

Great Professor! HW are based on what is taught in class, and this year coding was taught alongside had solved problems. Grade is only based on HW and quizzes so a high grade is easily achievable.
I heavily recommend this professor for this course.

Yusti is one of the best professors I have had. Weekly HW takes 1-3hrs and aren't that hard. The course now includes lectures on coding the example problems, so most other comments about sleepless nights are outdated. 
Overall I really recommend this class with this professor and he definitely does not deserve that bad of a rating.

Yusti is an immensely frustrating and lazy professor. I took him for ME 4550 (ME Design) in a summer semester. Class time consists of him speed copying his example problems on the board with minimal background explanation. When asked about an aspect of a problem, his most common response is "You should know this already." DO NOT TAKE HIM BY CHOICE!

By and far the worst professor I have ever had. At the beginning of the semester, I was skeptical about the reviews on here since he seemed nice; however, his teaching method is simply speed reading solution keys. The real issue was his skepticism towards mental health days, and blaming us when the whole class had difficulties finishing an exam.

He is one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern. He creates a fun, but still productive teaching environment. He gives you simpler problems in the lectures than in the homework, but he teaches you all of the concepts needed to succeed on the homework and tests. I hope I can have him again the next semester I am taking classes!
Does not care about mental health matters. Is not forgiving or understanding. It was a sad day when I had to sign up for his class. I don't think he realizes his students are students or human.

He will only solve problems by hand in class, but expect you to do the hw with MATLAB. I asked the professor and TAs for help on MATLAB countless times but they were always busy when I asked or gave the most vague answers that was absolutely no help. You will have to learn everything yourself. Be prepared for sleepless nights and 8+ hour homework
Terrible teacher. Does not teach coding, only teaches by hand solutions which do not help on the homework, quizzes, or tests. You will have to learn everything in this course by yourself.

Expected to spend 8+ hours per week doing homeworks using MATLAB, ANSYS, and SolidWorks, despite insufficient training in any of them. Prof. Yusti is uncompromising on late-policies (even when due to technical glitches) and stubborn about moving exams even when conflicts occur. DO NOT TAKE ME 4508 with him.

Decent teacher. I learned a lot and also got a good grade but it was at the cost of all my other classes. His homework took an unreasonably long time to do. I would recommend taking an easier teacher.

Tong is an okay professor. Your grade is based almost completely on the 2 tests you take in the class, which is hard to do well if you're not a great test taker. The lectures can be boring, but he does a lot of real-world application practice, which was very interesting. He is generous with his students, however and always willing to help.
Took him for Fintech, this dude is great. Lectures a little dry but he's super chill and tries his best. Curved both exams, homework is super easy. Recommend if u need a finance elective to take.

Tong was well organized and provided clear expectations throughout the course. The course was test heavy, with average scores were in the low 70s. At the end of the course he added a generous curve which pushed everyone's cumulative grades up by roughly 5 points. Guy is super caring. Would definitely recommend.

This course had me stressing but i've taken him before, to be honest he is my goat. He is soft spoken but he literally curved everyones grade by two levels (b= a-). All you have to do is be kind and participate.
Great professor. Very caring

Incredibly caring and understanding professor who's clearly knowledgeable of the course material and is able to communicate concepts effectively. First test average was around a 70 but was curved. Grading criteria are pretty clear in the syllabus. Attending class helps. Overall, great professor and probably my favorite finance professor so far.

He is pretty nice as a professor. The way he teaches didn't work too well for me because it was monotone and lecture-based, but self-studying for a bit before exams and doing the homework worked out pretty well. He curved our exams 10% and gave us extra credit in assignments and attendance. I liked him and will be taking another class with him!

Sometimes lectures can be hard to follow, but he clearly cares highly about his students and is well versed in all different kinds of financial fields. He's fun to listen to and interact with and he's open to learning himself. His class was a wonderful learning experience due to his personality and knowledge.

I would highly recommend taking professor Sonthalia's class. All the effort she puts into the course is easily translated into the learning. Had one of the best class experience, would definitely take her again if I can in the future.

Professor sonthalia is a wonderful lecturer. Her classes are engaging and very interesting. She does expect you to read and be present in class, but is also very kind and understanding of any issues you might be facing. One of my favourite classes in uni!!

Prof. Sonthalia is a wonderful professor and mentor. In her classes, we covered such interesting readings and pop-culture references – this helped me creatively test my critical thinking skills. I am also grateful for her availability outside of classes, and I am happy to report that my doubts were always clarified.
Highly highly recommend Professor Sonthalia! Her course helped me understand the subject deeply and I am grateful for that.
I loved the readings given to us by Professor Sonthalia. The course was rigorous and it helped me learn a lot. I would highly recommend taking her course if you get a chance to.
Really loved taking her classes. I learnt a lot and I am grateful to the effort that Professor Sonthalia put into her lectures. She would go out of her way to guide us wherever we needed her support.
She conveys expectations clearly and is quick to address queries.
One of the most interesting and genuinely caring teachers I have ever come across. It's only a cherry on top that she makes classes interesting as well. Would definitely recommend taking her classes.

Professor Sonthalia gave very interesting readings, and even though participation was crucial, she was very understanding of social anxiety. I would highly recommend her classes. She emphasises critical thinking, and truly rewards original thought. If you show you are engaged and truly trying, her classes will be the best course of your semester!!
She grades very harshly and takes until the last second to do grade every assignment.

reviews.comment: Professor Sonthalia teaches well and makes the classes engaging. It is a very participation heavy class. You are allowed a maximum of 6 absences and she is not forgiving at all. 2 lates to class count as an absence. She is a tough grader but overall a nice person.

She was fine. She lectures extremely quickly. I did fine in class because I had taken AP Calc A in high school (got a 3, so no credit for me), and the course is incredibly similar—if not less content. She kind of expects students to have already taken the class in high school tbh. Regardless, actually utilize her! She always answers emails.
If you've taken Calc in high school this class will be very easy for you if not you'll be in for a tough ride.
save yourself...

Honestly you will probably have to teach yourself most of the content if you are not already familiar, but she provides videos from the course coordinator that teach you everything you need to know for the exams. She is very sweet and will try her best to help you learn, but it usually isn't super helpful.

Need to attend lectures, teaches extremely well, easy to understand. Group projects have no clear grading criteria only instructions but they easy because she breaks it up into sections.
If you listen and ask questions you'll get a good grade
Made exams very difficult. Graded veryyy tough on group projects. She is knowledgable but doesn't teach very well. Sometimes condescending or ignorant attitude.

Honestly one of the worst professors I have had so far, make sure you do well on all the online homework and group project as that is the only way to say your grade. Final is worth 40% and half of it is topics she either barely discussed or just brushed right through.

I taught myself most of this class, she can be generous with partial credit but also nitpicks a lot. She cold calls and often makes students feel bad if they don't know the answer. If you don't take her too seriously and you show up to class you are fine. She also gives numerous opportunities to boost your grade so just do every extra quiz/project.

reviews.comment: I loved Prof. Raj and how passionate she is. I know some people think her explanations might be long winded but honestly I liked having that level of depth. Her emphasis on real life application (imo) was the most unique thing about the class compared to other profs & genuinely made me like math more as someone who didn't love it in high school.

I had her for Calc1 and while, yes, you do have to do a lot of practice//teaching yourself outside of class, I think her lectures were actually really interesting. She is very passionate and cares about her students. Focuses a lot on the "why" behind things, which I liked. Obviously, that teaching style isn't for everyone so do what works for you.
Does not post grades online and is not great at describing or teaching any content in the course. She seems like a nice person, just not a good teacher in my opinion.

She was a calm professor, and if you were struggling, she strongly encouraged you to attend her office hours regularly. However, during office hours she often talked about her business class, which could be distracting. I found the quizzes challenging, and I would sometimes feel overwhelmed after getting them back.
