reviews.comment: Don't take it if u are very good at math! She has a lot of quizzes and tests. I can't understand what she's talking about. I learned it all by myself!

Professor Jesudason is extremely passionate about math, and I've found her explanations to be clear and easy to understand. She is a light grader and gives lots of partial credit on quizzes and midterms which is very helpful. However, prepare to do some practice outside of class because she does waste a lot of class time talking or OVERexplaining.

Take it during the summer- get it over with quicker and more straight to the point. Smaller class means you have to participate (you will get called on). Practice and memorize. Very accessible outside of class. Relatively nice professor. As someone who has failed pre-calc in high school, this was really easy. Calculate your grade or you won't know.

reviews.comment: I've seen this professor tell her student he should get EVALUATED because he didn't understand derivatives---------- do I need to say anything else.

Raj's class was challenging at first because it took some time to understand her teaching style and personality. However, once you adjust, the class itself isn't bad. You just need to be prepared to teach yourself much of the material. She does tend to share a lot about her personal life during lectures.

There's only one way to pass - don't take this prof!! No clear teaching, no grade updates, tons of work with no reminders, rude to students, and acts like we're PhD math majors. Creates tension instead of helping. Lowk wants kids to fail to prove her insane points. This class will ruin your semester. Run like a plague is chasing you.

Although she was approachable for extra help, Raj did not use class time in an organized or helpful way. She would talk mostly about her personal life in class and would do very few practice problems. I had to teach myself everything through youtube. The hmwrk did not match up with what was on the tests, making it nearly impossible to do well.

I had her for mathematical thinking and it was one of the best classes I've ever taken. She lectures in the way that she engages the class so everyone learns. Before every quiz you can have her go through anything you are confused on. I would 100% take this class again.

As someone who didn't do well in her class and knew nothing about calculus prior to taking it, Raj was super helpful and kind. She reached out when I was struggling and pushed me to succeed. Tests and final are pretty hard, but if you do well on the group project and do the homework you can get a good grade. Lectures are pretty useless imo.

just a bad prof.... like, ur just not gonna enjoy this class.

she gets bagged on cuz it's calc, but tbh she is a caring professor, super accessible out of class, and puts in the effort to help you if you reach out. she goes over few problems in class, so go to her office hours. the group project is doable and an easy A if done well. Exams are tough of course, so practice using the online textbook.. it's good!

If you took calc in high school I feel like you will be fine. I was able to understand most things since I took ap calc. She does go on tangents sometimes and does max three questions in one class. WORST professor. I was sick for three classes and couldn't catch up.Told me"Ur not the student u used to be" and made me cry. Has no teaching plan. Semester gets increasingly harder.Vids helped. No notes published to review. Doesn't tell u ur grade in class until semester is over and claims that PET PEEVE IS PEOPLE NOT KNOWING THEIR OVERALL GRADE?
lectures are all over the place, jumps from topic to topic and doesn't tie everything together, super hard grader, tests are sometimes on material we've never learned, overall don't recommend

Avoid at all costs. Worst professor I've ever had. Doesn't teach, is rude, grades extremely unfairly, and makes things so complicated. I took the class in high school and still didn't do great. Just avoid her if you can.

If you wanna learn Calc 1, I do NOT recommend this course, especially if you've never taken Calc before. She goes on random long tangents about her personal life which is great for small talk but terrible for class. 0/10.

reviews.comment: Goes on random rants about things. Very disorganized with resources and content that will be on the quiz. Gets very defensive when you try to tell her her resources are confusing. No study guide and barely helps coming up with a plan when asked.

I assure you, Rajini Jesudason is out to get her students. I believe that she's a good person, but she is unfitting as a professor. She will purposefully regrade exams to take points off, cold call, and rush through material the day before the quiz or test.

I've had harder courses with lower rated professors, yet none were as inadequate as her.
Don't somehow she had the whole class confused, lost, scared, and helpless. Don't.
She hardly teaches the content of the class needed to complete the homework, goes on rants on the most random stuff in class. DO NOT TAKE.
The profesor was nice but she was just bad at teaching, she did not care how the students did at all and was a really though grader.
She is a difficult teacher but if you put in the work it works. ALSO BEWARE OF THE WAY SHE DRESSES BECAUSE HER  CLOTHING IS SO DISTRACTINGGGG FOR MY ADHD!

reviews.comment: Although at times difficult to keep up with and definitely does not have a conventional teaching style, Professor Raj is a caring and considerate teacher. Raj pushes students to their fullest potential and is very accommodating to student needs outside class. She is willing to assist students hours past her office hours and make sure you succeed.

Professor Raj, is truly a caring person. Don't get me wrong, this course is very difficult, but she makes sure students are aware of resources outside of class! I am not a fan of math, but this course might have changed that. I never thought I'd be saying this but I'm glad she's pushed me to achieve things I didn't think I could with calc!

Impossible to do well. She jumps from one topic to another and often goes on tangents about her personal life. Very few examples are done in class and hw has nothing to do with the tests. Claims to be available and willing to help, but will always blame the student, even for illness. Do not miss class! Grades not published until end of semester.
Avoid.

Most condescending teacher I've ever had. Instead of answering questions she makes the class answer for some reason (and waste time). She writes so small which makes it so half the class can't see. Futhermore, she expects you to know the material already, which for some students is a struggle. She wasn't late to class like the others suggest.

reviews.comment: Do not take this class! She did not teach anything and it was so difficult. My best advice is to not take it, it is too much work without the help of the professor

If you need to take Calculus or Math Thinking at Northeastern, DO NOT take Raj. The only way I was able to pass this class was by watching all the videos (taught by a different professor) and by going to TA hours (again a different person ). Professor Raj is unclear in her lectures and doesn't seem to know the material she is teaching, herself.

If you don't know calc and you're taking this class, DO NOT take it with her. Sure she may be a nice person, but she spends very little time on concepts and expects you to understand them. The only reason I was able to do well was because I already knew the stuff. 
Go for someone else.

She doesn't teach at all. Always late to class (20 minutes) and blame the T (green line) for being too crowded. Always teach easy stuff in class, and then it gets difficult on the test. Homework was chill on Cengage. 100% never retake her class again. If you get picked on, your dead

She is always in late to class and will email other students to write questions on the board. She often goes on tangents with useless information & her lectures often don't cover all the information you need for the tests. But if you are willing to go to office hours, you will do well.
