I absolutely loved this class. He is such an intelligent professor and makes the content so interesting. I am willing taking another class at 8:00 am because he is the professor. He's that good. If you don't like to write, this class might not be for you: your grade is based off of 5 or 6 papers you work on throughout the semester.

Professor Daniels is an amazing professor. I have taken two classes with him and love his lecturing style. His course is all paper-based (no tests), so if that works better for you, I 100% recommend him. The papers are challenging, but he gives thoughtful feedback for each one. His assignments are very thought-provoking, which I enjoyed.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: SO funny. Exams are all take home. Just a chill guy who loves birds. He rly does it for the love of the game. Would take again 10/10

Loved prof Roth. HIs stories and tangents are so charming and relating topics to real world was really helpful in understanding the why of conservation efforts. Lots of info and course content is all what he says in lecture. Online tests were reasonably difficult and final bird ID test was very fun. Loved this class and bird trips!

Professor Roth is very passionate about birds! I took bird class to fulfill my population and organismal biology requirement, but I really enjoyed it and learned a lot. Exams were all online take-home, and we got to go bird watching in the Fens for some of our classes. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a fun and easy elective!

Quizzes are based entirely on his lectures even if that's not what is factually correct, a lot is misspelled, very little time allotted, and his slides are written horribly. In the class I took, his quizzes were weighed the same as the midterm and final exam. Easy enough professor, but prepare to be frustrated.
All I have to say is, he is an icon, he's a legend, and he is the moment. Truly hilarious, but professional,  professor. Will make you laugh until you cry. He ate.

took this course summer 2 for nupath requirement and it consisted of 2 group projects and weekly discussion boards + mastering hws. honestly i loved this class bc it was really interesting, yet not hard at all. really recommend

He's super nice and funny, but the material can be difficult towards the end. There is a massive amount of material on exams, but if you study and take really good notes, you'll be fine. Exams are usually 60% multiple choice and 40% essay, and he lets you know what the essay questions will be about beforehand. The final was not cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Aaron is one of the best professors I've had at NU. He makes every lecture into a story, clearly knows his stuff, and he wants all of his students to succeed. We even had a day bird watching trip. For vertebrate anatomy there can be some small details on the exams, but if you take good notes during the class and study before, you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's one of my favorite professors I've ever had. I took comp. avian structure (AKA bird class) with him and it was very straightforward. Your grade is based off 2 midterms and the final, which are all multiple choice and very easy if you take note of what he says during class. His slides are very bare though, so it is important to attend class.

Took comparative avian structure and function with Aaron. The man knows his birds and is absolutely hilarious. Fairly easy class, he really just likes talking about things he wants to talk about (birds, his disdain for his dogs, spatchcocking, Victorious) and isn't trying to fail anyone. Not a bad choice for an upper bio elective with no lab

Aaron is amazing! I took his Bio and Society course during a summer semester and he made the course easy but meaningful. I wasn't a good bio student in high school but the contents that he taught and included in his powerpoints got me really interested and finished the course with an A. I took his class for nupath requirement, highly recommended:)

Lectures are fun and interesting, exams are very easy (all multiple choice), and he's pretty laid back. If you haven't taken a basic bio class before, it will be difficult because he doesn't explain things in detail.

Aaron is hands down the best professor I have ever had. He brings profound storytelling experience to the classroom in a laid-back way, as a result, his teaching effectiveness is substantial and needs proper recognition. If you are interested in the sciences or are considering a STEM career, I cannot recommend a better place to start.

I graduated 4 years ago and I still say Aaron Roth was my favorite professor. Super dry sense of humor and passionate about zoology when he gets going. He introduced us to a hilarious YouTube series about weird animals and we spent a Mammalogy class in the Fens listening to him nerd out about birds. 10/10 would get a beer with Roth.

Took this class online during Summer 1. I did not read a single chapter of the textbook or watch a single lecture yet got an A. If you have already taken a bio class you will do well in this course. Graded by weekly discussion posts and textbook assignments (which you will get good scores on if you already took a bio class), and 2 group projects.

Professor Roth is super chill and hilarious! Don't get me wrong, he knows his stuff! Took his BIO1100 on Saturdays and the lectures were about 3 hours long. He knows how to keep the class entertained while teaching us about things that can get a bit boring. Be sure to take notes though because his slides are minimal and only made for reference

I took comparative avian structure and function with Aaron Roth and it was one of my favorite classes I've taken at Northeastern. He's a great teacher, super funny and engaging and his tests are totally fair. The slides had barely any info on them so you had to go to class to get the notes, but other than that class was a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Literally the best professor I have ever had. His lectures are great. He is hilarious. His exams are straight forward. You will enjoy learning in this class.
BEST PROF EVER. You come out of his class having learned SO much. He makes 11/10 Dad jokes, and doesn't expect you to memorize everything for his exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor and very understanding, super easy online class, prob best bio prof at NEU
Super chill guy, pretty easy summer online class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dope teacher. Higher than a 4.4
Great Professor ever had. This guy is good and he knows his stuff.
VERY HELPFUL. HAS GREAT ABILITY  TO MAKES HARD STUDY TOPICS MAKES FUN AND EASY. HE IS ONE OF THE VEST PROFESSORS IN MY ALL STUDY LENGTH.

Roth is the funniest professor I've had so far.  I took his Inquiries into Bio on Zoonotics & really enjoyed it.  His lectures were informative & he always managed to squeeze in some really cringey yet twisted yet hilarious jokes in there.  You can't just skip and rely on the online slides though.  All his tests are given on Blackboard :)

Roth is 100% the best professor you will ever have! His lectures are SO interesting.  He's also really funny and an all around cool guy!  His tangents are always hilarious and keep you entertained.  If you're confused on something don't hesitate to go to his office hours, he's really helpful one on one.  Not an easy A, but worth the work!
Professor Roth is a really great guy. I liked his class a lot, and he is pretty funny.   Help is there if you need it, but most people get by with mild studying.
Well respected, Very understanding, Provides plenty of time to complete assignments.

GO TO CLASS. His powerpoints for VertZoo are a bunch of photos, so if you miss class, you'll have to get notes or you just won't have anything. He's a zoologist so he cares about the class a lot and loves questions from the class. Hands down most interesting class I've taken at NU.

Respectful, understanding and very hardworking professor. Roth is by far my favorite biology professor. He's so clear, passionate about what is teaches, easy going and respects his students. He's funny and the way he present the course is so interesting and funny that not only you understand it but he makes you interested in the subject.

very nice, funny guy. midterm was somewhat tough but he gave an extra credit assignment. all quizzes and final were online, taken at your own leisure. course was dumbed down a little compared to elsewhere but I also retained a ton more because of how laid back the setup was. Roth's tangents also improved my overall Bio intuition a ton. highly rec!

Had this guy for a course called Animal, a course about Animal, the psychotic drumming muppet from Dr. Teeth and The Electric Mayhem.  Roth is basically a cool cat all around. Very casual, and more importantly he knows his stuff. Ask him any question. If you can't get an A, you didn't spend enough time stdying or you aren't a cool enough cat.
He's very funny, interactive and makes the course even more interesting than it already is. The course itself if pretty intense but he makes it fun.

Great Teacher, he makes class worth going to, hes really nice and really tries to help everyone understand, he can speak a little fast but its not bad. His tests are hard but you'll do fine if you study and go to class. Plus it helps that he's a funny guy, friendly and easy to talk to if you need help.

hes a really nice personable guy who cares about his students. really knowledgeable and gets excited about what he teaches, so sometimes goes on about things that wont be tested on. makes class fun to go to. definitely recommend

I took General Bio2 with him, and it was a very intense course. It wasn't difficult but there's too much information to know! His lectures are very boring, but unfortunately, his exams heavily depend on what he says in lecture. His exams aren't impossible, but his questions are specific.

He's nice and apparently very engaging because people would not stop raising their hands in my class to the point where I became very annoyed. He's cares about all his students regardless of class size and he even gave me an A- when I had an 89.1 at the end of the semester. He does, however, mention too much information that is not tested on.
He is extremely funny, which makes me want to go to class.

Hes a great teacher. Makes class fun and entertaining. He obviously knows everything about bio and wants to share it with the students. His tests are difficult and you have to study a lot for them but theres no secret, just take good notes and read the book. Its gen. bio 1 so its not that  hard but if you put the work in and listen  your golden

He's legit. You'll like him. Many nervous laughes. Always willing to help. Loves loves loves bio. He'll teach you everything he knows and put 50 questions on the midterm- Tip: think "what would Roth test me on".

Awesome, hilarious guy. Great teacher. Definitely take gen bio with him. Really straightforward, fair. Super easy class if you put some work in. Don't ever need textbook. Will tell you what will be on exam in class sometimes, so go to class.

He's young, he's funny, and he loves teaching. You will love taking Bio with him, and if you don't get an A it's your own fault.  Misspellings plague his PPT's but at least he has a PPt and animation for every topic you'll cover. I looked forward to this class everyday.

This guy is hands down the best science teacher I've ever had. He has really funny digressions and jokes and keeps us entertained throughout the class. I wouldn't want to be in any other Bio class if he wasn't my professor. Thankfully Im taking Bio 2 next semester with him. If you have this professor for bio, be very grateful.

Aaron Roth is the perfect professor to teach Gen. Biology 1. He makes the class interesting and fun even while talking about the Kreb's cycle.  The tests are easy, especially if you have a background in biology. Nevertheless, you should still study. Don't buy the textbook unless you have never taken bio before, then you should.
He's a great teacher, teaches from slides but makes it interesting.  Tests aren't bad as long as you go to lecture and study moderately before the exams.
Simply he's the greatest teacher ever. He's helpful,nice,and funny.It's not enough to say he's the best.I highly recommend taking any of his courses.

So good.  vert zoo with him was fun, but be prepared to do a lot of studying/memorizing.  He really knows his stuff and doesnt expect miracles from the class.  the exams are easy as long as you study, and the same goes for lab.  highly recommend getting in one of his classes

I loved his class. I was considering changing my major because my professor before him was awful. But he made me love bio again. It's a hard class because it's all memorization, but he makes it easy and clear. I wish he taught more so I could take me classes with him.

He is very good teacher to have.  His tests are easy as long as you show up for the lectures.  He can take very boring subject and make it seem exciting.  I was dosing off and DYING of boredom in general bio 1, but for Arron's class which was general bio 2,I was very interested in lectures.

Engages class in very interesting discussions. Be aware if you take any stance other than the traditional evolutionary view (like if you point out contradictions to evolution theory) that he'll mark you off on tests and won't bother to acknowledge valid points, etc.

He is an awesome teacher. Def my favorite so far. His lectures are all online. He really understands college kids and he tries to make everything interesting. He's funny and relaxed and his tests are hard but nothing on them is unexpected. He often gives test questions in classes so you should go.

He has experience as a field biologist and likes to use his stories to help teach the class.  As long as you attend class, take notes/pay attention you should do fine.  He's actually really fairly interesting/lively/funny if you participate if you make him feel like he isn't talking to a class that's just staring at him.

very good teacher. he is good at and comfortable with public speaking=interesting to listen to. done lots of cool research and knows a lot, young & funny! gets class involved, cares about what he does & wants you to learn. lots of materialPPT lectures & reviews posted online. lab practicals are pretty tough but dont count for much. very fair guy, A

I think he's pretty new, so he's still developing a teaching style. A power point teacher...speaks for itself.  Class can be monotonous, but he will get excited if the class shows interest.  Tests are multiple choice, very detail oritented, but his pre-test reviews are pretty comprehensive.

The exams are worth 75% of your grade. Although attendance is not mandatory, there is a participation grade and the exams are difficult if you do not attend class. It is a big class and the lectures are quite boring. Rest of your grade is made up of 5/8 discussion posts which are easy to score in

It is honestly a great course for your NU Path. Exams are not hard, although they are 75% of your grade so you definitely want to prepare well. Readings don't really matter that much as long as you briefly skim through the, before exams. Home work is very light. You end up learning a lot of different topics about not just media, but history.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her 3 exam is worth 75% of your grade, other grades comes from discussion post. attendance isn't mandatory but if you don't come you are not gonna do good on the exam. Lectures are extremely boring and dry. This is not a typical easy A elective.

as someone taking this as an elective, it was great there wasn't much work. you only need to do 5/10 discussion posts and 3 exams. however, this course is 100% memorization, which is time consuming to study for the exams. overall, she made the lectures interesting, even at times when the content wasn't.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Media Culture and Society was a very interesting class. It was a large lecture so I wasn't expecting it to be the most engaging, but Prof Ahnert was a great speaker and listening was never monotonous. She provided a clear study guide before the 2 multiple-choice exams.

lectures are well paced and thought out, wish we got to engage more since its such a large lecture. i have a brain that prefers smaller classes, but i am (for the most part) easily focused in her lectures even tho they are huge. chill class though not too much work. go to the lectures though, your attendance is graded
Her exams were online and open note and she was very nice. She was passionate about the information she taught.

Professor Ahnert wasn't very good at giving clear instructions with projects and essays, and would just take off a bunch of points after during grading. Her classes were very boring, but attendance was mandatory. She never gave feedback also after taking points off, like she took 8 points off and wrote "good work" and didn't give feedback.
This class is an easy addition to a schedule. She is very passionate about the topic and created all of her slideshows. The workload is light, and the midterms/finals are open note.

Prof Ahnert is a really respectable person. The course was pretty straight forward, but 75% of the course was based on 3 exams, so that isn't great when the exams are 25 questions each. Overall a great prof who gives detailed info about the courses she teaches.

AMAZING professor! Lectures were interesting and I never dreaded going to class. She is a very easy grader and the assignments are also very easy. She is extremely caring about extensions and midterms are not bad. I especially liked how much she cared about the subject and everyone's opinions and thoughts on the films. Defs one of the best at NU!

Absolutely awesome professor!  Dr. Ahnert taught awesome lectures. The course was extremely enjoyable and work was very manageable. She was a clear grader and was very flexible with deadlines. You could tell she was very passionate about the content which made the course very enjoyable and fun, would definitely take again.

I LOVED this class. The professor has so many good ideas and I learned so much from this class. She creates a safe space to share your ideas and discuss important topics relating to race and social justice. Just go to class and do the work and you will learn a lot and won't have to put in too much work. Would definitely take this class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The professor was extremely harsh.
I really enjoyed Amal's class. She was chill and very patient. Her class was very interesting. You have to pay attention to lectures and work hard on homework to receive good grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I loved Amal! She was super passionate about the material. Her lectures did get a little boring near the end of the semester, but that was more of me being burnt out. If you want a good grade, make sure you show up to lectures. The homework got REALLY tough near the end of the year, but if you stick with it you'll do fine.
As long as you go to lecture and pay attention you'll be fine. She's super into what she teaches and gets really excited about new material so the lectures are never really boring.

As mentioned by the other reviewers, it's not required to go to lectures, but if you choose to skip on lectures, you'll need to read the textbook. I never touched the textbook and entirely went to lectures. The homework is tough but doable and very rewarding. Overall, she's an engaging lecturer so pay attention and you'll be fine.

only lectures worth coming are new topics. homework is 10 times harder than the lectures. please get lucky with your partner or be ready to do all your work by yourself. come to office hours a lot. final project (similar topic with her research i assume) was useless - try to do good on your homeworks so that you can skip one at the end.
just read the textbook, really no point in coming to lectures. if you have questions go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Really great teacher. Got me excited about computer science and inspired to pursue it.

Really animated teacher. Keeps the lectures interesting and explains everything well. The problem setsexams are tough for some but the TAs are always there to help.  Textbook reading is unnecessary, lectures and problem sets cover all you'll need to know.
Great teacher! Makes class very engaging.
Moves kind of fast, not organized.
HORRIBLE

Ron Thomas is one smart cookie! He gave great lectures and he has a voice like a grandfather-- so soothing. His sylabus made it seem like we were gonna be loaded down with work, but there really werent many assignments. Just dont be lazy and do zero of the readings cause he's gonna call on you, he ain't dumb he knows when you didnt read. Love u Ron

Great guy, cares a lot about his students and has a vast array of knowledge. However, his grading policy and habits are confusing and sporadic and the group TJX project is a nightmare. Doesn't convey directions or deadlines very effectively. In class debates and discussions are useful and informative.
Great professor, he always makes clear what he expects from you. Has a lot of knowledge and cares very much for his students. Definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The group project was kinda annoying but he gave great feedback and was very helpful throughout the process. Other than that the class was super easy with only a few essay type tests which most people got Bs on which is fine.
Professor Thomas made the overwhelming topic of international business very interesting and manageable. He really, really cares about the subject matter and all of his students. I would

Overall , professor Thomas is a great teacher who is passionate about what he does. But, he is a hard grader! He will criticize every small detail of your work! Be prepared to work a lot and participate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He is nice and kind. His lectures are clear and interesting. However, he is definitely a tough grader and he gives a lot, a lot, a lot of Homework (reading, essay, mini essay,...). The hw given in his syllabus is understated. Be prepare to do much more than what you saw in the syllabus.
Ron is a great professor, and is very helpful both inside and outside the classroom. There is not much homework, but he is a tough grader on tests and the final projects.

Avoid! Super hard grader. Unless he likes you it doesnt matter how hard you try you wont get an A. I studied for the quiz got a B-I didnt study for the 2nd quiz, still got a B-shows me he is biased based on his opinion of you. My group slayed the presentaion, still got a B Unless he likes you A-is impossible let alone an A. Harder than it should be

He's probably the hardest grader I've ever had.  Not even that he holds you to a ridiculously high standard (which he does), but that standard is unclear, and often swayed by his personal opinion.   Make a claim in a presentation and support it with evidence?  Incorrect.  He read something different. Class dragged on, most fall asleep.

Probably the BEST professor I have ever had. If you put in your best effort, participate you will get a good grade. After taking a class with him last semester I loved it so much I took public speaking this semester because he teaches it. The discussions in class, his enthusiasm, intellect, humor makes class so much fun! Take his class you can!!!

A very smart man. His lectures are based off the textbook. Be sure to read and participate in class. His exams are essay based so you really need to know you stuff. And you do a market entry project. Be creative and know your project well; don't read off of your powerpoints. He is really bad about returning grades.
He is charming teacher. Very respect to students, if you have any problem, he will help you friendly. Even though his class is not that interesting, but you will love him.

True that he's intelligent, and coursework is stimulating but his style is dry and boring, doesn't have much personality. Expects a lot but doesn't give much back in return- he's awful about giving grades back. Extremely critical of presentations, focuses more on presentation skills than content.

Awesome professor. He is really really smart, he definitely knows a lot and has the experience to teach us highly valuable things. He was highly respectful of students and really cares about what you have to say (as long as it's not dull). The class is really challenging though, it is a capstone class. He's my favorite professor ever.
Overall good class. Project was challenging.

Excellent professor. Interesting class and learned a lot. Project is challenging and during the summer it is a time crunch. Exams are straight forward and a lot of writing. Prof. Thomas knows what he is doing and has a lot to offer in this course. I highly recommend him for IB social and would take another IB course with him later.

Great Professor! He knows almost everything about Buz. world. If you are someone who really want to learn, def. take him! otherwise not, because he's exams(blue books) are hard, you need to write for 2hours full non stop. Whereas some other professors giving out multiple choices in the exams.

He's awesome. a great and interesting teacher. project is a lot of work but ultimately pretty rewarding, and if you mess something up he's always willing to hear you out if it's reasonable. definitely take his class!!

Awesome, brilliant guy. Unbelievable smart and shares his extensive knowledge during lectures. pretty liberal graders and just a great guy overall. only complain is the project - very similar to intro to business project, but assigned it halfway through the year and very in depth. i would definitely recommend him.

Prof. Thomas brings to life the materials of his class and explains the relevance in history and present day. He strives to provide a full understanding of the material and delivers interesting lectures even on dry topics.

Prof. Thomas has a great intellect and a strong lecture style that keeps the attention of the class focused and interested. He assigns a lot of work but it's relevant to the class material and exams. Great professor; he is insightful, up to date with the world, and has a great point of view and internaional voice.

Very intelligent and interesting guy.  He really knows whats going on in the world and gets you that information in an easy way.  The tests involve a lot of details, but it isn't hard to do well.  Big market entry project at the end of the year weighs a lot on your grade but it isn't hard, just time consuming...take this class!
Profesor thomas is one of the BEST teachers i have ever had. he makes the course veryvery interesting, although you will have to work. I will surely take him next semester
Great teacher. Hard class. Hard project. Learned alot. If you read the cases and listen him/take notes you will learn alot and really appreciate the class.
The best professor at NU, although there may be a heavy workload
Very well prepared and clear in class. Not a whole lot of surprises in this course, but you'll still learn a lot.

Very respectful, wise and correct. Very preparated about any topics and issues. One defect; He gives to many hands out, after two classes you re not even able anymore to fit all those papers in your bagpack.
The best Professor at Northeastern

Professor Thomas is perhaps the smartest man in the entire Northeastern University. Absolute genius.  No matter what your major or concentration is, you should try and take one of his classes. You will have to read a good amount of text for each class.  His exams are not too hard either.
Very smart guy - he really cares about what students have to say. Extremly respectful

This guy is a pro at what he does. Extreamly educated in internationl business. has a phd in physcology. Very interesting class, its actually enjoyable believe it or not... I only have 1 warning.. be prepared to do alot of work and reading. but its worth it, b/c u will walk out of that class with a brighter sense of international business
This class is very interesting. The professor's teaching method is great because he tries to always provide more points of view to a topic.

Prof. makes class extremely interesting through a mix of videos, readings, presentations, facts, articles etc.  Promotes an intellectual curiosity never so far matched by any professor or mentor; this guy is brilliant!!
Has a great way of teaching which promotes curiosity and understanding.

the Prof. is extremely knowledgeable and I loved the class.  You do have to do a lot of work, but its not hard.  Overall the class was really helpful in learning whats going on in the world and very interesting at that.  He's a cool guy
Boring class.  Easy A, if you can do tedious work, does not require too much thinking, just memorization of facts.  However, Thomas is very knowledgable about international business.

Probably one of the most knowledgeable prof. i have ever met. The class is really interesting at first but gets kind of boring towards the end. I would still recomend takin a class with him, you will learn alot
really knowledgable guy. the class can sometimes make you sleepy, but i still learned a lot.

He is an amazing professor. Despite somewhat heavy lectures overall, you can do it very well with his lecture notes and his discussion. His subjects are also worthwhile to take. He is also willing to discuss during office hours. I can say he is an incredible professor who is good to students and good at teaching.

Professor Coskun was difficult to work with compared to other professors. If you get stuck with him I would take Thermodynamics later. He shoo's you away to TAs during officehours. You can't be sick and take quizzes/tests at another time or you will get an oral exam which is unfair. The professor is not understanding of extenuating circumstances.
good professor, hw is a lot but helpful for tests. He pretty much just goes off slides for lectures but its clear and he makes it easy to understand given that its a hardish class

Coskun is a solid choice. There isn't a better option than him so might as well take him. I never attended the lectures and still got a good grade because of the textbook. He prerecords all his lectures so you can take it fully asynchronously if you want. His lectures are very detailed PowerPoints so they are a good reference. Class concepts hard.

Coskun is a knowledgable professor who knows how to break something down step-by-step when explaining it to you. Ask lots of questions and he always has an answer. Thermo is a difficult subject if you don't put time into it, but if you put in the time then Coskun will help you succeed. Also, every section has homework due every class, not just his.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Coskun is an amazing professor. Thermo is an extremely hard course with difficult concepts and his lectures do a great job of making it understandable. He is super nice and easy to find after class and is very good about answering question. Also hes just an absolute savage so gotta love coskun.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He uses Power Point heavily in lectures, but that is actually very helpful because you can easily see the correct equations without trying to understand handwriting. I went to his office hours several times and he was very helpful and also gave good feedback on the Midterms.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring and hard to follow. Teacher goes on ppt slides and doesn not write anything on the board. He teaches the class as if you already know the material.

His lectures are so boring. Thermo is a cool class but he makes sure that you hate it by the end of the semester. If it weren't for the homework due every class it would be a lot easier to just learn from the textbook than listen to him.

Professor has the most boring of lectures. Unfortunately you have to go three of three times a week just to turn your homework in. Yes, he has homework due EVERY class. As far as I'm concerned, his lectures are useless and the book is much more helpful.

Thermodynamics is an extrememly hard class. coskun makes this class even harder with his boring lectures, incomprehensible powerpoint presentations. willing to help though. smart. knows his stuff. but not good at teaching. thermo was very boring and hard with him.

awesome class, of course, for engineering majors. i enjoyed it, he was very clear on what he wanted and laid everything out for us so material was relatively easy to learn as long as you just paid attention and showed up. always in a good mood. didnt mind if i played computer games on my downtime. looked forward to class.
I loved him so much. Got to know everyone's names week 1. As long as you do the homework and use that to study you should be okay on the quizzes.

Professor Ahn is a wonderful professor to take. He made Accounting clear and understandable whilst also providing useful background experience. Grading is generous and you will do fine provided you understand the assigned homework. I wish he could teach my second accounting course here.

Professor Ahn is an amazing, respectful teacher. His lectures are clear, the course Canvas page is organized, he gives review materials for each chapter, and he offers consistent office hours. The course has two midterms, each worth 15%, a final worth 30%, four quizzes worth 10%, connect homework assignments, participation, and a project.

Professor Ahn is the best professor that I have had at Northeastern so far. He is clearly very knowledgable about the material, passionate for teaching, and super kind. He grades generously and fairly. The class itself is pretty difficult but Professor Ahn gives you all the tools needed to succeed and all tests/quizzes are curved.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Goat, best accounting teacher. 4 quizzes out of 50 that are usually curved heavily (split between like 10 MCQ and actual problems), drop the lowest. 2 midterms, one final ( not really curved), and one group project. Teaches really thoroughly and is accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, is available all the time for office hours and is very kind

Accounting in general is a hard course so I can't hate too much. Professor Ahn was great at first. His quizzes were okay and he went through content slowly. When we got to the more difficult chapters, he went too fast for my liking. Very exam heavy! However, he is kind and welcoming and made an effort to get to known everyone's names.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Super nice teacher and very easy grader. Makes an effort to know everybody's name. If you go to the lectures you will get a good grade in the class. Only one group project and isn't difficult.

A great professor for grading—quizzes get a nice curve, but exams don't. Lectures can be dull, but that's just the class. He's kind with selective office hours. Given accounting's difficulty, he grades generously. Multiple choice is key on exams, making up half the quiz points. Struggling? Watch Tony Bell's FA videos—they match the class perfectly.
awesome professor.

He is super knowledgable on accounting and you can tell he loves his job. Amazing professor, lectures can be a little boring but he makes them very straightforward and easy to understand. Tests and quizzes aren't too difficult as long as you study and do the homework. Might be my favorite professor so far.
the goat and the only reason i passed accounting after failing it before. Take him no questions asked. THE GOAT.
This dude is the goat.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very laid-back guy, very nice. Learns everyone's names. Straightforward lectures with practice sheets. Homework is very helpful for your understanding, too. Highly recommend.

4 quizzes and drops the lowest, 2 exams and one final, and one group project thats very doable with competent partners. Class is hard becasue of content but he makes it easy to understand. A VERY nice grader, as long as you show some effort you can easily get a B- on every assesment/assignment. HW can take a bit but just go to office hours for that

Professor Ahn cares about his students understanding the concepts, and definitely prepares you extremely well for every assessment. He is a rather lenient grader, and is not out to get you on docking points which, if you are not a great test taker, is a plus. His lectures are a good pace, and he is accessible outside of class. Pretty Easy A.

Professor Ahn is an incredible teacher for accounting. He is kind, lectures very concisely and slow enough to where you don't really have to study to do good. Overall GOAT and I would choose to take his class again even if I forgot everything about accounting.

Professor Ahn was one of my favorite professors this semester. There were weekly homework assignments and quizzes, but never any surprises on any quiz/exam. He dropped the lowest quiz grade, and exams are always curved. He is an extremely fair grader and replies to emails fast. There is also one group project that will definitely help your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a really good teacher and makes complicated topics easy to understand. He does a lot of examples in class and explains everything multiple times so you really get it. Quizzes and tests are in line with the in-class problems and slides. He is around for help outside of class if needed. Overall great professor.

Ahn is a pretty chill guy. Although the lectures aren't the most entertaining, neither is accounting as a subject itself. He explains things very thoroughly when asked to clarify things and is available outside of class most of the time. Go to his office hours too!

Professor Ahn wasn't the most upbeat or enthusiastic professor, but he possesses a rare ability to understand your questions and walk you through them thoroughly. Also has some solid dry humor, and if you pay attention and do your homework it's a shoe-in A-.

He is really caring about his student although his lecture is quite boring. He always tries his best to make the lecture as much understandable as possible, and his practice sheets for every class are very helpful for the midterm. His test is straightforward and fair grader. I would love taking his class again :)

Professor Jaehan Ahn is very understanding and caring. He gives practice sheets every class to perfectly prepare you to the midterms and final exam. If you want to enjoy Accounnting, you should take this Professor!

His lecture could be a little boring and he is very quiet. But his lectures are very straightforward and slide heavy. I did not always understand the lectures or content, but he was trying his best to teach. He was available during office hours to explain. He provided plenty of homework and study materials and his exams were fair & nice grader.

Great Professor who wants students to understand the material. He came across as slightly boring at the beginning of the semester but is a very nice guy and the class was definitely not boring. Four quizzes and drops the lowest grade of the four. 

Participation	10%
Connect HW	10%
Quiz	10%
Group project	10%
Exam 1	15%
Exam 2	15%
Final Exam	30%

Wonderful professor who really showed he cared for his students by learning our names early in the semester. Very supportive environment but it's a tricky subject matter and was a little scary to speak up. Class very lecture-based. Generous grader. Be warned he uses Excel a lot which can make the class feel even faster-paced.

Incredibly clear professor. As far as the intro to accounting class goes I'd say he's the best professor in the department. He made a notoriously boring subject understandable and interesting enough and the problems you go over in class prepare you well for the quizzes and exams. If you study a moderate amount you can do well in this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, he really cares about his students learning and always includes plenty of examples so that everyone understands. Tests can be tricky but if you study the homework and notes, you will be fine. Highly recommend for ACCT1201

Incredibly knowledgeable man who explains everything well. PowerPoints are extremely useful. Super nice and wants to see you do well. Classes involve a lecture, then working on a handout he provides. He has an amazing voice that can be extremely easy to let become calming background noise, but if you pay attention you will be rewarded.

His lecture could be a little boring because he is a quiet person, but his lectures are very straightforward. As a result, he taught us a very difficult concept in a clear, concise manner. He advised me on my future path in the accounting profession, making him a helpful person to reach out to if you have any questions.
Super straight forward and always gets to the point! Tests are very similar to the handouts he gives and additional questions he suggests doing from the textbook. Generous and fair grader.

These reviews got my hopes up about this prof. Maybe bc it's an online class during a rough pandemic, but he doesn't seem engaged. Very monotone and lectures are hard to sit through. Tests are like examples and homework but still quite difficult and not enough time to finish. I'll cut him some slack for the circumstances the world is in right now.
Professor Ahn was amazing at explaining difficult topics, and his exams were very similar to the worksheets given during class.

My friend and I were definitely surprised when he WASN'T AS FANTASTIC as these comments made him out to be, but he was still DECENT. Very respectable guy - nothing seemed incredibly great about him but he did all the basics pretty well - clear, helpful, compassionate - should feel safe taking a class with him.

Professor Ahn is super friendly and caring to students. As prior comments have mentioned he is typically lenient to students who try and make an effort to understand the topic. He also tries to break down accounting into the smaller segments for easier understanding. I like that there are in class examples and worksheets to practice on.

Out of all my professors this semester, he was the best. His lecture slides and the example questions are very helpful. There are a lot of assignments, but quizzes are more like the example questions. Advice: Just go to class and you'll understand the material better
Best professor ever!!!!!!!
Loved this professor. Best professor with the best humor around. He makes accounting truly enjoyable. Made me concentrate in finance and accounting.

A really great guy who wants you to succeed in his class, and will take the time in lecture to help you understand the material. Reading from the textbook is helpful for some chapters but definitely not mandatory for all.

Took his Financial Accounting class. He is a great guy, who wants you to receive a good grade. When he saw me struggling with some topics on quizzes, he even raised my grade by a bit. Explains the material well, though you may have some troubles with understanding his accent. Listen to his lectures, skim through the textbook and you'll do fine.
Best professor at NEU. I was intimidated by him at first but he turned out to be the funniest professor I've ever had. Makes you understand everything.

He is a great professor! Really wants his students to learn and always clarifies topics when people dont understand. Totally recommend this professor for anyone who nervous about taking accounting!! Hes also very nice. Loved him
What an amazing guy. He makes accounting an enjoyable topics and he's the cutest professor around.

Dr. Aerni is amazing. It is a hard course, and you will have to study, but she makes the exams only about 50% of your grade so if you put in a solid effort, you will get at least a B. The subject is inherently boring, but Dr. Aerni understands that this is material students struggle with. I hate math, but learned a lot and no longer hate stats.

I took Aerni's first semester teaching Wetlands- the course felt a bit disorganised and if I'm honest, I would have benefited from more homework in the class. Sadly I did not learn as much has I'd hoped, but she is caring if not softspoken, and in that class you do get to go play in the mud which rocks. Could have done with better class culture

Very helpful in class and led very interesting lectures which helped make the curriculum feel accessible. Grades pretty easy and makes her rubrics for projects very understandable. Participation is very important in her classes, but you can choose to attend through Zoom instead of in person. Hard to reach outside of class except in office hours.

The class was great, you got out of it what you put into it. Lecture-heavy, easy homework, professor very understanding, personable and smart. Participation graded but you were able to attend class virtually. Only problem would be that she is a little hard to reach outside of class/by email. overall would recommend and I want to be her friend

Loved her class, can be attended online or in person. Lectures are engaging and educational, and in class she is very helpful with questions/concerns. Only issue is she is very difficult to reach outside of class, never got an email back. Many opportunities for your grade, optional extra credit final and projects have super clear rubrics.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Held lectures on zoom and in person at the same time(you can still attend classes while sick in bed), great lecturer and easy to take notes for. Class content was easy. Dr. Aerni was very friendly and helpful in one-on-one interactions, came across as someone who genuinely wants students to learn and enjoy classes.

ENVR1400- Goes pretty fast through the slides but if you pay attention you will be fine, and lab is important for this course. She's really nice and personable but takes a while to grade sometimes. Canvas can be unorganized but she will always move due dates back if you express you had online issues. Participation required but you can join on zoom.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Probably the best professor I have had at Northeastern so far. She is kind, a great lecturer and a very fair grader. She takes attendance and keeps track of participation, but you can get credit for this from in-class writings every class. I got credit for every in-class writing without even reading the material. DON'T BUY THE TEXTBOOKS

Dr. B is one of the best professors I have ever had. I originally took her international relations class as a poli sci major and loved it so much I switched to IA. She is a gem! Has so many office hours, very passionate, always makes class engaging, and does an amazing job explaining IR theories. If you get the chance to take IR with her, do it.

Dr. B is a great lecturer though you have to make sure to keep up with her pace. The course is graded from two non-cumulative exams, a paper, and a group presentation. She's super accessible and understanding with students though you need to make sure to keep up with attendance or it will affect your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Badruzzaman's lectures might seem a bit rushed, but she is very sweet and genuinely cares about all of her students. She's not the easiest grader in the world but she is fair, and she gives plenty of notice for deadlines and things of that sort. International Relations with her was term-heavy, but she's more than willing to help if you asked.

Very hard to understand because of his thick accent. A lot of graphs and charts. The book should help you through the course. Pretty sure he copy and pastes questions from the Internet on to the quizzes. He's not engaging and just a very dry course avoid him if you can.
Guy is hard.

Average professor.  Very dry.  His lectures aren't particularly helpful, but they aren't confusing, either.  His assessments are fairly easy, but the online MC ones can be rough.  He doesn't take attendance, so your grade really depends on how you do on tests (especially the final).

Not one of my more interesting classes but thats microeconomics for you. Prof Saranjam did a great job of using relative examples that made things easier to understand but the material was still challenging. I would highly reccomend staying up with the readings as Saranjam only goes over the graphs and charts whereas the book does vocab.

This is your stereotypical lecture class. I am a good student, but this class was extremely boring to the extent that I lost interest. The teacher does not know who you are, nor keeps attendance. Quizes are all online and can be Googled. Midterm and Final requires looking at his notes and the book. Boring class, but not that hard.

A solid micro teacher. Has a funny accent, and is a bland person, but is quite clear and provides a lot of interesting real-world examples. Also, his quizzes are great because they're online, and you can do them twice in a period of 48 hours. Quick warning: he uses a lot of tables and math, so maybe not the best for the math-challenged.
4 online quizzes, 1 midterm, 1 final. No homework. Not very friendly. His notes are extremely basic so you need to study with the book. Cancels class/doesn't show up sometimes. Not very accessible.

I took him last semster and he stopped giving the answers to the midterm and final ahead of time ... but there are online quizzes and the midterm was really easy (only 7 q's) but the final was really hard but much harder than midterm) however class is easy and he gives you an extra credit option im a poli sci major and this was an easy econ class

If the below description fits you then you should get an A. Good luck, I did it.             - Dont alway's like to go to class                     - Strong memorization skills (hands out     questions for tests beforehand)                   - Can study for long periods of time just right before a test        GOOD GUY

class  is easy. take home quizzes. gives you the questions for the midterm ahead of time. but he is not helpful or understanding with anything. i never wen to class. i got a 79.6 because i totally bombed the final and he wouldn't even round it up to an 80 to give me a B-.

Macro = asy easy class. Take home quizzes with all the answers right in the textbook. Super easy midterm. Tons of easy extra credit assignments. Went to class a total of 10 times all year and still got an A-. Grades the final kind of hard, but he's a really nice guy who will answer whatever questions you have.

I hated him the first couple classes but now i absolutely adore him. he's really funny, has a thick accent but isn't hard to understand. all quizzes are take home and you can take them up to 3 times. midterm was really easy. don't need to go to class. most of the stuff is in the book.

saranjam on toast is HILARIOUS. he says funny things like that the shoes he bought were "twice money" and "bagels the size of pizza." so classic. i spent most of class drawing and writing down his quotes and still got a good grade. ahmad is really straight forward and loves to ask rhetorical questions that nobody answers-but it's ok, he's adorable.

This man is my life. He's hot, he's hilarious, and he knows it secretly. Sexy accent; it's like having Santa Claus teach me (plus some Owl and Cat like features). His class is fun and straightforward and he makes jokes that he giggles at (because they're hilarious). He uses GM in all of his "Exam-Pail"s. Love. him. Hope he's single <333333333

I love this man. His tests and quizes are very easy if you read the book and some of them are even online. He knows what he's talking about and thoroughly explains everything. Plus, his classes are always like 45 minutes long and he doesn't ever take attendance.
Great Professor. Usually puts the quizzes online with unlimited time to do it.  Try to go to class, if not everything is pretty straight foward out of the textbbook.
You wouldn't think he's as good of a lecture professor as he is- he's pretty incredible and making macro sensible and easy to understand. Loved his class, would take it again if I had to.

I struggled with this online class, I thought the amount of work was endless!  By the end of the class i really appreciated how much I had learned.  He graded very fairly and always answered questions.  He really wants you to learn and to do well!  Loved him!

Although not necessary to go to class, he does give useful notes. Still, reading the book is mandatory since the quizzes reference examples from the book. Good professor though, explains stuff well. One thing to keep in mind about him is that he doesn't like to fight so if you feel as though he did something wrong CALL HIM OUT ON IT.

he is really clear and writes everything on the bored...you might want to read the book unless your happy with a B-...the exams are easy if you study the review sheet....I enjoyed going to class because i understood the material and was way better than my macro teacher...plus he lets you out like 30 minutes early almost every day

All he does is lecture. What he teaches is identical to what's in the book, so a lot of people don't go to class, and just study from the book and do fine on the quizzes. Extra credit essays add ten points to each quiz grade if you have the time to do them. Midterm & Final were easy essay questions taken straight from the chapter reviews.
Really kind person, decent class.

I'm not an economics major, so this class was really boring for me.  I didn't like this guy at first, but he got better as the semester went on.  If you do all of the homeworks and take good notes, you should be ok.

Saranjam was a pretty ok teacher. Seriously, I rarely showed up for the class. 5 quizzes @ 10%, 2 exams at 25%. i read the book before the quizzes and got B+ as lowest grade. I studied for a multiple choice midterm and was handed an essay question exam and failed. Thus, i got a D+. Besides that he was great!
He adjust his test to the capability of the overall class.  Big on extra credit.  The notes mimic the text so going to class is optional.  Pretty good guy.

its the average college course. i got a C+ and all i did was show up. i never took notes or studied or paid that much attention. if i did, i would of had an A, guaranteed. so, dont get lazy in this class. he's a good teacher

I regret waking up every morning because I will have to suffer this class. He rushes through lectures and is passive-aggressive when students ask questions, yet we are still behind the other classes, which makes labs impossible. We just covered Lab 1 material...we're in the middle of Lab 3. For the exam, max 10 letters PER INCH on the cheatsheet.

Tests are beyond fair. Our first exam was so incredibly easy I couldn't believe it. I saw the work in my friends who are taking a different professor for this class and it seemed MUCH harder. He can be condescending and will call you out if you don't pay attention in class, but it's just because he wants you to learn. Would definitely take again.

Professor Aboelela is one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern. He is caring and understanding and can explain topics really well. He might throw comments at students who aren't paying attention and be a little sarcastic, but if you are someone who can take jokes, you will absolutely love this side of him. Highly recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very great professor, Dr. Emad is passionate about his lectures and insures his students receive the help they need if asked. Would take again.

Like most COE coding classes, it was easy if you already know some coding, and probably horrible if you didn't. Very passionate about his lectures but they can still get a bit dry at times. Exams were quite easy and the labs are pretty easy as well (and the reports are a joke). Plus all lab stuff can be split with a partner.

Prof. Emad is really caring. He puts learning first instead of giving too much homework, which is one of the best things about him. If all teachers used his approach, the COE would be a lot better, and students would learn more without just struggling to finish homework. He's simply the best.

Professor Emad is highly regarded for his teaching abilities. His lectures are so well-structured and engaging that it's difficult not to grasp the subject matter. He is, without a doubt, among the best in his field.

Amazing professor. His in class slides are detailed and easy to learn from. He goes over many examples to ensure students understand the concepts. Midterms and homework are both VERY fair. He is also just a great guy and cares about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Nice professor with detailed slides. Even though the attendance is mandatory, he is still a good professor. Homework is resonable and useful.
Easy exams, easy homework. Class participation is quizzes in Poll everywhere that no matter if it is right or wrong.

I thought he taught the course well. It's clear he's passionate about the subject, and knows a lot about it. The grading is generous in my experience and I wouldn't hesitate to take one of his classes again in the future.

I don't understand all the hate for Emad. Had him for embedded, and I thought his lectures were interesting, and that he really broke everything down logically to make it easy to understand for the students. Visited office hours with him a few times, it is evident that he cares a lot about his students and gets excited when we are learning!
Good as far as EECE professors go

Spends 2 hours lecturing and often does multiple chapters in one day, there is practically no practice material and what little there is will not help you for tests. Lectures are boring and it is incredibly hard to know what is important and what is filler. Does not prepare students for exams and is then confused when the class average is a 50.
The class is not interesting and she tries too hard t be liked instead of actually having us learn something new

Amazing teacher! Genuinely cares for students and does her very best to accommodate depending on your situation. She made the classroom environment super welcoming. Overall an absolute g and her assignments are pretty fun too

Took her class in person over the summer. She is a kind professor, and in-class activities are very fun! There were 4 assignments which were pretty easy, a quick online presentation, and the "final" is just making revisions on the previous assignments. There is a participation grade which can be completed by taking notes on the reading. I recommend

I took Professor DeCamp for Intro to Rhetoric and loved it! She is very kind, understanding, and well-read. She taught the course material in a very clear way, and used in-class group work to solidify understanding. This class is not hard to succeed in so long as you attend the class periods and turn in all assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. DeCamp is a wonderful professor and is incredibly passionate about teaching rhetoric. She makes herself super available and is always relating course content to things happening in the real world.

Took first-year writing with Dr DeCamp, and was very happy that I did! She is a wonderful teacher, lecturer, and knows how to balance learning and having fun. She made everyone feel welcome and is clearly passionate about what she does. Her expectations for you are clear, and she only wants to help you pass.

SO HAPPY I TOOK FIRST-YEAR WRITING WITH ABBIE!!! She's truly one of the kindest professor's at this school and really wants her students to succeed. You definitely learn a lot and she gives really good personalized feedback, but it's not hard to get a good grade. Can't recommend her enough!

Abby is the best calculus teacher I have ever had. She truly loves what she does and wants her students to succeed. She posts a LOT of super helpful practice for quizzes and exams. She gives us practice exams that are EXACTLY like the real ones. Quizzes are verbatim homework questions. The way she teaches in class is clear and easy to understand.

Genuinely one of the best professors I have had in a while. She is SO kind and so encouraging, I never felt uncomfortable or scared to ask for her help. There are seven quizzes that are taken straight from textbook homework questions, one midterm and one final. She is a really great professor, definitely recommend!!!

Love this woman. Very clear lectures, frequently pauses for questions, and quizzes are literally pulled directly from the HW. She also gives you multiple practice midterms and finals that are almost identical to the real thing. Best math instructor I've ever had, and a super easy A if you do the bare minimum amount of work. Definitely recommend!

Took her for geometry but that wasn't an option so posting here. She's an incredibly nice woman, but the class took up an irrational amount of time for a math elective, and the grading was unnecessarily harsh.

Professor Williams clearly cares about her students and is passionate about what she teaches. I enjoyed this class a lot, and it was very straightforward. Quizzes are just HW problems and all the notes are posted on Canvas so it's not hard to do well in this class even if you miss lectures. Would highly recommend!
Really nice person and thoroughly explained topics during lectures. Would take again. Good lecturer.
She is super passionate and absolutely loves what she does, which makes the class better. I have always struggled in math, but her lectures made sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very great teacher go to class take notes and you'll be fine she moves fast but very good at explaining everything and quizzes once a week but if you do the homework they are easy and the exact problems from the homework
Amazing. Best professor I've ever had at Northeastern. If you put in some work, you are almost guaranteed an A.

I'm not a natural in math, but I loved Professor Williams' course! She was always quick to respond to emails, gave extra credit if you did the homework, and quizzes/midterm had reasonable questions on lessons she covered thoroughly beforehand. This class takes effort, but she definitely teaches the course fairly, which helps a thousand times over.

Best calc teacher in all of Northeastern. She genuinly tries to make an effort to teach the class and is engaging with all students. 36% quizzes which are verbatim hw problems but it takes time to understand them so beware, 24% midterm and 40% final. If u stay on top of homework and use all practice materials, u should get an A (99 on final).

Dr. Williams is one of the most caring and supportive professors I've ever had, even though I math isn't my strongest subject and I was struggling a bit in her class. She provides so many resources (past exams/lectures) that are so helpful when studying and helped me do well on the final exam. Genuinely makes calculus fun and easier to understand.

Honestly an amazing professor. She did a great job explaining calc. Had taken calc in high school so was a repeat pretty much but things i was confused on she was always willing to help. quizzes were basically homework, exams were exactly the same as practice tests especially the final. she sets you up to succeed - couldn't recommend more!

one of the best math teachers I've ever had. Quizzes are verbatim hw questions, and you can get extra credit for them. Midterm and Final are super similar to past exams and she's super accessible if you need any additional help

She is honestly the best math professor/teacher I have ever had. The content on the quizzes all comes from homework and the midterm and final were very clear and pretty much the same as the past papers. She really cares about her student and explain content very well. Take her class!

This class (Geometry, no option to select) was extremely difficult. All the exams were take home, and they took HOURS to complete. She was very specific with her proofs, and she was not very lenient with grading. While she is very enthusiastic, I do not recommend taking this class. I do not feel like I have grown as a student with this class.
Great professor. She doesn't go too fast and tries to make class enjoyable.
Caring professor but not the best lecturer in my opinion. Good amount of homework and quizzes every week. Could've explained topics better
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Williams is the nicest and most caring professor I have had. Calc 2 is a difficult concept but she made it a lot easier with her lectures and examples. She was also accessible for office hours and very patient and helpful in them. If you have the option to take a class taught by her, do it without a second thought, there's nobody better.
Dr. Williams is an AMAZING Calculus professor. The course itself is test heavy no matter what, but she is good at explaining the concepts and she is a fair grader. I couldn't recommend her more.

We love Abby. I had a horrendous calc 1 prof and I was scared going into calc 2, but she was immediately willing to help whenever needed. She makes math so easy and approachable. I used to dread math, but now I dread it less because of Abby. She is so sweet and caring. Take her for any class if you can!

One of my favorite professors at NEU. Williams is so sweet and genuinely wants students to do well. The quizzes are verbatim homework questions and the tests are always on topics we covered and not a surprise. Highly recommend

Content-wise - it's such an easy class. There is a lot of busy work with the in-class activities and homework. She is a very harsh grader when it comes to the problem of the week and portfolios. There aren't clear guidelines and expectations, so she takes off a lot of points for things she never specified, which can be very frustrating.

Prof. Williams is one of the most caring professors I've ever had. She's a great lecturer who clearly has a passion for teaching and is always willing to help. I would highly recommend taking her for any math class at Northeastern.

She is awesome and so nice. As a Political Science/Journalism major, I wasn't ecstatic about taking a math class. She made it simple, fun, and I learned a lot. If you're like me it'll probably be the first math class you've ever fully enjoyed. If you do the homework, get her feedback on the portfolios, and do the practice tests, you will get an A.

If I had another math requirement, I would choose Abby again in a heartbeat. As a journalism/poli sci major, I had no interest in taking math again and was dreading what ended up being my best course of the semester. She genuinely cares about you and your understanding of the material. She's flexible on attendance but definitely recommend going.

Dr. Williams is the kindest and most understanding professor I've ever had. She's brilliant when it comes to math and has two PHDs. She understands we have other classes and other things on our plates and never over loads students with work. Make sure to go over study guide before exam. Exams are easy of you know the study guide.
Great professor, her lectures are super easy to follow and make the tests pretty easy (as long as you practice). Definitely recommend.
I would die for Dr. Williams. She is so compassionate and patient and she got me to look forward to math, which is insane. If you have the opportunity, take her!

I absolutely loved Professor Williams' class. She kept me engaged in calculus, something that is very difficult for me. She is a very fair grader and gives tons of partial credit on tests. Her lectures truly are great and she is passionate about what she teaches. A true gem at Northeastern!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I didn't miss a single class the whole semester because that is how interesting her lectures are. Very accessible to students and knows what she is teaching. Grading is based on 4 tests and a final exam and she drops the lowest test score. Tests are almost similar to the practice tests she gives. Replies to emails super quickly. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

Professor Abby is my favorite if not, top 5 professors that I have experienced at NEU. She is so enthusiastic about what she is teaching and she made me love Calculus all over again. Took the honors section and it was very easy. She explains everything in-depth and there are no surprises, EVER. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN OR MAKE YOUR SCHEDULE FIT HER!

Prof. Williams is the BEST math teacher I've ever had, and probably one of the best professors I've had in general. Lots of math professors are super passionate about math, but it's rare that they can translate that enthusiasm & knowledge to students like Prof. Williams was able to. Great and caring lecturer, highly recommend, just put the work in.

Professor Williams is the best professor I have ever had. She is an excellent lecturer; all of the notes she posts are easy to follow and straightforward. All of my emails were answered quickly, too. If you have the opportunity to take a class with her, I highly recommend doing so.

Abby Williams is the best! I had a horrible calc 1 professor and was nervous about calc 2, but Abby Williams really cares about her students, and even though the material can be somewhat complex she simplifies it and does not add extra information that would make it more confusing. She has so much extra credit opportunities and is a generous grader

Professor Williams is the best professor I have had at Northeastern. She is so enthusiastic about math and makes lectures less boring. She is also very caring and supportive to every student, no matter how stupid questions are. Easy grader and textbook is linked to online HW so it is required. Definitely recommend.

Prof. was enthusiastic & kind every day of class! Made sure to answer all questions & be available in & out of class. Always kind & ready to re-explain concepts to us when needed. Really emphasized learning the actual concepts before focusing on getting right answers. Was scared to take math but so glad I was recommended to take this class w/ her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Williams was the best Professor I had at northeastern! While it isnt her fault the course is based solely on tests/quizzes, she is fair and lets you know what the tests are on and is willing to help you outside of class. She really has a passion for math and that is evident in her fun lectures. Just do the hw and youre golden. Love her
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: It is SO rare to find a great math teacher - Professor Williams made this class as clear and painless as possible; you definitely have to study and put in the work, but she sets you up for success! I had very little calculus experience and still felt comfortable the entire semester.

She is really kind and knowledgeable and she was very helpful at office hours. Her lectures are pretty well set-up too. I would recommend her for Calculus 1 or Calculus 2 (I had her for Calculus 2 and I learned a lot!) Make sure to do the homework - it's what you'll see on quizzes and tests! And go to class.

Prof. Williams is probably the best Math professor i've had in a REALLY long time. She cares about the success of her students and is always open for questions at any times. She tries her best to make you understand, and makes class enjoyable! For people who struggle with math, Prof. Williams will change your perspective in 1 semester! Love her!

I loved Professor Williams! I am not a math person at all but her lectures left me understanding almost all of the material! She was always willing to answer questions from the class and from homework. I bought the textbook and we didn't end up using it that much, though it was helpful for extra review. I would definitely recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I'm not a fan of mathematics but when I took her class, she made everything so easy to understand! Her lectures are amazing and she is more than happy to help out any student who is having any difficulty in the class. If I had to take anymore math classes, I would be more than happy to take one of hers again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: A very good professor! I hate math and she made it bearable. Her lectures were never boring  and she made all math concepts very clear. I really liked her.

I was annoyed I'd have to take a math class even though I'm in CSSH. The class wasn't easy, and I had to work hard, but the class was actually interesting and helpful! Most of that is due to Williams. She's straight-forward but kind, caring, and extremely helpful and patient. She's accessible and goes out of her way to explain things simply. Gem!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Long overdue - had him for econometrics in fall 2024, but hands down the best econ prof I've had! He made difficult concepts so clear and care about his students very much. He is intelligent, reasonable, articulate, understanding, and enthusiastic. Would highly recommend!
Widely known as the professor whose exams require all-nighters. Unless you're looking to absorb a ton of material, spare yourself the struggle.

Prof Abel is the best economics professor I have had at Northeastern. His lectures are extremely clear, making difficult concepts much easier to understand, and is clearly very qualified by the depth of knowledge he demonstrates. He is very kind and cares about his students, taking time to remember each student's name in his class. Highly recommend

Prof. Josh is an exceptional lecturer, cares about students, helpful office hours. Also be prepared challenge. Exams and papers are tough, requiring a deep understanding of the material. Some exam questions are wild, requires a 500-word essay to explain, while other sections never ever have such crazy things. Twice efforts needed to get above 90.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had him for both Microtheory and Econometrics. He is by far a top three professor at Northeastern - insanely intelligent, helpful, and personable. I went to office hours a lot the last two years and he is always willing to explain. If you put in the effort you can do well. I can not recommend him enough, he is one of my favorite professors ever!
awesome. really really good. U need to watch/ attend lecture. So interesting. Make group for problem sets will help a lot

Best professor I have taken at this school hands down. Extremely smart and it reflects on his lectures - he explains topics super clearly and makes the harder stuff doable. Very reasonable problem sets, lots of exam prep, and accessible in office hours. Only 8am to date I have made an effort to go to everyday.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: BEST AND ONLY USEFUL ECON CLASS Which you can directly apply. U need to attend class

Learned a lot and not a time-consuming class. His lectures could drag at times, but his slides include everything we needed to know for the test and he spent decent time in class going over practice examples and applying theory to the real world. Really smart and helpful professor; tests are difficult but he grades and curves fairly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: AMAZING PROFESSOR! This class was incredibly difficult, and you really had to work for a good grade, but he was always available to help in office hours. Exams were challenging, but to be expected in a course like this. If you have the opportunity to take him, DO IT.

Best economic professor I've had so far at this school. Willing to help you with the difficult homework to get you a good grade. Great lectures and answers any questions efficiently. Relatively hard tests but have a good curve. You get all your information from lectures and off the slides, but his lectures are entertaining so it's easy to learn.
Legitimately top 2-3 profs in the Econ department at NEU. If you are able to take a class with him, do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Definitely not a traditional teacher, but you'll do well in this class as long as you show up and participate. My grade didn't drop below an 100 the entire semester and there are opportunities for extra credit. I couldn't tell you what she was aiming to teach us, we often did strange exercises in class, but if you go along with it you'll succeed.

Please pick her. She is super nice and truly amazing. You do not need perfect grammar. She is old school and makes you write instead of type, but she is very helpful. Her class activities are great. If you do the work, you can pass with an A. She is fair, caring, and truly compassionate toward students. Yes, pick her.

If you're worried about being a bad writer, this class is for you. The professor is understanding of all skill levels & grades more on effort than perfection. There are no formal assessments besides opinion-based writing, so you'll do fine. She can be a bit quirky (made me uncomfortable at times), but she's a good person. Dislikes poor attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Crain is a free spirited professor. She gives a good amount of homework and reading but honestly everything is usually opinion based and she grades lightly.
