reviews.comment: This is the writing class you want to take. Not too taxing but you still feel like you learned something.

I recommend this professor for your writing class. This teacher challenges in way where you have to think outside of the box. He truly cares about his students and gives amazing feedback on what to improve on. Take this class for first year writing. I would love to take his class again for advanced writing.

Professor Huggins is a super nice guy who really helped me learn more about English without additional stress as an Engineering major. His class was pretty easy as long as you tried. I'd 100% recommend taking him!

Extremely considerate of your circumstances. His grading is clear and manageable. Just get your projects/papers done and you'll receive the maximum grade. He often compliments students work and uses student examples which makes writing enjoyable.
very good professor and he really cares about his students!

Best professor ive had yet . Very chill guy and gives really good feedback . Went into the class not expecting much but left with so much more . Gives a lot of freedom with your writing and is open to discuss everything . The class does has work but the work is very fulfilling .Overall great guy and a great professor

Prof Blazek is very caring and understanding for all students. He understands students start the class with different levels of experience with physics and gives resources to those less experienced. Slides and lectures are very clear and well structured. I slept through the midterm and he let me take it the next day.

He is a very caring professor who wants students to succeed in his course. He makes an effort to be available for extra help and is very patient. Has good demonstrations during lectures that help enhance learning. Clearly very knowledgeable and always encourages further learning. I absolutely recommend him for anyone taking Physics 2.

Overall enjoys what he is teaching which makes the lectures fun. Lots of cool demonstrations which were fun/helped me visualize what we were talking about. The grade is broken up between a mixture of things which is nice in case you don't do well on the midterm or final. Homework is a little tough and takes some time but you have a week to do it.

Prof Blazek is really nice and cares about his students! I learned a lot in this course and would take him again. Homework, practice exams, and group office hours were really helpful! Online quizzes were a bit annoying but not really an issue. I really liked his in class demonstrations, and lecture slides were filled with helpful visuals!

He's the best professor I had at northeastern. Clearly knowledgable and cares about his students. Super friendly and is always willing to help with homework. Lectures are easy to follow and always posted on canvas. Gives lots of practice material. Likes to do demonstrations.

Blessington was the worst professor I have had in my time at Northeastern. I took his class because I was interested in poetry and he basically destroyed any chance of me ever pursuing that interest again. He was extremely rude and never responded to emails. He made fun of students and faculty repeatedly and was incapable of using online resources.

Created a classroom environment that made students fearful of reading their work because of his abnormally harsh criticism. Was incredibly unsympathetic and did not care about his students in the slightest. Ruined poetry for me and he clearly has no idea what a subjective writing course is supposed to be about as he was very objective when grading.

Course was called "Origins of Genres," and was part of a PhD program. I have no idea if attendance was mandatory because I wanted to go. I didn't mind putting work into it because I was there to learn and develop.  He was thoroughly prepared, hugely literate and immensely interesting. One of the top profs I've had, and I've had some good ones.

In a class about self-expression he promoted a critical, toxic environment. He made bigot comments on pieces outside of his own perspective and students felt uncomfortable/anxious about contributing to the discussion because of his scrutiny. If you want your self-confidence shredded then I recommend this class.
Professor Blessington ruined poetry for me. Never take a class with him.

I took Greek Tragedy so we were assigned mini reports for each play we read. It was fun, no pressure because of how short they were, and helped you dive into the material. Vague about what he wants from your assignments. He is more lecture based and he really knows what he's talking about, though sometimes class questions go right over his head.

Best teacher I have ever had.  I was at NU from 99-01, so it's been a while.  I am now an Eng. teacher, and I can honestly say that interest started in his class.  He is probably the smartest person I've ever met, but doesn't live in an ivory tower.  He's spent summers farming and Spain and just seems to know everything about everything.

Blessington is the best.  Wish he was my grandfather.  He is brilliant, hilarious and nice.  I was doing horribly in the class, probably because I never went during the first half, and he helped me get back on track and completely turn my grade around.  Makes the material interesting and fun, and I would recommend him to anyone.

Best professor I've yet come across. This man is a genius, and it's almost impossible to believe the extent of his knowledge of literature. He has translated Greek plays to English, is avid about Milton, can point you probably to any precise line in Homer or Virgil. Just the best, I want another class with this guy. Smart, funny, memorable for sure

He is brilliant and hilarious. I enjoy listening to what he has to say in lectures. He makes material fun and helps you to understand. I would recommend him to anyone. He's a bit of a hard grader, but it pushes you to work harder. I learned so much from this class.

AMAZING! He has seen and done it all. His knowledge of literature is astounding. His lectures are clear and while he does veer away from the topic at times, his stories/antecdotes are witty and interesting.

The readings were at times overwhelming, and much of the assignments I never finished.  His lectures were amazing, however, and made the class worthwhile.  The man really knows his stuff, and is HILARIOUS.  There are too many Blessington quotes to count.. and too many aren't acceptable for younger readers to see! ;)
Definitely intense reading, I would recommend keeping up with it. Other than that he is extremely knowledgable and impassioned about the subject.

The reading is INTENSE.  I'm an English major and I had difficulty keeping up.  Pay attention to the readings in class - they WILL be on the midterm/final!!!  But beside that, he is an incredibly intelligent guy and keeps a fairly uninteresting topic somewhat interesting.
Blessington is extremely intelligent. He makes a few jokes, and has some interesting things to talk about. He is a fairly tough grader but if you do the work you will do well.
One of the best professors I've had in NU.
No Comments

Blessington is the man. He knows his**** inside out and if you ask him a question on what you don't understand, he *will* clarify it and be direct. He's funny too, at random moments. Quite quirky and definitely the biggest character out of all my teachers
professor blessington is very brilliant although can be a bit boring

Blessington is the best professor I have come across at this school. Some how he made paradise lost and a**** load of poetry about god interesting. Extremly intelligent, a fair grader and, he's actully kind of funny. This guy could teach "the evolution and science of tax reform policies" and somehow make it captivating

One of the most intelligent people you will ever have the good fortune to meet in your life.  Honestly, such a great professor. His comments  anecdotes are also quite funny at times.  Although he might as well be the most knowledgeable professor at NU, he doesnt seem conceited.  Good Guy.

This guy has so much knowledge over such a variety of literature, it's unbelievable. One of the few professors I really feel I learned something from. A bit tough sometimes, but stick with it and you'll do fine.

He is obviously very intelligent, but the class was BORING.  Lectures very dry, I wanted to sleep through all of them...  Don't worry about going to class, most of the material on tests is from the reading assignments

Probably the best prof. I have ever had.  Made me want to become a teacher of literature myself.  The reading requirement isn't that bad if you stay on top of it.  Besides, by the time you get to college you should have read most of those texts anyway.
very very smart man.

The best teacher I've had at Northeastern. There is usually a good amount of reading and lengthy lectures, but I've never known a teacher who gives as interesting and informative of lectures. Recommended more for English majors or those who really love Literature.

although the course content is somewhat dry and a lot of reading is required in a fairly short amount of semester time he does make it as interesting as possible. And though he is a relatively tough grader he is always willing to help when you need him. He also really knows what he's talking about.

A smart man...but doesn't know how to teach. His lectures are full of tangents, and he doesn't really explain text very well. He's nice enough, though, and every now and then makes a good point, but overall...I'd say you had to be really into the subject matter to put up with this class.

Loads of reading--a novel each week, sometimes more.  And Blessington is something of an elitist--he belittles popular fiction, or anything that isn't considered "literary"--but he's a thorough marker, and smart as hell.  Recommended course.

Be prepared for a****load of reading.  Illiad, Odyssey, Aeneid, Bible, Bacchae and some other plays in a VERY short period.  Seems like a nice guy, very knowledgeable, but the material can just get boring I guess..

Very interesting course but look forward to a lot of reading. Blessington is a really smart person so that makes the class interesting as well. Only two papers and a midterm and a final besides the reading. I learned a lot though.

Prof Bhawesh is a typical college prof. Class is lecture heavy, so while attendance isn't mandatory, skipping class with often miss you an entire chapter. No tests, 3 exams and group project. Very straight forward. Easy grader as long as you complete your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is boring but you get a cheat sheet for the test, just pay attention and you'll end with an A. He also grades lightly and clear rubric, semester long project but not too bad.
Take hand written notes. He is so sweet and wants you to understand. As long you pay attention and do the homework you'll do great.
This professor is so nice. He curves based on the final score and understands students' situations. Respected!
Bhawesh is a decent professor. He grades fairly hard, but the expectations are very clear. He cared about the students success and there was no written final, only an easy presentation.

I think as long as you follow along in class and reference the canvas you'll do well. The homeworks are rarely more than an extension of what's covered in class and he's pretty approachable if you have more questions on the topic. Very chill grader as well if he can tell you're putting in effort

Does not know how to teach. Rambled & when someone asked a question he'd repeat what he just said & move on. Made us buy a textbook and never had us use it. No outline/guidance for final project. Tests were hard but let us make cheat sheets; no makeups and mcqs worth 7 points each?? Also taught us coding for no reason (nothing to do with stats?)

Professor is very kind and funny, and did a good job of teaching - can sometimes explain things too quickly for people not familiar with computer science but always willing to go back and repeat. Not a huge workload, would recommend this professor.

Not accommodating at all when having to miss class. Not even wellness days count. if you are sick or have a family emergency you still have to go or makeup in office hours. There are assignments due every class as well as homework. No help is really available for the assignments either.

Really nice professor! Took him for mism 3515 during the pandemic so his classes were online. Thank god, he might be a little slow for some during lecture but overall he's very kind and a solid choice for professor. Unless you have the option of some other amazing professor, go with him.

Super caring professor and is very fair with all students. However, his grading is tough and there is a lot of workload for this class, so be prepared for that! But highly recommend taking his class you will learn a lot!!
He's just amazing. TAKE HIS CLASS IF YOU CAN!!!!!!!!!

Legit favorite person in the world--so caring, equitable, and a genius. This man is literally a superhero. While tests can be hard, they are all open notes so you need to work hard and study the material, but not memorize anything. Changed my major to supply chain because of him!!

One of the absolute best professors at Northeastern; he treats students as equals and actually cares. The tests are difficult, but they have a heavy curve(stated that a 65-70 would equal a B+). Wait until a semester you are starting to look for co-ops, he brings in many guest speakers and discusses his real-life experience in the Supply Chain field

ABSOLUTE GOAT. Cares more about his class and students than my parents care about me. Prof Bhimani is so passionate and understanding. My favorite NEU professor. A little heavy on the work but very manageable. Put in a little effort for this class and you will reap the benefits. I hate supply chain but Prof Bhimani made the class so enjoyable!!!!

Probably the most enthusiastic professor I've had about what he teaches. A literal Gem. Very very understanding and believes everything is a democracy... so your opinion matters. Grade is very divided which means it's doable to score well. He also curves the grades at the end of the semester.
LEGEND! The GREATEST SUPPLY CHAIN PROFESSOR EVER at Northeastern University.

Tbh, Shawn is the best professor I have ever had at NEU, and I have taken his 2301 and 3305 classes. He was the reason why I added SCHM as my second concentration. His class is challenging but really interesting and helpful for your career. Some comments say the test is hard, tbh, exams are not hard if you participate in the class discussion.
Not a good professor. Tests are VERY HARD. I do not take this class again.

Shawn is an amazing person who practices what he preaches. It was so refreshing to take this class and learn about how we, as individuals, are what can make a difference in whatever we do. GAAHHH. Words cannot describe this man. A true gem.

Absolutely loved his class. Incredibly knowledge professor, but his exams are really something else. Extremely difficult unless you pour lots of time into them. However, he curves the class average to a B+.

This professor is by far my favorite I had at Northeastern. He's extremely knowledgeable in Supply Chain, combines class material with personal experiences and is the post inspirational person! You have to study a hard but it's very rewarding at the end. Participate a lot in class, do your homework and you'll do great! 10/10

I just graduated and am looking back at the worst professors I ever had, and no doubt this guy was it. I'll never forget when he wouldn't let us use the restroom and someone in the class had a disability. Straight up bad person and an even more impossible teacher who would give out bad grades just to give them out. Cant stand him, don't take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely the worst professor Ive had so far at Northeastern. Ill never forget the time they just graded my question wrong when it was correct and he wouldnt give me the point back because he wouldnt work the problem out himself to see the answer. Save yourself the trouble

Definitely an unorthodox teacher, but you can tell he knows a lot about the subject he is teaching. Beware that he customizes his own syllabus and the topics covered are very difficult to find examples of online. Also, the only grades we have are quizzes and the final and there are fewer quizzes in the honors sections.

FYI. In the canvas, in the quizzes, there were all of last year's bi-weekly quizzes and the final exam there. I found that out a bit late. It's not enough though; many of his quizzes are unpredictable. Just make sure you understand what he covers in class. Don't worry about unfamiliar things in recitation, since those won't be on quizzes.

As a person he is probably a good guy but he is a horrible professor. Very condescending and his course does not make sense. Impossible to find practice tests and exams, unpredictable and makes up his own way of teaching the material. You have to show up to classes to understand the way he does things. Office hours are weird sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: "Old SAT" grading only occurs for matching questions or MCQ, and quizzes rarely had those. While explanations of concepts can be kind of convoluted, he explains HW problems very well. If you are cannot switch out don't fret. An A is very possible. Do your due diligence of doing ALL the HW and going to office hours, and AP AB Calc was easier too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Absolutely terrible professor. He is so rude to students and fails to explain concepts. Absolutely avoid taking his class at all costs.

I'll never forget when he wouldn't let us go to the bathroom, and a girl got her time of the month and yelled at him that she had to go. Mean person, mean grader, dropped this class and preferred to take it with anyone else. AVOID. Absolutely terrible person. Miss class? Good luck. Have to go to bathroom? Hold it. 0 empathy here
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is made up entirely of quizzes and final. If you miss class, you won't be able to understand what's going on in class at all. Most of his methods that he expects you to use on quizzes and tests are not commonly used and googling to understand these concepts is not really an option. He does go over questions before the quiz which can help
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you have a choice, do not take his class at an honors level. He makes the quizzes much more difficult by putting questions that related to topics we never learned in class. Also, his grading criteria for the honors section is much more harsh than his regular section, for example, an A in honors is anything above a 94.5. I would not recommend him
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Doesn't seem to know how to teach. He's clearly very knowledgeable, yet he holds us to a higher standard on quizzes than even he is able to perform during class. Your grade is exclusively based on quizzes and tests, and if you make even a minor mistake on a quiz that can bump your quiz grade down to the 70s. Overall extremely difficult.

Professor Blank is extremely condescending to his students and laughs at "dumb" questions. He frequently makes mistakes on the board while teaching and students often correct him. Regardless, he is extremely smart and knows a lot about what he teaches. If you cannot keep up with him, you will not be able to excel in the class. D- required to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: sandy blank is by far the worst professor at northeastern university. he does not care for his students' success at all and in fact, enjoys when students do not perform well. He puts in minimal effort to explain topics to us and even purposely gives us incorrect problem solutions to work on at home. I promise that you will regret taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sandy is not a great teacher. He doesn't respect the learning process. If you don't get it, he fails to explain the concept in simpler terms (or at all). His tests were graded in such a way that partial credit is nonexistent, and you could only miss about 3 problems (over quizzes and the final) to still secure an A. His grading style is "old-SAT".

Hes willing to answer hw questions but spends too much time on hw and not enough on new lessons. Final is harder than quizzes and half the grade. Quizzes are the other half. Theres lots of pressure on the end of the semester because quizzes are weighted progressively more. Also grades no. right minus half times wrong , so a pretty hard grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: 40% of the class is based on the final and 60% is based on quizzes. He talks in a very quiet voice that can hardly be heard in the classroom so lectures are difficult to follow. This class is meant to be Calc 1 and Differential Equations, but he skims all of Calc 1 in the first week and skips through to linear algebra by the last month.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the strangest men I have ever met. Spends a large portion of the class giving background information on topics instead of teaching them. Quiz difficulties fluctuate. Would not take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: As much as I love Sandy as an individual, he expects his students to be able to understand complicated math theorems after doing one problem together in class. Be prepared to have to teach yourself the concepts through doing your homework. Attendance isn't necessary, but if you miss a class you'll fall behind and it can be hard to catch up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: If you already took AP calc AB, then itll be an easy A

I personally love Sandy and would recommend his class. He is exceptionally smart and likes to teach. His content is difficult but if you attend class and do the assigned homework problems/ask questions, you should have no problem getting an A. I have always loved math and Sandy is one of my favorite professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Sandy is a very smart man but he taught so students were supposed to learn how and why certain formulas/strategies work without him explicitly explaining it. This would work if the subject matter weren't already confusing enough. He does his best to answer all Qs but he's often hard to follow and makes a TON of mistakes. Harsh grader as well. Avoid

He won't be a good teacher for everyone. I personally did very well in the class but many people struggled especially if they hadn't taken calculus before. He can come off as condescending at times but if you just ignore it and ask your questions regardless you'll get a clear and helpful explanation. Show up and study hard and you'll be just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Must have a general understanding of Calc 1 BEFORE taking this class. Very heavy on differential equations. Don't recommend if you're not a good self-study. Grade is 50% quizzes, 50% final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Awful teacher. If you did not have calculus in high school do not take his class. He uses his own methods to teach and your grade is solely based on tests designed by him. Awful.

Not very helpful outside of class &doesn't offer extra credit. Came in with 3 yrs of Calc experience &knew all the material but performed poorly because of my test anxiety and he wasn't helpful at all. Makes everything more complicated than it needs to be, and tells you to learn things his way when there's and easier way. Quizzes  50%, final  50%
Awesome professor. Very clear, helpful, straightforward. Very clear homework and quizzes. I learned a lot and it was no easy, but he gives homework every night to help you keep up.

Took him in my first college semester and thought I was going to pass with a B but got a C+ after the final. Try to take a different professor. I practiced and participated, and even went to his office hours a few times. He's a cool guy but I would not have taken his class if I had the choice. But don't fret if you have to; just practice.
Sandy Blank makes up math terms, teaches you things in round about ways, and then lets you know you were learning derivatives etc. all along.

I personally didn't struggle in his class. I had a great calc teacher in high school so my foundations in the subject were very strong. However, if math isn't your strong point I wouldn't recommend Blank. He barely teaches in class, you basically teach yourself the material by struggling through the hw. But if you can do that the class is fine.

Blank does not know how to effectively teach calculus. He often gets example problems wrong, and his students are forced to correct his math multiple times per class. You're better off just reading the textbook and teaching yourself. As lon as you can do the practice problems, though, the quizzes are a breeze.

Sandy is not a helpful person. He is very disrespectful and generally not approachable. Usually spends the first 20 min of class on attendance the next 30 doing hw problems and then crams a whole lecture into the last 10 min. His quizzes aren't bad as long as you can do the assigned problems. If you cant teach yourself math it wont be an easy class

To get an A in this course you MUST do the homework and do it well. Take your time on the homework, and then the quizzes should be fine. The quizzes are pretty easy and its fairly easy to get an A for the class. The final is much harder than the quizzes, but doable if you know your stuff. If you are in honors and can take non-honors I recommend it
Awful. Doesn't care. Doesn't know how to explain. Takes joy in tricking and deceiving.

Prof. Blank is a really funny and nice guy, and extremely helpful when asked.  This does not mean his class is easy.. his quizzes are difficult and are 50% of the grade, with each quiz worth more than the last.  The final is the other 50%.  He makes the material clear and is always willing to explain things as many times as you want.
Though the material was difficult, Professor Blank was a good teacher. For someone who has trouble understanding math, he made the topics clear and easy to understand. Overall, a very good teacher.
Prof Blank is funny and really nice. His quizzes are pretty difficult, but bearable. Stay on top of the things and it's not that bad of a class.

I loved Sandy! The comments on here scared me at first and the first day of class he even acknowledged that people thought he was mean. His jokes are funny, and he's a really nice guy. He doesn't mind joking around during class. While his quizzes are hard, he's always available in his office. Sandy's one of my favorite teachers at NU :)

I had Prof. Blank for Calc&Diff Eq for Bio 1 and 2 my freshman year. He is definitely the hardest of the teachers for this class, but you will actually learn the material. Go to class and do the homework because the quizzes come directly from these two things. He is actually pretty funny and his hats were always entertaining.

Hated him in calc 1 but loved him in calc 2 since finally understood how to excel in the class: DO ALL HW in time for every class and ASK QUESTIONS for EVERY problem you don't understand. Uses hw for his VERY HARD quizzes and bases midterm/final off these quizzes. He's glad to go over problems and is helpful if you take initiative to ask questions.

ok teacher, not so great of a personality.. although there are only a few quizzes, they are hard -- STUDY for them!  don't be intimidated by the material covered the first day, it's not so bad.. the whole semester builds on basically the same stuff

Prof. Blank was a pretty good teacher. He knew what he was talking about. The online notes are really helpful, but overall he's kind of strict and condescending. He can be a jerk sometimes but when it comes down to it, he's a decent guy. Kinda funny, also will count good quizzes twice as much as quizzes you do poorly on. He's a pretty good guy.

Not to bad.  He is boring in class and moves pretty fast.  He quizes are on exactly what you do in class so if you study you will be fine.  The overall subject is very easy anyway and he is very fair with his grading.  Never uses the book though all the hw is on blackboard.  dont waste your money like i did on a book.
this is the best teacher ever. he look s great funnnyy, just the perfect genes. SOOOO U GUY BETTER STAYYY COOOLLLLLLLLL OORRRRR..... yeah just stay cooll

He was extremely rude to use if we didn't get something. One time he even said to us "It's not rocket science." If you pay attention in class then the tests aren't that hard and he'll replace you're average with what you get on the final if you get a better grade on the final. He had annoying mannerisms that bothered me the entire semester.

i once missed a quiz because my flight got delayed. i showed him my ticket as proof and he wouldnt excuse me saying it was my fault for not scheduling an earlier flight to be safe. but he excused my friend and she had the exact same situation and proof. his quizzes and tests are very fair if you listen and do the hw, but he's just a mean person.
Doesn't explain well.  He's also a little bit rude.  Enjoyed my other calc profs much more

I usually like math a lot but I did not enjoy this class. He trys to trick you on the quizzes. Will replace your quiz average with you final grade though which helps. Do good on the final and that is your grade for the class!
i had him for calc 1. do your hw and ask q's on which ones u dont get, and ull do fine. quizes usually have no surprises, and final is very fair. hes a fair guy, i thought he was easy
would take off lots of points when you only got one question wrong on the test. does not explain very well.
Pretty good class.  Quizzes are easy if you do all the homework and ask questions in class.  The final had no surprises.
This guy is great!!  Tries to be funny and makes classes interesting...not bad lookin' either

This is the worst teacher I've ever had. Class average was below 60%, and he refused to do anything about it. His explanation: "Well two of you are doing well and I'm teaching to them. You should all withdraw." Waste of my time and money.

He acts like you're an idiot if you don't understand something on the first explanation, or tells you to drop down to lower level math courses.  Who the hell wants to do that, and then have to take your class all over again dick.

I don't know why everyone gives this guy such a bad rating. Lectures are VERY helpful, problems are clearly explained, as long as you keep up with the material the tests are fairly easy. You want a bad math prof? Take one of Braverman's classes. <s
worst math teacher i've ever had. .  makes fun of your mistakes, talks to you directly in class - embarassing.  mean.  incompassionate. BAD TEACHER
pretty easy class, very helpful. knows when you dont understand and will try to re-explain

worst professor i've ever had!  very intimidating! loved to ridicule students and display their mistakes!  this is college!  he is the reason so many kids grow up fearing math!  teachers like him are why our country is behind the rest of the world in math
No Comments
Hard to find such responsible professors for online courses. Dr. Bhanot is very dedicated and was willing to help me do better at every step. I would like to take another course with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This course is intense and the class is lecture heavy. Prof. Bhanot includes lots of techniques to break the monotony of lectures. I really learnt a lot from the research proposal component of the course from her. I hope she starts a new class on writing research proposals. I will definitely take that class!
Professor Bhanot was wonderful. The course is very material heavy though but I learnt a lot from the course and her style of teaching. The way she guided us for the group project was amazing.
Lots of content in each lesson and the class is very boring. Try another professor for this class, don't take her class.

Dr. Bhanot is an amazing professor. Taking the course with her, I never felt lost or worried. She always answers every question in class or out of class or by email with a smile and a lot of enthusiasm. I have been reaching out to her even after the course was over and she always helps and guides me. I am grateful to have a professor like her.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Bhanot is awesome! She is not only a wonderful lecturer but a very caring person. She wants you to succeed and will work really hard with you to make sure you succeed. I wish I had more classes with her. Best class I ever took. I learnt beyond the lecture material!

Professor Bhanot is very dedicated and caring. Even with a tough subject like molecular and cellular biology, she keeps the lectures interesting with lots of opportunities to participate and discuss things. She is very understanding and helpful. I would love to take another class with her!

The course is very material heavy but Dr. Bhanot tries to keep the class actively involved and provides lots of opportunities to reflect and discuss during the lecture. She provides great current and background informational resources apart from the lecture materials which are very helpful and important. She is very supportive and motivating.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Bhanot is very motivating and always willing to help. She goes beyond the lecture to teach basic and relevant topics. I hope to take more classes from her.
Dr. Bhanot is very knowledgeable. It is also refreshing to find a professor who truly cares for the success of students.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: class is super participation based, like tons of cold calling, but it is helpful to learn the language! overall the course is pretty easy for russian being a hard language

Love this woman for Russian which is saying a lot. If you just show up to class and participate and try to match her energy it'll reflect on your grade. Some homework nothing too difficult and tests are easy too. For a very difficult language I could not ask for a better teacher.

I have previous Russian experience which def made this course easier for me but I thought Olga was generally a good professor. Class is participation heavy/interactive rather than lecture which helped with practicing.
Stick to rules, harsh, treat essays like linguistic functions rather than creative impressions.

This is the worst teacher I have ever seen. No one who has taken her class will give her a positive comment. Although the atmosphere in her class is very good, she is extremely cruel after class. She won't give you a chance to correct your homework and will only give you a very low grade(50%-80%). No one gets an A, and almost no one gets an A-.

She's so passive aggressive in assignment feedback. Very picky with research assignments mind you I've never had any prior experience with research and she's aware that is a common theme among many. Lectures are boring as well.

Class is manageable, but exams are very difficult and time pressured. The main issue is the amount of work in a limited time. It is hard to finish even if you understand the material. You need a lot of practice and strong time management. Lectures are okay, but you will need to study on your own.

she is passive aggressive in emails and in grading feedback. her comments on assignments are condescending and she will type in all caps and yell. she is unclear with grading criteria/takes points off for specific things
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really like Professor Blige's course! She was a very entertaining lecturer, and the content was interesting, though repetitive to earlier psych classes. There wasn't too much work outside of class either, definitely an easy A as long as you do your work and show up. The only downside was that if you missed a day, the notes weren't very helpful.

If you're a psych major & taking this class bc it genuinely interests you, DO NOT TAKE IT. She will make you hate your life and psych as a whole after taking the class. Ultimately switched out of the psych major after taking this class, and wish I had taken the other professor. If 0/5 stars were an option, I would rate her zero. Save yourself

nice professor - she's super accessible and everything. lectures are not the most informative, there are a lot of in class games/activities that don't really contribute to learning that much. you get a notecard on all the exams, which are pretty straightforward. weekly personal reflections + multi phase research project.

I'm unsure if this is new this semester, but the papers she gives out now are about 8-10 pages long, very unnecessary, and graded weirdly. We also have exams and other pointless assignments. Attendance, in a way, IS mandatory because you never know when an in-class assignment will occur. Yes, note cards are provided for exams, and they are easy.
Prof Bilge was wonderful. Very smart and clearly knowledgable on the subject. Sometimes the lectures were a little boring. Friendly attendance policy and she's a fair grader.

Professor Bilge has been one of my favorite professors here at Northeastern. She knew the content very well and was able to explain it in a way that made it easy to understand. She was super kind and always available to help whenever needed. Her tests were very fair and her grading was always clear and provided good feedback.

Dr.Bilge's lectures are extremely boring and do not cover any real content - it is mostly common sense with random examples and useless exercises we have to do. Her feedback on assignments is nothing as well. Her tests also have such bad directions, the class itself is easy, but she basically grades on how much she likes you.

Merely acceptable. Writings' grade based on correctness not effort, discouraging students to explore but rewrote what they learned from other classes&unclear feedback. No clear grading/instructions for final paper and writing even asking her. Lectures are instructed poorly&exams too vague/tiring, which are unfriendly to non-native english speakers.

Lovely teacher who truly wants you to learn. She says the hw/lecture is given is on research for learning. Some people do not like that she gives lots of assignments but most take under 20 minutes and she lets you have a note card for the exam. Only reason people would find it hard or unfair would be if they dont go to class/ pay attention.

Dr Bilge is a very good lecturer, she engages with the class often and makes a point to learn as many people's names as she can given how big the class is. She also applies concepts to the real world and there are almost weekly reflections that allow you to do the same so you can really learn the material. The final is a project and not a test

You can tell she actually cares a lot about what she is teaching. Attendance isn't mandatory but there are 4 in-class assignments throughout the semester which is group work. There are weekly reflections but they're simple and non-formal one pagers. I would highly recommend the course to anyone thinking about taking a psych class.

She is kind and responsive in person/email. But she flies through the slides, has the most nonsensical sentences sometimes on the slides, grades very slowly, so many papers, and exams are very application based (not always exactly what is said on the slides). However, on most assignments, she grades fairly and getting an A is pretty doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked this class. She was a bit boring at times but the exams were relatively easy and grading guidelines were all very clear. She takes feedback for how her exams are structured and was very nice. A bit of a slow grader though.

Dr. Bilge is so knowledgeable. It's clear she knows what she is talking about and is very open to student feedback. She truly wants each of her students to succeed. The topics itself did not interest me too much, but hearing her talk about them made me able to focus in class.
Slide content isn't super helpful so going to class is important. She is very nice and caring so if there is an issue just talk to her.

Dr Blige is a sweet and amazing person but her cognition class is really hard. She is very accommodating if you need extensions but you have to ask in advance. There are 10 weekly papers, 3 paper summaries, and 4 parts to the final on top of 3 tests. Stuff due during thanksgiving break. Give her feedback when stuff is hard because she will listen.

An easy class, content is simple, but she is a disengaging lecturer and does not structure the class well. She doesn't put actual content on slides, just strange examples, so they're not a great resource for the exams. She had us write papers every week but does not give feedback. Does not seem to understand how most students operate and study.

I know she has quite a few bad reviews so I was super nervous for this class. She's really not that bad though, her lectures drone on a bit but it's honestly just the subject and she gives a lot of good examples throughout. She didn't say the textbook was mandatory but I def recommend getting it because the quizzes are pretty difficult

I really liked prof Bilge. She leaves it up to you, so attendance isn't mandatory and there isn't a lot of homework apart from big assignments and studying, so if you go to class and manage your time I think this class is great...but if you need more structure it is easy to fall behind in this class. She is very nice and understanding!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Bilge really puts the ball in your court. Don't take this class if you don't find the subject/description interesting, as it is possible to slack and suffer from it with the way that it is structured. She doesn't take attendance, but if you skip class the exams will be really hard. If you go she gives good examples and you'll be fine.
The professor is a kind person, but is very strict when it comes to tests and papers. There are times that she may be unclear and confusing.

This course was very much reliant on lectures as well as reading the textbook outside of class. She didn't really have clear instructions for our final group project and graded us harshly even though we did everything that was required. She seemed passionate about what she was teaching but it was hard to apply what we learned in class to our tests.

The content itself is not difficult, the lectures has a lot of excess content that isn't relevant to the tests, be ready to write a lot for this course for paper reviews, bring a friend if you need to take this course for the group project. Overall, the work felt tedious and there are better courses for their content.

Extremely easy class and Professor Bilge is really understanding. Lectures are fun as she tells a lot of stories and examples, but this comes back to bite as the exams are much more difficult than what is covered in class. Even though textbook isn't mentioned in the lectures, studying it is required to pass the exam.

Prof Bilge is a really nice and funny prof and she tries to get her students to understand the topics. You do have to come to class in the off chance she gives an ICA. She is very understanding though and caring. Exams aren't that bad but she does rely on examples she used in class.

Exams are extremely difficult and she does not prepare you well for them whatsoever. Rushes through slides just to get them done with for the class period instead of actually teaching the content. Literally have to teach myself the content because she hurries so much.
Professor Bilge took the class's feedback regarding her exams and teaching and implemented it to make the learning experience better for everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very intellectually stimulating lecturer, making it very easy to stay engaged with her slides. If you show up to class and take comprehensive notes, the tests (2 midterms and a final) will be cake walks. If you want a class where you can not pay attention and put in no effort, then feel entitled to an A, don't take this class.

She's all over the place making class difficult to understand and BORING. Lecture slides are incomplete. Exams are difficult no matter how much you study and didn't provide a study guide for the first exam. Come to class so you don't miss a pop quiz called ICAs but I learned everything through Crash Course (shout out to Hank Green)

I had Prof. Bilge for PSYC3466 Cognition. It's an interesting class but she's a tough grader and gives very little feedback on why you got so many points off. You're also only graded on several papers that she assigns, a group project, and two exams. Her exams are pretty difficult regardless of how much you study, and you'll have to read a ton.

If you value your happiness, mental health, and will to live please don't take her! I truly wish I could go back in time and pick a different teacher. Her lecture slides are long and she talks way more than making sure you understand, attendance isn't mandatory you should still show up because she does 4 ICA's, and she's so rude and not helpful.

If you can pick another psych teacher please do! I don't recommend her, the slides are extremely long (44 slides) with a new slideshow every class. Then she has two exams and finally based on those long slideshows with no study guide and if she does provide them it's not helpful. She also has an attitude and is not helpful when you ask questions.

Professor Bilge was an awful professor; her lectures are long and all over the place. She didn't provide clear guidelines for the 1st exam, and she got extremely upset that people were confused. She makes sneaky, rude comments and makes it hard to ask questions in class. I would recommend not taking this class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Terrible professor. Super confusing and talked really fast. Never went to lectures and still passed the class.

She often uses our breaks to take quizzes or group work. She likes to everyone listen to her until the class is over. I suggest if you want to take the introduction of psychology course for the NU path, please don't choose her class. In the class, she always talks about unrelated information and details. And all the test are using paper not online.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you love yourself, your life, or your major even a little bit, don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ignores textbook, just unorganized lectures. Lectures slides are 99% pictures and INCOMPLETE sentences. Test are MC and fill in the blank with no word bank, so she wants you to read her mind, I guess. Random topics on test, useless study guide, & tiny curve. Attendance is "not mandatory," but if you don't go to class you will definitely fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She goes on these tangents and most of time the questions on her exam is not addressed in class. She doesn't teach in a linear manner, so if you don't learn effectively that way avoid her at all cost!! She has an attitude sometimes which makes it hard to be interested in her content. Keep your sanity and peace.

Professor Bilge has good intentions and is very knowledgeable in the classes she teaches. However, learning from her course was extremely difficult. She lectures most of the time and introduces new content the day before the tests. Every other week she assigns papers that barely relate to the content of the course. I wish I learned more. Don't take
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Shes one of those teachers who makes very weird comments thinking its funny. She never has clear answers when a student asks her a great question, instead she pretends like she didnt hear it. She assigns a lot of work and your grade is based on 2 midterms and a final. Participation matters a lot!!

Lectures are just her slides. Must go to class to get credit for in-class-only questions. Tests are manageable, just make sure to take notes/study slides after every lecture; leans more self-study than in-class learning. 2 midterms, 1 final, each worth 25%. Very helpful if you ask specific questions. It's a content-heavy memorization course.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class itself was super easy, but she gave no study tools before exams. Exams are also weighted 75% of your grade, so if you don't do well on one then you're a little screwed. She doesn't usually give people full participation points, which is a little weird, but she did bump our grades up at the end of the semester so that was nice.

She is the worst professor I have ever had. With the way she teaches, you have to study a ton on your own. Prepare for horrible slides and her talking to herself the entire class. Other psych professors offer an easier class. She makes it difficult for no reason. SHE IS HORRIBLE!!

Prof Bilge has a good heart. But her curriculum is absolutely horrendous. I don't know where she taught before NE, but I have never seen a style like it. Her class has 3 exams worth 80% of your grade. Not to mention, the exams are 50+ questions, mostly complex, and they are not all multiple choice. Do not recommend her, at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Bilge is a lovely person and highly passionate about psychology. However, she struggles to stay organized, and her lectures are often challenging to understand because she goes all over the place. Her teaching style didn't work for me, so I had to teach myself to keep my grade up.

The professor seems to be passionate about psychology. However, there are only two exams + final and the study guides she makes are not helpful. Her lectures are not to the point, slides are extremely vague, and for a foundations class I ended up looking up topics myself. While I did attend office hours, her teaching just did not work for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Reyyan just moved to the university so not all her content and exams are perfected to an art--yet. But she is really passionate, has a good sense of humor, and genuinely wants her students to succeed. Attending lectures alone won't prepare you for the exam. I suggest making Quizlets out of the slides. Tests aren't that hard if you study.

Quite frankly Prof. Bilge is the worst professor I've ever had. She is clearly a nice person but has 0 teaching skills. She's all over the place, and she contradicts herself from lecture to lecture. Her slides are a big fat mess, and she is incredibly unorganized. She literally sets you up to fail. Seriously, save yourself and avoid her class.

Probably the worst professor I've ever had. She is so confusing and disorganized. Her slides are all over the place. She contradicts herself from one lecture to the next. The class is based off of exams, but she makes the exams impossible to pass. Her exam questions set you up for failure. AVOID HER CLASS.

I think Professor Bilge is a good person; she is very nice and has a good sense of humor. However, I do not think shes a very good professor. She only reads from her lecture slides, which are at times very disorganized and hard to understand. Class is test heavy, only two exams and a final. Reading the textbook will definitely benefit you.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not the best Psych Prof. She seems to know what shes talking about, but her lectures are extremely disorganized and the slides are sparse. You really have to spend time teaching yourself the content in this class. Your grade is solely made of 2 exams that are worth 80%. They are very hard! Some stuff not covered in class appears.

Horrible Psyc professor. She seems to know what she's talking about, but her lectures go on and on in circles about things that are very easy to understand, then she'll skim over difficult concepts, and she's just a boring lecturer. Her slides are an absolute mess, and half of studying is trying to figure out what they're saying.

Dr. Bilge is a good person that cares about neuroscience, but struggles to teach well. Her lectures and slides are extremely unorganized so you have to study HARD. Her slides are quite vague and also unorganized. She assigns no homework except for 3 low-points discussions. The tests are difficult , are most of your grade, and have low class average
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Cares a lot about helping people understand, it is a small class, if you show up and ask questions you will learn a lot and need minimal outside study time. It is pretty basic statistics and as a stem major, I thought she was a fair grader overall, tests were fair and straightforward but other students struggled so if you are bad at math beware.
do not take
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: very hard to understand and often does not understand you. Teaches straight out of the textbook and all notesheets+solutions are copy+pasted straight from the online textbook, often with no context just formulas. She does not format the stuff after she copy pastes it so it just look like slop and very hard to follow. Take someone else.

Can you believe that there is an exam for a course every week? Exams account for 76% of your grades. I find that quite astonishing. Give me another chance, and I definitely won't choose this professor. I only like people who study hard and don't just focus on exams. I really dislike that.

She overcomplicates things unnecessarily and doesn't know how to explain things properly in a way that makes sense to people who don't have a solid background of calculus. She goes way too fast, has no patience for people who don't understand, and manages to make basic calculus confusing. Would not recommend to anyone.

The class wasn't that hard, if you have a solid understanding of calculus and high school stats. She explains concepts by doing example problems in class and she's a tough grader. She's heavy on participation, but actually go to class bc she's a good lecturer. tests weren't bad and based on the hws and practice tests
She is horrible at preparing you for the tests, which are also very difficult.

Took this class as an extra math elective, and regretted it. Attendance in person was mandatory, she would remove too many points for small calculation mistakes, assigned work during break that was due during break, and would go over the allotted time every class without fail. She is smart, but it doesn't feel like she respects her students time.
I really did not have any problems with her. I may have some bias because I took stats in high school but I think everything was explain well. The tests were not too challenging.

Dr. Veetel is a great professor. She teaches exactly what she plans to put on the exam, and is always willing to answer any questions you may have. You just need to listen in class and maybe do her supplementary homework if you're confused. I'd recommend going to class, going to office hours. She is really not a bad professor.

If I could have one professor FIRED, it would be Bindu. Overcomplicates calc and is not straight forward at all. Wish I could give a 0. Everybody would do terrible and her graders take off so many points for the smallest thing. Calls on you randomly with no warning. I understood calc in high school and did well, now I have never been more confused.
Her lectures are fine and make sense but she is kinda brutal about cold calling and she isn't very nice when people don't understand things.
If I could give her a zero I would she's actually the worst professor ever, she doesn't know how to teach. She cold calls, and will never be able to answer a question you have. Do not take her.
class is hard but not if you're willing to put in the work. Professor can be hard at times to understand and the project has very vague guidelines

This professor is decent at calculus but nothing else. She is the most disorganized and confusing professor I have ever had. We ended up being incredibly behind in terms of pacing and sped up towards hard concepts. If you are not good at math, DO NOT TAKE HER.

2 Students dropped her class in my section, has such a bitter attitude towards students who ask questions or are confused by her teaching. Is probably the worst teacher I have had and makes no sense, I had to re take the course because she literally cannot explain basic concepts. Everyone felt the same in my class, she is really terrible at her job
Attendance in class does not help, and then there is little online learning material. I don't recommend this professor at all if you want to graduate.
Horrible teacher.  Nobody in the class could understand what she was saying and there were a lot of people who would fail every test.  If you don't already know calc you won't do better than a C.

The professor has graders for this class and they are harsh graders. Participation matters. Has a lot of quizzes and tests, the actual quizzes/test don't look like the practice ones they include the stuff she says wouldn't be on the test. The quizzes aren't easy
This is the worst teacher I had since I started college, DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS!!!

Bindu didn't teach, she just wrote out a concept and then did practice problems all class, so you would eventually learn the concept either through sheer repetition or teaching it to yourself. We had a total of 3 online quizzes, 5 tests, and a final, and our tests were significantly harder compared to other sections (with different teachers).
DO NOT EVER TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSOR!

Prof Veteel is definitely a qualified individual regarding math, but she is kind of tough to understand in lectures. She teaches straight out of the textbook and is all over the place, it seems like she doesn't have a plan for any lectures and just decides what she wants to teach that day. Tests aren't too hard and she gives ample practice problems
Her tests were not too difficult but the grading was insanely hard and points were taken off for the most ridiculous things. The group project also sucks. Her in-class examples are good though.
She speaks at a very fast pace and gets frustrated when students are confused. Goes over course material very quickly and difficult to understand.

Professor Veetel teaches Calculus for business/econ with the assumption that you have already taken calculus, so keep that in mind when considering the pace of this course. She goes very fast over concepts and explains them in a confusing manner, and sometimes gets frustrated when students don't understand. You will do fine if you already know calc

I don't know why she is rated so low, but I believe she has been very clear, and always trying/up to help.During lectures she would ask questions to check up and make sure people understand before she moves on to the next concept. Her practice problems in class are very helpful, and doing Cengage also helps a lot. All it takes is practice.

Professor Veteel wasnt very clear and organized when teaching topics. I dont think she had a good gauge for how much her students understood. Group projects are also weird. Sometimes directions arent completely clear, and if you dont find a good group, you could be stuck doing a lot of work without much help.

Professor knows her material well but she does not know how to explain it to help her student understand. She picks the smallest details to takes points off from your exams and sometimes it's wrong. You will have to calculate your grade on your own for her class because she doesn't show it on Canvas
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is very intelligent and understands math but struggles to teach students. The topics, in general, were not confusing but she made it so much harder to understand. She is not bad if you are good at math but I would get a tutor or switch classes if I got her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She's nice and explains everything well. Definitely go to her office hours if you have questions.

Profesor Veteel is a professor that provides a sort of hard class but is worried and concerned for her students. She will help in class and after at any moments, and her office hours are the best. There are many quizes but those help you get your grades up and balances and prepares you for the final really well. If you are nice she will be the same
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Bindu is knowledgeable, but not a good teacher. She is poor at explaining concepts, she gets wrong answers on the bored, and her Blackboard site is terribly organized. On the bright side she is almost always available during office hours. Also the final grade is basically just the nine or so quizzes we had over the semester and the final.

She's nice and cares about her students. She's accessible outside class and if you do the homework the quizzes and tests are not hard. Get ready to have a quiz every week and study for it. Also, there's a group project that has a lot of weight so work for it
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: I believe this was professor Veetel's first time teaching stats and it was pretty obvious. Taught straight out of the textbook and often would ask students if she was correct. Didn't teach us the much easier calculator method for a whole semesters material till the week before the final.

Kind professor who cares about her students. She tries to go at a pace that everyone can follow. She also continuously asks for feedback to make sure her students understand the material. The quizzes may be challenging, but she gives all types of problems in class to prepare for them.
Her lectures can be kind of boring, but if you learn well through practice and examples her teaching style would probably work for you.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY--Would take again

reviews.comment: For our final group presentation, she asks questions at the end of each presentation to make sure everyone knows what they are talking about. She doesnt like my group so when she gets to us she asks the hardest questions she could think of to make us look dumb. The next group goes.. the questions are like "what would you do differently?" URGH
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The actual material being taught is TOUGH but Bindu does really well at teaching it. She took how our class was learning best into account and tried to ensure we were understanding. She puts a lot of effort into her lectures and they are the most important source of info in this course. Tshirt project ties nicely into the course.
She once gives a trick to all students, which causes no one gets a good grade and she feels it is our mistake. But, actually she doesn't explain that little step

As someone who took AP Calc in high school, I can see that Veetel makes the class harder than it is. She confuses a lot of people and there's a question asked almost every time she finishes a sentence. She's great at math, not so great at teaching. Homework isn't mandatory, and she takes attendance sometimes. Barely touched the book.
Professor Bindu is the best! She's very knowledgeable and reachable when you have question. Best professor in NEU! Must take her class for calculus! I got an A for my final grade!

Strong accent. Doesn't really teach calculus. If I didn't already know calculus, I would have probably failed the class. She knows calculus well, but is very bad at conveying the information in a clear and concise matter. A lot of self teaching involved.

She has an accent which is very hard to understand. On top of that, she moves through material way too quickly.  Her weekly quizzes are tough.I did okay in the class, but I had to spend a lot of time teaching the material to myself because her lectures just were not helpful at all.  There's a group project, but it helped save my grade.
Probably the most terrible teacher I have ever had. She barely knows Calculus, and never explains anything, just goes over it faster. beware of bindu
Professor Erten is extremely caring and engaging. She explains everything well and lays out what is required for assignments. Easy exams. Great professor.

Prof Erten Is nice and knowledgable, but as someone who has never taken an econ class before, this class was difficult and challenging, and at times the class moved too quickly to follow. Many other students in this class already have quite a bit of knowledge in Econ. The midterm was good, but final was hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Erten is one of my FAV professors at Northeastern University!!! She respects everyone and encourages students to participate. She really knows how to teach Macroeconomics and makes it very easy to understand if you pay attention to the lecture/slides (textbook-not necessary). And she is pretty easy grader! Easy HWs & EASY MIDTERM and a final.
Bilge will help you in and outside of class! She even encourages some of her students to get their papers published! The class can be challenging but she is open to have fun discussions on topics.
Boring. Repeating textbook without giving good explanation or examples.

She clearly loves economics. A grad professor teaching an intro course is sure to be interesting, especially in a class of 40 instead of the usual 200 with Simon. Only 2 tests, fairly easy, and 3 short HWs all semester. Her lectures are dry and she basically flips through a PPT, but you can still learn well from her
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Erten is a really sweet and enthusiastic person, it is evident she knows a lot about economics. However, her lectures can be a bit boring since she basically repeats everything from the textbook. You could easily not show up to class and not miss anything since she posts the slides online. She is an okay professor.

She has you read academic papers instead of using a textbook (a treat) She has a wealth of knowledge in regards to the material as well as the profession, so be sure to ask about her experiences in the field.  She responds to students who show interest. If you're looking for an easy class look elsewhere.  If you love econ, she's one of the best!

Prof. Erten is a solid professor, but the challenge is self-driven.  If you want an easy grade or if you want a challenge, this class would be an option.  She assigns a lot of reading, but the vast majority is *de facto* optional: do not be scared by the syllabus.  Lectures generally great but mostly from prepared slides she made and posted online.

Interesting class. Grad professor teaching an intro Macro course was really cool and I learned a lot. She's a great teacher and obviously knows what she's talking about. A lot nicer to have her in a 49 person class rather than Simon in a 200 person lecture hall.

She over explains everything and her lectures drag. Often contradicts herself and then gets confused. Lots of extra credit and really easy tests. Most people I know got As without trying. I'm sure she's a wonderful person but she's not an effective professor. Stay away if you want to learn.
Just an amazing person! I love her! It is a shame I've got only one semester with her.
Had her for AWD. Very nice woman, she'll give you a decent grade as long as you put a little effort into your writing and show growth from your previous drafts

She's not clear at all and even one on one help is completely useless. She does not make helpful revisions. I have legitimately not learned a single thing in this class. Class is completely unrelated to the assignments. If she likes you, you'll get an A. If she doesn't want to give you an A, forget about it.

She is a tough grader no doubt about that even though i got a very good grade. If she doesnt want you to get an A then forget it even if ur writing is excellent. Very moody. she gets very awkward sometimes. and on other times she is very nice. to get a good grade you need to know how to deal with her + good writing. I don't recommend taking her

Took her for AWD advanced writing. Good professor, expects class to participate and will call on you to answer some easy questions. There is lots of 1 on 1 interaction with her so have questions for her when she looks at ur paper. One of the sweetest professors at NEU. A very easy grader, got an A in the course.
She is useless.Tough grader.

She's really sweet and friendly and also tries to make class funny. However, she grades really hard. You think you did really well on a paper because she gives you good feedback, but then you get a C. You need to work hard for an A. She's very helpful if you go for extra help.
Excellent, helpful, friendly, fair
shes really nice and is willing to help if you meet with her.
she is super nice and fair! love her!

Take Gwen's class for AWD.  She's really cute and quirky, haha.  Not too tough of a grader and allows a lot of time to write...doesn't rush things.  I LOVE this lady, haha.  Makes the topic at least a little bit interesting.
Kind of flighty but a good and fair grader. wonderful awd teacher

Our class in general was very entertaining.  This professor was very laid back and made the class actually sound somewhat interesting.  Gwen is a very fair grader and was flexible about when you could turn in assignments.  She is VERY strict about absences, and too many will affect your grade.  I highly recommend this professor for AWD!
this is the teacher you should take for awd.  she is very nice and flexible and fair. class was not too hard and she did a good job making it kinda fun too. very nice lady, highly recommended
easy class, take this one, its way better then the other middler year classes, she grades tough but just do the work and its fine, shes wicked hot too, dear gwenny
Class sucked.  I think she grades tough, but what do i know im a pharmacy major.  She does cancel class alot

She's a great prof for middler year. She only holds class 2/3 days a week. She's not ****y, corny but has a great sense of humor. Work load is less demanding than other prof that teach the same class. I highly recommend her.

Doug is an incredible professor on music. It's a lot of labs, group project work, and quizzes, but he is lenient on grading and he caters to those who may not be music majors or have background knowledge in ProTools. Loved his class for Recording 1 and 2!

I love Doug. Best professor I've had so far. Had him for both recording 1 and 2 and I wish he taught more because I would take any class of his. He's always cracking jokes during lectures and getting off topic but in the best way. Learned a lot and especially loved how hands on Recording 2 is.

Doug Bielmeier really brought his job as a mix engineer to fruition in my mind. He's very understanding of his students when they have "off-day" and doesn't hesitate to accommodate our needs to the best of his ability. He's great at answering questions in a well communicated manner and he's quite charismatic as well.

reviews.comment: He personalized each lecture in order to make an easygoing and enjoyable atmosphere. I felt comfortable reaching out if I had questions because of his down-to-earth teaching approach
Dr. Doug was very supportive and made the classes interesting and the course material fun and exciting to learn.
Dr. Doug was very supportive and was always available to answer questions and help students.

Worst teacher ever. Wrong about everything. The fact that this guy is pawning himself off as a music recording teacher is an afront to music and audio education. Do yourself a favor - don't listen to a word this guy says!
Congrats to Dr. Doug on his promotion to Full Teaching Professor! Can't wait to take recording 2 with him this fall.

The instructor provides good feedback on all of the labs and is always reachable either by Zoom or email. He gives great advice and is patient when troubleshooting. The class seems comfortable, but still maintains a professional environment. In this way, class is something to look forward to.

I really enjoyed having Dr. Doug as a professor. He was incredibly knowledgable and passionate about various aspects of Music Recording. He personalized each lecture in order to make an easygoing and enjoyable atmosphere. I felt comfortable reaching out if I had questions because of his down-to-earth teaching approach

The instructor is extremely encouraging towards his students and is very knowledgable in his field. His patience and approachability really encourage learning but also help the class feel comfortable.
I liked that Doug gave us the materials to be very online or very in-person if need be. He was extremely comprehensive in his teaching and understanding in the online environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Doug is so inclusive, and it's so clear that he really cares about making people feel safe in his space. This is a really delicate time, and I don't think all professors have handled COVID well, but Doug has clearly gone above and beyond to create an environment for all.
I wish I could take this course again with different professor.
Dr. Doug was very supportive and was always available to answer questions and help students. He made the classes interesting and the course material fun and exciting to learn.
Professor set up a great learning environment within the classroom, especially for an entry level course. Very welcoming, casual and assuring so students can ask any questions
Dr. Doug is very understanding and helpful to his students. He is always prepared for class and makes each meeting enjoyable. I looked forward to attending each of his class meetings.
Doug is extremely kind, empathetic, and knowledgeable in his field. Learning is not only easy, but also fun.
The instructions are very clear for the protools labs; this makes it easier to learn how to do everything.

The strengths were that he's been doing this for years and although it is very simple information, he always found ways to make it fun by telling jokes and selecting music to edit/mix/master that we were all familiar with and enjoyed.
The course had very distinct guidelines, but still incorporated a diverse set of assignments and projects. I feel that the education in this class was not only technical, but historical as well.

This course was very organized and the Canvas page was easy to navigate. The labs Dr. Doug assigned were very helpful as a way for students to apply the material learned in class to hands-on work. Weekly partner presentations were also a great way to interact with our peers and learn from one another.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The online course environment was very friendly and open. The experience was very different from my other classes in that listening had a greater role than taking notes in becoming fully immersed in the classroom.
