I really like him. He tries to make his lectures interesting. He cares about his students and is always there to help them. Test are not hard but they cover a lot of information so reading the text book is a must in order to pass the exams but other than that the class is really easy.
I learned a lot from this course, he was very helpful.
Good man, and an awesome teacher. Learned a lot about different aspects of business, specially Marketing.
VERY NICE PROFESSOR
Great and he is very entertained.
Great professor.
This is a very good professor, and very helpful for improving your skills in business.
Nice professor! Always interesting.
nice teacher

He is a favorite business professor among the NU faculty. He is passionate and he will help you sharing your business ideas with your teammates. You will gain more than what you want  during the course works. I recommend him for your success.
This course is very useful for my career. Professor Lefever is very responsible and serious. To prepare PPT and interesting case study for each class.
i like this course, it is very helpful for me and I hope I can take this professor's class next time!

Duane was a great prof and I'm really glad I had him. He gave me a much higher grade than I thought I deserved (his grading seems to be more qualitative than quantitative), and his classes are very well prepared.
Good personality but questionable grading policies and teaching skills

The majority of your grade depends on the professor’s opinion of you and your classmates’ opinions of you. He asks for classmates' opinions far too often and uses that to grade presentations and group projects. He seems to completely ignore that classmates obviously act in their own self interest. GOOD LUCK!!

Duane was a wonderful professor.  Sometimes not always concise in initial instruction, but always there to answer questions and makes a ton of time for students  in his personal time.  Most importantly, he understands that students are people with limitations and will help you succeed to the best of your ability.
Duane is awesome!

I went on a dialogue to South Africa with Duane. He was very knowledgable about international travel and super helpful with any and all questions. I really enjoyed his lectures-- he has so many stories! All-in-all, great person and excellent teacher!
THE BEST

I attended the educational dialogue in South Africa. Professor Lefevre was very good at giving one-on-one attention and addressing questions on the culture and customs of the country. He has a great personality and a lot of experience in his field.
high quality class. real nice personality.
impressive teaching style and very useful knowledge.
Professor Duane,very interesting class and useful information. Thank you for all your nice suggestions and patience.
Professor Lefevre, is a great teacher. I like his teaching style, really organized and comprehensive.
Great professor, using lots example and case study on class. Quite fun for most of the time, really help on giving feedback to students.
Great guy, great class, great powerpoint slides! Love it!
His teaching is clear and concise, I loved it!
Great Professor! I really enjoyed the sessions.
He was awesome professor..
Really nice and interesting teacher!!

Lefevre was pretty good. He made business more interesting than I thought it would be. A few times he lectured too much (2 hr class) but most nights he had good cases and exercises. Seems to care. Lotsa stories.

Professor Dyer was great. He is deeply passionate about the subject matter and really cares that we all understand all the nuances of the origins of economics. His tests are long answer and require some work but his lectures make it worth it. I'm going to miss this class
Awesome.

Dyer was a great History of Econ Thought professor. You will learn about more than raw theory with Dyer. He really appreciates how culture influences on our ideas, and presents the social/religious conventions of various historical time periods, the personal lives of great thinkers, and the actual theories developed in reaction to that environment.

history economic thought. very interesting class with a responsible teacher who doesnt manipulate his students in believing what he believes. all lecturing, extremely boring (u will fall asleep), 2 tests, small project. You learn a lot but do not take his class if u dont have to, it is hard and you will feel like a zombie.

Took this class in 2009 and still have yet to find its equal.  Dyer is the most brilliant, thoughtful, and humble professor I have ever met.  He is one of the few professors you may have that goes against the grain in their field.  This class is an opportunity to significantly expand your worldview, at least it did for me.

I don't like writing a bad review of someone, but I took a class after reading good reviews here, and regretted it. The tests are not hard, and the lectures are not boring. I'm sure you could do worse, by far; but I found myself wishing I could have taken the class with a different prof.
Good professor, but can be a little confusing sometimes. You have a midterm, final, and a project. But he gives you the test questions ahead of time.

Dyer is the best professor I've had. Ever. You can tell he puts a lot of effort into being a good teacher, i.e. planning lectures. Either that or it just comes very easy to him. Very nice guy too. Workload isn't hard with him.

prof. dyer is hands down the best prof. I have had at nu. his lectures r unique and very interesting. u won't fall asleep even in the 100min class! the midterm and the final account for alot of the grade and are fairly hard. u'll need to take very good notes and make sure u ask questions when stuff doesn't make sense, he's always willing to help.

Fantastic instructor. His lectures are clear and insightful, especially in the beginning. Towards the end of semester he started rushing to get more in. His work load is minimal for a 500 level course, but it makes you think a great deal. Take this course if you want to open your mind a little.

Highly recommend this class for any econ majors.  I'm not even an econ major, but I took it for the fun of it because I read about what a great teacher Dyer is, and it's completely true.  He's hard and makes you work, but you get a new appreciation for Economics, so it's worth it.
Professor Dyer is the best professor I have ever had. He is very professional and gives wonderful lectures.  I plan on taking more classes with Dyer.
This guy is the man, often lectures over the alloted time period, but everyone is so focused in you rarely notice.
A great teacher and asset to Northeastern's economics department. Very clear and straitforward when teaching, makes you think beyond the basic ideas.  Highly reccomend for any class.

Probably the single best professor I had at NU. Turned me on to a discipline I never thought I'd like, and was genuinely interested in helping me with post-grad choices. A class act and an asset to the school.
No Comments
OMG, someone get this guy a psychiatrist!  So weird, not a horrible teacher though.

Definately the BEST economics professors at Northeastern.  He really makes you open your eyes and think.  You're definately getting more than you paid for.  If you work hard, you'll do well in his class.  And he treats you with respect and doesn't have a holy than thou attitude.
Dr. Dyer is amazing. The best teacher I have EVER had. Challenging and respectful. He gives you a new perspective on economics and life. I would take ANY class he teaches.

By far the best professor I had at NU. Take his history of thought class or one of his ec history classes. He made me realize that economics is stimulating and thought provoking, not just number crunching and models. He is the reason I went to grad school.

Prof Dyer really made me interested in Economics Id recomend his classes to anyone. Anyone who doesnt get him is just not trying hard enough. Any chance to take a class with him the opportunity was jumped at and grabbed
The best teacher that I have had at Northeastern by far.

Professor Dyer is the ****. I would argue that he is really the only decent Professor in the department. Most of the others have their heads up their asses. And for all the clowns that couldn't handle Dyer... you're just too simple
So hard and chain smoked. Kind of a hippie guy who taught theory better than numbers and then tested on the numbers.
No Comments
Very helpful and committed to teaching SCUBA.
Sign up early. Dan is always willing to help. Definitely passionate about scuba.
Dan is an awesome instructor, swim lessons haven't been this much fun since I was 6
Sign up early because everyone wants it. Best class at NU. Dan is the man!
Best class ever!  He's great and fun.  The only class i wouldn't miss. Ha
I love this woman

She is extremely knowledgeable and has been doing GIS for like 30 years. Super helpful with completing labs and using Arc. Also helpful with explaining what works and doesn't for the final project/where to get data. She is very understanding and super nice. As long as you get the labs done before the semester ends you'll be fine. Great professor!

Very clear lecturer and excellent at responding to questions. A few in class assignments that basically guaranteed As. 2 open note tests w/ multiple choice, fill in the blank, and short answer. Very accommodating with deadlines and cares about her students in and out of the classroom.
Lectures are pretty standard but her tests are literally the most straightforward tests ever so as long as you attend lecture and take notes you are guaranteed to do well on them.

She's an awesome teacher and extremely kind and flexible. Even after NU removed zoom requirements, she kept hers open in case any of us were absent and could only attend virtually! She's quick to respond to emails and clearly wants her students to learn in the most effective way possible. She always looks for feedback and is so down to earth!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Basic class in the sense that the content is very surface level and redundant. Prof Eby is very nice and accomodating. Multiple out of class activities, in class debates, 2 exams, and final group debate where you create your own debate. Overall interesting activities and pretty easy.

Mix of lectures, activities, field trips, exams, and presentations. Material could get a little boring or redundant at times but overall interesting and saw real world applications. Group article discussions and solo final presentations, 2 exams (midterm and final). Lecture slides not super clear so def come to class & take notes.

Really nice professor, easygoing & willing to help. Really cares about students' feedback. Like how grading is balanced with exams and projects, but can be a lot of homework. Clear about grading. Tests aren't terrible. Glad tests aren't ALL short answer. Interesting class that made me even more excited to pursue an environmental studies minor.

Dr. Eby is a really great professor. She is empathetic, approachable, and incredibly knowledgeable. She checks in with every student to make sure they are able to succeed, and she goes out of her way to help students when they are stuck on a project or confused by the material. Can't recommend her courses enough!

I've had Prof Eby for a few classes. Shes extremely nice and is an interesting lecturer if you like the material. She's easy going and always willing to help out if you have questions. She loves talking about research she's done as well which is cool.

This class is boring and she is not a good teacher. Her lectures have no flow or consistency, likely because she looks at her notes every 5 seconds which makes it seem like she doesn't really know what she's talking about even though I know she does. She seems like a kind person, but just is not a very good teacher. Pro: course isn't too difficult

Professor Eby is really helpful and wants you to succeed. For the final project(big chunk of your grade) you get to choose a topic that interests you. There was a huge range of topics and Prof Eby makes sure that your topic is do-able and certainly does not want you to fail. There's a graded worksheet each lab due the next lab, but she helps a lot.

This class is certainly lecture heavy, but it is necessary to go to lecture to do well in lab.  The lab work is the bulk of this class, be prepared to hunker down in front of a computer to get it right.  Tests are manageable if you study the lecture slides against the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I loved having Professor Eby as a teacher.  She's interested in getting to know her students, especially if you show up and get engaged in class.  She is also very passionate about her research and gives great examples based on her actual work.  Her tests are manageable, I got A's on most of them and didn't need to study for long periods of time.

If you don't need to take this class, do not take it and take something else to fulfill your credit. This class is tough and only those who seemed to enjoy it were going into a background of marine or environmental sciences. Her lectures are pretty boring if you're not into this stuff and the class has a lot of  statistical equations to memorize
Very generous with her extra credit and is willing to slow down the class and offer chances to get extra points for almost half of the assignments in the class. She is very caring and nice.
Class is crowded with Homework and quizzes. Overall interesting class combining lectures and Lab
flexible instructor and energetic. She is knowledgeable and kind.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Heavy lecture and materials
Good course,
Despite the challenging and boring nature of the material, Prof. Ebrahimi's guidance and support significantly improved students' confidence and grades throughout the semester.

The lectures are quite intense, and the material is overwhelming. Despite missing some homework and lab submissions, I was able to get the grades I expected thanks to the bonus credits. Just make sure to talk to her during office hours.
Very easygoing and helpful instructor. Despite the huge workload, our entire team got A's. She is very enthusiastic about the course and cares about students' success.

This is a challenging class with a heavy workload of homework and labs, as it combines material that was previously taught in two separate courses. However, the section taught by Professors Ebrahimi and Iman is much more manageable and runs smoothly.

Professor Ebrahimi is very kind and approachable. At the beginning, she was not entirely sure about our needs, but by the middle of the semester, she recognized this and provided additional support and extra credit to help us succeed.
She is great very helpful and dedicated. She has always ensured that I was all on track and can catch up with my grades.

Prof. Ebrahimi is alright. It's unfortunate she requires attendance (5% of grade), and it might be the nature of the class, but the lectures are monotonous and mind numbing. However, she does genuinely want you to succeed and provides bonus point questions on quizzes and EC for a Trace review. Read the required textbook and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor gives quizzes that are way, way harder than the other sections and tries to make the students feel bad for not understanding her super confusing lectures, which are filled with tons of mistakes and overly convoluted explanations.

The professor is super energetic and really friendly! She is very good teacher and really cares that we understand the materials.  The class was pretty intense for a 2000-level course with a lot of homework and labs, but she has been flexible with rescheduling stuff and offering bonus tax. Definitely not boring compared to other!

Professor rarely showed up, I learned more from the TAs then I learned from the professor herself. Lots of homework. Overall the course was not bad it was just difficult to learn the material because the professor never showed up but would still have the class taught

This was among my favorite classes taken at NEU. Professor is super nice and will relate to you in all senses, including grading. Homeworks are 1 per week, and directly tied to in class problems. Would recommend this course heavily.
I had fun...

Great guy! Passionate and good at teaching. It's maybe 3-5 hours of homework a week which I'd say is below average for engineering classes. Extremely interesting course material and exams are very fair. I didn't study much, but did all the homeworks, and got consistent Bs. Can't complain. Probably the best person to take energy systems with.

Professor Eckelman is a really really really nice guy who knows so so much about this course. This course is of course extremely difficult but his pure amount of knowledge and passion makes it interesting. Take-home midterms are extremely challenging and the grading is quite difficult but it is manageable as is the homework.

Eckleman is super genuine and really cares about his students. He's clearly passionate about what he teaches/is always prepared for class which makes lectures much more interesting to attend. Midterms are both take home and open notebook. Very manageable workload with usually 1-2 homework assignments a week.
Really nice guy who is clearly interested in material he teaches. Lectures can get a bit boring, but two open note, take-home midterms didn't hurt.
If you can take Energy and Sustainability with Eckelman do it.  He gives one kinda long homework assignment a week but no midterm and an open note final.

She is so nice and understanding, she's also a great teacher and really listens to her students. We pretty much just read for homework and had open discussion in class but you don't actually need to read to pass. Prof Economou is great!

Someone says, " The best teachers teach from the heart, not from the book." She is one of the best professors I've ever had in Northeastern. She teaches her students from her heart. She is incredibly knowledgeable and respectful to students. She is very understandable and caring. With no iota of hesitation, I would take her class again! Love her!

She works at a hospital as a social worker/counselor so she knows what she's talking about. Only HW is reading, and it's not overwhelming. No tests, just pop quizzes on the reading. Grades were based on participation, 2 papers, a group project, and the quizzes. Kind lady who gets to know students. Mix of lectures, discussions and practicing skills.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: This professor is older but has a broad range of experience in research, Public Health and microbiology. He is a bit dry but funny in a very subtle way. I definitely recommend him for the ault learner.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Inspirational

reviews.comment: This guy is awesome. His lectures are clear and interesting. He provides audio copies of his lectures on Blackboard and you can listen as much as you want. His tests are on target and fair.
I learned a lot about the history of microbiology through this course!
I love this person. He is one of the best science teachers I have ever had. Sometimes he spends to much time on the development of ideas and theories but OTH it is useful information.

Dr Cosgrove is a great microbiology teacher and he knows what he's talking about. I really like the class format and how he makes it easy to memorize scientific terms and concepts. I admit, if you're just a student looking for an easy A, you're grade will not be satisfactory. You will get As in both the lecture and lab if you show that you understand the material. What I also like about this professor is that, although he may not always be available to meet, he will make every effort to answer..
This professor is one of the best I have had in the evening program. He is organized and interesting. I love his analogies and historical vignettes

Very boring class. Material is interesting, but is conveyed poorly. He seems like he knows what he is talking about, but he just can't teach it to us. Unless the book is read instead of his lecture, the grade will not be satisfactory.
He is very good and very accomodating. This is a lecture class not a discussion group. This is science-either you know the material or you don't. You can not just talk your way to an A.

Very boaring classes !!! All you do is print papers and go to class and listen to lectures which makes it boaring to keep listening 2hrs.The test are all memorising and makes it hard to remember all the micro terms and steps. Essay formats are hard to answer. i wouldnt recomment if someone is looking for active class with assignments/quiz/discussio
i AM STUDYING TO BE A NURSE AND I REALLY APPRECIATE THE HOSPITAL AND PUBLIC HEALTH PERSPECTIVE HE BRINGS TO CLASS. HE IS THE BEST MICRO TEACHER IN THE WORLD
He is really good and very accomodating to adult learners who have to work also.
I just love this class.Dr.C can be dry and speakes in amonotone but he has an incredable span of knowledge and experience frombasic scienceresearch to public health.Take this class.
He is older but really up to date. his comments are right on target and he can be funny in a very subtle way. He is actually pretty cool.

This is the best science teacher I have ever had. He knows so much about his subject and can teach witout notes and make sense. He makes you read the text but never asks questions about anything he has not taught. He treats you like an adult and not some 18 year old child and does not  insult your intelligence. I would recommend him to anyone.

He is one of the best science teachers I have had. The class is huge with 160+ people but he manages to answer questions when you ask them without straying off course. He is not a regular faculty member but if you need to see him he will make arrangements to see you and he ALWAYS answers e-mails quickly and fully.
He is a very knowledegeable professor. While understated his class is excellent.

I honestly think he couldn't care less about how we did in the class. He never helped anyone outside of class and god forbid you ask anything that requires extra effort from him. No one ever had any idea on how to study for the tests except for try to memorize every single thing. Horrible experience with a class I thought I'd like.
I don't understand why he is teaching, he seems that he does not like, class is very boring just talk and does not like to answer questions for students.

Professor Ted is an amazing professor. I am in my second course with him. He is caring, understanding, and funny. He is prompt with replying to e-mails. Also, while we do have to post in discussions, he gives flexibility on the due date. He grades for participation, but does not check vigorously. Doing all your work will make or break your grade.

Prof Murphy is a caring professor, is a bit long winded though. Numerous readings and powerpoint lectures each week, some not always relevant. He provides decent feedback but expects a wider viewpoint than usual. He appreciates both perspectives on all issues.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Best professor I have ever had! He is highly intelligent, and assigns up to date, entertaining material. He is also vert kind and goofy, and care so much about his students. I try to sign up for one of his classes every quarter!
Very intelligent and due to this is at times hard to completely follow. He is very helpful, fair, and sort of goofy/funny. You will retain tons of info but he is certainly worth taking
Passionate about his work and it shows. The class is by no means easy, but he is fair.
He had a vast knowledge to lecture about every class.  The problem was, you practically needed to memorize all of that vast knowledge.

I took micro with him, and he made it a very interesting course. i didn't think i was even going to like the class, but i really enjoyed his lectures, he explains things well in his slides and puts them online as well. The book was also very helpful. I would recommend taking this class with him.

Professor Dinan is one of the best professors I had so far. He explains the material really well, gives a lot of practice problems and goes over common mistakes that students make. He also relates information from his professional life what makes the class very enjoyable and fun. Highly recommend!
Online class - had technical issues, but given that Professor Dinan lectures all over the place, it's hard to follow and doesn't explain content nor answer questions well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fantastic person, funny, smart, good teacher. You'll have an A... all the way up to the final

He's one of the best Northeastern has to offer for Accounting. He goes through material super fast and at times it's hard to keep up, but he cares about his classes and makes them light-hearted and as fun as an accounting class can be. A lot of group time during class to work on problems, fairly minimal lecture.

Prof Dinan is pretty great at teaching, just go to class and participate as much as you can, as long as you do the connect assignments and pay attention in class, getting an A won't be hard. He covers all the material in class and also gives many hints, if you're not good at financial accounting, take his class, you won't regret it

Prof Dinan is sarcastic and funny. Don't skip class - he makes sure to focus on relevant, important content. Homework isn't hard to keep up with (10 Connect assignments total + 2 group case studies) but you need to remember the due dates. He does freely give extensions for them. Tests are tough!! Study with practice problems! TAKE THIS CLASS!

Brilliant professor.  He knows accounting really well and can break it down in a way that makes it seem simple even for students who tend to struggle with accounting.  He is very funny and can make the most boring topics funny.  He is so efficient that class usually ends 15-20 minutes early.  Definitely take him!

It was the class forced to be taken but with this professor, I was even thinking adding this concentration. Funny and easy keeps us engage. Love to ask questions. Always thinking the question from our standing point, grades specifically. Currently the best professor that I have ever met in NEU. Recommending this prof to everyone around me.

This will be the greatest professor you will ever have. Ever. His teaching style makes you interested in the boring materials, he's always there to hear you out and give advice, and he's simply hilarious.

Amazing professor, inspired me to declare accounting as my concentration. He really cares about what information is important in the real world and skips things that you would never see. He knows its an easy subject and doesn't go out of his way to make it more complicated than it needs to be. Would love to take him again for other classes.

he is very easy going, and makes the class easy to follow by only focusing in important facts and going through hard problems in class (similar to the ones you will find in the exam). He is a very nice guy. take this professor if you are taking any accounting course

Dinan does an amazing job of teaching what would otherwise be a boring class. He skips the unnecessary parts of powerpoints and makes sure to go through example problems with the whole class. Even though about 13 of our lectures were cancelled from snow days, he still thoroughly prepared us for the unchanged department final.

This class is designed to be the entry-level class for both Accounting and Finance. Dinan is a great teacher and really does engage the students and is enthusiastic about teaching. Although the multiple choice on the test are a bit difficult, if you study the problems he gives you in class, the problems on the test will be very straightforward.

I do NOT recommend this teacher. He's a really funfunny guy, but he never gets his powerpoints done in class. His TA grades all of his tests and if you want any grades changed, you have to take it up with the TA, who (in my case) got super defensive and wouldn't change the grades. He also never explains anything properly no matter what you ask.

Dinan is great! I preferred financial accounting to this managerial acct class but he helps a lot and is funny. Doesn't take anything to serious and definitely an interesting guy with a lot of industry experience. Be prepared to study for exams, its not necessarily an easy A class if your not a big acct fan.. ;)
So hard and not helpful at all if you dont understand
Best class!

Dinan is a man among boys, and a God among men. I had the pleasure of taking his Financial + Managerial accounting courses. The subject matter isn't always riveting but Dinan will add interesting anecdotes while he saunters though it. 3 tips: When you do something, do it right, you can never overdress and you'll woln't regret taking Dinan's class
The best professor ever, he goes right to the point and teach relevant info you need for the real world.
The best Acct professor in NEU, you gota take this guy.

ONE OF THE BEST TEACHERS THAT I HAVE TAKEN. HE IS WILLING TO HELP YOU OUT NO MATTER WHAT AND HE MADE ACCOUNTING INTERESTING. I REALLY HATED ACCOUNTING AND TAKING HIM MADE IT INTERESTING. STRONGLY RECOMEND!!!!!!
Hands down the best professor you could take. He makes the class fun and way easier than the other ACCT professors.  By sophomore year (in which he also taught), EVERYONE wanted to take his class.

This guy is the best. He keeps the class lightened up with his unique smile and sense of humor. I am very pleased to have chosen him. He'll do all he can to help you achieve a good grade. I personally think that this is the best professor of accounting at NEU so far; and I'm an accounting major!
Good guy.  Understands that class is not the most important thing in life....
He likes to talk about himself alot, but he's very nice and laid back. Recommended

awesome professor. great guy, very funny, and relaxed. genuinely wants everybody in the class to get an A. Always prepares you for the tests, and the hw is easy. definitely recommend any class this professor teaches
He does appear intimidating and as a hard teacher at first, but he turned out to be an extremely chill and nice guy who likes to have fun and help all the time.
Quite possibly the most helpful teacher at NU. If you struggle, he'll turn things upside down and make it all seem like a piece of cake.
The best professor I've had at Northeastern. He's willing to set time aside to help you in any way possible and basically spells out what you will be tested on. Easy homework too.
Can be intimidating at first but is very nice
Literally one of the worst professors I've ever had. Petty and childish. Inconsistent grading. Mean and condecending.

Professor Kammerer is hands down one of the best professors I have had in my college career and I am sad I was only able to take one class with him. His classes are lecture based with active participation needed to move it along. We had 5 papers but if you listen in class and put in the effort, they are not that difficult. Over all take his class!

Took his public policy class at FSU, and would highly recommend him to any person interested in policy! Hands down my favorite professor I've had in college so far. PS: don't let him talk about bison or owls.
I like that he doesn't try to kid anyone. He appreciates a good discussion and is genuinely interested in the subject. I would highly recommend taking a course with this professor.

Class attendance is mandatory. You have 3 papers and one research paper. Useless to go to class though since none of the papers is related to what we discuss during class. Discussion gets really boring before half of the semester, maybe because this is his first time teaching it. He is a good guy, I don't complain, good person. Hard grader.
One of his best qualities was his ability to steer and prompt good class discussion. Definitely a great professor, but not necessarily a life altering one.
One of the his best qualities is his ability to steer and prompt good class discussion. Definitely a great professor, but not necessarily a life altering one.

he's a nice guy. but don't take this class with him. it is sad that such an amazing class be taught by a horrible professor. he was certainly not clear about what he wanted. he was not always available. I worked very hard for this class and never missed any class but didn't grade me fairly. apparently he didn't like me. DON'T TAKE HIM
NOT FAIR

I also agree with the general consensus here. The class was a waste of time with no clear expectations. The material he taught was based on his uninformed opinions, not fact. On the plus side, the class was fairly easy, the grade only based on one group project and presentation, which you're pretty much guaranteed to do well on. Avoid if you can.

I agree with previous comments. I was very disappointed in this class. I gained nothing from the project. Until this day I do not know how to write a paper that would satisfy him. Changed the syllabus often. Articlea were repetitive. Grades poorly when you're not his favorite.

He is unclear about his expectations for the write-ups and project. Even if you get it, if he doesn't like you (for whatever reason), you'll be graded poorly. There's nothing you can do but not take this class. Waste of time and money. All the articles reiterated the same concepts. The project was for his benefit not the students.

I agree with last comment. The guy is not clear AT ALL on what his expectations are for assigments - when you do what you think he wants he comes back with a B. not even a B+. He does pick favorites and you will know if / when he does not like you! would not reccomend him.

changes the syllabus each week.  not at all organized. very tough grader, puts what he wants answered in writing and then you deliver it, and then he will comment that you didn't answer the questions.  Very unclear direction, and flips flops all the time.
Hated him. Classes are a joke then he is a very tough grader. Not available for help or understanding in anyway. Picks favorites.

May be the best prof. in NU. Do not avoid this prof. he is great. I will use what I've learned from him after leaving NU. A++++++ Prof. Will work hard when needed but not all semester. Group work is most important in OB class.
He teaches in a very entertaining and interesting way.  I always looked forward to coming to class.  Also very fair with grading write-ups.

His class was a lot of work, but he was by far the most entertaining professor I have ever had. His classes are never boring, and lectures are lively due to his energy and enthusiasm. If you like a challenge, definitely take one of his classes. Intuitively knows how well you understand; gives you the grade you deserve.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. G is an amazing teacher. He makes class enjoyable and brings to life the material being covered. Go to class, read the books, and speak with him if you're having trouble with anything. He's a great professor with a sense of humor but won't tolerate phones or messing around in class. Highly recommend!

Very dramatic, his lectures have a certain socratic flair. You won't be disappointed. The class isn't super HARD and the tests are easily aced, you just have a lot of work and reading, and 3 books to read in entirety.
Group Project with a presentation, a paper to go with it, a term paper, and 2 exams. it's a lot of work but you learn a lot, and he's a cool guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. There when you need help. Lots of reading and two moderate papers (8-10 page term paper on 700+ page book, 3 page paper on historical film).  His lectures were my favorite and I looked forward to them each class. Made me love Greek History.   Attendance very mandatory. Will read both textbooks cover-to-cover.

Ed was extremely understanding during my crisis communication class.  I was struggling with some health issues, which translated to a rough online semester.  After explaining my situation, Ed worked with me personally and restored my confidence in the subject matter.  Grateful professors like him exist!

Ed's class strays from the traditional format in that there isn't a lot of note taking or reading from the book.  The class is mostly examining case studies and everyone participates.  He keeps it interesting by showing YouTube videos of current news stories.  A fair grader if you apply principles from discussion in your case analysis

Never got papers back until after the final. So no feedback. He graded with opinions of actual criteria.  Very political and had favorites, I am obviously on the opposite side of the political fence than him and he let me know it in a paper I wrote, it was an OPINION paper! Didn't even cover everything I thought he would have. Not IMPRESSED
No Comments

its an interesting class but HE HAS NO IDEA HOW TO GRADE!!!!! there is no criteria, no rubrics, nothing... it's like he just decides to throw out a grade and give it to you. Doesnt give A's. Sometimes you'll get an A- when you feel you deserve a B but then when you feel you deserve an A+ you get a C! If you're looking for an A - not this class!!!
I had an amazing class with farzaneh eftekhari. she learnt me a lot in design.

I think this class is introduction of design class, but she gave a lot of group assignments and individual assignments as well. You have to follow her mind to do your assignment unless you will get a bad grade. And tons of assignments together at the same time, and you have to be on time EVERY SINGLE CLASS. NO EXCEPTION.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lectures were based on text heavy slides, from which she sometimes struggled to read off of. Lectures and projects were repetitive. Missing class can easily drop yout grade. Her assignments and instructions are often unclear and confusing and her grading is vague with little feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Nice and caring. Vague grading criteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: This professor's grading is inconsistent and strongly focuses on product design rather than design in general. Attendance is a strong part of your grade and the professor will take off massive points if you do not attend class. Also, the grade shown on Blackboard is not reliable since she doesn't grade things ASAP.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is very laid-back and flexible with deadlines, which can be helpful. Lectures are not very engaging, so reviewing material outside of class is recommended. Exams are straightforward if you study the practice questions. For labs, keep your data organized since everything is collected at the end. I would take his class again.

Painfully boring lectures but he is a very wholesome cute old man. Educational value is minimal. I couldn't pay attention in lecture no matter how hard I tried so I read the textbook to learn the content which I never do. Tests are very easy though.
Ed is an amazing professor! The classes are very lecture heavy but his exams and homework's are very straightforward! Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ed's lectures are super long and boring. You have to teach yourself basically everything, but he does provide practice tests that are very similar to the actual exam. If you make an effort to review and learn before the tests you will be fine. Content is very basic chemistry you probably learned in high school.
He is wonderful! Take his course.
my goat! great lab prof for chem 1161. it was easy to make up labs if missed, and nothing was graded harshly. please laugh at his jokes.

Chemistry 1102 lab is so easy. Very enjoyable nothing about it is hard. The TAs are super kind and helpful. Labs are straightforward. Lab reports are very very easy and are not graded harshly at all. Best science lab by far.

He is so cute. Super sweet guy and he is hilarious (please laugh at his jokes they are amazing). Exams are exactly what he tells you, no tricks, topics on Achieve Homeworks are what is on the exams. Homeworks are based off completion and are weighted more than the exams. He gives lots of practice exams/material and can easily prepare for the exams.

His lectures can be hard to pay attention to, especially since they're  long. But, the content and his grading criteria is straightforward and easily attainable. You do need to depend on yourself to learn the content as it is difficult to learn solely in class. But it's literally not difficult content to work with. He's also open to clarifying.

He's nice, I just wish he spent more time showing how to solve problems and explaining how concepts connect to each other. Most of the lectures are just reading from the lecture slides. Lecture slides are dense and direct rips from the textbook.

Ed is a kind, chill professor. His class is pretty straightforward and the topics are simple. Lectures are very boring, so it is hard to pay attention. Even when I paid attention, I didn't really know what was happening because he likes to ramble so I usually just went to class to finish my lab reports. The class is easy, but everyone cheats.
Do not take his course if you value your sanity. You basically need to teach yourself everything. Sets you up for failure.
Lectures felt really long but overall great professor. Very understanding, exams were very straightforward.

Before I took this class I checked rate my professor, but now that I am actually taking this class I feel like everything everyone says is a lie. He reads off of the slides which are 150+ and he doesn't have review days. He was very unorganized at the beginning of the year now I am suffering trying to study 2 weeks worth of material in 3 days.

He just reads slides taken word-for-word from the textbook. There's no additional explanation or writing on the board, so you end up teaching yourself everything. His exams are also very poorly designed. He heavily weights the open-response section (roughly two-thirds of the grade) instead of multiple choice and makes grading feel unbalanced
Super nice professor. He just reads off the slides during the lectures, but if you take notes and review after class the exams should be easy.

He is a very funny and sweet guy, but his lectures were very hard to pay attention to. Pretty much just read off of slides for the entire class time. Mostly had to teach myself outside of class. However, he is extremely accommodating and it is pretty easy to do well in the course.

Not a hard class to pass but I would say that you have to teach yourself because lectures are very boring and the slides are from 2016. Also tends to go off topic and talk about personal life during lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ed is an amazing professor, he was always available even after class time. He grades fairly and give chances to improve your grade. It's genuinely hard to fail his class, but the only thing is that in his lecture he mainly reads off the slide so it's hard to learn much in class because you can jus take notes on the slides yourselves.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ed is wonderful! He makes an effort for his students, whether answering questions outside of class or offering extra credit. It's very difficult not to pass his class. Not everyone pays attention to his lecture, but I would recommend it!
Professor Witten just reads off the slides that are taken from the textbook.

Professor Witten is a gem. He truly cares about the success of his students and gives many chances to succeed and is a very fair grader. He doesn't make things harder than they need to be and exam questions are straight from lecture material and practice questions/exams he posts online.

Always willing to explain but very disorganized. At midterm, was 1.5 chapters behind so weren't tested on the first 5 chapters, caught up a bit but still missed entire chapter for final and self-teach. Changes deadlines constantly. Easy to succeed for entry-level class, but would've been very difficult for more challenging upper-level coursework.
Witten is an amazing guy who loves chemistry. He's super knowledgeable in the lab and happy to help out. I've been a TA for him for years and is great to talk to!
Professor Witten is a good professor, don't be hesitated to take his class. Three exams and one final exam. He will post practice exams, if you do that, exams will be fine.

Had for general chemistry lab. Whole class was taught by a TA who was very sweet and helped us out with any parts of the lab we were confused on. Small extra credit was offered at end of semester. Just show up to every lab and you'll be fine. Lab reports and post-lab questions take awhile so I always did them in advance before they were due.

Witten is an amazing chemist. He is very smart and funny too. If you ask him if your solution or crystals look alright he will answer and tell you what you should do for the best outcome. He is present in the lab, but there is also a TA there to help. Easy A if you put effort into the work. If you miss a lab, you can easily make it up.

I had professor Witten for ten chem lab, and I would definitely recommend. He is knowledgeable, and laid back, making class and chemistry fun/interesting. Attendance is mandatory because the lab needs to be completed to write the reports, but we are always let out early. Not a harsh grader, but the lab manual is definitely needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Had Prof. Witten for a general chemistry lab, he was extremely understanding to students and passionate about chemistry. He was lenient when students accidentally prepared for the wrong lab or turned in lab reports late. You do need to attend all labs though, otherwise you'll miss the experiment and have nothing to write in lab reports.

He is a good teacher. Im not strong in chemistry by any means but I was able to go get an A. He doesnt overload you with unnecessary class work like other chem professors like Topher. He understands that chemistry isnt the only thing you do. There are only two exams so do well and he does give extra credit but very easy going guy .

He goes pretty fast in lectures which made it hard to take notes but does a good job explaining concepts. Ended up taking most of my notes off of the slides he posted online. Definitely seems like a super chill dude and keeps class pretty lighthearted.
Lectures were hard to pay attention to, but the tests weren't bad. If you're confused in lab and ask for help, he'll basically do it for you.

He almost exclusively read from the slides which were huge blocks of text with typos. If you tried to answer a question in lecture and didnt give the exact response he expected, he would tell you you were wrong even if your response was correct. He couldnt understand students questions. Easy homework, easy tests, dont feel like I learned.
Really nice guy who is very willing to help you out. Funny and easygoing.

He prints out every slide and hands them out before each class. He then reads off of the slides for most of the lecture. He is very nice and funny but if you struggle with chem you might have to go to chem central a lot.
I loved Witten. Though he didnt know my name doing the practice tests over and over until you get it gives you an A. He is a great man.

This class is 100% lectures and it was extremely difficult for me to understand Prof. Witten's lectures, so I ended up teaching myself pretty much everything. Hilarious guy, not the best at teaching but pretty solid gen chem 2 option.

I think Ed is overrated. He's a funny professor and is nice, but I left Gen Chem 1 hardly knowing any of the material. From what I've heard, most of the other GenChem professors aren't any better, though. I have Vaso now for Chem 2, and I don't learn anything in her class either, but I have a better grade bc of the exams. Ed's tests are hard.

Witten is a very funny guy. His lectures are not very fun but he'll manage to entertain you with some jokes every now and then. I've never been good at chemistry before him, but he made me love chemistry. He knows his stuff well, the best chemistry professor you'll ever have.

Ed is a great professor. He is a caring guy, and he is quite funny. Put in some effort, and you'll find yourself with an A. He likes to strike up conversations with students who are friendly with him. He helps me get all of my labs done, and in some cases wants to do part of them for me! Highly recommend.
Ed is Straight Fire

He is a great professor that I would ever have. He makes corny jokes and he provides practice midterm exam (which is similar to midterm exam and final). He also provides the  student to write a paper anything in particular (chem topic) to boost grade up. I would recommend this professor to a friend.
Great teacher, straightforward. Practice exams basically the same as real exams. Put in some effort, get an A.

This guy was an awesome teacher. He was very specific in explaining how to go about solving problems. He did not make you feel uncomfortable about asking questions. He would introduce multiple ways to completing a problem and it was up to you which way was easier for you. He works off a power point. I did not need the textbook to get an A.

Witten is amazing. Super friendly, very responsive to email, always prepared in lab and ready to answer any questions you have. Very fair grader, outlines what he wants very clearly, just follow the rubric. Only had him for Gen Chem lab, but he did an excellent job. Highly recommend.

Witten is simply the best. He wants to help his students, so he gives out practice questions and their solutions. His tests are based on the book and his practice questions. There are three MC tests(about 30 questions each) and a MC final (about 50 questions). Overall, very fair! RECOMMENDED.

The most amazing Professor on Campus. I am assured that I will earn an A+ in this class!!! He is so helpful, so lenient, just an overall blessing to have as a professor. He genuinely wants everyone to pass the class. He make the most difficult tasks easy. He clearly loves what he does, and if you are reading this Ed, thank you so much.

Professor Witten is an amazing Chemistry teacher. His lectures are so clear and to the point. You can tell he really loves Chemistry. He also throws in jokes here and there. He gives tons of examples and hand outs and the tests are MORE than fair. I would highly recommend his course.

I cannot say enough about this professor - His teaching style is straightforward and he provides handouts,practice questions and exams which prepare one very well for tests. If one does the work there every opportunity to get an A. Extremely flexible with homework, extra help and test taking. Did I mention his sense of humor...priceless

HE IS THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! His class is the one class that I always look forward to, it is so much fun so much chemistry! Makes the class very entertainaing and easy. If you don't get an A its your fault.

THE BEST FOR CHEM 1.  Extremely fair professor.  Looks out for his students.  If you put in the work guaranteed good grades.  Forgives late homework.  Study the practice exams they will definitely help especially the practice Final.

He is soo funny but it's only funny if he says it. If you were good at chem before, then it should be super easy for you. If not, he's always willing to help. He has a cute lisp, and his mom calls during class. Once, he ended class early b/c he had a bowling team to get it. Got an A. Take him! Amazing guy.

A funny little man who wants you to do well. He's very flexible when it comes to tests and passing in homework. I asked him last minute if I could take a test on a different day and he had no problem with it. He'll also adjust your grade if you did poorly on one test but improved on another.
This guy is awesome.  He is so helpful and will do anything to help you get a good grade.  You will definately love him. He loves to make jokes. Guy is awesome

Ed witten is the man. He makes jokes that would only be funny coming from him. he really enjoys his jobs whihch makes it fun for the class. Pokes fun at students(never hurtful) which makes the class entertaining. My favorite professor so far. The man

He's so adorable. He tries to be funny but it's just awkward, which makes it funny. The first two tests were ridiculously easy but the last was tricky. He's very fair and really wants you to do well. I definitely recommend him.
I LOVE THIS GUY. BEST CLASS EVER.

he is awesome. tries really hard to be funny but its cute. he still lives with his mom and she calls sometimes in the middle of class. He is not crazy easy i mean you still have to study for his tests but if you study, you will do fine, I am not a chemistry genius and got a b in chem 1 but chem 2 i got an A and studied half as much
Very fair professor, funny guy, easy class.  Don't be surprised if his Mom calls him during class.
ED WITTEN IS THE MAN!!!!!!!!!!
No Comments
good professor for chem 2.  gives lots of handouts so notetaking is not really necessary.  practice tests are very good indication of mid-term content.

I love this guy. Hes so adorable, tries so hard to be funny, and has the cutest lisp in the world. DOnt be surprised if his parents call him during class, happens a lot. He really wants everyone to do well and will help you any way he can. Awesome teacher take his class!

Such a good guy.  He doesn't want anyone to do bad in his class and gives you a million opportunities to get a good grade.  On the first day of class he told us that you can get 40% average on his exams and still pass the course.  So basically if you fail it's your own fault.
very easy class,tests are practically the same as practice tests.very helpful with grades, gives u lots of opportunity

Relatively easy. Lectures are all clear powerpoints straight from the book.  Homeworks and in class problems are always very indicative of exam questions.  Exams based directly on practice tests and homework problems.  Easy to do well with just a little review

Witten is one of the better teachers. Lectures are from powerpoint slides that come with the book. He makes up his own problems and gives you an answer key. The tests come from his own practice problems, just a few numbers switched around. Lab = easy, Recitation = easy. Lecture quizzes/jeopardy questions are bonus added on to final grade. Easy A!!!
He is very good. Test are exactly what he teaches in class. The paper is easy. He is very helpfull. I will recommed him to everyone.
Witten is the man. Def take his class. Easy grade. He's helpful and very clear.
Take his chemistry class! He is sooo helpful and just a flat-out nice guy. He gives you practice tests that are really helpful too.
witten is the man. he's hysterically corny and makes chemistry extremely fun and easy. i wish i could take his class again. He's totally helpful in other ways too.

Funny, cute little guy who looks sorta like mr. magoo. Very nice, actually makes chem interesting and doesn't take attendence. Makes sure you will get the grade you need as long as u put in the effort.

Funny guy, yet you need to be to make chem interesting. The slides are right from the book and he teaches right from them. All you need are the slides and the practice tests to do well. With his labs beware of TA that don't speak English, go to him when you need help on labs he's great!!
good teacher, not too hard of a course.  He cracks a lot of corny jokes but they're sort of cute

This guy is the man, bar none. He's who you need to talk to for anything lab related. Helps out with labs, quick witted, and will help you with the prelabs and lab questions, and gives results. Can also help with genchem questions.
Used other resources to learn the topics. Stay away if you can.

The content isn't well organized and isn't comprehensive enough to be useful. For instance, the learning algorithms of important models are sometimes not discussed at all !!! The focus is only on inference for a large portion, which is useless without understanding how the models are optimized.

reviews.comment: Professor Elhamifar's class is a pedagogical nightmare. Lectures lack coherence, with explanations resembling cryptic puzzles. Grading is a mystery, marked by vague feedback and seemingly arbitrary scales. Seeking clarification is futile, as the professor appears disinterested. Students, beware of this academic abyss.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Going into this class I didn't have a very good fundamental understanding of basic machine learning concepts, but this class really helped me solidify these ideas. Professor Elhamifar is honestly really caring and understanding, he provided comprehensive lecture notes and stayed extra after every class to answer questions, couldn't ask for more.

This was the best class that I took at the graduate level. Clear explanations, great materials, fair exam, generous office hours. I have lots of great notes I saved to go back and read every time I need a reference.

His lectures and lecture notes are enough to survive through the course and have been a great resource. Unlike the remaining comments, I found him to be very reciprocating to student doubts during the class.

He doesn't use Canvas, everything is on Piazza. Homework 1 was chaotic because we had to turn it in on paper and then try to get it back, but then we were allowed to submit by email after. He uploads notes on Piazza from class, and yes they're scratchwork, but you get from them what you need. He does randomly yell at people for no reason also.

While Ehsan is not exactly the best professor, he doesn't deserve a rating of 1. It's true that his lectures are hard to follow along with but they are supplemented with concise lecture notes. Also his exams are fair to the material taught. Pretty much anything on the exam can be learned from reviewing lecture notes and homeworks, which is nice.

reviews.comment: This professor couldn't be more useless. Lecture notes posted are trash. Has his own website with no information. Also why is it you can lose 10% on your grade for participation, and if you participate he gets pissed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Disrespectful to students in class and lectures miserably. Lectures are hard to follow with no proper course material. Incapable of using technology and openly admits to being unable and unwilling to run a Canvas page as an ML professor. Becomes aggressive if asked questions. Writes equations on the board for 2 hours without explanation.

reviews.comment: I didn't understand anything. So fast and not organized. Worst professor at NEU. Others are way better.

reviews.comment: The homework doesnt help to better understand the course, and they are not even graded correctly. The exam is different from the homeworks. He doesnt answer to questions in the class but he asks questions alot.

Homework won't help you learn the material. The exam questions are different from what he teaches in the class. The TA believed that the students did good in the exam, but when we saw the grades most people were shocked. He didn't let us see the exam sheets. He won't give you solutions to Homework or exam, so you won't know your mistakes.
