reviews.comment: Best!

He teaches so fast and doesn't explain anything. If you didn't understand, that's your problem. He gave 4 homeworks and implementation questions too. The implementations take long time but he doesn't give any feedback if what you did is correct or not. His exams are so easy but the grades are so low. Plus, he never ever shows you your exam sheet!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dan provides time for students to ask questions in class, and is always willing to go over examples and content again. The lectures are great, but there are sometimes mistakes in the online lecture notes, so make sure you ask questions if confused. He's funny and understanding. Make sure you study for the weekly quizzes - the points add up!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Ehrmann gives some of the most understandable lectures I've had here at Northeastern. He breaks concepts down and makes them extremely understandable and uses memorable examples. I would highly recommend him as a professor. If you're worried about grades, he's not very difficult if at all. Just make sure to do some practice problems.

Powerful, clear lectures. Has a great classroom presence and really cares about the material he teaches. Be sure to take notes on the example proofs in class, those are almost exactly the questions on the exams. No real need for the textbook other than for homework.

Incredible lecturer - you can tell he really cares about the material, and he presents it very clearly. He's also super willing to work with you in office hours (he explained something I didn't get in different ways until I understood it.) The textbook is only used for homework problems. The class itself isn't terribly hard, but Dan makes it easier

Wonderful man who went way out of his way on my behalf during the semester and has continued to help myself and several other students find jobs in the corona economy. And by the way - he's the smartest individual I have ever met. Seems kind of spacy sometimes but misses nothing.

In my last semester of college, took his M&A class and changed my entire career goal. His enthusiasm is obvious and comparing him to other faculty? This guy is managing businesses during Corona and still puts together over 200 slide a week from scratch. The others won't even talk to you-c you need to talk to TAs.
Awesome.

Brilliant. Knows more about M&A than anyone I've ever met - the academic, the practical, and how they fit together. He hasn't been teaching long, and never taught this course before, and at times it's obvious that his industry job (private equity) is overwhelming him, but he does everything humanly possible to make the class fun and interesting.

Jean is a great co-op advisor! I freaked out so many times about applying to co-ops and she answered every single one of my SOS phone calls and emails promptly! 10/10 would recommend! Also for co-op class she never made us do a mock interview if we didn't want to, and we never had HW assignments other than to work on our resumes!
Great teacher
Not helpful when trying to apply for federal positions for co-op. She expects you to do a lot on your own.
sometimes good, sometimes not so good.  hot and cold

Super chill. There for you. Is older and makes a few mistakes, but always in good spirit. Answers questions, there at office hours, a super chiller. He laughs and smiles and teaches well.   I recommend A++, go to class, study, you'll ace it.

If you have trouble with a problem, definitely ask, because he will answer it and go through the problem, which is really helpful for math.  Although the homework isn't required, it's better to do it so you know what's going on in class, because he goes over questions people have on it.  He's helpful, just make the effort.
Prof. Shulte is a decent math teacher. He is good at introducing new topics by connecting them to things you already know. He is pretty clear, and answers questions just fine.
Egon is the best man in the world. I HATE Calculus but he is so nice and helpful and funny. Definitely make use of his office hours.

GREAT professor. Little bit of an accent, probably german. SMARTEST professor I have had at NU in terms of knowledge and ability to teach. HW is easy, 3 or 4 problems per class. takes about 15 minutes. 4 hourly tests that are just like the HW. Fair grader. All around great guy

Extremely good math professor.  Knows the subject, but most importantly he is able to convey the concepts well to the students. I wish he taught all math classes! Tests are exactly like the homework, so make sure to do the homework.  Attendance not mandatory.

He is very clear, and very consistent.  He always asks if we have any questions, he goes over homework, and his tests are extremely representative of the material he teaches.  Very knowledgeable guy, knows the subject very well.  I would definitely take a class with him again and I recommend him.

Good guy, good math teacher.  If you've taken any calc before this is a very easy class, otherwise be prepared to use your book alot because he isn't always the clearest.  Two tests, quiz every thursday, no hw.  buy class pak

generally good guy who wants you to learn.  beware however that tests are much harder than the quizzes.  buying the class pak is very beneficial, it contains past tests and quizzes which are almost identical to the tests you will take.

Total airhead. Clearly doesn't know what he's talking about. Answers questions by digressing off onto completely unrelated topics. Shows no signs of even knowing so much as a single thing about his subject. Avoid.
too hard and not clear but willing to help
AWESOME PROFESSOR!!! I've had him for this and Calc 2, very clear, very fair in grading and very knowledgable. If you have the opportunity to take this class, TAKE IT. GREAT TEACHER.

This professor is honestly one of the kindest and funniest I've had. He really cares and genuinely takes the time to make sure we understand the material. He is understanding, supportive, engaging, and approachable. Overall, he's a great professor, always willing to help, and clearly wants his students to do well. I would suggest taking him!!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He really cares about the students. He is fun and approachable. Tests and projects are very straightforward.

has weekly quizzes and sends the week previous discussing the material for the following quiz. has a clear-cut segmented teaching schedule and, really, he explains things in a way that allows you to truly understand the material. Try to attend all the classes in order to practice the formulas. 10 quizzes (40% of grade) and 1 final (60% of grade).
He is extremely helpful and very good at explaining problems.

Prof is great, but if you don't go to lecture you might struggle with the material. Even so, he likes the go on tangents which sometimes makes it difficult to follow. Very nice and helpful in office hours!
guys if you're looking for his ratings go to the page for cole eidson, it's the same guy. tl;dr: take him, great guy and easy class.
Bad prof

Class is horrible. Completely disorganized teaching methods, ridiculous tests, such a radical feminist who does not know how to effectively explain her opinions or how to accept student opinions. Stay away!

Serious issues regarding the grading system of this course. The main thing: it makes no sense. People who did not attend or participate got rewarded in their final mark, because since they didn't say anything in class, there was nothing the Prof. could scrutinize and  heavily base your final grade on. DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE!!! u will not be happy

Cant believe she was ever hired. Radical feminist. Completely lacks clarity both in assignments and on tests. I am a good student and have never been so frustrated with a class this ridiculous before. Drop this class for your own good. It will hurt your GPA.

IF YOU ARE IN THIS CLASS DROP IT NOW!! She is not clear on what she expects. Does not explain anything in class. When it comes to the midterm and final your looking at things you have never seen before. No class Structure. Numerous problems with gradding issues for roughly everyone in the class. And the journals are rediculous.

This woman is out of her mind...if you accidentally find your way into this class drop it. You basically debate her crazy theories in class and she tries to test you on something you didnt a) talk about in class and b) was not in the readings. The woman flat out has no bussiness teaching at NU

Have had a lot of professors, none as poor as this one. Her teaching methods are highly ineffective, never demonstrating any clarity. This miscommunication ends up hurting student's grades severely. Her grading is very controversial, raising heated dispute amongst students. I dont understand how this professor has a degree. Would not recommend.

This professor is honestly one of the kindest and funniest I've had. He really cares and genuinely takes the time to make sure we understand the material. He is understanding, supportive, engaging, and approachable. Overall, he's a great professor, always willing to help, and clearly wants his students to do well. I would suggest taking him!!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Eigen is a great guy. He reminds you of a family member that you love being around. He explains math in a way that everyone can understand and goes slow enough and makes sure you know the material. He often goes on tangents, but it's always educational and engaging. If you struggle in math, I 100% suggest you take his class.

Professor Eigen is probably the sweetest man you'll meet. He's very passionate about the math behind magic and card tricks, however his lectures were boring after a while and he doesn't grade attendance. There aren't midterms and finals either, meaning the course is graded purely on the service learning. Easy and guaranteed 100%, and a chill guy!

I took him for an honors inquiry class, and he was super nice. Class was boring but hes a super friendly quirky guy. Lectures were a little tough to get through and I did try to learn to sleep with my eyes open. But also hes so kind I feel bad saying that.

I took him for the honors elective, and he was a great professor. Really passionate about the subject, along with ensuring students were engaged in class. Teaching style was very laid back and relaxed, which allowed for better participation and a helpful environment. Overall, great experience!

Open note quizzes once a week and cumulative final (open note, as well). Every quiz can be retaken at least once (ensures a good grade). Takes his time making sure all students understand the material. Lots of algebra review and intro to derivatives. Professor is very kind, understanding, and considerate of the students.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: NO THX

I had him for precalculus and for my entire 21 years of life I had never understood math until I took this course. He's funny and creates a very intimate class setting where it feels comfortable to ask questions. Totally suggest him

Professor Eigen was the best math teacher that I have had my entire school career! I had him for Precalculus and he was very clear and thorough and basically covered everything that I needed for Calculus. Quizes are very easy and resemble the homework. He has a great sense of humor that adds to the class! Take him if you can!!
I took Stanley's Precalculus class. He was a really cool guy. The quizzes were really easy and if you didn't understand something he always took the time to explain it to you one-on-one.
Easy quizes, good style of teaching, and overall a great professor. Stan is the man.

This is NOT precalculus! This is an ALGEBRA class! If you already know your algebra, this class is POINTLESS. I thought we were actually going to do trig, but I was wrong. It's a waste of time for those who already learned from high school algebra.
Extremely easy. Actual quizzes are almost the same as the practice ones.
Great teacher
His awesome, easy class. All you have to do is the HW because its same as the quizzes. He helps a lot. Strange sense of humor. Great teacher easy A.
VERY easy class. He isn't very helpful but he will explain it and give practice quizes that are ALMOST IDENTICAL to the actual quiz.

very easy. quiz every week. gives you a practice quiz and the quiz is EXACTLY the same as the practice quiz. if you can do the practice i promise you can do the quiz. no surprises at all. funny guy, kinda a dork, but i liked him. oh and if you knwo what you are doing you can leave like a half hour early :)
Teacher is very rude. When I went for help after he did very little to help in anyway.
No Comments

Very easy if you put in the time. Ask questions after class or during office hours if you need help. Rewards you in the form of overlooking algebra errors on quizzes if he notices you putting in work.

easy class. hes scatterbrained but somehow he explains things really well. nothing unexpected. homework and a quiz every week. each class was like 20 minutes long with the rest reserved for people who needed extra help. if you need precalc, pick him.

kind of a jerk to his students.  very harsh and doesn't always explain things in the best way.  overall an easy class, if you stick to the homework and listen, he will give you all the tools you need to get by.  don't expect a lot of help if you don't understand something though.

Funny man.... horrible teacher.  He sounds like Woody Allen, he dresses like a lumber-jack (with his patented flanel shirts) and teaches like a genius who has no idea how to relate to his students. Get a tutor fast.
Not so good.
omg this guy is just funny to look at and watch...what other professor comes to class in flannel shirts and his hair everywhere? he's crazy man..but he sucks at teaching, so find a good tutor lol

VERY EASY MATERIAL!! However this professor is no help whatsoever.  He is rude when you ask questions and thinks lowly of his students.  As a person I hated him.  The one good thing about him was his sense of humor.
Very knowledgeable, learned loads!

If you can live with 3.3, then it's ok to take his class. He won't bump you up even a single point. His grading standard is inconsistent. He will took many points off for just some rediculous reasons. Obviously,  He doesn't understand the meaning of 100 class that it should be easy and there was no point talking to him. He doesn't care!!!

Nice guy. Never seen anyone get 100% on any paper though. In general the class is laid back, but he is a tough grader. I found it obnoxious how I had over a little over a 89% in his class but he refused to bump me to a 3.7 and made me take the 3.3. He's the only professor i've heard of and even encountered that doesn't show that type of sympathy.
the professor is very helpful and clear.

Eijmberts is amazing! He is not only the nicest professor you'll ever have, but he is also genuinely interesting and he is very helpful outside of class as well. I would definitely take another class with him. Exams aren't too difficult at all if you study and they are very fair. Take his class if you can!!

comparative politics with him was great... so chill and laid back... makes alot of jokes and he is a really easy grader... everything in lectures will be on the test... I never read the book and I finished the class with an A-... take this class with him... great prof really chill and cool... def recommend
Very nice and helpful. Dressed very nicely every single time.
very helpful and easy professor

Not a great experience with this Professor. Didn't seem to grasp writing styles other than her own. One on one meetings not consistent with her grading and the class was very uninteresting. Prepare to learn more about theories in the book than how to write better.

Very easy teacher, grades based on content of work, grammar does not really affect grade. She may be boring but its freshman writing, its already boring. I never got an A/A- paper but that was because I always did the papers the day they were due so I didn't expect a high grade(had 4:35 class and settled with a B+).
super nice, could be unclear sometimes but always willing to help you out
She teaches the Psych Freshman English Writing class.  She grades fairly on content and style, but not grammar.  She's always willing to help, but not exactly interesting.

Be extremely cautious before joining her lab. While she may seem professional externally, many students and postdocs have shared serious concerns about emotional abuse, intimidation, and exploitative behavior in private settings. The lab environment has been described as highly unsupportive and damaging to mental health.

I was her PhD student for six years. While her own career is impressive, I often experienced her intense and loud frustration or anger over relatively minor issues. Hence, regular communication felt draining and conflict-oriented, not collaborative/supportive. Her advising style did not provide substantial added value for career development.

In my experience, she is highly transactional, often leveraging connections with little reciprocity. While publicly gracious, private interactions can be unkind and volatile. Despite 25+ years in academia and many publications, she has mentored relatively few PhD students to strong career outcomes.

I applied for a postdoc she had advertised as a joint position with Stanford/Princeton/MIT, with time split across institutions. But the offer letter omitted any joint appointment. When I confronted her, she said these arrangements are not guaranteed and it would depend on my “performance”. This is the level of deception she is now well-known for.

Flatters you when she needs something from you. Then, abuses you continuously so that you do not demand your rightful academic favor from her. When challenged, throws fake apologies, without actually doing something for you. Avoid her. There are plenty of genuinely nice profs out there to work with.

Did anyone notice how she scrubbed her site clean - erased all photos of her ex-husband and dropped the “married” tag from CV, but never mentioned being divorced, as if he never existed? If she can rewrite her own past so easily, imagine how effortlessly she can erase students and postdocs from the record: no citations, false rumors, total erasure.

I can't stress enough how crucial it is to stay far away from her. Profs like her thrive on only manipulation and politics, using students/postdocs as stepping stones for their own fame and recognition. The toll this takes on students is often invisible but devastating. Keep your distance. It's simply not worth the damage.

She is the 'missing stair' of signal processing community. IYKYK. People know she's not reliable as a collaborator or advisor and needs to be "managed," but instead of calling her out, they just quietly warn newcomers and find ways to work around her without addressing the problem directly.

Her default management style is intimidation: threats, public shaming, and raised voices. Self-centered and neglectful of her students' needs, she reacts to any refusal of her petty requests with explosive, disproportionate anger. She turns a mere disagreement into a personal emergency, as if her lack of anger management is your problem.

No matter how outrageous her behavior gets, don't waste time arguing with her. She'll just deny everything outright. The best approach is to document everything and file a complaint, or cut off contact with her entirely. Don't bother trying to convince others what kind of PoS she is. Focus on getting out yourself.

Folks, don't be surprised. She has a history of frequently moving from one university to another. Unfortunately, her conduct often creates tension and discord within the department. Once people realize it, no one wants to work with her and students avoid her lab. When she's found out, she typically relocates and repeats the pattern elsewhere.

When I told her I would not continue my thesis under her, guess what was her response? "I need YOUR help to find your replacement." This is the level of cruelty, selfishness, and delusion she is known for. Even students who completed their thesis with her were left without any job, reference letter, or support from her.

God help our department! The university administrators seem completely oblivious to the harm she brings to students. How could they justify hiring someone with a known history as a harasser to students and staff? Decisions like this undermine trust in leadership and place students directly at risk.

Ellen is super understanding and amazing as a professor. Partway through the semester, she gave us a break to help us recharge and catch up. You need to be putting in consistent effort, but it is 100% manageable
She is awesome I am looking to take her again when I do AWD

Ellen was a great professor, her style was different from other writing classes, we had the freedom to write whatever we wanted and were encouraged to explore different styles. We weren't graded on technique or traditional essay criteria but graded instead on effort so you could go at your own pace. Overall great experience!

I study electrical and aerospace engineering, and Ellen's class was the best part of my semester. She gives feedback to everyone and is just a really good person. Definitely give the class a shot—you won't find many like it in college. If you put in the effort and do a little extra here and there, you'll get a good grade.
Assignments aren't graded; a grade is given at the end of the term based on how she feels you did in the class

One of my favorite classes I've taken! I had this class at 8 am but Ellen made sure to keep us awake, engaged, and genuinely interested. It's more of a discussion based class so make sure to participate. If you don't want to speak she lets you participate on Canvas instead to get the points. Instead of typical essays we did fun, creative projects!
LOVE this woman! She's the sweetest and really cares about her students' success.

Ellen the Felon is AMAZING. I had this class at 8 am, but it woke me up more than any of my other classes.  Minimal (and interesting) homework. She cares so much about her students and tries to get to know EVERYONE. Just write 3 thoughtful extras, participate in class, show your effort and you WILL get your A.

Ellen's class was unique and her way of teaching promotes thinking in different ways. There's a fair amount of writing to be done in this class, and it can be challenging, but it's a very self-reflective class. I had personal issues during the semester and Ellen was understanding about the whole situation. Attendance and participation are important

Ellen was one of the most innovative and thoughtful instructors I have ever had. She does look for effort, so be ready to demonstrate you care about class content. Her class is graded on contract, so it gives you freedom to test your creativity. She fosters a great class community with discussions every day on many different topics. 100% recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Ellen is a very nice and caring professor. She wants student to enjoy writing. Her grading is based on a grading contract and it is pretty easy to get an A in her class. There is a lot of work and reading, but they help you grow as a writing and reader.

Sign up for Ellen's class now--any of them. I hate writing and was dreading taking AWD but Ellen made this class absolutely wonderful. She fosters an environment full of freedom and flexibility. She prioritizes learning over grades. She provides a space to write because you want to, not because you're required to.

Ellen's first year writing course was structured differently than the rest at Northeastern. Each week consisted of short pieces of writing of which you will select two to turn into longer pieces. She recognizes that everyone participates differently so submitting extra writings or just paying attention counts for that part of your grade. Easy A!

She is a great teacher, she likes to push your creative brain in your writing. She has really helped me become a better writer and now I can read more pieces and books more critically and make more connections that might have previously gone right over my head.

Ellen is by far the best professor I've ever had. She likes a certain style of writing and if you can understand what she's asking for, you will be set. She won't directly tell you what it is she wants, but provides a lot of guidance and wants you to figure it out for yourself, which forces you to think critically and develop yourself as a writer.

Great teacher, seems friendly and very willing to help. She will give you good grades and credit if you work hard. You need to read a lot, and sometimes you need to dig though the instructions to find a clear prompt. But, she is very fair and willing to help. No textbook but need to do the reading.

I'm sure she would be an excellent professor in a classroom. However, taking an online class with her is very frustrating. Her instructions are unclear and every assignment requires consulting at least two documents to figure out what to do. AWD as she taught it was not helpful and it all just felt like busy work. Find another prof. for AWD online.

I took the online section with Professor Noonan, and she seems like a decent professor. The generalizable comments on rough drafts directed to the whole class are vague and not helpful, but she gives sufficient feedback at other times. There is a lot of flexibility in the course in terms of topics, writing style, and deadlines. A doable A course.
hated this class! She wants so much work and if you don't love writing it sucks. She is a nice person, but not a great teacher.

She is AWESOME ! I loved all the help she provided, I definitely suggest taking her class if you can. You will learn how to think critically and fully analyze a text. She gives you the freedom to create your own assignments but guides you through your process.

I had Ellen for 2 semesters and  I  was so happy I did. She is one of the best professors I have ever had and I encourage anyone with the passion to write or learn to take this class! If you work hard, she will reward you with a great grade. I have been truly inspired by her teaching!

She is an amazing teacher, extremely helpful, vry knowledgable. Her class is a good challenge i definatly came out learning a lot and enjoying myself. DO THE READING, and ask her for advice and help she is very assesable.
Great teacher, we had some cool conversations as a class, very funny and she can take jokes. Class was hard just because it required a lot of online homework.

It is true that the course is hard but if the student does work hard enough he/she will be able to pass this class with a good grade. I recommend this class to any student who is interested in learning the material and is prepared to work. Ellen is a great professor IF the student is willing to learn and make the best of the course. Great class!!!

Ellen is understanding and punctual. The class is small, maybe like 30 seats so there is a 1-1 opportunity so to speak. Do not go to class unprepared be prepared to do alot of reading and taking notes if you feel you cant grasp certain things that she points out. Heavy use of blackboard and POST ON TIME!
No Comments
Ellen is very helpful and is always available in her office to go over work.  The final portfolio is A LOT of work because we have to revise everything that we ever did in her class!
she wants so much work

Joke of a capstone class. Professor uses ChatGPT to generate EVERYTHING. Besides the class sides that he took from another professor, all of the assignment instructions and feedback on assignments are painfully obviously generated by AI (even quiz questions most likely are). This is an insult to the students who are paying to take this class.
He's a great guy, and if you care about the course and create an interesting product then you will be successful.

He is a great guy ignore any bad reviews. There is quite a bit of homework but its really easy and the class was a easy A as long as you did all of the work. He has pop quizzes once in a while but they are super easy. He also really gets the class to interact with each other and there was a great sense of community between us by the end of semester

Good teacher overall, kind and cares about his students. The class is a semester long project with a group that you are assigned in the first week. Pop quizzes every once in a while, HW is not that hard.

Good teacher cares about his students. Whole class is just a year long project with a group assigned at the beginning of the semester. Reading quizzes every once in a while otherwise your whole grade is made up of the group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Don't take BUSN1101. It's not required. Unless you're someone who is interested in creating your own product/startup don't take this class. Professor Elias is a nice guy but he is a pessimist. You work on one group project for the whole entire semester which is easy but no matter how good your work is he'll give you 80s on everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very good Professor, better than most of the other BUSN1101 Professors. Class was easy to get a B+ in and all of the stuff we did in class was interesting and engaging. As a person who doesnt enjoy school, I enjoyed his class.
You will learn nothing in this class with this professor. Either take the class with someone else, or better yet just don't take the class at all since it isn't required for business majors.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He sometimes confused me and my classmates with his explanations and feedback, and really liked this one kid the whole semester, and would mainly call on the guys in class. He makes the groups and won't help you with group conflict. Grades things last minute and doesn't give clear feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Just an overall horrible professor. No clear guildine and many projects we had to work on with the same group for the whole semester. All groups had 80s for projects and his feedback wasn't even helpful. Even if you try fixing something, there is always another thing wrong. Doesn't even know what he's talking about half the time, I learned nothing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Gunther didn't really teach us anything that was in the guidelines for each presentation, and also did not every clarify the instructions. This meant making presentations was just guessing at what he wanted us to do. He was a tough grader and gave harsh, and not helpful criticism too. He would routinely ask questions that were stated in the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Majority of class lecture is spent watching other people's presentations/ debates, so be prepared to have a lot of free time during class. 3 tests worth 15% each consisting of 30-45 MC, but the lowest one usually gets dropped. Exams are all based on the textbook so READ it, lots of groups projects so get comfortable with your group early.

Very invested and caring professor, class was not mandatory towards the business curriculum but I still thought it was interesting to take. Semester starts with a few pop quizzes and longer busy work assignments but then gets very manageable though the semester. Not the most important class there is but still somewhat engaging.

He's not the worse professor and definitely better than some of the other INTB 1203 professors. He doesn't give out that much work. And the work he does give out is pretty easy. All 3 exams were online and were all multiple choice. He seemed pretty disorganized but was an easy class overall.

Do not take! BAD BAD BAD :O! Not a required class and there are no clear grading criteria. One semester-long group project that pretty much determines how you do. He is also extremely harsh in grading.
amazing teacher and class
The professor is knowledgeable but every assignment outside of midterms is a group project. Lots of lecture time will be spent listening to debates from other groups. Grading is somewhat unclear.

I enjoyed the content of this class, but the professor did not do a good job of teaching it. Very kind person. lectures generally were fine, though he was rambly, but rather than focusing on lectures we had pointless debates. The final project was supposed to be worth a large portion of our grade, but he never graded it.
Don't take this class. Not required. Very hard to get a good grade. This class will not help you whatsoever. Stay away. Professor does not give any care towards this class. No clear grading as well.

A useless class where you learn nothing. You do nothing in class, but then have loads of work outside of class. One group-long semester project where barely any good feedback is given. Prof gave me a random grade at the end of the semester without even having graded the big semester project. This class is a joke.

Beware, BUSN 1101 is not a requirement for business majors, so think again before taking this class. The prof barely provides any good feedback on assignments. In class, useless assignments were completed and homework was graded harshly. Prof may seem chill, but he's not. In the end, he didn't grade half of my assignments. Don't take this class

HORRIBLE HORRIBLE HORRIBLE. Did not grade all assignments and decided on a random grade for the transcript. No feedback on projects and assignments. Supposed to be a "easy" class but will hurt your GPA. AVOID!!!!

This class is not a requirement for business majors. Basically a semester long project where you have to present the same thing three times. Received little to no feedback from the professor and he also seems like he doesn't know what he's doing most of the time.

Professor Elias needs to have better time management because half of my assignments are still not graded when the semester is over. He doesn't give anything above a 75 on homework assignments and doesn't give any feedbacks. Overall a very useless class.
Great professor
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I love Professor Elias as a person but I don't think I learned anything in this class. We did have a lot of interesting discussions but they were often unrelated to the material. This class was almost too easy as we didn't really have assignments besides 2 simple group projects. Overall, he is a very kind person and understanding.

I don't think I learned anything in this course. The professor never expanded on any of the news article readings, all of which did not explain how these factors could impact business. The class was very group project heavy. I would avoid this professor if I could. He seems nice, but he simply did not teach.
Lots of reading and a couple of group projects, decently manageable tho! Definitely do not misinterpret quietness for lack of kindness, truly a very nice professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment: Great intro class. Class are discussions which he makes interesting. Gives good feedback on the semerster-long group project.
Very nice guy but I haven't learned anything from this course and he will not help you with anything. Recommend not having this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great guy, great professor
Lots of discussion in class, lots of group projects, and only two tests that are largely based on discussion and the vocab in the book. Super nice guy and shows personality which is nice
Great guy, you learn a lot. Good structure for an intro course. He offers a lot of valuable insight and you get a bloomberg certification by the end of it.

He is an amazing professor that really cares about his students and treats them like equals. He wants you to learn as much as you can in his class and you can see that in every discussion. His class is run like a discussion so make sure you do the readings. As long as you work well in groups and put in effort, you will do well. Work slow on BMC!

She's so caring. The class is very easy to excel in if you follow her instructions. Lectures are interesting and fun and she gets to know all her students. No exam. 3 projects, 2 individual and one group. You can choose your own group. Projects are spread out over weeks so you have more than enough time to complete. Most work is discussion posts.
She is really good
She is so kind, take care of our difficulties, like some time I must delay to submit the assignment
She is a very good professor, lets you off the hook if you make an honest mistake.

Impossible not to earn an A. Very understanding and nice. Class participation is fun and engaging for students. However, could be a little more focused on the specific writing skills of each individual.
Great professor. Easy to get good grade, light homework load, respectful lecturing.
Great professor! She creates a great atmosphere in the classroom and is very fair. She is very understanding and fun! It's an easy class. Three writing projects throughout the semester, no final.
Greatest professor in the University by far. I highly recommend taking a class with her.

She is the best professor I ever met in Northeastern. Her lessons are helpful to your understanding of writing. Also, she is a very kindly professor who aware anyone's weaknesses and help them to improve.
The classes are fun and the professors are very nice

Easy class if taken in the summer, only 3 large projects and graded discussion posts (but basically graded on completion.) Feedback felt unnecessarily harsh at times, but overall a much easier class than I thought it would be. She pays very close attention to detail, so make sure that you do as well, and read all of the rubrics.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's a great professor. The class itself isn't too hard; you just have to actually understand everything and know a lot of definitions. Her final was easy too, just questions pulled from exams 1-3. Lectures are funny/engaging, and the material is interesting.

Prof. Greiner structures the course around three in-person exams with multiple-choice and open-response questions. Exam content is taken directly from the slides and study guides. The cumulative final is based on material from the previous exams, which helps with preparation. Lectures are engaging, and extra credit opportunities are available.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: i really liked this class! there is a LOT of material but she makes study guides that are pretty accurate and help a lot. the final only had one question that wasn't on a previous exam which was really nice. very interesting class!!

Dr. Greiner is an excellent professor! She's down to earth, kind, and the most knowledgeable prof I've had. You can tell she's very passionate about the field and wants her students to learn and succeed. There is a lot of material, so her classes are lecture-heavy but super interesting. Definitely use the study guides and go to her review sessions!

very passionate and knows material well. tests on paper in class (i had 500-600 flashcards for each test (3). If you work hard, you will do well. Only annoying thing was that the final was repeat qs (i get it was to pull up grades) but as someone who already had a high grade in the class, it felt like a waste of time to re-memorize old test answers
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she's very personable and flexible, i loved taking this class lowkey. grade is calculated off 3 tests, final, and attendance. lecture is engaging but there is SO MUCH material, and can be overwhelming sometimes. however the final is only made up of past test questions, so it kinda balances out. also all exams are half MCQ and half short response.

Great teacher, sets you up for success with clear lectures. Quizzes and discussion posts every week with other assorted papers, all easy As if you complete them as instructed. Very encouraging and easy-going.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Botchkovar is absolutely amazing. I adore her because not only is she intelligent, witty, and caring, but she is also a brilliant criminologist! That probably sounds forced but I just really enjoyed her teaching and I immediately liked her when the class began. I am not a general pushover so the fact that I adored her was meaningful!
She is an angel on this earth.  So accommodating to any conflicts with the class.  Tests are pretty easy and class is interesting.  Love her to death. Wish she was my grandmother.

Super sweet teacher. Cares about how you're doing in the class. Make sure to use the extra credit opportunities because the mid-term and final are worth over half of your grade. Also, make sure you try to participate in class, it goes a long way.
Took two classes with her and liked both a lot.

I am still puzzled by this teacher. She gives the impression that you're doing great and then hits you with a low grade. She is not at all specific about expectations. Her feedback on tests usually doesn't make any sense and it's like she takes points off for not dumbing down your work. As a grad student, I think we're beyond that.

She is one of the best professors I have had in my 4 years! She is excited about the subject (gender and crime). She used video clips and, while long, very interesting readings! She encourages participation and loves class discussion! Highly recommend!
Loved the class!

Tough to follow anything she's saying between thick Russian accent and condescending manner of questioning the classroom every few minutes. Mandatory attendance because of random pop quizzes. Zero discussion and class involvement. Was a very painful class and I would not recommend.

Amazing professor, interesting topics, interesting readings assigned, fair grader and tests, attendance is encouraged as there may be a pop a quiz at any time...this professor came to class with such enthusiasm every time, even brought candy a few times to encourage students to participate and get excited about the material.
Great professor! Very enthusiastic, interesting class material, straightforward tests, lots of reading, 1 project a mid-term and a final plus class participation and multiple reading respons papers

One of the best teachers at NU. Always there to help her students and truly wants everyone to do well. You can email her any question you have and she always gets back to you as fast as she can. A really nice person - definitely take one of her classes

She is very, very nice and really enjoys what she teaches.  The content is pretty interesting.  The journals are kind of a pain and heavy on the reading but you can get by without doing all of it.  She is very willing to help outside of class and really wants you to learn. Class participation is very important and there are some pop quizzes.

Professor Mann is one of the most knowledgable professors I have encountered! She is truly engaged with the material and wants her students to succeed. What a horribly, horribly rude and demeaning woman. Truly shameless about the way she talks to students in her office. Unhelpful, condescending, uninspiring.

Emily is amazing.  She is adorable and makes a lot of awkward jokes that are just really endearing.  She has so much passion for her field and made me remember that I care about people and should be doing something good in the world.  She's also an easy grader, or was for me anyway.
So much passion and she really cares about her students. It isn't a class that you dread sitting in for 100 min. like most others for myself.     Am I the only one that thinks she is a babe???

very funny during class, which help because material was a bit dry. somewhat flexible and very strict which may be difficult for freshman and sophmores. She is use to teaching graduate level social work students.

She is amazing, very passionate about what she teaches and very knowledgeable as well. The class can be a little dull at times but thats due to the nature of the class (research methods) not the professor. She makes the class  as interesting as possible. Shes awesome overall!

The best professor ever, seriously. He's so funny and is easy to talk to. Office hours are always available. Tests and quizzes are online except for final. Dr. Okeke is one of the sweetest people I have ever met! Dr. Okeke is seriously one of the sweetest professors I have ever met. The lectures can be long and sometimes you can get lost but he is more than willing to explain outside of class. Overall, Professor Okeke is a great professor. He is super nice, caring, and passionate about what he does. However, he is not the most engaging lecturer. Three tests (non-cumulative), poster project and presentation, and a few short 1 page proposal papers.

Very kind professor. He really cares about making sure you enjoy the (rather complicated) material and get something out of it. He is not focused on making you grind out difficult homework and exams. This professor really makes me rethink about class experience, even on ZOOM. Great class

If you ever have the misfortune of having this man as a professor, know that there's a much more understandable online version of his Theory of Computation course that can be accessed on Youtube taught by a professor from another university (Harry Porter). reviews.comment: He has a thick Italian accent. He gives poor feedback, and his grading scheme is harsh and unforgiving. He's obviously smart, so he probably thinks it's trivial to explain the things that don't make sense to students.

I defended my dissertation with no revisions! Committee says she is a qualitative chair with a quantitative mind, exceptionally sharp and analytically precise. Amazing Chair! She tells you how she works before accepting you, is very consistent. That said, she's very selective about who she agrees to work with. If she agrees to work with you, you're a lucky winner. The committee respects her, and having her as your chair makes everything go more smoothly.

Dr. Elias is awesome! She's such a chill, friendly, and nice doctoral chair and professor. She's super organized and keeps things consistent. Plus, she's down-to-earth and easy to talk to. With her experience, you know you're getting honest advice. I highly recommend her! She's the best!

I had the privilege of working with Dr. Elias as my doctoral professor and chair. She is an exemplary doctoral professor and dissertation chair who displays exceptional care, expertise, and dedication to her students. She fostered a supportive learning environment, provided invaluable guidance, and genuinely prioritized students' well-being.

MY CHAIR! I just love Dr. Elias, she is the kindest most understanding faculty member I have dealt with during my dissertation process. She is very easy going and provides precise directions. She is well respected by the committee and very knowledgeable about data analysis processes and coding.
Best dissertation chair. She is smart and very good with Interpretative Phenomenology and coding process in general. Good chair/ committee member, committee respects her opinion.
Excellent dissertation Chair, easy to deal with as she provides great direction, guidance and knows how to align your study.
Simone is very polite and all students adore her. I wish she could teach all Edd courses. She is a very bright professor.

Dr. Elias is an excellent professor. She is accessible, understanding and very inteligent. She has been  my favorite professor in the doctoral program and a very popular professor. She is very thorough and consistent, students trust her and want her to chair their dissertations.
Simone is intelligent, yet very humble about her knowledge. Everyone loves her and her courses are very popular. You'll learn a lot in her classes.
Simone is wicked smart, intelligent, and very patient with her students. She is a great adviser and the best prof I had at NU.
Just heard that Dr. Elias left NU I had her for a DS class and she was my friend's advisor. I can only say good things about her ways of teaching, very intelligent and happy person.
Simone is a wonderful professor. She is extremely nice, and she gives great feedback.

Friendly, happy, funny, intelligent, warm, neat, caring... gotta love this professor.  She makes everything enjoyable to work on. Super nice woman,  definitely one of the best professors that I've ever had.
She's wicked smart and my favorite professor.
She does a lot of reviewing and really makes sure you understand the material. I would highly recommend this class to everyone!
She helps you to be a better person. You learn a lot from her, she is always happy and is very organized and smart.
Simone is awesome!  3
Dynamic and happy professor - Would take again.

Mrs Eilias is a good person with a good heart to help her students to be the best they can be, she is able to get something complicate and make simple to understand- Only northeastern professor I will miss after graduation probably the only one that replies e:mails, knows y name and stops to say hi and ask how y are doing when she sees you around.
Best professor @ Northeastern.

Simone rocks- and I plan to take all my electives with her because she is a kind, smart, and happy professor that helps you learn without getting burned out- you actually use what you learn in her class in real life.

She is an A+ prof! Her syllabus can be intimidating ( 25+ pages) but the way she structures the course really makes sense at the end and I never felt overwhelmed. You need to work and meet her deadlines, but she is always willing to accommodate students and help! Highly recommend. She is the best.
SUPERB teacher!!

Simone is very approachable, intelligent and has a pleasant personality, everyone loves her.  Once you are her student she will always help you. I am not even taking Portuguese anymore bc my schedule does not allow but I often visit her.  Most organized professor I know at Northeastern.

She is phenomenal, just an excellent professor  I even don't like languages but I like her class. I like the logical manner  she presents the material and how she is always happy, it makes you want to go to class, she is very knowledgeable smart and intelligent.

Nicest and coolest professor I have ever had!! She knows how to teach portuguese and she makes good emphasis on accent. If you are willing to learn, you will certainly and easily will. TAKE THE CLASS!!
Simone is the BEST!!!!!!!
She is spectacular. I also went to her dialogue to Brazil, just amazing.

SHE IS THE BEST!!!!!!!!

She is simply the best professor at Northeastern. Period. She is a good person, very intelligent and an amazing professor. That kind of professor you will remember your whole life. I graduated and I am still in touch with her. She is happy to offer good advice and love seeing her students succeed. I highly recommend.

Simone is a very understanding professor. I had several personal challenges during the semester and she was there for me. I even felt I did not deserve it but she is so kind. She is not only the best professor at Northeastern but also the kindest person I know.  Very smart and intelligent woman too.
Best professor at Neu ! Would recommend her to anyone who wants to learn portugues!

She is organized and business-like. I am an engineering major. Tons of business and engineering majors in her classes.  Learned a lot without the stress. No bad surprises in her class she walks the talk. 5 starts.

Best professor at nu. Her class fills fast, very fast. She was kind enough to meet with me and help me to figure out what I want to do after I graduate. Great mentor. I will declare a Portuguese minor bc of her.  NU should hire more professors like her.  She goes above and beyond to help you with everything not only Portuguese.
I LOVE  her!!!!! She is awesome. Will take her again.

Simone is amazing. She is there for you, you will see that she loves what she does and it reflects on her teaching and the way she treats everyone. All grades are posted within two days. Get to know her and she will help you beyond Portuguese. She was the only professor at NU that took the time to help me succeed and to find my passion.

She helped a lot to find job and my differential after graduating was that I learned Portuguese with her.  I recommend her.  Wonderful woman, smart, and down to earth. Her class is engaging too. Take her!

I like mrs. Elias. She takes the time to get to know you and to help you. She is fun and smart. She gives tons of feedback and chances for you to do well.  She wants you to learn Portuguese and if you follow her advice you will. At the end pays off. She is a good mentor too, if you are interested in brazil she knows a lot about it.

Literally best professor I've ever had. I'm probably going to put off graduation just to minor in portuguese. She is the most inspirational awesome professor I've ever had! Take portuguese with Simone!!!
I love this teacher! She is always happy and nice. I recommend her. She goes above and beyond to help you with co ops and everything not only Portuguese. She is very kind too.
BEST PROFESSOR EVER. IF YOU WANT TO LEARN HAVE FUN AND BE WITH A NICE AND BRIGHT WOMAN TAKE THIS CLASS.
She is so nice :) She is smart and kind too. I recommend this teacher. I learned a lot with her. I will miss her classes this semester!
She is the BEST!!!!!  I like her modern teaching style. I only take Portuguese because is with her !!!!!

Simone is great, organized and fun.  Answers emails or Facebook msgs in lighting speed. I took a hybrid.You can call or text her too if you have questions. She is always smiling in a great mood, knows everyone’s names. Class goes very fast and you don’t want to leave. She usually starts with conversation and ends with music or movie. I recommend!

Love her class, adorable professor.  I took all of my electives with her. Her classes fill fast because she is a fantastic professor and  human being. She helped me not only with Portuguese, but also with job applications. She is well connected to help you to get a co-op. I can say that I am fluent in Portuguese now, and have a job because of her.

She is a lovely intelligent and smart professor. Knows her stuff. Very approachable and down to earth  type. She has high expectations for you to speak Portuguese, and provides tons of feedback. She is a great teacher, extremely helpful and fun. She will be with you all the way helping you with anything you need. She is a wonderful person as well and understands that to teach dosen't mean insert this content here and get a grade, but instead she encourages you to find your own way. SPLENDID TEACHER, DO IT!

The homework varied in length and difficulty. The recorded lectures were clear and examples were good for learning. The exams were similar to the preparations/homework, but they were very long. great techer!!! knows his stuff adn exams are okay as long as you do your studying. This is a graduate class so do not expect it to be a piece of cake.

Good explanations and in-depth lectures with well-explained practice problems. Do the homework and you'll be fine. Difficult class but his lectures make it easier. The group problems are fun but challenging, study for the quizzes and tests. Fair grader, will answer questions well.
Lectures are not that important. Very nice grader, decent workload, and nice guy.

so sweet i miss him already i took the final this morning -- class is very hard be sure u study for the quizzes every week
lectures are kind of sporadic and hard to convince yourself to go to but he's a great guy
He is amazing, best Physics professor ever. He does lots of examples in lecture to get the concepts across, which is great for Physics. He explains concepts very well.

The assessments /quizzes can be hard, but the grade distribution helps, and they curved my class grade at the end. His in class problems and slides are helpful for the weekly quizzes, and he always offered extra office hours before the midterm/final.
Moreno's class is hard but he has everything you need from the schedule and syllabus on canvas. Just pay attention to the schedule and homework to keep up and you're all set.

I loved Professor Moreno, he is super sweet and explains things well. He gives at least 4 practice exams to study from before a midterm or final, the test is always similar to those (no surprises). If you have questions, he explains problems very well.

I found there was little overlap between class examples, quiz problems, and homework problems. I never felt prepared. Unless you already know physics, you won't do well in this class.

Final Exam and Midterm hold significant weight. Great Prof and I will be taking again for Physics 2. Annotate the slides he posts and the course will be fine, posts all materials online to canvas. i had a lot of trouble understanding anything moreno said because of his accent. i'm sure if I could just understand him better, he would be an excellent teacher so I feel kinda bad giving him such a bad rating. his class was well designed and encouraged the students to collaborate which I like and piazza was really helpful as well

He is very nice and he is good at teaching. His lectures might be a little dry and his accent is very thick, but he is a good professor. He also has enough assignments to give a nice pillow to your grade if you don't do well on the final or midterm

stupid boring class. He's condescending when you try and asking questions and he's not very helpful. He does allow cheat sheets for the final and the weekly quizzes but he doesn't do much in telling you what to focus on when studying. He would also give us breaks in class but only because he was bored listening to himself

Effectively teaches material in lecture and the required homeworks/in class worksheets solidify the material. Lecture can be a bit boring but he is very helpful and learned and wants his students to succeed.

Had the class at 8 am during summer 1. I was dreading it especially since my physics 1 teacher was terrible. Moreno made the 90 minute lecture go by surprisingly fast. He teaches very clearly and if you pay attention you will do well on quizzes. Study the quizzes and you'll be fine on the final.
Professor Moreno is the best lecture professor to have. He is clear and has great handwriting. He plays music before each lecture and is funny. Plus, he has a great accent.

Moreno is an awesome teacher. I needed a lot of extra help, and he was always happy to explain anything in detail outside of lecture. He has an accent, but it doesn't impede upon your ability to understand him. The class is hard, but that's just because it's physics. :)
You will struggle if you do not know calc

very helpful guy. study an hour before the thursday quizzes and stay on top of the online hw and you're pretty much guaranteed an A... And you actually learn to apply physics in real life which is pretty effing cool! cant wait for physics 2! :D
cool dude
Great accent with a good sense of humor. Always welcomes questions and is very helpful. (:
Is willing to help you as long as you show him you are putting in effort. The class is easy as long as you do the homework.

tests are really hard (first one exactly like practice, other 2 totally different) other than that, easy to get 100s on everything. participate he will love you, he is very well connected and knowledgeable, Enio is the best, TALK TO THE TAs IF YOURE CONFUSED, there's some assignments that require rubrics you don't have access to, ask TAs about EBs

Professor Velazco overall was a great professor! His classes are discussion based so be prepared to be called on but he makes it a fun environment to participate in. Prof Velazco is super passionate and knowledgeable about supply chain. Lectures are not super helpful, but the group projects are super fun.

Prof Velazco is a super nice guy and is very passionate and knowledgeable about supply chain. His lectures aren't super helpful, and he just repeats the textbook material, so if you need good lectures, this class might not be for you. no final in the class, just three exams throughout the semester. Overall would recommend.

He is a very interesting professor with lots of cool stories and engaging lectures. He is passionate about supply chain and makes his students intrigued as well. There is a lot of work and tests are not easy. There is lots of textbook HW, multiple written assignments, 3 tests, and a project. It is a lot of work but you will learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I really like him regardless of how others may feel. He is strict but wake up people, it's an upper level college class in a tough major, it's not supposed to be a breeze. His class is a great refresher from my other classes that are just Exam 1 + Exam 2 + Final. There is a massive variety of projects, case studies, and other interesting content

He's awesome! I love that he does many things not just tests. There are many different projects and such. He also always has good stories about working as executive in the real world so it is not just lectures and textbook

Many of the reviews tell you to avoid him because of his harsh participation. However, I believe this is not the case. Professor Velazco provides ample opportunities for you to participate and is really just looking to see if you are engaging the classroom. As long as you put in an honest effort, you will do great things in this class!

Professor Velazco is a wonderful professor who spices things up with a wide variety of class activities. There are several different group projects, case studies, papers, and readings that make his class much more exciting than an average lecture heavy, textbook-only course. He is a tough grader on participation though, so speak up more!

Beware of the participation grade at the end of the year. It dropped my grade very low. For the case presentations, his rubric is unclear and he's a harsh grader. His tests were very difficult and didn't match his material. His exams were online with lockdown browser but it was still difficult and the class average was low but he didn't curve it.
I would recommend taking Enio's class. Slightly disorganized and vague in his requirements for papers and projects, but for the most part if you put in decent effort you will do well.

I was doing well in his class, which took a lot of work and effort to be consistent in, but he ruined my grade with participation. Beware you must participate throughout the semester or it will kill your grade by the end of the semester.

This class is based on 3 tests, that are not related to the LONG lectures given by the professor. All the projects are impossible to get a 100. He is passionate about the class, but his way of teaching is of the 20th century. If you want to learn with a mediocre grade take this class, if you want a good grade avoid it!

This class is hard. Everyone I know, regardless of professor would say SCHM is hard. The exams are also very difficult to get the grade you want on. Despite this, the professor is still amazing. He is very passionate and makes lectures fun. Of all the SCHM professors, I would recommend Velazco the most.

Nice guy but very difficult class. Could've gotten a B+ but the prof refused to bump my participation grade 5% despite actually participating in class. Most of your grade comes from the three huge tests that are throughout the semester which are confusing and cover content that was not gone over during class. Do not take SCHM with him.

He is a nice guy, it was his first semester at school. I learned a lot because I read all the chapters, not necessarily from the class. The major problem was that the exams were extremely confusing and hard.
The material taught in class didn't match what was on exams. It was difficult to prepare for exams given the differences between the information in the textbook/slides versus what was on the exams.

I thought all of these reviews had to be exaggerating and she couldn't actually be that bad. But no, she was worse somehow. I could have gone to sleep during class, dreamed about the Teletubbies, and still learned more than if I payed attention to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: On most days, instead of teaching us c++, solidworks, or arduino like the other professors would, she would go on these long rants no one cared about. In fact I have heard more stories of her car crashes than I have actual content for the course. Let me just say, she is a terrible teacher as she is a terrible driver. Please do not take her!

On the first day of class I arrived 1 minute late to class, only to have found professor Engelbrechten to have locked the door into the classroom shut. When I stood outside the room, The rest of the semester, she waited outside the door for me, only to shut and lock it on my face when she saw I was the slightest bit late (even by seconds).
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: What the skibidi is wrong with this class bro
The most boring professor with 0 educational skills
If students have any kind of snacks she takes them.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Kirda is a fair and good professor who cared about the course. He does warn you at the beginning of the class that you will get into trouble if you cheat so I am not surprised some people here are upset.
He is rudest prof I've ever met. He talks aggressively and does not intend to help students. He really has a difficult personality.

My grade dropped by one and a half because the system accepted my copied submission as final submission which was picked from the internet. I truly had fun solving all the assignments and put my hard work in just for this unfortunate event to happen. while my classmate who couldn't solve a single of them (whom i helped in ALL assgn.) got an A grade
He is best Professor i got in the university
Probably the best professor I've ever had. Can walk the walk and really fun lectures.
Class was fun, Engin is one of the best professors in NEU
Awesome professor.  Really will go out of his way to help students understand the material, which to me wasn't that difficult.  Exams/quizzes are really easy.
I took this class last fall and was very disappointed.

(i took engw 1114 but it wasn't a reviewable option.) super kind professor. if you overslept and missed lecture 3-4 times she'll be chill about it just dont do it too often. as long as you're following the rubric and not chatgpt-ing everything you'll get an A. my volunteer org ghosted us and she genuinely let me slander them for my final project.

I took advanced writing online with her while on co-op and it was easier than I thought. Do the assignments and you will be fine. She gives feedback and ample time to adjust your pieces to meet her feedback. She has specific things she is looking for and they are outlined in the rubric and syllabus.

Very unprofessional and rude. The content was fine and course work was very manageable, but it was her attitude that should keep you away. She was condescending and as the other ratings claimed, very biased (which of course she would apply to her grading and "feedback"). Don't take her class. You won't be able to tolerate her snarky comments.

professor enos was a very excited professor and showed enthusiasm in all classes. There were lots of assignments but they made sense and were striaghtforward not complicated works. During class we had good discussions but at times it felt like we could have finished class alot earlier. slightly a harsh grader but gives lots of feedback to improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: stay far away from this professor for advanced writing, grades based on style and is quite rude. her feedback really is something, completely useless. once you take her feedback and revise based on it, she changes her mind when grading. there's no way she isnt trolling
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Advanced writing classes do 3 essays at most and this one does 4. The teacher seems super passionate to a fault. She  made us build up to a large research paper that won't be seen elsewhere. If your writing doesn't fit her style, she takes points off because she doesn't bother understanding  your writing. Somehow takes points off for everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I think she does a great job at making deadlines but I do think if your paper does not agree with your own personal ideas then she will downgrade you for that. To me that shows she is not a prof. that takes things holistically and has a very skewed way of thinking.
Very caring professor and gave us a lot of good feedback for each paper. Grades pretty generously if you put in the effort. Would recommend for first year writing.

Prof Enos is super nice and gives lots of feedback before final drafts are due. She made sure the whole class became comfortable with each other through lots of peer reviewing. We picked a topic and wrote about it the whole semester. If you incorporate her feedback and submit on time, you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Enos was a great professor who clearly cared a lot about her class. However, she would sometimes make sarcastic comments during class that were out of pocket. Regardless, her class went smoothly, and I would recommend her if you want to get through first-year writing with an "easy" A.
Professor Enos is a great teacher. Her class is easy to pass as long as you due your work on time and have good writing and analytic skills. She also keeps the class environment fun to learn.
A very understanding teacher! I would definitely take this class again with her.

Professor Enos is extremely fair. She gives you a lot of feedback on your rough drafts which almost guarantees you an A if you spend enough time on your essays. She also lets you pick a topic you are passionate about for the entire sesmter!

She's a nice lady who puts lots of effort into providing feedback into everyone's drafts and is very available for assistance outside of class. She includes lots of peer review in the course, which is really helpful. Could be a little less biased at times during discussions, but overall a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: "depends if you fit her style" are words you never want to read when you're looking for an English professor (an already subjective subject). Enos is the epitome of a liberal prof who believes there can only be one set of opinions - are hers aren't even the ones that take fact into account
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Enos is very passionate about teaching this course. She's funny and likes to create real connections with her students. However, her grading criteria is a little all over the place, so even if your writing is good you might not get a good grade - depends if you fit her style. Send your drafts to her before the finals are due!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr. Christen Enos is amazing. One of the best professors I've ever had and she's super cool and fun and makes class so exciting. I looked forward to going to class. I learned a ton from her, and am sad I won't be having another class with her (Bio major!). Take her! It's a really easy class, a lot of work due to projects but extremely manageable.

Professor Enos is a very nice professor. Her classes are so enjoyable to be in, but she's a tough grader. The classes are mostly for peer reviews which to some extent is helpful, but you are mostly on your own. If you are struggling with your grade for English, you should make an appointment at the Writing Center as it a very helpful resource.

One of the signs of a good English teacher is a level of unbiasedness, this professor lacks that. If you write on a topic that she disagrees with in any manor, you'll do worse then your peers and given her level feedback (it's low) you won't even know why. Don't fall for the 'nice' facade she puts on.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Enos is just great. Cute lady with a sense of humor, and she offers plenty of tips for your writing. The class was a bit of a joke, but she always made it enjoyable to show up to.
she is a very kind professor, she helps me a lot, but attendance is very important,be careful. it's not very hard ,you can take it

She's nice, humorous at times, and sometimes lets you out of class early. She's not a particularly easy grader but I got my A because she improves your writing so much through her feedback on your essays and advices in class. Be prepared to pay attention in class as she makes everybody speak in discussions.

Christen's the only teacher I've had so far where I feel she really puts time into everyone's essays.  As a comedy writing teacher, she gives really detailed analysis of your rough drafts, and really wants to help you write better. You get out what you put in, but the more your participate and are thoughtful, the more she'll appreciate your writing
A really nice person, but I didn't learn anything from her.
She's likeable and very helpful.  The comedy writing class makes the freshman writing requirement a little less painful, but doing so many essays is a major drag.
very good and helpful teacher
this was an extremely fun class. i had the comedy college writing course and it was the best english class ive ever had, and i hate english.
i took the comedy course of freshman college writing and it was really fun. i liked her as a teacher. shes fun
She's very understandable!

Professor Mingolla is an amazing person. You should be prepared to put in the work in his class. Lots of material and a fair amount of writing, but the majority of class time is devoted to answering questions and it is expected that you won't understand everything. The course is less about the material and more about self-improvement.

Dr. Mingolla is amazing! I definitely recommend this course. He is such a wonderful professor and cares about the students as well. The content can be difficult at times, but as long as you are willing to put in the work, you will do perfectly fine in the course.

*Actually took 3310

Best prof I have had the pleasure of learning from at Northeastern. Would encourage everyone to take this class if possible. 

Would not say this class is an "Easy A" in the sense that there are easy tests or w/e, but if you're down to learn something new, participate a bit, and put effort into your 1pg/wk journals it'll work.

Prof. Mingolla is one of the best professors I have interacted with. I took the "Your Eye & AI" option and the class covered some pretty interesting content. The only homework is a weekly journal. The structure of the class uses a gradeless approach where he leaves comments on assignments and you meet with him to debate what grade you deserve.

Dr. Mingolla is amazing! He is very understanding and allows you to "grade yourself" at the end of the semester. The course is meant to be conceptually difficult, as the main way he evaluates you are through journal responses that are essentially reflections on the coursework. You do have to read some material outside of class, though.

Dr. Mingolla is awesome! I took his class in an area is wasn't familiar with and I didn't end up loving it, but the class was still great. Grades-wise, it is very easy to do well in his class as long as you stay engaged as he grades holistically rather than based on tests/quizzes. He's super supportive and formats class in a very engaging way.

Awesome professor! He really made topics interesting even if you had no background in the concepts. I appreciated how open he was to questions and how he structured the class based on what we, the students, were curious about. I learned a lot in his class that I still think about to this day!

Dr. Mingolla was absolutely amazing! He cared about all of his students and went above and beyond to help us succeed. The class was "gradeless" and this made it much easier to focus on the material. He understands that the material is difficult and that we will not understand it all. He cares more about us learning and pursuing our interests!

Mingolla's material is challenging, but there are no tests or quizzes so it's not stressful. The only work in the class is weekly journal entries and a final project. The class is "gradeless" and you ultimately choose your final grade. I really enjoyed how much this class made me think and Mingolla has great personality.
The material is challenging, but he is genuinely passionate about it which helps a lot. He puts in extra effort to make sure students have the best learning experience possible.
Very helpful and understanding. He gives you tough material, but puts no pressure for you to need to understand it completely on the first try, he will talk with you until you do. Fantastic!

Very kind & witty. I had him for an honors inquiry course and he doesnt give you all the answers and expects you to work to reach your own. He tried very hard to himself accessible to the class and to get the class to participate even in a virtual setting. Material is hard but I think the amount of work is appropriate given no tests or quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: By far one of the best professors I have ever had. He really cares about his students and will go above and beyond to see them succeed in his class. The material is hard to understand at first but becomes easier as you get farther along in the course. I would recommend Dr. Mingolla without a doubt.

One of the most incredible professors I've ever taken at Northeastern. Not only is Professor Engen an excellent lecturer but he's passionate and that passion transfers over to his students. His assignments are manageable but definitely take loads and loads of hard work - he does try to make the content relatable though which is fun. Greatest guy
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy
