reviews.comment: OMG, when I took this class a few years ago, it was so hard and I was frustrated with all the work. But I'm so glad now because I really learned a ton and it's been very valuable in my job.

The lecture material is interesting and he is a good teacher. Outside of class, this is a total nightmare. Do not take this course unless it is a requirement. He told us he wants wants us to spend 1-2 hours on his homework per day and boy did he mean it. So much busy work and  you basically have to teach yourself to use the software. Nightmare.
Protein Chem is hard! but Professor Engen really teaches.  You cannot get out of this class without learning a lot.  Don't get behind in the reading or you will be dead.

Protein Chemistry was the best class I've taken at Northeastern and Prof Engen is one of the best professors.  If you have a chance, take a class from him - but get ready to learn something and to work for it.

Professor Engen's Protein Chemistry course was absolutely amazing. He covers a huge amount of material. All the tests are take-home, but dont be fooled, they are all hard as hell (avg grade ~70. It also helps that he is an amazingly attractive and personable man. If you like nerdy and sexy scientists...you'll love him.
He is very compreshensive in his teaching methods. You really learn alot not just memorize for tests. I highly recommend taking a class with him.
great guy. really cool

Amazing professor who genuinely cares about his students. Such a cool teacher and funny a lot of the time. He's enthusiastic about the course he teaches and is very knowledgeable. It's almost impossible to go wrong in his class (or get a bad grade) unless you aren't doing anything or putting in the effort. He actually wants students to have a life.

I took this class asynchronously and thoroughly enjoyed both him and the lecture material. He recorded his lectures and I'd watch them weekly, taking notes. Then, at the end of each week or so there were quizzes on the lecture material for that week, which were very straight forward if you paid attention to & took notes during the lectures. Loved!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Epstein is a cool teacher. His stories about traveling and his research is always great to hear. Lectures themselves can get monotonous at times, but you can't expect every little thing about microbes to be super exciting. His research is amazing(look it up) He could be teaching anyone, but he chose to teach freshman. And I think that says a lot.

Really interesting guy. The lectures are really cool when he starts talking about his own work and experiences... he's lived with uncontacted tribes in the Amazon and invented cutting edge biotechnologies. The grading was clear. Pretty much you had to memorize the powerpoints to get a decent grade.  He's a little confusing, but it works in the end.

Slava is an amazing biologist and has amazing experience in the field. There was not a lot of room to mess up in this class, and there wasn't any extra credit aside from one question on both the midterm and final. His lectures can be dense and difficult but overall he really knows what he's talking about and posts the slides online to review.

Passionate and well prepared for class. Homework's will prepare you well for tests and exams but you must do the reading. The professor is very flexible if you communicate with him before hand and is extremely nice. There are lots of small and big group projects but the professor will give detailed and valuable feedback when those happen.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very smart and well organized professor. Fair grader and manageable amount of work. Highly recommend

Professor Rixey is hands down the best professor I have ever gotten. He is caring, sweet and makes sure that everyone is heard. Attendance is graded but you can skip class if you have a valid reason and let him know. The class is homework heavy with up to 3+ hours of work a week but its all pretty easy stuff. AMAZING TEACHER WOULD RECOMMEND!!!

Professor Gerber is one of the best professors I've ever had on the DS track. He taught his classes very well and explained some of the toughest ML concepts so clearly that I didn't really need to do much studying outside of class. Make sure to attend the lectures, he takes time to answers questions. Showing up does most of the work for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Took ds4420 w/ gerber, NOT EASY, we did unfortunately have both a final and a final project, but he graded fair, was actually pretty lenient on the final exam(deserved a 30 and got a 75), and overall a great lecturer. Also provides study materials, slides nicely organized, everything posted in canvas, and excessive amounts of ec on hw&labs.
GOAT! His lectures are extremely useful for the homeworks and is overall a very nice professor.
Really good professor. I really liked the way he teaches and he cares about students as well.
Dr. Eric Gerber is cares about students. If you can go to his each lecture, I believe you can get an A and don't worry about the final.
he is caring students! don't worry about his DS4420, just follow his each lecture then you will be good in the final exam!
shoutout gerber

Professor Gerber is one of the most dedicated and passionate professors I've had at Northeastern University. Each lecture & its respective material are meticulously thought-out and display the high level of knowledge that he possesses. I also very much appreciate the subtle jokes/wits he throws into the lectures. Great guy, great class.

Gerb is an outstanding professor. Ive never seen a prof put more time and effort into planning out lectures. 

He chooses super fun data to work with: Penguins, Sports, and even Overwatch. 

He was able to immediately give a fantastic answer to every question he was asked during class, clearly knows his stuff.

Bonus points for being adorable.

Lectures are not always the most engaging and quizzes and exams are quite difficult. He is also a bit of a tough grader. He says attendance isn't mandatory but it basically is, so show up and participate and he will like you. He does also try to give a few questions before exams and throw students a bone sometimes but not an easy A by any means
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is very cooperative and helpful with feedback. Gives extra credit; the "pop-quizzes" are announced/heavily hinted at and the first quiz is basically group work so everyone gets an A. Overall highly recommend taking this class.

I clearly remember checking his rating before the start of fall semester and a 2.5 scared the s**t out of me but he is actually great! The exams are tough and solely based on lectures/detailed PowerPoints (no point in cheating). He is very lenient and cooperative, gives extra credit and actually wants everyone to do well.
Super interactive professor. He's lenient and gracious. Since it's an intro class, it's easy and very manageable.

As of recenlty, he changed so much of his teaching style. Tons of work and complicated readings. Was looking forward to take this class but ended up being stressed out than my other classes that I was expecting to be more difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Perfect teacher for an easy class. I need this class to take as little time as possible and I genuinely spent like 20-30 hours total the whole semester on the class. One project was like 10 hours over a weekend. I had 2 weeks to do it but I procrastinated.

I took ENGW3302. My favorite English class I've taken at Northeastern. We used Discord as the homepage which made discussions feel a lot more fluid. Homework was atypical of an English class, no traditional essays. There were 3 group projects that were a majority of your grade. They were not difficult and rather interesting. Highly recommend

I really hate writing, but I honestly had a great time in Eric's class. I took ENGW3302 35000 Advanced Writing in Tech Prof with him asynchronously. He's an understanding guy and super friendly. Everyone I talked to really liked him. There isn't a ton of traditional essay writing and he will give you a good grade as long as you put the work in.

Eric's the Man! Very down to earth guy who just wants his students to enjoy writing and learn through their enjoyment. The whole class was very relaxed and he gives you so much freedom for creativity. You will do a fair bit of writing but it's not through essays, it's through blog posts and letters mostly. A lot of discussion in class, makes it fun

Eric is easily my favorite English teacher I've ever had. The class does have a writing aspect to it, but whether your writing is incredible or could use a ton of work, you will really benefit from his course. He's not a harsh grader, he just cares about you trying your best and gives genuine feedback on how you can improve. Would 1000% recommend!
I loved his class. I usually hate English class but he makes an 8am fun. I 10/10 recommend him. He's so chill and down to Earth and always ready to help students.
I love this class. I have professor Marshall for First-Year Writing at 8am, and I'm always looking forward to going. Class is super easy and professor Marshall is super chill.
best of the best
love her !!!! miss her now that I'm not in her class this semester :'(
very generous grading, and easily explains the readings from the seminar during our recitation time

gokcen is the best design recitation professor there is. she cares deeply about her students, reminding them frequently to drink water so they can achieve their greatest hydrated potential. she has a good artistic vision, however she is not always the most competent when it comes to technology. overall i can't wait to take more classes from her.

Super funny dude. His lectures are pretty information-heavy, so best to make sure to attend class. Sometimes it was a little difficult to gauge what information was important and what wasn't. Very helpful outside of class and makes sure you are prepared for the tests. Would recommend!

Really amazing professor. He would make class entertaining by cracking jokes and doing in-class experiments. Sat in front and looked forward to coming into this class everyday. He focused on practical applications that are helpful in industry. Super knowledgeable, funny, and one of my favorite professors. I would love to take a class of his again.

Took Randy's Soft Matter grad class. Was very insistent on applying the theories to practical use and it was really fun to be part of that. Super nice guy and understanding when you'd let him know about any problems with the course. He really loved the classroom interaction and you could see that it hurt him to lose that to the COVID situation.

Randy is a great guy and really knows his stuff. Was great when in-person and online. Made a effort to help people and have clear grading criteria so that you were set up to succeed. Tests were oddly specific so if you didnt specifically say something in your answers, it was wrong. However, peeps you and wants you to succeed. Brilliant guy
No reason to bomb this. It's not easy and it's boring af ,but he offers a lot of support and chances to boost your grade. He's chill
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Good professor. Not an easy A course. But He's helpful, so there's no reason to do badly.

Honestly the best professor I've had so far. He was very clear and very helpful. The tests and homework assignments aren't easy but if you pay attention and let him know when you're struggling you'll do fine.
Knows his stuff. Lots of extra credit and he draws cartoons on his lecture slides Keep up with the work and you'll do fine. Cute too

I don't enjoy material science, but he manages to make the class entertaining. It's obvious that he's really into the material. He also cares a lot about his students and gives many opportunities for extra help. He's also kinda quirky and silly, which makes things fun.  Side note, he's really, really attractive. *swoon*

Professor Erb is the most proactive I have ever seen when it comes to adjusting his teaching style to help students when he sees we are struggling. He could be more engaging, but in terms of a professor committed to doing his job well and to being available for students, I couldn't ask for anything better.
Northeastern's greatest professor. If you haven't taken her then youre missing out. Thats it.

The best professor I've had at Northeastern - she's a real gem. You can tell she loves CMB and she explains things really well. She's also super nice and helpful when you ask her questions (some profs can be a little condescending or don't always explain things very well). Highly recommend!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's so kind and caring of her students. Her enthusiasm for bio makes the lectures more interesting. She really prepares you for the exams by providing study guide questions and practice exams; grading for the exams is also fair. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Shes an amazingly professor. Her lectures are engaging and the coursework is very meaningful. But she cant keep track of time!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really loves the topic and it shows. So long as you go to class you'll do fine. Most of the grading is the exams but she's a fair grader. All around a smart and kind professor and scientist.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The best teacher I e ever had! She is extremely helpful. Her lectures provide you with great notes and reflect her exams. She also gives you past exams as study tools. She wants you to succeed and understand her subject. Honestly take her if you can she's amazing and extremely helpful! I wish all teachers could be like her.

Dr. Cram was by far the best professor I have had during my 3 years at Northeastern. She made the class fun, applied real life concepts, and always had a great attitude. Clicker points during lectures were an easy grade booster and made the lectures interactive which made paying attention easier. Her exams were fair, and helpful in office hours.
Very enthusiastic. Keeps it simple but ensures that she conveys everything that she wanted to. Not too taxing.Would love to take another of Erin's classes

Cram is so genuinely nice, and really wants you to do well. She dumbs down the information and holds your hand through the class. Seriously, on several occasions I felt like I was back in Kindergarden. The lab for this class is horrendous, but her lecture is excellent.

Relatively easy class. Prof. Cram knows all about topics relating to her research - meaning some other topics difficult for her to teach. Overall a good class, however the lab is another story with a couple of long scientific papers to write.

I loved Cram. Some people complained that she just reads off the slides, but I liked going to lecture and thought she did a good job organizing the material. I could tell she really knows her stuff and loves genetics. Just know everything in the slides and on the practice exam and you'll do well.
Pretty easy to understand. Powerpoints give most of the information that you need to know so it is easy to catch up if you miss class.

A little different teaching style.  You will have to write a couple short papers and read some literature.  We gave a presentation as well.  Overall it was pretty good though, exams are hard but fair.  I would recommend taking this class with her the other proffesors arent that great compared to her.
No Comments
If you are looking to be a geneticist and get your bases in this class... you probably won't.  Cram is very easily flustered, but she means well...
Very good and engaging professor, and will provide a lot with extra recordings of lectures, extra problem sets with answers included. Homeworks will take time, but prepare very well for the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lovely professor. Enthusiastic lecturer. Class was relatively straightforward and he was very clear on what we were going to be tested on and what shows up in exams. Tries a lot to help his students, very accessible at office hours and will be fair in terms of grading.

Other than 4 homeworks, the assignments and quizzes are extremely easy. He teaches you in a very practical manner. He also has a really cool group project at the end which he grades very fairly. Very funny and gives great feedback. Also gets many data scientists to the class throughout the semester for us to interact with and ask them questions.

Professor Eskew was really confusing and would often skip back and forth between topics. Sometimes, he would talk for ten minutes before saying he was incorrect or had been misleading. It was very frustrating to take lecture notes. I relied on the book heavily. He gives extra-credit, but doesn't say how much they will be worth until the end.

Very knowledgable on the subject but doesn't communicate info clearly at ALL. Goes far into detail during lecture. It's impossible to distinguish what is testable material without a study guide for exams. I often wonder if I completely missed a prereq for this course. I'll take nothing away from this course besides an unreasonable amount of stress.

I was panicking because Statistics is a required course.. and I was scared because math has never been a strong point of mine.Well, Prof Eskew really used a wonderful approach... giving us as much help as we needed to grasp the material.  He really saved the course for me.. and, I learned quite a lot of Statistics!
You need to do your homework if stats is not your thing but Rhea Eskew is awesome at making sense of what is a very confussing subject.  Very nice guy.
One of the harder psych classes, but still pretty easy. I had no problem with his tests.
terrible teacher, never had an answer to your questions. he would just reword your question and ask it again.  Also his tests were hard and unfair, he doesn't try to help you.
Knows his stuff. Tests are hard and a little unfair, but you'll learn a lot. Also, this class is more optometry thah Sensation + Perception. You won't learn anything about touch, taste.
Totally awesome.
Nice guy, but I hated these classes. Stat 1 I got a B and understood it fairly well. Stat 2? Forget it. LOL
my absolute favorite teacher ever at NU, was my advisor too--he kicks ass
Hard Class. Hard Tests. Alot of reading. Good teacher though but should make work load lighter.

He makes statistics easy and interesting by applying it to real-life situations.  He makes you see how you can actually use the knowledge you gain in this class.  His homework assignments are limited and extremely helpful to study for the quizzes with.
Not an easy class b/c it's very scientific.  He hands out a study guide before the 2 tests & final.  Hard to follow his lectures and take notes
Very great professor, I will definitely take this class again, If you see this professor on your list, just go for it, you wont regret this journey in your entire life.
She's PERFECT
Classes are comfortable and teacher provides a lot of support whenever you need it

I love prof. Espina so much! She is super friendly, responsible and gave us many opportunities to fix our mistakes. If you communicate with her about any special circumstance, she will understand. And she is always full of enthusiasm and smiles in every lesson. Every assignment comes with detailed feedback and suggestions! Take her class!

She is really friendly, and aspect to every student's thoughts and points. She responses really quickly when you have any questions during email. This class gives me a place to write about my own thoughts and interesting topic. The activities in the classes are good, and helpful for writing. Really want to take her classes again.

Dr. Espina is definitely one of my favorite professors. She is very enthusiastic and understanding of your situations as long as you communicate them with her. The workload is manageable, not too easy but not absolutely terrible either.

Dr. Tabitha Espina smiles at us every day in every class. She is energetic and enthusiastic with our class and provides us with useful feedbacks. Fun activities are planned for classes to help us engage. The class is a little bit of homework intense - four essays a semester for first-year second language speakers, but she's offering a lot of help.
Knowledgeable about what she does

She is tough, but she really cares. I took her for Personal Skill Development where she taught a lot. She was a little unavailable, so you have to ask for time in advance. She expects a lot, but she will give a lot in return. She has great application, co-op, resume, etc. tips and is a great resource.

Wow! Esther is tough, but is also kind. Found it interesting that some students gave her a poor evaluation. She is one of the best professors at Northeastern. Esther is fair and honest, and works harder than anyone I know. If you are in her class, you will work hard, but learn a lot too.

Ms. Chewning is a great co-op advisor, but not a great one credit teacher. She tends to require more work than any other co-op class, and takes it extremely seriously. She is definitely one of those one credit profs that likes to teach it like a four credit. Make sure not to let the final paper sneak up on you, the readings are actually mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: OKKK so she does care about her students and wants to know them better but puts in no effort to actually help them. she is absolutely the most pathetic coop advisor you can get. Not very accessible and also requires you to write unnecessary papers. If you want to MISS OUT on your job applications to your DREAM companies ... GO AHEAD and take her!

Objective is to prep students for their first professional job. Esther is awesome she really wants what's best for you and tries to get to know you so she can help you on your search.  A lot of Work to be done in this class but it's to help you figure out the path you want to take and not regret it later. You get what you put in, highly recommend.

Although I think only half of the lectures are useful, it's a required class to go on co-op, and Esther is honestly a great person who cares about her students. There is some work to do but it's really easy, and as long as you show up to class and turn in everything on time you're find. She's a great co-op coordinator who teaches and helps a lot.

Hard class and sometimes he forgets to teach, but really does care about his students. Offers test retakes which is nice. However, his additional office hour he treats as a fourth class, which is very disadvantageous for those with other conflicts at that time.

Very very smart guy. Sometimes his lectures can be a bit confusing and he moves very fast. However, he genuinely cares about each of his students and will allow test retakes/replacements. Gives good tips and shortcuts at office hours, and rewards effort with grades. Smart, caring guy that made me enjoy math a lot more.

I genuinely do understand some of the negative reviews here, grading of this class is a little bit of a black box. However, he truly goes above and beyond to help you succeed if you put in a tiny bit of effort. I also found his lectures engaging and very helpful, which is not easy to do for linear algebra. Take his class if you are going to show up

He was a tough grader, but he cares about students and offers extra credit a lot. Go to class, but you will  have to teach yourself everything. Impossible to reach him outside of class. Holds review sessions before exams. Just choose another prof, he tries to give extra points where he can so everyone can succeed, but really not worth the trouble

Prof. Esole is a good guy, but he isn't a great professor. He's a touch grader, and never updates Canvas. He forgets to hold office hours that he mentions in class and is really hard to get in touch with, but he will hold additional review sessions before an exam. DON'T MISS CLASS, even though you'll have to teach yourself everything anyways.

He takes off an unreasonable amount of points on tests, but give extra credit opportunities throughout the semester. However, it's basically impossible to reach him and he always says he will post stuff on canvas and never does. One good thing is he gives a lot of practice material for the exams, but just won't post answers.

Takes off an absurd amount of points on tests. He just looks at the answer and marks it wrong if it's wrong. There is no partial credit. For a question with multiple parts, if you get the first part wrong then you get the entire question wrong. Prof Esole also cannot teach, his teaching is very scattered and it's hard to follow along.

Prof Esole is a nice guy and gives extra credit and allows you to retake quizzes. Your grade will improve if he sees progress and improvement. However, he's such a bad lecturer and takes an unreasonable amount off points off on tests. He's also very careless and always makes mistakes, including calculating test grades.

Super disorganized and hard to understand. Constantly making mistakes and doesn't provide answers to practice tests on Canvas because he claims that "it would be unfair to students actually showing up to class". Hard to contact outside of class. He's just all over the place and literally the worst professor I've ever had. DO NOT TAKE HIM.

Prof Esole is very disorganized and forgets to teach us many topics. He posts practice exams but I don't even know how to approach half the questions because he hasn't given us such examples. He doesn't even give answers so it's very hard to study. He doesn't respond to emails, is hard to get ahold of, and doesn't show up to his own office hours.

Esole is one of the kindest professors out there. While his teaching is incredibly disorganized and his scheduling is unpredictable, he is very lenient with grades and gives many opportunities to raise your grade/redo an exam. Fair warning he forgets to teach some topics but if you go to office hours and ask him about it he will go over it.

Professor does not use Canvas at all. He repetitively says he will post material but will not until right before the exam. He was kind and helpful if you went to office hours. However he completely mislead the class about what would be the content of the final exam. Do not take this class if you don't want to go to office hours at 7pm.

Prof Esole does not explain concepts well. He is very disorganized; says he will post exam practice and does not. He doesn't teach thoroughly during class time and holds meetings outside of class that he claims are essentially mandatory because of this. He often acts like he's taught stuff that he hasn't. He's kind, but not worth the suffering.

He has no helpful canvas and has awful lectures he also does not answer questions when asked and does not show up to office hours. His office hours are also not accessible in the first place and he lies a lot about various things, he also does not put any grades anywhere.

The goat. Lectures are confusing, and he will often make mistakes in computations. However, the office hours are literally a godsend. I can somehow not understand anything in one lecture, but suddenly know everything after attending office hours. Very funny guy and does want his students to succeed. He let us retake quizzes infinitely.

Prof Esole is the man! He held review sessions way outside of working hours (7pm the night before the exam) and is very compassionate. He wants you to succeed and cares that you put in effort. You can retake quizzes as much as needed, and the exams can be tricky but you know what's on them. If you put in effort, you'll succeed.
All I can say is that his teaching style does not suit me.

Professor didn't like actually doing the problems on the board in a math class, so you were almost always confused; solutions he did write down had a 50% chance of being wrong. Went over concepts one time and expected us to be masters. Takes off absurd amounts of points on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Can't understand what he is saying. Super confusing.

He is very passionate about the topic but the way he teaches can be very scattered at times and you can get lost easily. He is nearly impossible to access outside of class and does not know how to use Canvas. You get your grades back way after you take a test. The good side is that as long as he sees improvement he will raise your grade.

Very clear lectures. He recommended reading the book, but you can just survive following the lectures. He talks about the history of the subject and gives a lot of examples. He wants his students to be successful and will do the extra mile to make you are ready for the exam. On top of his work in math, he does a lot of inspiring nonprofit work.

Does not know how to use canvas. Received no homework answers and in-class lectures were messy and jumped all over the place. My high school math professors were better. Save yourself time and effort and do not take this class. You wont get exams or your grades back until its too late.

This professor is so smart and he clearly cares about the subject matter but he was awful as a teacher this last semester. He was extremely disorganized and didn't know how to use Canvas, so it was confusing when quizzes were or what our grades were the entire time. Material wasn't too hard but his lack of organization made this my worst class.

Easily one of the worst professors I've ever had. Lectures were extremely unclear and jumped around a lot, leaving me with no understanding of the course material. Was extremely terrible about grading, either taking months to return tests and quizzes or not doing so at all. 18 out of 30 students initially enrolled dropped; they were the lucky ones.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I had him for calc1 during my first semester at Northeastern. If you find math difficult this professor really helps you to improve and always makes you feel that you have someone to turn to if you have any problems with the material covered! I would definitely recommend taking his class and any other classes with him! His chats are the best!

During the first classes, the professor went straight to the point but as we advanced through the semester he became closer to us and more understanding. He has helped me to achieve things that I would have never expected even If I wasn't always being the best part of myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof Fenton is obviously passionate about sociology. However, lecture slides weren't clear, and she doesn't post them anywhere, so if you don't go to class get notes from someone else, as all of the exams were based on class discussions. The weekly essays were harder than the exams. Really helpful if you see her outside of class!

prof fenton was super cool. really fun class to go to. we discussed a lot, and instead of a text book she had us read 3 books by sociologists, a few of which were really interesting. don't have to show up all the time, although i'd encourage it. tests are written short response and definitely require examples from class discussions/lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great teacher, do the readings and talk to her outside of class and you will do well.  You need to do reading for all of her classes but at least they are thought provoking.  I really love when a teacher is truly inspired by her topic.  Her expertise shows through.

This instructor loves talking. She gets off topic sooo easily that you will get annoyed sometimes. She loves to talk about her family and friends. Her class seemed easy before I signed up, but I realized that you really need to be interested in sociological perspectives. Her exam can be difficult but make sure you do all the readings.
very good teacher but homework is brutal
Great professor, really interesting lectures and super clear passion for the topic. Heavy workload class, but expected for a graduate school class. Overall, a great guy too.
Great lectures, but HWs are very hard

I feel like much of the hate towards Prof Kim is cuz people don't want to put in the work. She is one of the sweetest and best professors I've ever had. She pushes you to your highest potential and is extremely intelligent and inspiring. Readings are long and dense but I feel that she prioritizes how much you learn over grades. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: AVOID HER. She's the worst. she started class with a list from"the literary canon"aka a list of books SHE made up on the spot and was missing major works), then said if we didnt recognize 3 of the books we were in the wrong major and should switch now. Ontop of that said we should miss no classes and its unfortunate the school gives us 2 freedays.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I don't understand where all of this hate for Professor Kim is coming from. Her classes are definitely heavy on course material, but not for no reason. Not only does she encourage us to think more critically by assisting us in how to engage with the text itself, but she is not shy in complimenting you during office hours and email correspondences!

I found Professor Kim's class very unpleasant. We never ended up really learning the material we were there to learn. Classes were spent in conversations on our own then returning to the group to share and people are frequently told that the things they are interested in sharing are wrong. My opinion wasn't respected by the professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Old reviews of Professor Kim are totally not my experience with her. She does assign a lot of reading, and expects engagement with it, she is one of my favorite professors. Professor Kim is a wealth of knowledge, her class asks you to think critically about everything. She is very approachable and intelligent. I highly recommend taking her classes.

Prof. Kim is extremely cold and rude to students. She assigns whole books for class, and then decides when you show up that she's not planning to talk about them and you just wasted hours reading. She offers opportunities to ask for help, then punishes people when they do. Definitely one of the worst class experiences I've had in a very long time.

This was a tough class, but the material we covered was so eye-opening that it hardly mattered. I will say Professor Kim definitely created a hierarchy in class, so you could tell who she thought the best students were, which wasn't great. Will absolutely push you to think about materials more critically.

Miserable, angry, and cruel to students. Obviously doesn't like teaching. Gives writing assignments but never gives feedback, instructions are super unclear so you end up reading three books when you were only supposed to read one. Don't be fooled by the older reviews--this is clearly not the same person. This professor has mentally checked out.
One of the worst professors I've ever had. Don't feel like I learned anything, professor took weeks to respond to emails and was rude to students. Avoid at all costs
Genuinely inspiring, one of the best Professors I've ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Professor Kim possess an extremely interesting mind. While her approach to class can be a bit chaotic, the true value comes from her office hours. Her feedback is more fruitful when you speak to her in person and you'll easily find yourself delving deep into discussion.

Her choice in material for my Tech and Empire class was amazing, I learned a lot and it was so much fun. The class was very text heavy, and was round table based. Each student led a class discussion for about a 2 hour block throughout the semester. Your participation matters each week! Prof Kim is very kind and respectful and will help you succeed

I really enjoy Professor Kim's class. She takes her teaching very seriously and wants to engage her students in their work inside as well as outside of the classroom. Be prepared to take field trips to see visiting authors and attend lectures of interesting contemporary writers and poets!

While the writing prompts were a little basic for me, I had a great time in her class, and for someone just starting to get serious about poetry, this is a good pick! Professor Kim makes her classroom a really warm, supportive space and tries to put the art above the class structure. It's obvious that she really wants students to leave as poets.

He never understands where his lectures are going, and makes up answers on the fly. His projects are based on nothing relevant to the class, and the class relied on our TA to get through the course. Even the TA seemed confused when he promised to talk to Gene for us. No syllabus or reference to our textbook, despite being asked to buy it.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lectures are rambling and utterly incoherent; he has no idea where his thoughts start and end. Seems like an intelligent and nice person but not a good instructor. He'll tell you that you need to study the material heavily outside of class, but it's not because the material is obscenely challenging, it's because he is useless as a lecturer.
Unorganized, unclear, vindictive. Easily the worst professor I have had at this university.
If you need help, he even has office hours during the weekend.  This is a chem. grad. course that I would recommend for undergrads and chemical engineering  grad students as well.

Class was interesting and really fun. We talked about all kinds of different energy devices and what makes the work technically and then in the market. Gene also encouraged  discussions in class and was always ready to find a different way to explain things if anyone was unclear. He wanted everyone to get it - not just the majority: Great Teacher!

The course was very challenging but it is a difficult subject to learn. Lectures were very helpful to help make clear the main points which can't be learned just from the text. The foundation was necessary to setup the remainder of the class which was about the practical aspects of battery design - which was lots of fun. Not too easy, but worth it!

I loved this course. Although I don't have a proper background in chemistry, it is the interest and the passion that Prof.Gene has made my learning more enjoyable. Unlike other rigid and structured courses, this course is adaptive and flexible and discussion based. We had lot of discussions;the professor is ready to teach what the student needs.

Very motivated to not only teach students but make sure they understand. Will explain concepts thoroughly. Interested in teaching newer, more relevant technologies which is extremely useful for those interested in entering industry. Attendance is vital. Final presentations are useful and effective for learning about a variety of topics.

Waste of time. Class is not mandatory, I suggest not going, you'll become more confused. He goes off on tangents that don't correlate to anything being taught and it only confuses you more. If you've had chem before this class is the saddest joke and painful to sit through. The man is nice but makes a lot of mistakes. Pretty entertaining. Easy A

If youve taken chem before, this class is a joke and absurdly easy, not to mention a comlete waste of time. Going to class is completely worthless. If you havent taken chem before, going to class is still completely worthless. He's a smart guy, but a horrible teacher and terrible at explaining things. Use the textbook if you need the help.

Prof. Smotkin is a really nice guy, but not a great teacher. His lectures are  confusing and unclear. His tests can be difficult as well. He is a brilliant guy so he doesn't really understand when students cant comprehend the information.  Luckily the class was curved.  Not a good class to take.

Professor Smotkin is a really nice person but I didn't really get his class. The use of Smartworks was not the best option and even though he really tried to help I came out of the class empty. Really nice person but not such a good class.

As a person, eugene is a great guy. very friendly and helpful. he IS really smart but when it comes down to teaching students- terrible. his tests are 'so-so', not so easy, not so hard. but avoid at all cost. by the 2nd week, less than half the class showed up. and among that half, more than half fell asleep. so, you be the judge.

Pure awful. Day one was bad when he didn't even have a decent syllabus. Never stayed on topic. Friendly guy, and willing to help after class, but couldn't stay focused.  Disorganized labs thrown together days before hand, avoid at all costs.

P chem is supposed to be hard but it seemed as if Prof. Smotkin tried to make it even harder.  Most of the class was lost all semester.  Questions and gradeing were vague and left everyone scratching their heads.  Avoid if at all possible

Terrible teacher. I had her for Writing and Communication at Berklee. She is nasty online with email, comments and advice. She is unforgivably forgetful and unbelievably unorganized. Miss Flanders also makes class uncomfortable by sharing disturbing stories from her life that are not at all related to the class. Save yourself the frustration.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Horrible, absolutely atrocious.  Simply put, it was the worst liberal art experience of my life.  She sets due dates and then gives you a poor grade if it isn't handed in 2 weeks early.  She assigns a ridiculous amount of work and she is never at her office hours.  DO NOT TAKE, GET OUT WHILE YOU CAN!!!

As a berklee student, I never liked writing and communications but she gave me every reason to love it. I totally recommend her to anyone. Besides, this lady had to go out of her way to come for one of my concerts in school. That meant a lot to me. She is just such a sweet heart.
Most hardiest class I ever had in Berklee. If your English (I mean, you are international student) not so good, don't take this.
Makes me appreciate Life

WORST PROFESSOR EVER!  Never graded assignments, didn't respond to questions, didn't post course materials.  Links to readings were often broken (copy and paste?) or hopelessly out of date.  TONS of assignments, but no guidance.  I learned more from my classmates than from her.  Why is she still teaching?!?!?!

I can't wait the day she gets fired.  She doesn't know anything.  All the materials and assignments she gives were untrustworthy (probably she just copy and paste).  She never checks homeworks she gives out a lot.  She is just a horrible, lazy, mess teacher.  Why is she teaching here?
Just horrible. She does not help anything.  Too much work with no response.

Tries to kill you with work! Don't take her class if you can help it! She is bordering on very clueless! She wonders why people don't participate when she kills them with so much work! She also changes the readings without telling you after the syllabus/course material has been posted!!!

Nice, unable to explain certain aspects of politics, concentrates largely on other systems of government beyond US which she doesn't seem to have as much knowledge of. Quizzes often, though they are vague, hard to understand.
Learned nothing. Waste of time and money. She is nice.

I liked her and the class, but she needs a little bit more experience to become a great professor.  Seems uncomfortable in front of class/unsure of herself.  Very easy to go to outside of class, and I thought her non-american nationality gave the class a cool spin.  I'd take her again if I had the opportunity.
She is a great teacher, there are frequent quizzes, but helpful I took her class 1 semester ago and still remember everything she taught me!
No Comments
easy teacher, very understanding, sometimes hard to understand(accent), nice!
No Comments
I think he is a very good teacher for helping international students check papers' grammar mistakes or make conversations of general topics.
Need to show up to class Lectures are long and unnecessarily drag on Gives extra credit to students who are always there and are there before break
He's great!
Actually horribly awful.
Try your best to avoid him. Not a helpful guy.
Hard class with tons of work but all my friends seem to have the same amount of work so it may not be her fault.  Always uses current examples, lots of videos but the class is really hard.
Very Helpful in understanding business concepts

She presented 15 question tests worth 12% of our final grade. Students asked to increase the amount of questions. She replied "I figured the less questions, the less you have to memorize." That makes no sense considering we don't know what exactly is going to be on the exam. Just one of MANY examples proving her inept capabilities. Horrible teacher
Thinks she knows everything, she is way too confident in her self and she lets that get in the way of her teaching ability and reality. HARD TEACHER dont take international business with her.

She is a good teacher, but is too confident. She thinks she knows more than she does. Claims to have come from an executive position in a renowned company. "Those that can, do. Those than cant, teach." I think she likes girls more than guys too.

Not clear on what she wants. Went to office hours, not helpful at all. There are 2 tests, a debate, an individual paper and final project. Unless you like to read the book word for word and do not need any help from the teacher, I would not recommend taking International Business with her. Terrible teacher.

Evans is great at lecturing and gets some great guest speakers. Beware, there are 3 group papers that will take a considerable amount of time. If your group works well you'll likely get an A or B in the course.

Prof. Evans is very knowledgable with many years in industry to draw upon in her teachings. Her class is unique, and she brings in interesting speakers. She respects her students and gives thoughtful assignments. Not a lot of work in the class, and all readings were posted on Blackboard- no textbook to buy! Overall, a great and different professor.

so at first i loved him. funny chill dude. but i can tell you hes a great guy but a horrible teacher. i had him for lit and theory and he just goes wayyy too fast. attendance is MANDATORY and so is hw, which is super hard and he grades it but never goes over it. nice guy but not a good teacher.

He barely assigns homework, which is cool in the beginning but you never really get to practice/apply the stuff you're learning until the test. He teaches material and immediately moves on, but he is very clear and goes over the material very well.

had him for theory and for music lit. really funny guy, wears the same sweater every day. he makes you want to learn. theory wasn't too difficult, he's an easy grader, sometimes goes a little too fast but hes an awesome guy. lit was just impossible. too much information to stomach at 8am
An excellent theory teacher, so entertaining and really clear when helping you with music problems

i would say he is a good professor. always makes sure his students know the material and is clearly enthusiastic about teaching. killer piano player pretty funny too. you really just have to work hard to do well in this class. i think he is a sexy jewish man.

Had Johnson for Theory 1. He's quite a good teacher. The best thing is that the work is easy but he's still getting the information across. He takes input from the students seriously; the final project was pretty much decided by us.

The fundamentals of music theory are sometimes hard to stomach at 8 am, but I've never missed this class because I don't think I'd get anywhere without Professor Johnson's lessons. He really knows what he's talking about, has a goofy charm, and makes sure that we know our stuff. His tests have gotten harder as the semester has progressed, but he of

He is an awesome teacher and is VERY VERY easy...there are lots of grades and as long as you go to class you are going to get a good grade. Funny guy and very flexible and wants his students to be sucessful...didnt miss a class (and it was 8 am)
he's awesome!
He is really smart and high energy, but unfortunately his subject is boring.  This class was required for mus ind.  What he loses in subject matter he makes up for in personality and intelligence.

Dr Bernstein is hilarious and his lectures are very engaging for an 8am, but the class is graded entirely on 3 Canvas online exams . There are no resources outside of the slides he lectures with, which are super content heavy. He wants everyone to pass but believes there is only one way to study the material which doesn't work for everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very much enjoyed my Nanotoxicity course with Prof Bernstein. He is very enthusiastic and knowledgeable. The only grades for the course are 3 exams (first, midterm, final). They are all online and open notes, but you only get 40 seconds/question, so you don't really have time to check your notes. Your best bet is memorizing all the lecture slides.
He literally can not teach for the life of him.

The class is only weighted by 7 exams, so one bad grade can tank your average. The exams are based entirely on the class presentations so study them thoroughly. He also does not answer any questions himself and relies on the TA
Great prof

Genuinely the most entertaining lecturer I've had here. With that said, the amount of material expected to be memorized is wild. This has become a weed-out class with only three exams making up the entirely of the course grade. Hundreds of questions on the tiniest details, often with mistakes. He cares, but is inaccessible.
Make sure to just study the lectures because test questions are basically taken from the slides
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His teaching style and lecture slides weren't my favorites but because he was covering for a professor on maternity leave, his exams were relatively simple and he added extra points to exam grades.

He tends to go over the information multiple times which is quite helpful. He reads off his lectures and tests based on the lecture. Very easy to comprehend once you get behind the accent and he's funny. I love the pictures he draws, makes it much easier to understand difficult concepts. Can be a little scary at times lol
Very engaging and will go over topics until all students understand. Lectures are fun. Professor Bernstein cares for his students and wants everyone to pass.
Such an amazing professor. Makes class very interesting and he really cares for all his students. Draws very beautiful pictures and always puts a smile on your face. Definitely recommend!

This class is so difficult. He just wants you to memorize the material he could careless if you learn it. His exams are super tough not enough time is given and he will add 5-6 questions that he never even taught or talked about. Your grade is made of 3 exams. Do not screw up on any Bc itll be incredible difficult bring grade up.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Took this class during the summer to boost my GPA. Amazing time listening to his lectures and reading the materials. Would recommend.

Best professor at NU. Cares a lot about his students and is always willing to help you succeed. Lectures are terribly important. He draws many beautiful pictures that make material easier to understand. Had he been 10 years younger, he would still be a gallant boxer.  KGB occasionally steals his chalk under the cover of the night, though.

I love this guy; his green screens are epic and ridiculous. It's the best. Took alt-med online and loved it. Learn relevant things easily: with all this essential oil craze these days, my favorite thing to do is shoot it down in flames using stuff I learned from this class. Class is great - all week to take test and docs with all you need to know

I literally love Dr. Bernstein. He is the cutest little man ever. He made lectures so interesting and genuinely wants everyone to do well. The course itself is challenging but he does everything he can to make it more manageable. My favorite professor in college so far.
He has a strong accent, but you will get used to. The material is very basic. So if you want to learn sth advanced, dont choose his courses.

Dr. Bernstein is awesome. In order to get all that you can out of his lectures, you have to go to class. The diagrams he makes are extremely helpful and he is entertaining and funny so he keeps you engaged. Great guy.
Go to every class and memorize all the class notes and you will be fine. He doesn't use the textbook so participation is key.
awesome teacher, had him for alt. medicine. print out the packets and memorize everything. that's basically it

He's funny and tries to be kind. Very thick Russian accent. talks about communism a lot, will call you comrades. Claims his tests are 'fair and honest', but they're really about  memorizing arbitrarily estimated numbers in 30+ pages of notes per test. He does not answer phone/e-mails or Qs during exams. Gives bonus points.

He is the cutest man alive!!! If it wasnt for his Russian accent (mostly understandable, took me la couple of weeks to get used to), I would have given him a 5 for clarity. He is super helpful-- if you have a question just go up to him after class he is really nice and friendly! Go to class and study. Gives test questions in class prior to exam!

This professor is one of if not the best professor at the school. His classes are challenging, but not difficult and he often give extra credit quizzes where you get bonus points for class participation. He's very helpful, very visual and mentally simulating. He's also got a killer sense of humor and makes class worth while.
Dr.Bernstein is the man. At first he seems a little scary but if you get to know him he is the nicest man. If you go to class, pay attention and study / memorize your notes..your good!

Feel bad saying anything bad about this mad because he is so sweet, BUT if you're taking a lot of hard classes that constantly need your attention then do not take this class. SOLELY memorization. Each exam had 30+ pages of typed notes to be memorized, nearly impossible during finals week. The final was the worst exam I've ever taken.
KGBs after him well they keep taking his chalk...

Possibly the best professor at Northeastern. He knows the material very well and knows how to explain it very well. He cares a lot about his students and tries to help them do well in any way he can. He's funny and very enthusiastic and he's able to hold onto the attention of the class. He's an excellent professor and I highly recommend him.

Eugene is a GREAT professor and I enjoyed going to every class. He has so much energy and excitement for the subject material and wants his students to do well. Although it is not necessary to go to class, you want to because EVERYTHING you need to know is from his in-class notes. Definitely recommend this professor!

Best professor I've had so far. Fair and honest. Study all his notes. Not mandatory to go to his class but you want those notes! He'll ask you everything in detail. But no trick questions. Very funny and blames KGB for everything. The best 8am classes I've had so far.

One of the best all-around professors I've had. Knows his subject very well as well as many others. Funny and interesting during lectures.  His tests are completely derived from his notes so take them well, pay attention to memorizing specifics when preparing for tests (flash cards are great for his classes)

He's a great teacher once you understand his style.  He made a potentially boring topic fun, but you need to study hard for tests.  If you know everything from the notes and his outlines, it's easy to do well but it takes a lot of studying.  He was one of my favorite teachers at northeastern, very smart, straightforward and entertaining.

His topics are mostly in the lecture manual but he himself explains the material. Take your notes and study EVERYTHING. His tests cover everything down to the specific numbers. If you have good memory, you'll have no problems. Make sure to do the bonuses. Every point counts!

AWEEESSOMMEE teacher! If you have him jump with joy! He is so energetic, gives great examples, and makes 8 am Anatomy worth while! Great Guy. If you go to class and read the lecture notes you will easily get an A! (Don't even buy the textbook)

Awesome guy.  ANYONE GET GET AN A IN THE CLASS IF YOU JUST GO TO CLASS WRITE DOWN WHAT HE SAYS AND STUDY HIS PACKETS.  If you get atleast an 80 for multiple choice you will be fine because you get a lot of extra points for writing bonuses and he just gives extra points.       Go to class, take notes, study his guide and YOU WILL GET AN A. I promise

His tests are pretty difficult and detailed, but he gives out bonus points which are helpful. Towards the end of the semester he kind of rushes through everything, forcing you to teach yourself a lot of material. Overall, he's a nice enough guy.. his style of teaching just wasn't for me.

COMRADES, YOU CANNOT SKIP CLASS! EVER! Tests are based SOLELY on the manual and class notes. He LOVES asking little details, especially numbers... so make sure you memorize them really well. Draw a lot of beautiful pictures for bonuses! He is VERY funny and everyone loves him.  He was the only prof. I liked sophomore year. Is it clear, my friends?

Such a cute little old russian man. I wish he was my grandfather. He has the funniest stories and keeps class at 4:30 entertaining. Somce people don't like his teaching style though and sometimes you feel like you're missing something. But all of his tests are straight out of the notes and he tells you EXACTLY what to write.

Bernstein is amazing.  He really tries to get to know all of his students and wants to make sure you know what you're doing.  He has a few key phrases that he ALWAYS says and he is very funny.  Even though he's in the morning, it not bad because he is so energetic.  No need for the book, study his notes and go to class and you'll be fine.

Probably my favorite professor in my second year of pharmacy school.  He is a funny guy, he tells the most absurd stories that have no relevance to class you can't help but laugh at.  Class is overall fun and interesting.  All you need to do is show up to class, take notes and study them (especially numbers) and you'll be fine.

He repeats too much. He's full of himself and likes to hear himself talk. Don't ever come to his office hours, he never stops talking. Granted, he knows his material...he's just not an effective teacher. He also has a very bad tendency of getting off topic. One of the worst professors I've had as of yet. He just grates my nerves.
Berstein is the man, very good guy to start your day with. Comrades It is a pleasure to see you all, guys this is the moments of all the moments. Go Straight to the notes.

He's a funny guy, but I always feel like I'm missing something when he finishes a sentence. The entire class was memorization. Don't bother reading the book, just go to class, write down everything he says and study that.

He teaches like Emeril: "*bam!* This is the anesthetic. *bam!* this causes priapism" Just not very affective for me. I need better explanations, not pure memorizations! Funny & full of energy in class, so not unenjoyable. Seems nice enough though.

This man is one of the most intelligent professors u will ever encounter.  He knows ten times more than your other professors added together.  His teaching style is clear and he is helpful.  The class is challenging.   You do not know what a professor should be ti u see him.  The most knowledgeable prof i had hands down.

bernsteins a funny man. all you have to do is memorize his notes to pass. he'll remember you forever. but you wont remember anything you learn cause its never in a relavent way of learning. but he is amusing.

i actually attended the class rather than sleep in (that also had to do with the fact that his tests are pretty much entirly on class notes and u dont even need teh book)...he teaches well, cares that the class does good, is funny, and he also gives a lot of extra credit
Great guy.  Class is based on three exams, you do bad on one you can't bring up your grade.  Other then that its not too bad.  Don't open the text book, only memorize his notes and youll do fine

Bernstein is great. He's willing to help. He gets off on tangents sometimes but he does care about students. At 8am he was really pleasant. If you reach out to him he will definately recognize that and take it into consideration when grading.
essentially he is a good teacher, essentially
If you intereact with this guy, you get an A.  He gives extra credit on most of his exams.  He usually tells you what are on his tests.  If he doesn't, ask him to.  Always available for extra help.
This man loves his job and you can tell. He cares about all his students.. "once upon a time, failing grade not bad"

Bernstein makes 8 am classes bearable, believe it or not.  The guy says some random things that crack you up, but most importantly, he knows what he teaches inside and out, and cares that everyone does well.

thinks a lot of himself. sometimes talks down to students very indirectly (hard to notice). Book is useless, class is interesting, tests are ave-easy, keeps you awake at 8am. Final isnt cumulative.  Gives bonuses on exams
i'm somewhat apathetic.  he's nice, he tells funny jokes, and the class is easy, but i'm not a fan of his way of teaching.
Amazing man! He's actually on the student's side.  If you need anything at all he is more than willing to clarfy things or accomodate to your needs.  He is hilarious!

he says the most hillarious things, like " Don't be sad or i will install the machine guns". Great teacher esp. for an 8am. Conveys material with ease and tells the funniest stories. Always willing to help.
This man cracks me up!  He would say his tests are "fair and honest."  Just study his notes, don't bother with the book, the test questions come straight out of the notes.
Funny little man... Loves to hear himself talk, but makes things interesting.  Really knows his info and is very passionate about what he does.
Very passionate about teaching.  Interested in helping students as much as possible.
He's a cool guy but his exams are tough
He is the cutest old man! I loved his jokes with his Russian accent!
funniest, cutest teacher ever... who doesnt love a russian professor?!
You either Love him or Hate him...I think I hated his style of teaching
amazing teacher!!! love that guy
No Comments
No Comments
great teacher-really knows his stuff
No Comments

When she speaks during class you can't understand a thing she says due to her accent but on top of that she doesnt seem to know what she is talking about. Her grading scale is so crazy! It actually got changed cause so many people complained but it used to be ranked like the top so many people got A's and so on. So just be careful if you get her.

she is a horrible teacher. she has a thick accent and you can barely understand her because of that. also, when you ask her questions, she doesn't seem to understand them probably because of the language barrier. she gets everything from the book, which makes me wonder if she really knows the subject by heart. DROP THIS CLASS IF YOU GET HER!!!

She is an awful teacher. She writes notes on the board as if she is brainstorming to herself! Hard to understand and you simply dont learn. You are better off teaching yourself. If you want to enjoy this course switch teachers or you will regret it! You actually get mad at yourself when you do decide to actually go to class, "like why did i come".

Absolutely terrible. Everything was right out of the textbook. There was no relating the material to the real world at all. Only 2 tests and a final. Very disappointing - all I needed was to buy the book, the class itself was a big waste of money.

The class was pretty bad.  I mean, she knows what she is talking about, but she goes straight from the book and then doesn't really explain anything - plus she is really bad at answering questions.  She is difficult to understand and most people just use their cell phones during class.  It's not fun.
No Comments
You can not understand anything she says! Reads directly from the book and most of the time if you ask her a question she gets confused and can not answer it. A total waste of a class.

She is very difficult to understand, but you sorta get used to it. Her lessons are pretty much exactly from the book, so following along in class is very easy (thats if you go). Attendance is never taken and don't be alarmed on the first day when there are not enough seats - 75% of the class won't show up. Tests are pretty hard, but not impossible.
she is very hard to understand because of her accent

Impossible to understand. even when talking 1 on 1. Dont bother going to class she just reads straight from the textbook all class and doesnt really answer questions. if you like teachers that are helpful and can speak clear english without such a thick eastern european accent then take someone else
You can't understand her.  She can't answer questions.  She is a moron bottom line.
hard to understand but not a bad class, kind of easy grading but hard tests

Thick accent and hard to understand.  Pretty much just recopies the book on the board.  Most boring class ever.  She cannot answer a question for the life of her which makes her class a little more difficult than it should be.

She's a nice woman but it is just IMPOSSIBLE to understand what she's saying through her accent.  Her notes on the board are also confusing because she shortens words that shouldnt be shortened . You don't have to go to class though. theres no attendance and you will do fine if you read the chapter online and do the aplia.

He is an absolute genius and will absolutely explain anything you ask about, but oftentimes his lectures are so advanced because he is moving at the speed of his brain rather than the brain of someone hearing half of this stuff for the first time. He threatened us with pop quizzes when we didn't participate and is the slowest grader ever.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This man is evil.

Honestly - dropping this rating because I feel like he's a pretty good prof for Linear Systems. Knows his stuff and is very good at explaining things. Also very understanding. Rewards effort - so show up to class and office hours. The homeworks are long and assigned kind of randomly throughout the semester though, so be prepared.

Took him for a BIOE class, and he made it so much harder than it had to be. Lectures were okay, homework was long. He was making all the homework and exams on the fly so the class was very disorganized, and grades took a long time to come back. We were so behind, and he had to start doing extra 2 hr weekly recitation for us to know what's going on.

Professor Fanaei is a great lecturer, if you pay attention youll know everything for the exams. Most of your grade comes from hw and weekly quizzes which is nice. Each exam you get 2 pages worth of notes so if you plan ahead theyre a cake walk. Unfortunately the man does not grade, its the last week of class and I could have a C or A, I dont know
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very chill guy and honestly a good lecturer as well. He doesn't give a lot of work so it is important to turn everything in on time. Definitely would take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor was the worst teacher I have ever had. I already knew how to code in python but his tests were impossible and grading made no sense. He used chatgpt for everything and it made no sense. He showed up to class 20 minutes late and was impossible to reach through email. He doesn't post his code.

He is not very encouraging. If you do not understand something he tends to be rude about it. He "lectures" but he does not post any of the lectures online, and he does not post any of the in class code online either making it very difficult to study for the class.

Terrible lecturer, very boring. Does not post anything online regarding upcoming assessments. Did not even upload the syllabus to the Canvas page until the 3rd week of classes. If you already know Python you will be greatly disadvantaged - he marks wrong any problem you do that uses things he hasn't taught already. Very close minded

Difficult to pay attention to in class, often unclear in his directions and teaching, nothing posted on Canvas. Didn't know what my grad would be between A and D until the day grades were due, not even sure if he graded the final project

took this course my first semester at Northeastern with no previous coding experience. Fanaei made this class incredibly stressful for me. He does not respond to emails, he does not provide lots of feedback (if any at all). It's finals week and I have genuinely no idea what my grade is because he has not graded either of our 2 midterms.

The lectures were boring but homeworks were pretty much all based on effort and there were a lot of extra credit opportunities. The two midterm grades were pretty low but he scaled everything after the final and also the weight was not as significant as expected (even with a 75 and 80 on the two midterms I got an A). He is nice if you ask for help.

took this class fall 2022. definitely go to lecture because he doesn't post much on canvas. towards the end of the semester he started posting jupyter notebooks to go through. He takes a while to grade assignments. I think if you attend lecture and follow along, you should be okay. he also seems to be very open to suggestions or improvements

He is bad at teaching. He doesn't post any of his slides from class and barely posts any of his code. He assigned a large final project on the second to last class of the semester and only gave us two weeks, which was finals, to do the project. Take a different professor.

Want to know your grade in the class? Get ready to wait. It's been 45 days (I checked) and the first midterm still hasn't been fully graded. 

Lectures are honestly pretty boring and repetitive. Despite this, the exams are insane so your average won't benefit.

He admitted that he used chatGPT to make the online quizzes, which explains a lot.

Lectures are extremely long and boring, barely any grades (last 2 weeks of sem). By the time we took our first midterm the only grade in canvas was one homework from the first few weeks of the semester and two auto-graded canvas quizzes which were assigned as homework. About to take the second midterm and the first one hasn't even been graded yet.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He will not tell you this but you need the textbook. He does not teach half of the materials on the quizzes because they are in the textbook. He doesn't post anything on Canvas and his lectures are dry and slow.

Horrible Professor. Lectures are very boring, he is very longwinded and repeats himself at least 4 times on everything. Holds you at the end of class to tell him 5 things you learned that day. Tests are impossible. Still hasn't graded the homework from second week of classes. About to take second midterm and he still hasn't graded the first one.

I really tried to cut this guy some slack, as it was his first semester at Northeastern. However, his homeworks didn't make sense, exams were basically impossible, and he assigned us so much work in the last 2 weeks that people in my class complained to admin. He also doesn't know how to work canvas or reply to emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of best lectures I've had and super interesting content. Attendance isn't mandatory but he gives you exam answers in class and the lectures are super informative so I'd definitely recommend going.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: love this king, attendance isn't ever taken but pretty much everything on the exam is something he said in class so you do kinda have to show up, half the classes are films, other half are lectures, your grade is based on 2 tests and 2 essays, he is one of the smartest people i've ever talked to but he does tend to ramble on in class
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Faber is so knowledgeable and passionate about the topic that his lectures are super interesting. I learned so much! All of his test answers are given in his lectures, although attendance isn't mandatory. Be ready to watch a lot of movies, as many of the classes are just taking notes on films. Best class I have ever taken!

Best professor ive ever had, his class is so interesting and important to the real world. He gives you answers to the tests in class, if you go to class youll be fine, I ended with a 99. Long lectures but very interesting and informative.

Professor Faber is very knowledgeable about the environmental movement, and has a lot to say about everything. He is good at explaining topics, but has a tendency to spend half of class going off tangents. Additionally, the Canvas page was very unorganized and he doesn't respond to emails. The self paced aspect of the class is nice though.

Faber is knowledgeable and passionate about his course material and I learned a lot in his class. Attendance is optional but sometimes he explicitly gives you answers to exam questions in lectures, so I recommend showing up. There are homework readings which he doesn't check for completion, but you do have to cite them when writing papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Faber is hands down my favorite professor yet. He truly cares about the topics discussed in class and knows how to integrate real-world pieces into his lectures. Although attendance wasn't necessary, I actually enjoyed going to class. I had to take this for an NU path requirement and wasn't sure at first, but it was the best decision.

I feel like no matter what you're studying you should take his class, even if it's for an NU Path I think you can get a lot out of this class. It definitely changes the way you see things about sociology and environmental science if you weren't already aware of what's really going on. 2 tests, 2 papers, go to every class and you will do just fine!

"I give students the opportunity to get a better grade" Sorta what he said.
He grades his written papers very leniently.
If you're not used to lecture hall style classes it can be hard.
Part of the hw is watching films.
Easy to talk to and knows a lot about what he does, so much so that he's essentially memorised the slides

Professor Daniel Faber is very passionate and extremely knowledgeable about the topic of environmental sociology. I loved his class because the content was so applicable to every part of my life, and without being too challenging I learned a lot. His course is reading-heavy but they were manageable. I recommend him as a professor!

Professor Sultan is a tough professor. She demands too much from her students, gets caught up in nit picky details, and is rude and disrespectful much of the time. Don't take her class unless you absolutely have to - I think this class is her whole life and she expects her students to do the same. She will belittle you and has a superiority complex
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Horrible professor. Don't take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Sultan is the worst professor I've ever had in my 6 years at NEU. She wants students to fail, seeks out to make your life difficult, and spends lecture primarily complimenting herself. AVOID HER CLASS FOR YOUR SANITY. I only did well-ish bec. I had to drag my academic advisor into several meetings with her to literally fight for my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: she seems to be nice when you talk to her at first but she is overly strict and could get quite rude and disrespectful. she cannot stand the typos and pays attention on small things like that, instead of paying attention on the content. she likes to talk about herself and gets irritated when you ask for clarifications. one of the worst professors.

Sultan has a very structured course layout. If you want to get a good grade, find out exactly what she is looking for and give it to her. If you deviate from her rules or requirements, don't expect any good comments. The group project takes up a significant amount of the overall course load. Choose your team wisely.

I took this class online so I didn't have the same experience as other respondents.I am enrolled in the MBA online program so comparatively this class was moderate in expectations.I had classes where both material and requirements were far worst. Each week usually 1 current discussion topic, 1paper, and another disc based on it(final project@end)

Not a big fan of the manner in which Prof. Sultan teaches, I have learned very little.  Very rude, she cuts off students mid-answer when they answer questions.  Have not received grades for almost any of the assignments turned in yet.  I would not recommend her to anyone.  Also missing 3 classes results in a zero participation grade (20%)
Sultan is the worst, most degrading professor I've ever experienced. Her classes consist of her yelling at students until she gets the answer she wants. Terrible. Never take her.

She is a hard teacher and we went to the bar after every crazy test/presentation. As long as you GO TO CLASS you will end up doing OK. She thinks missing class is a sin, I swear. Midterm was really hard but she gave us as many points as possible...thought I failed but I got an 83. Ended up with an A- but I think it was cuz I dared not miss a class.
