Furth was a pretty good teacher. He knows what he's talking about and he explains things pretty well. My only problem with him is that he makes students feel stupid when they ask questions. Otherwise he's fine. He collects a short homework (1-4 problems) every day and gives 6 tests. Do the homework and pay attention in class and its not too bad
No Comments

Professor Fuchs genuinely cares for her students and wants them to learn. Her class does involve a lot of homework, but the tests are all online. She is understanding if you turn in things late as long as you show effort. I thought her teaching style was really effective and helpful.

the group project towards the end of the class left a lot to be desired, but that's largely because of who I was paired with. she's relatively strict although does allow the homework to be turned in late with minimal penalty, which is helpful because there's something due 4/5 days of the work week.

amazing prof that really cares about your german learning, all homework is completion and she gives adequate feedback on to help you learn, you have three attempts for quizzes, which aren't that difficult, overall an amazing prof who really cares for her students and their learning

One of the kindest Professors. I took intro to German just for fun and she was the best. There is a lot of homework but she is understanding with late assignments. There are pop quizzes but they are just to check your understanding and don't effect your grade, and quizzes are take home with three tries. She just wants you to learn the language.

The classes are well structured and she clearly likes teaching. There are a lot of homework assignments but they're easy enough. Half of the classes are spend on zoom with elders in Germany which was boring most of the time. She also is a very easy grader, it's okay if you submit things late as she grades completion.

I had Frau Fuchs for both elementary classes, and I'm glad I did. The class was well-structured- lots of opportunities to get practice talking, reading, writing, and listening. She herself is a good teacher, and takes care to convey the content clearly.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Frau Fuchs is clearly educated about the best method of foreign language learning--half the class consists of a virtual exchange with students in Heidelberg, Germany. However, she gives very limited and unhelpful feedback on assignments. Her attendance policy is incredibly strict, miss two classes and automatically fail the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: His lectures are optional and his zooms every lecture, but I tried attending most of his lectures. He tries to make lectures fun by adding jokes but it is still pretty dry. But I feel like he explains the concept well. He gives a lot of homework assignments. His tests are like the HW but harder.

Very nice and caring professor. Attendance is not mandatory and he records the lectures live on Zoom and puts the recordings on Canvas, so the class can basically be taken without ever stepping foot into a lecture. However, tests are in-person so make sure you go to those

I was in a class with 200+ students so I would recommend going to office hours if you need assistance. My TA with recitation did not know a lot and did not help me once so I attended office hours and Professor Georges assisted very well. I would take him again however the lectures are boring because he just reads right off the slides.

An amazing professor. You never have to come to class for lectures, but the exams are always in class with a shorter take-home portion. Once a week we are assigned a lot of homework with a lot of questions, many multi-part. It is still manageable, just start early and do a few problems a day. The class is pretty easy, I would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's such a king
he's a sweet guy. lectures are boring, way too dense & so much fluff. however, he records & zooms lectures and tests are 1/2 in person, 1/2 at home. easy A.

Professor Georges really cares about his students and wants the best for them. He was always available outside of class for help and he was very lenient with deadlines. Bless this man, I really learned a lot about Economics from him and although I rarely went to class as long as you keep up with the textbook and homework, it should be easy!
Frank is literally the goat. Such a chill and easy class. Highly recommend. Very easy A. It is easy not to listen to him during his lectures tho as they are a bit boring.

Nice guy and the class itself isn't too hard, his scheduling is crammed and makes the class more annoying and adds unnecessary difficulty. For example: most exams are two parts in person and take home, but he would frequently have a homework due Mon, an exam on Wed/Thur, another hw due Fri, and then the take home due Sunday.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: such a chill class, very easy to get an A if you put in work. Alot of homework, but you can repeat until you are satisfied with the grade. Would definitely recommend! only 4 tests.

easiest professor ever. class is optional and has a zoom meeting during the class so you can just listen from home, and records every zoom and uploads it to canvas so every lecture is accessible whenever. tests are on canvas with no lockdown browser so they're basically open note. there's a lot of busywork for homework but the class is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super easy class, lectures aren't mandatory and are always recorded on zoom. Tests are two parts, half online half in person which makes it super easy to perform well. He's passionate about what he teaches, but it's tough to stay engaged during the lectures. Can pretty much review the slides, do the homework, and then do well on the tests.
Frank is a very chill guy, but his lectures are boring. Luckily, you don't have to go. All tests are online including the final. He is very accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher. I went to class and actually learned a lot even though it was very easy. Long lectures but he can be funny at times and it isnt a bad place to go and even do other work. Exams are easy. Homework takes forever but as long as you start on them early and don't leave it til last minute you're fine

Very chill. You don't have to go to class and the exams are pretty easy if you do the homework. Only downside is that the HW for the week is like 100 questions with multiple parts so that bit is annoying, but very doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took him in the fall he mad chill. Homework can be long but you have unlimited attempts. Tests aren't hard if you study for them. Also, if you want to listen to the lectures but not walk to class you can join his zoom.
If you want to be behind a computer for hours working on economics this is the class for you!
bros the goat he emailed me saying I forgot to do some assignments and then extended the deadline just talk to bro a little bit and you'll be fine. my g

Professor Georges is a very smart man and he also provides valuable knowledge. A true treasure to Northeastern. His work requires lots of time and sitting behind a screen. I recommend him as a teacher.

He cares about what he does, but often his lectures are just simply boring. He records them and posts them so you can skip class and watch the recording on 2x. His exams on on canvas not locked, however in person. Its an easy A if you try even a little bit.

Professor Georges deserves all of the good feedback that he's getting. He really is a good professor who is very accessible outside of class hours if you're stuck on a subject. While his lectures were a little dry (had him at 8 AM), his homeworks and tests were fairly straight forward and easy.
Good lectures and easy class format. The homework sometimes took a while, but it wasn't bad if you broke it up over the week. I learned a decent amount without really trying.

Super nice professor but the lectures weren't very engaging, but you could tell he knows what he is talking about and wants to help you succeed. A lot of textbook homework that takes a big part of final grade and remember to do your discussion board posts cause it is for a grade. Easy class and great prof.

Professor Georges is very laid back- but his classes did not really relate to the exams at all and I found the exams quite difficult. Cheating is very abundant in this class as well meaning there was never a curve. Due to the very lenient grading policies getting is good grade is still achievable but the class was very frustrating overall.

Such a kind teacher who does everything in his power to help you suceed in his class! He gives multiple opportunites for you to do well, and his office hours are very helpful. Highly reccomend this professor if you are taking a basic econ class. He is so knowledgable, and he genuinely wants his students to learn.
Hes a great prof. Cares about his students and if you do the bare minimum really easy to get an A. Take him for microeconomics!!!!

Professor Georges was great. Only about 5% of the students went to class but I think he had some interesting things to say. The class has a lot of busy homework but you get unlimited attempts on homework. Just show up to class pay attention and you will barely need to read the textbook.

Teacher clearly cares, but is a little bit boring with his lectures. Good guy, easy class. The homework is abysmal though; Not hard at all, but so time consuming because it's always like 102 questions of busy work.

He's very knowledgeable about Micro, but his lectures are not engaging. He assigns 60-100 questions per homework, with multiple parts per question. It's usually unclear what will be covered in each test since he starts new sections before we've been tested on the previous section. He's very kind and replies quickly through email outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Frank was great. Lectures can be boring but he explains everything clearly. Lectures are recorded on zoom so you can watch them whenever you want. Tests are pretty easy too.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This guy is a good teacher overall. Cares for you even though theres 200 people in the class. However, he assigns an unbelievable amount of homework. Each assignment can average around 60 questions each, with the biggest one being 97 problems and my most recent one being 86. These problems are also not all one and done problems, they have parts.

This class is really easy. All the test questions are just like the homework questions. He allows you to attend class through zoom and take exams through zoom; just need to have your camera on. He was good at explaining everything and answers emails very quick.

would take professor georges again for any economics class. he genuinely cares about his students and gives such great feedback. exams are exactly like practice problems so put in the work and you'll definitely get an A!

If u genuinely want to learn then i would not recommend this class. lectures are super boring and monotone. but homework and assignments are easy. its an easy A. tests and quizes are online but in class. he doesnt care about attendance i barely went. super understanding professor and reachable outside class. If u want a GPA boast take this class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not many people came to lecture because he posted the slides and most of the content was learned virtually.

Prof Georges is a nice guy, but public choice econ is the biggest waste of time ever. Can't believe I spent $8k of my money on this BS of a course. I'm sure the prof even agrees at how dumb this content is, all you do is learn about different methods by which election winners are chosen. And trust me, there's a lot, so you can read the book forever
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are super boring and monotone. Attendance not mandatory, barely anyone shows up after the first 2 weeks. Just do all the homework quizzes on pearson and youll be fine. He has 2 midterms and 1 final. All are online on canvas but u need to be in class for them. this class is mostly self learning.if u want an easy A/B grade then I'd say take

Rather boring lectures, but super nice guy and easy grader. Attendance does not matter at all and slides are always posted for students to review. Final exam was open note and weekly homeworks were easy. As long as you complete weekly assignments, you will get an A.

Great guy, and a great teacher. Knows what he's talking about, and explains well. The only problem is showing up to class, which few do after the first week. If you show up to class you'll do well, if you don't, you can still do well. Micro is a subject that will help you in the real world too. Not too much hw, you'll be good.
literally an angel

I thought Professor Georges was a good teacher for econ. The slide shows he used were good and easy to follow with minimal text. The only thing I wish is he did was use the whiteboard to draw out graphs to help visualize concepts as I feel that's important in a course like econ. Other than that, he was a great guy and super nice.

Frank is so nice and so accommodating- of course, do not take advantage of his kindness. He genuinely wants students to succeed and is accessible outside of class. I love him and would 100% take again.

ECON 5105. Not recommended if you have not been exposed to the math topics (linear, calc3, stats.) You will be overwhelmed. does a great job attempting to condense the info for a 1 sem course, but it's best taken only if you are STRONGLY considering Econ grad school. weekly HW, no exams. Took half remotely, half in person - dry lectures but fine.

Professor Georges was great, attendance isn't mandatory and all of the lectures are recorded and posted. Tests are online but in person, they aren't super easy but are very textbook based. Professor Georges is genuinely so nice and cares a lot.

Prof. Georges is great. Attendance isn't mandatory and he offers Zoom during every class. You can drop your lowest midterm and do homework as many times as you want. Tests are challenging if you don't read the textbook, and lectures can get a little boring, but overall a great class.

Very nice professor will do his best to ensure you do well in the class. What you put in you will receive in return. Test heavy but tests aren't hard, he drops your worst of the 4. Lets you make up missed work if you have a proper reason. Knowledgeable guy who will take time to explain things to you. Can be slighly monotonous, take morning class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Georges is an extremely chill professor and will give you every opportunity to get a good grade. The lectures can be a bit dry, but he does have a sense of humor that shows every once in a while. Textbook is important, but he really gives you a chance to get a good grade. Knows the material well too so if you're interested you can learn.
Very good professor .he understands his students and do everything to help them
He is nice, caring, and accessible outside of class, and his class is lecture-heavy. He wants his students to succeed.

Professor Georges was my easiest professor at Northeastern. All exams are take home and online and all you need to do is read the slides. Stopped going to class after the first month and ended with an A.

Great professor who's passionate about what he teaches. You can take from this class what you want - attendance is not mandatory and he posts zoom sessions to watch whenever, meaning you never have to go to class. However, I enjoyed going because Prof. G is very knowledgeable and I learned a lot. Open note exams and final. Easy A for sure.
Only lectures on the PowerPoint but tests are based off the online HW questions.

Material is straightforward and not too difficult. Open note tests and unlimited tries for homework. Prof Georges is nice and lectures are okay, but not particularly interesting or stimulating. Would recommend only if you need the credit, not if you are really interested in the subject.
Very chill professor. You can totally pass the class without going to lectures and privately studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are INCREDIBLY boring. Either read the textbook or go to class, no need to do both. Tests are easy and he allows notes. Not a course to take if you are looking for intellectual stimulation.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is SUPER EASY, and francis is such a kind and chill professor, take him!!

Such a nice guy. Very understanding and great at explaining content.

Weekly homework's which take a while but you get unlimited tries so you should be getting 100 and they honestly help me learn a lot.

Four take home quizzes done online but timed. They do test you but are open note. Final is in person.

Highly recommend this professor.

this class was SO easy. he drops the lowest test grade (including the final), gives a bunch of free extra credit on homework, and his few quizzes are unlimited attempts. and everything is open note. i stopped going to class like the second week and ended with an a. he's a caring person but his lectures are boring. def take if you want an easy a.
100% take micro with this professor.
Professor Georges is a super sweet professor who is very understanding about grades. His Principles of Microeconomics class was very interesting and easy.

Professor Georges cares about his students and only wants to see them succeed. I only went to class a few times and just watched his recorded lectures which had great information. His homework and exams are also straightforward and pretty simple. I would recommend this class + prof if you're looking for a fairly easy class.
He is super caring. The lectures can get a little heavy but he prepares you well for the exams and everything you need to know. I agree, protect this man at all costs.

SO. CHILL. like almost too chill. Don't even have to go to lectures if you read the textbook. Tests are straightforward and easy. HW helps you learn the content. Take as an easy welcome to college course

reviews.comment: His class is a good fit for literally anyone. If you want to learn, read textbook and go to class, he is very thorough and explains content well (a bit boring though). His team training is especially valuable since few classes teach how to work in groups effectively. Sean also has plenty of stories and extensive knowledge about marketing that he's passionate about sharing during both class and office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Sean is great! The class is heavily based on discussions and team work (group project). We had lots of readings on team effectiveness and creating a safe space for sharing. For a good grade: know key terms and frameworks from the textbook, participate (1x/class is a good goal), and spend time on Marketplace. The exams are scaled so the mean is a B+

Sean's a great professor that makes, in my opinion, a boring class interesting. The only thing to be wary of is that 30% of your grade is subjective. 20% class participation and 10% is a peer evaluation from a group project. As long as you get As on the exams (which are easy), you should be fine.

Super great professor who definitely cares about his students and the course material! Participation is huge, but I would highly recommend even if you're someone who struggles with it - Sean makes a very encouraging environment and it helps with learning to the tenth degree. Definitely read your textbook, that's the best way to do well on exams

Amazing, kind, funny professor who really cares about his students. A lot of reading but the material isn't anything too challenging. The marketplace group project will really challenge you but a good learning experience. He takes the time to create a welcoming, nonjudgmental learning environment. Very generous with curves on exams as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: This professor is amazing! His lectures are fun and engaging. The exams are not that hard if you pay attention in class and do the readings (also everything is curved). The class is discussion based but it is actually really good and helps you learn. I had the class at 8am and it always brightened my day! Absolutely take this professor!!

Very textbook heavy as the discussion revolves around the textbook. Tried taking a test using only his presentations as study material and bombed it. READ YO TEXTBOOK. Difficult to keep up every single week, so I cram the reading before each exam. Average score per exam was 80-90 w curve. Readings r so heavy, but tests are easier than Rachel's.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof. Sean is a lousy teacher. The semester project is 25% of your grade and instead of giving pointers to his students to succeed he only tells them to read articles on teamwork and communication. It's completely possible for all participants to receive an A, unfortunately Sean prefers to story tell instead of give insightful assistance.
Professor Sean was an excellent teacher, and I had a great time learning in class. All you need to do is show up to the class prepared, and you will do very well.

Professor Sean is good and transparent. Class is very enjoyable with active discussion and some good humor. You need to read the textbook day in day out, to prepare for the quizzes which are pretty tough like he says. The course works on improving how good you are in a group. In class, you learn about marketing and pick up essential life skills.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Sean was a great professor and by far my favorite. Advice I can offer is that you do the readings and participate in class. He is pretty straightforward about what he expects and he is really nice about it. As long as you read, pay attention in class, and study you will get an A. Also, go to his office hours (even if you don't have any questions).
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Sean is an amazing professor. He encourages students to participate in class through class discussions. He is passionate about marketing and often relates concepts to his own experiences and real life examples. I had his 8 am class, and his class is very engaging (not boring at all).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Sean is a great professor and is passionate about the courses he teaches. DO NOT take intro to mktg with him unless you are willing to participate in class. His exams are challenging, but he curves them on a generous scale. Read the textbook, participate in class, and contribute in discussions and you will find success.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Sean was a great professor. I really enjoyed learning in his class, and he really cared about his students. Even though it was a large class, it was easy for me to participate in a safe environment. Sean always encouraged any response to the reading. I also learned a lot about collaboration and team effectiveness. Definitely take again!

Sean is one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern. His class is discussion-based but don't let that scare you, even if you're an introvert like me! Sean goes above and beyond to make everyone feel comfortable speaking up and shares a lot about himself and his very relevant real-life experiences in marketing. Keep up and you will succeed!

Overall, this is a straightforward class to succeed in. It's not necessarily "easy," but if you do the readings, study hard and go to lectures, you succeed. It can be easy to slip up and stop doing the readings, and you'll quickly fall behind. You do learn a lot, and it's worth taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: MKTG 2209 with Sean was a delight. Sean is both an amazing teacher and person. He makes class fun and truly cares about his students. His discussion-based class, personal life examples, application activities, and willingness to answer any and all questions helped me succeed in this class. His dedication to team effectiveness was a plus.

Sean is one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern! He is super encouraging and makes it easy to share your thoughts. Sean definitely cares about his students and cares about your development throughout the learning process. I would highly recommend his class to anyone who wants to internalize and apply the marketing material.

As someone who took MKTG2201 Fall 2021 semester, I can say the transition back to a classroom setting was not easy but Sean made it bearable! This class is discussion and group project based so get ready to connect with your classmates! Sean really does care about each student and is always available after class - great guy to get coffee with!

To do well in this class you MUST participate and do the readings. The group project is an important part of the class. The professor harps on team effectiveness in which he will prepare you for. Tests are multiple-choice and difficult, but they typically get scaled. If you participate, do the readings, and work hard you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Sean is a great professor. He wanted all of his students to succeed but you have to put in the work. He cares a lot about his students & really cares about the learning process & their development. We learned about team effectiveness and used it during our group projects which enabled the groups to work more efficiently and productively.

Sean is a great professor. He wanted all of his students to succeed but you have to put in the work. The course is extremely reading heavy so make sure that you come prepared for class. The class is discussion based with a short lecture at the end so it's important to have points ready to share from the reading. Also, the USE PEER TUTORING resource

reviews.comment: Sean (as we would be asked to call him) was one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern. Would definitely recommend him, he is a professor who enjoys teaching!

Professor Gallagher definitely knows what he's talking about, having a lot of personal experience. The whole class is discussion based. So, you'll definitely need to read the text or else you'll be lost. Grades are based off a few projects and exams that aren't terrible. The grading system is a little different, but he curves.

reviews.comment: A fantastic professor and I would definitely recommend his class to anyone who actually wants to internalize the marketing material. reviews.comment: The intro to marketing class I took with this professor was discussion based and therefore attendance was mandatory. He was a great professor, answered any question, kept a light mood and taught great

This class isnt very lecture heavy, but rather driven by a lot of discussion of nightly readings. Prof Gallagher usually goes over key points after the discussion occurs, which can be helpful to go over important info for exams. Really encouraging professor, would always recommend

reviews.comment: I learned a lot in his class, and have a new appreciation for marketing! Definitely recommend taking the class with this professor.

Sean Gallagher was one of the best teachers I've had at Northeastern and I'm really glad I had him. Attendance and participation in class are essentially required if you want to get a good grade, but as long as you do those things, as long as you read the textbook, as long as you study a reasonable amount, you'll do fine in class.

Took the class over the summer, super accommodating for people in different time zones. ALOT of class discussion so even if you don't know what to say, say something. Overall great class, amazing professor. Lectures alot but makes the content easy to digest.

reviews.comment: Very understanding and considerate professor. He does have a pretty interesting sense of humor that keeps the class alive. reviews.comment: Sean's class is discussion based, so you definitely need to read the textbook before class. Sean's funny, keeps class engaging, and only lectures what is missed in the discussion or deemed very important. Learned a lot of frameworks for marketing that will help me in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Sean is really great, as was the class! He is so caring in terms of offering help, examples, additional material, and guiding you through the project. The assessments were good if you can apply and remember terms/concepts. The class needs you to participate every day and read the book to understand the comments and short lectures.
Such a kind professor. He really helped me when I was struggling and was always encouraging and understanding. Love him.

It's a tough class no doubt but Sean makes it a bit easier. It is heavy on theory and you would need to memorize quite a bit. There's a marketplace simulation to help apply the concepts discussed in class which is fun. The grading system was different as compared to other classes. A lot of weightage was given to class participation so be active.

reviews.comment: ADORE HIM! Such a kind soul, his exams can be challenging but he curves generously. Always willing to help and makes class so fun and engaging. Make sure to participate!!

Sean is very sweet and encourages class participation a lot. His lectures can get slightly dragged but if you read the assigned text for the day and make a comment in class, you're good to go. The marketing simulation is not too bad if everyone in the group participates and the quizzes are hard but he curves generously.

He's a very nice guy. If you do the assignments, which can be tedious but are manageable, you will most likely get an A. He definitely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. I would highly recommend him.

Professor Gallagher's class is certainly unique. He's big on participation and will cold call people throughout class. As long as you do the reading and offer one comment per class, the experience will not be difficult. Don't think it'll be easy to hide in the background as almost everyone speaks during class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Sean Gallagher's classes were the highpoint of my week. It is a discussion-based platform making class fly by and actually enjoyable while learning. Homework reading was turnkey and was not burdensome at all. It is not often you get a professor who is so willing to help. I've never had a kinder professor in my life. My favorite class 100%
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had Sean for my Introduction to Marketing class during the summer of 2020, and he soon became one of my favorite professors during my time in NEU. I never got bored with his deliverables and personal anecdotes. He did an excellent job connecting the course materials with real-life examples. I highly recommend him to everyone!

I had the pleasure of having Sean for two semesters. He was an amazing prof! Participation is crucial in order to get an A and he can be a tough grader at times. But with that said he makes the classes fun and he's very knowledgeable in his field. He's always around to meet outside of class and I highly recommend meeting him to pick his brain!

I had Sean last semester for introduction to marketing. Going into the semester, naturally, I searched him on rate my professor and saw some really horrible ratings. I am no genius so i was worried when I got him. With the semester done and my grade an A, I PROMISE his class will become one of your favorites, and the man won't fail you.
Great professor that really values class discussion. Take him if you can, he wants to see everyone succeed!

He's a top-notch discussion facilitator and genuinely cares about students' learning. Extremely knowledgeable and shows great enthusiasm for the material. Reasonable workload: 4 written assignments, 1 final project and discussion prep. I don't normally enjoy participation-heavy courses, but I found his to be a uniquely positive experience.

Sean makes it clear that the class is "discussion-based." Instead, the course is "find something from the chapter to bring up in class and wait for your turn to say it." reviews.comment: He required a lot of participation, and to do well on the quizzes/exam you need to understand the textbook very well. However, he was very approachable, easily accessible outside of class, and always took the time to address any questions we had.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof Gallagher is very well informed, which makes his discussion-based class less boring. His way of teaching forces you to learn through the textbook & take notes cuz thats the only way youll do well in the 5 quizzes (30%) and cumulative final (25%). Attendanceicipation is worth 20% and the rest goes towards the Marketplace Simulation game.
I usually don't participate, but Sean encourages it and makes it easy to do. Very recommendable if you want to actually learn about marketing.

Although he might seem like a nice and genuine guy, Sean doesnt care about his students and their grades. He fails to understand the importance of guidelines and grading criteria. Prof. Garey is great! She always brought the best energy to every single class and she is super knowledgeable about National Security. I took this + Arab League at the same time. She's goated.

Prof Gary is great but this class can b a bit much sometimes. there's a lot of outside work since the class is once a week, and you have to do a lot of outside research to learn about the countries. reviews.comment: Prof. Garey must have changed! In 2021, no tests; the only assignments were open-note, untimed, 10 question reading quizzes, and weekly discussion posts. reviews.comment: This class was manageable but you had to read a chapter of the textbook every week (60+ pages). Prof Garey is so nice and helpful when you chat with her, but wasn't very accommodating with holidays/wellness days. Easy class but you have to do the readings. Prof Garey's so sweet

Her lectures are dense of information and sometimes you got lost because she usually throws in a lot of examples and anecdotes that are not relevant. Her recitations are worse. reviews.comment: Best teacher ever! Always available, gives great feedback and pushes your comfort zone. Class is not about being the best but more about improving where you are so next time you are that much better.

Prof Garey is nice and definitely knowledgable but isn't a great lecturer. However, her slides are helpful & her TAs are awesome. reviews.comment: Garey is a very sweet person, but for an intro class International Relations is absurd. You are required to read over 100 pages per week and unless you listen to every word uttered you will not do well on tests. She doesn't provide study guides, may switch the content of a test the night before, and doesn't curve or provide extra credit.

Professor Garey is a really good lecturer and is very nice. Her lectures are interesting and she's easily accessible by email. However, her tests are incredibly hard and she doesn't offer any curve or extra credit. If you don't pay attention and take good notes in class and study hard for tests, you won't get a good grade.
Prof Garey is an amazing teacher. I have never had so much fun learning before. There will be lessons from her class that will stay with me for a lifetime.
Prof. Garey is a great lecturer and cares about her students! There is a lot to read but her explanations are clear and she is always available to help during office hours.

Not a great IR prof, fell really behind bc of snow days, but wasn't able to catch up. I didn't learn anything profoundly new, everything we covered I'd heard of elsewhere, here it was all condensed. She's really nice and cares a lot, but IR just wasn't the class she was meant to teach

reviews.comment: My favorite professor at NEU thus far. Attendance is mandatory, but class is typically really interesting and an open discussion so it's worth going to. Great sense of humor, and very good at answering questions. Tests are very fair, and she's very easy going on her essay grades. If you put in some effort, there's no reason you shouldn't get an A
really fun professor, great teacher

Her lectures can get less structured and many in-class activities are high school like, but Professor Garey is a great person. If you need any help, she will always make time for you. The only reason you should not get an A in this class is if you put in no effort. Word of advice, GO TO MEET WITH HER! She is extremely helpful and loves the effort.

Great dude. It's necessary to pay attention in class and write everything down because a lot of the test questions are definitions that he says in his own words. Also attendance is mandatory. Tests & homeworks weren't hard and the collaborative quizzes were fun. Would def take again.

Lectures were over complicated and under explained. Took AP stats in high school and somehow that did not help at all. Homeworks come from textbook but he rarely teaches straight from the textbook. He likes to teach his own way, use own definitions, and his own examples. Textbook will not help you at all for his self-written tests and quizzes.

The whole class was a mess. He expected us to know STATA without teaching it. He overcomplicated the math while repeatedly getting the problems wrong. Then for the tests he would tell us exactly what was on it, because no one knew the material, then he would forget a part and we'd get points off because of it. Overall, nice guy, bad professor.
good professor
had him for econ online over the summer. very engaging course for it being asynchronous.

Prof Roy is great for any class. He is very clear on what will be on the exam so you don't waste precious study time. The lectures are interesting, attendance is required but it really isn't hard to show up to class. 3 exams + a final but that means everything is weighted a little less. You'll be pleased with a semester with Roy.

Prof. Roy is awesome. His econometrics lectures were more than bearable at 8am, he was a very fair grader, and there wasn't a ton of homework. Most of the course & grade is based around a research paper that is spread throughout the semester. If you end up with Roy, you will be happy. He knows his stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took for Summer 2. Really funny and passionate guy, wish I was a business major just so I could take more classes with him. AI projects were kinda weird but I like how he had us apply our thinking elsewhere. absolutely love this dude!
I'd absolutely take another class from this professor and I wish I had him in-person. The lectures were entertaining and thorough; it's also very feasible to get a good grade.

Had Roy in-person for Microecon Theory. He was a great professor - very enthusiastic about the material he was teaching, plus he was hilarious. Easy to reach outside of class and fair grader. Overall one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern.

Took this class online for summer 2. Great experience and he had very interesting lectures even for an asynchronous course! I'm sure in person he would be even better. Nice guy cares a lot about his students, would take again!

Roy was the best. Took this as an asynchronous summer course. There are a lot of assignments to stay on top of, but he explains everything in lectures so well, better than most econ professors I have had at NEU. Take him if you can!!

I took online. Canvas was very organized. Work is posted weekly and is manageable. He's understanding and flexible. His projects use ChatGPT which was very interesting. His projects consist interdisciplinary thinking and connects econ with social justice, AI/tech, ethics, etc. I like how he thinks out of the box and branches out beyond economics.

This class was amazing. Professor Jedras has a great deal of real-world experience and was able to apply his knowledge in the classroom. Take his class! He's an amazing professor and truly cares for all of his students.

Loved Professor Jedras! He is very humorous and kind, and genuinely cares about his students. He is very knowledgeable and his lectures were engaging. There are a lot of quizzes and exams but they were pretty easy. We also had 3 group project presentations but they didn't take too long. So glad I took this class!
Jedras CARES. He supports his students outside of class, wants to see them succeed, and will give you the resources to do so. If you want great life advice and an easy A he is amazing!

Prof Jedras is the best, he is extremely kind and caring with all his students. Although the class material is dry he always fills in with his personal experience which is extremely vast. All tests and quizzes are easy and he gives free extra credit on each one. Genuinely the best prof I have had, make an effort to talk to him outside of class.
Loved him, would take any class w him
Free A, easy class, online unmonitored tests, attendance not required, some group projects, no HW
Easy class, free A, attendance not required, mainly group projects.
TAKE THIS CLASS!!! So easy and the professor is the best. Legit so easy and he cares about his students and tries to teach us life lessons and not just school work.

George Jedras is Awesome! He is caring and goes out of his way to chat with every student he can with a constant smile. He makes lectures fun and engaging, always interjecting his stories and personal business experiences. Quizes are easy and even though his class is supposed to be 3 hours long, he almost always let us out 90 minutes early. 10/10!

Professor Jedras is such an amazing professor. He cares and wants his students to do well. You will always have extra credit on exams, easy graded projects. Easy A. I am in his 3.5 hour one week class, I would have dropped if it was not him. 100% recommend.

i love this professor, he is so wholesome and cute and talks about daily news which keeps me updated on life. valuable life lessons and you get to hear news everyday I love it so much I attend to every class.

I took him once a week for 3.5 hours. The lectures, tests, and group projects are easy. If you are seriously interested in learning about international business beyond common sense observations, I would not recommend INTB1201. He is an interesting and knowledgeable person with industry experience.
Very easy and chill class. Although it's lecture heavy, it's very easy going. If you need to leave class, you can.

Super chill and informative professor, gave us the chance to network with everyone through group presentations (which are simple and not strictly graded). Exams/quizzes were all online, with some take-home exams as well. If needed, please take this class to secure your easy A.

Prof. Jedras is really caring and really wants you to do well in your class. There are a few large group projects and exams/quizzes, but for all the assessments you are given the content that's going to be on them. Attendance isn't required but please go to his lectures! Also gives extra credit on almost every quiz/test.

Very nice man and super easy professor. The class is chill which is nice. He's a super easy grader as well. The pace and style of the class made it so that if you liked the subject material you would remember it but if not you would cram then dump. I liked him but if you're looking for a class that's a little more serious/challenging don't take it.
Prof Jedras is an amazing teacher who cares about his students so much. Guaranteed an A, and his tests are very easy - multiple choice online taken from textbook.

So kind and caring. Prof. Jedras does his best to understand his students and made class enjoyable and not overwhelming at all. Incredibly genuine and just wants the best for everyone -- Lenient grader and interesting guest speakers. Love him

Prof. Lustilla is the best professor I've ever had. Both discussions and coursework are extremely thought-provoking and interesting! Discussions are very open and unbiased, and he takes the time to thoughtfully work through everyone's considerations. He honestly just cares about his students and wants them to learn and succeed. Take this class!

He's genuinely one of the best professors I've ever had-- super laid-back, his priority is having students actually engage with the material. He also very clearly cares and wants to get to know his class. If you haven't had a chance, definitely take a class with prof Lustila!

Professor Lustila is super kind, caring, chill, and funny. He's very passionate about philosophy and extremely knowledgable in regards to the material being taught. Class time is just a discussion based off of the readings that are really interesting and genuinely get you thinking.

My favorite human and my favorite professor at Northeastern. Every time I went to class I learned something new about life and about myself. He is brilliant and kind and everything desirable in a philosophy professor. I am so thankful I was able to learn from him.

If you want a class where the prof is extremely passionate and knowledgable about the material, this is the one for you. I took Indigenous Philosophy during the first semester it was offered, and it was my favorite class by far. Getty is hilarious, his readings are very accessible, and he totally opened my mind to all sorts of new ways of thinking.
Professor Lustila gives great feedback and I would strongly recommend taking his class

reviews.comment: This is my first time leaving a review, but I love Professor Lustila so much I had to add on to the praise. He gives excellent feedback, is funny and passionate about the material, and a genuinely kind person who cares about his students. Missing class is hard because he doesn't use slides, but I never missed a class because I enjoyed it so much!

Fantastic class! Fantastic professor! Gives very constructive + helpful feedback on essays, and lots of it, but your grade never suffers for it. Genuinely wanted to improve my essays to get a compliment from him. I love him he was great! Funny too. Lectures went beyond just the material and wanted you to have a better scope on happiness and life.

Getty was a great professor. His lectures were very interesting and I found myself always wanting to participate in his discussions.

Getty is one of the best professors at Northeastern. He cares about his students and is always willing to help them with anything. Overall 10/10 person and professor

reviews.comment: The best class I've ever taken with the best professor. He is so kind and understanding and wants his students to succeed and learn. Going to his classes were always the highlight of my week.

Getty was so so good as a professor. His classes were very engaging and he made sure to address any and all inputs from students. I definitely grew as a person while in his class this semester. Take it if you can!

reviews.comment: Getty is incredible. He is by far the best professor I have EVER had. His lectures are truly amazing and enlightening. Great Professor! Really cares about his students. Makes you work for the grade but worth the time and effort. Highly recommend if you really want to learn how to create an effective strategy!

Giglio isn't an easy professor and you can tell he's proud of it. So, if you can’t handle constructive criticism than you're not going to do well in his class or in the real world for that matter. Professor Giglio has high expectations and expects students to step up to the plate. Far and away the best professor I had at Northeastern.

The class was great and professor amazing. I would advise that you participate whenever you can and do the readings. Professor Girgenti is really understanding and have a deep passion for what she teaches.
Honestly, I like Professor Girgenti because she is down-to-earth and an honest teacher. Take her for sure.
Honestly a great teacher. Willing to help student anytime and does whatever it takes to help you understand the material. Taking her again next semester. Highly recommended.
Awesome Professor! Comes to class everyday with a great attitude, and makes course very interesting. Highly recommend!

I've had this prof. for 2 semesters now and I highly recommend her. She makes literally the most boring topic (research methods) interesting. Awesome professor. She is extremely helpful and organized, and presents material (which would otherwise be extremely dull) with a lot of enthusiasm. great prof. very organized and clear, highly recommend
Awesome person. Two group projects, one is 15% of final grade, and it isn't challenging to get a good grade. Lectures can be hard to focus on sometimes. Guest lectures were great.

While the lectures can be long, Professor Nyaga is a great teacher and person. He really wants people to learn and cares about everyone. His tests and quizzes are manageable and so is the class. He is a very flexible teacher and would highly recommend.

His tests and exam were kinda hard but if you kinda pay attention in class and study later ur good.
LOVE HIMMMM BEST PROFESSOR

Professor Nyaga is a great guy! Clearly loves about supply chain. reviews.comment: Professor Nyaga is one of the best teachers Ive had at northeastern. He genuinely cares for his students and loves to teach. He is very reasonable and eager to help you succeed. His lectures are PowerPoint based and he moves through the material quickly but its not a terribly difficult class. As long as you do the work youll get an A.
His lectures are in PowerPoint format. They are very nice and make sure to take notes. He is a fair grader, makes you work for your grade but class is interesting.

Professor Nyaga is awesome. Comprehensive knowledge in healthcare management and supply chain and could always provide insightful thoughts in the industry. I attended the class in Spring 2020 when COVID-19 began to spread around the world and he used this as a good case to demonstrate the important of each part of the healthcare supply chain.

Very caring and kind professor, he is genuinly interested in teaching what he teaches. He is a fair grader, but the course is definetly not an easy A. Exams and quizzes are relatively hard but if you read the textbook carefully, you'll do well. Only a midterm and a final and 2 quizzes that aren't worth much in your grade. Good professor.

8am class mandatory attending. 4 quizzes, not hard but not easy. 1 hard final. 1 easy final paper. If you worked too hard u'll get a B+ max.

worst teacher! test are hard. final is impossible don't recommend the teacher

Great professor.  He really cares about students and wants you to do well.  He makes class fun by getting to know his students and keeping class interesting.
Wow! One of the best teachers at NEU. He knows his stuff and you learn a lot in his class. He is very very very nice and always goes out of his way to help. Enjoy!

very arrogant and rude to students.

Professor Gin was a passionate and knowledgeable lecturer who taught interesting topics. I have two main concerns about him. One, he talks very fast without break. Professor Gin is awesome, his lectures are quite interactive and leaves students with smiles on their faces. It always shows when a professor appreciates his students and values their time. I took this course during NU accelerate online to fulfill a core requirement. I was amazed by the environment created, as Matthew's passion for teaching is very apparent. He is a great professor and leaves heartfelt feedback on assignments. Best professor I've had a Northeastern!

One of my favorite teachers so far. He is insanely knowledgable about the content and although he tends to read off his notes a lot, the lectures are very engaging and easy to understand. He's the nicest guy ever, and if you go to him for office hours he's very helpful and he's even given me girl scout cookies before
The class wasn't the easiest but Larry taught well and was open to all questions. He even made time outside class for a review before the final.
Normal amount of homework. Normal professor, my grade was so low because i didn't study enough or take it serious as much as I should have. You could easily get an A or B.
decent professor pretty good at teaching, all test and quizzes are online except for final, group project is not too bad

Ginsberg is the best. I dropped Managerial with another teacher in a previous semester, and taking it with him made all the difference. Professor Ginsberg is one of the best professors I've ever had. He takes the time to make sure you really know the material, gives real-world examples, and all of the material on the tests is covered in his lectures. He has you do problems on your own as you learn the material, which ensures that you're prepared for the exams and case studies!

Ginsberg is an extremely kind professor and if you care about his class he will care about you. His lectures are pretty dry but the course overall is very manageable. Professor Ginsberg is someone who honors his commitment to the university and his students very seriously. He believes in providing real value and life advice to his students, and does so in an engaging and interactive way. I cannot recommend him enough.
moves very fast but is thorough and provides a ton of in class problems and examples to help you! very fair grader, cares lots about his students and genuinely wants everyone to do well!

Amazing guy. Even though he is a tough grader, as long as you participate and add valuable insight to discussions you can get an A. He is very clear on how the course will go and how things are weighted and graded, and definitely not here to trick you.

You honestly just need to do the work. Like if he sees you read the readings and if you speak once or twice in class you will do good. The class is very interesting and I do recommend you have him for ORGB

Loved Professor Glick. I feel like this was one of those classes where I actually learned things that I will remember once class is over. Lectures were very engaging. Participation is a big part of the class.

I worked my but off in this class, and he set me up with a bunch of foreigners in my group who killed us for our presenations.  The he killed my GPA b/c it counts for two.  Do whatever you can to take somebody else like Griffith.
Worse Techer ever!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Talk about a class that you think is great, has easy material, and not a lot of work. Now, talk about this asshol* as a grader.  This teacher will give you open-book tests that are designed to**** YOU!!!! Then, he grades you on how much he likes you.

She is the sweetest woman EVER. Made class so much fun and she is so accommodating. Truly a real-life Mrs Frizzle and I feel like I learn so much in her class. I took a gamble with this class given I had no clue what it was but god am I so happy I did,if you have the chance to take her please don't second guess it.She is so smart and awesome.
she's great just wish she was a stricter grader tbh
GOAT, no need to say anything else.
GOAT!!! Great class so awesome

Dr. Glowacki, one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern, is a wonderful teacher who makes class engaging through her lectures and the topics she discusses. She's also a chill and caring professor who's flexible about assignment due dates and grades. As long as you demonstrate your commitment and effort, you'll do well!

Glowacki tried her best to make the (very dry) material interesting during class time. Sometimes we would talk about something super interesting but most of it was basic communication type of stuff. Very understanding and caring person as everyone else has said!
I second all these reviews! Prof Glowacki cares a lot about her students and has a great sense of humor. All she wants is for you to participate and show mutual respect!!

Professor Glowacki is THE BEST! Take her class and work hard, and you will definitely get an A in the end. Plus, she is super caring and understands her students. She is flexible about grades but also gives good feedback.
A little disorganized, but fun and easy class with a fun professor. Really cares about you and your interests.

Took COMM1225. Great instructor, definitely knows the content. Asynchronous lecture almost every week day, 3 tests, 2 quizzes. Prof is accessible outside of class and the lectures prepare you well for the tests, just take notes (oh and the tests are open notes).
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Took COMM1225. Asynchronous lecture almost every week day, 3 tests, 2 quizzes, all open notes. Lectures prepared you well, just take notes. Prof was funny and definitely made herself accessible.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Prof. Glowacki was one of the best professors I had at Northeastern. She creates a safe place for everyone to talk about personal things and then apply it to class concepts, therefore makes us actually learn and have fun while doing it. Very funny, few homework, easy grader, and just the chillest prof ever.

Professor Glowacki is a fantastic professor. She really cares about the well-being of her students and creates a comfortable atmosphere for students to share personal experiences with health communication. She is a great listener and loves participation in discussions. I highly recommend taking classes with her or just getting to know her!
Prof. Glowacki is an amazing teacher, a genuinely kind person, and an inspiring researcher. 10/10 would recommend.

Took this class Summer I 2019 This class was so fun, easy, and knowledge. This was the one of the few classes that changed by insight on what healthcare can be truly be. Prof G was the best, she was very accessible, and took time to connect with everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Glowacki is a fantastic professor. She sets clear expectations for her students and her lectures are interesting and engaging. This class was very helpful for future healthcare providers and those with any interest in health alike. I would recommend her to anyone who has the opportunity to take a class with her!!!

Best professor I have ever had at Northeastern! I definitely recommend. She cares about her students, she is hilarious, and lectures are so productive and fun! Even though there is a lot of writing because it is an intense writing class, I absolutely LOVED it!

Favorite class and professor so far. She is very caring and is more than willing to be a resource to help with anything from cover letters to recommendations. The class itself isn't the most difficult, but it helped me become more comfortable and confident presenting in front of others. You can't get much better than Glowacki; take her if you can!

Super easy class. Provides comprehensive reviews of the topics/problems that will be presented on each exam. Only 2 exams and a noncomprehensive final. One group case study that he gives more than enough time for. Worst part is sitting through boring lectures and rants every class. HW due every week. Bad Prof but easy class, take him.
Super nice super chill teacher. Class is just yapping so might not learn much but the class itself is very simple and easy to learn/understand. HWs are simple, and exams are easy. underrated prof

This guy is extremely difficult, if you have the option to avoid his class, I would. He spends most of his time discussing his history with general electric and osramslovania along with his kids accomplishments. He rarely responds to emails, gaslights any confrontation of an error, and doesn't teach or care about how his students are doing. Avoid!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I wish I could take an exam on his life because he talks about it for 80% of the class time. Very picky about how he wants things done, specifically with the Excel assignments. The subject itself is not difficult at all compared to financial accounting. The exams are relatively easy and straightforward.

Easy A, the hardest part is sitting through class. He's a chill guy but just talks SO much. I somehow made it to every single class and we usually got out early, he's a caring and good guy, but doesn't know his audience. Must but Mcgraw hill. Almost all serious due dates were flexible. Final exam study guide didn't really help.

super easy class but such a boring professor. if you can drag yourself out of bed and sit through his life stories to get the attendance points, it's the easiest accounting class you'll ever take. beware that all assignments are on mcgraw hill, so you'll need to pay for that. but otherwise such an easy class

The practice tests and study guides helped a lot. Got sick once, emailed him about it, he ignored it, and dropped my attendance grade even though I literally couldn't get out of bed. Honestly talks more about his life than accounting. I basically know his whole life story that I didn't ask for, because he tends to ramble a lot during classes.

Professor Glencross truly loves accounting and cares about his students. He tells you what to study to help prepare for exams, is pretty understanding, and is available outside of class. The cons are that his class sometimes lacks engagement, and he doesn't provide many extra resources/practice questions other than the textbook and slides.

He was a super chill professor and was pretty flexible when things came up for students. He moved a midterm and was super accommodating for students that had already made plans. His lectures felt a little long sometimes, but he's a nice guy and I learned a lot in his class.

He is a very nice guy but his lectures don't really help with exams. For quizzes he does let you know what's going to be on it which is helpful. The average for the last quiz was so bad that he had to drop it the average was around 40%. Overall, he is a nice guy but not a good professor.

Professor Glencross is passionate about accounting and loves to talk about his work experience/life advice. Weekly assignments and group project are easy good grades. He tells you questions on every exam (including final), but lots of the material is self taught and many test questions are not straight forward. Lots of work put in outside class.
absolutely terrible. he does not know how to teach and thinks his students care about his family's accomplishment. i dont care! can u pls teach

I don't see why glencross doesn't have a higher rating on here. For all quizzes/exams he tells you exactly what to study for each question, minimizing study time. Weekly homeworks aren't hard. Gives out bonus points throughout the semester for the final. Lectures get repetitive but he's j a sweet old man. J show up to class & study what he says

This professor is mean forget about sick days or even wellness days if your not there even one time your grade will go down. The homework is honestly not bad but the test and quizzes were difficult. Overall not the hardest class ever if you are willing to put the work in but he was just not a good professor.

Glencross is boring and talks so much without any of the information he says being important.He doesn't even review the slides he's presenting before class, and spends more time talking about his son's accomplishments than accounting.I survived his class by self studying everything before the test.Don't take this class if your goal is to stay awake

Not a hard professor, but does repeat the same personal anecdotes over and over again throughout the year. He's passionate about what he teaches, but doesn't know how to structure his lectures very well. Relies heavily on the slides and usually ends up repeating them back to you, so just take notes on what is posted online and you'll be fine.

He is a very nice guy, but does not know how to teach. He spends the entire class telling personal anecdotes and attempts to connect them to the lecture but it does not work. He repeats the same stories over and over all semester and barely teaches you how to do the actual material.

Glencross may be a bit eccentric in his lectures, but he gets the point across. For each of the exams, he provides a study guide as well as goes through the content that will be covered. This was extremely helpful in preparing for exams. He hosts office hours 3-4 times per week, and you can always get your questions answered. Definitely take him!

Yes, his lectures are not super engaging, but he gives out GREAT study guides (basically the exam). He does not deserve a 2.8 rating. He is pretty boring, but you will learn a decent amount and get a good grade. Take this class for an A. It's accounting, no professor's lectures are interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very boring professor, not difficult but spends the entirety of class rambling about irrelevant  life stories and advice. Didn't learn much from this course, but not hard to do well.
No comment.

This was my second time taking Financial Accounting. he is WHY I PASSED! Thank you so much Dr. Glencross... He taught so well and easy to understand. He didn't move on until everyone got it and he kept lectures interesting. Great guy.

His lectures are boring at times, and he does talk about his personal life stories a lot. His class isn't difficult if you put in some slight work though, and he's an extremely fair grader who really does want to help his students out.

Dr. Glencross is my fav prof. The last few reviews had to be written by the same dude... He relays life stories and talks about his personal life, without fail. But it did not take up a majority of classes. We spent most time clarifying back and forth with the Prof. He wouldn't move on unless we got it. Will tell you what's on the exams!

Avoid Professor Glencross's financial accounting class at all costs. His teaching is appalling, with nearly all discussions focused on his USELESS "life stories" &  achievements rather than the actual course. The class's performance throughout the semester was abysmal.

AVOID Professor Glencross's financial accounting class. He's a poor teacher, focusing mainly on his son's achievements, not the actual course material. The class final average was a dismal 67, with some test exam scores as low as a paltry 37. I got a C+ in the class, my lowest Northeastern grade. Professor Glencross should be fired immediately.

DO NOT RECOMMEND!!! worst accounting class ever. going to class felt pointless, never taught during lectures, only shared life stories (the same ones throughout the whole semester). felt extremely unprepared for the final had to teach myself. northeastern needs to get rid of this guy.. HE CAN'T TEACH!!!  and i never wanna look at accounting again.

Lectures consist of 60% monotonic speaking, 20% completely irrelevant, gibberish personal stories (such as how his son got a job [nobody cares dude]), and 10% pithy life lessons that can be deduced by a middle schooler. The best thing Northeastern can do is fire this guy as he is doing a disservice to his students.

I took his ACCT1201 class. The guy is a former shoe salesman (so he has said), which should tell you all you need to know. He's a nice guy (sometimes) but teaching is not about being nice, it's about educating your students. At that he is a complete failure.

Professor Glencross was a terrible professor and I'm so glad I will never have to take his class again. Super boring and the material is very tedious. This class is made worse due to the fact that everything we learned how to do is now done on a computer so the material is outdated. I hated this class and prof Glencross is not a good teacher at all

Lots of stories but always cover what we have to! Most application learning can only be done through homework anyways. Spoon-feeds exam content as much as possible and provides so much information on grades and expectations. Lectures are fine, it's a boring subject but he makes it enjoyable! Won't move on until you get it. Very sensible and sweet!

Prof. Glencross does care about his student's success, but he simply reads his slides instead of explaining what the slide is trying to convey. He brings up examples from his own days as an accountant that lead to other tangents about his own experiences instead of the concepts we need to learn. Learn by doing the homework and textbook problems.

Prof Glencross is one of my favorite prods. a sweet man with the best of intentions for his students. you can tell he wants us to learn, not just from the textbook/lectures, but also from his experiences. he strays from the class material, but the only way to really grasp accounting is by practicing anyway. plus keeps us awake from boring material!

Glencross is nice but his lectures are about 60% him talking about his career in accounting, 30% him telling a story he told last class but forgot, and 10% teaching the material. His tests are quite easy throughout but the final is made by the department head and you will know nothing because of his non teaching style. Prepare to teach yourself.

He is a very nice and organized professor who cares about his field and the material he teaches. Sometimes he can go off on tangents, but his stories are entertaining and we always remain well on schedule. He hopes that we all become future accountants.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Glencross is very caring and easy to talk to. I always felt comfortable in his class and he always wanted the best for his students. Lectures can be boring and the class requires a lot of studying but having him as a professor made the class more enjoyable. He is super nice and respects his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor does not teach very effectively. Class time wasn't very efficient as he tended to read off his presentation slides and repeat the same stories of his life as an accountant. He seems very knowledgeable about accounting but is not great at teaching the material. I learned more from self-studying on Youtube than from his lectures.

He doesn't really teach you how to do the actual maths in accounting but is more focused on theory so you'll have to teach yourself. He also tends to go off-topic by repeatedly talking about his experiences. However, he is very kind and wants his students to pass. There is a lot of homework but it is very helpful when it comes to exams.

ACCT 6200 - He's just great. I want to retake his class just for the stories about Sylvania, GE, and his current AP consulting project - hilarious. Do the HW.. He's extremely reasonable and he wants his students to succeed in understanding the way financial statements flow - he's not interested in making you memorize useless accounting jargon.

Prof Glencross is definitely a little old school but he's very kind. He makes his own study guides so the exams were very doable and the homework's easy. Tells a lot of personal stories but still covers everything he needs to in lecture. He made accounting bearable.

The guy is super outdated in every aspect in his life. Incredibly boring and inapplicable, goes on about the same stories from his life over and over again. Homework is alright, but will not curve any grades. We had a 60% mean for an exam and he just does not care if it is hard or not.
Nice guy but assigns A TON of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Really nice guy but he spends entire class telling stories of his experiences. Long winded stories that are somewhat relevant only because he was an accountant. Heavy use of power point, each slide he would tell a story. I had to do a lot of learning on my own because we couldn't get to relevant material. Not necessarily a tough teacher though
Because, He explains the topic with the examples which is easily understandable and also he is very much friendly
Super easy grader, but he has no idea what he's talking about. Drones on and on about his work experience, which is almost entirely unrelated to the subject matter.

took cost accounting with Mr. Glencross.  he relies on power point a lot, but did an overall fair job compared to others at NEU who use power-point as a brain substitute.   you can tell he enjoys teaching and is not just coming to class to earn his tenure.  if he lectured he'd have been that much better because i think he really knows his stuff.

Professor DeWalt was really great in how she ran Cell Bio. The textbook that was given is a bit heavy and you'll be reading a lot every week, but the assignments and tests are very straightforward.

She was easy to get in touch with if you needed anything, and gave good feedback on assigments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Cell bio is pretty straightforward but she makes it interesting. Not a hand holder (thank God). Fair grader, encourages questions. Awesome instructor!
Love her! By far the best teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor DeWalt was AWESOME! She's tough but fair. Taking another class with her this fall. One of my favorite teachers at Northeastern!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Gloria was a good teacher. Worth taking a class with her if you can. Go to her office hour! (she can meet with you different times if her office hours don't work). She's a tough but fair grader. I would suggest that if you have any issues with points lost that you talk to her, prob one of few teachers that will actually hear you out.

Prof DeWalt was great. She really cares for her students and gives amazing feedback. The lectures are very thorough and she will give hints to questions that she puts on the exam. Amazing Professor overall.

I really cant say enough good things about Professor DeWalt. The best instructor I have had in a long time. She really cares about her students and works to make sure everyone understands the material and engage with each other even without being in-person. Highly recommend any class with her. Worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I can't say enough good things about Prof. DeWalt. Really. She is that teacher who genuinely cares and take the time to invest in their students, but doesn't offer free rides. The best. Period.

Gloria really cares about the students. She wants you to learn the material and not just memorize it. She provides detailed notes along with the lecture slides and makes sure to highlight key points that will be on the test. She always makes time for students outside of class and allows for ample extra credit opportunities. Good teacher and person.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: She's actually a pretty good teacher. She knows a lot, slides are super clear and she shows interesting videos in class. Unlike other professors I have had, she actually is nice too and she answers people's questions without making them feel stupid. She also pretty much tells you what to focus on for the exam AND she let us have a page of notes!!

Prof. DeWalt makes you work for your A. But honestly she's great and when I reached out to her for help she did everything she could to help me. She doesn't curve but she does offer extra credit and it is possible to get an A! I love Prf. DeWalt!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: HONESTLY THE WORST TEACHER. SHE GIVES RIDICULOUSLY HARD EXAMS. SHE NEVER COMES TO CLASS PREPARED. SHE DOES NOT HELP ANY STUDENTS WITH THEIR WORK. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS... YOU'LL BE LESS INSPIRED ABOUT WHAT YOU'RE STUDYING.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Doubts about his qualifications as a professor. He gives good grades to students who obediently follow without asking questions. Once, during a discussion-style conversation where I was trying to engage in a healthy debate, this professor disadvantaged me by low grading. All the course materials are outdated theories and cases from the 1980s.

If you can stay away from this professor/instructor. For an online course instructor he is by far the worst I've ever had. He is very unclear in grading criteria, he does not give clear feedback with assignments or project, and he always tries to be cryptic in what he is saying. I have never been so frustrated with an instructor like this before.
no tests at all!
Really good

He is a great professor, always relating the material in class with personal experiences making the class fun yet educational. He has a great beard and he knows how to captivate the class with his stories. Although he does run off topic sometimes

This is the worst professor I have ever had.  Kids show up once a month and he marks down perfect attendance.  If you don't hand in an assignment that's fine, you just get graded different.  instead of 4/4 you would get 3/3 if you missed one.  SO for someone that does their work, they can get a worse grade than the slackers!  Boring, no discussion!

gloria is the best!!! I really enjoyed taking the class and I learned so much in that class and also from her. she gives constructive feedback and she's a fairly easy grader who would want all her students to succeed and pass the class. def one of my fav professors at northeastern!!
Great professor!

I absolutely loved Gloria! She's a gem who will come to class enthusiastic each time and ready to teach. You can tell she really cares about her students and how her course is taught. She makes everything very accessible and is super helpful on any topic or assignment. She never makes you feel dumb. Don't stress and enjoy her class!

Very intelligent and passionate about art history, also somewhat intimidating.
