reviews.comment: ENTR2301 was a course requirement for me so I went in thinking it would be a drag, but it was the complete opposite. Professor Golden runs you through the beginning stages of the entrepreneurship & innovation process, giving you the blueprint you need to begin execution of your ideas. Overall a really great professor and would recommend taking him.

Prof Golden is one of the best professors Ive had at Northeastern. He is a tough grader, but if you put the work in he will take care of you. Take his deadlines seriously or your product wont be ready for the panel at the end of the semester. Highly recommend him as a professor. Teaches from real life experience, not from a textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Golden is more "Northeastern" than Northeastern, his course on prototyping is experiential learning to the max. The course isn't easy, but the course prioritizes learning experiences above grades. If your goal is to one day be an entrepreneur, take the opportunity to learn from someone as experienced and talented as Professor Golden.

don't take this class. he will choose a group for you, and if you don't have a good group, IMPOSSIBLE to succeed because the entire grade is based in one giant project. too much work and the grade criteria is not clear. you will have to build a final prototype for this class, and you will have to beg for help in order to get this done.

The best professor at Northeastern. I took his class in summer, so each lecture was around 3 hours, but time would pass so quickly, as his lectures were very fun and interesting. He really wants his students to think outside of the box, it's one of the classes where you learn essential skills that could be applied in real life.

I would definitely recommend taking this class with Professor Golden! The class itself if interesting. There are a couple of homework assignments. However, they are not too difficult. The group assignments are fun and you create your own product. The class really inspired me and allowed me to come up with a few business ideas of my own!

Professor Golden was hands down the best professor I have ever had at northeastern. His teaching style is inspirational and very different from everyone else. He doesn't teach you to get good grades, instead, he teaches you on how to be successful in life!

I had Golden on the Seattle Dialogue (most impactful educational experience). When he told us to relax during stressful times, it was his way of letting us know that all things will pass. Important Note: he wants you to have fun and work things through with your group mates rather than leaving things left unsaid. It is a safe zone to fail often.

Steve was a great prof, definitely an easy B. The group project is definitely a lot of work and your teams quality will impact your experience. The midterm is a crapshoot, as some questions are gotcha questions, but overall the class is really interesting and you learn a ton. It also helps Steve has tons of experience and is super fun.
take him if you can

I just completed this in Seattle. It was a 2 week dialog. Professor Golden is one of the most amazing and compassionate people that I have met in my time at Northeastern . The course is a lot of work but I have learned more in this experience than any other class. Be ready to work as a team and the down side is he picks the teams. But he is

i don't usualy do these but this professor deserves some words . he is tough but he is one of the few professors that cares. Golden reached out to one of his contacts for me and helped me land a coop. As others have said, he puts the work out their but he is there to help, always, and his sht is real - not like most of the other stuff profess

do the work get the grade I rarely take the time to post to these things but this guys deserves some nice words. He is an amazing lecturer, cares about the students, shows respective and will meet with you any time, I heard he bought pizza for one class and took another out to celebrate finals. My only gripe is the amount of work- just do it

prof gouldin is heavy on team projects so make sure you get on a good team, he is great meetin outside of clas and is very responsive to requests for help. He should be a chairman for the department and all courses should be like his. I am planning to take his second class and highly recommend him as a professor
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: got to do the work to get the grade guy is dope always willing to work with you and a really good person that cares - took the class outit after finals

Golden was energetic but his projects were vague. Teams would lose most points because of APA citations and not the actual substance of their projects. He also possessed a lack of humility when it came to student-teacher interactions. There were rare occasions when he would admit to grading errors. Kudos for the alternative midterm, however.
Terrible clarity with grading policies and a ton of work throughout the semester. Good lecturer tho
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: NEU Shark Tank - this is by far the most comprehensive, pressure-packed course that I have taken during my five years at Northeastern. This should be a capstone course. Golden is fun, challenging and pushes you hard and it heavy team centric but if you are going to do your own business, take him. I love this prof
SO MUCH WORK

Nice person, interesting but at times can wander in his lectures which don't always follow the syllabus. Certainly engaging and relevant subjects and he certainly has a passion for innovation. Might be the best professor I have had but can at times be challenging if you expect to follow the syllabus

Pay attention to details. Golden is one of the most engaging and caring professors that I have had in my fours years @ NEU. I was part of the Seattle edition of the product development course and wish that I could do it again (this encouraged me to sign up for the Silicon Valley prog). Teams are important, address issues up front. Details #1.

Mr Golden is not easy by any means, but he is very approachable and willing to help outside of class. The course materials are interesting and flow well. Sometimes he goes fast and skips things but if you ask he will go back. His explanations are comprehensive and relative. He is very experienced and different than other professors in that his

skip the textbook wasn't as helpful and useful as actual class discussions and activities. Great interactive class, one of the best prof I've had during my time at Neu. The only issue I can argue is the toughness while giving essay's grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: dope

By far the best professor I've ever had. I never thought I would ever be saying this but I always looked forward to go to his class. He gives great feedback, he has great experience in the world, and he is extremely funny. Definitely recommend

This is withoutquestion the best course and professor I have had. Although it feels like a lot of tedious work, it is really up to you to take advantage of it. If you put in the time and effort on what may seem tedious, it will all make sense in the end. Especially when you choose your project, make sure everyone on the team is on board.

Professor Golden is very passionate about entrepreneurship. He has a lot of experience to offer and there is never a dull moment in his class! I wish, however, that he was more communicative about assignment due dates and what was expected.

Stephen Golden is the best teacher I've had at NEU. He is so inspiring, intelligent, and funny . He makes everything in class so interesting to learn and very obviously understand everything from real life experience. If you take Innovation!, you have to take it with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: real deal clear direction tough but if you follow his instructions and ask for help he works with students he will call you out if you are no paarticipating can be embarrasing like him a lot wihs he taught more sections
He is great professor who is willing to help students answer every questions. He really cares about students.

goldin is the best professor I have had in my four years at northeastern so far big on team projects and presentations which can be annoying at times with some students but in general makes sense grading can be tough but he is reasonable and willing to help
Professor Golden is one of the best professor one could have. Taking classes with him was an amazing experience.

not easy, just awesome. a really genuine guy who cares but don't try to skip assignments, grades tough. approachable and funny. knows his stuff and works hard to bring it out of students. some people can find him a bit tough and pushy but when I finished the course I realized his method. I like him and recommend him.

took him for summer session and thought that by far he is just one of the most amazing people that I have had the pleasure of meeting. Key takeaway for me from this class was (1) think big, (2) think smart, (3) work hard and (4) don't fall in love with the baby. prof Golden really helped me make sense of it all. Great, fun, inspirational guy
by far the best class I have had yet - much different than expected. might change my major as a result of his enthusiasm, help and encouragement
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Golden is one of the most unique and distinguished professors - he helps you think non linearly, in a 360 degree perspective.

Professor Golden's teaching abilities are beyond words. He is charismatic, experienced, and extremely skilled in conveying ideas through story telling, such that every topic is engaging, important, and easy to remember. Golden's life and entrepreneurial experience truly comes across in his lectures, and it is clear that he knows what he is talking

wish I could take him again. some people say that he is hard, but it is all about committment - work hard and you will want him for all your classes. Only complain t is the amount of the grade based on group work especially if you have people that are just in to get course credits but that happens everywhere. Prof is genuine

Overall, Professor Golden is a great teacher and made class time both interactive and enjoyable. The material and assignments weremore hands-on than any other class I've had, and made my learning much more comprehensive and interesting. However, in terms of grading, I believe too much weight was given to the group project, which accounts for half

Have to put this out there. five years as a husky, no professor comes close to this guy. i am a bio-med major and took this course on advice of a friend and this guy is amazing. approachable, friendly, truely cares about students - my team messed up a presentation bad, this guy pulled us aside and helped us bring up our grade. Awesome man.
Lectures are casual and interesting and he has a lot of great experience, but really not as great as everyone thinks. Grading system is very skewed towards group project
He is a really nice professor with lots of real world experience. You have to put effort into the assignments. Its not an easy A class and a lot of people think it is.
Very funny and approachable. Certainly the most casual professor I've had. Treats students as his equals and challenges students to defend their point of view.
Best professor I've ever had. He is an extremely passionate professor and I would recommend him to everyone I know.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class! I liked how it was very hands-on, engaging and consisting of a pot of different assignments. I probably would have liked to have a bit more case studies or more experiences of the professor. I would recommend doing that instead of the Bridge Building competition, which I found useless. I would also change the textbook,
amazing professor and person - take him

best course yet at neu. PRof Stephen Golden teaches this class in a way that will make you understand what you don't know (what other professors forget to help you learn). The final presentations last week were amazing. The prof had us present to professionals from staples wayfair and tjmax and they provided honest feedback. Prof G is a mentor

took this class lean product design two semesters ago and while I at times didn't agree with prof golden at the time, I am now working in a start-up, and boy was he right -- take this class - Prof Golden teaches the way we should learn, reflecting now, probably the best class I had at NEU - go Huskies, and keep it up Mr Golden
Best professor yet, sometimes a bit challenging to keep up with, highly recommend golden for innovation -- i am also planning on taking his other classes - hit him up, good guy outside of class too

3330 is by far the best class that I have ever taken at either of the two universities that I have attended.  I met some great new friends in this class and we have decided to carry our team project forward (minus one student).  This class is all about how you take and idea and create  a real business.  Golding is a great coach and is always availa
prof golden is by far the best professor that I have had at northeastern

good guy,  practical lectures that make sense, interactive and likes to engage students, tough grader at times but fair and explains rationale even though you might not agree at times but makes you think differently

professor golden is just a great guy and likely the best that I have met during my time at neu - willing to spend time in and out of class, always available - taken him twice and would take him again if I could - admittedly I was struggling early on, he saw it and stepped up.  2301 and 3330 are the best ent courses offered, take golden

all group work, and difficult course.  A fair amount of work, but the final presentation today was likely the best experience I have had in school.  I learned more in this class this semester than in my first three years.  Prof Golden likes to push you and at the beginning I almost dropped it, but glad I ddnt. Genuine guy that loves what he does
Prof Golden is very funny and accessible You learn so much in his class Amazing semester He brought us all to Connor's for the last class
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Super funny and is an amazing resource during and after the class. The class is based around one group project, and you learn so much from it.

Steve is your typical business professor - he isn't always clear with what he wants from his students but you learn how to get good grades with him as you go along. He'll give good feedback but can be a bit tough and honest with it. Other than that, it's definitely one of those "character building" classes.

Goldens by far the best prof at neu. this course is so hands on and by far was the best I had at neu.  You use all your skills and actually get to build a product and present to professionals at the end - recommend that everyone takes this course if you are thinking at all about going into business on your own -- the best!
tough but very smart , tough grader - says dont worry about it but make sure you pay attention

3330 is the hardest class that i have taken at northeastern and the  one that i learned the most - golden lives for innovation and it shows - forces you to do the work and in the end you realize what he has helped you do.  Always available for help outside class. taken him twice, wish he taught more classes - all professors should teach like him

Golden is crazy in a good way. He's in love with innovation and he's always willing to talk about the latest developments in the business world. However this can often distract from his planned lectures, which is fine until you realize that he never explained the group project reqs. Hard grader, the midterm was absolutely ridiculous.

Golden in 3330 was the best class i have taken in all my classes.  the prof makes sense, pushes you to participate, and makes you think on your feet.  this class was my last one at neu and what a way to close out this round of education.  I am thinking about coming back to take him again -- hopefully I return as a success so I can "make him proud"

One of the best professors I've had in my college experience! He really cares about his students and is always available to chat about absolutely anything! Whether it is related to his class or about any topic that crosses your mind. His energy in class motivates you to do your best and going to class is definitely a pleasure!
This guy is so awesome. Focused on real world applications, not just about getting good test grades

Professor Golden is easily my favorite teacher that I had a Northeastern. I have nothing to say but praise about his availability out of class, his mentoring capabilities when approached about things outside of class, his deep knowledge of the material, and his love and dedication for his  students.

Professor Golden is amazing - real world teaching, best class that I have taken at Northeastern.  Lots of group work which can be a challenge at times, but in the end the projects and rpresentaions for your final pulls it all together.  I actually think that I learned something in this class.  Class is hard to get into but if you can take him -

took this course for ent and goldin over delivers - just finished our final presentations today and he had us present to people from staples brookstone eastern bank and others.  not easy course, but best at neu by far.  prof works with you all the way, but gets on people if you slack.  all team work but teams were too big -- love this prof take him

Professor Golden is really a nice guys, he works hard to make the class interesting and listens to the students when they need help/support. Take his classes if you want to work hard and be rewarded for it. There is no simple task but a lot of good conversation that will make you smarter.
Awesome guy and a great professor, classes are fun. Would definitely recommend to a friend

He's awesome and passionate. It was my only class for business that I actually enjoyed & learned from. He's motto is "break the rules/show up to work like you're going to get fired". He was the only "real" teacher I had the pleasure of interacting with at Northeastern. He doesn't like cookie-cutter, and neither do I!

prof goden always wants the students to challenge their thinking. first time i have had such a professor.  he is really different in the way he teaches but when the course was over it is the first time i wanted to keep going to his class.  he always is meeting with students and helping them. i am trying to find more of his classes

amazing. course is lean design and this guy takes you through the entire process of launching a product - without a doubt, my favorite and most real-world educational class I've taken to date. final presentations to buyers from staples, brookstoen and tj max - tough grader, but fair and willing to help - his class is always full but try to take him

Best professor at Northeastern so far.  Hands on, relative and animated.  Sometimes can push hard but by the end of class it all comes together.  I will take him again.  Northeastern should use him as a baseline for teaching.  And he is a good guy, very approachable.  Not sure what else he is teaching.

Professor Golden, is a great teacher and a great guy. His encouragement and help allowed us to explore ourselves as individuals and entrepreneurs. His Experience and his practical way of teaching is the one i loved the most... that has been the most effective of any professor I have had. Good Grasp in lecture. good data analysis.

professor goldens classes are inspirational and fun but dont be fooled, he is a tough businessman.  this class is like shark tank and the final presentations and grade were harder than anticipated you need to pay attention and dont let his humor in class fool you as the grading is tough you need to do the work and pick your team well
toughest course I took at neu so far and should be the standard. guy is tough but works with you to understand - final presentations were an amazing experience --look for this guy and take him
Good professor, he gave us a lot of good praise and advice.
EXCELLENT Professor.  Can't speak highly enough.
Great guy, effective, helpful, approachable, worldly and fun -- totally engaging course, recommend this guy to everyone

Never replies to emails, swears constantly in class, and thinks communication is the most important subject ever. Grades were also never posted until the last 2 days of grading period before the semester ended. Overall, easy class, but boring and not worth the money.

Really a rude professor. Never responded to my emails, and when he did, he responded so rudely. Don't think he cared about students' success. Graded everything at the every last of the semester. Funny guy but does not recommend this class. Got my ever first B in this class...

Professor Steve explains concepts clearly and offers helpful office hours, which I appreciated. However, exams felt harder than necessary, lectures could be sidetracked by stories, and interactions sometimes felt inconsistent. I also found it frustrating that my previous review was removed, which made it harder to share my experience.

Steve is a very entertaining professor. His class isn't too hard as long as you pay attention in lectures or do the readings. There are 3 tests usually, and they are multiple choice, then you have a poster project at the end of the semester. Would recommend his class, also you can find the textbook online for free so don't buy it.

super funny guy with lots of interesting personal stories (stories that actually connected to the lectures themselves). his exams are a little more difficult than expected, but at least they're all MCQ. great personality too, i just wish his presentations were a bit more bearable to look at. no cumulative final, and final project was graded fairly

Steve made the material really fun and engaging in his lectures. His grading criteria and grades felt fair, and I had a good idea of what grade I was going to get based off of the rubrics. He offered study guides to help us prepare for the tests which were really helpful.

Assignments from September graded on literally the last day of classes. Doesn't respond to emails half the time, also rude when he does respond. Grades are arbitrary and no feedback is provided. Unnecessary and strict conduct from this professor when it's a required class. Each class he goes over only like 5 slides. Waste of time, just talks a lot.

grades at the very end, test grades (3 tests, 60% of grade) graded faster, textbook easily found online but you don't rly need it for the 3 tests (use quizlet), tests are all 80 Qs, 4 mult choice: 50 easy, 20 "should study for", 10 specific ex. from class, attendance "optional" (he took it thrice lol), double dip gen ed but unnecessarily tedious

Steve is one of the only teachers I've had where I'm actually engaged in lectures. His lectures were the best! he made jokes and analogies so that everything was super easy to understand. He is super passive-aggressive, though, and was definitely on a power trip sometimes. He will call out students in front of 100 + people.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You NEED to prepare well for the exams. Easy class if you put in the work. His teaching was engaging & not too boring, I respect. He sometimes includes the story he tells in the exams. He is a 4/5 because he's quite passive-aggressive, which is very off-putting, but he's chill I guess. He also doesn't grade anything until the very end.

He didn't respond to a SINGLE one of my emails. For the final group project, one of my group members stopped responding. You'd think professor would respond to emails when the class is asynch. No. He ignored me and gave me a unsatisfactory grade. I've emailed professor 3 times and he responded to none of them.
He was a good professor and had interesting lectures. Fair grader.

The class was pretty easy. As long as you attend class the tests aren't hard. Professor has kind of a rude sense of humor that could be off-putting, but he clearly tries to make class engaging. He will definitely call you out in front of everyone for talking or being off task.

I took this class thinking it was easy A but I was wrong. I am not good at memorization and this whole class is memorization based. I will warn as well that the tests have questions that are very specific to examples given in class, so if you are not in that class you are screwed for that question. the teacher is entertaining but u get bored.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Steve's lectures are amazing and so engaging and I learned so much! It's a huge class so there's no professor-student engagement at all, but it's fine if you sit with friends in class. Very little actual work with a few easy assignments (make sure not to do them late!) but then the exams are very important!

Class itself is pretty easy as long as you memorize definitions. You need to get at least a 94 for an A (he doesn't round) and tests are long and worth a lot of your grade. Steve is very charismatic and his class covers two NUpaths so overall I recommend.

I had Steve last term and loved his teaching style. I thought his personal anecdotes helped me retain the course content easily. He outlines what is going to be on the test so making a quizlet and studying it well is what I suggest to get a good grade. Yes, he grades down to the wire, but I wasn't too pressed!

Had him for COMM1101 and was miserable because of how annoying he was, but took him this semester and I truly think he's more tolerable in smaller lectures. I surprisingly really enjoyed his lectures and he made it fun to listen to (which I would have never said last sem). Lets class out early, take home exams, but he still grades off no rubric.

He was a funny guy, and his class was very interesting, but he can seem stand off is at times. I did not like the way that he spoke to some of the students during his lectures, he seemed like he was annyoed at times. He also takes forever to grade work. I still don't know my grade for his class. His TAs are also rude, but that's a longer story.

Steve is one of the best professors I have had. He makes all of the lectures interesting and even though it's not required to go, I would still show up just because he made them interesting. The tests are multiple-choice and require some studying but they are not hard. He is a great guy and easy to access outside of class. All his notes are online.
great prof, makes the content really relatable and understandable and is very entertaining

Always a good time in Steve's class, looked forward to going to his class. He made all his concepts into a story which made his tests much easier. One large group project, 3 test, and an couple hw assessment. Very manageable.

I had Professor Granelli for asynchronous COMM1101. It was the WORST class I have ever taken. He did not lay out specific guidelines for what needed to be completed and graded harshly on rubrics that were not posted. Unrealistic expectations. 
Exams made up 60% of our grade and the questions asked were so specific it was impossible to memorize.

If you're just looking to fulfill an NUpath requirement like I was, look elsewhere. As require a 94%, and tests are a game of endurance at 100 questions each. Content itself and assignments are interesting enough. Engagement with the lectures/textbook is forced because exam questions will be taken word for word from specific lectures or readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Very funny, uses personal experience to help teach the material, expectations were very clear and he was very approachable

Steve was SO fun! Definitely one of my most engaging professors as he always had funny stories to tell in class that directly went with the material we were learning. I chose to go to every class but if you just looked at his powerpoints and read the textbook you didn't really need to show up.

I love Steve! His examples and the way he can reillustrate the same concept in different ways makes it so the content really sticks -- you onlyy really need to review for exams if you pay attention in class. He makes that easy by being entertaining too. Can be "adult" I guess but nothing like you wouldn't experience in real life. Fun chats too

He is funny and his lectures were entertaining, but the examples he used from his personal life made him look very bad. Definitely had an attitude, but was usually nice one-on-one. Not a difficult class, if you do the work and study a few hours for each test it is an easy A.

Steve is not my favorite professor but he's not that bad. He can be funny but definitely a little rude sometimes if you don't enjoy bluntness. The class is all about the slides and a poster project at the end and his other  assignments are pretty easy. If you just study for a few hours for each test and try on the poster project it's an easy A.

Amazing professor. Entertaining lectures. Class is about leadership and teamwork. Content is very basic (you will not learn a single insightful thing all semester, it's all obvious observations about how groups function). Your grade is mostly made up of group projects and two exams (super easy if you study for a few hours the night before).

I barely went to lectures, but they were entertaining when I did go. You can look over the vocab in the textbook and the slideshows on Canvas before a test and you'll be fine. The grade comes from three exams and a group project. There are also a couple of assignments that aren't worth as much.

Really easy class if you just look at his lecture slides the day before the exams. Talks about himself and his stories he thinks are funny (they're not). Had like 6 TAs who managed to do nothing because nothing was graded til the day before grades were due. Even tho he had a rubric, he did not follow it/it wasn't specific.

I LOVED this class. It's a big lecture class, so it's easy to just not pay attention/ skip, but his lectures are worth going to because he makes them interesting and mostly story based. If all you want is to get the material and leave, you will hate this class, but if you want to enjoy material this is the one for you. great intro to comm.

Live laugh love Steve. Best professor ever. Lectures are material heavy but he is so entertaining and tells us so many stories. Very little homework. Tests are straightforward and pretty reasonable. Project was super fun and a great time passer. Would take his classes over and over if possible.
This class isn't hard but the professor is, he don't even be grading, like do your job.

Felt like a comedy show because hes so funny!! His stories made it easy to remember certain things on the tests. Please take. Best professor Ive had yet. AND I also learned things. The tests are very easy.
Good professor. Has long online lectures tho. Lots of opportunity through homework, exams, and projects to get a good grade. Pretty easy course, would recommend.

This class is entirely based on popular culture. If you wish to learn ANYTHING about communication competence in any form that is not related to pop-culture, stay FAR AWAY from this class. Also, the professor is ridiculously nitpicky and will not follow the grading rubric at all, so good luck guessing what he wants out of you.

Interesting Class! The class has 3 tests out of 200 points and a big group project in terms of big assignments. Tests are manageable he gives you a study guide w/ everything on it. You have to read a good amount of the textbook to understand the concepts and do well on tests. He also includes video lectures. Funny and fair professor overall!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: The class is fairly easy if you stay on top of your notes and watch the lectures. Your final grade is mostly dependent on the 3 tests he gives, so make sure you study. Tests are easy if you memorize what he puts on the study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best professor ever! He has great character and a sense of humor beyond compare. Prepare for intense belly laughing in every lecture. Absolute gem!

I really had no connection to him and felt like he basically turned everything into something about himself - the stories were sometimes funny, but mostly just things no one really cared about. He makes small things difficult just because he can.

The content is nothing special, I feel like I did learn something, but was annoyed in the process.

found the textbook online, and its not bad found myself accidentally reading it when assigned but even then its not necessary, read the slideshows see what concepts he left out (he has a slideshow dedicated to it) and then read that portion, fill out the study guide and its an easy A. I found that it feels like common sense + attend class

Prof Granelli is probably one of the most entertaining lecturers you'll encounter at Northeastern. People saying his grading is too tough are a bit ridiculous. Go to class, read the textbook, treat this class like any other class and you'll be fine. People think that because he's funny he's easy-going. He's not, but he's fair.
Best professor ever. You will have fun and love the subject after taking this class with him. Must take for any COMM class.

Take him if you want an EASY A!! 3 non cumulative tests that are just MCQ's and if you go through his slides you will definitely get an A. He is funny too and gives tons of extra credit. However the class is really huge but it can be an advantage as he rarely ever takes attendance.

Essentially, if you show up every once in a while and then memorize the slideshows you will get an easy A in the class. I loved going to class every day because of how engaging Steve is but, at the same time, I don't feel like I've left the class with bounds of new knowledge. Truly just an intro class but fun nonetheless.

It's a big class, expect to not get emails read, so go up to him in person. I would rather have him as a prof for a small class than a big one, because he's a prof I would genuinely want. The tests are ok as long as you study enough. BE PREPARED TO STUDY. He's funny too and as a person he's genuinely a fun and nice guy.

Steve is such a funny, inspirational professor who is able to effectively introduce students to the various concepts within communication. He does a great job of incorporating his real-life situations into the concepts in class. I was always engaged in class and never felt like it was a chore to show up. The class is overall fairly easy and great.

Since it is a large class it is only lectures. It gets tedious but Steve does his best to keep lectures interesting with personal stories as examples. Grading is fair and the 3 exams are 80 multiple choice questions that require memorization and concept application. Steve is a great person and really helpful if you meet with him IN PERSON.
Awesome professor.

Granelli gave no feedback on any assignments and did not give access to view what questions we got wrong on exams. Therefore, I felt that this class was not worth money and self study of communications would have been just as useful. 

Pro tip: download lecture slides instead of watching the videos & use the quizlets someone made to study.
Amazing!! Super engaging and informative. Very clear and fair grading, and lectures are very interesting. Amazing guy and teacher, could not recommend more highly

Professor is great at presenting and teach material but getting an A in this course is a bit unattainable due to the grading scale. Grading was quite harsh for an intro class and very specific on detail. There were quite a lot of things to do per week but the grade is heavily skewed to just the exams and group project. :/
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: The class content was very easy as long as you take good notes on the lectures. Personally, I found some of the questions on the test annoying as they were asking for minor details. Workload is not too heavy, but grading was harsher than expected. Overall, it will take more time than you expect but very easy content.
you won't regret taking his class, Steve makes learning actually fun. I would recommend his intro to comm class super easy, super fun. Easy A too.

Professor Granelli is one of the most entertaining professors I've had. He is very funny and his tests are clear if you have the textbook and kind of pay attention during class you will do well. Although I did not continue studying comm, I do still think about his class.

Took steve's class this past fall, one of the few classes i had I really looked forward to. while lectures weren't mandatory, they definitely helped improve your understanding of important concepts. He's also just fricking hilarious to listen to. Really appreciated the extra credit opportunities. seriously there were 6 in total.

COMM 1101 with Steve is great! There were 3 exams and a final project with a few assignments in between. Definitely worth taking if you are interested in Communications, it was an awesome starting point. Steve makes his lectures really interesting with real-life examples, cannot recommend this class enough!

10/10 would recommend! There's four unit exams and one cumulative final exam. He gives study guides out in advanced so you know what to expect on the exam. My advice: Go to class and preemptively study for exams using the study guides - to get an A you really do need to understand what is being taught.

Grabiner was a wonderful lecturer. taking notes and studying a reasonable amount will get you a very decent grade. He is also a very nice person and is very easy to talk to, I highly recommend going to talk to him if you don't get a concpet

He's a pretty good teacher. Grades are based mostly on exams so be prepared for that. Your lowest exam grade can be replaced by the cumulative exam at the end of the year. Quizzes have 3 attempts, so you're guaranteed a 100%. He does a review before each exam which is super helpful. Finals was a back-to-back Unit 4 exam and a cumulative portion.

His exams are poorly worded and there are very few questions on each exam, so you need to do perfect to get an A. The lowest exam gets dropped. During finals week he assigned an essay, a unit 4 exam, and a final back-to-back so it Was hard to study for everything. I think the other teacher is better bc he has online exams.

Dr. Grabiner is a brilliant lecturer who provides many practice problems, but his exams are extremely challenging and heavily weighted. Even dedicated students often struggle, and one bad exam can ruin your grade. Don't be fooled by reviews claiming it's easy; those are likely from exceptional test takers. Be prepared for a tough course.

He's a very good professor but make sure to take notes on what he says and not just the slides, because a lot of the exam is based off what he says. Also, the exams are multiple choice, and they are not very difficult as long as u study the material well and go over practice questions and quizzes!

Lecures were extremely helpful and slides provided most of the information needed for the exams. Exam 1 and 2 were quite manageable, but it progressively gets harder with exam 3 & 4 being quite difficult. He is just strict about his policies which is sometimes disappointing and annoying especially if you have an unforeseen circumstance.

Professor Grabiner is very nice and approachable. The class does not require attendance and the lectures are all posted online after class. Grading consists of online quizzes and exams so it is test heavy, but the tests are all multiple choice and not too difficult. If you take time for studying for exams and taking good notes you'll be all good!

reviews.comment: I was nervous to take biology but Professor Grabiner made it super comprehensible!! His lectures are dense, but he records them so you can go back and listen/watch them. Attendance is not mandatory. If you take notes on the lectures and put in the time to understand the content, you will do great on the exams (which are not particularly difficult).

He has engaging and detailed lectures with just enough dad jokes and good opportunities for participation. He includes practice questions for every section, and the answers can be found easily in his slide decks. The only outside assignments aside from self-studying are quizzes which you have the option to take multiple times.
One of the best professors I've had at Northeastern.

The lecture is very helpful. He is very caring. He inspires students to do research or at least keep in touch with new things happen in biological world. Very great professor and person. Definitely recommended.

For Dr.G's class, you definitely gotta know the content inside out. He can be very sassy but aside from that, he is awesome. Lectures are clear, informative and recorded. His tests are all MCQ and 85% of your grade. Just rewatch lectures and study everything under the sun, and you'll be good.

Dr. G is definitely very passionate about biology and it shows. He is very eager to answer questions during lectures, and his slideshows are very well-made. He gives some practice questions that you can use to review the material, and his lectures are also recorded which is nice to go back for studying. His tests and quizzes are also very fair!
Prof Grabiner was great he always was very transparent about test content and provided a lot of practice
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are very well organized and delivered. He always makes time to thoughtfully answer students' questions. All homework and exams are multiple choice. If you study the practice problems and quizzes you'll be golden. Easy A.

Dr. G is great!! He is pretty chill, but sometimes the lectures become a bit of a drag because it is a ton of information. Nonetheless, he is very good at explaining things and giving lots of practice and tips for success. Plus, he records all of his lectures! His quizzes are open-note and are really great practice for the tests. Would recommend!
You will learn a lot in his class. Everything you need to know is in his lecture slides. Organized well and relatively easy if you stay on top of the material.

He is a very smart, and knowledgeable person, and he teaches pretty good. His classes are just lectures with good slides. Overall, he is good. His quizzes are helpful for studying, but he doesn't post enough practice problems. I found I had to find extra practice online.

Dr. G was easily one of the best science teachers I've ever had. His lectures are easy to follow and accessible online. reviews.comment: Professor Grabiner is very knowledgable and passionate about the topic. reviews.comment: Wow. One of the best professors I've ever had at Northeastern. I am not great at science, and this class was hard for me. He is so passionate about biology + a really kind person.

If you put in the time to study and take his practice quizzes, you will see the effort pay off in your grades. Office hours help a lot!

Class is well organized. He has the slides and lecture recording posted for you to look back over. reviews.comment: He was an excellent teacher. His lectures were always very thorough, so make sure to show up to those. The majority of your grade comes from 5 exams (including the final) that are spaced out through the year. As long as you are going to his lectures and doing the practice problems he assigns for (optional) homework, you should be completely fine.

Really great class taught by a very passionate and well-spoken professor. Each quiz gets 3 attempts (keeps highest score), and then your lowest test score is replaced by the finals grade (if you do better). I recommend doing practice problems and using Quizlet (use study guides as template for Quizlet) to prepare for exams.

Dr. G was an ok professor. Despite the exams being multiple choice they were a little difficult in terms of the wording. I was left second guessing a lot. With that being said the exams make up 85% of your grade and quizzes are 15%. I felt like it was hard to get an A in the class because of how exams are weighted. Was helpful to rewatch lectures.

This was honestly one of the easiest class I have ever taken. There isn't a lot of work besides from attending lecture (which isn't mandatory), taking quizzes (he drops the lowest), and taking unit exams (he replaces your lowest with your final exam grade if your final exam grade is higher). Just attend the lectures, take notes, and you're all set.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you take him he is not the worst option. If you don't go to class or office hours you won't understand what's going on unless you have a strong background in Biology. Other professors do exam corrections, he doesn't so it kind of screws you if you are a bad exam taker. He has a lot of office hours so its really what you put into the class.

His lectures are concise and well put together - provides structure for notes. Exams can be deceivingly easy, but not too difficult to get a good grade. No homework or outside content for this portion of Gen Bio.

Great professor! Gives us clear and concise information, is great at answering questions, has a good sense of humor, and gives us opportunities for discussion in class. Posts his lectures online so you can go back and rewrite your notes just because it is a pretty dense class information-wise. Recommend him over and over for genetics!

Dr.G is a great lecturer and does a good job of breaking down complex concepts. This class is not lecture-heavy and is more of a Socratic seminar. Be prepared to work on your public speaking skills because you will have to do (casual) presentations. class conversations and well as peer presentations are great preparation for the exams.

This class is a great class. Anyone interested in Biology, I highly recommend take really any class with this professor. Not only is he good at answering questions, the class is of a reasonable difficulty and all tests are multiple choices. Participation is helpful, and I highly recommend asking questions. I'm not sure why he has bad reviews, 10/10

reviews.comment: Grabiner is a great professor who gets the class involved in discussion about the papers. The inquiries section I took with him is on the ubiquitin proteasome pathway. Coming out of it I have a significantly greater understanding of the pathway, along with increased ability to read scientific literature and knowledge about the process of science.

Dr. Grabiner is a great professor. He is really nice and accessible outside of class. His lectures can be a little boring but he clearly covers all the information necessary for exams. All the exams were straightforward and reflected the material taught in the lectures. Definitely recommend taking him for genetics!

reviews.comment:
Honestly I was shocked that his rating was so low. He's a pretty great lecturer. I don't do much studying, but I did attend and take notes every lecture.

Exams are all mc, there are online quizzes each week (3 attempts allowed so almost guaranteed 100)

If you show up and pay attention I think you'll do fine. I'm glad I had this prof.

Good professor! Gives all the materials and support you need to succeed and do well in class. Cares about students grades and will help you out if you need it. Shows a genuine care that students are actually learning and is clearly passionate about teaching.

He's a chill professor and is willing to re-explain concepts to you if you don't understand. The material was easy, but his lectures were kind of boring so I ended up falling asleep a lot and had to rewatch the recordings. The only work outside of class are the quizzes which are easy. Overall, you'll get a good grade if you study.

reviews.comment: He was a solid professor and definitely has a love for the subject. Overall grade was primarily determined by 3 midterms and a final, but one midterm grade gets dropped. I didn't attend a single lecture and still got an A. The tests were so easy, the content was basically taken straight from the class lectures, which were all posted online. Just watch the lectures the day before a test, take notes, and you'll be fine. Everything was super straightforward, and Prof. Grabiner explains the course material really well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I thought Dr. G was a great lecturer, they were very engaging. But his exams were extremely difficult, and we were not given the exams back ever. reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seems like a good prof, very knowledgable and everything on the tests is in the lectures. There are weekly online quizzes, but the grade was mostly made up of 3 midterms and a final. Requires a lot of studying outside of class.

His exams were about 30 questions each and filled with unfair, confusing and difficult questions. Questions were correct because he said so. He would just tell us to study more. He does
not even hand back exams and gives very broad feedback via gradescope. Plus exams make up most of our grade. Although he is very dedicated and explains things well.

Prof G's lectures are very good and you do not need to read any textbook to study or learn material for his exams (all MC). Weekly online quizzes to boost your grade + one midterm grade is dropped if you do bad. All lectures are recorded so attendance isn't required but being there definitely helps understanding. You can tell he cares about biology

I'd say he's pretty much okay. He does grade by a few things (3 midterms, final, and quizzes). Quizzes were easy but counted for a small percentage of your grade. As for the midterms, I suggest using his study guides he provides and rewatching his recorded lectures. One bad grade on the midterm can take a toll on your grade so beware and do well.
This class was really easy as long as you reviewed the slides before the tests. The tests were pretty much entirely based off the slides and if you knew those, the tests were easy. All mc tests.

Professor Grabiner was amazing at lecturing! The class was straightforward and based on assessments. The quizzes were online with multiple attempts, but the exams were in person and not very difficult at all. If you come to class, or watch the lectures on zoom, take notes, and do the study guides he provides you should be able to succeed.

He is a good professor, he is very lecture heavy, but you do not have to attend class because they are posted, yet it is recommended. I took him for BIO 1, but this course was the only option to write a review under. Overall, good class only thing that's frustrating is your grade is completely 10% take-home quizzes, 60% midterms, 30% final.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved his class! He's a really good teacher and knows the material inside out. I took Genetics with him and thank God I had him and not one of the other professors. Attendance isn't mandatory since he records his lectures, but I recommend attending his lectures cause you can ask questions and he dressed up as a lamb for Halloween lol.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: At first I was not a fan of her, but I grew to like her throughout the course. She can be slightly unorganized, but contrary to other reviews, I found she answered my emails within a day or two. If you make the time to consistently reach out with her and meet with her you will do well. Meeting with her made the biggest difference.

I completely understand that a professor's job isn't to coddle students. However, this professor is often unnecessarily rude and blunt. I would be fine with this sort of personality if I learned a lot in her course, but I did not. She is so unclear in her expectations for the course. I second the other reviewer who said her grading makes no sense.

As a non-business student, this class is attractive to me. The instructor makes the content easy to follow. I like how he organized the whole course content in a framework and motived each concept. reviews.comment: Professor Shan respected and cared about every student. The course related material was organized by weekth and date on canvas, making it pretty easy to follow. He is also very generous on grading by providing so many extra credit opportunities.
Hard to understand, goes on lots of tangents, grading can be confusing but the class is easy

Professor Shan is so kind. I didn't love the material and lectures were super content heavy, but he was very respectful and accomadating. He gives you a chance to work hard, but he tries his best to fix something when students are confused.
Greatest professor ever! Care about student learning and teach pragmatic concepts and frameworks!
Perfect professor!!

He is very kind and supportive. He genuinely cares about students and provides practical advice during office hours. He is always willing to answer questions promptly and makes sure students understand the material. As long as you attend class and follow his instructions for assignments, it is very achievable to get at least an A- in the course.

One of the sweetest professors at Northeastern University. He really cares about his students and always gives helpful feedback to help you improve. He is also very fair and generous with grading, which makes the class less stressful. His lectures are, engaging and easy to follow, so you can actually understand the material without feeling lost.

One of the best professors I've had. Professor Shan is very responsible and cares about his students. He replies to emails quickly and is always helpful. His online tests and quizzes are fair, and the class is well organized and easy to follow. Definitely recommend taking this class!
Honestly one of the best professors I've had. Super enjoyed this class. Take this class!!!
Learned a lot from this course, motivating me to take more MIS courses. Professor Guohou Shan cares about his students, very knowledgeable, and makes his class engaging and informative!

BEST MISM professor. He is kind, approachable, and truly cares about student learning. Attendance is required, but he is very understanding if you have valid reasons.Participation is easy through discussions. The course includes group projects, take-home exams, quizzes, and extra credit. Please don't judge him by his accent-he is a great professor!
Professor Shan cares about his students very much. He is patient and responds to emails quickly. A great professor!

To be honest, he's a dedicated and very helpful professor. I think he does his best with the courses he teaches; while the grading criteria can be a bit complicated, overall he doesn't make things difficult for students. If you're considering taking 2301, he should definitely be at the top of your list.

Worst Professor I've ever taken. Case studies are graded harshly, with unclear directions. Test questions have little to do with relevant content and are impossible to study for even if read the textbook. Thick Accent & Participation Matter. EC only helps participation. Lectures are super dry.
Prof Shan is really a good prof! Lecture is very easy to understand.

You can tell he really wants to be a good professor, always asking for feedback, listening to criticism and will adjust accordingly. He's really passionate about the subject, but since he's new to teaching lectures can be not the clearest sometimes. Get to know him, and you can tell how much he cares for his students. (Knowing Mandarin helps.)

Cons: harsh grader, (especially on case studies), difficult online exams (sometimes unclear, confusing, and with little time), accent heavy so it might hard to understand, mostly reading/explaining off from powerpoint with little class engagement.

Pros: caring profesor, open to feedback, willing to help students outside of class, knowledgable.

Professor has to be my favorite I have ever taken in Northeastern. He cares about all of his students and makes a effort to get to know all of us. His accent may be a little hard to understand but he is extremely accommodating and willing to help anyone. All the exams and quizzes are take home and there are two group projects.
we love kai gu

Class consisted of 10 homework assignments, 3 exams, 3 quizzes, a group project, and participation + attendance. The classes are 100% lectures.

reviews.comment: Overall I had an amazing experience with Kai Gu. His lectures while sometimes can be difficult to understand are insightful and give you the foundations to excel in his course.

Does require buying a $100 online textbook for homework. Teaches well and is able to answer questions well. Homework every week isn't too difficult if you pay attention and/or read the textbook. One semester wide group project with 3 parts that isn't difficult and he grades it easily. He's a little awkward but knows what he's talking about.
That's correct. That's correct

KAI GUUUU is the absolute GOAT of accounting. Nobody breaks down complex concepts the way The GU do. The Gu make difficult material actually make sense, keep the class engaged, and make you want to learn accounting. Best professor there is.

last midterm 50% of the class got a 90+ on the exam. Lectures are useful if you don't understand the content, although it's fairly easy. Kai seems to really care about making it easy for students to get a full understanding of the content so that way he doesn't have to cheese a good grade with a curve. Boy oh boy, where do I even start with my king, Mr. Gu — bro is the absolute GOAT. He helps you with anything you need, never complains, always shows up, and somehow still stays patient and positive through everything. Truly inspirational.

he is very kind and educated and cares about his students. i am not the best at math/finance in general so the course was tough for me but if you pay attention during lectures and do the project, you'll be fine. curves up grades one letter grade, so he bumped me from a B to a B+.

This course is straightforward. The professor breaks down the textbook material into much simpler concepts, and his slides capture all the key points. He goes through plenty of practice problems step by step, making things easy to follow. Exams are fair. The only part I found tougher was the quizzes, but they are still manageable.

Prof. Kimball made stats really easy to understand. This class is based on 4 exams (online) and 4 homework assignments, which were all pretty light. I've never taken stats before, but Prof. Kimball made it seem really easy. He goes over the lectures in depth which made the subjects so much easier to understand.

Prof Kimball made stats very easy to understand! He was very nice and clearly wanted his students to succeed. Class was pretty easy, exams were online/take-home, and grading is based on 4 exams and 4 homework. As long as you pay attention I didn't really have to commit too much time to do well outside of class. Definitely recommend taking him!
I enjoyed Prof Kimball's class. I'm usually not too good with math, but I'd definitely say he made it accessible. His feedback was a little bit vague on homework, though.

One of the most straightforward and simple professors I have had at Northeastern. Very nice guy. His lectures usually end early and the grade is based on take home quizzes and homework assignments. I am not good at math at all but he made stats easy and fun. If you have the chance to take him for stats please do!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was great. Lectures were on interesting topics and he did a good job of including other materials like videos and documentaries to expand on his slides. Had a couple exams and then group and individual projects due at the end of the semester. Nice guy and I enjoyed attending class even though it wasn't mandatory. Textbook was his published book

I took PSYC2315 with him, the online psych stats supplement. Syllabus is very clear about the grading criteria, and the class is very self-paced after he posts each module. His recorded lectures are very helpful and the assignments are easy after watching them. I'm glad I took it with him because his teaching style is very in-depth even on video.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He cares a lot about his students. We only had 4 homework assignments and 4 quizzes, and that's all he graded. Attendance was not mandatory, but his lectures were really helpful.

reviews.comment: Amazing, super nice and caring!!! Class was easy and super interesting! Take him!

Run of the mill professor. Grade comes from homework and online quizzes. Homework was a direct indicator of the quizzes. The class was average, but an okay option for when you're choosing your stats course. Stats was easier than foundations, and I'm afraid it won't prepare me for upcoming lab courses.

I truly would have failed any other stats class not taught by him, he made learning stats easy and I am not a numbers or math person whatsoever. As long as you do the homeworks, the quizzes are basically the same. Quizzes are take home and you can do it during any time in the day , as long as it's before 11:59pm. Take this class 100%!

Prof. Kimball is a great prof and makes stats easy even if you don't like math. There's 4 hws, 4 quizzes and a reflection paper. Quizzes are open note and no time limit, just do it within 24 hours. Super clear on what questions will be on the quiz and very similar to hw problems. He cares about his student and very accessible outside of class.

He was an amazing prof. Super kind, class is based off of a few assignments that are really now difficult. He is a very fair grader, always available outside of class, and made this class fun for everyone!

Prof Kimball was a great professor! He was extremely reachable outside of class and made stats easy to understand for students that have zero background in stats, like me. He started from the bare bones of stats and made it very easy to follow. Be prepared to pay attention because you'll get lost if you don't.

Great professor. Makes stats very easy through lots of examples and practice problems. Grade comes from homework, a short reflection paper, and online, all-day quizzes. Very accessible outside of class as well. Highly recommend him and the class to balance out harder classes.

Was dreading taking stats, but he assuages your fears almost instantly. Super nice guy, funny, and his lectures are so engaging that he somehow makes stats interesting. If you have to take stats, seriously take him.
Dr. Kimball was great. The workload was super light but the weeks you have an assignment/exam they each take almost a full day to complete. He tried his best to make stats easy.
He's so chill and the class is so interesting. Do your GPA a favor and take him.

Prof Kimball made statistics easy and enjoyable because he assumes no prior knowledge of the concepts. All of his lectures are thorough and clear and you can access them for HW and tests. If you do the work, the grade comes easily. He cares about his students learning and is easy to talk to
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is one of the easiest classes provided at NEU. The professor is pretty chill, just submitting the assignments will get you an A. Take this class to balance with your tough classes during a semester.
This was such an easy A. It was an interesting topic, but overall the professor and the class were below average I would say, especially in the online zoom format.

Dr. Kimball is a great lecturer and this class was very interesting (even to a person who has no interest in sports). The quizzes were straightforward and the essays we had to write took minimal time and effort. Take this class if you are looking for something interesting and laid back!

I thought that the class wasn't too bad as long as you watched all the lectures and understood the content. Even if you didn't understand, the textbook and office hours are helpful as supplemental tools. Some of the questions on the quizzes were a bit confusing at times; but overall, the class was pretty straightforward and I knew what to expect.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bless this dude! Truly so supportive during COVID even when no one had their camera on. Just take good notes & try to truly understand the concepts. You can't bs your way through. reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: He's an amazing professor. His lectures are clear and they tell you exactly what you need to know for the homework and exams. Straightforward class and he's always there to help if it's needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Kimball is a fascinating guy and his course was an easy A. Quizzes are straight off the ppts and papers are graded easily. However, it is still a very interesting and valuable class. Although you can easily get an A without going to class, would highly recommend going because he has a lot of knowledge and is a great connection to have

This class is well designed, and while it was super easy I still learned a lot. The homework is a great indicator for the quizzes so if you take your time to do well on the homework you barely need to study. I'd highly recommend taking his class.

He is truly one of the nicest Professors. Im not into sports at all but I took Sports Psychology because I needed an elective. Can I say youll love his class whether you like sports or not. Even though its a lecture heavy class he makes it super interesting and always answers questions with such enthusiasm and respect. Gotta love this guy!
Amazing professor, great lecturer and makes you want to do well in class

Super great guy. He does a very good job of explaining the material, his expectations are clear, and he's very fair. If you need to take psych stats, definitely try to take it with him. The class is super easy if you pay attention/study his slides.

Love him! My favorite prof in NEU. He clarifies everything very well and makes the material not as dry as it supposed to be. He can always answer my question in an understandable way. I would recommend everyone to take his class
Really chill guy in general. He's a Deadhead so manages to bring the Dead up every other sentence even if it had nothing to do with sports. Easily one of my favorite professors at NU
His lectures are very clear and he manages to keep things interesting even though it's a pretty dry subject. Would recommend! (PS save some money and don't buy the textbook)

Great professor, easy class. Honestly too easy. At times, felt like a joke of a class. Still loved it though. Talking about sports and performance? Doesn't get better in my book. Attendance isn't mandatory and all of the slides are on blackboard. Basically just a really fun elective. Recommend it.

The class could be monotonous, but that was just the material. Stats was very easy, with just four quizzes and four homeworks, no midterm/final. Professor Kimball was very easy to understand and would answer any questions you had. The PowerPoints were very comprehensive and you didn't really need to attend to do well.
Easiest class I've ever taken in my life. Very nice guy and makes everything simple and easy to understand. Would recommend to anyone.

Professor Kimball was calm, direct and sometimes funny. He made sure to go slow enough that you grasped the info, but didn't drone on forever. I loved his Sports Psychology course. It was very intuitive. There was no final exam, only three quizzes and two papers. The grading of the papers seems to be pretty laid-back. I can't wait to take Stats.

I had Dr. Kimball for 9 months straight in my masters program.  This man has mentored me, taught me, encouraged me, understood problems I was going through, was interested in the details of them and helpful.  I have never had a better professor!
Super easy if you go to class and study his slides. Even gives extra credit at the end if you need it.

He is a very approachable teacher, makes learning statistics fun and interesting. His powerpoints are great, but try not to skip class because sometimes he'll throw in useful info that you can't find on the slides. No final in his class, just 4 homework assignments and 4 quizzes. Easy to get an A!

Kimball is great- calm demeanor, nice guy. Made statistics as easy as could be with lots of powerpoints to take good notes. Reading the textbook and powerpoints really contributed to my getting a good grade, but if I was ever confused he was really willing and understanding to help.
Great professor, super easy class.
Super funny lectures, not a lot of assignments or tests. Would take a class with him again, he seems super knowledgeable and passionate.

I took Pol Sci 101 because it was a requirement, I am not a huge politics fan. The assignments were fantastic, easy to understand subject matter and the professor was great. I could not say enough about Guy, I wish it was in person instead of an online summer session but thanks again for making the subject enjoyable.
He is awesome.  I have had him 3 times and each time not only do I learn a lot but it's fairly easy and the assignments are entertaining and so is he.  He's pretty funny and extremely cool

Guy is so awesome. This was probably one of the better required classes for my major. He made semi-boring stuff really interesting and sometimes hilarious. This was a class I definitely looked forward to attending. Partly because of the material, mostly because I had a crush on him.
Guy is the man. That's all you need to know. Take the class. Real chill guy and enjoyable class. He's also really funny, half of the time unintentionally
He is the best!  He spent a good deal of time making sure everyone understood the material.  Probably my favorite teacher (so far).  -research methods
He does a great job of making sure students get the material.  He is more than fair grading as well.  He is easily sidetracked though, and some students take advantage of that.  Great communicator!
Really hard greater, but other than that, brought the energy and made the topics we would go over very clear. Scheduling office hours and other means of getting a hold of him were easy as well,

really nice guy, kinda hard to reach outside of class + is sometimes hard to understand, i lowkey only went to first 3 classes. literally one hw every 1.5 weeks, which takes maybe a couple hours to do and also is usually pretty basic, but if you havent used excel or sheets ever in ur life then it can be difficult judging by some other reviews

He expected a lot from us on the Excel assignments, even though he never took the time to teach us how to use Excel. When we asked questions, he would not answer them. Not very accessible outside of the classroom. Assignments took roughly 6-8 hours to complete. If you are thinking about taking this course as an easy elective class, don't.

This may be the worst professor I have ever had. Prepare to open your wallet -- in order to complete his assignments you will regularly have to spend hundreds of dollars to gain access to the data he requires, and presumably has, but will not provide. Expect no instruction on any of the technical elements he requires. Expect to grace or patience.

This professor creates horrible video lectures and has very limited knowledge of recording software, making most of his content useless. Furthermore, his... unique cadence makes him very difficult to understand. He grades extremely harshly, and will use the fine text of his rubrics in order to significantly lower your grade.

The class is not hard, but the way it's set up makes you question life, question the apple that hit newton, question math itself. Man has the same videos from 2020, does NOT respond to emails, and ignored me for 15 minutes on OH (he was on another tab and I screeched into the abyss). Take it if you must but them assignments take AT LEAST 6 hours.

Professor Vicentini works very hard to convey everything in his lectures, and sometimes can overexplain simple things (but you'll be glad about that when he moves onto harder topics). He can be a hard grader, but not unfair, what he expects will always be written down, and he's always available for help. Overall a great educator and nice guy.

My 1 critique is that the class is slow and we often repeated content. Other than that he is great. He brings up relevant examples, draws lots of diagrams, and lets us take breaks. He has a no device policy. The homework is straightforward and he is available for questions. He is really understanding, though has a strict late work policy.

Very nice man who cares about his students. There are no tests just take home assignments. However, the lectures and easy examples given in class do not prepare students for the tough home work assignments. The optional textbook doesn't align with class material. Tutors don't understand his assignments. Office hours not helpful.
Really nice guy. Topics are a bit simple if you've already taken calculus though.

Professor Vicentini is super nice and caring. He always welcomes students to his office hours. The course is only 8 decently spread-out homework assignments. Definitely be comfortable with a data visualization software, as we made lotsss of visuals. My only negative is that I think the last three modules could have been spread out more.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The online videos were helpful but I always had to watch him at 2x speed. He tends to overcomplicate concepts that can be explained within 5 minutes and somehow he stretches it to 40 minutes. Homework is extremely doable if you are in a group and he is a very friendly person.

heavy lecture with confusing notes and graphs. tough grader and slow at responding email, giving zero rubric and confusing instructions on hw. do not expect him to be lenient when it comes to deadline related requests.

There are no tests, just a series of assignments from each section. You can work in pairs or groups for assignments. There are about 7, but he and the TA do not provide a lot help with them. He is one of the nicest professors I have ever had and he truly cares, but his lectures can be confusing. No attendance, but I wouldn't skip class.

Professor Vicentini is very nice, but lectures are confusing and focus so heavily on messy graphs that its easy to lose sight of the concepts. The textbook usually aligns with the lectures but not to an extent that makes the homework assignments any easier. There are no tests, which is nice.

Professor Gustavo is a friendly and kind person; he is patient and will treat every student well. I enjoyed his class, and it was beneficial. I constructed my final paper with his help, and I recommend everyone take his course.
My favorite professor. I took statistics, econometrics, and econ seminar with him. As long as you listen to his lectures, you will get an A.

Gustavo is a very good lecturer. He spends time going over concepts and reviewing them to ensure students really grasp them. There are no tests, only written group assignments every few weeks that are pretty hard but manageable. Relatively easy to do well in this class if you pay attention and ask questions. Take him if you can!

I agree that his lecture was boring. It's because he talks so slow. Luckily, I took his class online, and playing his lectures in x1.5 speed was perfect for me. Other than that, his lecture was straightforward and easy to understand. He's not really an easy grader, so work hard. Still, you'll definitely feel like learning stuff.

I don't know why there are so many negative comments about Gustavo. He is a great professor, he can be repetitive or explain a concept very slowly sometimes, but he just wants to make sure everyone understands. In my opinion, he is a great teacher and I highly recommend his class.

Professor Vicentini is one of the nicest professors I've ever had. He genuinely cares about his students and provides the most relaxed class environment possible with his funny jokes and sweet family (cute hamster too!). The work is very manageable as long as you pay attention in class and everything is graded very fairly.
He is an incredibly nice person. He will answer any question you have. You will definitely learn a lot in his class. He is very chill with attendance and prepares you well for the exams.

Professor Vincentini is very passionate about Statistics and Econometrics and conveys that during lectures. He has clearly planned his teaching material well, gives great notes and has very well structured lectures. His homeworks and projects can be extensive, they are not boring text-book like problems and trigger the student positively.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: For certain reasons (maybe the professor's speaking style), most of my classmates get sleepy in class. Although it doesn't mean the professor isn't passionate on teaching (at least I don't know), this course is not as exciting or passionate as others. The grading in homework is also kind of inflexible.

Gustavo may be one of the sweetest men alive but he is proof that just because you have a Phd does not mean you are cut out to teach. Confusing, not accessible, helpless and the phrase "I'm not explaining this well" came out of his mouth too many times. If you have a strong econ background, then go for it! If not, pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He gives us past exams which helps a lot; however, be aware of exam might cover sth its not in sample exam.  He gives definition questions in exam, usually worth 15 points out of 70.   not so many exams, just three. Assignments are easy to get 100.

Gustavo is a misunderstood professor. He's a great guy who cares a lot if you understand the material. If you show up, take notes, and ask questions, you will do well. It is not an easy class but it is not overly difficult. The class definitely gets boring but I left with a great foundation. HE DOES NOT KICK YOU OUT IF YOU ARE LATE, HE DOESNT CARE.
