Homework is rarely collected. Quizzes and tests are pretty fast paced, but sometimes are the same thing as what we did in class. Not fantastic, but not bad by any means.

Disclosure: I took an entry level course with this prof. Homework was not collected, tests and quizzes were your entire grade. If you do the homework and go to class you can do well on the tests. His lectures are good but he can move a bit fast and doesn't leave much time for questions. Overall a nice guy, he cares about his students too!

Professor takes this class as a an opportunity to make kids rue the day they chose this elective. Incredibly hard homework assignments and tests. Lectures are interesting; however, there is so much work. By far my hardest class and my classmates can say the same.

He grades the quizzes ridiculously hard. Even if you do the work out if the answer isn't correct he will take full credit off and is an unfair grader. He does not give extra credit or scale anything. I, along with almost half the class ended up withdrawing.
Class review and homework solving in class really helpful! No need to do self review at home

Professor Hudon went out of his way to teach the material in a way that was understandable and made a real effort to make sure students were understanding the course. He also jokes around with the class from time and his passion for teaching is apparent in what is otherwise a somewhat bland lecture. Overall great guy and teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He's really not a good professor. I literally taught myself Calculus 1. For real, it was really hard for me

Wonderful teacher who is truly invested in making all of his students interested in the material. He goes above and beyond to excite students about the material and makes class consistently interesting. Also has a fascinating background in astrophysics.

I wish they would stop doing Service Learning; it's a waste of time every week to go to some random place to practice Chinese. Service Learning, in general, is one of the biggest stresses in this class and simply adds more onto your plate than what's necessary. It's an hour a week, but you have to commute.
Dong Laoshi is the best. She is tough on you but she loves her students like her own children. Give her your best effort and she will give you hers.

I took this class because I am pretty fluent in Chinese and thought it would be a good gpa booster but it wasn't. I feel like she purposely grades me harder than other people because I'm fluent and she also grades so hard on participation. She also gives so much homework and projects that I feel she doesn't give enough time for

I wouldn't say she is really good, but she is not really bad. I had her for 2201, it wouldn't let me choose. This class has the most amount of homework. There are a lot of projects and she calls on people and then makes them say the word/sentence properly over and over again. She is very understanding and brings tea and food for us

Her quizzes are hard, you really have to study and keep up with learning the characters but she is the nicest!! Rlly considerate especially w covid. Fair bit of in-class discussions & group work but there are so many contributing factors to the grade (quiz, hw, mini-essays/final projects for each unit) that you have time to make up for a bad grade.

Prof Dong is a nice person, but her teaching style is not the best. The class is very much lecture heavy and not many class activities, which would make the class much more interesting. Hard tests, even if you study for them and a lot of homework.

I took her class and I can pretty much say that the textbook is your everything. All her powerpoints are material from the book. She's very knowledgable, explains clearly to students, makes sure that at least everyone from the class speaks once during that class and is overall a good teacher. It's hard to get an A though so you need to work hard.

Adorable!!! Such an amazing teacher, and I love how she laughs at her own jokes. its a foreign language class so you get what you put into it, but she's very helpful and friendly, she really cares about her students, wish I had her again.

Professor Dong was one of the best professors I had this semester. Although her teaching style using powerpoint wasn't the most effective for me, she really wants everyone to do well and is genuinely a kind and intelligent person. If you want to learn the language, definitely take her class. She's not an easy A, but working for it really pays off.

Prof. Dong is a very good/funny professor. She laughs a lot at her own jokes which keeps the class lively. She is a really easy grader on hw and her quizzes are usually medium difficulty. She emphasizes real world scenarios to teach the material. Just make sure you spend enough time on the material especially if you didn't pay attention in 1101.

I love professor Dong. She is a really smart woman and very well versed in English, knows how to teach Chinese in an interesting and fun way, she is very contemporary in her approach and will use real world examples to help get the message across, and she's always laughing. Take her if you can! Class is a big jump from CHNS 1101, be prepared.

Dong Laoshi is an excellent teacher! The class is not a walk in the park -- Chinese is not easy. But, Dong Laoshi makes the material fun, and she has a very light and airy spirit. I would recommend her if you want a very thorough teaching in Chinese.

Love Dong Laoshi!!  She is one of the best teachers I've had at NU.  You do a ton of work, but her style makes it easy to understand and retain.  I definitely feel confident in my speaking and writing skills.  She's also so nice and genuinely cares about how well you're doing.

Professor Dong is great! You definitely have to put in a lot of work and studying for this class, but if you do she really appreciates it and your grade will reflect that. She is an extremely nice person and makes learning such a hard language fun! Definitely take her class!!

dong laoshi is super sweet! she wants students to learn and will always help you if you ask for it. students sometimes take advantage of that but she's smart and won't let you get an A unless you've worked in the class and deserve it. def try to take chinese with her if you can!
I don't even have her as a professor but she's hooked me up with so much stuff in China ie. internship, housing. She's got mad guanxi, like tons of it.

had previous chinese experience so the class was easy, but prof dong is the sweetest woman if you try. participate in the class chants like everyone else - she appreciates it. NEED to go to class, not just for attendance reasons, but it will help you tenfold. loves to help kids, just help her by preparing for class
She's a good teacher who helps students get exposed to the language. If you have prior experience with Chinese the class should be a breeze, but you do have to commit a fair amount of time to it.
No Comments

Professor Dong is a wonderful women.  You won't be able to slip by this class without studying, but the work is porportional to the time she gives you.  I get A's on all her quizes and you really retain a lot of vocab in such a short time.  She makes learning a new language extremely simple!!!

Prof. Dong is such an awesome teacher for this difficult, difficult language.  She is enthusiastic, funny, and always pushes us to learn, even when it's clear we'd rather not.  She'll go out of her way to help you, and she is an awesome person.  If you're going to take Chinese, get Prof Dong!

Took calc 3 with this professor, had a similar experience as others, attending lectures didn't help me learn well and professor would consistently make mistakes with content. I had a hard time learning from him, I feel that he could do with more teaching experience. Quizzes were fine (copy of HWs) but overall I had to teach myself most things.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dinkins is a nice guy but his class is truly one of the worst experiences I've had in my life. Lectures were incredibly unhelpful and they did absolutely nothing to prepare you for the quizzes, which were also insanely hard. I only barely got a C because I spent way to much time reteaching myself the content. Avoid this prof at all costs.

AVOID IF POSSIBLE. Hunter is a nice guy, but man, he just can't teach. I kind of feel bad writing this, but he can't convey his ideas in a way that allows students to learn. The quizzes that he makes himself are significantly harder than any of the other Calc 3 teachers and his lectures are a waste of time.

She's definitely very good at music. Sometimes she wasn't able to communicate her ideas as well as she could have as English is not her native language but did a good job trying. She's very nice and approachable. Do the HW and attend the classes and you'll get an A.

Her explanations of things are not the most clear, however use the book and its easy enough to learn the material. She gives the perfect amount of hw so that you learn the material without being overwhelmed. Written exams are fairly easy, but the practicals are more difficult. You need to practice for them. Dictation was hard; she can't keep time.

She was an awful teacher, had no sense of fairness, treated her college students as kindergardeners, she required a request if you needed to use the bathroom and at times she would decline your request. She does not have a grasp of the English language at all.  Just because one understands a subject it does not mean that one should be able to teach

Wee is stubborn, demanding, and unfair. You can't leave class to go to the bathroom, no laptops...you are back in kindergarten. She makes you hate the subject and is unclear in explanations because she does not have a full command of the english language yet.

He is genuinely a nice and funny guy. He is strict about having devices out and attendance/deadlines. There's a lot of work, but the concepts aren't too hard, and the TA did not grade harshly at all even for the big projects. As long as you follow instructions you will be okay. He doesn't respond to emails and he is not tech savvy.

Learning SolidWorks isn't really something you need a teacher to lecture for. He makes it harder by assigning lots of homework and having a harsh test grading distribution. At least once a class, he finds a way to berate his students/Gen Z population in general. He seems pretty stuck in his ways, and honestly looks and gives off Disney villain

He lacks empathy. It is truly fascinating how he is still teaching in this school, especially because every single upperclassman that I've talked to was just as traumatized. And I can tell you right now, he truly doesn't care what you think of him. There were times I believed he was here for the fun of seeing his students struggle.

Assignment instructions can be contradictory + vague. He often skims through slides without explaining. When he does explain, it's very helpful. You must attend class and show respect in order to do well.
nice guy, doesn't teach well and lecture is very long. Super work heavy class. 10-20 hours weekly.

He sold us his own textbook and every  class session was him reading the tutorials out of the book word for word. Every tutorial is click-by-click instructions. He managed to detract from the value of the textbook by making it distracting to follow along with his bumbling, half complete sentences. He would also insult us in class.

Professor Zeid is much better than many people say he is. Yes, his lectures may be long and boring, however, he does a good job at explaining the info and making sure that students understand the topic. Homework is long but good feedback is given on all of the assignments and help is very accessible. He will call you out for not paying attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: One of the rudest professors at this university
So so class need do some work. Fairly easy. Homework a bit hard and heavy.

Professor Zeid doesn't care how his students study. He was my capstone instructor and he merely responded to your request to meet. Even though he agreed to meet he would tell you he cannot meet before the scheduled time without telling you the reason. DO NOT expect to communicate with him.
Awesome Professor. Tries his best to help our students. TA was accessible too. Helped in getting a good grade.
tests are bad

The course is useless. The entire semester was just aimed to study SOLIDWORKS, which is easy. It's a waste of time and money. If you already choose this. Remember don't spend too much time on it. And It's hard to communicate with professor after class.

Zeid really knows his stuff, and he teaches it right at the proper level for Industrial Engineers learning to write code. Some of it may seem to obvious at first, like the HTML, but trust me by the time you get into the more complex PHP, the level of intellectual challenge will make you learn a lot

Be ready to take notes! Zeid's method is to write on the chalkboard for the whole period and he expects you to take everything down. Willing to help. Somewhat lenient. If you have a decent reason that you couldn't complete an assignment just tell him, he will almost always help you out. Will probably learn the most in the lab though.

Never take a class with this professor if you can avoid it. There are better options where you will learn more, have less stress, feel respected, and understand what is happening in class. I feel like I learned all of group theory through a textbook, so why am I paying for tuition if it is all self taught?? STAY CLEAR
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor is genuinely one of the most grumpy and unhappy professors you are likely to meet.  Further every email he sends is laced in rudeness and condescension.  I have scheduled times to speak with him outside of class and his tone and attitude persists.  Moreover, when a question is asked, he seldom is capable of a direct answer.
Although I love him as a person, he is not very good at teaching
AWFUL. Cannot teach. Made simple math confusing and hard for math majors where other classes found this class incredibly easy.

Right now I am crawling through a never-ending swamp of homework, with wrong answers and frustration at every turn.  This one class takes more time than all my others combined, and ironically, is the one I understand least.  Coincidence?  I think not.  He is a totally bamboozling professor.  At least he's hot.

Can't explain things clearly.  Assigns hw problems on things we've barely talked about in class because we always run out of time.  Asks for feedback but I haven't seen any improvements unfortunately.  There are much better math professors... find them.

Very intelligent guy, but bad teacher. He moved way too fast and mumbled and his instructions were unclear. However, he gives many opportunities for extra credit and ways to get more points. He is always asking for feedback and definitely took the time to read them.
Confusing and unclear- willing to help but fails at it. We had another professor for 2 days- only time things have made sense so far. Terrible handwriting

Professor Iarrobino is a really great prof. who cares about his students a lot.  He gives practice exams and quizzes so there's NO reason to do badly.  The students who complain are probably the ones aren't serious students or don't put the time in.  He is always willing to help even late at night (email).  Overall helpful, brilliant guy.

Don't expect to learn ANYTHING from class. If you've taken class before, you'll be fine - the quizzes are easy if you know what you're doing.  If you havn't - Give up now, you'll never get it - he is SO all over the place

Very hard to understand. The fact that he has horrible handwriting and writes really fast makes it impossible to take notes and understand. Group Theory is supposed to be an alright class, he teaches it as if we're on the quarter system and teaches meaning that he goes way too fast. He's always willing to help, but confuses you more than helps you.
Horrible professor!

very nice person, but doesn't make the subject matter very clear. he is willing to help during office hours and will often stay in his office late if someone needs extra help. he is so disoriented, classic nutty professor!
If you aren't familiar with or somewhat skilled in Calc of any kind RUN AWAY!
Linear algebra is supposed to be really easy, but this guy makes it so hard to understand. he's nice and always willing to help you out, but he's not good at teaching.

He is very willing to help and has a big heart.  You can see that he wants you to learn while he is teaching...however, he isn't the best getting the material across to students who haven't taken Calc before.  He'll explain anything to you if you go to his office hours so take advantage of that! He's wicked respectful.

This guy is such a mess. He is so confusing when he teaches. he messes up all the time when doing problems on the board which is annoying to go back and redo everything. He gets problems wrong a lot and he asks random questions on quizes. hes a horrible professor dont take his class!

If you never had calc in your life, DON'T take his class! He's a very sweet man, loves to go tangents talking about his daughter. I gave up on paying attention in his class because of that. Easy grade for those who know the material and not so much for those who don't. Have a friend explain things to you and have fun reading his writings!

Hillarious.  Gets thrown completely off topic and starts ranting about the most obscure things, cracks everyone up!  BUT he is a horrible teacher, really bad at getting meaning across and just not good in the classroom, makes alot of things harder than they are, but gives lots of chances to make up.  Who else gives a make-up midterm?

Had him for Calc 1. Having never having calculus before, it was very difficult at first. His quiz's and tests were difficult, he is very thorough and wants everyone to understand the applications of calculus. He was a great teacher and when it gets to the final hope that he makes it. You will appreciate his knowledge when compared to the other prof
i took calculus last year with an amazing teacher so i was alright. but don't take this class unless you have the info already down pat. he's confusing and his handwriting needs a lot of help

Really nice guy, funny with really corny jokes. If you have had calculus before and understand the concepts, you'll get an A. His clarity sucks so make a friend with someone who has had calc before or understands what is going on.

One of the worst math prof. i've had, everything is difficult in his class and he offers no encourgment, just explains, expects you to understand and tells you to drop the class cause you don't understand.  WARNING: drop the class now, do not pass  go, do not collect $200 DROP IT Rating: HORRIBLE

I had this guy all of freshman year, and I really liked him.  Very willing to help you out if you ask, responds to email like 42 times a day, really wants you to get the material.  Midterms, final not too hard, tests were a bit challenging.  Homework was useless for me, never did it.  just try REALLY HARD to pay attetion in class, and take notes.

In the early/mid 90s, Iarrobino was open to my request for reading courses (i.e., we created the type of course we wanted to take).  He was tough but fair in the 2-3 reading courses and kept math interesting.  Note -- my opinion is as a math major who'd completed the required courses (calc, diffeq, linear algebra, etc.).

Drop this class! Esp. if you've never taken calculus before. I lucked out because I knew most of the stuff beforehand. He confuses the whole class with everything he does; very unclear, horrible teacher. Try and find a different class, this one is just a waste of time.

If you have never taken calc,do not take this class,you will not learn anything from him and just struggle through the course.He doesnt explain anything he puts up on the board and half the time what he does put up is wrong or you just cant read it. Makes calc even more miserable than it already is.

This had to be the worst class I had ever taken. He goes off on tangents and would get everyone so lost. And when I would go in for help he'd be able to help for maybe one problem and then confuse everyone again. If you can, take someone else.
This guy is a waste of time...DROP HIS CLASS
My sister had him and he was so bad she switched out, and when she went to switch all the people werent at all surprised when they heard who she had.
I like Dr. Thurston, and she's really nice and everything but oh god is this a boring class. It's fine, take it for an incredibly easy A. The textbook is available through the library which is nice.

Such an angel shes my favee. Quizzes and exams are 70% of the grade but she uses quiz questions for the exam and gives a ton of guidance on whats on the tests. Most people will end this class with an A. Just show up and she will love you. If anything happens during the semester she is so understanding but she does follow the syllabus too closely.

Relatively easy but heavy workload. Quiziz, in person, almost every single class. Weekly discussion posts, along with regular work, too. Very kind and passionate teacher; however, an overwhelming amount of work at times.

This class is truly comical. I felt like I was on an episode of What Would You Do from day one until the exam. The prof cares about her students but has no idea what she is talking about. Barely makes it through the title slide in lectures. If you're in her class, make sure she knows your name! So lenient if she likes you but SO not if she doesnt

My only gripe with her was her grading. She is very nit-picky with grading, never giving you a 100% on assignments and your grade falls into the balance of true/false questions where if you get one wrong, you lose 1% of your overall grade. She is very passionate but you NEED TO PARTICIPATE! Don't need to run away but be prepared to have headaches.

This professor never gives out 100% on any projects. I think highest grade she will give is 95% at most and her feedback are unhelpful. She is sweet but can be stubborn and scary at times. She cold calls often. Overall coursework was pretty light and stress free. Her midterm and finals are like quiz. This class reminds me of highschool.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Did not know how to teach but there were two tests the whole year and you could BS the assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Constantly interrupted students when they answered questions she asked the class. Has strict/odd grading requirements and doesn't give a rubric; just expects students will somehow read her mind. Least favorite class I have taken in my academic career thus far
Great
Definitely one of the worst professors Northeastern has hired. She barely speaks english so it is hard to understand her. Lectures are a tough listen.

Professor Khan cold calls you in class and if she doesn't like what you say she cuts you off and cold calls someone else.  She is nice with deadlines and will give you extra time if you give her a valid reason.  However, she grades assignments very harshly, and it is hard to bring up your grade if you make a mistake.

Although this professor is very caring she calls on students randomly and will cut off your answer, she also does not give time to think and then will judge the answer (this judgement cut down on how much students openly participated). You are also graded on very little in this class: a case study paper, 2 quizzes, and a large group project
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is fantastic and she wants all her students to succeed. She is funny, at least my class was. This class is an easy A if you show up, participate and read the textbook. There is also big group project, one paper, and two quizzes. Overall I liked this class but sometimes she won't let you finish talking.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: EECE 7311 - Professor read off the slides as if scripted, barely interacting with students besides occasional eye contact. I can tell he put effort into the slides canvas page, but these aren't effective teaching tools. You may as well not go to lecture, because they don't help with the homework, which was all time-consuming textbook problems.

Professor Ingle is just okay. He is knowledgeable about the subjects he teaches, but he is a boring lecturer (practically just reads off the slides). Bring a pillow to class. There's nothing interactive about his classes. He assigns A LOT of homework and his tests are challenging.
When you asks questions, he just asks why you don't already know the answer, since we should have already learned it. And he gets annoyed when you come to office hours.
makes it so no matter what some people will fail< DUMB

Very poor teaching ability. Assigns hw of high level of difficulty that is disproportionate to his teaching ability and therefore his students' ability. Therefore, his teaching, homework assignments and quizzes do not help students to succeed in this class. Most of us learned through youtube videos or help from students taught by other professors..

The worst professor I have ever encountered, because he can't teach. His lectures and lecture notes are very disorganized. He can't explain anything while this course is all about understanding math logic and its application. He takes random worksheet online and assigns it as homework not even knowing what is in there.

He is a horrible lecturer. I got As in all the other math classes, and this class was the hardest class I've taken. You need to teach yourself everything through youtube and textbooks. Good luck if you have him! He doesn't have answers to your questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Go to class and if you're decent at math, the course is simple and easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Would not recommend gives no feedback at all only know how your doing in the class until you receive your final grade, even if you have a meeting and ask for feedback you get no feedback on how your doing in the class. Would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Can't speak for ORGB but his negotiations class was a blast. BP3 is a very fun and engaging guy and his classes are full of content. Definitely one of my favorite classes I've taken at Northeastern. It requires minimal effort and you learn a lot about the subject.

I've heard he is tough in OB, but Negotiations is SUCH a fun class. He is straightforward, funny, engaging, and makes remote class fun. Anyone who gives a bad rating is probably lazy. It's so easy to do well when you show up and engage. No txt book, every class is a fun activity + discussion. Learned SO MUCH useful knowledge. 100% Recommend!
Best professor I have ever had at NEU. Easy A if you do the work and attend class. Attendance is however mandatory. Would 10/10 recommend. He is the best teacher ever.
Good guy but class is unreasonably tough. Therefore I would not recommend. I am sure there are better professors out there that teach OB.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This is one of the worst professor I have ever had in NEU. This class is unreasonably made hard by the professor. Not recommend!

Professor Ellen was amazing! He is definitely one of the best professors that I've had at Northeastern. He is very engaging, energetic, funny, compassionate, knowledgeable, and caring. The classes were very interesting and engaging, and I haven't had a professor yet who connected with students so well. TAKE HIS CLASS
Took Parker Ellen for Negotiating in Business. Amazing professor. Extremely engaging speaker, I would definitely take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Second comment! your awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Ellen is, hands down, the best professor I've had at NEU. He teaches well, and clearly, and gives you easily understandable guidelines for papers, making it easy to get an A (if you know the material well). His tests are fair, albeit fairly challenging, and cover all the concepts from class and the text book.

READ and do ALL parts of the assigned work and youll be fine. Pay close attention to the dates when mentioning them in your work; it pays to proofread or youll get points taken off because they are important and make a big difference!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Funny Professor but the work load is quite heavy. Lots of reading, writing and, analysing.
He's tough, but you'll learn a lot!  Just keep up with the reading!
Relies too much on text. Not very approachable or creative.
No Comments
He's the nicest teacher ever! He helped me so much through out the course. Take him!! he might be hard... you just need to read!
best teacher in the school

This class was very entertaining but the assignments we were given were pretty tough. We would have weekly essays that we'd have to write up, and those were graded harshly. Explanations that were said in class didn't make a lot of sense either. I wouldn't recommend this class unless mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Amazing course, I learned a lot about dance and tried new styles. It's a great combination of reflection, practice, and understanding styles and history. I think this is a great course that gives awareness about why we dance and how certain historical events affected dance.
I honestly thought this was a cool course, and I really loved working on my final creative project! I feel like I learned a lot about value sensitive design and creative practice research.

The course is very challenging but it is very rewarding at the same time! The opportunity to craft something new has been very rewarding. The process is very deep in research and self-exploration, made me self-express and revaluate a lot!
Good class and interesting subject, but projects were explained very poorly and we were often graded on things we weren't even aware were apart of the criteria

Ilya is incredibly smart and can communicate ideas extremely well. He has extensive knowledge in a number of different areas and can answer questions on most topics. He is very caring and gives good feedback, and his class sessions are valuable. I highly recommend taking his class if you want to learn a lot about yourself and about the subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Very talented, smart, and well read professor teaching a passion project course. Ilya will help you if you don't slack. This course was more than I bargained for, but still a good experience. Requires a lot of reading, writing, and reflection. If you have a creative project you want to work on for a grade, this course will let you do that.

Dr. Vidrin is clearly very passionate about course material and really wants students to learn and understand it. Course really gave me a strong ethical vocabulary and taught me how to think about different things in life.
Professor Vidrin is an extremely passionate individual when it comes to ethics. His enthusiasm for the subject made me really interested to learn more.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Ilya really cares about his students and the material, which shows in how much time he dedicates to answering questions both inside and outside of class time. The reading quizzes were difficult sometimes, and he grades papers with very specific guidelines that are sometimes hard to understand/write correctly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor was extremely helpful and worked with students closely (at least those who asked). He challenged us intellectually and actually inspired us to grow. I felt comfortable being uneasy with concepts and didn't feel judged. I felt like I was given a lot of examples to go off of when I had a question and was provided with a lot of feedback.

Ilya clearly has a passion for teaching and really wants his students to grasp the assigned readings. He was also very flexible and tried his best to work with students who had not come from very rigorous academic backgrounds.
The space Professor Vidrin builds to make learning about how we communicate is amazing. He is incredibly collected, and makes the whole space comfortable. He's dope.

Professor Vidrin is very aware that the subject matter of the course is challenging, and makes space for that. He is very receptive to feedback, and also very willing to work one-on-one with students on whatever they need. The final project is very open-ended, which allows for a really fun space to create.

Professor Vidrin is very well organized, and he has a clear passion for the course material. Even though the content itself is difficult in nature, he made it very straightforward how to engage with it. His comments were always incredibly insightful, and he is very kind, compassionate, and thoughtful. He truly wants his students to succeed.

Incredibly supportive professor. This class inspired me to be more intentional in my creative practice. The readings are a bit dense but we go over them thoroughly in class. As long as you show up, you'll get a lot out of it. Highly recommend.

If its not required by your major, avoid this class. If it IS required by your major, you should reconsider your major. There is a lot of dense philosophical reading that you have to do which will get you just about nowhere in understanding ethics. The work assigned is busy work and gets graded arbitrarily. The 2 NUPath attributes aren't worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, they have high passion for teaching and made my day every time I came to class. Made me found a love for accounting with his easy lessons that made me understand everything. Homework can be annoying but overall does help lock in my understanding.

Hurley is a wonderful guy, I have never met a more caring/engaging professor. 
Personally, I think his teaching style is tricky to understand, but it's more of the courses fault than his.
Workload was a bit heavy because I had to practice a lot + tedious hw,
but there is a HUGE curve at the end. For example: my 79% became a 92%.

He is actually the GOAT. I view him more as a friend than a professor at this point. Accounting is not always an easy course, but he makes it easier with all the additional practice he provides and his inspirational words.

Hurley really is the GOAT. He is so personally invested in the success of each individual student and provides lots of opportunities for extra credit. You don't need to read the textbook at all, and just need to come to class and pay attention to the lecture. He also provides a copy of his notes after every chapter!

The only downside is that Pat is an Eagles fan. He understands his students and truly cares for them. He is always willing to answer questions, and does anything in his abilities to give us the best grades possible. He is also very open to give extra credit opportunities and is not strict in any way. He makes accounting fun!

He's awesome. You definitely want him for ACCT1201. I'm a freshman studying Business. The material can be difficult at times, but he is always willing to answer questions, and the way he formats class makes it easy to learn. He gave us candy, and he's just so nice. He's accessible outside of class, responsive to emails, and accommodating.

He genuinely cares sosososo much about what he does. You can tell in lectures that teaching is what he's passionate about and he is always willing to help out with any questions you have. He's super personable and definitely the best professor I've had! 10/10
Really cares about the student and does everything he can to get them the best grade and understanding of the course.

Patrick is a great lecturer, you can tell he is passionate both about accounting and about teaching, and he is very engaging. He was by far the best professor I had this semester. He also really wants you to do well and is very helpful with any questions you might have. If you go to class and pay attention you won't need to study much on your own.
lebron of accounting
Very great guy, genuinely cares about all his students.  Open and willing to meet during office hours or other times, really wants to help and see his students succeed
Go birds! Fancy shirts every day for class.
Great professor, has a lot of "tricky" questions on the test and quiz. Funny guy, let's go Pat.

I couldn't recommend Professor Hurley enough. I was terrified before starting ACCT1201 but he is the most welcoming teacher Ive had. You can tell he genuinely respects his students & wants the best. He's also hilarious and even brings a huge bag of candy to each class. Im grateful to have been one of his students & hope to be taught by him again!

I was terrified to take this class as I genuinely had zero business knowledge going in, that quickly changed first day. This professor truly is incredible, its still is one of my harder classes but it is also one of my favorites. His office hours are extremely helpful (GO TO THEM) he grades so fairly giving as much partial credit and candy!
Best professor of all time. Very genuine and does his absolute best to make sure you succeed in class.

he is the BEST professor here at NEU, genuinely so funny and he drops the lowest quiz grade. his lectures all have notes that you fill in the blanks with him as he teaches, also takes the time to make sure students understand the topics

He is my favorite professor at NU, honestly so great and teaches accounting in a way that makes sense. There are weekly homeworks on MGH, and the hardest part of the class is tests/quizzes. Study a good amount and you will do well. You will come out of the class very knowledgable on the material. Highly recommend him!! :)
Pat is such a good professor. He would crack jokes all the time and his teaching style made things really easy to understand. His notes are very clear and he is very good at answering questions.

Amazing professor, is very good at explaining and keeping the class engaged (even at 5:30 pm when it was the very last class before the weekend). Accounting isn't the most interesting subject but he makes it interesting.
genuinely the best.

I FREAKIN LOVE THIS PROF!! truly the best professor ever at neu. I literally PRAYED for him to teach managerial cuz I just truly loved his lectures (sadly doesn't seem like he teaches). amazing professor you should take it !!

Professor Hurley is amazing, very funny and made the lectures easy to follow. Very organized and offered help outside of class. Quizzes, midterm, group project, and final. Everything builds upon each other, so if you have questions or need help ask right away. He's the nicest and never makes anyone feel bad about asking questions. Big curve at end.
Audit isn't a particularly interesting class, but Hurley does his best to incorporate case studies and activities to provide more hands-on learning. The tests aren't easy, but he grades fairly.

Mr. Hurley is just the best professor I have ever had. He is truly amazing. He is very caring, always tries to create extra credit opportunities. His lectures are super informative. He is extremely kind, and he just wants his students to succeed. Definitely, take him if you can for your accounting course. Thank you Mr. Hurley!!

THE GOAT. Professor Hurley was by far the best professor that I've had. He cares about the success of his students and keeps students engaged with enthusiastic and very effective lectures. Great at responding to emails I always got a response on the same day that I sent it. Great at answering questions. Would recommend him to anybody.

Bloody legend. Professor Hurley is probably going to be my favorite teacher I have had here at Northeastern. He cares so much for his students and tries very hard to make sure everyone is succeeding and understanding material in his class. GOAT.

Professor Hurley was certainly the best professor I could have had coming into my first semester of college. His caring and hilarious personality made it extremely easy to participate in class and allowed for an unjudging environment regarding any question a student may have had. I would totally recommend Professor Hurley if anyone has the chance!

This is the man. He is caring and wants you to understand the material. He always has completed chapter notes before any quizzes or exams. His class is very important. I would say attend class even though he does not care about attendance but the notes you miss, and his explanations are essential for your understanding of the course.

While I was not very fond of Financial Accounting & Reporting, I couldn't have asked for a better professor. Professor Hurley was patient and encouraged questions whenever someone was confused; I always had questions in every class. The course has a lot to cover, so he had to go quickly, which could confuse some terminology and content.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Hurley is the best. He has amazing lectures and cares about his students. He always goes out of his way to make time for us outside of class if we need help. The content can sometimes be difficult to understand, but Professor Hurley explains it in a way that makes sense to whoever he is teaching it to. I could not recommend him enough!

Professor Hurley is great! Although audit is a boring class, he tried his best to make the lectures enjoyable. He is very understanding and truly wants to see his students succeed, both in and out of the classroom. The topics build upon each other and he does a good job circling back but it is important to stay on top of material to not fall behind
he's a great professor who cares a lot about his students :) he's clearly passionate about audit, which makes the material a bit easier to understand!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Literally the best professor I've had at Northeastern! So enthusiastic and really cares about you understanding the material :)
he's awesome! we actually don't even have to buy the textbook, as he distills it down for us in our lecture. best prof i've ever had at northeastern, would absolutely take again!!

Dude's a beast, loves the content of the course. Tries to make lectures and interactive. Cracks jokes when he can to lighten the mood. Take this guy's course if you can. Grading is straightforward, tests aren't hard as long as you study and pay attention to lecture. Doesn't track attendance but don't skip too much.
Great Professor, he responds emails really quick. Grades fairly and wants you to do good. Interesting lecture and organized.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Makes it easy to understand material. Had 4 quizzes, one midterm and then the final so not a lot. 100% recommend.

Professor Hurley is AMAZING! His lectures are clear and concise, while also being informative and detailed. He places an emphasis on the components of each chapter that will be most prevalent on assessments. He also has an amazing personality, which definitely helps make classes more entertaining. Accounting is hard but he makes it better!!
Wonderful Professor, Nothing I can say that others here haven't said. He is amazing.

Prof Hurley is such a great teacher! He is more than willing to help and always wants his students to succeed- he'll go out of his way to adjust quizzes/projects, respond to emails, and coordinate zooms/office hours to ensure you understand the material. He truly cares. Highly recommend if you struggle in accounting- he'll def help!

HE IS THE BEST!!! I have loved every second of being in class with him, and people say accouting is hard, but he makes it so understandable and if you dont understand he is very very willing to work with you. 1000/10
He really wants his students to learn and he is so understanding. Very accessible outside of class to help students. 100% recommend, best accounting professor at NU!

I literally just created an account to write this man a review. Patrick Hurley is the goat, he is by far the greatest professor I've had at Northeastern. Not only that but he's also an incredibly chill dude who truly prioritizes his students. This class is def hard but if you pay attention in class and do the homework it's hard not to do well.

Truly one of the best professors here. He consistently goes above and beyond for his students. There have been multiple occasions in which he's stayed on zoom calls with me late into the night to help me with homework or studying. He's also hilarious! If I had any other professor I'd be failing.
Very friendly and caring, makes everything as simple as possible. Clear with expectations, flexible with deadlines and always willing to help and answer questions. Great guy and great professor

He is great. Attendance is technically not optional, but he is lenient on days you need help. Lectures are not boring; he really simplified the textbook, which is much wordier. He also posts all of his notes so missing a class wouldn't be too big of a deal. He also gives tons of extra credit and scales generously.

Professor Hurley is one of the best teachers I have had at Northeastern so far. He cares about his students a lot and tries to make sure that all of them score well in his class. Extremely kind and understanding. Would recommend him 100%

Patrick is a top 3 teacher I've ever had. Reviews are 100% accurate, he is a funny, kind guy that makes every accounting concept crystal clear. Super available outside of class and responsive. Learned a lot in his class and made me love accounting!

Professor Hurley is AMAZING. His lectures are very informative, simply just pay attention and study a bit and you are set. There are four quizzes throughout the semester and he lets you drop one of them. Attendance not really mandatory. Super funny and laid back guy. Would 100% take again.

Great Professor! Very helpful and makes this difficult class fun and interesting. Gives several opportunities to get extra credit & cares about his students. Definitely recommend taking Accounting with him!

Best prof I've had in my three years at Northeastern! Truly a great guy - will meet with you outside of class whenever you need it whether it's online or in person. Answers your specific questions during quizzes and exams.
He has very engaging and entertaining lectures! Outside of class, he is also very easy to ask and talk to about the class material. I'm glad to have had him as my professor!
Professor Hurley is an amazing professor.
Solid professor, very flexible and is good at teaching the material. Definitely a chiller.

Professor Hurley is simply the best! He made math possible for me and I excelled in his class. He is very understanding and provides amazing notes. With four quizzes, one midterm, and one final, if you focus and study, you'll be fine. 10/10!!
Perfect professor, he is the only guy that can curve 20% in my University life. I will definitely take his course again.

Best prof I've ever had at Northeastern. His notes are so easy to follow and he prepares you well for exams. Homework is all online and you get two attempts, he drops the lowest two grades. He drops the lowest quiz grade too. I took him for Summer 1 and still didn't feel like he moved too fast. Def take him if you can

Professor Hurley is a really excellent teacher. He makes the class interesting and breaks down difficult concepts so they are easier to understand. He is always available to help students outside of class and is encouraging of questions and reaching out for help. His class is very educational and I would highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Hurley is an awesome professor! He is super funny, sweet and overall an amazing person to learn from. It was a pleasure to be in his class! Pease take accounting with him!!!

Professor Hurley is by far one of my favorite professors! He's an all around great guy that actually cares about his students, their success and if they understand the material. He acknowledges that accounting is not for everyone but is always available and ready to help inside or out of the classroom. I always looked forward to his classes.

My favorite professor at Northeastern so far! Tests are challenging but Prof. Hurley had great lectures and wants his students to succeed! (he also curves ur final grade) If you ever need help he is very approachable and always answers his emails!

I have never had such an amazing professor like Professor Hurley! He is caring, teaches really well, and wants all of his students to succeed. In his class whatever effort you put into it you get out of it. His note sheets are so helpful for learning all the material. Trust me when I say this -- take Financial Accounting with Patrick Hurley!

He is a very fair professor who genuinely cares about all his students. Tests and quizzes are pretty difficult but the grade you get is an accurate representation of what you put in to the class. If you stay up to date on assignments and attend office hours as needed you should be able to pass the class with no worries.

Professor Hurley was an amazing professor, he cares about his students and gives many extra credit opportunities. It is accounting so the class and the tests are difficult but they are extremely fair and I encourage you to take his class.

Professor Hurley has been the best Professor I've had since being at Northeastern. The exams are challenging but you definitely have all the resources to succeed in them. You definitely have to show up to class and participate and it helps to get to know him and show him you care and really want to succeed.

He is the boi! He is just a really wholesome and solid guy. I struggled in his class initially but by going to one office hours he set me up to end his class with an A - it's all about just starting to relook at the chapter notes before the exams and then doing the practice problems. It's a HUGE impact.

Greatest Professor I have had at Northeastern. He truly cares about every single one of his students. The class itself is fairly rigorous, but he is a super accepting grader. He makes students want to attend class due to his passion for teaching, and his human with all of his students. He is super easy to reach during office hours or through email.
Professor Hurley really cares about his students and his tests are a little challenging but he curves it.

Professor Hurley is amazing. He goes out of his way to help his students and wants to see everyone succeed. The tests are difficult and are challenging, but do well on the homework, quizzes, and final project and you will be set.I would absolutely recommend him. You will not regret taking him! He is also hilarious.

One of the best professors for accounting and he truly cares about his students and wants us to do well! His quizzes and tests are hard, but he's willing to help during office hours and class time, and he has a lot of other assignments that can help raise your grade. Homework assignments are easy and his review problems are super helpful.

Professor Hurley is one of the best at Northeastern. He makes the material interesting and engaging, and genuinely wants to see each student succeed. He is incredibly caring and responsive to email, and he curves the class at the end of the semester. Show up to class, follow the notes, and prepare for each test for an A.

Pat is an amazing professor. If you show up to class, participate, and follow his extremely well-formatted notes which he gives to you, you will be set. He is also extremely caring for his students and is always supportive if you need help or anything really. He has tough tests but they are perfectly mirrored by the notes and guides he gives out.

If you are taking ACCT1201, take it with Professor Hurley! One of the best professors that I have had during my time at Northeastern. He genuinely cares about his students and his main goal is to help you succeed in his class. Material and exams are challenging but he will go out of his way to help you understand the concepts and get a good grade.
Awesome

Awesome Professor! Cares about his students and takes the time to make sure they really understand class content. Assignments are actually interesting and help you understand the material. If you have to take audit I would 100% recommend Prof. Hurley.

Great engaging lecturer. No participation or attendance requirement. His presenting slides are well-made and a great way to review for class. No textbook required either. His quizes/exams can be tough but he is a fair grader and does well explaining his grading methods. I'd take him again!

I loved taking Audit with Professor Hurley! He definitely gives tough exams but he curves them to ensure that our knowledge is being tested without our grades being affected too much. He also genuinely cares about his students and it is clear that he doesnt want to be unfair ever. Would definitely take again.

Professor Hurley is one of the best professors at NEU. He's very caring for everyone in the class and has a good sense of humor. He teaches effectively with his own slides and you don't need to purchase the textbook. Definitely take his if you want to take the audit class.
just a really positive and fun professor that teaches a pretty differcult course and he does an amazing job of it

Professor Hurley is one of my favorite professors! He is truly the best & really cares for his students and how they do in his class. Audit in general is different than other accounting classes so it takes time to adjust to the style. His lectures are interactive and his cases and activities allow you to apply concepts in a fun way!

An amazing professor who really cares about his students! The lectures are very interesting and he makes the topics relatable to the students. I felt I was evaluated very fairly and that he wants each student to succeed.

I've never met a professor that cares more for his students than Hurley. He genuinely wants every student to succeed. Even though his exams are hard, the tested material comes directly from his slides (which are extremely well organized and thorough). Just make sure you understand the concepts and memorize it WELL. Questions are super specific!
Great professor who did care about his students much. Tried his best to make the lectures interesting. Get ready for the Hard Exams. (but he do curve)
Hard class as it is all theory-based and no typical accounting problems. Nice professor but gives very hard exams.

Although Audit is an extremely dry and boring subject, Professor Hurley really tried his best to make the class engaging. He is an extremely caring professor and really puts the needs of his students first. There's really nothing to dislike about him, 10/10 personality and all you can really ask for in a professor.
Professor Hurley is one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern. I've taken two of his classes now. The audit course is challenging, but manageable. He's a great guy and teacher!
Really great professor! I have nothing but good things to say. His instructions are clear, he's fair, and he makes the classes interesting.

Cares so much about his students. Always accessible outside of class. He knows audit is boring in a class setting and makes his best to keep things interesting. He respects students so much and encourages everyone to speak up.
Highly recommend taking Professor Hurley for audit if you have the chance! He cares about his students and tries to make a dry subject more entertaining and applicable to real life.

Hurley is a really nice guy who cares deeply about his students. Audit is very dry and he tries his best to make it interesting and succeeds! You do need to pay attention during lectures to do well in the class and on the cases because the textbook isn't much help. If you're going to take audit, take it with him!

Nicest professor you'll find. Always willing to help. The cases can be a lot of work depending on your team. He's engaging in his lectures but they're dry, but then again its an audit class. Class seemed easy until the midterm hit and the class averaged a C. Take class if your actually serious about auditing, Take the prof if you want a good one

Professor Hurley is one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern. Audit is a fairly dry and boring subject, but he does his best to make it more interesting. He always makes himself available outside of class to answer any questions, and really cares about his students.

Professor Hurley is an amazing professor and he takes his time to make sure that the material each class is not overwhelming and is understood by the whole class. Auditing is not the easiest course but Professor Hurley made it extremely enjoyable. Grateful to have been his student!

Patrick Hurley is one of the best accounting professors I've had. He makes the classes interesting and definitely wants the students to take away the important information rather than just droning on in a text book. He will make sure you understand the material. His exam is comprehensive so it really tests your application abilities.
If you want to understand auditing , be challenged, and learn how to be competitive in your profession then take this professor. It is not an easy A but the effort you put yields appropriate results.

Professor Hurley is one of the best I have had at my time at Northeastern. Not only does he teach the material effectively and clearly, but he also makes the class very interesting. He teaches in a cross-disciplinary manner and integrates a lot of psychology and laws of human behavior in his teaching. I found his class really interesting.
Prof Hurley is awesome! He keeps lectures light and fun while also teaching you alot. He uses different materials to break up lectures which makes paying attention in class so much easier.

Patrick is a really amazing professor. He always introduces humor to the class and you can tell he really cares about his students doing well. Participation is key in his class and he notes every time a student contributes, however, he offers plenty of chances during the semester for extra credit participation points. Will curve class average to B+

One of most caring professors I have ever had to date, however if you are someone who does not like participating in class, I do not recommend taking his course just because there is such a heavy emphasis (20%) on the amount you participate (He marks down the amount of times you participate in class).

Professor Hurley is hilarious and sensible and cool. He really cares about how his students. I like how he's very hands-on and makes sure to communicate very often and well especially when it comes to doing group projects/case studies. I'd definitely retake him if possible; 100% recommended!

He added jokes and comments to PowerPoint slides to make the information easier to understand. The case studies were really helpful to understand the material because this class is better learned by doing the procedures rather than just reading about them. Overall one of my favorite classes I have taken.
Really funny, he adds jokes and comments to the lectures so that they're not just powerpoints and slides

Professor Hurley is the best professor in the business school. I've never had a professor- or heard of a professor- who cares so much about his student's succeeding. If you have the opportunity to take audit with him, do it. I honestly wish I took some of the lower level accounting classes with him, I think I would've learned/retained much more

Honestly the best professor I've had at Northeastern! Highly recommend, he makes what is a pretty boring subject (sorry to all the auditors out there) super engaging, interesting, and easy to learn. Provides hilarious commentary, encouragement, and extra cred points for participation which is great b/c I'm introverted & don't like to speak in class

If you have the opportunity to take his class DO IT! He made an 8am Audit class that I was dreading my favorite class this semester! He really works with students to create and move deadlines and provide real world material and cases to supplement the textbook. He's super enthusiastic about the course and offers a lot of different participation

Professor Hurley was one of the most compassionate professors I have had. He was always interested in feedback and worked hard to make class as interesting as possible. He incorporated presentations, exams, cases, homework, and discussions painlessly into the curriculum. I feel like I learned a ton in this class without being overly stressed.

He is one of the best professors I have had in my time at Northeastern. He is very invested in his work and is always willing to help you outside of class. Tests aren't easy but manageable if you study and do work outside of class. Would highly recommend taking his class!
Amazing teacher, makes accounting fun -- is very young and understanding

Hurley is a great professor, he really cares about the students and will offer to move deadlines if enough students have conflicts with other classes. There is one group presentation and 3 group cases due throughout the semester. Participating in class is important but he offers other optional assignments to bump up your participation outside class
One of the few professors I actually liked and learned from. Take him even if you hate to participate or whatever, he's worth it

Prof. Hurley is really smart & funny. He lectures by writing on a printed out copy of the Powerpoints and using an overhead projector. Participation is important, but he gives other options to earn points if speaking up in class isn't your thing. The material isn't all that difficult at first, but paying attention in class helps for the exams

Professor Hurley is one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern. He truly cares about all of his students and wants them to succeed. Participation is key, as Hurley wants you to learn and be able to discuss the material. Thankfully he does not require you to remember useless codes from the Auditing Standards. Would take again.
Great professor - engaging lectures and fair grader.
Awesome teacher!

I would definitely recommend taking this class with Professor Hurley. He breaks up his lectures with cool personal stories and interesting psychology connections to auditing. You must be prepared to participate, however, homework is manageable (1 per week), 1 midterm, 1 small group presentation on a real-life fraud case, and a few cases to turn in.

Professor Hurley is a true gem at Northeastern. He makes audit a funny and entertaining class. He always tries to accommodate his students, and he is unbelievably reasonable. Seriously, no one knew that an accounting teacher could be so cool. However, his tests are on the harder side, and he is slow to return grades.
The lectures are very clear. He always tried his best to make concepts fun. Case study is helpful. Good professor!

Prof. Hurley is by far the best professor I have taken at NEU. He understands his students far more than anybody else and is always there for you, whether you're having a tough time in school or in life out of class. His class is well-structured (assignments/tests). His lectures are interesting and he adds personal insights/jokes to make class fun!
Understands auditing can be dry sometimes but does his best to make it clear and enjoyable. He shows he genuinely cares about his students. I would definitely recommend this professor.

Amazingly fun lectures. I never thought Financial Accounting could be a fun course to take but this guy makes every lecture worth it (and you learn everything too). He's very good at explaining all the material and is very patient and understanding. 10/10 would recommend him.

Hurley is one of the best profs I have had at NEU in my 3 years here. He is an all around great guy, who goes out of his way to help anyone struggling. Accounting may seem dull, but you will enjoy showing up to class if you pay attention and listen to him. Highly suggest taking as many courses as possible with him.
Pat Hurley is an asset to the D'Amore McKim School of Business. He tries his best to make accounting interesting, fun and fair, and has remarkable success in doing so. Thanks for a great semester!
inspired love for accounting
Professor Patrick Hurley was the best professor I had this semester. He really cares about students and I'm sure you will have fun in his class, although do prepare to study a lot.

Hurley is without a doubt one of my favorite professors I've had. Many people told me he was someone to take this class with and they did not disappoint. Genuinely wants his students to succeed and puts in the work to make sure that happens. Take a class with him if you can.
Great teacher
I really enjoyed Hurley's class. It made accounting bearable and he's very clear on what he wants.
A very honorable man who cares about his teaching efficiency

Professor Hurley is probably the best professor that has taught me. He has an amazing sense of humor and a knack of making even the most tedious topics in Accounts, fun and interesting. If you are taking Financial Accounting take him. Period.
Amazing Professor! He really helps students to reach their optimum. Midterms are hard but if you study his notes well then you are set. His grading method is really good
Professor Hurley is a great teacher who made accounting so fun
The best professor you could possibly have. He's really understanding and really cares about his students.

Accounting sucks and he makes it not suck at all. Somehow makes literally the most boring material of all time interesting. I have never skipped a class. He is hilarious and includes memes on all of the tests. He also uses note packets for all notes so all you have to do is pay attention. Also super caring and approachable.
Accounting is a though class but it doesn't seem bad with Hurley! Highly highly recommend him! He cares about his students and he is always available to help!
He was by far my favorite professor I have had at Northeastern. He made class enjoyable while still teaching the material. I feel as if I learned the material and am prepared for the next level.
Professor Hurley is the BEST professor in Northeaster. He makes accounting fun and easy to understand. Recommend 100%%%

Professor Hurley is a great teacher who is a not only a reasonable teacher but a great person. Accounting is a very dry subject but Hurley's jokes and funny problems make the class bearable. Only problem is he likes Philly teams and lives in Boston...

One of the best professors Ive had this entire year (Im only a first year). He really makes class interesting and as fun as an accounting class can be for someone who has absolutely no interest. He does everything to be fair to every student and makes it a point to know everyone. You can tell he really cares about his students and teaching.

It was my first accounting class and I absolutely loved it! He prints out note packets for every chapter and if you familiarize yourself with those, you wont have surprises on the exam. Patrick Hurley is a hilarious guy which made this boring course entertaining.

Professor Hurley makes Accounting, a class that most people do not like, enjoyable. He has a sense of humor, and he makes his classes as engaging as they can be. I highly recommend him as a professor.

Patrick Hurley is an amazing professor. I love going to his class everyday and he always makes me laugh. He is able to get the information across clear and easily. In the later chapters of accounting, it gets quite difficult. But Hurley is the the man to teach them. You will not regret taking his course.
Hurley is an awesome prof! He's so funny and puts memes on his tests which are appreciated. I would love to take another class with him
After taking his course, I even want to switch my major from marketing to accounting. He is always welcomed to answer questions and make the intro to accounting course more enjoyable.
Great guy, very funny and very good at keeping people interested in a not so interesting subject. Would definitely take another class with Professor Hurley.
Very good teacher, his classes are quick and clear. The subject is difficult and dry but he seems to make attending class fun and useful.

He's the teacher to take if you're taking Financial Accounting. He teaches everything so clearly. The packets he give out for every chapter is so helpful. You would get an A very easily if you put in the work. HE'S MAD FUNNY. You'd enjoy this class 100%

Hands down one of the best professor I've had at Northeastern. His exams are challenging, but he is fair in grading. If you work hard, it will pay off. Always willing to answer questions during and outside of class. Awesome professor--would highly recommend to anyone taking accounting.
I really hate accounting but love my accounting professor.

You need to pay for the code for the textbook, but I literally haven't opened my book since the first day of class. He gives you packets that are better for teaching the material he is grading you on. Attendance isn't mandatory, but "Professionalism" is taken into account for your final grade, and if you don't attend class, it might be graded low
Easily the best professor I've ever had. Really tries to make accounting understandable. You need to put work in on your own, but definitely doable. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He makes these packets which means you basically do not need a textbook

Professor Hurley has a great way of explaining things so that they make sense to people. I took two years of accounting in high school and barely knew anything past chapter 1, thanks to him I managed to Ace his class and even switched to an accounting major because I was so well-versed in it. In addition, he's very funny and makes class enjoyable.

Accounting was something I was scared to take because I was intimidated by it, but Professor Hurley makes me excited to go to class and learn about the material. If you are confused just tell him and he's willing to help you out!

Thought I would hate accounting, ended up being one of my favorite classes. He's funny and understands how college students act. Writes notes out every class and always does examples. answers any questions you have and explains things perfectly. Provides plenty of resources and cares greatly about his students.

Professor Hurley makes accounting enjoyable. His lectures are nicely paced and easy to follow. His exams are on the tougher side, however there are a lot of other opportunities to raise your grade. Overall he is a very fair and informative professor.

Professor Hurley is a  very enthusicastic and funny professor that makes the material easy to learn. He is always around to help if need be. His grading is very fair. If you want to do well in his class, go to his lectures and pay attention. He pretty much lays out all the information you need to do well. His class is very enjoyable.
This professor is so great. Easy to follow.

Taking Patrick Hurley's class was a great way to start off accounting at Northeastern. Lectures are well paced, and extremely useful for understanding the material. It was very clear from day one what was needed to receive a good grade in the class. Overall he's a great guy inside and outside the classroom, and he really cares about his students.

Its the classic accounting with a great professor that makes you want to work for that A. It should be pretty easy if you follow up with his lectures. Gives a lot of extra credit to students for completing small tasks and is quite inspirational.

Hurley is my favorite freshman year professor. He makes accounting fun, cares about his students and most importantly, makes it fair for everyone. If you have the chance to choose him as your professor, do it.

Patrick Hurley literally makes me want to be an accountant even more. When coming into my freshmen year i knew accounting might be boring but because of the enjoyable, interesting spin Hurley put on his lectures and notes, i found this class to be the most enjoyable one of my schedule. My only advice for him as teacher is to never change!!

P Hurley is the bomb. His quizzes and exams challenge you but they're fair and he grades kindly. Accounting lectures with him are something I actually look forward to  and thats's big because I hate classes in any shape or form. He puts the best inspirational memes in his quizzes to motivate you and he watches Archer. Definitely take his class!

One of my favorite professors. Very clear in telling you what you have to do to get a good grade in his class. Lectures are engaging with the added bonus of some cheesy jokes(You have to love it). Would rocommend this class to anyone looking to truly learn accounting and have a good time doing it.

Pat was a great professor, super organized and expectations were clear. His use of examples and practice was really helpful. I don't love accounting, but his class made it more enjoyable. Tests are more difficult, but study the right things and it will be ok.
