I think I would've thought higher of him if I had an earlier section than 4:35-5:40 3 days a week because I was so gassed after sometimes 3 lectures before. Each lecture he goes thru some homework questions and answers whatever questions students have. Each assessment we're allowed a double sided notesheet. Taught the whole course to myself.

Very good teacher, taught the subjects well and clearly. Not the hardest class but he definitely makes it easier and explains everything well. He gets straight to the point and explains everything needed without going on tangents about stuff that doesn't necessarily matter. Very nice guy, easy to talk to and is accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. The content was a bit difficult, but he explained things well imo and he really focuses on class understanding.
Best math professor I've had at Northeastern by far. He gave us so many practice problems and prepared us well for quizzes and tests. Wish I could have him as my professor for every math class ever
John is a great professor. Best prof I've ever had for math at Northeastern! The course itself is very difficult but John makes it really easy to understand

Like most Math courses, grade is only on tests. He taught well and was pretty funny. Very fair with people coming to office hours to get points back on quizzes/tests. Extremely chill professor if you want to get to know him. Drops the lowest quiz out of 4 (Summer 1 2024). Homework and attendance not mandatory. Going to class helps a lot tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BEST CALC 3 PROFESSOR. And best prof I've had in the department so far. He genuinely made calc 3 the easiest math class I've ever taken. Lectures are so clear and he does such a good job of making complicated topics really straightforward and simple. He's also really funny if you get to know him and dresses like Adam Sandler. Awesome guy
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Lindhe is super knowledgeable but his lectures can be a bit disorganized. He clearly knows the material he is teaching but the disorganization can make concepts unclear at times. He's very caring towards his students and is a fairly lenient grader, and does a great job of making a lot of difficult material easy to digest.

Really easy course and he explains everything very well. Typically NEU math course. Most of the course is him teaching how to do something by hand, then showing how to do it on a calculator (which is allowed on quizzes and exams). The material is very easy because you don't really have to grasp the why, only how.

Really knows what he's doing and gets more into applications rather than theoretical. He's great at teaching and provides helpful guides for student to succeed. I also enjoyed his computer lab activity for further analysis. My small issue is he didn't cover much of the final project for the course so some students were a bit lost on what to do.

Lindhe is a genuinely nice guy. He gives good practice for exams and quizzes, which generally closely mirror what you actually see. Grading is the same as most every other math class, which still sucks, but he is super helpful and accommodating, and his lectures are solid.

Mr. Linde is not the best lecturer for his courses. He is smart. But he is also very accommodating in my experience with him. He helped me pass the class. And I feel comfortable with my mathematical education from him. He's been a good lecturer, and refers to his textbooks well. I could not recommend a better math teacher, in my experience.

Prof. Lindhe made Calc 3 super easy. Everything was taught in a really straightforward way, and he explained things that may have been unclear really well. The exams were very representative of the problems we'd do in class and for homework, and he did a great job preparing us for the final. I'd absolutely take a class with him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easiest math class I've taken so far. Very straightforward tests and quizzes. Final was really hard because we weren't very prepared for it but he rounded up our entire classes final grades. Would definitely take again.
He is a good guy and willing to help out outside of class

the G.O.A.T. Easy tests, quizzes, and take homes. Genuinely does not want this class to stress you out. You can practice from old tests and finals so if you go to class and do the review, you're basically guaranteed an A. A very nice professor in general, and accessible for office hours.

Professor Lindhe was the only math professor I ever had that was able to stick to the pace of the curriculum and frequently end class early due to covering enough for the day. His way of explaining the material is very concise and focuses on what you need to know and what will be tested. Absolutely reccomended.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really like Prof. Lindhe! He is reasonable/accommodating, personable, and very available outside class. He seemed passionate about the subject and gave fair assignments/tests. One thing I loved was that he offered materials from previous semesters to do as practice for the quizzes/tests! He is a good choice for probably any course

Lindhe is a great math professor. He makes things clear and if you do the hw you will be fine. Practice material for tests and quizzes is exactly like the actual thing. Drops a quiz and overall class isn't too hard but depends on how much u put into it. Overall super nice guy and great teacher.

Professor Lindhe was most definitely one of the best math teachers I have ever had. He explained all the material really well and went over everything he would test so there were no surprises on exams or quizzes. He also provided us with a lot of extra material, in case we were confused about any particular subject matter. I highly recommend him.

Lindhe was one of, if not the best professor I've had. He connects very well with students (even in online class format) and is passionate about the material. He explained calc3 very well and I and my friends never felt lost. He hosted live lectures and addressed any and every question or concern. The class was graded on 4 quizzes and 3 tests.
I love him and I take his class this semester again.

Always prepared for lecture + engaging. We have a quiz every week and he drops the two lowest grades - great way to make sure you're keeping up. Homework is suggested for each section but not mandatory/graded. Very willing to help outside class. Gives partial credit. Doesn't really teach a deep understanding - more like "plug and chug"
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr Lindhe is a helpful and supportive instructor. He is always ready to support you outside of class. But sometimes in lecture I struggle understanding why certain equations work. He seems to focus on take all the theorems and plug in numbers rather than learning why and problem solving skills. Overall, it was a great class as hes always prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: In past semesters this professor prepared his students for finals and test. However, this semester we really got blindsided by the final (which is 40% of your grade). The final had problem unlike anything we had done the whole semester and nothing like the past exams. He told us to study past exams and we'd be fine but that was clearly not the case

He grades by 2 quizzes, 2 takehomes, and 2 tests. All of these were easy and really similar to the ones from previous years. The final (40%) was impossible, with problems that were much more harder than the ones we had done in class. I found his way of teaching the class boring and the explanations weren't clear for me, he just did problems.
Love this man. Makes the material straightforward and easy to learn. Gives plenty of examples and is always willing to answer questions.

Prof. Lindhe is a fantastic professor. His lectures were very clear, easy to follow, and explained new concepts in the best way possible. He loves what he does, and that shows when he is teaching. He made himself accessible to students, and was understanding when issues come up. I found the class to be very easy because he had us well prepared

The nicest math teacher I have ever had. Gives a lot of partial credit. In general a fair grader, knowledgeable, nice, helpful, passionate about math. The class though was not very challenging (the department's fault, not his) and the examples shown in class lacked variety and didn't promote deeper understanding of the concept.
He is mean for every test or quiz grades. He never round up grade and is hard to communicate with. All grades are non-negotiable. I won't take his class again.

Prof. Lindhe is an incredibly talented professor that really wants you to succeed. He provides so many resources and really explains the material. He uses class time efficiently and no matter the time of day, he always has a smile on his face, ready to help. A wonderful human, a wonderful course. Would highly recommend.
I would defiantly take his classes again. He is a REALLY good professor!!!!!
Wonderful teacher. The class isn't stressful at all, but you learn everything you have to know.

Really good lecture and he is willing to answer questions in class. 2 take-home and 2 in class quizzes. The take-homes are a little bit harder, and he will give help if you asked. Offering reviews for tests and quizzes which are helpful. If you study hard and understand the materials, easy to get A.

Prof Lindhe is great! He's super clear and really wants his students to do well. He gives review sheets before each test that are really similar to the test. He's a really fair grader and gives a lot of partial credit. Always willing to answer questions. Wish I took him for MATH3081.
Clear, good professor.
Best Calc professor I ever had! Do the practice quizzes before the quiz and you'll do great. Super friendly and explains concepts very clearly. Really patient.
Great prof.

This is the second time I have had Professor Lindhe. He is the man! Both times I have had him he has taught the material well. He is very good with explaining topics and will help during office hours if you show up. His testquiz reviews  are also great indicators as to what type of problems are going  to be asked of you.

Clearly puts very little effort into teaching or even understanding the material he is teaching to the class.  Offers no understanding of the material, and most of the class time is spent doing slight variations of the same problems over and over again.  Tests are all just plugging numbers into formulas, anyone with a formula sheet could ace them.

One of the best math professors at the school. You'll know exactly what to expect coming into every class, and you'll know exactly what to expect on the tests/quizzes. Pay attention, take notes, ask questions, and you'll learn a lot

if you take good notes, you are likely to pass. He gives clear explanations and loves when people comes to him with questions. I never used the textbook but I'm still doing great in the class. He tries his hardest to pass everyone.

Usually good at teaching and explaining.  Occasionally unclear, but he does a good job with examples, which makes up for it.  Will never surprise you on a test with stuff you haven't already seen.  Pretty non-strict during class, too.

He spends a lot of time on examples in class, which helps with learning a lot more than the way most math professors spend the entire time dissecting theory. The way he explains things can be a little muddled sometimes, but when he goes over the examples it clears everything up.

You do not have to do the homework or read the textbook at all. But if you don't make sure you pay complete attention in class and take EVERY note, as his lectures are very helpful. Tests and quizzes are relevant to teachings. Sometimes does a poor job of fully explaining concepts. Final is deceptively easy..didn't do as well as I thought, wtf?

HATED that class and him. He speaks and goes way too fast and has a deep hatred of foreigners. Also a harsh grader and is useless in his office hours. I understood things WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAY better with a tutor than with him. He sucks.
awesome teacher. everything he teaches is as clear as can be. nice guy. perfect for non math intensive majors
Hated his class. I never understood ONE WORD that came out of his mouth. He is even worst inf you get him, do your best to get his attention.
LOVE HIM!! easiest class ever!!!! i got 100 on my final and I didnt even study that hard. I skip class very often and dont really study~~~~~

Completely agree with the previous post. Never did the homework, and got A's. 2 quizzes, 2 tests, 2 takehomes; cheat sheets allowed all year. Do King's final review as well because he writes the majority of the final and his wordiness tends to make the questions more difficult to interpret. Still, Lindhe is a great teacher, highly recommended.

So your taking this course and its easy!  Quizzes, tests are cake since he reviews a near identical format of it beforehand, takehomes are somewhat challenging, but he dedicates days for questions on the takehomes.  Book is useless, only used once to look up what I can find online.  BEWARE OF THE FINAL!  Its nothing like the ease of the course.
Crystal clear, very knowledgeable, extremely nice and helpful.
unmatched clarity

Sometimes skips steps - you'll be fine if you did well in Calc 1. Use book for HW, but not necessary. Gives clear review sheets - everything you need to know is there. Go to office hours for ANY questions and he'll clarify in terms of the quiz. Kind of awkward but overall a good guy.

Teaches very clear, makes sure you understand the material, and always willing to help. I'm not good in math but did great in his class because of his ability to teach in a straightforward and helpful way.
easy a
Do well on the quiz and exams. He does not curve at all.

Stats: I returned my book the second week of class, never did the homework, and got a solid A. Lectures make you want to stab yourself in the ears to keep from getting stupider just by listening. No intelligence, effort, or participation expected of you.  Just know the exam review sheets cold. Kinda depressing b/c the class *could* be so much more.

Easy class, helpful professor, very clear when speaking.  Gives tons of opportunities for you to go see him if you need help, but just copy down what he says in class, and you're fine for an A or B.  Teaches you what you need to know, is the simplest way to put it.

Excellent teacher, VERY helpful, and you can learn a lot in this class. However, if you just want the easy A and don't really care about learning statistics: Go to his office hours for the computer labs; take extensive notes when he's reviewing for a quiz or test, and copy those notes to your [allowed] cheat sheets to use during the exam.

He does a great job, and makes awesome review sheets. He does a great job preparing you for the quizes, mid-terms and final. If you need extra help, he's always available and puts in sincere effort. The material isn't hard, but he is still one of the best professors I've had in my first year at NEU.
No Comments

Lindhe is a bit timid and nervous, which shows through his teaching. But like everyone has been saying he wants to help you. Only 2 computer labs which he basically does for you in class, and either 3 tests or 3 quizes and 2 tests, the class gets to choose. Don't do the homework, just the reviews!

He's a great guy always willing to help.  Can be a bit confusing when he's explaining things but gives great review sheets.  Make sure to do them... and go to him for all computer projects, he really wants to help and wants you to do well.
He's a really good guy.  His tests are exactly the same as his reviews so it makes things easy, plus he lets you use a sheet of notes for the test.  He'll help you out too if you need it.

He's a really good guy, always willing to help you in any way, I missed midterm week b/c I was in the hospital and he let me make up the work at my own pace until I caught back up with class, he's just really nice and very helpful
Good guy, was always available to help you out. The test and quizes are the same as the practice tests he gives out. It is really easy to do well in his class
He's easy, and hott!
Good guy who will help u as much as ur willing to be helped.  Makes everything clear and does good examples on the board.  Usually get out of class early but knowing everything u need 2.

Prof. Lindhe is a great guy. He is always willing to help if you don't understand. He does tons of examples in class. Never do the homework just go to his reviews and do the practice tests and you will be fine. He tests on what he says he is going to.
kinda crazy, but he's a good guy and if u do u r work you'll do well
tries to make things as easy as possible, nice person
Weak teaching skills
unreasonable. do not recommend.

Professor Marpaung is somehow a professor. That said, the course can feel pretty demanding due to the pace and expectations. One downside is that getting extra help or clarification harder than it should be. Also, at one point he tried rizzing me up in front of the class, which was… unexpected and definitely threw off the learning environment.

I missed the final exam due to stomach issues, not to get into too much details, but I was having chronic diarrhoea. And this professor said I couldn't write it again, even with a doctors note. my GPA took a hit, I feel I should have gotten another chance.

Professor Marpagnug is knowledgeable and organized, with clear lectures. However, he is hard to reach outside class, which can be frustrating you almost want to thank him and kiss his forehead when he replies. He is also an extremely tough marker, so be prepared to work hard.
Don't do this to yourself

Your experience with Dr. M will depend on the course you're taking. 2 days before midterm he says 4/5 of the questions will be RISCV questions despite giving us practice midterm 1s with no RISCV questions...basically wasting our study time. It feels sometimes like he's unorganized on purpose. He's not difficult, just frustrating. Read the textbook

Reasons to take this class:
1. You hate yourself

Don't take if you:

the worst ever.

The most unprofessional professor I've ever had. Late almost every single day, and it genuinely always seemed like he was viewing the pre-made lecture slides for the first time. I hate her.
jesus man take any other class besides 2322 please oh my lord
gives too much work

Valid prof.

reviews.comment: Please don't take this class. Take any other professor.

Julius was great. He was funny and a good teacher. At no point in that class did I feel ill prepared for a test or homework. He works closely with the TAs during lab to help us. reviews.comment: Where do i even begin, whatever you do please, if you value your well being (and your education), avoid Julius Marapaung as much as you can,  I don't care if you have to take an 8am or even a 3am DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS. ESPECIALLY 2322. He had mandatory attendence yet he was late to every class and the tests and hws are AWFUL.

Worst prof out there - genuinely a mean person who's out to get students, and he has no shame saying so himself. Ruined my life. Will ruin yours if you take, beware.

Ended up being great to at least my group and/or section, a smaller section, so that helped. Interacted with us a lot. Personality absolutely not an issue.
If you're looking for a challenge  that will test your stress tolerance, then this professor comes highly recommended!!!

Hilarious experience with this bul**** Professor, I've never encountered Proffesor  who would lead students into such risky situations. If he doesn't like you, you're out of luck.

Just bad in so many aspects. Avoid to save your academic career.

reviews.comment: If you care about your wellbeing please avoid at all costs

Don't be surprised if you spend a decent amount of time outside class completing labs. Lectures were barely helpful, and long-ish readings are assigned weekly to make up for that. On the flip side, he was lenient with due dates. 

Best not to procrastinate on the midterm.
He's a terrible professor. He does not communicate concepts clearly. It is a lab heavy class, and is impossible to finish labs in class. The averge time to complete a lab is about 6 hours.

This is an easy A class. However, the professor spends most of the lectures discussing material that is not useful for the projects or for the exams. He is very condescending when answering questions and did the bare minimum. I got above a 100 on most projects and got As on the exams, but for some reason I got an A- in the class.

He does not care at all about helping students succeed. There were weeks where I spent over 10 hours outside of class on the labs, and the TAs knew as little as us. He did not give an extension on a lab when my partner and I were both really sick. He seems to get joy out of stressing out his students who try so hard to do well. Would not recommend.

Needed to take EECE 2160 as a comp sci major. He was not understanding of the fact that I had no prior knowledge of the concepts in his class. Talked bad about me to a TA saying I was not putting in any effort despite me going to office hours after spending 3+ hours struggling to complete an assignment
I would rather tear out my own eyes and eat them then have to take a class with this professor ever again. He makes a point out of not helping students and ridiculing them for questions.

Probably the most rude and egotistical person I have ever met. Unwilling to answer questions in class and unable to respond to emails. Mocks students during class regularly. Collaboration and seeking help are actively discouraged by him. None of his qualifications make up for any of this. Avoid associating at all with Professor Marpaung.

Assigned a project that was so far beyond the class nearly everyone dropped it. During my time in Dr. Marpaung's class I saw student's mocked and disrespected by him for not being able to answer questions in class. This guy is truly a horrible person who's ego rests solely on how many people he can get to drop his class. Avoid this prof.
hard-o

reviews.comment: Started the class by saying "Every student will get an A if they do the work", and then was extremely harsh grading the midterm and final reports, which are 40% and 20% of your grade. Despite the report itself taking 1 hour to write and the projects taking 20-30 hours to complete.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wowee! I enjoyed him so much! He gave the first exam after the drop date, in which the average was a 40. So strategic! He insulted me throughout the semester for asking him questions. Wow, so generous! He repeatedly referred me to Google! And finally, he picked and chose those who peeved him and purposefully failed him! So fair! Take him!!!

Marpaung is a funny professor. He teaches the topics well and makes an effort to ensure every student learns the information in the lectures. Do not skip lecture or labs if you want to pass this class, but it is not difficult.

It is very easy to get an A in this class but the professor is extremely confusing. He WILL NOT answer your emails even when he tells you to email him. He confuses up his own deadlines and keeps changing dates. But midterm was online. Sometimes he would get answers wrong when explaining.
He's super nice and makes class engaging. Absolute GOAT.
Super nice and caring professor. Doesn't make you feel bad even when you ask obvious questions. Probably the best math teacher I've had in college. Not sure why his rating isn't higher.

The class consists of 2 mid-term exams, both open book and online. There is no final exam. Attendance is mandatory but is only worth 5% of your grade. Group project was quite easy and had 6 HW assignments throughout the semester that were graded.
Excellent professor.

He's a very nice professor and is considerate towards helping his students. He has a somewhat difficult accent barrier. At least you can rewatch his Zoom lectures. Somewhat tough grader for exams and group assignments (He had to curve the grades). You leave 30-40 minutes early every class, which is nice.
Group project is good, and professor is good, but special Indian accent in lecture is hard to understand, and high score like A and A+ is not easy to be get.

Very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about material. Moves VERY fast so you either have to be very prepared or backtrack to go over lecture/material again. Understands many frames of thinking and extremely helpful if you ask questions (even if you think they're dumb). Lectures way more useful than the book.
Very easy lectures but assignments are very difficult and class notes are not at all relevant to the questions he asks in assignment and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The lecture is very technical, one has to have a solid background in Math to understand the concepts. The lecture is wholly conceptual.  Exams are not the easiest, quite a lot of preparation is required.  The Professor is the best, couldn't ask for a better guide.

i had professor kautsch for ILS, he always teaches what you need for the quiz beforehand and puts all the necessary equations on the board. the quizzes arent too bad as long as you study. hes super funny and caring and he makes the lectures super fun by bringing in lego figures. hes a great guy, take him if you can

great guy and i loved having him for ILS, i would highly recommend taking it with him! he always put equations we needed on the board and expressed a lot of interest in physics which made it entertaining; honestly more helpful than the lectures on most weeks.
He's a funny guy but not very helpful with teaching physics.

The class is reverse-classroom style, meaning you watch lecture videos for hw and do practice problems in class. This guy is very sweet, but you will learn nothing from him. He doesn't even make the lecture videos, and his explanations in class are all over the place and confusing. He gets two stars simply because he's funny.
This guy actually taught me nothing of value in physics for life sci because he will just try to relate it to astronomy or his legos!!! Accent is top tier tho

If you get the chance to take any of his classes you definitely should. This man is so sweet and enthusiastic. I do not like physics but looked forward to showing up every day because of him. He brings in Lego models that go with the topic we are learning about and seems like he really wants you to understand the topics. 10/10

This was his first year teaching Physics 1, so he was still figuring it out. He brought a LEGO model to each class, which tied into some aspect of the lecture. He is a very sweet guy and obviously very intelligent, but lectures sometimes stray away from the content for the quizzes, ect. His accent is great, and he cracks a lot of jokes.

Professor Kautsch made ILS a breeze with extremely helpful lectures (more so than 1151's), helpful feedback, and very fair grading and treatment. He was very personable and understanding, reaching out if you missed a quiz automatically. He made my experience in physics much easier and I feel as if I learned a lot from him.
Great professor. Very clear and achievable expectations and grading. Easy to reach outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a quiet teacher, but he really knows what he is talking about. His classes are very lecture-heavy, and even though he says to get the textbook, you do not really need to buy it. Everything in the books is what he talks about on his PowerPoint in class. Would definitely take classes with him again. He is very easy to reach outside of class

Prof. Khatchatryan was great! His expectations were extremely clear and relatively easy to meet as long as you look at/attend the lectures. Your grade is made up of 5 quizzes, 2 midterms/tests, a term paper, and participation. Overall a super kind professor and very responsive to his emails.
waste of time and money. for a class that could be so interesting and motivating all he did was read off the slides.

Super easy class if you show up and take notes. He posts the slides beforehand and the quizzes only cover stuff in them. Sometimes, there are bonus points for something he says in class. Funny guy and wants everyone to do well. The midterm and final are both online, take-home, so they're very easy. Fun field trip to a jail aswell.
Great guy.

Professor Katchatryan's lectures were often dry and unmotivated, he spoke with a monotone voice that was very difficult to pay attention to. That being said, class assignments were not hard and were very fair. Not hard to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy classes but lazy lecturer in my opinion, no passion and he's a quiet speaker. He is super kind though, grades fairly and cares about his students. I found this class a little frustrating as it only looked at russian/italian org crime and it seems outdated and stereotypical - I think there is more to talk about specifically in the US.

Professor Katchatryan is such a kind professor! He was very helpful with any questions I had throughout the semester. A lot of his class is him reading slides but he also added in a lot of class discussions and encouraged us to have thoughtful conversations about topics which I always enjoyed.

Laziest professor I have had at Northeastern, he just read off the slides everyday in the most monotone voice that it became difficult to stay awake. I did not learn anything in this course, and I do not fully understand why students or faculty like him. Easiest A you will ever receive, but at what cost.

Has this class over the summer online -- He is caring and always put in work to make sure we felt prepared for quizzes. Not graded on many things, but always very fair. Not a difficult class, but still was very interesting!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Katchatryan's class is pretty easy (the quizzes are taken directly from class slides and the midterm + final are online) but his lectures are extremely boring. I didn't know it was possible to make a class on organized crime boring, but he managed to do it. Seems like a nice guy tho, just so not engaging.

Dr. Katchatryan is one of the sweetest professors I've had at Northeastern. His quizzes are very straightforward as long as you review the slides he presents during the lectures. There are three writing assignments that I found very interesting but also weren't too difficult. The midterm and final are both online and open-note outside of class.
Very sweet guy. Course was easy if you read the slides and complete the writing assignments.  His smile lights up a room!
If you go to class and read the slides you will get an A

He made this class very easy, there is a textbook but it's honestly unnecessary. Everything you need is on the lecture slides which he will post after the lecture. If you take notes on the slides you'll be fine. There are 5 quizzes throughout the sem. but they are not hard. Take notes for the open note exams and you'll be fine.

Very kind professor! The class was all lectures and a bit of discussion. 3 writing assignments, 5 quizzes, and a midterm and final (both online). Participation is graded, but if you go to office hours you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You go to class, type the notes he gives you, you have about 5 quizzes that are on one chapter each. 3 writing assignments that are 3-5 pages each with their own requirements.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor is a genuinely nice guy, and if you have a general interest in criminal justice, his class offers a pleasant and laid-back experience. His teaching style is straightforward, mostly consisting of reading off slides. Exams and quizzes are very easy and the final paper is very easy especially if you start right away.

Prof Katchatryan is a solid professor. He reads off the slides that he later posts, so it's pretty easy to refer back to them in prep for the online exams, though the lectures can be boring. There is a final paper that I found very interesting and he reminds you of it often. This was a course I could rely on to be easy, so I definitely recommend.

Prof Richman was easily the best professor I've ever had! Her passion for nutrition is so evident and encourages questions. Her quizzes (5 total) are very easy, and she basically tells you exactly what will be on them before the quiz. They are the take-home messages at the end of each slideshow. Barely any homework, 2 big "projects" are very easy.

Dr.Richman's lectures are amazing and insightful. Attendance is not mandatory but just attending the lectures is enough information to do well on quizzes. The class is made 40% off two easy assignments that take a day and she gives you the word for word questions that are on each of the 5 quizzes and the final. Highly recommend her class! So easy!
Judith Richman is my queen. She wants you to succeed in her class and she makes sure that you are well prepared for her (very easy) tests.
Judy is the best!! She gives a thorough review the day before quizzes with all the answers. Lectures are boring but she lets you out early most days. She is so kind and understanding!

The class consists of five quizzes and two papers with guidelines that are difficult not to follow. She wants every student to succeed and it would be difficult to get anything lower than an A. If you don't want to go to the lectures, be sure to go to the ones before quizzes as she tells you everything that will be on them making it easy to pass.

Prof. Richman is the BEST! So kind and understanding. Grade is basically 5 quizzes, but she gives a really good review the class before, and 2 "papers", but you just have to put effort in and respond to the questions. She's passionate about the content and wants everyone to learn. The sweetest teacher I've had, if you can take her class do it!

Judy is the best!! She gives a comprehensive review the day before the quiz with every answer. Lectures are long and boring, but you don't have to pay attention or take notes because the review is so good. She genuinely cares about her students and lets class out early every time. I wish I could take more classes with her
BEST PROF!! Genuinely so kind. She will give u the test questions and answers the day before the test. Love love love her :))

Basically just graded by five quizzes, a couple “papers” (documents with short answer questions) and our final exam. You can do well by just studying the “take home messages” at the end of her slides but there's a lot she says in class that you'll miss if you don't come to lecture. Kind woman who really wants you to do well, but not a tough class.

Prof. Richman is super nice, and her class was very interesting! There were 5 quizzes in total but they're not bad at all. The class before a quiz she goes through all the content you need to know for it so definitely attend class those days. All the other work from the class is pretty easy and she doesn't grade harsh at all.
Very interesting material with a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Richman is great! She is genuinely so kind and wants to make the class as easy for students as possible while still providing a variety of material. Tells you exactly what you need to know for quizzes and additional assignments are very clear and straightforward.
Nutrition with Prof Richman is a must take course! She is brilliant and passionate!  All students should take this course.

one of my best professors this sem! her lectures very detailed but informative. she gives you all you need to pass the class and rlly cares about her students. you will def get an A!

exam tips: she sometimes provides study guides; otherwise i would use the take home messages at the end of her slides and take note of repeated concepts.

She is a caring professor who really does want you to do well in her class. She goes over the materials of an exam a lecture before the exam. If you study what she tells you to study, you will do well on her exams. Her projects are also relatively easy if you just follow the instructions.

Although her lectures were uninteresting, Richman still cared about her students. Richman constantly emails students to make sure they're on track and if you have trouble with her quizzes or information, she is a great communicator and will send you her lecture videos.

Loved her. Quizzes were okay but easy. 2 projects that if you did exactly what it tells you to do, you will get a high A in it. she tells you what will be on the quizzes before and on the take home messages. very nice of letting you take a quiz later or earlier if you have any time conflicts.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Richman is great. Her quizzes are very lecture heavy however they are easy. She does not take attendance and you do not need to go to every class. As long as you go to the review lecture before taking the quizzes it very straight forward and easy

Professor Richman really cares about her student and knows her stuff. Workload in this class was manageable but be prepare for biweekly quizzes. However, if you study her study guide/attend the review lecture, it should be easy. Definitely recommend Professor Richman.

Very caring and teaches with a drive for students to actually gain something from the class. She very clearly indicates what will be on the quizzes and the final exam, to the extent that I got a 100 on my final after reviewing for around 2 hours total.

Grade is mainly made up of like 5 quizzes, 1 major project, and the final exam. Please take the quizzes seriously as that's lowkey what determines your grade. She gives you take home messages so I stopped going to class after like the 2nd quiz. Easy teacher  although she lectures the ENTIRE class start to finish which was painful to sit through.

I LOVE Judith. She has been one of my favorite professors so far, she's very understanding. Her tests are very easy since she has take-home messages for all slides, if you study the take-home messages you will get a perfect score since everything on the take-home messages is on the quiz. Her class has taught me a lot.
This class is easy take her littelry u dont even need to come to class, just come on the review days and that will tell you everything for the exams.
Great teacher: friendly, approachable, creates a positive atmosphere, patient, and genuinely cares about student success. Provides helpful feedback and accurate study guides. Highly recommend.

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR IF YOU NEED THE CREDIT. This class was actually very easy. Lectures are long (can get boring for some) but I promise it is worth it. Final is worth 10% and the bulk of your grade are the quizzes which are easy! I recommend studying the take home msgs and if you want a better understanding, going back to read slides helps too.

Professor Richman is such an empathetic & caring professor. She's accommodating for people with disabilities. I struggled with medical & mental health issues & she was always willing to support me in any way. The quizzes can be tricky so make sure to memorize the study guides. You can get an A if you put in a good amount of effort & come to class.

You can tell that Professor Richman cares about teaching and her students. The assignments are not difficult. Also, she provides many resources to help you and your grade in Nutrition. I recommend, that everyone take Nutrition as an elective, or have Professor Richman as one of your professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof Richman has a fair to easy class, and as long as you put in a little effort and start working on the 2 major assignments around a week in advance it is hard not to get an A. The material is easily retained and overall she makes it very easy to learn the material both in class and through her section overviews online.

Great professor! Really cares about what she is teaching and I actually left the class learning a lot just by attending lecture and listening. Quizzes are straightforward and she typically gives you some kind of study guide. Otherwise take home messages are the study guide. Just show up to class and listen!
Lectures are long and content heavy. Assignments are easy. Sometimes insensitive when teaching certain topics.

Professor Richman was great!! Her class was boring and tiring at times, but not very difficult. The main projects and assignments are actually fun to do, and you learn a lot of things. She started uploading study guides for the quizzes we took, which made them 10x easier. She's also a very considerate Professor and tries to work with you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Richman is a great professor, although her lectures are very lengthy, her class is very easy to pass. Depending on the person you are, just listening to her may be enough to absorb info, if she gives you a study guide you will ace her quizzes. The only negative thing I have to say about her is about her some of her commentary.

Prof Richman is so great. She's caring and understanding. She taught nutrition very well and was very accommodating during the covid issue/moving online. She will even tell you the textbook is not needed. I am likely to get an A without having it. She goes fast, but it's not too hard to keep up with her. Study take home slides and you're fine.

Homeworks (papers she calls them) are lengthy but rare. In my opinion she barely even read papers and gives high grades. Lectures are lengthy and drag on. I was somewhat interested in nutrition but still found myself getting tired of it. Her class doesn't vary much. For quizzes you just need to memorize the take home messages from slides.

Judith is nice & an easy grader, but that doesn't make it a good class. Some of the information (not all, but enough to notice) is false or twisted if you've looked into any aspect of nutrition before (she teaches type 1 diabetes wrong). She knows what she's talking about but puts her opinion into everything. Very frustrating. Would not recommend.

It is so refreshing to have a professor who really wants us to understand the material and use it in everyday life. Her lectures are interesting and you can tell that she really cares. Passionate and kind, you are in for a treat if you get to take her class!

Judith really knows what she is teaching and embodies what I want to be when I'm older. She is super nice and understanding, and her class isn't difficult. Read the take home messages and you'll be fine.

Judith Richman is an angel sent from above. Very knowledgable of the information she is teaching and extremely flexible to the class' preferences of when tests should be given. Overall a genuinely sweet person with immense knowledge about nutrition.

If you have a chance of taking Nutrition 1105 with Professor Richman do not hesitate to do so. She is so kind and cares a lot about her students and the subject. Her tests a very easy as long as you go over her power point slides. One of the best professors I've had at Northeastern University and I would highly recommended her to anyone.

She is the best professor I took this semester. Book is not necessary. Just listen to her lectures and study the take home messages and you will pass. She makes it incredibly easy to pass with very minimal effort on your part.

Very fair teacher! Tests are very straightforward and she even gives you study guides, which if you fill out, is basically the test.  She knows what she's talking about and it's very clear that she cares and wants you to learn.  Sometimes gives HW solely to check attendance, it's not that serious. You don't use the textbook at all.

Fantastic professor! Very knowledgeable and passionate and always willing to help. Quizzes are super easy (just memorize everything on the review sheets). She checks attendance randomly and occasionally includes lecture info on quizzes, so go to class! class usually ends early anyway
She is a very nice and helpful teacher. I learned a lot about nutrition without having to do any work at all.

Take her nutrition class! I learned a lot without having to work a lot and it's a pretty interesting course and I actually changed my diet and lifestyle based on some of the things I learned in class. Attendance isn't necessary and she checks it sometimes, but it's only 5% of the grade. If you study a little, it should be an easy A.

I love going to class just to hear her lecture. Shes a great teacher, and cares about what she is teaching you. The book is not necessary, and if you go to class you will actually learn something. I highly suggest taking this class!!

Probably the sweetest teacher I have ever had. She is exactly like a mom and willing to help anyone. Although going to class is not necessary at ALL, it is still interesting and you can get an A without going. Such a nice woman who is really into her field. Tells you exactly what is on the tests.
very nice lady, passionate about the subject and wanted to make you learn it. tests were super easy, but you still learned a lot.
One of the best classes I have taken.  She tells you what will be on the tests, easy A.
This professor is very easing going and knows the material well. The class was very interesting and I recommend this professor to all who take Nutrition for a class.

Really nice lady. All material is on powerpoint that she gives you. Attendance is not really necessary, although it is a relatively easy class to sit through. She wants everyone to do well in the course, and clearly knows her stuff.

Really nice, passionate, easy class, no attendance, easy exams...basically all you can want in a class. only negative would be class size, there wasn't even enough chairs for one of the exams and the classroom was huge
She was so nice!
Very passionate, I was already interested in nutrition but after the class I was even more so. Also, an easy A, she'll tell you directly what will be on the final and midterm.

The clas was VERY easy, but you were able to learn a lot. The class is set up so it is hard to fail, but you still learn a ton. Tended to get monotonous and long, but always got out of class VERY early.
If you don't know anything about gov take her class.
Great prof

POLS2345: Prof. Wolf is great. Very down to earth and has a lot of personal experience with the topics she teaches. She is very straightforward about everything and lectures are usually a pretty laid back but on topic discussion. Most of the weekly work is reading (ungraded). Exams are what you would expect, grading is quick. OVERALL great course.

I loooove this professor. She's funny, cares about her students a ton, and makes learning enjoyable for everyone. She uses a lot of NYT and other current news articles to explain how American gov topics are still relevant now, which makes it easier to stay engaged. Feedback on writing may be confusing but office hours clarify it. 10/10 prof.

THE BEST poli sci course you will take here at northeastern such a nice woman and very understanding ad caring make sure to lock in and study for the midterm and your guaranteed an A trust. TAKE IT WITH HER.

Prof. Wolf is such an amazing professor! She is passionate about her teaching and really wants her students to exceed in learning. Most of her classes consist of lectures and discussions which help to truly understand the topics. Overall, amazing professor and would HIGHLY recommend!

Prof Wolf is without a doubt one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern. Beyond being an amazing lecturer, who makes class content incredibly engaging, she is so caring as a professor, and always goes above and beyond for her students. Readings and class discussions were so enriching on an academic and personal level. LOVED her class.
Great professor! Her assignments were actually useful, and I felt like I learned a lot in this class. I definitely would take a class with her again!

Prof Wolf is the sweetest and completely understands how stressful school is. She is understanding and wants you to do well. This class is an easy A. Almost felt bad at how little work this class was. I think I spent less than 20 hours on this class all semester. Everything you could want in a professor. Would take again!

If you want to love your life take any class with Kayla Wolf. Trust me it will be the best decision of your entire academic career at Northeastern. She is the best professor I've ever had, not only is she ridiculously intelligent, but she cares so much about her work and her students. If you actually do your work you'll be fine. TAKE HER CLASS!!!

RUN. taught by claude, assignments and tests written by claude, probably graded by claude. makeup exams are nice and saved my grade, LONG learning curve to get to an A; thought i was going to have to withdraw. sorry econ and other cssh students, he expects existing calc and cs experience; good luck.

Have to learn all material outside of class on your own time. He told us we were overly reliant on AI when AI use was required on homework. Assignments take 7+ hours. I should end with an A, only thanks to retakes and lots of extra credit. If you want a good grade, prepare to be overworked. The A cannot make up for the emotional toll.

This man made me consider lying on the green line tracks. I once drank while doing homework in the hopes of alcohol poisoning taking me out. 13+ hours on weekly homework assignments. Forced to be taught by AI. Tests are incredibly hard, and lectures are AI-based. Tests average 40%, no curve, only one retake per test. i really considered it

Probably the worst professor at Northeastern. You cannot understand what he is saying most of the time. The TAs are not helpful and take days to respond to even the most basic questions. Exam averages were around a 50, and weekly assignments take hours to complete.  Avoid this class.

Pros:
- Lots of time spent in Excel, great for experience
- LAMBDA knowledge definitely sets you apart from most users

Cons:
- Weekly assignments always a number 1 priority (shortest one took me 6 hours.)
- Instructions for these assignments are super unclear
- TA help isn't great
- Huge over-reliance on AI teaching
- First few weeks are brutal

Seriously avoid this class if possible. I took it because I needed a class with a lab for 5 credits and this was offered online. Serious mistake. The assignments are very hard and the professor essentially makes you use AI to learn everything and do the assignments. However, on exams, you cant use AI which makes them very difficult.

By far the worst professor I've had at Northeastern. As someone with ZERO excel experience/knowledge, I took this course thinking it would be an introductory course (1000 course). But, this professor has decided to overcomplicate topics as if we're all experts at CS, designed hellish weekly assignments, and the TAs are unhelpful.
I'm an economics and business administration major, and this class was rough. Tests were hard, tons of homework, and honestly just not worth it if you're not a CS major. Wouldn't take it again.
Assignments took hours and hours and made absolutely zero sense. If you are an Econ major and need this for reqs take either of the other courses offered and save yourself.
If you're a CSSH major (or basically just not cs and don't have much experience w/ excel) avoid taking this class. All i can say is thank god there were makeup exams otherwise I would have failed
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I spent one week in this class before dropping it. I cried myself to sleep every single night. Most of the TA's are useless except the girl one. This class is impossible if you have no cs background. Holy hell. Zero guidance, no one teaches you anything, actual hell on earth. Run, run, run, run, run, run.

This class was hybrid. The online portion was very easy, I had an A. However, the lab portion of this class was stupidly difficult. It did not match the online portion and Dr. Lieberherr did not seem to understand that this was an intro level class for non-CS majors. Assignments took HOURS to complete, and he made us use ChatGPT to teach ourselves.

I took this class as a requirement for Criminal Justice, but dropped it without a W a few weeks in. Online lecture material is taught by a different professor and is barely (if at all) related to weekly assignments. Weekly assignments take multiple hours a day to complete, they are confusing and frustrating. I do not recommend this class at all.
Run. Whole class tested 33% average score on exam 1, we all almost failed. I am an elite academic and had never withdrawn from anything ever. I withdrew from this. Run, you will not pass. Run.

Genuinely the worst course I have ever taken. This professor does not teach, and he relies on ChatGPT, yet you can not use it on exams. The TAs grade everything! It is way too difficult for an intro class, and just horrible. Do not take.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Run.
honestly save yourself while you can.

This class is unnecessarily difficult for an intro class. Assignments take 12+ hours to complete, so it just feels like the work is never-ending. Weekly lab sessions are essential because it's the only time you can get in-person help. Go to TA office hours even if you feel like your question is insignificant because the grading can be harsh.

This class was basically Excel 101 which is super helpful for future jobs. Almost all of the learning is done outside of class on your own time. We met once a week and the professor would work through problems. The assignments can be tedious and long but are doable. The use of ChatGPT plus was required for the class.

Prof Lieberherr isn't uncaring towards his students, he is just so out of touch with them he doesn't realize how unrealistic his curriculum is. The hw & online modules were extremely outdated and clearly hadn't been revised in a while. Helpful when I would come to him for office hours, thats abt it. Unreasonably difficult class. Avoid if possible.

If you have to take this course I'm sorry, it is impossibly hard due to Prof Lieberherr. The online course material is confusing and hard to follow. The in-class labs are useless, when you ask a question he will pull up ChatGPT and tell you how it will answer it. Assignments and exams are hard to read and deceptive in what part is being graded

This professor does not teach anything, only advice I have for you is to make sure to show up to class because the one-hour labs per week is useful to completing SOME parts of the 4-5 hour long time-consuming assignments. Way too much content for an introductory course, and way less teaching. Now he has implemented chat-GPT teaching, good luck.

Weekly 1 hour class barely scratched the surface of what we actually needed to know for the assignments. Highly advise against taking this class unless it's a requirement, you will be countless hours working on the weekly project. There are 2 exams each worth 25% of the grade, so you have no choice but to learn it

Online lectures are useless. They tell you the basics of functions but you must figure out how to use them. Lab sessions are essential, as he goes through assignment for the week and teaches you how to do it. Quizzes easy grade boosters, but assignments are confusing, unclear, time consuming and hard. Prof is good but class is structured terribly.

Weekly 1 hour class barely scratched the surface of what we actually needed to know for the assignments. Highly advise against taking this class unless it's a requirement, you will be spending 1 day every week cooped up inside trying to complete the assignments. There are 2 exams each worth 25% of the grade, so you have no choice but to learn it

Great professor, I just hated the class. Just make sure you do well on the assignments because that really helps, but there's an assignment due every week which took up my whole weekend. There's two exams, I got a 65 on the first exam and still ended up with an A-. The 1st exam was harder than the 2nd.

As a Psych-CJ major taking this course as a requirement, I am so thankful to have had Professor Lieberherr. Though the online portion is less than ideal, Lieberherr makes up for it by giving useful and easily digested information during class. I never thought I'd be able to understand CS in any capacity, but Lieberherr has changed my mind.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I went to Professor Karl's office hour twice. He is extremely willing to help, so if you get stuck by the homework, don't hesitate to ask him.
Class is based mainly on weekly homeworks and one project
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very good

One of my favorite professors at Northeastern. I had him for CS1100, and while my friends who had other professors were complaining, I had nothing to add. The class itself is mostly self-driven, so if you do not like that its an issue with the course, not the professor. Karl was available outside class time to help and is really such a kind person!

All learning is watching online lectures, then review is done in class. Watch them and take notes before class. Be prepared to be called on! Only 1 65 min class a week, but 10+ hours spent outside of class. Prof is quiet unless asked a question, but is very knowledgable and a sweet man if you talk to him! Hated class at first, ended up loving it!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: for the required class for a lot of different majors, prof lieberheerr was good. if something was unclear, he would explain it and make sure you understood. but the class itself required a lot of work outside of the meeting time, but thats with any professor you choose to take it with.

This was the most work i've ever had for a course so far and it was only an 1000 level course. The professor doesn't explain anything. You are expected to teach yourself all the material by watching the online lectures before attending class. Class is once a week. Not nearly enough time to understand any of the material. Don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I took the class twice... the first time was during my very first quarter of graduate school and I dropped it after 2 weeks because it was hopelessly more complex than I could understand.   I took it again during my last quarter and was AMAZED at the depth of information Karl presented.  He remains one of my two best graduate school professors.

The man is an enigma. He has you learn algorithms through the use of a "game", which in theory is a very novel approach. In practice, it's sometimes a little silly (especially when you play by yourself). In class, he's fairly clear and is very receptive to people asking questions. Exams are open note.
The Game is useless and even if you ask exactly what you need to turn in for homeworks, you'll still be missing something. Avoid if possible, but you probably won't be able to.

This class is like starving to death. At first, you try and try to make it through the next day, but eventually, your stomach distends, and you hallucinate the laughing specter of Karl, mocking you, as you cannot even muster up the strength to swat the flies off of your face. You, and your GPA die, just as you came into this world, alone.

The course was Secure Software Engineering. Or, at least, that's what it was called. It turned out to be a course in AspectJ and Demeter - really just him providing a forum for his students' research projects and trying to push AOP on everybody. I am told this is what ALL his classes are.

Brilliant man, wonderful professor. My only complaint is with the course itself, not with Lieberherr. The project was one that he had never done before, and didn't even know how to do himself. Talking to others who took his class, I guess this happens a lot. Surprised to find no Lieb bashers here!

Work hard and you'll learn LOTS. Lieb. is a zen sort of guy, but if you get him talking you immediately pick up on his vast ability and experience. He is willing to help any time, but can be confusing at times. Great class. Do y'self a favor and take it.

prof kelley is a rlly funny guy and makes lectures fun. although lectures aren't mandatory they are helpful. the class is very manageable. i would just recommend you understand the homework and assignments/quizzes from ILS. The midterm was pretty easy but the  final was pretty tricky.  practice problems are your friend. overall i would recommend.

Tom Kelley is a pretty good professor, but not a great lecturer. I probably went to less than half of his lectures for that reason, but I had taken Physics before and succeeded because of that and ILS. Overall not too bad, just kind of average. Still the best professor of all the physics 1 for engineering profs.

He honestly doesn't really teach during class; you're pretty much expected to know material coming into lectures, and the lectures serve as practice time. Physics 1151 is difficult and time-consuming, but homework helps guide understanding. I love this guy, he's super nice and full of energy, but his handwriting and lecture notes are a bit messy.

He is an amazing professor. The class size is huge so difficult to ask lots of questions but his office hours are the best. He is really helpful and explains class material really well. Well prepared for lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: AVOID AT ALL COSTS. Walked into class on the first day and he announced that he didn't feel like teaching this semester, so he employed a flipped classroom. I have had to try and teach myself this entire course with no previous physics knowledge with a heavy course load and it's been hell. He frowned and sighed when I walked into office hours too..

Office hours are a saving grace. He expects all the learning takes place outside class, thus class time is only practice for stuff he expects you to know. If thats your style then you will love him. Personally I'm paying to be taught by a teacher not have then be a tutor for 100 ppl simultaneously. Funny guy, cares about students just doesnt teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kelley is a good prof, knows what he's talking about. 1151 is a hard class overall but kelley does help us understand whats going on

Professor Kelley is a very good professor. He cares about success and gives good feedback on everything. He is a good lecturer, however, he often chooses hard in class examples that do not allow us to understand the topic in a simple sense. We also never finish the in class problems. There is a decent amount of HW, however its spread out well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professors lectures were useless. I did not learn a single thing from his lectures and he was a very tough grader during the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Kelley is very nice and enthusiastic about physics. I had no issues with his class. There is a decent amount of homework, but spread into 2 assignments throughout the week, so it isn't awful. He gives good lectures and I was never super confused, however I took AP Physics so I was already familiar with many of the concepts.
Saw the review was a bit high so had to lower a bit.
Very hard class so I do not think he is all to blame. Some days he would give a really good lecture, other days it would make no sense.

Physics 2 is a tough class so it is unfair to place any blame on Professor Kelley for the difficulty that I had taking this course. There were sometimes where the lecture would go off on a bit of a tangent and he would end up proving a lot of formulas that were unnecessary to prove. Super nice dude. Hard class.
Kelley is a decent professor. His lectures are relatively easy to understand, if a bit dull at times. No major issues.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kelley seems like a nice guy. He's like most physics teachers because he is really passionate about physics but is just not a great teacher. It's not an easy subject to lecture to that many people and get the content across. If you struggle with physics, try to go to office hours or tutoring to supplement. Kelley isn't a bad guy, just a bad teacher

Thomas Kelley is a hoot, and he makes physics exciting. Anything wrong with this course is not under Kelley's control, the material isn't particularly easy but he does the best he can, and if you put in some effort, you'll probably end above a B. So much better than chem1151, if gen chem ruined your life don't worry this class is so much better.

Physics is hard no matter which teacher you have. Tom Kelley is one of the best physics professors because he is very enthusiastic and passionate about physics. He makes his lectures interesting with his great personality and it made me actually want to go to class.

Interesting lectures, covers everything you're expected to know . His only downside is that he jumps from very easy problems straight into difficult problems, with no real intermediate problems where you can practice your skills with new concepts. Other than that, accessible, caring great guy (go to office hours if you're struggling)

I do not understand Tom's current rating. I have taken him for both physics 1 and 2. I have always heard that he was the better professor. However, after a year of classes with him I disagree. It may be the class layout, but at the end it felt like I was only going to get the equations I needed then I would teach myself the rest. Tom is overrated.
He was very unhelpful in office hours and his lectures were incredibly confusing. He barely gave out notes and rather gave very complex example problems.
Fun guy and probably the best option out of the phys1151 professors. The difficulty does not vary between your options. The worst part about the course is the lab anyways.

Dr. Kelley is pretty decent. His lecturers are bearable, but not that effective. Mastering physics HW is not fun, lab is not that fun, ILS is terrible. Dr. Kelley is probably the best option out of the mediocre Physics 1 teachers.

Kelley is a good physics professor. He presents information simply and gives good example problems. What earned him a 5-star rating was how well he handled a massive technological glitch within ten minutes of the final, which was unendingly stressful for both students and profs alike. He was very on top of it and did his best to help the students.

Very good prof for this course. Easy to understand and learn a lot from. The difficulty of phys 2 is the same across all the profs so that's not a knock against him. Write down the example problems or go back to them because those scenarios will be in the homework.

He is probably the best prof for this course here. Does a good job at covering material and making you stay awake with funny demos. Doesnt do a great job in change of difficulty. Would give easy problem then wildly complex one. However, does a good job making sure you have some idea how to solve problems. Chill dude
Prof Kelley has great lectures and is pretty clear in how he explains things. Goes over practice examples.

He is my 2nd fav professor so far. His lecture won't make u sleepy as he throws random jokes as well as objects. He shocked himself to demonstrate static current. He has clear voice, answers any question also has an online anonymous q & a for shy students.

Tom is a very dynamic lecturer, is fun to listen to, and thoroughly and clearly explains the material. Will occasionally fling chairs to demonstrate concepts, but never at students. He is also very responsive to student concerns; I never went to his office hours, but he and I interacted via email about some problems I was having. Great teacher.

Professor Danahy is kind and wants her students to succeed, but Orgo is tough. Practice exams felt manageable, yet actual exams, especially the final, were much harder and heavily application-based. There's no curve or extra credit. Despite mastering and understanding the practice material, my exam results didn't reflect it.
She was a really good teacher, but her tests were super hard, and she doesn't curve.

The lectures and the practice exams make the tests seem like they will be so easy, but last minute she always makes the exam 50x harder. The Puzzle Sets which she grades are almost impossible because you are allowed to use 'outside resources' but there are none that can even help. Please take ANYONE else, she is nice but she is extremely tough.

Take any other professor but her she has a massive ego and millennial humor. The exams themselves were hard and does not compare to the study material that she provides in which she barely provided any. Save yourself and take another person, if not then prepare to STUDY like your life depended on it. Do NOT trust the good reviews.

Learned a lot and organic chemistry is just a really tough subject, she's an amazing lecturer. Homework is hard and the tests are nothing like her homework or the suggested textbook questions. Final was legitimately ridiculous. There's 3 exams and a final and she never curves.

Many people in the class dropped. A lot were not in good standing. Averages for first two exams were in the 70s, the average for the next wasn't disclosed (for how bad they were). Also, she gave the hardest final exam I've ever done at northeastern.
Was okay until final. The final exam was insane and nothing like the course work. Studying did not help.
I love professor Danahy! I genuinely learned so much in this class. Very test heavy, but she does give you all the knowledge to succeed. Put in the time and you will do well

Makes orgo unnecessarily hard. No curve no corrections. The first two units are considered "easier," and the class averages were 75. After that she didn't bother mentioning the average. Practice tests are NOTHING like the actually exams. Final was impossible and nothing like course material. If you're not getting 90s on the first two tests, drop.

Confusing, and the final was impossible. Lectures are extremely fast; she expects you to learn a new topic in five minutes.  With that said, she will probably prepare you more for chem than other professors.

Class will be interesting, but she treats students as if they have a PHD in organic chemistry, using language unknown to students, making things complicated instead of simple and to the point. Puzzle sets are helpful and well-organized, as are the practice exams, except for the final. The final exam was impossible and lowered my grade by a letter.
RUN. And if you can't run... good luck
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I swear every good review on here is written by her. PLEASE don't take her is you value your sanity, literally anyone else.
Don't take if you value your social life or mental health. She is incapable of explaining things and expects you remeber every word she has ever said.

Professor Danahy is really good at teaching you the material but her class is considered harder than some of the other professors. You will have a great understanding of Orgo but your grade might be lower than if you took another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Take orgo with literally any other professor!! Her lectures are lengthy and confusing, and she doesn't explain concepts well. Her exams are very difficult and require you to have an extremely good understanding of orgo to apply concepts. She rarely does guided practice with the class and you're expected to know how to do all of the homework!!

Honestly one of the worst graders possible, tests are unfairly graded, lack of support and understanding, the practice exams are nothing like the real exams so no point in doing those. Her lectures are heavy and don't teach you much at all. I recommend taking another professor.

Danahy is a very nice person, but her tests are impossible. Studied for hours on end, yet still felt completely unprepared for each test. The topics covered between the last test and the final are rushed and poorly covered, so there was no shot the "final redemption" policy would apply. Love Pensive Cat, but not this class.

As a ChemE who had Danahy for Orgo 1, this was my favorite class of the semester. Puzzle sets were short and sweet. Office hours make the semester enjoyable. I always go into her exams thinking they're going to be harder than they are. I'm coming out of the course feeling like I know how to do useful things with Orgo. Her humor is icing on the cake

I am reading all of these bad reviews and truly wondering if I was the same class as y'all…Like yes her exams are hard but the comments about there being no support are just false. She has 3 hours of office hours per week, responds to emails in like 10 minutes, and has 3 excellent TAs. She is also extremely kind and nonjudgmental.

Danahy is an amazing teacher who really cares about her students. This course is of course challenging, but she sets us up for success. Her exams are all free response, so if you prefer MC,  take it with another teacher. I really enjoyed this class, and it has made me appreciate chemistry more! My D in her class is a reflection of me not her!

Super nice and caring; very accessible and approachable outside of class for extra help. Lectures are given via her iPad, and her notes and weekly homework are very useful to learn from. If free-response exams and "content mastery" aren't your thing, take the other professors with MC tests.

Take someone else if you can. I loved orgo 1 and got an A, but did terrible in this class. Exams are extremely hard and despite studying nonstop, I felt hopeless. The exams have content that we never covered. Some puzzle sets were easy, and some were very hard. She also doesn't curve, give extra credit, etc. She's nice, but the class is so so hard.

Honestly liked her for orgo 1 and did well. However, this class was so bad for orgo 2. Insanely hard exams and randomly pulls out mechanisms no one has ever seen. I studied like 30 hours a week and still felt blindsided on her exams. Take Matthews instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DON'T TAKE HER. Her exams are impossible. She says, "I'm not trying to trick you." SHE IS. I spent so many hours a day studying, but nothing prepares you for the exams. Grade is basically just 4 exams, including the cumulative final. No practice is similar to exam questions because she pulls questions out of yk what. Take Staton or Mathews

This class (and her) made me cry on multiple occasions. I've studied hours on end, practically dedicated my life to this class, and never was it enough. her exams are nothing like the ones she gives us from ‘22, they are so so much more difficult. do your self a favor and please do not take her, this class is actually the most crazy thing ever…

Her exams do not reflect the material learned. I studied 15 hours straight every single day and understood all practice problems and practice exams. Yet, every exam consists of questions that are a mix of things and ultimately something we didn't learn. Her exams ARE NOT FAIR. Orgo is not easy, but she makes it harder. She gives no support. NOTHING

Do yourself a GPA favor and mental favor (emphasis on mental) and do not take her. I thought I could give her the benefit of the doubt, but the exams are not AT ALL similar to what we learn. To put it in perspective, someone fully balled their eyes out LOUD in the middle of the final. Multiple people left in tears with empty pages. Don't take her.

if you didn't do well in ochem1, do not take ochem2 with danahy. the exams and homeworks are insanely difficult. people told me ochem1 was harder than 2 but this class was so much harder. this class was miserable. take any other prof.

Dr. Danahey is an amazing professor! I took her class for both Orgo 1 and 2 and enjoyed both classes. Her lectures work best for visual learners because she essentially takes notes with you. She is extremely kind and wants her students to succeed. Responds to emails fast. GO TO OFFICE HOURS!!!

I liked her so much better for Orgo 1. Her lectures got very hard to follow and we never got to do guided practice in class. I wanted to like her but it was so hard to do well in this class, she is incredibly stingy with partial credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Danahy is absolutely wonderful. Incredibly kind and truly cares about her students. Her syllabus can make the class seem daunting, but if you put in effort she will genuinely love you and bend over backwards to help you. Read the textbook before lecture, come with questions, go to office hours, and you'll be fine!

She was a very hard grader and all tests were very difficult. She teaches in lecture very well but that is it. She provides no support, gives no extra credit and doesn't curve. Be prepared to study for your life for this class.

In all honesty she is a very sweet professor but she is extremely difficult. Orgo is a hard class no matter who you have, but she doesn't help. No curves, extra credit, or test corrections. Her exams are extremely difficult much more so then previous years and practice problems. I shed blood, sweat and tears and still ended with a C.

Professor Danahy is awesome. The textbook reading are not super important if you understand the lectures. The puzzle sets are really good practice for exams. She is so helpful and kind during office hours. Her lecturing style is keeps you engaged during class and she gives time for practice problems during which she walks around and offers help.

I dedicated my life to studying for this course. Did every problem in the textbook; they helped, but only to a certain extent. Some exam questions aren't like any practice.
