Prof Larsen is the most entertaining professor i have had so far at school.  I was never bored during her class, she has plenty of funny stories (regarding law), and fields all questions no matter how ridiculous.  Offers tons of extra credit opportunities and with some effort you'll get an A.  Very cool lady, take her class.

Prof Larsen is the BEST professor at NEU. She is not easy but she is very good and you will learn a lot from her class. She will make you want to attend the class and honestly you will learn a lot from her. She is young and very easy going. Always willing to help. TAKE HER CLASS!!!!!!

Honestly my favorite class at Northeastern, she is the best for this subject because she is an attorney. Do the readings so you can participate, although she goes over it in class. 4 Quizzes, one dropped, 4 extra opportunities, one paper, midterm and cumalitive final. She's also very good with answering email immediately.

Nice professor, she's cool. Hard grader though, no leway really. Your either right, or you dead wrong. Class is pretty fun, just lectures everyday. Extra credit opportunities(papers) help raise your grade which is nice.

Kuga is sweet & clearly knowledgeable about orgo but is not the best at explaining concepts & being clear & organized with both the way he presents new material & how he structures the class. He pushed tests back to the next day the day of & would not give clear answers as to when tests would be uploaded & due. Did not follow the syllabus well.

Class is an easy A if u pay attention, keep track of assignments, & hand in hws & exams on time, but u won't learn orgo well. Gives partial credit, easy grader. However, he's often hard to understand&follow during lecture as he skips around, mumbles, & writes unclearly on the board. He also uploaded our tests late & doesn't respect students' time.
Kuga is the best teacher for organic chemistry . makes easy to learn

If you skip class - you won't pass/get a good grade. Kuga makes o chem simple and will not waste time teaching concepts that do not matter. That being said, he teaches you a lot of things and expects you to know everything he teaches you. TIP: Be sure to attend Office Hours and ALWAYS do the HW outside of class. Highly recommend this class!

reviews.comment: He knows the book front to back, and he expects you to learn it in 3 months. That is to say he expects a lot, but he also takes that into consideration of your final grade. If you at least show you're putting in effort and trying to grasp the material, he will remember you and will help you where he can. GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Kuga is dope. Go to class, draw what he draws on the board, have a sense of what is going on, memorize the notes you took/the problems you went through in class, and go into the test to get at least a B on every exam.

Kuga is awesome!! I think he is the best orgo professor ever!! He makes Orgo so doable!! He is a fair grader and his exams are literally the notes, so everything he writes on the board is 100% important... I strongly recommend Kuga for both Organic 1 and 2!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: I don't know where everyone else gets their good opinion of him, because Kuga is at best a scatterbrained professor and leaves students vastly underprepared for his own exams. Expect to teach yourself and still do poorly unless you have a natural talent for orgo
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is an okay professor. He gets the job done but the communication outside the classroom is bad. He doesn't respond to emails clearly and he responds late. You can teach yourself and not show up to class. You will pass if you do your work and that's it.

Kuga is the man. Like a lot of other pre-med students I was dreading Organic Chem I & II. But then I register for the class and Kuga sends me this email telling me that Orgo is gonna be easy as pie. Wishful thinking right?  It's Not! Kuga is clear and concise in his explanations of difficult orgo concepts. I got an A in both Orgo 1 & II!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Kuga is a legend. He asks very straightforward questions on his exams, but also doesn't gloss over important information you might need for the MCAT.   His explanations are easy to follow most of the time, but he goes fast sometimes. Just copy down EVERYTHING he writes on the board and study that for his exam. Do that and you'll get the A

Puts dad jokes on exams. Go to class - he goes over many things. Stay on top of the work as he may throw a random assignment that he probably will never grade. Exams aren't too hard, but he tells you what you need to know to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Kuga is alright; could definitely be a lot worse. He's a nice guy and tries hard to teach well. But sometimes I he just kind of nonstop writes things on the board with no explanation. The lack of oral communication means his lectures are pretty boring, and sometimes a little confusing. He wouldn't be my first choice, but I'd take him again.

He is a very understanding professor . So pay attention and make sure that you keep up with all assigned work and readings. Do a lot of studying outside of the class . The only thing is he teaches fast & works the problems fast so don't be afraid to ask him to slow down it's like the alphabet to him .

Very willing to answer questions both in and outside class, though not a great e-mailer. Only negative is lack of clear communication on what's expected for assignments, and doesn't hand back lab reports. But he only teaches what you need to know for the exams and doesn't throw many curve balls. A nice guy.
Kuga is a good professor. He is clear in what he wants from you so just study and you'll be fine.

Kuga is awesome. I was expecting to die in orgo again (second time taking it due to an unexpected medical leave), but he's so great. While he has an accent, it is not difficult to understand. He teaches with many examples, so paper and pen is a must. He doesn't post supporting material online, so make sure you attend lecture and pay attention!

While it took a lot of work to master the material, his tests were more than fair and he was very generous with extra credit. As long as you put in the effort outside of class and go to class every lecture, you will definitely do well.

Kuga understands that Orgo is a hard class and he tries to make it fun and easier for everyone. Really nice guy. Biggest criticism would be lack of information anywhere except lectures. Like if you miss any lectures you're kinda screwed. So make sure you don't ever skip class. Otherwise you don't know which stuff in the textbook you actually need.

I'm not sure how well I really understand Orgo after taking these classes, but I did pretty well considering. I had a hard time grasping the concepts, but Kuga gave extra credit questions occasionally and tends to boost grades a little bit. He will answer any questions you ask. Hard class but pay attention and show up and you'll be fine.

really good teacher. At first it takes time to understand, i mean in ORGO, it is not easy . But kuga makes it easy. I had fun taking this class, i did worked my ass off but it paid off well. Thanks kuga. Will definitely take his class again.

Dr. Sanga Kugabalasooriar is an excellent professor whom I have had the privilege of learning from.  I struggled in his class; however, he is understanding the stigma about organic chemistry, and indicates what is needed to succeed in his lecture and laboratory recession.  He does not guarantee an A, you work for it.  He let me do extra credit work

The BEST Orgo Chm prof I have encountered. He makes concepts so easy to understand, and if you are still struggling in his class, he puts in the time and effort to help you. He is the first professor I have ever seen who takes a personal responsibility over his students to learn his material.If u put in the hard work, u will get great results.

Dr. Kuga is a great teacher. He explains the topics extremely well and tells you what you need to understand. He also connects the material you learn to real life examples. He even jokes around with his students. He was awesome! take his class!!

Best Prof you can have! Orgo is notorious for being one of the hardest classes-Dr. Kuga made it so easy to learn & fun! I recommend everyone take CHM 2010,3015,3020,2313 &2311, he is easy going and effective. Classes are engaging & interesting  take all his classes you won’t regret it!Even a dummy can understand Orgo w/ Dr. Kuga.

Dr. Kuga taught the material very efficiently. He made organic 2 seem manageable and even somewhat easy. I highly recommend him to any student taking orgo 2. He also teaches orgo 1 and, from what I've heard, the exams have a similar set up. He wants you to do well, and he tries to stay entertaining in class. Overall, awesome professor.

The name is "Kuga".   He is excellent.  One of the best I have had.  You have to work hard.  Come to class well prepared and with plenty of questions and he will answer them all. He wants his students to do well.
one of the best in orgo

The best professors can take one of the hardest subjects for a biology major and turn it into something a monkey can understand.  This is the organic chemistry teacher to take.  Just make sure you go to class daily because the pace is not consistent and goes at whatever pace he wishes.
He makes very difficult material easy to understand, but your still learning a lot from him.  HIGHLY RECCOMENDED!
take him for orgo, he is the best orgo professor you can have
great teacher. I enjoyed the class.

I find his teaching style very erratic.  There seems to be no sense of organization of the lecture. If you don't self study after lecture you're screwed for the exam.  He insists that you do problems on your own and won't give you the answer until you try. Quizzes some times happens or not. NEU does not give much option to Orgo profs.

He put hard orgo material into Jessica Simpson terms! He wrote a lot of random things on the board, but he taught very well, I actually understood organic chemistry. His tests are very fair (he adds a few tricky problems); his practice quizzes focus on main points. He cuts the c**p and goes to the point!!
Makes a very tough class a little easier. Very fair testing and grading.
He's the best Orgo teacher!!!

This guy is cool. Not bad for Organic. His tests are easy and he does give out practice quizes. Lecture is not helpful if u dont read the book. Just puts bunch of**** on the board and solves it. never explains why. And yeah, falling asleep during class always happens...
Kunga is the man. Makes one of the most dreaded classes on campus passable. Accent can be hard at times but he will always repeat himself until you understand if you ask.
Very helpful, makes difficult subject easy to understand.  Thanks to Kuga I killed the Organic Chemistry/Sciences section of the MCAT!!! Medical school here I come!! You are the MAN!!!
does good job of breaking down this complicated topic in easy-to-understand manner
best organic teacher at nu he makes it easy

My advice is never take any of his classes. It's my final year & never had a professor like this guy. Only knows to give out low grades. Feedback not helpful. Assignment directions are super long. Takes longer to figure out the work than to do it & you will still end up with points off. If you are in his class/ drop it now! Don't wait-drop it!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Incredibly harsh grader. Instructions for assignments are crazy specific so make sure you read VERY carefully. It's really hard to get a decent grade in this class.
- Direction to complete assignments are harder than the assignments themselves

Extremely tough grader! Be prepared, you will never receive a 100% on your assignment (even on the discussion boards). The textbook is mandatory, and you will have a group project. Most difficult class I've ever taken.

This professor cares that you are learning and taking away something valuable. He knows exactly what he wants, and you had better also. Very high standards. Follow instructions exactly & tailor your work to match the grading rubrics. The group project is no joke; you will spend up to 20 hours per week in close coordination with assigned teammates.

Grading is ambiguous with unclear expectations. You could follow the rubric down to the details and will still grade you down every opportunity he gets. Definitely one of the worst professors. Even if you're doing everything right, your grade will not reflect your effort in the course. Absolutely 110% don't recommend.
Great guy. Class is hard due to large online group project

He means well, but gets confused easily when grading and will deduct points based on his confusion. His methodology is the more complex an assignment is, must mean that you will learn more. However, this only serves to confuse him even more. He has up to four documents on how to do an assignment and each of them has different criteria.

All assignments have vague instructions, will only get negative feedback with no suggestions to fix in the future or positive. Feedback is never useful. Grades seem baseless. Not a positive environment even online, which should be hard to achieve. If you take him, good luck!

One of worst professors I have ever had. His grading makes no sense and he doesn't give out better than B's for outstanding work. He continuously gives C grades with no explanation even if rubric is followed perfectly. Does not teach, just tells you what to do and then gives you sub-par grade for it. Would highly recommend a different professor.

Professor Kwoka is clearly very knowledgeable on monopolies and antitrust theory, however his teaching is sometimes confusing and material classes are not very well structured. He tries to adjust the level of difficulty throughout the semester but it can still get hard when it comes to applying calculus and mathematical theories. Do not recommend.

The worst econ class I've ever taken at NU. We have no chance of getting final grade. Faculty grade deadline for spring class is on Apr 28, but he posted 2 exams (include final exam) grade on May 2. Tons of reading materials without using textbooks. Slides are disorganized, lecture at a dreamlike tone. Criteria is a disaster.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Avoid Professor Kwoka unless you are genuinely extremely interested in the topic of the class and will put hours into the hundreds of readings he assigns to every class. Professor Kwoka is very knowledgeable and a nice person. However, he does not do a very good job of making his classes engaging. The content is usually very dense and advanced.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Bubbles, Busts, and Bailouts was one of the best classes I took at Northeastern. Great class from a great prof.

dont take him for this course

reviews.comment: Excellent professor, probably the best I've had in the Econ department. He is clearly brilliant but comes off as a likable guy and makes the complex material accessible. No attendance required

You will learn much about game theory and how it applies in business strategies. He is a great person, but this class is to do something, not just "chill". I wanted to really know about Africa and I did.
NO Comment. Please Think Twice before you took this class.
He is very confusing. He all talks about Ghana. If you took his class you will more on Ghana. I would NOT recommend to you take his class.

Extremely subjective in presentation of course material.  Doesn't answer students' emails.  Provides very little guidance in regards to course requirements.  Lectures involve long, self-promoting tangents.  Would not recommend.
nice proffesor, very engaged and knowledgable about Africa. best class i ever took. kindly take the class you wont regret.

This was a very engaging class. Though the textbooks are not referenced, the lectures, movies, and final projects/papers are very interesting.  If you want to learn about Africa, this is the class to take.

Great, smart professor. Best professor for any class involving African relations. He is always willing to give extra help if needed and wants you to succeed. Though he is a tough grader, take class notes and do the readings--your grade will definately reflect that which, in my opinion, is reflective of a good teacher. Enjoy!

Great professor.  Definitely learned a lot from the class.  Lot of information to digest, presented in unique scholarly format.  Got the sense that I was receiving objective perspective - no agenda behind lecturers.  Opportunity to contribute but you had better come prepared and know your stuff.

Talks about Ghana most of the time, because that is where he is from. Knows a lot but does not teach it well. Nice man, but acts like your grade doesn't matter. Pay attention to movies in class they are important.

This class was an utter disaster. Lectures were complete wastes of time and unorganized. One time he tried to hand out schedule to so that he would be able to organized and not go on tangents....and then he spent 20 minutes on a digression about how useful the schedule would be and as a result couldn't finish the lecture!! Seems like a nice guy tho

Worst professor I have ever had. Many required readings are given without guidance, or review, and some not even available. No class structure. Lectures are composed only of digressions,and are indecipherable. Most learning takes place during movies. Assessments are unfair, and the professor has to spend hours in irrelevant defense of himself.

Great Professor. Very engaging, enthusiastic and also an endearing individual. Very smart and a true scholar. If you want to learn about Africa, take this class. You will learn a lot in a short amount of time.

One of the best professors I've had at Northeastern. He is so knowledgable and highly active in his industry which makes his content authentic and extensive. Lectures were long but so fun to attend due to his amazing teaching style. A lot of reading and writing required but grading is fair and content is so interesting. Expect awesome lore drops.

Prof Courtney's Cyberlaw course is an absolute must-take. He's one of those professors who's clearly smart but never makes the material feel intimidating, always prepared, engaging, and genuinely great at running a discussion class that makes you think. One of the best undergrad experiences you'll have, easily one of the best professors on campus.

reviews.comment: Kyle is an awesome professor. His lectures are fun and interesting and he always has a story to tell. He has a great sense of humor and is very respectful of everyone. I highly recommend him. I wish he was my instructor for every class. Real nice guy.

By far the best course I had in the MSIA program - actually he's the best professor I have had at Northeastern. Never let him go. Structure was great and the material chosen was very interesting and taught new skills. Strengths: Great speaker, knowledge, experience, affable, teaching style, and enthusiasm to name a few.
Best class ever!  He is very knowledgeable and makes the class interesting.  Not only does he provide contextual information but also uses current examples which helps drive the material home.
Best class I took at Northeastern, hands down.
This was one of the best and most interesting classes I have taken at NU.  The professor was great.  He was enthusiastic and knowledgable.
No Comments
Not worth the time, energy or money.

Great course and a good professor for students new to data science/ analytics. She's very considerate and will extend deadlines very often for students. Lectures can be attended online as well. And almost everyone will end up with an A grade. Assignments will take maximum 2 days to complete.

reviews.comment: Lectures directly correlate to homeworks. Uses practical application to demonstrate principles. Class material sets you up perfectly for the final project. Great lectures with lots of room to explore and expand on the material.
Amazing professor. Calm, cool, and collected. Very accessible outside of class. The course was challenging but doable if you attend classes and pay attention.
Professor was knowledgable about the subject, and went through the lecture slides as well as coding part of the assignments. She does not provide extra credit. Taken in Fall 2021.

reviews.comment: Shes clearly very knowledgeable, and does an excellent job transmitting that knowledge to her students in a clear and concise manner.

reviews.comment: I was dreading this class, but she made it enjoyable. Far beyond my expectations!
She kind of recites the pdfs, class is not interactive at all and super boring.

He is GREAT, he is definitely a silly guy who is very kind. He wants his students to do well and really understands the material he is teaching. Class was very chill; the design assignments could take a while to complete but he graded lightly. He also offered a few extra credit chances. Don't sweat this class.

He provides detailed slides and also additional/supporting materials are uploaded. He is quite funny in class, also accessible outside classes. He gives feedback on homeworks. Exams are not hard if you study and reflective as weekly homeworks.

his lectures are very long but he records them if you miss anything. he does not require a textbook but i got one of the recommended ones and i recommend getting it if you take this class. homework assigned every week or so, the assignments weren't bad. opportunities for extra credit given. exams are okay, do some practice problems for them
his lectures are extremely boring and long. exams reflect the homework pretty well. Lots of homework weekly.
Very respectable Professor. Good lecturer, homework was very reflective of lectures and notes, and exams were quite easy. Overall excellent.

Casanova's lectures are a little bit boring but if you pay attention he can be really funny at times. He is always very flexible with the students and wants you to understand the material. He always answers questions clearly and clarifies if you need him to. His tests are pretty easy if you can do the homework without cheating you will be fine.
ok

Gosh just take this class it changed everything for me. I love Professor Twohig dearly. This class is what you make of it, if you don't want to learn and your not gonna put effort/ be passionate do not take this class. I wish I could take this class again.

Professor Laura Twohig is by far my favorite at Northeastern. She is so chill and nice and an actual reasonable human being. She is very caring and understanding with her students, brought snacks, guest speakers and made class actually enjoyable. When you finish the work in class you get to leave, she never assigns busy work which was great. 10/10

I had her as an 8 am last semester and although attendance was required, this was honestly my favorite class I took my freshman year at Northeastern because of professor Twohig. She is so nice and made the class enjoyable. I recommend.

Professor was very enthusiastic and had lots of real world experience that she shared with us. We had one project we worked on all semester and it was very comprehensive but fun. No tests but you had to be active and engaged each class. Absolutely loved it! #innovationbaddie

This was an incredibly easy class and Professor Twohig is an angel. Incredibly kind and good-hearted, making the class enjoyable. Would recommend this class if you like working in teams and developing innovative idea's.

Very good and kind teacher. We spend almost, if not, every class working with our group on our project. We don't get homework. The stuff she assigns can be done in class. The only thing I've had to do outside of class were case studies. She's a very easy grader.
This is a good learning class. The project is a huge part of this class and attendance and participation matters a lot. Would recommend if you want to dive deeper into innovation.

Two midterms and weekly homework, no final. Prof is very caring about students but sometimes gets lost in the notes. There is no textbook, only notes that she posts, but it doesn't always follow the lecture. Linalg is the prereq but realistically should take calc3 as well.
actually the kindest person ever. She is so caring and wants students to succeed. Loved my experience with her.
The midterms would be hard if we were not given the prep material. As long as you study that you will do fine in the course. Her online notes are very good as well.
Great professor where the practice tests and her content will prep you perfectly for exams. A little disorganized in her lectures, but her notes are really good so you can just look at them too.
Really nice professor！ The test is almost same with practice test!

Prof Lee is very caring and accesible. She uploads notes after every lecture and creates practice exercises for each lesson and a practice exam prior to each exam. She makes it hard to fail or fall behind since she is very helpful in office hours and provides more than enough material to gurantee that you succeed. Hope to take her again.
LPL is my goat. Best professor I've ever had and ever will have. If you're lucky enough to have a class with her you should count your blessings

Class teaches many different things, so exams, while a lot of syllabus, are easy. HWs can take a little work, but it's good that you get to work and play with Python code. TAs & OH are very helpful, please go! The professor is very wonderful. Lectures are amazing, very clear. She provides detailed notes for each class! Very helpful & motivating.
A wondrous professor in every aspect, care for her student so much. Love her.
Amazing professor!! Little notes. MATH4570 was cool and I learned a lot from her.

Dr. Lee is my favorite professor at Northeastern, she has a lot of enthusiasm and you can tell she deeply cares for her students. She is very accommodating and is always happy to answer questions and explain concepts. I would highly recommend taking any of her classes ❗️

Lee is an incredible professor who is very caring about her students. She takes the time to give proper feedback and gets to know each student individually. The class itself can be difficult at times but in the end, if you take the proper time to go to office hours and ask plenty of questions, you will be good.

Prof Lee is amazing! Truly cared for every student in the class and made sure everyone understood the material. Grading was very generous and the lowest hw grade was replaced by quiz average (the quizzes were basically just attendance forms where she would give you the answer at the end of class). No final exam (summer 2) which was amazing!

Professor was super helpful when it come to homework and generally with exam and other things. I think going to her office hours will help you greatly if you didn't understand something from lecture or just going over your hw and exam. She is very for giving when it come to the exam, she usually give point back if you talk to her about your mistake
A rare unicorn professor. She is probably the best lecturer I have ever had.

Professor Lee is one of the most caring math professors I have ever had. She always went out of her way to explain the material to the best of her ability. Her detailed notes and extensive list of practice problems made me feel like I was always prepared for exams. If she is ever teaching another course, I will most certainly take it!

Very kind and funny professor. She explains everything clearly and will stop mid-lecture to answer any questions. Review sessions are really helpful, and the selected exercises and practice exams are similar to the actual exam. She does retakes if you score poorly which are always similar to the original one.

Professor Lee is one of the sweetest math professors ever. She really cares about her students and loves math! She can sometimes get a bit lost while lecturing, which can make things hard to follow, but she more than makes up for it with detailed notes. Homework's can take a really long time. Hard course, but great prof and you will learn a ton!
Good professor. Going to lecture definitely benefits but old videos and pictures of class-notes are also posted on Canvas after class. Lovely person and accessible at office hours.

Professor Lee is so sweet and she will often give some points back on tests if you make mistakes. Homework can be hard especially if you are new to this type of math but office hours are super helpful and guarantee a good score. The class can be confusing but not the fault of the lecturer, and I would say she does a good job ensuring you succeed.

Sweetest professor ever. The class itself is hard, but she does a great job explaining the concepts. She's always smiling and very understanding. The class consisted of 4 tests, 9 homework (graded on accuracy), and 1-2 question quizzes after every lesson that she usually gives us the answers for. Make sure to go to her office hours and she'll help.
Lovely professor, always smiling in the class. Explains everything well, would definitely take again and recommend
Professor Lee was just amazing!! You will really enjoy the lectures. She brings a lot of fun to them and makes learning the material easy and exciting. Never once regretted going to her classes.

reviews.comment: Great prof, explains, answers questions. But to do well you NEED to do ALL exercises daily or consistently. Tests are similar to the prac test but you need to master how to do diff types of problems or the prac test won't help bc you won't know how to do it anyways. Go to her OH for hw help!!! She's very very helpful and generous with the answers.

Started off a bit rocky, but the more you talk to her and get to know her teaching style, the more you will learn. She posts notes before class so you can read them. She will provide retakes for tests you fail and she supports you completely.

One of the best professor's I've had in my four years here. Amazing lectures, with notes posted online so we can follow along or read ahead. Lesson quizzes after each class are an easy 20% of your grade and help to reinforce the material. Homeworks were useful in learning. Best part, no quizzes or tests!
Very clear lectures and very kind

Even though this class was so easy that I probably would have received an A without going, Lee Peng-Lee is so GOATed that I didn't miss a single lecture. I took MATH3315 (Dynamic Systems) with this professor and she is very sweet and nice but I just couldn't understand the course material.

I never thought I would have so much fun writing proofs as I did with Professor Lee Peng! She is energetic and incredibly personable. She does a great job at explaining concepts and I find her lectures the easiest of all my classes to sit through. I would genuinely take any class she teaches!

One of my favorite teachers of all time--she is so sweet and cares about her students a lot. She is extremely smart and explains things in very simple and intuitive ways and will walk you through things in such a way to make sure everyone understands before moving on. Could not recommend more
Professor Lee is fantastic. She cares a lot about her students and is very welcoming in her office hours and after class. She has great, organized lecture notes that she posts for every lecture.

Lee Peng-Lee is an amazing professor who is very knowledgeable on the material. She puts in a lot of effort to ensure the students fully comprehend the subject. reviews.comment: I am begging you to take diff eq with Prof. Lee. She is truly amazing- her lecture notes are concise and helpful, you dont even need the textbook, and she is very clear about what she expects on exams. She is my favorite professor at Northeastern, she really cares for her students and it shows.

Amazing, sweet, and caring professor and incredibly passionate about mathematics in general. Grade was 20% Homework and 80% exams (4, with heavier weights on higher scores). Lee is very knowledgable and made the course incredibly interesting.

The professor is super sweet and one of my favourites. She gives out notes on all the content that clearly explain everything. The weekly quizzes are fairly easy. She's the sweetest professor I've ever met. Super super nice to students, explains stuff well, test questions are straight outta class notes

Lee Peng-Lee is one of the best professors I've ever had. I took her for 3 out of the 4 math courses I took at Northeastern (Diff Eg for engineers, Calc 3 for engineers, and numerical analysis). Her class notes are clear, organized, planned out, and easy to understand. Her grading system is VERY fair, and she genuinely wants you to get a good grade

Lee is great! She really cares about her students success, and is always available for extra help. Her grading is very personable; she weighs your best scores the highest which is helpful because the material is difficult. You'll have to study a lot on your own, but she always goes over all material in class and provides a lot of practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Goes in depth with material and gives great examples from easy to hard. She starts lectures right away, and is good humored. Always covers all material, and day before test reviews all material covered that will be tested.

Professor Lee is amazing, and she's the best professor I've had so far at Northeastern. The material in the class is very difficult, but the professor has great office hours and is always helpful over the discussion board on Blackboard and e-mail. She curves her grades, making life easier. The class forces you to think - no rote memorization.

Go to class. She knows what she's teaching, but she's scattered. You'll get a good laugh but she gets down to business quickly so don't be late. She counts in class exercises as participation for this class (Stats and Stochastic Processes), so be sure to attend! Overall good, but hard, class. Didn't use textbook once, so save your cash.
Very Helpful, Explains clearly. Good teacher.

Professor Lee is incredibly kind and helpful. She has an accent but its still easy to follow her lessons. She breaks each lesson down to exactly what you need to know to get a 100 on the weekly quizzes and is always well prepared. She is relaxed with a good sense of humor making class enjoyable and will do anything to make sure everyone understands

She is a very nice teacher and offers a lot of help. She gives quizzes bi weekly to make sure everyone understands that material. She does have an accent and language barrier which can make it a little hard at times. Her class is extremely easy!

Ricci is an interesting professor. I didn't love her, and this class wasn't exactly what I thought it would be. Slides are confusing at times, and lectures aren't really organized. Exams were online and open-note, so grading was fine, but I thought I was going to get more out of this class than I did.
Ricci is amazing, she has so much information on neuroscience to teach and she cares deeply about sharing it, she is also hilarious but clear and respectful in her classroom directions

Ricci is normally a great professor, but for behavioral endocrinology, beware! I hope my message can reach people before the add/drop period ends. If you're thinking about dropping this class to take a different one, do that!

Ricci's lectures are often times very confusing. It's hard to follow along with her because she often gets sidetracked or explains things in convoluted ways. Overall, I ended up learning a lot from her class, but I needed to spend some extra time with the material by myself to understand what she intended to say.

I love Dr. Ricci. She is by far the best professor I've had at Northeastern. You can tell she actually cares about what she's teaching and is very knowledgeable about anything related to neuroscience. Grading is super straight forward. Go to class and you'll get an A.

Professor Ricci is a quirky but engaging lecturer. Her classes are light on readings and homework, but the exams can be tricky. unstuck study's flashcards and practice tests really helped me prepare. Overall, an easy A if you stay engaged.

I love Dr. Ricci. Her lectures are interesting and energetic. She is willing to go off topic and answer questions students have about the brain. She clearly outlines the information, tells you whats on the exams and she provides recorded lectures that you can listen to. Her exams are easy, online and pulled straight from the slides.
Very understanding and is pretty reasonable. She makes it easy to get an A in the class. She is a bit strange but she is refreshing to have.

You either love her or hate her, very blunt and direct but the class is very easy. She encourages questions and loves to have real-world implication conversations on her subject matter. Doesn't really believe it tests(so all open note) and overall quite the character.
Pretty difficult grader, very no-nonsense. Moves through material quickly.

Dr. Ricci is incredibly knowledgeable, but her lectures can be a bit disorganized at times. Her slides aren't great, but that's because she barely needs them to teach effectively. Her teaching style probably isn't for everyone, but if you're seeking a genuine understanding of the content, she is the right choice.

Class was super interesting. Responds to emails quickly. PowerPoints are super sparse; have to hear lectures in person or they'll make no sense. No rubrics and grades based on her personal opinions of the course material. Doesn't show up to scheduled office hour appts and often impatient when speaking one-on-one.

Dr. Ricci's lectures are often scattered and hard to follow, but very entertaining. That being said, you will probably still do well in her class as she is very fair with her grading and definitely seems to care about student success. Supplementary textbook reading is recommended if you want to learn the content, not just do well in the class.

No readings, no homework that i remembered and if there are they were so easy, super relaxed professor and just nice in general she is a lecturer that keeps the class engaged and doesn't waste your time. A little biased in some Psych topics where she may go on a tangent but it's easy to pass, Only con i can think of is her slides are bad!

No readings, minimal homework, tests were easy and multiple choice, interesting class discussions, good lecturer, everything you could want! A bit of an odd ball but that makes it fun. Definitely recommend her class

Ricci is great, and really cares about her students. The mixed reviews are because her lectures are sometimes "all over the place" but that's only because she enjoys going on tangents to explain why material matters and what the real-world applications are. Not hard to do well in her classes, test q's straight from her ppts (and is open-note)!

I highly recommend Dr. Ricci. She is absolutely hilarious and cares a lot about her students. Attendance (Psych 1101, not sure about other classes) is not mandatory, just read the slides and you'll be just fine. Exams are online and open for a week, you can take them any time you want during that week! Discussion posts - 100 every time. Great.

Dr. Ricci is great! It's very obvious she cares a lot about her students and that she is extremely knowledgable in her field. Very easy to work with, always gets back to your emails and is very clear and upfront about how to do well in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Ricci may be hit or miss depending on how you best learn. I'm someone where lectures are very crucial and learning applications of the class knowledge are super important for digesting the material. Ricci was therefore amazing for me because her tangents provide real-world applications to our class material. She can be chaotic, but is intelligent.

I've had her for every psych class I've taken and she is my favorite professor at this school. She cares about her students and always tries to make her lectures entertaining. Considering this how complex the topics covered are, she does a great job simplifying things. She's definitely not for everyone though and a bit all over the place.
Prof Ricci is brilliant and gives great lectures. The exams are 4 hours long, all multiple choice, and take only an hour to do. If you take good notes, this is an easy A.

her slideshows are very minimal, but it gets to the point. if the class was an hour, she would lecture for 35-40 minutes then ask questions, where you can leave. She's an easy grader and rounded up my grade too. her quizzes and exams are a bit confusing but relatively easy. highly recommend her!!!

Ricci's class is split into 3 days, one for lecture, one for asking her questions, and one where she goes over what will be on the exam. Her lectures are a little difficult to understand, but she makes it very clear what information will be on the exam. She definitely tests on smaller bits of information so know everything from the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Ricci is super nice and her lectures are very organized and easy to follow. The structure of the class when taken online is a bit strange. She posts the lectures and you watch them outside of class and then the lecture times are used for review and questions. Exams aren't too difficult but some of the questions are a little specific.
Very straight forward. Everything on the test is covered in the lecture.

Though Ricci can seem scary, she is very straightforward. She wants her students to do well. The nature of the class however is pretty hard. But she makes it easier by relating it to her past jobs and real life examples

1st half of semester is just an intro to DSM + review of biopsych + psychopharm + genetics. Not that hard but she is not a gifted lecturer & can be v confusing. Ppts held little info so had to take good lecture notes. TAs & recitations were super helpful tho. 2nd half of sem  case studies. One cs usually took me a full day 2 do & a lot of research
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Ricci is a neuroscientist so when answering questions she provides a lot of experience and prior knowledge. Her lectures are interesting and she's fun and easy to talk to. The grade for this class was based on discussion forums and 2 exams. It isn't difficult to do well in this class if you participate, pay attention and review lectures.

Doctor Ricci exceeds expectations in every area. She is remarkably intelligent and willing to help and most importantly pause for student understanding and discussion. Lectures are engaging and informative. Her honesty about topics in psychology and human nature are reassuring and inspirational. She is genuinely an amazing human.
I could not believe Professor Ricci had anything below a 5. Fantastic teacher with a real unique way of connecting and engaging her students, I could not recommend her enough

I first had Dr. Ricci for BioPsych my freshman year, and I absolutely loved her. I then took Clinical Neuroscience and Psychopharm with her. Her classes are all lecture based; she offers textbook options only if you need outside material to study. She is so passionate about neuroscience and it shows. The class can be difficult, but worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Ricci is hilarious and great at keeping students engaged during her lectures. Missing lectures is not recommended since a lot of the slides have little-to-no bullet points and you need to listen to her to know what will be on the assessments. Otherwise, the content is very interesting and she is very straightforward about it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Ricci is both brilliant and hilarious. She is very knowledgeable in her field and will always make sure that students with questions understand the material. Her tests are not difficult if you study well. Highly recommend.

Professor Ricci is a great lecturer and is one of those people who have strong background knowledge in the field. Her lectures were content-rich and quite humourous. She assigns a paper to read about every week that go well along with the subject matter being discussed in class. Her tests are tricky and really help you to get a strong understanding

Professor Ricci is definitely an 'acquired taste' for a lack of a better word. Delightfully quirky and blunt, she obviously is passionate about the class. Fair warning, the first half of the class reads like the world's most confusing bio psych textbook, and you may initially form negative feelings regarding the class (and her!) from it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Drugs and Behavior with Dr. Ricci was extremely easy. It was a hybrid class (half online half in class) and grading was based on online discussion posts each week. No midterm, no final, 2 tests that were heavily reviewed. She is also very kind and funny!

Great professor. I would definitely recommend taking her classes. She is very knowledgeable about her field, so she will often go on tangents in class when students ask her questions. There is often really interesting discussion. No book required. Tests are manageable if you prepare. Only downside is she is not very available outside of class.

Ricci clearly knows what she is talking about. The material is a bit difficult and requires a lot of memorization but it's obvious that she is ridiculously intelligent which allows everyone to ask questions and she will have an answer for you. Funny, a chill teacher but get ready to study for her tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: For a very difficult class, my girl Lesley makes it all worth it! She is hilarious, brilliant and her tests are very straight forward. This class is very memorization heavy but it is worth is. Ricci makes the material understandable and conveys the informations importance.

Taking clinical with professor Ricci was a fantastic experience. I learned a lot about disease classification and diagnostic tools.  The clinical case studies are really interesting and the final is super cool, with actors coming in for the class to interview and diagnose.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very funny and entertaining. I was never upset or dreaded going to class. Would def one of her classes again!

Lesley is one of my all time favorite professors. Only take her if you are a non-Psych major though, because she doesn't focus on the topics as much, which is useless to Psych majors.  Attend class, write notes and pay attention in class and you will be guaranteed an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Ricci is both a hilarious and extremely effective teacher in her field of study. Her classes are always engaging, interesting and enjoyable. They are run in a more casual setting which takes a lot of pressure off of students and makes them feel more comfortable to speak up. She is also extremely clear when discussing course material.
Great teacher, very clear. No textbook needed. Always very helpful and very willing
Witty & Funny. Interesting lectures and fair exams. If you are not only in class but actually present, you will do well and enjoy it.. Her brain makes her hot.

Ricci is funny and she's very conscious of being funny. Honestly I think that was the best part. She probably cares a lot since she commutes from NH every day. However, this is a very hard class! The class lacks clarity in lectures, study guides and review time. If you just want to fulfill your Area B class, I would look elsewhere if I were you.
Better than anyother psyc department professor
Ill miss her
Great teacher. Overworked and underpaid
Professor Ricci is awesome! I mean she is very blunt and won't sugar coat things but she definitely knows her stuff. I think she's a great professor!
The class is amazing full of information, that will help you everywhere. She is very educated in pathology and very young spirit !!!!

She's extremely opinionated but she is SUPER smart and knows exactly what she's talking about. The lectures are always very entertaining because of her sense of humor! Her tests and quizzes are very straightforward, but make sure you go to class, because she doesn't post any material on blackboard. Strongly recommend anyone to take her class!

AKA Lesley Ann Potter. Ricci is hilarious and easy going. She's also extremely smart. Her exams are easy, and attendance isn't required. All standard Psych 101 topics are covered and she's clear, with a great sense of humor. A good intro class for freshmen.

Ricci is wildly intelligent and knows her stuff. She has multiple bachelors, masters, and a PhD. She is also one of the funniest professors you will ever have. Highly recommended and an easy A if you attend class. Do not buy the book.

textbook unnecessary. goes by lesley ann porter when registering. every1 cheats b/c class is huge. very funny & entertaining lecturer!! knows her stuff & will tell you what is impt to know & what isnt. she'll tell u what will be on tests, which are all mult choice. no cumulative final. 4quizzes but lowest one dropped. gives extra credit opp's!!!

easy class. almost everyone cheats b/c its huge. very funny & entertaining lecturer!! she knows her stuff and will tell you what is impt to know & what isnt. basically she'll tell u what will be on tests, which are all multiple choice.  there is no cumulative final. 4 quizzes but lowest one is dropped. also gives extra credit opportunity!!

It took a while to realize that she is extremely witty, definitely insane, and really knows her stuff. Class consists of powerpoints of notes and her tangential discussions, but she ONLY tests on powerpoint stuff, and only some of it. Makes explicit what we need to know and what we don't. So class is fun and tests are easy. Brilliant woman.

It took a while to realize that she is extremely witty, definitely insane, and really knows her stuff. Class consists of powerpoints of notes and her tangential discussions, but she ONLY tests on powerpoint stuff, and only some of it. Makes explicit what we need to know and what we don't. So class is fun and tests are easy. Brilliant woman.
Tests were hard but the class was amusing, fun, and cool.  She really works with you.

Very interesting professor. She has a biased point of view and does not bother to hide it. She puts a lot of emphasis on the biology section of the course but she is a very entertaining professor. This was the once class where I actually enjoyed the lectures.  Days off were pretty common and the book was used once, for extra credit, so dont buy it.

1- don't buy the book; she's a lousy lecturer but everything's in the lectures and the TA's make up the difference/clarify.  2- take her with a grain of salt, cuz she presents stuff as fact that is disputable, or is just not true (ie vaccinations...made up stuff about burning witches at Salem in the schitzophrenia lecture...)  3- EASY A if u show!

I took Clinical Neuroscience with Ricci, and it was my favorite class at NEU.  She's funny, she's insane, and she knows everything you'd want to know about the brain.  This is not an easy class. Form study groups and make a facebook group, or you will have an impossible time deciphering Ricci's notes. This class made me want to become a doctor.

You either love or hate her. She has a great sense of humor that makes the most boring material interesting and funny, and she is very straightforward. She answers questions during class and you'll have many days off in this class. Overqualified to teach 101. For non majors.
Very straightforward teacher. Good sense of sarcasm. Doesnt use textbook once. Uses TA's for her dirty work. Makes an uninteresting topic kind of interesting. Would recommend for non PSYCH majors.
Amazing Teacher

she acts WAY to smart to be teaching an intro class and her TA's do everything so she never knows what questions were on her quizzes when students ask questions. 10 questions on her midterm covered material we NEVER covered in class and her slides are useless because she just blabs. i never went to class and got an A, but prepare to teach yourself!

She goes off on tangents and strays far from the lecture. She tries to make jokes but fails miserably. Rushes through lectures and doesn't answer questions. She told us to buy the book and after the return date, she let our class know that not only do we not need the book, but she had a deal with someone from the textbook company. SHE IS AWFUL.

Loved the prof. Class is amusing and hard to do poorly in. Exams are all multiple choice and if you learn the material from the slides she gives there's no way you won't get an A. DONT buy the textbook. It's completely worthless; just go to class and you'll be fine.
The class doesn't demand any work but good grades are still hard to come by because the class and teaching are not serious at all.
She is so smart and has an answer to any question asked.  Every question on a quiz comes from the slides.

easiest class i have taken at northeastern so far. theres 4 quizzes(she drops one)and 2 exams. her quizzes and tests come right off the information you get from the slides. so either go to class or get the notes from someone you know. dont buy the book. she understands college kids and usually lets us out early from class. she is really funny too

Easy Class. Just pay attention to the notes and you should be fine. Shes very willing to answer any questions you may have. Study ONLY the notes, dont even bother buying the book. Stay awake and study and you should get an A.

I had her for clinical neuro and I loved the class! she knows everything there is to know, and she is just a great teacher. The material was sometimes difficult but she is very willing to answer questions and clarify in order to make sure the whole class is on the same page.  Great teacher.

ricci was a really good teacher for someone not that interested in psychology. she kept my attention and was really funny. it was a good class just pay attention to her and take notes in class and you'll be fine.

Horrible professor! She is Hard to understand and goes off into tangents about Kelly Rippa and Monkeys on cocaine. I'm not kidding I have had two reluctant classes with this lady. PyschoBio was my 2nd and last. Her test questions are made to confuse you, and she skips sections b/c she is uncomfortable talking about topics. ur left in the dark. BAD!

She is very funny, keeps you entertained, all of the lectures are from slides. The quizzes come from slides and the exams come from the quizzes. Hope to get a good TA. Ricci doesn't care about the students and teaches the class cause she has too. Don't buy the BOOK. She never uses it.
She's very entertaining. She reads right off the slides. If you take the notes you'll get an A

Ricci was really entertaining and funny. I was never bored or lost. She may not be completely clear at all times but her quizzes/tests come DIRECTLY from her slides and the TA's go over the midterm/final question by question of what you need to study. Its easyyyy!!

Soooo difficult to understand! More concerned with being "entertaining" than teaching clearly. Rarely prepared to teach and tests were so difficult! Everything is right off the slides, so memorize it. As hard as it is, the book does nothing to help either so don't even bother. How is this a psychology course?

Real easy.  Boring as hell, doesn't give a care about you.  Reads from powerpoint slides that aren't even hers, tests are based completely off slides book is useless.  she does know her stuff real well though.

Do not buy the book, she doesn't use it.  She is very clear and has a good sense of humor.  Attendance is not mandatory but tests are based on lecture notes.  She has office hours, encourages people to show up and helps if you go.  Pretty easy to get an A if you do the work, study, and show up for class. She is fair and she drops your lowest grade
The quizzes and tests are difficult and the power point presentations she displays do not follow along with her lecture. I would avoid this class at all costs!

overall a decent class. attendance isn't mandatory as long as you get notes from someone, tests/quizzes/finals are right from it. textbook is a decent reference material but not necessary. She seems to want to be there as much as you do(which prob isn't a lot), but its not a bad thing, so class seems to go smoothly if you somewhat care about psych

If you took Psychology in high school it's a lot easier to understand her. DONT BUY THE TEXTBOOK. It's a waste of money and she doesnt take anything out of it. She's an only notes professor, so go to every class. She makes class interesting and shes quirky. Likes to drink coffee. If you study the notes, you will do great.

Prof. Ricci is a bit quirky, and tends to go off on tangents, but she really knows the material and makes the class really interesting. Part of that was that it was an honors section, but she was definitely a good teacher to have. Don't buy the textbook unless you want extra reading, she tests right from the notes.
completely blitzkreig's through lectures and doesn't use the book.  also just reads slides and doesn't put them up on blackboard.  pretty poor teacher.

Horrible Professor, she moves fast and doesnt follow a text book. If you make an appointment to meet with her good luck shell probably forget and schedule a meeting for the same time. Needs a prereq. She assumes everyone is a neuroscientists. If your not take the class when  another professor is teaching it. Also stay away for intropsych as well.

Lesley is a great professor. She knows her stuff and makes learning the material intertesting. It can be a difficult class, but it isnt bad if you put the time into it. 3 exams total, all multiple choice taken from her slides and extra notes. Not very helpful with questions, too wordy in lectures, and easily distracted. go to every class!
GO TO CLASS. She test you right from her notes. dont even bother  reading from the text or buying it.

Knows what shes talking about, but has no idea how to teach. Anyone can read a powerpoint slide outloud in front of a classroom. She jumps topics way too much which makes it very difficult to follow the material.

She is an amazing professor. It is true that bio background is extremely helpful for this class. I have no bio background and still love the class (and do well). She makes a class that could be extremely boring very interesting and is always willing to help! If you go to class and study you'll do well.

i had her for two different classes (psychobio and biological basis of mental illness) and shes great. funny, makes class interesting, and tests are easy. people who dont understand her probably didnt understand the material, not her.

Team-taught w/ Dr. Melloni, and both profs were great. Lesley has a lot of field experience w/ drugs (we got to see her sad/gross slides of brains on drugs), so that unit is especially interesting. I have no bio background, therefore this was the hardest class I've taken at NU, but she made it easy to understand. Very willing to stay after class and help out. Tests are hard, but are all multiple choice/matching, and she gives a thorough review.

This was a great class. The material could have been boring, but she made it interesting and actually kept me awake every single class. Her powerpoints make studying very easy and she is willing to answer any question that comes up. Tries to be thorough, but sometimes ends up on tangents (at least they are educational).

Psychobiology.  She knows what she's talking about.  She's a smart person. BUT she's very confusing and doesn't focus when teaching.  She's distracted by noises and such and looses momentum while teaching. Too wordy.  I wish she'd speak clearly and concise.  Sometimes it's frustrating listening to her, because she doesn't focus and is confusing.

This is an awesome class, and people who give her bad ratings either weren't interested in the material or were just too confused (psych students.) It's interesting material and she is a lot of fun.  She is quirky and helpful if you have intelligent questions. I loved this class.

Professor Ricci is one of the best Psychology teachers at Northeastern University. If people give her bad ratings it is because they don't go to her class or they get bad grades because they are stupid and can't read. I have an A in her class and I study the notes and the book and always do fine.

Absolutely amazing professor; really fair and has made me decide to take on psych as at least a minor. If you attend class and/or read the chapters and study there is no way you can do poorly. Everything on the quizzes are things talked about in class, and if you miss class its in the book. She answers questions and is always available!!!
Makes class interesting. She uses examples to make the lecture exciting. It is a good choice for an elective because you will get something out of it

Do you want to understand how neurology affects psychology?  Would you like to actually "get" why thought occurs?  Enjoy her, because she knows why specifically, and is more than capable of helping you to understand--if you want to understand.  If you don't, don't bother, but you don't need to be in the profession.  Neuro & Psych are converging.

Overall a great professor and always willing to help out after class. Does not hold students' hands and gets a bad rep because of it, but I am taking her class as a freshman and am doing fine. Her classes are hard and require studying, but are worth the effort. Learned a lot; def. taking her class on psychobio.

She was never prepared for class and she told "jokes" way too often which is inappropriate when people (like myself) were struggling to understand the difficult material. She thought she was a "fun" and "cool" teacher, but the class was completely boring and simply a waste of time.

Ricci is not a bad professor, but she has some problems: she does not see the students as a class. She sees the students as an audience, and she is the performer. She is often more concerned with making people laugh than with actually answering questions, teaching, or being helpful.  If you get something useful out of her show, so much the better.
No Comments

She was pretty confusing and hard to follow at times.  Also would not answer any questions in depth.  The class was totally memorization and pretty much an easy A.  Also, there are no pre reqs so bio/science majors should not expect a challenging class! There were people that didn't know what DNA was.

I think people give her a bad rep because of her personality.  I thought the class was awesome.  Tests are fair, mildly difficult, taken straight from the powerpoints (posted on blackboard).  Melloni's lectures SUCKED in comparison.  Know's her stuff and then some.  A little cold, kinda hard to get extra help, but do some studying and you're fine.

Hard to follow, doesn't make the already difficult material any easier to understand.  Skips helpful things like pictures, and when she DOES give examples they only serve to confuse.  Kind of nutty, seems like a really nice PERSON, but not too great of a PROFESSOR.
No Comments

i loved lesley... melloni was more interesting to listen to, but she's just as knowledgable, and also pretty entertaining. i can see how some people mind find her hard to follow, but she's really not that bad

what the hell is going on......she charges 20 bucks an hour to "tutor" you rather then just have office hours to help people and is very hard to follow! prof melloni should teach the whole class himself

I LOVE this guy but his lectures are dull. repetitive structure consisting of weekly readings, discussion posts, guest speakers, and slides. I had him for my recitation and he absolutely ROCKS. super caring, but grading criteria for assignments and your final grade are too ambiguous & he didn't grade any projects until the very end of the semester.

Great lecturer! I think the course readings are lessons are all super important for new designers, the lecture class is very long sometimes. Seminar sections are OK, depends on TA, there are only 5 major assignments + discussion posts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super interesting teacher. He brought in unique, relevant, and interesting guest lectures each week. A breakout group section was also held each week. He was a modern teacher with lots of relevant experience, and super nice. Class was a little long, though.
Lots of reading and weekly homework. Boring lectures with occasionally interesting guest speakers. Easy class. Do your work on time and you'll get an A

he is the best of all the design lecturers. okay the lectures are long, and he does give lots of reading, but for the most part it is all fairly interesting, and you can def grasp the points by skimming through/showing up to class most of the time. overall he is very accomplished in the design world but still lighthearted and approachable. easy A.
The assignments don't reflect knowledge in the class and most of it is based on listening comprehension skills while projects can be fun very time consuming for so few credits
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: no 2 credit class should be this strict and its so lecture heavy

lee is great, and you can tell he is knowledgeable when it comes to design perspectives. attendence every class gets old after the first week, especially since the guest speakers werent always the most interesting/relevant. it is also just a very long block of time to sit in a lecture hall. a little too serious for a 2credit course, but not awful.

Another foundational design course similar to most of the foundation courses. The material feels redundant, especially the hw. The discussions are easy to write, but the seminar for this class is pretty boring and overwhelming with busy work. Another example of how CAMD needs major curriculum reformation. Would never take this class willingly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: guest speakers are irrelevant sometimes, but attendance is mandatory regardless of major and interest, which is fine but a bit annoying. Very repetitive assignments, gets tiring, lecture hall is the worst room in the building, such cramped inconvenient seating, and he keeps making people get up and move around and its really such a hassle
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: While lecture heavy Professor Lee still stands as my favorite professor. He's incredibly knowledgeable in his field and as a CEO of his own design studio he has given great advice about his practice. For someone who had never taken an art class before I found it was very easy as well as inspiring.

One of my favorite professors so far. Lectures were engaging and featured guest speakers with fresh povs. Studio felt like an open, collaborative space that made it easy to stay involved. Projects were flexible and allowed us to explore our interests, which made the work genuinely enjoyable.
Extremely complicated homework and very lecture heavy. I took this as an easy elective but the grading certainly doesn't satisfy the criteria of an easy elective.

Laurent is the best professor I had at NEU. He clearly cares deeply about teaching and it comes through. It's hard, but you'll get out of the course what you put in. Stop reading the review and TAKE THE CLASS
One of, if not THE best professor I've ever had--explains concepts really well, always happy to answer questions during and out of class, and in general makes you excited to learn.
Best teacher I've had at NEU

Professor Lessard cares deeply about teaching and it comes through in his lectures. The material was clear, well presented, and extremely interesting. If you have the chance to take a class with him, do it!

He's greatly underrated. The material is tough and you'll feel overwhelmed from day 1, but it's not his fault. He was forced to teach a hard course (chem 1 and chem 2 in half the time), but if you do what he says and take his advice he'll guide you to victory. Get past his boring tone. Attendance is optional for lecture but mandatory in recitation.

This gen chem lecture will make you want to quit engineering. Lectures are all conceptual and dont prepare you for tests that are heavily based on calculations. He does not know how to explain the mathematics; he just points at a slide and yaps for an hour.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly if you could avoid chem you should. The class isn't easy but i literally failed two of my mid-terms and still managed to finish with an A in the class. The lectures are sometimes pointless since you have the slides already which pretty much summarizes what the lecture is about. Definitely the better prof for chem.

Murga is okay overall, the lectures are super boring and you kind of have to go for the top hats, there is a lot of homework but honestly if you weren't like me and actually spent a few hours outside of class time to learn the content you will be fine. The extra credit helps a lot Aswell.
He's pretty good- chem is just difficult, but you'll be ok. Just go to class and do the homework

professor murga is my king. his lectures aren't the most enthralling but they're very useful. show up to class, pay attention, study, and you'll easily survive. he gives sheets with equations for all exams as well as helpful practice. viva profe murga.
Lesser of the two evils of freshman gen. chem. Reads strictly off slides and all lecture materials are posted on canva. Decent guy with a fairly lenient grading rubric.

His class is manageable, but don't skip every class and cram for the exams, and you should do better than I did. Class was boring, and I wasn't learning much, so I started skipping and lost many participation points. HW helps to learn the material, but exam questions are quite different.
Lectures are long and hard to follow. But still better than Piatt

Lectures are hard to follow and midterms and final tend to look nothing like the homework questions. He is generous with scaling at the end of the semester, but you will feel like you're failing the whole time. Be prepared to study a lot and not get the best grades. The slides are helpful but you will need to teach yourself most of the material.

Professor Murga is possibly the best teacher at NEU. I completely missed my final and he let me take it right after in his office. He extremely caring and tries to make sure all students have the resources to do well in his class. His lectures are long but informational, so you have to make sure to focus. Tests are hard, make sure to study.

Murga does a very good job at teaching CHEM1151 in my opinion; he knows the material very well and he really wants his students to succeed. He's super caring, and he understands that it's a difficult class but he doesn't make it much harder than it needs to be. Lectures are occasionally boring, but that aside, I'd definitely recommend him.

Just take AP Chem. We got a guy who just reads off his slides, have a thick ass accent where 50% of the time you are unable to understand, only good side is that his exams are multiple choice with no explanation involved and we got  Piatt (by all means dont take her you will regret it her name is enough for you to shit ur pants).
all he does is read off the slides so i lowk stopped going to class 2 weeks in because i can do that myself

Compared to the other CHEM 1151 professor, he is a saint. But based on him alone, I would say he's reasonable. He cares about your grade (gives curves every midterm and some extra credit opportunity), and he is a nice person. But chemistry is hard, and unless you're good at it, it's going to take a good amount of time to study for his midterms.

Bro, Mr Murga is the goat, and on god, anyone saying hes bad or that the lectures don't make sense is lowkey just slow. Obviously, you have to do work outside of class, practice tests, active recall, wtv helps u remember the material he teaches in class. saying he does not explain stuff well is just wrong like pay attention more idk what to tell u

Murga is better than the other Chem 1151 professor, but his lectures can be confusing. He skips steps in math problems, jumps between numbers, and reaches answers without explaining. He also talks fast with a strong accent, so you may need textbooks or extra practice to keep up.

I didn't do well in this class, I had to retake it. But I'm glad that both times I took it, Murga was my professor. Taking this class freshman fall was killer. But taking it Summer 1 is actually doable, even while taking another hard class (i just had no free time). He also provides extra credit. Murga is kind, understanding, and approachable.

Professor Murga is really awesome. He is extremely passionate about the subjects that he teaches and keeps his course really organized. Physical chemistry is a LOT of work but it is possible to do well if you stay on top of the work. The summer class is really fast paced and I had to treat it like a full time job but the prof gives extra credit.

He was exceptionally average. His lectures are somewhat boring and you have to put in a fair amount of time if you want to do well in the class. That being said he is probably the best option for first year engineering chemistry.
Lectures are boring and long. He knows what he is talking about but doesnt know how to explain it. Midterms are not bad final is impossible.

this guy is great i love him. he curves so so so much i should've ended with a 78 and ended w an 82 - he curved the final ten points and curves all of his midterms (unfortunately they're all super hard). he doesn't take attendance but he does top hat sometimes during class so dont lose points on smth so easy. great guy and cares abt ur grade.

The class is hard, but Murga is a solid professor. His lectures are hard to pay attention to and the tests are always harder than the sample tests. The final was extremely hard, but he curved it by 10 percent. He gives really good extra credit opportunities, and it is definitely possible to get an A if you study a lot. Take him over the other prof.

Murga was a good teacher given that he taught chem 1 and 2 in one semester. He was easy to reach by email and overall a nice dude. The class was difficult though, I spent most of my studying during the week on chem. While there are a lot of HW questions, they are SO helpful to learn the content. Content builds, so try to understand the basics.

Murga has a lot of extra credit opportunities but don't let that fool you. Unless you took AP Chem in high school or are ready to spend every minute learning this you are done for. His tests are harder than the practice ones he gives and his lectures are boring and he reads directly from his slides. Best of luck taking this class.

Professor Murga is your best bet for chem. It's pretty easy to get a good grade in his class. He offers generous extra credit—120/100 for recitation (6%) and over 100 in Homework and TopHat.Tests are fair, and with prep, you can score in the high 80s or low 90s(Test 1+2). Lectures slides are posted online, but he occasionally does TopHat in class.

This guy is not meant to be a professor. His lectures are a joke and are a complete waste of time. On top of that, I could only understand 50% of the words coming out of his mouth. Don't take his class, it's the biggest waste of time.

I don't really blame Professor Murga. He's trying his best with what he was given, just like we all are. This is more so aimed at the people who put this course together. They decided to combine Chem 1 and Chem 2 into one course. It's very fast paced and hard. The tests are brutal and the review material rarely helps. Be on your guard from day one.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Murga is genuinely a good guy, but has one of the worst teaching styles I have ever seen. There was purpose to go to lectures unless you wanted to see him cite the slides with no supplemental information. The practice exams have nothing to do with the real thing, but there is a lot of other opportunities to save your grade.

Compared to the other chem professor, he's a saint. But that still doesn't excuse his dreadful lectures and his hard to study slides. However, he does give small curves to tests and HW. It really sucks because there's so much material that he has to cover is such an amount of short time, which lowers the quality of his classes. Chill guy though.

lots of HW for only 15% of the grade. The rest of the grade is based on 4 tests for the entire semester. It is messed up, and the practice tests often don't *really* resemble the actual tests given. Also, no practice final. So happy this course will be over soon. Blegh. Only lectures.

If Leonel Murga has a million fans, then I am one of them. If Leonel Murga has just one fan, then I am that one. If Leonel Murga has no fans, that means I am dead. My pookie Leonel Murga is the greatest teacher to ever walk the earth. He can be compared to our glorius king Lebron James, but Leonel is far better in every aspect.

The lectures are very boring and most of the time Murga just reviews the slides that he posts on his canvas. You don't have to show up to class to do good, just study the slides and do the hw assignments. His teaching style is horrible and no beneficial information comes from his lectures.

Dr. Murga is lecture heavy and tends to read off the slides so take advantage of office hours. Atttendance isn't mandatory but he occasionally uses TopHat questions to count your participation and correctness which affects your grade. Much better than Dr. Piatt. If you can switch classes into Dr. Murga's please do. Tests are magnitudes better.

Very well prepared, but heavy-loaded lectures. Dr. Murga gives a lot of chances for extra credit (exams, homework, participation and recitation). He is available outside the class, explains every topic very clearly and gives okay amount of h/w. As a person he is really kind and caring, and what I respect the most he loves to teach his lesson.

He is a pretty good lecturer, but the course is extremely difficult, and you will suffer. Making friends is the only way to survive the course, and in order to get an A in this class...
