I put in nearly 20 (40 for the final) hours of studying for each exam. You don't have a choice as a biochem major; just make sure to take easy classes with this.

Tests are insanely hard if you don't know the material and he barely teaches it. He reads off the slides and has no personality. To pass you have to do a lot of studying. His tests are all multiple choice and are curved if the class does badly enough (excluding the final). Pray you have a good TA for recitation because that's where you will learn.

DO NOT take his class. He pretends like he is willing to work with you and it is merely a facade. He is awful and his tests often had answers that were intended to confuse students. He makes so many careless errors in his homework assignments and exams which are a deciding factor in your grade. Everyone in FA23 chem was lost, the TA was way better.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His class is all lecture. He is a nice guy, but he doesn't really have much personality in his lectures. You also are "required" to attend lectures in that he doesn't take attendance, but he randomly asks questions that your participation in is graded. His tests are tough, but he posts full explanations for tests afterwards.

Murga tries to make this course as easy as he can considering the amount of content NEU requires him to teach. He posts all the slides, which is good because his lectures are boring. He offers a lot of extra credit points and curves a lot (for those saying he didn't curve the final, he curved the whole class up by 2 points). Exams were all MC.

Professor Murga only read from the slides. He did not make any effort to try to explain without reading from the slides. He also barely solved in-class problems which made it  difficult to grasp some of the topics. The TA was honestly better than Murga himself. It was very hard to pay attention to him as his lectures were not interactive at all.

He is very kind and knows a lot about the subject. However, the final exam had a median score of an F and he did not add a curve. Be prepared to work very hard in this class to do well. Even if you study a lot the exams are all multiple choice so if you get one wrong your score goes down even if you know how to do the problem. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you would like to waste your time/money, just take this professor's class. He has done nothing (except read his posted slides word for word). He rushes through concepts and offers NO extra material to practice. He is hands-down the worst professor or teacher I have ever had. He is rude in his emails and can surely destroy your love of learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: bad final that he didnt curve despite average of class being sixty

Professor Murga was a great person who did a good job teaching. He is very lecture heavy so be prepared. Try your best to pay attention in class because if you don't you'll find yourself lost when it comes to exams. Overall, a challenging class with a good teacher. Don't buy the textbook!

This course is a challenge for most people don't get me wrong but his exams are fairly easy as long as you study up on the topics that are coming up. His lectures are honestly optional because he gives the slides in advance but still shows up.  He gives ways to bump your grade up including homework and tophat questions.
Not bad at all, but it takes you a lot of time to review for the tests.
Professor Murga is the best chemistry teacher in the school!

Sometimes takes attendance depends on the day. VERY lecture heavy but he posts the slides so you don't have to take many notes. Textbook really isn't necessary, just study the slideshows. Really nice guy, not his fault the chem department make the course so content heavy.

The class itself is a challenging class as it is meant to be a year-long class but for whatever reason northeastern decided to make it a semester. You have to put in the work to get a good grade don't slack off and you'll get the grade you want. He gives you cheat sheets on exams with all the equations and it's scaled. Overall solid professor.

His accent is a little hard to understand and he talks quietly so make sure you sit close to the front.  The slides he uses are very informative, but he's just reading from the slides.  if you need help, though, he's always happy to answer questions.  He's very sweet and definitely the best professor for gen chem you can have at northeastern.

He has an accent but it isn't difficult to understand. The tests were online which helped, but the actual content was hard to understand and the course was boring and moved fast in general. Even though I aced the class, I didn't retain anything tbh. He replaced 1 out of 3 midterms with ur final exam grade if it helped ur final grade and scaled.

there is a lot of content, so it's a hard class. Murga does a pretty good job at going through everything, but lectures can get monotonous and hard to focus in. he's really fair when it comes to what goes on the exams and he does usually curve a bit though
i took this class fall 2022

Probably the best option for gen chem. His lectures aren't exactly inspirational but it's a big lecture so don't expect it to be the most interesting class ever.  He tries to relate the chemistry back to the real word to make it interesting when he can but its not always possible

CHEM1151 is really two classes compressed into one, so lectures are dense and fast. Few office hours, recitation was only used for homework. I didn't feel like I learned anything, but at the end of the semester, Murga listened to feedback to improve the course. His teaching is burdened by the chemistry department at Northeastern.

Teaching is done via lecture, with some problem solving. The textbook isn't needed, all the material is on the slides. Class is fast paced and hard, but he breaks down the tough topics well. There's a lot of homework, but we have recitation time to work on it. He posts practice tests before the midterms. He's curved tests and extended due dates.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: lectures were so boring and I barely went. Could watch on a zoom, so I wouldn't miss top hat attendance and questions. Had three exams, which all had curves. Tests questions were harder than the practice questions he gives. Had 30 question homework each week. Also gave bonus points on final if people filled out survey. Pretty average chem teacher.

Reads off of the slides. Very boring, difficult to pay attention. He's hesitant to post practice problems for exams. When asked if he was going to post practice problems for the final, he said that he wouldn't. The exams are difficult. Questions in exams are much harder than the examples in class and in recitation.

Read off slides the whole time. They were helpful but didn't teach the material very well. I learned more in recitation than in lecture. Also, he got mad people were saying Mr. instead of Dr. Apparently, it's so terribly disrespectful to his degree that he had to send out an email and complain about it in class.
the cutest guy in the chem department. paul

This class was definitely hard. Lots of hw, hard tests, and you need to study a lot if you've never taken chem before. Although the class was hard prof Murga was pretty good at explaining during lectures. He wasn't super inspirational but with a general lecture class it's hard to do much more. He gave extra credit options and was a fair grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Murga is extremely smart. His lectures, however, are also extremely boring. If you work hard to understand the material, you'll learn a lot. Murga's class will better prepare you for further chem-based courses rather than the other professor.

Murga is an all around great professor. The class is not easy but he is consistently available for extra help. Lectures arent super helpful, but go to get the basics then learn the rest w homework and recitation. Do the homework before recitation quizzes and youll be fine. Not a super difficult course, just takes some effort and time management.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures are somewhat useless because he just reads off the slides. Go to the recitation and you'll be ight

This will be one of the hardest classes you ever take if you didn't take AP Chem in high school. Switch out if you can. Professor Murga is a nice guy, but his tests are way harder than anything you will learn in class or from the homeworks. He is terrible at explaining concepts in a way you can understand, and he doesn't like to curve tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly, hard work pays off in this class. Pay attention in lectures, go to office hours, and put in the extra work and it's an easy A. There's really no surprises on the exams, and Murga is a really nice guy who is generous with extra credit.
This was an unnecessarily difficult course. The tests were really difficult and the lectures aren't very useful. The homework assignments were only slightly helpful.

Murga is clearly passionate about the material, makes a content heavy class as engaging as it gets. He treats students with respect and seems like a actually good guy. Midterms and final were online. The class average cumulative grade after the third midterm was an 85, so not the easiest class in the world. Don't buy the expensive textbook.

This class is really not that hard if you just keep on top of your work. Murga is super helpful during office hours. Homework assignments take 1-3 hours a week and there are 3 midterms that arent terrible but def require studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He was very nice and approachable in office hours, even met on weekends when we asked. Very helpful and kind! The class was just extremely hard, so many of us really suffered. I think collaboration in this class is key, just wish exams were take home or weighted less. Hes a great guy tho!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Murga was a good professor- material was unreasonably difficult for non-Chemistry majors but he did his best to condense and simplify topics down to the essentials. Course ran fast over the Summer, and he acknowledged that + made appropriate due date adjustments to aid with the quick pace. Overall, learned a lot and wasn't a bad class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Physical Chemistry can be challenging to some students but anyone who tries his or her best will do very well. Professor Murga is very professional and easily approachable. He helps students as much as he can. Use his office hour as much as you can. And try to understand the concepts instead of memorizing the materials.

Working with classmates was encouraged for homework assignments, so make sure you find a group. They make up a large part of your grade, and they are very challenging, but you will likely get full credit if you work with a group. You really need full credit on these in order to pass. It was hard to know what to expect for exams and quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A lot of complaints I have with this class are with the department. It's a lot of material, esp if you haven't taken chem before, and there's no time left in the semester to go in depth. Prof Murga is great tho. Lectures are clear and he's super accessible and accommodating if you need him to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: professor was bad

Murga is a very sweet guy. However, I didnt take AP Chem in HS so I struggled with the content. Wasnt overly accessible outside of class. He read right off the PowerPoint and he didnt really prepare or review what the final was like. While kind, his deliverance of content made it hard for people with little chemistry background.

For every class, he just reads word for word off a slideshow(while mumbling...)and doesn't explain concepts in a logical matter. I took AP Chem in high school, so the class was pretty much just review, but some people who did not take that class struggled with learning so much new material at a fast pace.
Pr. Murga was asked to teach this class last minute and I think he did a great job. He was very understanding of students and always available to help. Im glad I had pr. Murga for this class.
Did a decent job. Have to learn the work outside the class somewhat, but is trying his best and wants students to learn.

I took two years of chem in high school and I felt like I lost information in his class. He isn't very clear in the examples he does in class and mostly reads straight from the powerpoints which are from the textbook and full of mistakes. There's a lot of homework on a program called smartworks which is terribly designed and sometimes hard to use.

It was his first semester teaching this class. His PPts were quotes from the book and lectures were reading the Ppts. Reading the book and doing homework is the best way to learn. Hes hard to follow in class. The exams were rough unless you took AP chem. He gave a lot of extra credit at the end of the semester, which boosted everyones averages.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Definitely not a great professor. Not very clear when teaching the material - would introduce complex topics but not go very in depth, then on tests would ask very difficult questions. Did not effectively explain how to do out very many problems we would see on homework/exams. Hardest class I've ever taken
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Prof. Murga did a fine job. I didn't have any issues with his teaching style and he did his best to answer questions and make the lessons clear. If you go to class you'll do just fine.

The class is like any other Chem class, you will have virtually the same material and grading criteria. Since it is a lecture it becomes a difficult class because Chem is a hard topic you may need one on one teaching to understand, however, he tries his best to answer questions. The tests are really hard if you don't come to class and study.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: RUN. if you value your sanity and GPA, TURN THE OTHER WAY.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Li is definitely very lecture heavy, and it's often easy to distract yourself from the lecture and content of the class. They can feel long and boring, however the content is not as difficult as it seems if you take some time out of your day and study the material properly. You also have to pay for a textbook for around $100 to access.

Professor li LOVES economics (perhaps a little too much), which is what makes his lectures long/boring. Attendance isn't as mandatory as you think, and people end up not showing up after the first two weeks. content is memorization however if you study enough it's an easy A. u do have to pay125 for a textbook that you will most likely never read

he was very unorganized and had lecture-heavy classes that weren't engaging or helpful. He also put a lot of content on the midterms and finals that we either barely learned or didn't learn at all throughout the semester and didn't have a clear grading criteria.

Seamus is very knowledgeable but lectures bad. I learned most of the course from the textbook and taking notes. He usually shows up ~5 mins late, then takes another two to set up. He's really nice though! His grades and rubrics are very clear and his feedback on the project is clear and thorough. Drops one of three: midterm i, midterm ii, hw grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures boring asf. However, I stopped going to class and did well (attendance 10%). Midterms I and II are 60 MC and if you perform poorly on a midterm, he will drop it and replace it with your homework score, which is a guaranteed A. Also, there's group project that he'll pre-grade and tell you exactly what to change to gain a higher score.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Needs improvement.

Great guy, not a great lecturer. If you have not studied economics and are trying to take an entry-level econ course, you will most likely have a tough time. His class consists of hour-and-a-half-long lectures with little engagement with the class. It's kind of like he's too smart to be teaching a principles course. Overall, pretty difficult.
NOT OKAY

She is very confusing, not very good at english, and refuses to use english even to help explain something. She is bad at explaining things, disorganized, and often late to class. She likes to talk about her personal life a lot and talk about things unrelated to spanish.
easiest class if you ave taken spanish before or have oe knowledge of romance languages... her class was hilarious and she is goofy but really nice

She's great. She speaks very clearly so she's easy to follow. She tells great stories and gives cultural tidbits to supplement the language learning. She's fun and lighthearted. You're learning but don't necessarily realize it.

She is cute as can be and while she can be a little confusing the quizes and tests are out of the book so its not too hard. she makes class fun. If you talk to her outside of class she will help you. I liked her a lot!
Terrible teacher- can speak very very limited english, whole span 101 class taught in spanish, not helpful, makes up grades. only plus is that if she likes you, she'll give you a good grade
No Comments
I learn everything from the book.  I leave the class confused everyday.  She is very entertaining due to her ditziness.  Overall she's fun but one of the worst professors.

I am shocked that the comments below are positive.  She was the most HORRIBLE professor I have ever had.  the entire class was always confused.  The entire final was on something she taught us the last day of class in 10 minutes.  Nobody knew what they were doing.  She wasted my time.  I learned spanish from reading my textbook, not her.
She is awesome.  Really funny and keeps the class going.  Although you don't feel like it, you really learn a lot of spanish from her.

She is a character. She is an outgoing professor that likes to involve the students with the lesson of the day. I had fun as well as learned a lot of spanish in this class. I would recommend her to anyone.

Professor Tanlu has great lectures and really wants you to understand the material. He goes step by step on problems, but he does not really give you a chance for individual work besides connect. His exams are extremely hard, but he curves so if you do okay in the course you will probably get an A.

Professor Tanlu is a really good person. He is very available outside of class and will go over the same problem until you understand it. He has a BIG passion for accounting and it definitely shows through his enthusiastic lectures. Sad that he'll be leaving Northeastern, but I know wherever he goes, his students will be BLESSED with this great man

Professor Lloyd is a blessing in disguise. He makes a class that could be boring extremely engaging. He really wants to hear student inputs, he appreciates participation. He will never frown upon something. He is a jolly, organised and a fair grader. He always comes to class prepared and believes in short breaks when lectures get overwhelming!
He's a really funny boi, and goes out of his way to make the classes fun, interesting and engaging for the students. I would definitely recommend him.
The best professor in the school of business in Northeastern. His tests are very hard but he puts a lot of effort in teaching the exercises. He makes classes as enjoyable as possible.
The best professor I had at Northeastern. Extremely caring and provides very detailed feedback. Take his class you won't regret it. The only down side is tests are hard but this is a hard class.

Awesome professor and really nice guy. You can tell he really loves what he does and cares about students. Exams are tough, but I learned so much from the class that it was worth it. I would gladly take another class of his!

Profe Tania is super nice but the class is very work heavy. For being a language class and elective for many, it felt overwhelming. Especially the end of the semester, a module was given 2 weeks to be finished and then you had a final project on top of that. Felt very rushed. Overall fine class if you have experience with Spanish.

Profe Tania was clear on instructions. The class was pretty work heavy at first, but once we said it was too much work, she reduced it. She was very clear that we should expect to spend 8-10 hours per week outside of class on Spanish. She gave extra credit and quizzes/ projects were easy, but definitely study. Be communicative and it'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Muino is such a great teacher! She makes learning Spanish fun and not intimidating at all, even if you've never studied it before. She's super patient, explains everything clearly, and is always willing to help if you don't understand something right away.
She was such a kind and caring professor. Spanish 2101 has a lot of homework but the class was so well structured and you can tell she genuinely wants her students to succeed.
Worst teacher I have had at Northeastern by far. Destroyed my gpa. This class will take so much time away from your actually important assignments.

She was very knowledgeable, passionate, and kind. Always prepared with engaging activities, she made the class welcoming and well-structured. She was also accommodating if you reached out, showing genuine care for her students' success.
So, very nice she is. Cares so much about her students learning the language. Very particular about the canvas discussion posts so dont cheat. As long as you particpate in class she will like you.

Professor Muino was very caring and understanding when I took her class. I have dyslexia and had absolutely no previous spanish experience, so naturally it was very difficult for me. But Professor Muino was very understanding and accommodating. She helped as much as she could and was very encouraging.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She was very organized and provided clear explanations for assignments. Emphasizing group work and participation greatly enhanced my confidence in speaking Spanish. The course served as a valuable review of grammar while also expanding my vocabulary.

She was incredible instructor who was able to personally assist me outside of class, and she was very passionate about
helping her students understand the language of Spanish. She is readily accessible by email and is extremely personable. She makes the class fun and upbeat and she is always interested in the material that is being taught.

I think she is very fair with grading and is an understanding professor. She gives lots of opportunities to students outside of class to get help like with her office hours and she is always quick with her email responses.

This class was challenging, but definitely improved my spanish. Each class you have at least 3 homework assignments, but they don't take too long usually. The quizzes are pretty difficult. Each unit you also have a project which can be a lot of work in one week. She is willing to help if you ask, but can be a bit intimidating.

I don't understand all the negative reviews, Tania is an amazing professor who provided great feedback and gave so many resources to help increase your Spanish skills. She gives a few small assignments for each class and overall, they didn't take too much time.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Muino was not my favorite Spanish teacher, but she wasn't super bad either. She uses the flipped classroom method, meaning she never teaches in class and you have to learn all the new material yourself. On tests she grades pretty harshly. Overall would not take her again.
I liked the class. She is very passionate about teaching and wanting to help us succeed.

You definitely need a background in Spanish for this class as it is intermediate. The class goes by pretty fast with activities and you do need to pay attention. The homework does matter and there is work outside of class but it is super manageable as long as you manage your time.

Professor Muino is not a very good professor if you're trying to learn how to speak in Spanish. She gives 6 or 7 assignments at a time, and most are due only around 3 days later. Almost all of it is boring busywork that doesn't make you want to learn the subject at all. Her feedback is good, but she can be very uncaring if you have an irl issue.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I have never been more miserable than I was when taking this class. Crazy amounts of work, completely unsupportive, awful at communication, uninclusive, etc. I am genuinely a worse speaker for having taken this class (she killed any OZ of confidence I had but didnt make me better). It also could have been taken online for a few hundred bucks.

She is the nicest most understanding person and really cares about your success and growth in Spanish. There is a decent amount of work and class participation is super important but everything she assigns is for a reason. This was my favorite class and Tania Muino is my favorite professor. If you have the chance definitely take a class with her!
Prof. Muino is a very effective professor, who is always willing and able to help you if you don't understand. . I have considerably improved my Spanish skills.
I learned a lot in her class. A very well organized teacher. The online course I took was clear and well-structured.
Tania is definitely a professor I would recommend to any Spanish student. She always had engaging and fun activities prepared for us , and they helped a lot in building my Spanish skills.

Tania was the most frustrating professor I have ever had. She uses the flipped classroom structure so you have to learn everything before each class and you have homework for EVERY SINGLE class. She is a hard grader and she will give good grades to her favorites, but if you aren't a favorite you really have to work for it. Not easy to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Enjoy spending every single class writing down liberal talking points in Spanish and speaking maybe a total of 30 minutes for the entire semester. If you want to learn a language I suggest looking for a language lab around the city that focuses more on dialogue. If you just need a language credit, find an easier professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Profesora Tania make the class fun and she taught the class enthusiastically. I really enjoyed the class and my Spanish has improved a lot.

Profesora Muino is not a very nice person in my opinion and she assumes the worst in her students. I did well in the class because it was like a refresher course for me, but I feel that if i had known nothing before, I would have done poorly because she rarely goes over grammar.
If you actually want to learn anything this is not the class for you

Great class, didn't make me wanna kms. I recommend studying the material and trying to master it if you're new to Spanish. However I myself had experience before so I only needed some review. The professor is a nice person but show her you want to learn and be respectful (don't use phones in class unless instructed otherwise).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: It was clear that she favored certain students over others and since there were more students she disliked than liked in my class, the majority of the class was spent disciplining students rather than teaching us new content. She's a great teacher but acts like a high school teacher. Not very understanding of students who don't prioritize Spanish.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Profe Tania was my favorite professor last semester. I learned a lot and the classes were fun and motivating. I was sorry she was not teaching Elementary 2.

Tania was one of the best Spanish teachers/professors I have ever had. I do not understand the bad reviews because she was always very nice to everyone and very respectful. She was also always available after class and very helpful. I learned a lot in her class and I would take a class again with her if she was teaching the next level.

I think she is a very effective professor, and goes beyond what is required to help her students. I've taken two Spanish courses with Profesora Muino, and she is always fun and very willing to help. She genuinely wants her students to learn Spanish. You will learn a lot.

I had her for intermediate Spanish 2 and thought she was pretty good. I liked her and thought she was a good teacher but she wasn't anything incredible. Her tests are fill in the blank and usually pretty do-able. She's nice and helpful if you go to her office hours. Participation does matter so you can't miss too many classes.
Tania is great! I think she taught the material in a way that we all understood. Assignments were varied and really helped learning.
its a good class and great professor!

The exercises in class help you learn a lot and the explanations are clear. She made sure to incorporate fun activities so that we get to understood the info. I didn't really like the online homework but it was ok.
Probably the worst class I've taken at Northeastern. Muino talked in English, was disrespectful to students, and completely unorganized. I dreaded going to this class.
Excellent Spanish class, I will take classes from Tania again.

Best spanish teacher I have ever had. I really like Tania's teaching style and how she came up with creative and fun activities to do in class.  I was never bored and I feel my Spanish has improved exponentially.

I thought that she did a great job of making spanish class enjoyable while at the same time really effective, I learned a lot from this course and there was a lot of real conversation in Spanish. Definitely recommend to other students.
She is a great teacher, I learned a lot from her. She uses the textbook and other materials to teach efficiently. This is my second time having her as a professor and I definitely recommend her.

Tania was amazing, by far the best Spanish teacher I've ever had. Because of her I really feel I have improved so much over the semester. And she took the initiative in stepping forward and offering to help me outside of class before I even thought to ask her. Such a fantastic teacher.

I loved prof. Loureiro's class! she varies the activities and I was never bored. There were always interesting and not just fill this blank. She will make us use the language in real situations an it was always different and engaging. I feel my Spanish has improved so much after this class. If you really want to improve your spanish take her class!

I really learned a lot in her class. Everything feels very efficient and she is very enthusiastic and kind. Treated students with respect. I will recommend her class to other students without hesitation and I  do not understand the bad reviews. She was a wonderful teacher and I enjoyed the class.
Worst teacher I've ever had. Rude, disorganized, speaks English 95% of the time. I hated every minute of this class.
I took her Spanish Beginner 2 class and we spoke english 99% of the time. She isn't helpful and never responds to her emails.

I really enjoyed class with Prof. Loureiro. She's very kind and her expectations are reasonable. Her Spanish accent can be a little tough to understand at the beginning though. I'm minoring in Spanish and will be going abroad with her this summer. Great prof, would take again.

She checks homework pretty regularly and gets pissed if you haven't done it, but the class is pretty easy if you actually do the work. The tests are pretty predictable and not all that difficult. I'd definitely take another class from her.

I've taken both Con & Comp 2 and Advanced 1 with her and I really like her as a teacher. The textbook we used was terrible, and she loved it, but I still learned a ton in her classes. She's really good at explaining things, you just need to tell her that you don't understand. Take her classes, you'll learn a lot and you won't regret it.

I don't know why some people are rating her badly! She's such a nice professor and is very understanding and lenient. Her classes are pretty interesting and she is not a tough grader. She's great, and Ihate spanish!

She is very willing to help, and makes an effort to give assistance wherever it is needed.  The class isn't too hard if you pay attention in class and do the homeworks.  Mandatory attendance is due to the department rules, not hers, so don't hold it against her.  Takes about a week to get grades back to you.  Overall, a very good professor.

Extremely easy class, if you are actually at an intermediate level.  Can be redundant at times, but she tries to make the lesson plans differ which is key in language courses. I don't know if i would take her class at a higher level than 302 because i don't feel that her explanations would suffice.
I liked how she would take current aspects of culture, such as music or movies, and tied them into the course. This made the class very interesting because it was not just a "textbook" course.

Terribly boring class, all we do is exercises out of the book. You'd think that in college, your teacher wouldn't just rely on the workbook and the online activities for class. She does not answer emails. Find a different class to take.
very nice and helpful. Great teacher and very enthusiastic.

I couldn't stand her in the beginning of the semester, but later found her much more understandable. The work is pointless at times and the syllabus was way off.  Fortunately, she was unorganized forgot it was due.  She can be a nice person and I think she does try to help.I'd recommend a different teacher but she is passable;it's just frustrating.

He might be the GOAT. The market entry project that he assigns is meticulously designed to optimize your success, allowing for his high expectations for the project. Do NOT try to cheat the market entry project, you will have wasted your time taking this course. Do not be afraid to speak to him outside of class, he cares for each and every student.

He was a great professor; he kept lectures engaging and made sure he was always available outside of class. He was heavy on one group project, which was annoying if you had a group that didn't do work as I did, but besides that, I really enjoyed his class.

Prof. Lovely is very enthusiastic and prepared. He cares a lot and always makes himself available, so go to office hours. He's a little theatrical. He provides instructions for every assignment, so the outlines are all right there, so you know what to say, super helpful. He does rely a lot on the readings, but the slides in modules are really good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Lovely is my favorite professor here at Northeastern. He's the absolute goat. He spends so much time perfecting his lectures and quizzes-- you can tell he cares a lot about his students. The MEP is almost 40% of your grade... so pray you have a good group. The quizzes are hard, but not overly so. READ THE TEXTBOOK. It's not optional.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lovely is an amazing professor. Yes, he is a harsh grader, and you will probably end up with an A- to a B, but I think his class was the best I have taken. He is an amazing man who cares about each student and offers value as a mentor outside of class. He is strict and follows his rules, but if you show up and participate, he is an amazing guy.

Professor Lovely is the best professor I've ever had at Northeastern. His lectures are never boring, he's a very entertaining guy, he genuinely cares for each of his students and it shows. Take his class you wont regret it.

Great teacher, great guy, might be a little bit in love with his lectures/speeches, but he means well. Extremely enthusiastic and will go to bat for you if you put in the work. His Market Entry Project is extremely useful for the real world of International Business. A guy that makes you want to put in your best effort.
Great professor who cares about his students, readily available outside of class to help, and tries to make lectures interesting.

Professor Lovely is a good professor but he is not for everyone. He is very caring for his students and his lectures are interesting. Attendance and class participation matter a lot and count heavily towards your grade. His grading on written assignments its tough, but the quizzes were pretty easy if you study.

I felt like I wasted my time taking this class. It is very clear that he has favorite students and I was not one of them and I just felt unheard and not seen by him. It's very clear that he cares for his students but I just felt like he didn't care about me as much because of my grades in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Lovely is a genuine guy and truly cares about his students. His stories are interesting and I would recommend taking his class.

The first professor I've taken in college that truly respects and cares for all his students. He is kind, respectful, engaging, , and truly wants each of his students to succeed. Cannot recommend this class enough. It is not an easy class and he expects a lot of his students, but that is because he knows we are more than capable of success.
the best. a must-take professor.
He really cares about his students by far the most entertaining course I have ever taken. Group project is weighted heavily but the professor is understanding and gives detailed feedback

Professor Lovely is one of the most amazing professors I have ever had. He truly cares about each and every student and goes above and beyond to make sure this is known. Although this class was hard, it was hard for a reason and I truly loved this class

Group project is very important, if you have a bad group your screwed. He is a very tough grader and gives little feedback to justify the grades. He is very nice though and is always willing to help you out and definitely cares about his students.

Professor Lovely was extremely nice and (for the most part) understanding, but is a strict grader too. It is clear that he develops favorites during class quite early on in the year, which makes a bit annoying when he prioritizes calling on those before others. His stories get a bit old halfway through the semester and wastes content time for sure.

whatever you do, take lovely! one of the most entertaining and interesting classes i've taken ever. the class sort of felt like a family by the end of the semester. it's definitely challenging, but professor lovely wants you to do well in his class. so show up, and you'll have a blast listening to his stories and lectures.

Profesor Lovely truly cares about his students. He is an amazing storytelling and has engaging lectures that relate not only to the course, but the real world. It is most certainly a difficult course, and Prof. Lovely holds his students to a high standard, but at the end is so rewarding. Highly reccomend taking his class and joining the forum!

Professor Lovely was the best teacher I had this year. His class is a lot of work, but you will learn SO much and he cares a lot about his students. His lectures follow the textbook and his quizzes are very fair and straightforward if you study.

Overall, Professor Lovely truly knows how to tell a story and has a lot to share. But he has a high ego and believed he was the best teacher, when in reality he is getting old and tends to confuse a lot of things. He grades based on if he likes you or not. You learn a lot in this class, but quickly get sick of Lovely's fake personality.

One of the most fascinating & intriguing courses I challenged myself to take. I learned valuable lessons everyday through influential anecdotes and thorough logic. While having the ability to use his power in a legitimate manner, Professor Lovely managed to emotionally connect with students. This is a class where I felt like a part of a family.

TAKE LOVELY! This is hands down one of the most amazing teachers I have ever had. I have never met someone that cares so much about his students. He is exactly like Robbin Williams in Dead Poets Society. I truly have never met a better storyteller. His class is not easy, but he is always willing to stay with you for hours after class to help.

Professor Lovely was hands down the best teacher I have ever had. He is a very tough grade and makes you earn your grades, he won't just give them to you. I recommend taking his class if you actually want to learn about international business and apply it with the group project.

Hands down best prof at Northeastern. Absolutely hilarious, great sense of humor, and he genuinely cares about his students. If anyone has the opportunity to take a class with Lovely, don't miss out. Definitely participate in class!!!!

Professor Lovely is the best lecturer I have come across in my entire life. His infamous "Captain Lovely" stories are a fun way to blend the course content with real-life examples. I highly recommend taking this course. But be sure to routinely check the warehouse and modules. Group work is very important. Also, LOOK AT THE PEER EVAL EXAMPLE

Prof Lovely is an amazing teacher. He has endless stories to tell the class and keeps students entertained while connecting his experience to the class content. The class is heavy on group work! Be cooperative and friends with your group, it will help. Harsh grader so pay attention during discussions and make those connections in your papers

Professor Lovely was the most caring professor I have had in my academic career. He truly wants his students to do well and his class is very interesting and engaging. If you want to do well, you need to participate and prepare for his exams. Group work is worth a lot of your grade but he is extremely accessible outside of class

This is a class where the professor puts as much work in as his students. He is a fantastic lecturer and cares extraordinarily about his students getting the most out of the class. If you are engaged in the class and take it seriously, you will do well. I was often excited to go to class - it was extremely enlightening and entertaining.

Im sitting here wondering what the f Im supposed to do for the first assignment of the class because he makes no sense and his assignments are all over the place you have to look at modules then go to the assignment then to the syllabus and link it together to find out actually what ur supposed to even do bc theres no set directions
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: He's a great lecturer and makes sure to keep the class interesting. He's very high energy and very professional. He does care about his students. But his grading is stupid. The class is heavily project/debate based and he tends to grade very subjectively. He has said my essay is perfect but still didn't give it full marks.

Amazing Teacher. He's like Robin Williams, has so many stories, and keeps class perpetually entertaining. It's the only class I actively wanted to attend. There is a lot of group work and writing, but it's very doable. If you get the chance take a class with Captian Lovely.

While receiving a B+ was not optimal, I can be certain that Lovely is the best option for INTB 1202. In class, he shares his very notable Captain Lovely Stories. During this past semester, Lovely showed a high level resiliency by working through difficult personal and global matters. Please try taking him if you have the chance.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: best teacher I've ever had
THE BEST PROFESSOR. He is not a harsh grader if you do your work, has amazing stories, and is extremely engaging. Take his class.

Profess Lovely is, by far, the worst professor I have had since coming here to Northeastern. Although international business courses here are known to be somewhat difficult, Lovely makes it ten times harder than it needs to be. He also assigns a huge Market Entry Research Group project and paper. He is unclear, rude and only pretends to be helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Extraordinary professor. Hes super passionate and knowledgeable and very helpful.

This man is the most amazing man I've ever had as a teacher. I am seriously amazed that people on here didn't like him. He makes you work for it but only because he wants the best for his students. HIGHLYYYYYYYYYY recommend taking any class of his you can!!

Lovely is a great lecturer and gave us 5 really interesting books to read for the class. However, He doesn't post grades until the end of the course and certain projects will count for a large portion of your grade. The guy also is very hostile and if something doesn't go his way, your grade will suffer. Wouldn't recommend taking him again

Professor Lovely has been the best professor I've taken at Northeastern. He is a fantastic lecturer, truly cares about students, and his class is fairly straightforward. He goes above and beyond in being available and understanding to students, and is a genuinely nice guy. As long as you participate in class and do the work, it should be easy

Lovely is the best prof I've had in my time at Northeastern. His tests are super straight forward and he's genuinely the nicest guy. He really wants you to do well and if you put a bit of effort into his class he'll like you back.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Would never take a class with him again. He is by far the worst professor I have had at NEU so far. He is extremely unclear, and is quite hostile with students. If you don't do it his way he will not like it. Avoid Lovely at all costs.

Love Captain Lovely. Fmr Marine. One of the kindest, most caring professors and people you will every meet. His classes often don't have a rhyme or reason as he just talks more on what he believes or is feeling, which keeps it interesting. There are a TON of assignments and you'll always be doing work, but if you do it, you'll get an A and have fun
Perfect for those who want to take a class and learn general international business

Participation makes up a huge percentage of the grade in his class.  However when I did volunteer my answers he would often roll his eyes, I'm assuming because he disagreed with me?  Eventually he started to altogether ignore me even if I was the only one willing to answer his questions.  I felt very disrespected in this class.

Professor Lovely is my favorite professor at NEU by far. He made a boring subject a fun class and I never had any problem going. He is a very inspirational man and you know that he is there for you whenever. Studying abroad in the Balkans with him was also amazing. Not the easiest professor but it beyond worth it to know him.

I loved Professor Lovely! He really cared from the beginning and was also there to help us learn. He made sure to make his lectures interesting and had some interesting group projectsassignments for us to work on. I had a blast and wish I could've taken another course with him! 100% recommended.

Lovely is a great person but just an OK professor.  He chooses favorites and rarely hands assignments back.  The class itself is comprised of assignments worth 15-25% of your grade each, so if you mess these up you're screwed.  However, Lovely is fair and will try his best not to let this happen.  One of the best professors for the class.

Professor Lovely is amazing! He cares about each student in his class. He loves teaching at Northeastern. His lectures make what would otherwise be boring material funny and interesting. Go to his office hours too! He loves to help his students.
Motivational.

Easily the best teacher I've ever had. He has a great sense of humor that made learning very entertaining but also very effective. Also, Prof. Lovely is very fair and helpful to all of his students and generally just a great person. I'd definitely recommend taking any class he teaches
Loved that teacher. Very funny and enthusiastic! Definitely take him, he has some really funny jokes! Best part is that he was a Marine soldier!

Great teacher, definitely take him if you have the chance. Even though the course was so poorly designed (the course coordinator's fault not his), he made it fun and did the best he could to help us with the ridiculous quiz questions they gave us. Super helpful with our projects and said we could use him as a reference for jobs and such. Great Guy

Such a great professor.  His enthusiasm and willingness to share his knowledge  and help all students succeed is great.  It was really one of the only classes I looked forward to going to all semester and was such a great introduction into the business program for me! I 100% recommend taking him :)
great prof!!! wish i would have him for another course... you actually learn and have fun doing it.

Sweet professor we have here nothing against his personality. However this class is extremely subjective with grading. Odds are most of the class will end with a B+ which isn't bad but I believe you should have full control over your grade. Not once did anyone in this class receive a 100 on an assignment Not a hard class material wise just annoying

The Bike sim you play is bad, hope you get a good team, but he lets you pick maybe. Slides are AI, grading is AI - making an A in the class impossible, no one ever got one. Boring lectures, but all quizzes are on online canvas. This is a very easy class for an A-, but imopssible for an A. I didn't learn a lot but it was easy.

Professor Loessi is a very sweet and caring man! While he is very unclear with his grading system, he wants the best for his students and shows that. Lectures can be very mundane, and there is little to no work in the class besides 5 homework assignments and surveys.

Two open-note online quizzes and a final. Attendance allows 2 drops; absences excused if sick. ~5 HW plus easy grade boosters. Simulation is standard but limited presentation guidance; good guest speakers. Grading is strict—90%+ is rare for HW/Quiz. Must justify each MC. B+ to A- doable, A is tough.

The class consists of 2 online ‘quizzes' and an online final. Every class is the same with a lecture and slide deck that he goes through. The class is simple and only requires the bare minimum effort and if you do end up struggling, just ask for help. Bike sim: even though my group finished last we got the best grade bc our slide deck was the best.

A.I's all his slides and homework, convinced he uses A.I to grade everything which explains why he gives weird numbers as grades and why no one was able to get an A in his class. Boring lectures but participation is needed. He's a good guy, but a pretty bad professor. If you want an A- take it cuz that's easy to get but an A is impossible.

Don't think anyone in my class got an A since his grading system makes it impossible. Open note quizzes and final exam but don't help since timed and everyone in class used A.I on all assignments including the exams. Boring lectures tbh but participation matters. Take a different professor to get an A otherwise an A- is really easy to get.

Mandatory attendance, participation is graded, and his grading system prevents you from getting an A. Great thing though is that all quizzes are "open note open web," but what sucks is that he makes you give JUSTIFICATIONS FOR YOUR MCQ ANSWERS. Don't take him if you want an easy A. He's a great person and accessible outside of class though.

Wants success for his students! Lecture heavy, but take notes on the slides as he presents them and its manageable. Group bike simulation project for most of semester is main homework plus a couple others. Unique grading format for quizzes and tests that gives students the best opportunity to do well. Talks kind of quiet so sit towards front.

Great professor. The class is lecture heavy and participation matters. There are two quizzes and a final; there is a bike simulation group project that you complete for most of the semester and present at the end. The quizzes are done on Canvas and he has a unique grading scale - I recommend him overall, very caring, respectful, and experienced

terrible class, it's primarily based on R coding and the examples from the slides are NOTHING like the weekly assignments. They do provide a lot of office hours help and both the midterm and final were taken online.

I never really went to the lectures, it covers the basics of statistics and they take right off the slides that they post on Canvas. There are 1 weekly homework assignment each week along with 1 midterm and 1 final. Which the tests were online and they let us take them from wherever. All R code you can just look up how to do it. Easy A.

Smith is awesome but this class is dry if you already knows basic statistics. Some of the R information was useful. Even if you aren't code inclined, all the slides (posted on canvas) have examples of exactly what you need to do for the weekly assignments, and you can copy paste and edit them to answer the questions. Exams were take home

be warned this is a CODING course for HEALTH science students... however midterm and final were both online and taken from home. besides that it was just weekly coding homework that we were allowed to use chatgpt to do. attendance isnt mandatory so most people didnt go to class tbh as exams were online. louisa was kind but lectures were confusing.

Professor Smith is 1 of 2 professors for this course. The class was held in Blackman Auditorium, making it difficult for the professor to interact with students/teach effectively. The notes didn't make sense. She tried her best and was sometimes able to expand on the slides, but the concepts were difficult/hard to teach to such a large lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor D'Souza truly cares about his students. Since he is online, I would suggest reaching out to him to get extra help before exams. He truly wants his students to succeed in his class and goes the extra mile to help us understand coursework without feeling too stressed if you reach out. would definitely take another class with him!

Super reachable outside of class and always willing to meet with you for extra help. However, be aware the exams are NOT multiple choice even though the syllabus clearly says so. Weekly HWs can take a while, and sometimes he's not super clear on expectations. Overall, nice guy but sometimes disorganized.

Professor Lowell cares a lot for his students and is very easy to reach out to. Although the class is online, lectures were easy to comprehend. I definitely recommend him as a professor as he truly wants his students to succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor D'Souza is a fantastic professor. I struggled with this class as I took it for minor credit and my major is very different from finance. Even though it was an online class, Prof. D'Souza was easily accessible and incredible at helping me keep up with the class. He is a great teacher that anyone would be lucky to have!

He was an amazing professor during my course. Even though it was online, the video lectures were extremely educational and taught better than the textbooks. When it came to grading, I was able to understand what I needed to write because the rubrics were easy to understand and descriptive. I truly enjoyed taking the class and would take it again.

Fantastic professor across the board. Financial management can leave students lost in the theory due to the broad subjects, but Prof. D'Souza made sure to constantly provide real life examples from articles, things he has dealt with / received in the mail, breaking down news, etc. to always put things into practice. Extremely caring professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor D'Souza was a great prof, always was available throughout the semester via phone call and email, which was extremely helpful in a remote class. Homework can be tough but if you stay on-top of it on a weekly basis you should do just fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took his class asych over Summer 1 and it was terrible. While sych classes meet for 1.5 hours a day 4 times a week, his lectures were on avg. 35 mins per chapter and he doesn't share his slides which give middle school vibes. All assignments are on connect. If you email him he will reply and you can voice call him for help. Take a different prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Virtual class did him no favors; everything was pre-recorded with absolutely no classroom environment or professor-student interaction except for a once a week Canvas announcement. Clearly didn't read an email I sent him with a question and responded with a screenshot of the textbook. Very easy class but supremely underwhelming and disappointing.
Professor D'Souza cares about his students and wants to see them succeed. If you put in the effort, you will be able to do well.
Professor D'Souza was available outside of class and gave great feedback. He truly cares about his students and focuses on learning rather than focusing on simply making the class difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great choice - would definitely take more classes with this professor. Very helpful outside of class.
Professor D'Souza really cares about his students. Great professor who is always available should you need his guidance. I would definitely recommend him to everyone!
He wants you to succeed in the classes, and is willing to take time off his busy schedule to talk with you about the course. One of the most caring professors I've ever had!

Professor D'Souza is an excellent teacher and person. His lectures are engaging and he genuinely wants you to learn and puts in the effort to help you in and outside of the classroom. You will need to do your part, but will get a lot out of it if you do.

Professor D'Souza took the time to learn about me and help structure coursework to best fit my needs and the learning objectives of the course. He was very kind and helpful and was available to help if there were ever any issues!
He is very caring and willing to help you out, you just need to do your part.

I had the pleasure to be a student of Mr. D'Souza in the Spring of 2017. I was able to learn the material very well. He was always available to answer any questions I had, and also able to use his outside experience to make the material easier to understand. If you have the to take him as a professor especially if you are serious about finance
Take him. You will learn a lot regarding corp finance
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Honestly a gem of a professor with a lot of real-world experience. He makes sure you are ready for the exams. Homework is case studies and aplia. The final project is  a stock valuation paper.

I've had professor D'Souza for both Financial Management and Corporate Finance and I highly recommend him as a professor. He cares tremendously about the success of his students and brings in wonderful work experience from the time he spent in consulting and with startups. Company valuation paper and BMC certification are very useful!
AMAZING PROFESSOR!!!! You learn a lot in this class especially with the Bloomberg Certification and the Company Valuation Paper!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: For an intro to finance class he expects a lot. He is always available to help, but this class was just too stressful for an intro class. He assigns a lot of lengthy papers that he lets his TA grade. He lectures a lot and although he definitely knows his stuff it would be nice if he could stick to the curriculum instead of go off on tangents.
Makes dad jokes. Extremely nice, but horrible teacher. Willing to help, but good luck. Says do X, but don't do X. Then do what?

Loredana is amazing. I learned so much from this course, and it lived up to its name; it was extremely innovative. Each class was a new experience. The course is mostly class discussions, and people are encouraged to participate. She might seem intimidating at first, but she cares so much about her students and would do anything for them.
Long rants and rambles, lots of people like her because she makes them feel special. Just take someone else for innovation.

Professor Loredana is genuinely an amazing professor. I wish she offered more classes because I would stay in college to take her courses. She doesn't just give busy work, she really wants her students to gain knowledge and come out of the course with new skills.  Take her courses if you have the choice.

Genuinely the best Professor I have had at Northeastern so far. Her teaching style is unique, engaging, and informative. For the semester long group project we chose groups and created podcasts on industries we were passionate about. This project taught us how to create a business in a new and unconventional way that was fun and educational.

Best professor I have had at NEU so far, not your typical professor. At first, very intimidating to weed people out. Show up with positive attitude and participate as much as you can. Do the mandatory readings before class and take notes prior. Learned so much from her and she builds a community within the classroom. Will forever remember her!

She does NOT create a welcoming environment, she will berate you and nit pick what you said. She also boasts a lot about her personal achievements, like how she has a wait list for registration. Yes it gets better as you get to know her, but it doesn't worth it. I was also not the only one who felt this way, she annihilated our entire section

One of the best professors I've ever had. She creates an inclusive, collaborative environment where students feel encouraged to take risks and challenge themselves. Her lectures, assignments, and course content are innovative and engaging. She's deeply passionate about her students as well. I truly can't recommend her enough. Best professor!
Great professor and I highly recommend her class. You will learn more from this class than any other professor at Northeastern.

She is the best teacher I have ever had in my life. This is the second course I've taken with her. She genuinely wants everyone to succeed - not just in the class but in life. She goes above and beyond with everything she does for her students. You will learn so much from her that you will use the rest of your life. BEST TEACHER EVER.

Easily the BEST professor I've ever had. If you have the chance to take her class, do it. She creates a welcoming, inclusive class environment where everyone feels comfortable participating, and you genuinely look forward to going to class. You will learn so much from the class. Take her. You won't regret it.
Participate, listen, and put in effort. Amazing professor and I would easily take her again. I recommend to anyone who's interested in AI, entrepreneurship, and innovation. Extremely engaging.

Professor Padurean creates an environment for students to be collaborative and bounce ideas off one another. Her teaching method is unorthodox, but by far the most consequential I've experienced. I haven't learned more about what it takes to succeed in the world of business in any other class. Professor is an amazing teacher and even better person.

Professor Padurean is an excellent professor who delivers deeply engaging and interesting lectures. She is more than just a teacher; she has the unique ability to captivate her class with interesting and relevant stories that spark interest in almost anyone interested in business and entrepreneurship. Highly recommend.

The best professor. Class is engaging, effective & relevant to real life. She is inspiring, knowledgable & sees students as individuals. Class is interactive, discussion-based, and captivating. Innovative & embraces AI. Impactful for me as a student & person. Always helpful with her class and anything else. If you can take her do not hesitate!

She is one of the best professors I've ever had! She challenges her students to be better and is full of knowledge. I learned so much in her class. Definitely take her! Yes, you'll need to put in effort, but believe me — the class is totally worth it.

She is absolutely amazing! You either love her or hate her-I  loved her. For the first few classes she will be tough, but she becomes warmer over time. She does this to weed people out which, honestly gives a great batch of classmates to work with. Participation matters! It's a big part of your grade so be sure to participate and do projects well.

I really enjoyed this course with Loredana. She is very passionate about Innovation and how products have been innovated over time. She has a lot of wisdom and gives wonderful life advice. She has a lot of stories to tell which makes the class very memorable. Even though she might be intimidating at first, she becomes warmer overtime.

Hands down one of my favorite professors I've had the opportunity to take a course with. You get what you put in, and it's very hard not to be engaging in class. Lectures are conversation-based, so participation matters a lot. She can be more strict in the beginning of the semester, but she will lighten up and I guarantee you will enjoy class!

The best professor I will have taken at Northeastern, intellectually stimulating and impactful. Such a fan of this class and how Padurean approaches it that I could get an F and still recommend her forever. Class was discussion-style based on HBS readings with one large group project. The value in taking her  is out of this world, seriously

Professor Loredana is incredible. With engaging and inspiring class discussions, I have learnt and benefited a lot from taking her class. For future students please focus on reading the HBR articles rather than the slide shows. Class is great and fun to be a part of, also is intellectually stimulating!
Incredibly engaging and interesting to learn from. overall my best professor this semester.

You're either going to love her or hate her, and I loved her. Towards the beginning she is harsh if you are late to class, however once you warm up to her she is the coolest Professor you will know. I didn't even get an A in the class, but I would take her again. She is inspirational and truly has some funny stories if you get to know them. 10/10

This class is one of the most intellectually stimulating classes. Beware that participation in class matters the most. Through the group projects you will learn a lot. She will make you work for your grade and is one of the best professors you will get at Northeastern. Never be late to her class!

Professor Padurean is one of my overall favorite professors in the business program. The class is not for you if you don't want to put in the work, but if you are willing to it's amazing. Participation and group work are super important. Class is super engaging and definitely one of my favorites. It's tough, but totally worth it.

Great teacher who cares about students. She creates a community and if you are willing to put in the work then you will succeed. She believes that no one can force you to be an entrepreneur but you have to crave it. Care about the class and see will notice and be happy. She also has fun fashion and style!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: An amazing professor if you're willing to put the effort in. She's always willing to help students outside of class and gives the best lectures. I took this class early in the morning and it made waking up early feel worth it. Definetly take this professor if you have the oppurtunity.

Very knowledgeable about entrepreneurship, and her excitement for the course rubs off on everyone. Group project-based, so make sure to pick a good group. Really enjoyed working with my group. Everything you learn in class is applicable in life. Highly recommend taking her class.

I took Innovation 2301 with Professor Padurean. One of my favorite classes I've had. Her energetic personality makes class engaging and fun. She teaches you important life lessons that will help you throughout your life. I loved how she related material to personal and real-world experiences.

Professor Padurean is a wonderful professor. Her class is discussion based and be ready to participate. The stories and lessons she tells are very entertaining and interesting and make the class fun. Lots of group projects so make she to pick your group wisely at the beginning. She gives great feedback and wants you to do well. Highly recommend.

She is an amazing professor. If you participate, engage, and give good contributions to the class, you will be good. She gives great feedback on group projects and really wants you to grow. She said the first day of class how her goal is to build a community, and she did! Her classroom is a safe and encouraging community!

Best professor I have ever had in my entire life! If you are able to get into any of her classes, take it! She teaches the material in such an engaging way! The class discussions are amazing and I would look forward to her class. She has changed my life for the best and I highly highly recommend her!
She's a really good professor, just make an effort to participate and show up to class as the exam is easy if you actually do readings and listen to what id going on.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Loredana is my favorite professor. She has a fun and unique personality that makes class exciting. She is very intimidating at first, but warms up throughout the semester as she gets to know you and the class. She is very swiss with time, so if you show up even one minute late she will call you out. Your grade is based on participation!
I took Innovation! with Professor Padurean and I loved it!! She's a fair grader and provides applicable feedback for professional development.
Great pass/fail grading policy, was excused from the final because I had perfect attendance. Very knowledgeable

reviews.comment: Great teacher, course is extremely straightforward and you are graded on a few things, which are mostly completion. Highly recommend for any looking to learn more about History and wanting an A

She is very kind, but her lectures are just reading a piece of paper at us with no information on slides and barely stopping to answer questions. Lots of inapplicable readings and very hard to pay attention during lectures Strange grading system that almost encourages perfunctory work. A shame because this topic is interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Walker is amazing! This class was sooo interesting and one where you get to really critically think. The work assigned never felt super demanding and you'll definitely have fun writing the very few papers she does assign because you get absolutely free range with them - she encourages you to write about what interests you!

Professor Walker is super nice and really passionate about history. You will get an A as long as you complete the work, which I liked cause it allowed me to have some creativity in my work. The assignments were never super demanding. Readings can be a little too much but that's only cuz I don't like to read lol.

Prof Walker knows a lot and is very passionate about the subject. We wrote papers based on two books from the course so those are important to read. Weekly readings are unnecessary. I am still confused about the attendance policy and lectures were scattered
Hard to judge from an intro level class but I enjoyed Professor Walker. If you are at all interested in Latin America she is the person to go to. Very passionate and well informed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She has a great background in Latin American History and is an engaging lecturer. She gets students involved in effective ways and takes from a wide variety of sources. Do the readings and be prepared to take notes. She is a great history teacher (no sociology or archive rats here), I would say the best at Northeastern.

He is incredibly organized, understanding, and willing to answer all your questions and enthusiastically encourages them. He truly cares that you learn. Those rating him poorly did not put in the work (seriously). Organic is hard, but if you go to office hours, read the textbook, and practice until you are bored...you can well! My fav Prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall, I would never take a class with him again. All he grades is homework, quizzes, and exams, with no study guides for the exams. When people were struggling, he said, "just do the work" and "watch my videos." When everyone was failing the exams, he wouldn't give us any extra credit besides attendance on random days near the end of the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Try not to take his if you're not SMART smart. Exams and Quizzes were hard af at the start but he gave lotta compensating extra credits towards the end.

Homework problems were harder than the quizzes or exams. Half the exam questions are the same as the practice he gives. If half the class stops showing up to class, he'll randomly give extra credit for showing up. Really nice but hard to learn in his class since he seems confused about what he's teaching sometimes, better off self-studying.

Great professor who makes O-Chem manageable. I studied the day of most exams and still did well. He's kind, gives extra credit, tons of practice, and note cards on exams. Tests and quizzes EXACTLY match practice exams given. Very helpful and approachable, willing to talk research as well. highly recommend over other any other neu ochem professors!!
If you're struggling in his class it's genuinely because you aren't trying hard enough. It's orgo. Do better.
SO unhelpful. Genuinely just teaches to keep his lab at neu.

Do not take orgo with him. You will not learn anything unless you spend hours teaching yourself. Exams are impossible, with 4 25 MCQ exams determining your entire grade. Many many people dropped his class the semester I took it. When I asked him for help or to see if I should drop, he asked if I was pre-med and when I said yes, he laughed.
DO NOT TAKE ORGO WITH LOPEZ IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR GRADES!

Take anyone else. Average on one of our quizzes was a 54%. Everyone seemed like they were in survival mode. Everything after ch.5 is completely self taught, and everything significantly increases in difficulty. No one should be relying on a curve to save their grade/gpa. Cool guy, but save yourself. Take Matthews or Danahy.
