Vaso, a sweet fashionable mess. the more you listen, the more confusing it gets. Had to get tutoring every week and was still surprised by some of her questions. if you go to her office hours (I recommend you do) she's willing to listen and help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Everyone hates on Vaso but to be honest she's not the worst professor you could have. She's funny, kind and cares for her student's success. If you actually pay attention in class and read the textbook this class is a breeze. If you don't understand something go to her office hours; she's always there to help and shes also very big on extra credit.

It was very clear that Prof. Lykourinou knows what she's talking about and is very kind/willing to help her students. However, she is extremely unorganized and disjointed in lectures. This class was super frustrating as someone who has no background in chemistry. Recitation was a SAVIOR!

It's clear Vaso cares about her students and knows what she's talking about but her lectures could not be more boring. If you're comfortable teaching yourself the material I'd suggest skipping the lectures altogether for the extra hour of free time, but keep an eye on the online assignments she posts occasionally during class for attendance.
This professor is very disorganized and the lectures are very unclear. If you are in this class you should be prepared to learn from the textbook on your own.

Vaso is a wonderful person, but a confusing teacher. She really cares about her student's success and if you go to office hours and show that you're trying, she will work with you. Unfortunately she is very hard to follow in lecture unless you have read and understand the material before class. This class is difficult for me and lots of work

Easily the worst professor I've had. Lectures are pointless, disorganized, long, and no one can hear anything she says or writes. She also never replies to emails, and that's a pretty big problem towards the end of the semester.
This is honestly the worst class in my first semester. Disorganized and unclear lecture. You need to teach yourself and get a tutor. Will not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Vasiliki tries her best to make sure her students understand the material. Her power points are very helpful, which can be studied own your own, but it's important to go to class so that you don't miss her clicker questions and explanations to practice problems.
Vaso is a horrible prof. She was very disorganized and didn't know how to teach. She REALLY curved all exams. Easy A though.

Vaso is honestly not the best teacher at all. Her teaching style is terrible and her lectures are disorganized. We were always behind schedule. However, she curves all the exams and even the finals grades. I should have gotten a B or even lower, but I ended up with an A. She is a great person though and she really does care, just a bad teacher.

Vaso, being not only a terrible lecturer, poor teacher, and disorganized clown, is also completely disrespectful to students. You come out of lecture more confused than when you went in and get major attitude when you dare ask a question. I was really disappointed by my experience in this class, and probably owe my A+ to my awesome tutor.
AWFUL. She constantly changed her schedule and was very confusing in lectures. Learn nothing from her.

Vaso is a pretty awful teacher-- her lectures are confusing and I can hardly understand what she is saying. She also has not stuck with the timeline at ALL and keeps falling behind. However, her tests are extremely easy-- you only needed to get 18 out of 23 questions correct to get 100% on both of the midterms. However, she's quite nice.

Vaso is a very nice instructor and ready to help. She doesnt really know how to teach. She explained concepts in a very sophisticated manner which was very confusing. She should work on her communication skills.

I honestly think she's a wonderful person, but she cannot teach. Whenever a question was asked during class, it ended up taking the entire class. She's well intentioned but lacks the necessary skills to effectively communicate information. Get ready to teach yourself, not worth going to lectures get your sleep and learn from the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This prof. is sooooo CONFUSING. she made easy concepts way more complicated. I was not able follow her in the lecture. I ended up teaching myself. Stay away if you have a chance.

Vaso is a very nice and helpful professor! She truly wants her students to be successful and likes to personally know you and help you. Very open to people asking her questions. Her lectures can be a little unclear but make sure you ask for help. She gives extra credit and tries to make notes and wksts as clear as possible. very difficult class!!

Vaso is a great person, VERY helpful when you email/ask her, but lectures are definitely confusing. Very hard to follow what she is saying and writing at the same time, she explains in more words than necessary. Tests  can be tough with a decent amount of easy questions, but not too hard to get at least a B with at least some effort.

She was very confusing to understand. No one ever understood what she was talking about and no one ever went to class because when you did she confused you more.  Very approachable. If you are having trouble go see her from the start because she is very kind and wants you to succeed.
during class I wasn't able to follow the lecture easily. However she is very nice and willing to help. The test were pretty hard, expect to study a lot.
Vaso is sweet but just so confused.
Not clear at all and not very helpful

Extremely kind prof-takes the effort to learn and remember your name. Can be confusing during lectures and sometimes does stupid math errors on the board but if you know what's going on, you'll be fine. posts helpful ppts but reading from the book is helpful as well. her tests cover everything. gives pop questions every lecture for participation

Solid professor. Sometimes confusing in class, but is awesome at explaining things face-to-face. She will bend over backwards to help anyone who reaches out.  Attendance not mandatory, but gives in-classes quizzes for attendance.

Gen. Chem was an easy class, all you really have to do is study the textbook and powerpoints. Prof. Lykourinou is not an outstanding instructor, but she is nice, open to feedback, and willing to help. She gives a lot of pop questions in class that count for credit, and weekly quizzes are given at recitations. Tests are very easy.

The class was good and introduced many real world examples which is nice. Professor was easy to talk to and cared for the students. As long as you go to class regularly and seek the professors help you will get a good grade. Only down side was the students who came unprepared and asked simple questions. Loved it!

While it is clear that she really cares about students and wants them to do well the lectures are confusing and hard to pay attention to. Getting an A doesn't take a lot of work but actually learning the material requires a lot of commitment to the class and commitment to putting in work outside of class time.
Her lectures are pretty long and boring (and sometimes confusing) and there are participation quizzes but if you ask for help she'll definitely give it and in the end everyone got an A or high B.
She does a lot of in class questions which is an easy way to get points but its not necessary to go to class.  Her lectures can get pretty confusing at times

I really liked Vaso. She really wants you to learn and takes the time to exponent things. Her accent can be hard to understand at times, but if you pay attention you will do fine. She really cares about the students. Would recommend her!

class is fine, but only because the course moves so slowly  - i never actually have any idea what's actually going on, but I'm getting A's. The lab for the class moves at a completely different pace than what she teaches, which means you have to learn all kinds of stuff on your own, skipping ahead by a week or two in the lesson plan. dont recommend
Only professor I ever had who spend so much time making sure students know the material. Go to class, do the homework and make sure you finish the discussion assignments.

Professor Lykourinou is amazing! She went above and beyond meeting with everyone in class, giving feedback when needed and extra credit in one of the hard exams. She went out if her way everyday to make sure we had a chance to learn! Highly recommend, I wish she was teaching other chemistry classes!

She is simply just ok. I think an easier grader who does want her students to well but she just doesn't seem as knowledgeable as I hoped, and can be confusing at times. If there is a mistake on your grades, you definitely have to set a time to meet with her because she wont remember to fix it otherwise. That being said she will fix it and is nice.
Maura is the best. I had a tough start in BUSN1103 but she has been very supportive. Would recommend her class to anyone.

For BUSN 1103 (Co-op Class). Maura is incredibly energetic and truly cares about ALL her students. She engages with everyone like her friends. In her class specifically, you learn about the unspoken rules in corporate and gain crucial skills necessary for the workplace. HIGHLY recommend taking her class for anyone going on Search!!

Absolutely loved Ms. Maura, a blessing to have her as my advisor. Incredibly patient and hard-working. Loves to talk, it feels like talking with a friend when we have a meeting. Could not recommend her enough. Had a very tough semester and wouldn't have done it without her!
My favorite professor I've ever had at Northeastern. He explains things really well and is always willing to answer questions as needed. I've learned so much from him, and 10/10 would take him again.

My GOAT. Teaches material very cleanly and directly, and cares about the students in his class. Is always available to answer questions and tries to help you really understand the course's material. Would absolutely take a class with him again.

Currently halfway through the class.

Doesn't explain problems super clearly (especially if they are difficult), but still helpful.
Weekly quizzes, two labs a week regularly, easy lab reports (not IPL format).

Like most other eng courses, homework is more comprehensive than the material covered in class.

Overall: amazing and passionate teacher.
If you do the labs and HW guaranteed A quizzes and final exam were light
mad chill guy easy quizzes cool dude and nice vibe

McElligott Is a good professor, however, she can be a bit testing if she see's not many attened her class. She might say "it's because you guys don't show up to class why your test scores look this low". But many first years don't have control over their fall semester schedule so many had 8am EVERYDAY! But if you study & do the work, you will pass.

Bro she is so boring, her grading is alright. she got mad at my class for not attending 8am in freezing rain. She is very high school teacher like. She gave almost no extra credit. her grading system wasn't bad.

As a first year, I loved her. Most times it's lecture but every once in a while she'll have worksheets for students to complete during class with peers. Tests are lecture based so as long as you pay attention in class you should be good. I definitely recommend taking this course with her.
If you are passionate about biology, TAKE THIS COURSE! The course pushes you to do a lot of reading and homework, but really teaches you the material. Lots of small assignments to get a higher grade!

She is a wonderful, enthusiastic, and knowledgeable lecturer. Gives opportunities to keep your grades afloat, generally very helpful and the class is tough but comprehensible. The one thing is her tests are HARD. You can know all the content and still do bad on the tests.
Her exams are very difficult and honestly ask too much sometimes, but she's a decent professor. Speeds through her lectures, but has a good amount of availability in office hours.
She really loves teaching Bio, but the tests were difficult. If you pay attention and try, you could get a good grade, but it's hard to get anything above a 90.

she is great at explaining things and keeping you engaged. there are three exams that consecutively weigh more of your grade as they are cumulative. the third exam is weighed more than the final. the tests are difficult but not impossible. very hard to get 100 or even above a 90 on the exams. there are a lot of assignments so it is a heavy workload

Shes such an easy A if u know the method to ace her exams but her lectures r boring and annoying like taking an 8am with her was the death of me and ruined my day before it could even fully start also she requires u to purchase a lab book made by her and its literally so useless like it could've been a pdf online

Definitely agree that this class is like a full-time job. There are a lot of assignments and readings, which you HAVE to do or else you're not gonna understand. I thought she was a bad lecturer in the sense that I didn't really learn anything in class because it felt like she assumed you knew it already. Tests are difficult. But she cares
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is the BEST. Attendance isn't mandatory but going to class & participating is super important. Prof McElligott is incredibly supportive and reachable outside of class. Test corrections but she expects you to learn from them. Best prof at NEU yet!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor. She really cares about her students. I suggest going to office hours she appreciates when students show up. Make sure you take notes during lectures and review the textbook, the test can be tricky sometimes.

Such a great first year professor. She really prepares you for your time at NEU and thinks of everything. I see people say that this class is like a full time job and I can't disagree, there's a lot of work outside of class, but it really helps you understand the material. I love her lectures so much too, she's so engaging and knowledgeable.

When taking this class, expect to spend HOURS outside of class. She does offer some extra credit, but most of your grade depends on the 3 tests and 1 final. Has post-class assessments that are timed, not too hard, they're fair. Exam questions are fair if you study and do the review sheets. She cares, but this class felt like a full time job.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The best class I've taken so far
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved her. Classes are mostly lecture style and attendance might not be mandatory but participation is. Also, her tests depend on what she says in class so you should probably go. A lot of textbook reading outside of class and some post-class assignments/assessments. There are three exams before the final but they're relatively easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor McElligott is an amazing professor, especially for first years. She includes many different types of assignments and test corrections to help you get the best grade you can. Her lectures are engaging and she records them so you can watch them later, but go to class so you get the best experience. Really sweet lady, absolutely recommend.

Stem Cells Section - 
Her tests (w/ test corrections) are based on articles or lectures read/discussed in class. The class involves active listening and participation, and classes are recorded w/ audio and screen-share. She is clearly a great, passionate, and caring scientist and teacher. Her class reminded my of my excitement toward biology.
lots of out of class work that requires time each week but it balances out your exam grades nicely if you do them. post class assignments are hard but i learned a lot and overall enjoyed her class

Very engaging lecturer. Decent number of external assignments, but it helps boost your grade. Shes very considerate with her grading (extra credits and exam corrections, + drops lowest grades on some assignment). Attendance is graded with poll everywhere so that should be considered. Very nice at office hours and wants her students to succeed.
She assigns a lot of work, but everything is pretty manageable and you can easily get a good grade in this class if you work hard and pay attention. I would take her classes again
I did not really get her point. Drop my assignment with full scores and grade my lowest assignment???
Post-class assessments were hard and exams were confusing, but if you put in effort you will pass. She is super sweet and a very passionate biologist, so it made the class more engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Missy's teaching style is just not effective in my opinion. If you don't do all of the readings, take notes on them, and study them every single day, you won't do well on the tests which are basically the only thing that makes up your grade. I wouldn't recommend taking her unless you are willing to spend 10+ hours/week studying outside of class.

McElligott is an OK lecturer. She has a clearly structure lecture with presentation. I had the most external work from her. Participation matters!!! (poll everywhere + discussion posts). She is fair about grading and allows corrections for each exam. She was a decent first time prof for my intro bio class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: McElligott definitely cared a lot more about us understanding the information she taught us rather than getting through all of the planned course material. Tests definitely do take a lot of memorization, but its doable.

Prof McElligott is hands down the best professor you can get for bio. She's super nice and a really good teacher. Copy paste her learning objectives into a google doc and fill them out during her lecture, otherwise you'll spend way more time studying than you need to.

She was one of my favorite profs this semester. Her lectures are engaging (even at 8am) and she explains course material clearly. Theres a decent amount of homework, but its pretty easy. She gives lots of opportunities to boost your grade via extra credit, test corrections, etc. I really enjoyed this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Shes one of those prof that really cares about her students doing well and understanding material. Shell assign a lot of stuff to help learn a difficult concept. Shes very understanding about attendance and whatnot. Her exams detailed so make sure you take notes. She assigns a lot of extra credit to help your grade! Overall, amazing Professor!

She is very passionate and is really good at engaging students in the subject material. I felt very inspired by her teachings and more connected to the subject of biology because of her love and enthusiasm. She was very kind when I sought out help outside of the class. if you do the work you will likely succeed in her class.

She's absolutely amazing and you can tell she actually wants all her students to succeed. Make sure you do the reading because it makes it so much easier to understand what happens in lecture! She gives you plenty of opportunities to get your grade up!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: McElligott is an excellent prof; she does a great job of making sure that you leave her class with an in-depth knowledge of the material. Her lectures are great: she's both engaging and amusing/funny when she's teaching, not to mention that they cover everything you need to know for the exam. Attend lectures, pay attention, and you'll do fine.

Missy is definitely the best professor I've had so far at NU. She gives you so many chances to do well in her class from the Poll Everywhere attendance grade to pre class quizzes that you can take until you get a perfect score to test corrections. Also, I am NEVER bored in her class! I am easily able to pay attention he hour or so that class lasts.

She is one of the best professors I have ever had. She cares so much about her students and us doing well rather than just relaying information and testing us on it. Her class is very engaging. She includes group work, poll everywhere questions, and videos throughout the lecture to keep you from getting bored or lost.

Missy will probably be one of the best professors I'll ever have. She cares more about our learning than sticking to her syllabus (e.g. she removed an entire unit from one of our midterms because she didn't think we had gone over it in-depth enough in lecture). Lots of quizzes but they prepared you for the exams, and overall, she was a real one :)

Professor McElligott is a wonderful instructor. Classes always start with artistic expression where you have the opportunity to draw on a colletively shared screen on Zoom; interactive lectures with lots of breakout rooms; material is clearly explained and you have a pretty good idea of what will show up on exams. +, Office hours are awesome. :)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you do the work you will get an A. She is positive, kind, and easy to work with. Respect her and she will respect you. Just make sure you don't turn things in late and watch the lectures to stay caught up.

Best professor ever! Very clear lectures, very good at explaining concepts. Always had a positive attitude. Always willing to answer questions in/out of class. Very approachable, grading is based on many different things which is meant to help your grade. Highly recommend taking her classes!!! Literally everyone I talked to in the class loved her
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I was having problems with my mental health. I remember her expression when she said I couldn't submit this homework assignment (that wouldn't really impact my grade) a day later. I think a mark of a good teacher is how they treat ALL of their students and how they try to help them out. You never know what is going on behind the scenes.

Missy is the best biology teacher on this planet. I was lucky enough to have her for my first two semesters of college. She gave me the will to live. Her stem cells class was so amazing, she deserves the world. I remember her freshman bio exams being really specific, but if you study for the stem cells exams, you're gonna do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: BEST PROFESSOR @ NORTHEASTERN IVE HAD! Missy is super sweet and an amazing professor - if you out in the effort she will make sure you succeed!

Dr. McElligott is one of the best professors I've had. She is genuinely interested to teach and see her students perform well. Her grading criteria is clear and spread out so exams aren't a majority of your grade. She also gave us an opportunity to earn half our lost marks back after each exam. That being said I found her exams quite tricky.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Missy was so nice and really took a different approach to teaching. She's good at explaining things 1 on 1 and is very approachable. Her tests, very hard for me. I failed the first one but then worked really hard and went to office hours to make up for it. She's hard but I don't regret taking her one bit. Work hard, and you will be rewarded.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Missy is a wonderful professor and a nice lady. She explains concepts super well, and is always willing to go over concepts in office hours. I had her for Foundations in Bio and Inquiries and loved both classes. You really have to know the information to do well on tests, but there are lots of assignments so tests aren't weighted too heavily.

I had Missy for 1107 and 2299, definitely one of the best professors I've had by far. Midterms can be challenging, but there are lots of opportunities to raise your grade and she always makes sure we're graded on many things so no bad grade will pull down your average too much. Very kind person to talk to outside of class as well.

Missy is great! Class is mix of lecture, videos, group work. Lots of activities both in and out of class (HW), but she tries to space them out. She gives lots of resources, and is always available for office hours or extra help. Quizzes and test questions can be challenging but she gives good feedback and extra credit options. She cares how you do!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. McElligott is very passionate about her teaching. She conveys information very clearly and efficiently, leaving little room for confusion if you pay attention. You should read the textbook, but don't necessarily HAVE to. She expects you to and moves quickly through class assuming you understand most of the content. Tests are straightforward.

Missy was absolutely fantastic. I pleasure to be in class with and I fell more in love with Biology because of her. The stem cells class is beyond interesting and you will learn so much about science careers through her help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. McElligott was an awesome professor; she makes sure to incorporate group activity into lectures which made them less boring. Her exams were extremely fair and allowed for group discussion afterward. Also, she is super organized in terms of grades/hw/quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you think active learning is fun, you'll like Missy. I, however, felt like I was back in high school when we would pause a lecture to do a fill-in-the-blank group assignment. I definitely learned something, but not because of the active learning. You definitely need to do your homework and study to do well in any of Missy's classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Very good lecturer and makes the class interesting; always available in office hours to go over tests, quizzes, and assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Prof. McElligott is clearly passionate about teaching Biology and is very open to new ideas when it comes to her teaching style. Her lectures are the most important part of learning the material, but doing all of the assigned reading is a huge help. She gives lots of extra assignments to help you practice the material and boost your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She's a super nice lady and good teacher, but the class covers such a broad scope of subjects, and her tests are always full of super specific details (maybe a footnote of 1 slide in a test over 6 different lectures) but definitely a nice teacher, and you can get a good grade even if you dont do great on the test (she helps you boost your grade)
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Personally, Missy is THE BEST professor I have ever had. She is truly passionate about what she teaches and cares for her students. Although attendance is NOT mandatory, you should go just to get participation points (checked through TopHat) and so you can get the small details she expects you to know for the tests.
Go to the class for the tophat questions, fair grader, fair tests. I would take her class again. If you pay attention you will pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: Textbook online that she uses is really helpful. Coming to class isn't mandatory, but you get participation points using TopHat and she helps explain the topics from the readings. Some of the questions on the tests come straight from her lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: In class, she definitely has a good personality; however, she is a tough grader and does not take it easy when it comes to tests. Be prepared to study everything and memorize every single detail from the ppts and readings. The group tests count for 15% of your grade, but barely bump you up (about 1-2% depending on how well you do).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Teacher know what she's talking about and has very detailed lectures. You need to memorize the littlest details for quizzes and study absolutely everything she gives. Tests are short so each question counts as a huge amount.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: To pass the class, you would have to put in a lot of work, such as studying and making sure you pass Top Hat, quizzes on Launchpad, assessment quizzes on blackboard, and Biology Lab. Even though that seems intimidating (and for me it really was), it gave you a chance to raise your grade and quizzes on launch pad were really easy to get 100% on.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Missy cares about her students, and has a group work approach that really worked for me. Her tests are very tough, though. She is very friendly and was there to give specific ideas for changes for our final projects.

Missy is probably one of the best teachers/professors I've ever had and has a great personality. It's obvious she has a genuine passion not only for the material but for teaching. That being said, her exam are difficult and detail oriented. However, she knows this and lets you correct them for 1/2 credit and they exams aren't weighted too heavily.

Missy is friendly and really into teaching the material, but she expects you to put in the time and effort as well. There are lots of really interesting outside reading articles with accompanying worksheets that aren't collected, but can be tested on, and tested specifically. Her exams are hard and require extensive studying, but the class is great

Missy is an incredible professor. She is very, very clear and is always willing to answer questions and go out of her way to make sure things are as clear as possible, and there are plenty of opportunities to do well. However, her exams are very difficult and detail oriented- you have to study extensively in order to do even remotely well.

She feels like an elementary school teacher; really dumbs things down in class, doesn't really know much about what shes talking about however she plays it off like she does. Her tests are ridiculously detail oriented that it is almost unfair. However she is friendly and approachable.

The lectures are essential to go to.  She gives you a ton of information and they are fun to listen to because she has so much personality.  However, her exams are pretty tough so you must be ready to apply your knowledge!

She's a pretty great teacher but you do a lot of little in class projects.  Can sometimes feel like busy work.  Never collects anything.  You can get a lot of points from top hat so showing up to class is worth it

hadn't done bio since 9th grade and it was a steep learning curve in the beginning  and it takes work to get up to speed and stay there but she always encourages office hours and relates the material so its easy to understand. Tests are difficult, kinda detail oriented but you could easily to well if you study. do hw, read articles. 10/10 recommend
She is the best.

She's great! She reminds me of a typical high school teacher, but is as tough as a college professor. If you really participate and actually do the class activities, read the textbook for things you are confused on, and talk to her for further explanations you will surely get an A. I never scored above a 90 on any of her tests and I still got an A.

By far the weirdest biology course I've ever taken. She teaches in a style that's more suited for middle school gym class, favoring activities with markers and construction paper over actual lecture. Didn't learn much, but on the plus side it's an easy A as long as you know what bio is, and you're willing to do silly stuff in lieu of  actual work.

I have taken Missy for two semesters now and I love her! At first I was struggling but she helped me. She is a great professor and most importantly passionate about what she does and teaches. Her class is really interesting because of the way she ties everything to the real world. Need to study a lot for exams because they are difficult.

She is very good at teaching, explaining thoroughly. Tests are difficult but she lets you correct them afterwards for 12 pt per question. She loves what she does and can be quite funny. She is really approachable and happy to give you feedback. I've had her 2 semesters and it has been a pleasure. Definitely recommend for any bio class.

She's really helpful if you go to her office hours and she really wants you to succeed. Going to class isn't mandatory but it really helped for some of the topics we discussed. There's a lot of material but getting an A in her class is far from impossible.

One of the worst professors I've ever had. Unaccommodating to students with mental illnesses. Tells you to post on her "discussion board" if you have questions, so if you don't have any questions you lose 10% of your grade. In-class activities are useless - I learned more from skipping class and reading the book. If you can avoid this prof, do it.

Great professor! She is very clear about what is expected of you and a good funny lecturer. She will give you study guides to fill out before the midterms; there will be no surprises. She also makes a point to be available and tries to cater to all students by showing you real world applications in different sub-fields. Very happy I had her!
he is a very nice guy but the tests are so hard and he grades it incredibly badly. The tests account for 60% of your grade which is absurd considering how hard the class is.

Terrible, absolutely terrible for business statistics. He makes all the classes and homeworks so damn tough, its impossible to keep up with him. He shows no mercy and is very strict with his grading. Had to drop the class. Would NOT recommend him for business statistics specially because there are much better professors available. SAVE YOURSELF

He is a super kind and caring professor who loves when people participate and ask questions, he does grade participation which is aimed to help everybody's grades, not harm it. Homework is given once a week, with a week to complete it. It takes a while but is super helpful on exams which you're able to bring a cheat sheet for. 100% recommend him.

Professor McGovern is highly skilled in his profession, with an engaging and interactive teaching style. He have a knack for breaking down complex material into easily digestible concepts, and his explanations are always clear and concise. His teaching style maintains student focus and interest, effectively imparting knowledge to his students.

I had a terrible experience. The lectures we recorded in 2013, did not provide office hours (he was too busy with his other fulltime job to meet/call), the only grades came from a midterm and final (which students had to write and solve) and two papers with very little guidance. This shows extremely low effort from the Prof and did not care at all.

He is a nice person and knows how to teach in a way that helps students understand some very complicated definitions. Assignments were set perfectly for us to wrap up all the knowledge covered in the class. The only thing is that the course was pre-recorded several years ago, I wish Prof. McGovern can provide a latest version of this course.

Professor McGovern is not only a great professor but also a great man. He cares about his students and has a very interesting background serving in the Navy. He gives you homework that you need to deliver in every week, they are long and quite complicated, but they do prepare you very well for his exams. If you follow his system and you'll do well

McGovern is a solid professor but has a bit of a laidback "do it yourself" personality which can be very difficult. He often refuses to review things already said, and rarely repeats himself. When students ask "Could you do __ again" he often responds with an attitude of "I did it once, you'll remember." I'd take him again, but with a new attitude.

Professor McGovern was one of, if not the, best professor I have ever had. He doesn't simply tell you things and expect you to remember them, but rather walks you through formulas and information in a way that makes you come to the conclusions on your own. He really helps you learn and I would STRONGLY recommend choosing him if you have the option.

Professor McGovern made the class easy and fun to learn! The workload is manageable, and the exams are relatively easy as long as you study and do the practice exam - plus side: he lets you bring a cheat sheet before his test. Easy A as long as you put in the effort! Highly recommend taking this class with him.

Very good class. Very long homework and it is actually worth something. Tests are somewhat easy. Does make class do a project that is very interesting but extremely time consuming. Overall really good teacher and person. Would take a class with him again 100%.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor McGovern is the reason why I made a rate my professor account. The course is relatively tough, but thanks to his explanations and the homework he assigns it becomes very manageable. As long as you put in the work you will get a A, also he allows cheat sheets for his tests and exams.

Prof. McGovern is the best professor I've had so far. He is really effective at communicating important things and gives you lots of chances to get your grade up. As long as you work hard you can absolutely get an A in his class.

Prof. McGovern makes it easy to participate in class with real world examples that make the homework more manageable. He is very helpful when you ask questions in class because he wants everyone to be given the same chance to do well. He is without a doubt the best professor I have had at Northeastern.

Prof. McGovern is very helpful, caring, and would always get back to you in a timely manner. He does a great job linking the course materials to real-world applications and I also find the exposure to SPSS in his class has become very helpful in my later studies. Homework is straight-forward and helps succeed exams. I would highly recommend him!

Professor McGovern was a great and caring teacher. He always went out of the way to help us and did his best in helping us learn the material. His exams aren't super hard as you can use cheat sheets, and we do a lot of prep from homework, even though the amount of homework is a lot. Classes are a bit boring sometimes. I would recommend taking him.
Really enjoyed this class. Material was relevant and he emphasized important parts.  Good examples and practice for exams.

Good guy. you'll do well in his class if you pay attention to lectures and take notes. lets you have a sheet of copy paper filled with notes for all 3 exams(extra page per exam). Made stats do-able for  someone who isn't math-oriented.

Professor McGovern is probably the best professor I have had at Northeastern. He truly cares about his students and how well they do throughout the course and even after the course is over. His lectures are very informative and he does a great job of applying statistics to the real world. He is an overall great person and great professor.

BEST professor I've ever had. This is the first review I have ever done on here and I really feel bad that I haven't given him a review yet because he is that amazing. He really cares about his students and will continue too after the course is over. Extremely inspirational humble, and smart. One of the best people I know and others feel the same.

He goes above and beyond for his students, I had a conflict where I couldn't take take an exam because I was out of state trying to secure a co-op, and he let me take the exam a different day (against his policy) because "he really wanted me to get the job," he followed up several times asking if I had gotten it, and he's just a genuine good person

He'll give you all the tools you need to get a good grade and really learn statistics and it's real life applications. The classes are very straight forward and he covers every single topic on the syllabus clearly. You will also use some Excel and learn how to use SPSS. You can make your own cheat sheets and he will be always willing to help you.

Seamus is amazing, one of the easiest and most generous professors I've ever had. Listen to what he says in class and go over the homework, problems on the exam are very easy, he is definitely worth it. 1 group project, participation/attendance and homework matter.

Professor McGovern was my favorite professor throughout grad school. His lectures were clear and he made it easy to learn the material. Most of all he was accessible, patient and respectful of students needs.
Clear and precise. Online lectures were good. Would take his class again.
Took his class in statistics and he was a great professor. If you participate every class, the tests an quiz will be really easy.

Very easy A. Lectures can be long and sometimes boring, but homework is easy (I often did half of it and received a hundred?). Ability to make your own cheat sheets make tests easy as well. He cares about his students success and overall is a great professor. Highly recommend.

I enjoyed everything I learned in his class not only because stats is interesting, but mainly because he is a fantastic professor who makes it interesting. He is my favorite professor I've had in college so far. I have so many amazing things I'd like to say, but not enough space to say it all in. Just take his class and see for yourself!

He is the best professor I had in my fall semester. He designs the class so you learn without focusing so much on the grade because that will come if you follow his instructions. I can truly say that I learned and got a lot of takeaways from his class. Sometimes the lectures are tedious, but it's because he explains the material step by step.

He is really nice guy and cares about his students. He knows what he's talking about. The class is boring and sometimes he uses awkward examples, but he is always looking to help you. Easy class overall, expect homework since it's around 20% of your final grade. Also, TA's homework grading policy is questionable.

The textbook readings aren't too long, but it's important that you go to class. He goes over the readings and clarifies what you need to know. He is a laid-back person so there is no stressful atmosphere in his class. There's weekly homework assignments that take some time, but are beneficial. Overall, I believe he is a good stat professor.
Prof McGovern is willing to help students .

He is a very nice person, you can  get feedback from him very soon. Knowledgeable and knows a lot about Stats. The lectures and homework are long, but tests are easy, the project is also not too hard.

Very helpfulapproachable, speaking to him and participation is a bonus. VERY knowledgable about Statistics. Gives an easy project at the end that can boost your grade. Although lectures and homework are long. Tests are easy, always had grades in the 80s-90s. The class was very applicablehelpful while I was interning this summer.

He's a nice guy and wants to help but his lectures are just boring. The powerpoints are endless and the homework every week takes several hours to complete. Not very helpful, kind of vague when answering questions. Knows a lot about stats but the class is really boring. Tests aren't bad, midterm grades: 82, 95, 98

Really nice guy. He tries to be helpful, but he's a really confusing professor. You basically have to teach yourself when you take stats with him. His tests are pretty easy though and he tells you basically what you need to know to do well.
Lectures were confusing. You have to study on your own.

AVOID at all costs. He's possibly the worst professor I've had NEU. Uses powerpoints, that he didn't even take the time to make. Rarely writes on the board or clearly explains things. Seriously, avoid if you can.
Great guy, knowledgable about stats but recommend him to teach another course. TA grades homework way too harsh though.

I will NOT recommend this professor at all. This professor does not have any skills of teaching, the way he teach is unbelievable, even he does not care if you understand or not. Several times students asked him a question, he does not know the answer, in addition he said any help!!! he is not willing to answer or at least to have it on next class.

Charn is literally the best professor I've had in my now 6 years of college. He's an incredible mentor, and he cares about your learning and development more than your grade or his pay. I wish I could take another course with him.

Leadership was an easy, but incredibly worthwhile course.
This class was not only an extremely fun class but out of all my classes at NAU this class easily taught me the most. This is a must take class trust.

Charn is a great guy and one of the best profs I have had at Nau. He cares for his students and makes sure all of the work is necessary and teaches a good lesson. there aren't tests but some reading quizzes. 100% recommend taking this class with him!

Professor McAllister is an awesome professor. There are readings each week with a reading quiz, but the quiz is not hard and the readings are great (and usually short). All the assignments are due at the end of the semester, so you just have to get on them early, but they are creative assignments and are not hard to do. Great class overall.

One of my favorite teachers ever! Very project focused and he does not do a lesson if he does not think it is valuable for his students. He gets cool guest speakers (EVEN DURING COVID) and has amazing personal leadership examples that he follows through with in how he teaches. I would take any subject from him assured that he would make it amazing.

Prof McAllister is a really genuine and fun guy. Lectures were interesting and he always asked for student feedback so he could tailor it to what we actually wanted to do/topics we were more interested in. He's always avail outside of class and actually enjoys helping students and encouraging them. Super great professor. Def take him if you can!

Charn is probably the best professor I've had at Northeastern. From day one you can tell he cares about his students and works to make learning as enjoyable as possible. He connects well with his class and lectures can be pretty informal. Instead of textbooks you read actual books about management and philosophy. I would recommend him x100

If you could duplicate one Professor and have him teach any class at any school - you'd duplicate Charn. He's incredibly smart, experienced, driven, and open to hearing new and radical ideas. Definitely hasn't ceased to impress me.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: One of the nicest & most respectable people Ive ever met (not just professors, people). The class is incredibly fun, dynamic, and you learn a ton. He treats you as an equal and Id argue his teaching style is unrivaled at NEU.

Exceptional professor who comes to class ready to teach and engages the class in great discussions. Knowledgable and friendly, he is approachable and dedicated. The class is not too hard, and the fact that it is very interesting almost makes it easier. I was recommended him by someone else, and I would absolutely recommend him to anyone else.
Highly recommended, amazing professor! A genuinely good person. He really cares about everyone and clearly enjoys teaching this class. Take his class if you have the chance you wouldn't regret it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Would take again

reviews.comment: Took online version it was extremely easy would recommend if looking for a chill async class. With it being async, I will say communication for assignments was poor and would wait way too long for feedback on assignments. Harsh grader on essays. Would respond within a day to emails which was nice.
just don't if you want an easy course
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This was the 2nd class I took with Prof McCarthy and I know she has mixed reviews but I truly love her. If you want to learn, take her class. If you want to sleep through class and skate by for an easy A, don't take her. She has many years of teaching experience and I truly think she takes her TRACE evals to heart and is always improving.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: At all costs do not take this class with McCarty. She is the absolute worst at giving clear directions and then proceeds to grade like her life depends on it. Gives extremely vague feedback and offers no opportunities to improve your grade. Literally any other professor is better than her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Do not take Professor McCarty if you want an easy class. She is definitely a tough grader and assigns a lot (4 big papers within the first month, 2 big group projects) plus a tough and long final exam. However, outside of class, she is really awesome. If you are willing to put in work and are not looking for an easy way out, I would recommend.
Amazing professor, really cares about pedagogy. Awesome assignments that have lessons outside of business. Was the perfect application of theory before my graduation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed the class and thought that it was very interesting. That being said, I don't think that this is an 'easy' class by any means. If you go to class, participate and put effort into the assignments, you will do great! The professor is caring and provides good feedback however don't expect easy As.

I loved McCarty. The class was easy and she was insanely caring. People who say they didn't learn a lot and it's all common sense most likely say that because the content is not relevant to their future career (valid argument). The class is required and you have to take it with someone. It's absolute best case scenario to take it with McCarty!!

Class is common sense, but Professor McCarty puts in great effort to make it engaging. There are a lot of papers and group projects and she is a tough grader, but is also very reasonable and accessible outside class. Feedback is thorough and improvements based on past feedback are noticed and rewarded.  Final is weighted very aggressively (30%).

Felt like I was taking a 5th grade class in college. The teacher is one of the tougher graders that I have had at Northeastern, very bias at what she wants the students to write. Am not sure why this class is a mandatory class for Northeastern students, I did not get much out of it at all.

I took Paulette for Intro to Business fall 2021 semester. She is an amazing teacher! In all honesty this class was not hard. It was personally challenging because the entire class was surrounded around creating a business and presenting for three demo days and one final presentation. To pass this class, just show up and participate!
If you want to listen to her ramble for 50 minutes and have almost a third of your grade be in participation be my guest.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The majority of the course is based on the TJX project and she chooses her favorite group to get an A, and the rest have to try and get a B or C. Not very helpful if you need help on the project even though it is worth so much. You learn nothing in class since lectures are mostly just her talking about her family.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof. McCarty is very nice and cheerful and makes her classes fun and interesting. HOWEVER the workload is ridiculous and she is a REALLY tough grader. Would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: WOULD NOT recommend. really tough grader, instructor did not positively encourage student feedback. if a student gave a wrong answer, she would say no, no no. did not use time efficiently, poor teaching methods. talks too much about history rather than business. ITS a required BUSINESS class

One big midterm exam.  She is such a hard grader though.  Great professor and does make class fun, I will give her that.  But if you are trying to take org b for an easy A... this is not the professor you want.

Professor McCarty is one of the nicest professors I've had at Northeastern. She was always cheery and funny, even at 8am on a Monday. The biggest grade in the class is a massive group project (all sections have to do), she grades this tougher than any other professor. Participation is 20%, only gives "a handful" of students an A for it.
Great professor. Very helpful in preparation of the final presentation worth 15% of your grade for the semester. Take this class
Worst ever, not only academically, also personally. Always tries to make your answers look wrong. Avoid.

In a subject that has a lot of different interpretations, this professor had a "my way or highway" policy. No professional experience to bring to class, and doesn't allow for student interpretation of theories.
If you want grey hair like hers take this class.  She has unrealistic expectations about the outcome of the class and thrives off her tenure instead of teaching.

Literally the worst teacher I've had at Northeastern.. no idea how they've let her get away with teaching this class for so long when she is absolutely awful.. actually told our class that we should aim to get a c in the class because they means you are performing at an average level. DO NOT TAKE THIS WITH HER

One of the worst teachers I have ever had. Completely ridiculous policies and is not worth paying to take her class. Her reading assignments and frequent quiz/tests are redundant. Unfortunately she does not teach you however makes you read instead. In addition her text books are not cohesive.

Professor McCarty was my favorite professor for my first semester at Northeastern. She is super helpful, but you must put in effort and approach her if you need help. She cares about her students, and she's a really great teacher.

She is such a stereotype. This class is stupid and boring. Spending 1 hour listening the nonsense three days a week is killing me. She just try so hard to let her students become one of the fab4 that can keep her reputation. I just hate her.

Just stay away with her!! She is arrogant and useless. I just cant figure out why Northeastern hire her. This class is stupid. If you get on her side and kiss up to her, you will be totally safe, otherwise, you will be screwed. She is the teacher I hate most in my freshmen yr.

Excellent textbook and choice of case studies. Graduate level MBA course so expect to study hard. Feedback is weak. Speaks to what you failed to do rather than confirming you're on right track. A bit arrogant. Little direction.

Mccarty helps you with the business plan- the main part of your grade- throughout the semester. You must prove yourself to her- if you work your ass off, its going to pay off :) shes a great teacher, helped me so much.. do your textbook reading for quizzes. all in all, she will reward you when you work hard.

You have to do more than what she expected. You'll do a business plan and she'll help you out all the way. Read the assigned readings and you have to really understand the reading. She really cares for you though. She will help you fix the presentaion to make it the perfect presentation. This is not an easy class.

She is horrible. Fo r the first 5 or so quizzes atleast 5 people would go up to her asking why they got a question wrong. She would basically just say "because" even though they had answered the question correctly. BAD TEACHER.
A lot of work to get an A and a hard grader. Liked the course content for the most part.  No exams, just daily quizzes and cases.
she is a good professor, just do the readings and you will be fine. must go to class. group papers arent that difficult. and participate. also agree with her on papers.

BY FAR the best intro to business teacher. Two years in a row, two teams from her class have made the final four. And the year before the past two, three of the final four teams were from her class. She knows exactly what she wants and never tries to screw you. If you have a good idea, she'll fight for you until the death. You want her as a teacher

I disagree with all the other comments on McCarty and Into to Business.  You don't do much work (one presentation, quizzes on every reading and speaker, and one written plan) and she helps you out the entire way.  Other Intro classes really had a lot of trouble....and you can get an A if you don't make the final four....

Without a doubt the best professor you can get for intro to business. Professor McCarty is on top of this class and cares so much about her students succeeding. Her criticisms are blunt and valuable. I came out of this short class learning so much.

Had her for introduction to business in Fall of 07.  AMAZING teacher.  If you care about class or even life in general (as most kids don't) she will be a perfect match for you.  I was the first general studies "FAB 4" team to win, and she by far helped us get there.  McCarty for US President '08

People give her a bad rep, and I definitely went into it dreading the class- but the class is extremely straightforward- do the readings, work hard on the papers, participate and you'll get an A. It's worth it to make the effort because she is fair. The class is pretty interesting also- so that helps. Go in with a good attitude, and you'll do well.

This class was so much work. She is either 100% supportive of what you have to say about a topic, or she is exactly the opposite. The benefit of the class is that there are no exams. However, you have a group paper to write every week or 2, and a quick every class or 2. Apparently she only gives A's to 4 kids in each class, you will get a B.

really awful class. She pretty much just craps on any thinking outside of hers. The group work is absolutely terrible and it is all you do. Quizzes every class. Attendance is also taken so beware. Do not take this class if you do not have to.
Try and you get an A, don't and you get a B. You don't need the textbook, just borrow someone else's. She doesn't really teach so much as critiques the slides and your work.

I dont know what everyone else was talking about, Professor McCarty told everyone what the class entailed in the beginning of the semister.  Those who went to office hours and actualy listened to her advice recieve good grades.  She threatens quizes but only gives about 3 the entire semister.  Overall a great teacher and i learned alot from her.

I wonder how this woman got hired by Northeastern. What are her credentials...I would like to know. Openly scorns out-of-the-box thinking and believes there are very precise answers to objective problems. Not smart and very narrow minded. Show up and you will get a B.
The class is a joke. Any middle school kid could teach it. Do nothing and you will get B.
You only use the textbooks twice, three times max throughout the semester. Unless you make it to the fab 4, you will get a B.
Very rude and not good at explaining things. She thinks she's best professor in school. Do nothing and you will pass the class with B.

PSYCHOTIC.  If you get on her good side and kiss up then you will get good grades, otherwise expect a C or lower.  In 5 years at Northeastern, I have never encountered such an AWFUL judgemental professor.

DO NOT BUY TEXT BOOK!  You never use it.  Professor does help you along the way with editing your work and giving you suggestions before you hand them in.  She can get on your nerves but she is helpful.

Lady is a piece of work, DO NOT BUY TEXT BOOK, you never use it, it's a waste of money n u can't return it, you don't learn anything from her, you have to teach yourself EVERYTHING, i've heard it gets worse than her, but if u take this class be prepared to teach yourself everything
Her grading has is totally based on what she thinks you should get.  sucks! grades should be earned by doing work an knowing the material not by someone's opinion.

overall good teacher, very understanding (called me out on falling asleep in class but when i explained to her how much work i had she laughed and said she understood), though a lot of us thought that she graded the final project too hard.

just dont do it. like everyone else said, she's not that helpful and screws you with the grading. your grade is mostly the tjx project, and even people who do literally NOTHING get the same grade as you, even if you tell her so in your peer review. my advice: be the guy that does nothing, you'll still get a B-

Interesting class. The grading really sucks. Class participation is a big part of the grade yet there is no way she can remember. She grades unfairly. Take it if u are ok with a B or B+ and learn more than usual while getting your insulted for not knowing something.
one word for you people: no
just bad

Terrible. She's extremely rude and makesd you feel stupid and insignificant. She's a hard and unfair grader. It seems that she just gives everyone B's to save herself time. Since this class is a requirement TAKE IT WITH ANOTHER TEACHER!

I felt that i learned alot through the course of the classes, but the downside is that she gave the constant impression that we were doing and we were doing extremley well. The end of the semester rolls around and my entire group got B's including one member that did NOTHING which she knew about. So much for peer evaluations.

i really hated her, she was rude to our class often and i just couldn't stand how stupid the class was!!! i do not suggest her, always talking about how we had to get to the final four, and how good she was and how terrible we were, but news flash, WE ARE A REFLECTION ON YOU MCCARTY

Ok. I am being so honest here. If she doesn't like what you write in your hmrk assignments, get ready to get a 2.5/5 on all of them. 2.5 is her fav. number. Be ready for pop quizzes. If she tells you there will be 3 all semester...that really means you will have 5. AND DO NOT HAND IN STUFF LATE. she won't take it nomatter what!

If McCarty "bashed" anyone's work, it must've really sucked, because she's very clear in what she wants and what's expected in the Final Four. I know that McCarty's classes' powerpoints and business plans are more thorough and better than any other classes'. She is so nice and loves teaching, it's awesome. I really liked having her as my professor.

I have personally found her to be absolutley rude to my class on several occasions, bashing our work and being mean, so i would not recomend her, i liked her at first, but now i see that she is completley two faced
Prof. McCarty often speaks in a condescending tone to my class. Most students find their student consultants more helpful on the "big project" -at least, they are more approachable.
Really helpful, very clear, and really loves teaching :)

Very tough grader. You need to keep up with the reading and papers. She is looking for specific points within the cases. She gives a quiz almost every class. Nice teacher however you need to be on the same level as her to succeed.

Awesome teacher - really cares and loves her students! Makes it a point to personally know her students.  Class isnt difficult - based mostly on business plan presentation at end.  Project takes a lot of time but isnt too bad - just dont wait until the last minute!
Awesome teacher, very clear and helpful - makes class a lot of fun.

This teacher is nice and straightfoward.  The class is pretty easy, but your entire grade is based on one group project, which stinks.  She doesn't help enough with the project.  It's an okay class, and you have to take it anyways.
This teacher is a total freak. It's impossible to pass on their grading system and you can't learn a thing thanks to their teaching style.

barely had to do any work in this class for summer I.  no midterm, no final. all based on 2 page short assignments you do on readings throughout the term. participation counts so make sure you talk a lot.
really weird grading style.  gave everyone an 85, and added/subtracted depending on hw and quizzes.  LOTS of work... she seemed pretty biased to the kids who talked a lot.
Awesome teacher. Really loves her students and teaching. Very helpful and dedicated to making sure you know what you are doing.
awsome class.  she's smart and funny.

Really nice and really cool teacher.  She's very chill aobut most things.  She cancels class a lot too.  The only bad things about her is that you feel that you don't get your money's worth in the class you barely learn anything.
She's on the level.  Good class.
Great teacher, always helpfull.  I learned more in this class than I have in any class for years.  The drawback is her class is hard, but it's worth it.
So cool.  Not much work.  Easy to talk to and very helpful.
Amazing professor.  Well educated on subject material.  Fun aspects about teaching style.  Willing to help at all times.

I don't know why the course code isn't selectable, but I took ARTF 1220 with Jose. He's very energetic and very excitable and engaging about his work. Especially typography. He doesn't care if your there in class or not, and will give you good grades and good feedback as long as you do the work.

very charismatic, energetic morning person. somehow Jose made 8am classes fun (I am NOT a morning person) and as long as you do the work he will give you very good feedback. highly recommend, and hope i take another class with him again!

Super passionate charismatic guy. There was a lot of work at the beginning of the semester, but it got built in as part of the process. He's had an interesting career and is knowledgeable in design and various tools.

Jose is one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern. His class allows you to explore your interests and gives you the design tools to showcase them. He gives great feedback and sets you up for success. He helped me build the foundation of my design career and single-handedly gave me the confidence to continue my degree!!
He's a fantastic designer- and lots of fun. Expects a lot, but worth it.

She is SO passionate about sociology. I wish she wasn't teaching a NUPath course, because most people (including myself) are not that passionate about sociology and just do other work in class. Your grade is based off of 3 MCQ tests and attendance. All she does is lecture, she made me wish I was a bit more passionate about sociology haha.
Yes great class!! She's genuinely a really kind professor, and she cares about making sure everyone understands what is happening in class. Also, very interesting material was taught as well.

Rachel is a great professor. She is super nice and understanding. Her class is lecture heavy but, she gives a break in the middle. There are only 3 exams including the final, all multiple choice and the final isn't cumulative. Really pay attention to the lectures and do the readings. Lots of extra credit (up to a 7% boost in your grade).
Super passionate and kind woman. The lectures are v engaging and interesting and she gives a ton of extra credit. There are only 3 exams (including the final) and it is not cumulative.

Professor Meyer was a great professor. Only 3 quizzes and gives extra credit to boost your grade by 5%. The quizzes are exactly what the slides and lectures cover. There are readings every week, but they prepare you for her lectures. Her class is very engaging and interesting.
She's really passionate about the things she talks about which rlly helps you get through the long lectures lol. highly recommend taking her!!

Rachel is very kind and loves to talk to students. Looking over the assigned textbook chapters is a good way to make sure you are keeping up, but just taking notes during class is enough to do well on the exams. Exams are pretty straight forward, she gives a lot of extra credit and her grading system is to your benefit.

This has been my favorite professor thus far. Her teaching style is incredible. She will explain the same concept in numerous ways to ensure your learning style aligns with one of the explanations. She is approachable and makes class interesting. You must study for the tests and take notes, but they are not tricky. I recommend her highly.
She gives A TON of extra credit. Def more work than other sections but not hard at all.

One of the best classes I've taken at Northeastern. She is an amazing professor—super passionate about the subject and genuinely wants students to care and understand it. You learn a lot, but it never feels overwhelming because she explains everything so well. Readings are reasonable and well chosen. Would absolutely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very intelligent and great teacher who is very very clear about what you need to succeed in the class and provides you with all of the resources and materials to do so. Will assign a good amount of readings but SPECIFIES PAGES and paragraphs so you don't have to read entire chapters, and all readings are super helpful for tests. easy to succeed

it's nice to see how passionate professor meyer is about sociology. it makes lectures very enjoyable and easy to follow along to. her exams are very straightforward. if you show up to lecture and do the readings (not graded), you're guaranteed a good grade. i can't recommend her enough!
Just somewhat pay attention and understand the course material and you will do great!

Prof. Meyer was great! The class was a piece of cake and she gave many opportunities for extra credit even though your main grade is comprised of 3 equally weighted tests. Lectures were straightforward and as long as you took notes on that and skimmed the textbook you were fine.

Heavy on in class lecture and material is straight forward once you understand his teaching style. Homework prepares u for the mid-term and final. If you do the practice exams he provides, have a good note sheet, there is no way you can't pass the class. He also sets up individual meetings post-midterm to give you feedback so, he cares for students

By far the worst professor I've had in northeastern's cive department. Not only are his exams long and difficult, he is rude in class and makes students feel bad for asking questions. I regret taking this class

he is a very nice man and very knowledgeable, he wants you to do well. he sets office hours up based on the students schedule and gives many opportunities to ask questions and seek help. exams are okay, there are only two, but they are open book/note and he gives practice materials that very closely reflect the actual exam. good prof and good class

It's a tough class, but he does a great job explaining things. If you ask questions he'll always clarify things, and he does really care about his student's success. The exams are tough and worth most of your grade, but he lets you know exactly what's on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sasani doesn't answer questions. Its just not his style. You'll get yelled at for asking a question. 80% of your grade is 2 exams. Each exam has two questions. Miss one question? You've just lost %20 of you entire course grade. Didn't understand something in class? Well he doesn't have any notes or resources online, and the textbook is useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great professor who sets his lectures up well for each topic so that they are easy to follow and cover main concepts well. HWs are given regularly that cover everything very well and set you up perfectly for exams. Exams are also open notes so make sure to pay attention in class & that ur notes are good. Cover hws well & exams are straight forward!
she a sweetheart fr luh thus woman

I actually took this class last Spring. Such a sweetheart. Her class discussions are such a blast if you're willing to participate and she really cares about her students as people. What I remember from this class isn't the assignments but how I'd look forward to coming in and talking to her.

I loved Meredith! She is one of my favorite journalism professors. She really cares about her students and is really charming. You will learn a lot — she is great at teaching the foundations of journalism that every good and passionate journalist should know.

I ABSOLUTELY ADORE THIS PROFESSOR. She's such a baddie, and her class is my favorite this semester by a long shot. If you need a DD NUpath class TAKE THIS ONE. The way she presents journalism and real world issues in an engaging and digestible way is so fantastic, the class is also super easy, almost no homework. Cannot say enough good things!

She is just wonderful. Very knowledgeable and kind. Very interesting class content. She is very well rounded and intelligent. She is willing to always work with you and help you out. Love this class and this prof so much, probably my favorite professor ever.

One of the best teachers at this school. She's very caring, fair in her grading, and overall runs a great class. Not too much writing for being a journalism class. If the class is running, highly recommend taking it with her. Good nupath class as well.

Professor O'Brien is very passionate about journalism and provides great feedback and response to students' thoughts and ideas. There was a lot of material to read and analyze, both for in-class discussions and 5-7 page essay assignments. She does count for attendance and appreciates participation in discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: She really cares about journalism and truly wants to see you grow as a writer. If you enjoy writing, which I assume you must to take this class, it should be easy and even fun. Her grading criteria was a bit unclear, but as long as you consider her feedback it should be fine. Genuinely learned a lot about journalism and writing in this class.
She's awesome! Professor clearly enjoys her job and grades very fairly. I learned a lot in the class!

Definitely my favorite professor at Northeastern so far. She is super caring and her class is not too difficult if you put some effort into the essays. The class is graded mostly on four 5-7 page essays, which O'Brien genuinely wants her students to succeed in. She has lots of practice in the field and is a great person to talk to.
Classes were just discussion, participation is mandatory, there were required readings for each class but you can easily get away with not reading them

have her for phil3435. she's a great lecturer, but she does not answer emails. almost never. doesn't have a very clear grading criteria for assignments, and she's a tough grader on top of that. again, great lecturer and super kind, but not communicative and its unclear what she's looking for in assingments
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Took PHIL3435 but would take any class with Meica. Really a 'get out what you put in' kind of professor, you could get away with not doing readings but they're interesting and make class better. Would also highly recommend speaking with her outside of class; she gives thoughtful and helpful feedback for writing.
Professor Magnani did a great job of lecturing and synthesizing dense readings into compelling slides/discussion. I had her for Moral Philosophy and would recommend taking her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: understanding prof, fascinating class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Magnani is a super sweet professor. Always willing to help and talk to students outside of class. Participation is mandatory but she understands anxiety about public speaking if you speak to her.

Meica is amazing. Her class was super interesting, and she is very passionate and knowledgeable. The in-class discussion is great, but you do have to participate, and she keeps track of both participation and attendance. There is a lot of group work in this class. I would recommend any class she teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Magnani is an incredible lecturer and her class truly change the way I think about moral philosophy and virtue ethics. The class has a TON of reading that is very hard to keep up on, so be aware.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is super nice and a really good lecturer! However, the amount of reading that is expected is quite laughable. I know by the end that about 10% of the class was actually doing it. Despite not reading I learned a lot and always looked forward to class!
Lots of writing with homework due every Friday. Minimal guidance was given in the Canvas modules

By far the best teacher I have taken at Northeastern and could not recommend enough. Came into the class nervous about writing, but made the classes fun and engaging while also giving clear criteria on how to succeed in his class. Take if you have the chance you will not regret.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I have never done one of these, but feel the need to do one now. Professor Mellette is the nicest guy and wants to see you succeed. Classes are super engaging and fun. I am not a fan of writing, but Professor Mellette made me enjoy every second of it. Plus, the man is hilarious. Please take!
GOAT! So nice and shows he cares. Gives you two 24 hours extensions no questions. Is super accommodating!  Has clear expectations and is awesome!!

An absolute gem of a prof. Keeps the class feeling lighthearted and chill but teaches you plenty. I went into this class feeling like I didn't have much to learn in the subject but he very much proved me wrong and helped me grow even more.
