Dr. Mellette is a king and a half. He is insanely accommodating and gives amazing feedback when grading papers. He very clearly cares about the content and he consistently facilitates engaging discussions on relevant readings. My only qualm is that he's a little awkward lol. Would recommend!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Great professor and this was an interesting class. Grade is based on five online multiple choice exams. Great lecturer with interesting material. One of my favorite teachers I've had.

An amazing professor! I would gladly take another course with him. His exams are based directly on lecture material, so attending and engaging in class is essential for success. He presents complex topics in a clear and accessible way, and his lectures are consistently engaging and thought-provoking.

Melloni was amazing and this class was great. It's an easy A (tests are online, open note, take-at home) and the material is not too rigorous because tests are online. I definitely recommend taking this class along some other harder ones, it doesn't require much outside work, but still interesting to learn about.

Prof Melloni is definitely one of the better professors I have had at NU. He makes neuroanatomy a bit more easy to understand, and is extremely receptive to questions and repeating things if the class doesn't understand. Your grade is just 5 online open note exams (20% each) and he drops the lowest one.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easy A. Class is what you make it. 5 tests, all ONLINE (open note)... do with that info what you will, No HW, also drops lowest test grade. Attendance was never taken. Very good class to choose if you are taking other hard classes and want a lighter work load with this one. If you want to actually learn though, you have to lock in for it. SO chill.

Amazing and knowledgeable professor. He makes neuroanatomy which can be really difficult, easy to understand. He also uses many analogies and anecdotes in class to help us retain the information better.
Amazing amazing prof and person. Lectures were interesting and engaging. Your grade is made up of 5 open-note online tests. Is flexible and understanding, open to rounding grades. Take him!!!

Melloni was great for neuroanatomy. Our tests were take-home, which saves you for this class, because it would have been so much harder otherwise. Exams weren't too bad (the spinal cord one was the worst), he posts almost all the lectures on Canvas, and I think he ended up dropping the lowest exam grade. Grade is made up of only 5 exams.

Really interesting class. The only thing is that you are graded by only exams--no other assignments. This means if you do badly on one, you're cooked (happened to me :( ). I also found one or two of the exams pretty difficult. Overall, would recommend, just lock in and don't neglect studying!

You can tell he really likes the subject when he's teaching and he explains complicated concepts in a really clear way!! Your grade just depends on how well you do on your exams but your exams are all online AND multiple choice/matching!

actually the goat. he simplified neuroanatomy down so well, which is def not an easy task. attendance isn't mandatory and he does post zoom recordings of his lectures, but i would still go to class or watch the recordings because the lectures are super helpful. grade is made up of 5 exams, he ended up dropping the lowest exam score!

Best professor in the psych department and it's not even close. If you're a pre-med major you need to take his class. He teaches all 3 major BNS courses - biopsych, psychopharm, and neuroanatomy. Great lectures, actually cares about the students, and tests are online take home (still difficult though). Makes even the hardest topics make sense. Goat

Prof Melloni honestly made me even more passionate about neuroscience and medicine than before. He taught in medical school and is amazing at simplifying complex neuroanatomy topics. 5 exams all taken online/open note but they can be difficult--final is not cumulative. He really cares about his students and almost everyone loves his classes. 10/10

Melloni is the goat. All tests online, take-home, and if you go to class you'll do just fine. He does a great job breaking down the hardest units into simple terms. And he teaches the big 3- Neuro, Psychopharm, and Biopsych.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: TAKE HIM!!!

TAKE THIS CLASS best teacher i've ever had the lectures are so interesting he knows EVERYTHING about neuroscience and the content we do is really interesting. theres 4 or 5 exams over the semester that are only on the recent topic you did (not cumulative) and they are online. the exam average is usually a 90. TAKE THIS CLASS ITS THE BEST THING EVER

Attendance is mandatory if you want to do well, he is a phenomenal professor and I have learned so much from him! He is hilarious, interesting, and engaging. His exams can be scary but you just have to study hard and write questions for him as you review, because he will answer them very thoroughly and always help you when you need it!

Dr. Melloni is one of the best professors I've ever had, his lectures are very interesting and he perfectly breaks concepts down so that they're better understood. Your grade is entirely dependent on 5 take home open note tests and he is likely to drop your lowest of the 5, plus your "final" isn't cumulative its simply the last test.

Professor Melloni is a great lecturer! He explains neuro in detail and goes over and over challenging topics. Great at answering questions. Lectures almost always end early bc some of the material is heavy. 5 exams including the final that's not cumulative. Ended up dropping the lowest grade. All exams are mc, online, open note but time-limited.

Melloni is the man!! Genuinely a GOOD lecturer. Grades are entirely the average of five multiple-choice exams on Canvas, and the final is just the 5th exam. Would give points back if he felt an exam question wasn't fair. Likes to end classes early too. Take his class if you actually want to learn something and also get an A without too much effort!
Good lectures and nice guy. Four online tests about 40-60 questions each. Exams had some tricker questions but overall not bad. The content was very interesting
Psychopharmacology: 4 online exams (open note + book). Some questions are from textbook readings, not in lectures. 50-60 question exams in a little over an hour (but final was 2 hours).

I had Melloni for 3 classes, clinical neuro, biopsych, and psychopharm. I loved him for every one of these classes. He's such a funny guy, and will answer any question with enthusiasm. For all these classes, he had around 4-5 tests through the semester, either open note or open note + take home. No cumulative midterm or final.

Super interesting lectures + course material. Cares a lot about what he's teaching. Very funny + engaging. Questions on tests are sometimes confusing, but he goes back and gives pts back for problems a lot of ppl got wrong. Tests were all online - even final. Ends class early a lot
This class is difficult so it's important you go to all of the lectures, but Professor Melloni is truly one of the kindest, most accommodating professors I have had. Great teacher and person
Dr. Melloni is very caring and simplifies complex anatomy for the undergrad level, however is pretty unresponsive and there are errors are many tests.
Dr. Melloni does an excellent job of simplifying complex topics and makes lectures interesting, however he isn't very responsive and there were somme errors on ever test.

- 5 tests in all: all are online and you do not have to be in the room during the test

- he makes the toughest topics seem so easy

- his grading is fair: if you mess up, then it is entirely your fault

- he is reasonable with his test dates: a week after the content is done (btw it is not cumulative)

- I highly recommend him
Super passionate about what he's teaching and also very understanding. I definitely enjoyed the class

I really enjoyed taking this class with Professor Melloni. He is very passionate during his lectures and takes the time to answer questions. This class covers a lot to find what you are passionate about in psych. The only thing is your entire grade is based off of 5 exams, but you definitely feel prepared for all of them.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: professor melloni is one of the most compassionate and considerate professors i have had. he makes sure that everyone understands each topic before moving on. he opens a for students to then critique his test/teaching format to make sure we are getting the most out of the class. 5 exams, MC, online, open note, but timed so study b4. flashcards help
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: professor melloni's class was super fun. grade is determined by 4 exams. exams are all multiple choice and not hard as long as you go to class and take notes. he does offer extra credit for participation, so make sure to ask questions during class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor melloni is such a great lecturer, makes sure we understand the material and willing to go in depth with any questions we had Goes over clinical applications of everything (he taught medical students) Passionate about the course material Tests are fair and he boosts your final grade if you participate a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Had Spring 2020, so half online. Only graded by tests, which are 65 multiple choice questions and included info from the textbook as well. Overall vibe: good guy, wants you to succeed, has some favorites but u can go unnoticed if u want, jokes around, has a lab & teaches medical students. A LOT of information. Have a good note-taking system.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Melloni was great. Tests won't trick you if you are prepared (read the book to clarify power points) and is fair about giving points back if most of the class struggled on a question or two. He drops the lowest exam grade which wasn't on the syllabus. Overall, I would take a class with him again and recommend him to others.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Melloni is by far my most favorite teacher that I've taken. His powerpoint lectures are very straight forward and clear, and the discussions in class are very knowledgable. He's pretty funny, and as long as you go to class, you should at least get a B or higher. His tests are straightforward with no trick questions, but still hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: His tests are not very fair, sometimes they are on very minor details he skimmed in class, and he rounds down. However, I did learn a lot and I don't regret taking the class. If you study hard (AKA memorize the slides and read the book) then you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He will bend over backwards for a student. People saying he wont help outside of class are too timid to get the help. He treats students with the same respect that the student give to him, very much like a real world boss. go to him with specific questions and he wont let you leave his office until you 100% understand. BNS/psych: TAKE HIS CLASSES!!

The tests are not very fair. He sometimes writes questions that are clearly not covered in the slides. Also, he rounds down: if you have a 89.7 on a test, that becomes a 89. It makes a difference in the final grade.

Each lecture throws a lot of information at you, but it is presented clearly. There is a lot to learn, but Professor Melloni will answer your questions. The tests are pretty tough, you definitely have to study, but it is nothing he hasn't covered in lecture. The PowerPoints are comprehensive and the lecture notes are essential.

VERY difficult class. Dr. Melloni is not available for help, and not interested. He goes over an INSANE amount of material, and doesn't have much patience for questions. No book; material is entirely based off his PowerPoints. 3 tests per semester, and he drops the lowest score, so each of the two remaining tests  50% of your grade. NEVER AGAIN!!!
Really interesting and engaging lectures. He's super smart. Tests are straight forward, all materials from the slides. Provides slides with great notes. Fun class.

Your entire grade is based off 3 exams, but then he drops the lowest grade so it's really 2 EXAMS... 50% each. That's just insane. I feel bad for all the other people like me who get test anxiety and don't perform well that way. Hardest class, but coolest material. Fascinating! I suggest getting a tutor... don't expect ANY help from him at ALL.
Amazing professor and a great guy. Fascinating material. He always made the extra effort to answer someone's question and made sure the class understood. His tests were straightforward.

Great teacher! Really enthusiastic and knowledgeable. He really gets the class involved and tries to make lectures engaging. He doesn't use a textbook and everything from the slides are on the tests. I would highly recommend him!
Loved the class. Interesting material. Easy tests. Eliminates questions no one gets right. No book. Explains everything in depth. I would take another class with him in a second.

LOVED THIS CLASS! If anyone is really interested in the biology part of psychology take this class. Professor Melloni is an amazing professor and makes the class extremely interesting. HIGHLY recommend this class.

He is a great professor! He doesn't use a textbook, so you have to go to class to get the notes. He makes his powerpoints available online so you can print them out. He answers all questions very clearly and makes sure that people are understanding the material as class goes on. He lets you out early most of the time, too! :)

Very interesting class although the first sections can be boring. One thing I found is that although this class is HUGE at 200+ students, Melloni manages it very well and engages the entire class with a conversation-style lecture. Exams could be a bit tough but are manageable and he's very helpful if you need any sort of clarification.
Great class, the information is interesting and Melloni is engaging when he teachers, made me want to go to class. He clearly knows what he's talking about.  Highly recommend!

Easy class. I skipped most of the lectures and did very well. You just need to memorize the slides he asks you to print out. Don't ask dumb questions. He's also very hard to get a hold of so if you have a question ask him after class.

He is very passionate about what he teaches and definitely knows his stuff. There's no textbook, so you need to show up to class. I tend to fall asleep when he goes off on a tangent because someone asked irrelevant questions, but the information is very interesting, so it's great most of the time.

One of my favorite classes at Northeastern! Professor Melloni knows just about everything about Psychobiology but he can be a little condesending if you ask stupid questions, don't come to class, or aren't paying attention. I loved his teaching style, no textbook and the students print out his slides to bring to class and take notes on.

Really interesting class. It's straight forward and pure memorization. I loved having no text book. Melloni knows a lot about neuroscience and makes it very evident. He's a good guy, I envy his knowledge. Memorize the slides and the exams will be a breeze.

He's an awesome, funny guy and he's on top of his game. He's a BIG **** if you seek help outside of class, or ask dumb questions. Essentially if you do your part, he'll do his. Don't look for an easy way out. The class is a joke if you're a BNS student. The exams are legitimately right from the slides.

Dr. Melloni is amazing. The class is really interesting, exams are a little challenging, but if you average a 94 on the first 2, you can skip the final. He is super ridiculously smart - pretty much knows everything about everything, except what happens when you eat a jalapeno..hah. There's no textbook, class only meets 2x a week, and fun lectures!

Really enjoyed going to this class and found it very interesting.  Its not the easiest class, but its worth it.  My piece of advice would be to go online and by the text book that the class is based on, it costs $2 and explains everything with color pictures.

he is okay, he makes everything really clear and is a good teacher. he is also a very busy man, who is doing tons of research so you won't get a lot of one on one time with him. his tests aren't easy but there are not surprises just make sure you know EVERYTHING on the slides
I don't have a good background in Bio which made this class challenging, but I also have never been this interested in going to class. I'm going to take all the classes he teaches.
all slides used in class are available online...tough class, but if you put in the study time you can pull off a good grade. dont need extensive background in biology

Professor is a great teacher and really funny. He'll keep you paying attention to the entire lecture, he's not boring at all. He gives you the notes, there is no textbook. You just have to understand/memorize them. His test questions are straight from the text. They are mostly multiple choice questions and a few matching. He's AWESOME!GO TO CLASS!
With a science background, easy A.  Very interesting and fun. 3 exams. Can skip final if ave of first 2 is 95. Melloni is impossible to get a hold of outside of class
This is a great class and I found dr melloni to be very clear, although some students think he goes fast. His powerpoints have everything you need to know already on them.

This class was team-taught with Lesley Ricci, and they were both great.  Very interesting, gives lots of examples.  I had zero bio background, so it was the most difficult class I have taken at NU, and he made it much easier to understand. I heard that students with bio background found it easy, though.

Really intelligent guy, he def knows what he's talking about and his lectures keep you awake.  The material itself isn't that easy but it's still really interesting, and he makes everything easy to understand.  Easy grade if you study!
This man is the love of my life hehhee but seriously... The class is great.

awesome class! SO interesting. potentially a difficult subject, but prof melloni is such an effective teacher it was a breeze. the assistant teacher that comes in a lot, lesley, is also cool. both very knowledgable and pretty funny. highly recommended!

Prof. Melloni was very straightforward, funny, and well spoken in psychobiology. I took the class as a freshman and it was still very manageable because the notes are written by him and he allows you ask any questions, etc. Also, his assistant who comes in to teach is very knowledgable in the field and offers tutoring to students who need help.

Allows you to be exempt from finals if you have an A (94) NOTHING LESS. Don't try w/a 93.5. Won't happen. But I never took a final in either of the 2 classes I had with him. Very knowledgable. Never had to find him outside of class but I hear he is a ghost. Wouldn't doubt it. But I would take him if he taught other higher courses....
He is very smart and states everything clearly. Very interesting class. I learned a lot. The tests can be hard but there are no tricky questions. Every question will be laid out in the book.

Have had him both for Psychobio and psychpharm. Although I enjoyed both classes, I felt I could have learned much more. He frequently canceled classes and let class out early by 30 mins every time. If thats something you like, then go for it, but I am actually interested in subject material and we didn't cover a lot of what he said we would. He's also very arrogant and don't ask him for a recommendation because he won't remember to send it.

Prof Melloni is an excellent teacher IN CLASS.  However, it's almost impossible to contact him outside of class (at least was my experience.)  This class is really interesting, and I learned a lot.  But when it comes to getting extra help or really anythin
enjoyed both psychopharm and psychobio very much, tests can be difficult, but he usually gives u all his lecture notes so that makes it a lot easier.
No Comments

Probably one of my favorite classes.  He is an awesome professor and is very knowledgable and understandable in his teaching.  I would recommend this class to anyone interested.  Some of his test are a little hard, but I feel that I've learned so much!
Good class. Does good job though he can be confusing. Would be better if he was a bit less arrogant.

my favorite class so far.  difficult at times but if you pay attention and read the packet which has everything! that will be on the test you'll be fine.  his passion is very apparent, he knows his sh*t and he loves it.  absolutely amazing class, i'm almost sad it's over

One of the best teachers I've had at NU. Knows the material inside out and has a passion for the field.  Also has the ability to make information that can be boring interesting. His skill is readily apparent when the TA teaches and there is such a deviation in quality.

Melloni is beyond cool. Knows his material to each and every point. Likes to answer questions and is very willing to help those in need of it. The tests are moderate but they do require a fair amount of reading over and over. No book. A powerpoint packet which has EVERYTHING that will be on the test

Let me just say that I hate science, which is why I'm a psych major.  The course is really challenging, but just as long as you study and pay attention in class, it's not that bad...  though the tests he gives have been known to give it's takers migraines.
Challenging tests, but an awesome professor!  Great info and very humorous.

Good class...Melloni is a really good teacher, and this class covers of material but if you go to lectures and study the way he tells you to, you will be fine...I got my first 99 on a college exam in this class

I think Melloni is awesome. He really knows his material well and is great and making it seem down to earth. He presesnts the material in common terms that everyone can understand. I really recommend taking at least one of his classes!

Melloni knows his *hit... but he is a bit arrogant and I was not treated with respect in his class. Also, if you're a neuroscience major and have  alot of psych people in your class.. get ready to learn all about action potentials..

Makes everything sound so simple.  His tests are hard, but if you learn the material, it isn't so bad.  He uses powerpoint but explains it in full in class, constantly asking if anyone has any questions.  The powerpoint was a classpak, the only reading.
tries to make the class simple although the subject is somewhat complicated.  good teacher, wants everyone to understand.
No Comments
I looooove Melloni!

This guy is pretty cool and laid back. The tests are challenging, but he makes the material really easy to understand. He's one of the best profs i've had. He is loaded with info related to the course and is happy to share his knowledge.
He is a really hard professor, and does not give many assignments.  He is kind of intimidating at first, but if you show that you are trying hard, he will pass you.

Totally cool guy, more like a football coach than a professor. But, don't let his relaxed attitude and humor fool you he is one of the smartest professors out there. All notes are in Powerpoint and posted on Blackboard which is a big help.

Prof Miazi is amazing. I was in his 6-9:30pm section, but he was usually able to fit all of his lectures in and let us out before 8pm. His lectures were very engaging despite being at night, and he always showed up with lots of energy to get us through. He was also very accessible for help with assignments. Would highly recommend!
Honestly the chillest professor I've ever had. Makes the class easy while also making sure students really learn the concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The teacher definitely cares about his students, and his lectures help you understand the course content. He doesn't just give a rundown on what is found on the slides, and he actually expands on the topic and any given questions.

Didn't really do much for the class. There's an in-person version of this class & that prof is 10x more involved. Sakib also didn't release proper guidelines for the final, meanwhile the other prof was very clear in requirements, and then Sakib goes "I don't know why you guys are looking at instructions from in-person section"... Easy A tho 🤷‍♀️

He is one of the best professors out there. He has made his entire course available on his website and the level of detailing his notes include are remarkable. Also he is not strict about attendance which provides more flexibility to students. His notes have step by step solutions to any doubt you have. Highly recommended if you are ready to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Online Savvy

reviews.comment: An really emotional professor, it is an overwhelming workload, 3-5 due per week, sometimes 7, not sure if he is a qualified professor, he used a lot of videos from YouTube to teach, so anyway, run, don't take it.
She is great! Super intellectual, super sweet. Would recommend!

i genuinely do not know why her rating is so low on here. she was one of the best professors i ever had. the way she teaches is very memorable and she's very lenient with grading as long as you know what you're doing. frequently gives out examples for you to follow for a good grade and is overall very nice

I think she is the worst teacher I've had throughout my education. She is so hard to reach outside of class. One day she didn't show up to class and waited 40 minutes to tell us class was cancelled with no apology.  She also goes on random tangents all the time it's so bad. Nice person but horrible teacher

Ok, Minott truly is passionate about her work. After taking this class it is clear that she wants everyone to succeed. She made time after class to discuss research projects and I truly believe her reaction time to emails improved over the course of the semester. Grading is hard but she tells you what she expects. I am taking another class of hers!

People like to hate Minott, but she knows her stuff and is a great lecturer. The class addressed key issues and was very interesting. She always kept you attentive, and the podcast assignment was a great way to end the semester. Grading can be nit-picky and random, but most people do fine. She can be a bit difficult to reach, but was never an issue

All class time was spent with Professor Minott reading word for word off the slides, and her slides consisted almost entirely of information copy and pasted from various websites. She required us to read numerous articles completely unrelated to the course matter (and tested us over them), gave no instructions/feedback, and never answered emails.

I would avoid at all costs. She was hardly reachable outside of class and graded randomly. She also went on long irrelevant tangents and at one point said she didn't know what the IRA is (one of the most important pieces of environmental policy). She inappropriately put images of self-flagellation in the lecture without any trigger warning.

Lectures are pointless; they go over the readings and fail to make any new points. Class barely discusses key pieces of policy and spends absurdly long on irrelevant concepts.

Minott was on her phone while students presented their final projects. Also refused to read my work (during office hours) before I could ask. 

Would avoid.

Professor Minott is an amazing teacher who genuinely cares about her students. It has been such a pleasure to be able to take her class and learn from her. She possesses so much knowledge about what she is teaching about, and she constantly shares her own experiences with the class. I highly reccomend this professor to anyone!

She is really nice and helpful , but sometimes to unorganized and struggles with online lecturing and technology. Her class is very interesting and you can learn a lot if you want to but unfortunately she did not get the most out of the class in an online environment
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: Anya is the best professor I have had at Northeastern thus far. She is not only extremely knowledgeable in the field of finance, but she cares about you as a person more than any other finance prof at NEU. It's a shame she only professes in the fall - take her for FINA2201 and you will learn so much, but don't be soft, she makes you work.

Anya is perhaps my favorite teacher so far in my Northeastern career. Genuinely an amazing person and teacher. Would hands down take any of her classes again. She made me push myself and work for my grade.

Anya is L I F E. this woman is a hidden gem in Northeastern. I was a marketing major and switched over to finance because of her. She cares so much about her students and is always willing to help, she is amazing at how she teaches the course, you will learn ALOT. she will go the mile if you do. Shes on your side. Honored to have had her.

Anya is very caring and responsible. She wants you to learn a lot from her class so her tests are hard, which push you to overstudy. She does curve so the letter grade will be pretty fair. She also gives useful practice exams to help you prepare. Very rewarding course for finance intro, highly recommended!

Anya is bae. She may be challenging to some, but you can tell she really cares about the students. Just follow these steps: go to class, pay attention in class, raise your hand every once in a while, review a bit before the test. Boom you have an A. Plus she curves.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is the best. It's a tough class, but if you stay on top of things and ask for help, she is the nicest and most patient professor there is!!! Class average (even if it's 65) will always be a B, so it's not that bad. She wants everyone to pass!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough--Would take again

reviews.comment: I CAN'T SAY ENOUGH GOOD THINGS ABOUT ANYA! I'm studying marketing and she is the best professor I've had at NEU. Very knowledgeable and nice, SO willing to help you with whatever you need. Finance isn't the easiest topic, but she makes it much easier to understand and genuinely wants to see every student succeed. 10/10 would recommend!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Really good at teaching the course and explaining anything you do not understand. Homeworks are really hard tests are difficult but the class average will always be a B.

Anya is an AMAZING professor! I am a marketing major and was terrified of taking finance, but I ended up with an A. Its not that bad. Shes going to tell you at the beginning that he averages are low, but dont let it scare you away. She curves everything in our favor and is super willing to help whenever you need it. Go go office hours and get to
hard

Professor Anyas Finance course is one of the most challenging courses I have ever taken in my life. CLASS average ended up being a 68. Homeworks and exams are HARD! She goes really fast with the material &overestimates her students she said it herself so she makes everything a lot harder. However even if you end up with a C you will learn A LOT
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Although she is really smart and is really open to helping you, her tests are unecessarily hard as well as the homework. It doesn't really help you learn. She goes through powerpoints really quickly, not great.
She is an amazing professor. If you want an A you need to WORK for it. Stay on top of things and you will be fine. She's awesome. Tough test.

She is an amazing teacher. Class is challenging, but you will learn alot so it is worth it. Listen to lectures in class and print out the slides and you should be okay. The book is optional. Very patient and easy to talk to if you have questions. Very caring about students learning. Wish all my teachers were like her!

ANYA'S THE BEST. Her class is hard, like really hard. On our first est a 68 was a B+. But you learn so much and she presents the material so well. I loved this class and it's the reason I concentrated in Finance. You have to take this class as a BSIB major anyway, so DEFINITELY take it with Anya. She rocks

Professor Anya is a great finance professor. She is crystal clear in her explanations and her lectures are never boring even though the material could be. She does go over the materials at the speed of light, but she is always available for help outside of class and is incredibly helpful. I would definitely, strongly recommend her to anybody else.

She understand that Finance can be challenging and she really wants you to pass. She will explain things in different ways if you do not understand the first time.   Definetly would love to have another class with her.

She is very sweet. Extremely knowledgable. Came into class not being a fan of finance and after the class, I kind of started liking it! She made it very interesting. Homework consisted of relatively longer excel projects. In terms of exams she was extremely fair. Provided practice problem reviews and curved everything. Hoping to pull off a A-/B+.
Great teacher, her exams are hard but she  curves. She is vey clear in the classroom and you know well what will be in the tests. I definitely recommend her!

Nothing negative to say about her. Extremely knowledgeable in her field, and can/will make sure that if you have a question she will have an answer. Wants you to do well, but makes sure that you work hard for it. Very fair, and if you work for an A, you will leave with one, as well as a solid basic background in Finance

This was her first time being a teacher. Very sweet lady. She wants you to do well in class however she makes you work hard to get an A. She is very helpful and always available in her office hours. Go to all her classes, do homeworks and study from her slides and you'll be fine. Overall, I recommend her.

Lectures were no use. Material was from coursera. No talent for communicating in class or teach. No response to emails, No OH, outdated labs, left everything on TA, there is no oversight, involvement from his side. Demo at expo was disappointing, only interacted with one engineer. labs and project were not graded.
I took his course recently and this was one of the toughest courses which i have taken so far but i also did learn a lot. I just wished he was covering aws as well.
course was heavy but i loved it.

This was my second course with him (ML and MLOPs) and i enjoyed every moments of his classes. He only teaches though courses but he breaks them down really good and explains all the details. Overall i wish we had more prof like him at NEU.

I took MLOps course with him and this has been the best course i took during my graduate school so far. Lots of materials and labs, i did kot know anything about the difficulties of model development in production environment and i think this course has prepared me for whats out there. I just wished he did have some office hours himself.
difficult course but I learned a lot.

Professor teaches using white board and no slides. Classes were theory forward whereas homeworks and exams were application forward, also homeworks don't help in preparation for the exam at all. Barely did any coding to help connect all the math we were learning in class. Wouldn't recommend unless you have a strong math and ML background.

Hard course but taught well, i took this course in CS department and ended up dropping it because it was really hard to follow. Took his class and despite his style of teaching (no lecture notes or slides), i fond myself enjoying the class every session.

No slides are provided. Lots of note-taking. He skipped explanations on some topics but had that on one of the exam problems. many different versions of questions on the exam, and it's by luck to get easier questions.  This professor has a wrong sense of fairness.

I made a mistake and took his class in summer 1. His class is to heavy to be offered during summer 1 which made it really difficult for some of us to catch up with. His class is full of math and statistics and recommended if you are planning to read, his teaching style is really good and he spends lots of time repeating the materials.

I really enjoyed his teaching, he is really passionate about the class and learned a lot but i would not take this course with him again. Although i have learned a lot and it helped me with my internship interviews but i did spend so many hours reading for his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Unclear grading criteria. Not really helpful for students to learn, but wants to brag of himself, especially with the exam. Try same class with another professor - much experienced.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: By far the most advanced course which i have taken. Although this course was really difficult but he taught it really good. If your goal is to get high grade without studying hard then you shouldn't take his course.

The BEST machine learning(Bayesian based) course in NEU, the textbook is Bishop PRML, it is very very difficult whatever the lecture, homework and exam, full of complex mathmatical stuff. I would recommend it if you are interest in math ratinale and scratch code. BUT, the grade is good, he would curve it if you are too bad to curve.

I took his course for machine learning, and it was honestly the best money spent to date at Northeastern. He enjoys his lectures, and if you are as driven and motivated as him, you will thoroughly enjoy the classes and the homework. The exams are challenging, and they are solely responsible for making or breaking your GPA.
I highly recommend  taking his course. He is very understanding and very well prepared for the class.

What truly elevates this course is his teaching. He is an outstanding instructor—knowledgeable, engaging, and genuinely invested in his students' learning. He uses relatable examples, and creates an environment where students feel encouraged to ask questions. Assignments and exams are fair, and the pace of the course is moderate.Highly recommended!

reviews.comment: I had an amazing experience taking Econ 1115 with Professor Shabanpour. He is a passionate and engaging instructor who makes complex economic concepts easy to understand. His lectures are clear and filled with real-world examples. He's approachable and genuinely cares about student success. Highly recommend!

The class was not too hard, but he did not end the class on time. He was assigning tests after all classes ended like he either did not know when the semester ended, or he just forgot to give the last three exams until the last week. Textbook homework was due every week, discussion boards were due almost every week, and there were 5 exams.

Class is very test-heavy, as there are 3 exams worth 25% each, but they aren't difficult if you study. Lectures are great, and the professor is funny. I would recommend actually going to class, although not required. Great professor overall.

Genuinely one of the best profs I've had. He's hilarious, and his real-world stories make concepts actually make sense. You need to attend lecture; he works through real exam problems in class. Grading is almost all exams. Homework is tedious and doesn't really help. Highly recommend.
Best professor I've ever had. Wouldn't be surprised if over 50% of the class added on a major/minor of Econ
Stone is mad chill and a great teacher. The topics are relatively easy as well and you never regret going to a lecture as hes very engaging.

Great professor, attendance is optional, but I highly recommend going to the lecture because he clearly explains the slides and works through helpful examples. He goes through everything in detail and genuinely wants students to succeed.

Honestly one of the best lecture professors I've ever had--he's both super knowledgable about micro and a super engaging lecturer. His teaching is straightforward and he spends a ton of time going into depth about the topics until everyone understands. Tests are as expected, pretty easy, and only cover what was discussed -- would 100% recommend

Super nice guy, actually engages with the class. Genuinly has made the class laugh a couple times. Actually show up and pay attention to the lectures and you'll be fine. The class has three exams and weekly homework but nothing that intense. I wish the grading wasn't that exam heavy but studying isn't too complicated since he post's the slides.

I had a stone in a lecture class, which made individual relationships impossible, but he is a good lecturer; he spices up his lectures with stories and jokes, making it easy to pay attention in class. He is understanding, helpful, and overall a good teacher.
This professor is amazing! He's so passionate and is an amazing story teller. I come to class just to hear him talk. 3 tests and all multiple choice.
Amazing professor!! He makes his classes so engaging
The best professor ever! Decided to minor in Economics because of Prof. Stone.

Prof Stone is actually the best. His classes aren't mandatory but his teaching style and the fact that you actually learn so much from them, as well as his personality and engagement make you want to go. Still a relatively difficult class but he is so helpful and all exams were online.

While I am not the best at econ, I studied very hard for this class and I feel that his class was extremely test heavy; thus, not a fair representation of my mastery of the class. Taking it online made it extremely harder as it was difficult to reach both the TA and professor for help, so it was a very independent-type class. Good luck!!

reviews.comment: Hands down the best professor I've ever had. He is clearly ridiculously smart and he's just so passionate and enthusiastic and his lectures are amazing. He does a great job breaking down the tough concepts, moving at a good pace, and including interesting/funny real-world examples. Literally joined rate my professor just to recommend him!
Great Lecturer, easy class and easy tests just make sure to show up to classes and do lots of mind tap. Also may give a curve at the end for final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Stone is awesome! By far the best professor I've had at Northeastern. This is a very interesting class, but it is not easy. If you pay attention to the lecture and do all the homework you will be fine!
The lectures are very entertaining, and I never had to read the textbook. The tests are straightforward and very similar to the homework. I always looked forward to the class.

Michael Stone is a great lecturer and he's very interesting to listen to. The workload is minimal and if you study for the tests then you should be fine. Attendance isn't mandatory but I strongly suggest going if you want to learn.

Stone is one of the best professors I've ever had. Made the material accessible and easy to understand as well as being caring towards all of his students. Came to class prepared and always in a friendly mood. Grading based on three exams and hw, as long as you put the work in and go to lecture you'll be fine.

Prof Stone is someone who genuinely cares about his students and the subject that he is teaching. He always came ready to teach and made all the classes super engaging and fun to participate in. He made sure to answer all questions that came up in our class which was relatively large. Would definitely take his class again!
Super funny, super chill and made econ genuinely interesting. Pretty straightforward exams & hw. Great guy, considering an econ minor bc of him.
He was a great lecturer and one of the best professors I have had
Lectures are fun and engaging. Homework is all online and the difficulty is not hard. Recitation attendance is mandatory.

This class was great for an intro to econ. His lectures were not mandatory, and you could just look at his slides if you miss class. No need to read the textbook, which was nice. Makes lectures as interesting as they can be!

Absolutely adored hi! He's an amazing professor who genuinely cares about the subject! Tests are not cumulative, all multiple choice, and only 33 questions and homework are once a week and not difficult to understand!

Honestly one of the best professors at northeastern. His lectures are really amazing and he keeps the class engaged. You can actually observe that he is really passionate about what he teaches and wants you to succeed in his class. Highly recommend taking him. Tests are pretty easy (read slides, cengage prep) and there is weekly HW. Easy A. 10/10
Simply outstanding.

This was a pretty easy class. Stone is really funny and interesting to listen to as well as just a nice professor in general. It's pretty test and lecture heavy so be prepared for that. Study the slides for the tests.

He is a very kind Professor. Lectures go on a lot of tangents so it can be difficult to follow most of the time. I studied very hard for each test and still would not do well. For a 1000 level class, it is very difficult, I suggest taking another Professor.

Stone is nice but this class was so hard. I spent hours studying before exams and would barely pull an A. Study with cengage test prep if you want a chance at getting a decent grade. Exams are in person online. I would take another prof if possible
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Stone is amazing. He is so passionate about teaching economics, and making sure everyone in the class is keeping up with the course's content. Despite this being a big lecture with 100+ students, Prof. Stone could always keep the classes engaging and super interesting. There are three, in person, noncumulative exams, and weekly homework.
TERRIBLE! NEVER take professor stone's class it will ruin your GPA

There's not much to say about prof Stone that has not been said. This guy should be a public speaker. He is so emotive and interesting to listen to. Every class became a conversation where you really got to learn beyond just the lectures. Easily the best professor I've had. Great guy who I can't speak highly enough. Make sure you pay attention tho

Amazing teacher. His lectures go beyond the slideshow and he uses the white board to really nail down topics. Since participation doesn't matter it can be easy to just skip lecture, but you will learn SO much more just listening to his lectures vs reading the slides alone.

Michael Stone is my favorite professor that I have had at Northeastern. His lecture are extremely engaging and he uses real-world examples and analogies to help students understand the material. Tests and workload are extremely fair. Highly recommend.

Super enthusiastic lecturer but goes on so many tangents throughout class. I completely forget by the end what is important to know for the chapter and what is irrelevant. I needed to teach myself everything before the exams (which counted 75% of the final grade, by the way). The course being this exam heavy made it difficult to be successful.

reviews.comment: i took this class in spring of 2020 as a freshman & even with the covid transition - i can confidently say a few years later he is one of my favorite professors in college. take him if you can. go to his office hours - he has so much knowledge & wants to help you succeed in his class!

Super nice and knowledgable. Read the textbook and do the practice quizzes and you will get an A. I got lazy before the final and had to settle for an A- but if you just do these two things your good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Excellent professor gives you a lot of information in lectures and tries his best to help out anyway. If you listen to his instructions and follow them it is an easy A

Stone is definitely one of the best professors I've had at NEU so far. His lectures are engaging and funny, and he's always attentive and accessible to anyone that needs help. His grading/tests are also really clear and he gives you everything you need to do well in advance.

Stone is a great professor who goes out of his way to make the lectures interesting and engaging. His explains the concept very well that you don't even have to read the textbook. The test is not hard and everything is basically off the slides in class. He is willing to help students anytime. I would highly recommend him.

Professor Stone gives great lectures. His slides give all the information you need to pass the class, yet attending his lectures is heavily recommended because of how well he explains topics. He really understands his audience, plus hes funny and engaging. I never took notes and just watched him talk, and I did great in microeconomics.

Definitely recommend Stone, he is absolutely amazing.  My favorite professor at NU by far!  He helped me develop a love for economics and is one of the main reasons why I decided to further pursue microeconomics in future courses.

Best lecturer out there. Most interesting class. Easiest tests if you do adaptive test prep on mind tap, which he uses some years. Tests are easy, just don't slack and do the practice problems, which set you up for a high score. Read thru ppts. Couldn't have picked a better prof.

Professor Stone's teaching was engaging, energetic, and thoughtful, especially considering our large 300-student class size. He assigned weekly homework and administered three multiple choice exams, none cumulative. Although reading and taking textbook notes wasn't required, it's very helpful. Also, I'd advise studying textbook practice problems.

Professor Stone explained the concepts well. There were only 3 tests; in order to get an A, you have to do well on each exam with minimal room for error. The tests weren't abnormally difficult and reflected what he taught in class. But, you definitely need to study and complete a plethora of practise problems in order to succeed on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super funny and super invested in the material. His lectures are super thorough and if you pay attention and take good notes, you can cash a good grade in this. He clearly cares about his students too, and he's really entertaining. Great professor, would absolutely take a class with him again.

Here's the thing. My class  ECON1116, fall 2021  had 300 people in it. This poor man had to perform econ standup three times a week to a crowd of fickle students in a literal auditorium. But he really knows what he's doing, is super accessible, and does genuinely cares about you. He's funny and articulates economics really well.

He's fine. Goes on tangents a lot of classes are 300+ ppl. His tests are more difficult than the test prep on the mandatory homework service you buy for like 130$. He seems like a nice guy, just not the best teacher for this class. Probably a lot better in smaller class sizes tbh
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I thoroughly enjoyed professor Stone's class. You could tell he really wanted his students to succeed and he would stay long after his office hours were over to get to every student. The tests accurately reflected the homework and as long as you read the material and watched his videos you would do fine.

One of the BEST professors by far! Makes his online lectures engaging and is funny. I highly recommend going to office hours if you get confused on a concept because he does a great job clearing it up and will never make you feel rushed. He is also very easy to talk to. The exams are not bad as long as you put in the work and ask questions!

Professor Stone was my favorite professor during my first semester of college. He was fun to talk to and knew the subject very well so the way he explained things made it so anyone can understand the topics.

He is very animated and puts a lot of effort into his recorded lectures. This course is mainly based on the textbook. If you take good notes and read the book, you'll do fine on the graded homework and tests. Discussion board posts are also part of your grade from your recitation. Overall, if you do the work you'll likely get an A- or A.

reviews.comment: Smart and helpful, even though its online.

Professor Stone made really engaging lectures which made it easy to understand the material. I was in a very big class so exams were one of the only sources of grading we had, making the class really test heavy. However, if you paid attention in class or looked at his lecture slides it was very easy to do well

Professor Stone is an amazing professor. He is super passionate about economics and makes the material fun and engaging. There are 3 MC exams which are relatively easy and weekly homework. I always looked forward to his class, take him if you can!

Stone is AMAZING! Great lecturer and super funny. He says to go to the TA first, but was super accessible. The tests matter, 3 tests at 33 MCQ, but you learn so much. I took him during COVID-19, and he did an amazing job with the online transition and had video conference office hours. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! He made me look forwards to a 4:35pm class.

reviews.comment: AMAZING professor! Really funny and amazing explanations, gave new perspective on economics.

I think Stone is one of the best professors I have so far. From a person who never took econ perspective, his class was pretty difficult at first, then I started to understand more concepts by doing more of the study guide. One recommendation is to do practice exams before taking exams because some of the questions were exactly the same.

Tough tests. I will not recommend this class. The professor is nice and patient. But, textbook and homework are not related to the tests. If u want to get good letter grade, u should not be in this class.

Amazing guy, always ready to answer questions. HW once a week, really easy if you pay attention in class. Exams very easy, just take good notes and they're all straightforward questions. 100% would take this class again
Amazing Professor.
Lecture is probably good. But, the tests are usually tricky and tough. Weekly Time-costly homework.
Very entertaining for econ. I didn't mind the class and it wasn't too hard.

He is so passionate about what he's talking about. Never once had to open a textbook. Lectures are super detailed and informative; exams are straight-forward questions. The homework is only once a week, only 3 exams all semester (including the final). Such a great professor, passionate about what he is talking about, definitely knows his stuff.

Phenomenal Professor. Classes are always engaging and funny, and he really personally connects with his students. He knows the material well and wants the best for his students. Would absolutely love to take his other classes.

GREAT PROFESSOR. i can speak on behalf of all the 40 students in his class that he is a solid professor. he knows his materials, makes sure he repeats stuff often so everyone understands. only had a few homework and the tests are doable as long as u read his slides. highly recommend Stone!!!

Stone is a great professor and he puts all his material online for students to study. The majority of the grade is based on 2 exams and a final, so study for them accordingly. Attendance is not mandatory, but he is a nice guy so going to class isn't a struggle. Also he is good at updating grades which is a plus.
Prof. Stone is great - show up to lecture, pay attention, and you'll pass the class easily. He is straightforward and funny, and makes lectures entertaining. GLORIOUS.
His lectures were great and all you needed to know were in his slides or examples. The homework was good because it correlated well with the lectures. Highly recommend him.

2nd yr student and Stone is easily one of the two best professors Ive had at Northeastern. The Econ department is lucky to have him, he's everything a professor should be. He genuinely cares about his students, he teaches in a hilarious and relatable way, he's always willing to help you in his office hours. Take his class and you will be soooo glad

I took Econ as an elective and so far it's the best class I've ever taken. Professor stone  hands down is my favorite professor and would love for him to teach all my courses. He knows the material, his tests and grading criteria are fair and he's the kind of professor who genuinely care about his student.

Great lectures, he basically goes over the textbook in his powerpoints and he is really good at explaining the material. You can tell he really loves econ and teaching and he makes some jokes in the lectures. The homework is good and most of the test questions come straight from there, so make sure you understand the homework as you do it.

Professor Stone teaches the class amazingly well and makes sure that students understand what he is talking about. He is very funny, cracking many jokes and even using entertaining and relatable examples in class. He is one of my favorite professors and I highly recommend him to anyone interested in Economics

Prof stone is easily my favorite professor. I am not good at economics but did relatively well in his course because he teaches beautifully. Very clear, tells funny stories, and really engages with students. He also talks to us about random stuff in the beginning of class which makes him very approachable! I love him. wish he taught all my courses!
Great, easy, and you learn a lot!!
Fantastic Professor. Taking him for Law and Econ and it is one of the best classes I have ever taken at Northeastern. Easily the most enthusiastic professor I have ever had. HIGLY RECOMMEND him.
Easy class! Very entertaining professor. Enjoyed being in his class.
If I could, I would take all his classes. Enough said.

Best professor I've ever had. You do not need to buy books for he has ppt slides that covers everything you need. He is funny, amazing, charming, and his classes are always filled with joy.  And the most important thing that his exams is not difficult so you do not need to worry about fails. Just take his class and you will not regret!

Mr. Stone was a very good and supportive teacher, one of the most inspirational economics professors I've had. Class discussions were fun and if a student struggled, he was always willing to help and explain it over and over again. He is very fair in grading and he is super friendly. Class materials are uploaded on power point and straight forward

Mr Stone is what you want in a professor. He's very thorough with the material, and covers so much in his slides that you don't need to buy the textbook. Online homeworks are hard but allow for infinite amount of attempts. Two midterms and one final that is NOT cumulative. Brilliant teacher who may not be easy but its certainly possible to get A's

Genuinely a great professor. He's very knowledgeable and creates a very friendly environment in the class, so you can ask him about anything. The resources he provides are also very useful for the midterms and exams.
Professor Munoz should be teaching a higher level environment class, where his passion can be of greater use. In the end he was very informative and great to talk to about course topics

reviews.comment: Sam is genuinely one of the most amazing professors I've had. He is incredibly helpful and knowledgeable about the course content, answers questions in class, and posts all the slides on Canvas. All lectures recorded and uploaded. Easy class but take good notes and you'll be set.
Such an amazing lecturer. Always showed up to class ready to talk about whatever the daily topic was. He has a lot of research experience and is clearly passionate about the field.
Honestly the sweetest professor I have ever had. The class was easy but enjoyable and you do learn a lot.
Amazing class amazing professor. Made everything extremely easy and accessible. Easiest science elective you could possibly take.
He is a good teacher. He explains concepts clearly but goes over everything very quickly. The exams are not difficult, easy to get credit.

I can't think of an easier way to do the science requirement. It's all open note, but all of your grade is comprised of timed online exams and quizzes. For this semester, at least, we had the option of attending lecture through zoom. All lectures are recorded if you miss them, and all notes are posted online. Just watch out for the 2nd midterm

reviews.comment: Sam is so clearly passionate about the work he does and enthusiastic in his lectures. This class is open-note and just quizzes and exams, so it is not bad at all and the content is pretty interesting. Def would take him again.

I absolutely loved him. Super funny professor that made all lectures interesting and interactive. Responsible Investing exams were not hard in the least bit and he tells you exactly what you need to know to do well. Loved him.
He's a nice guy but the lectures had absolutely nothing to do with the exams and he's a harsh grader.

fina3303 is hard so dont take it. professor myers does make it better though hes hilarious and passionate. lectures are really interactive so be ready to get cold called but hes chill still. homeworks are manageable and easy but exam is SOOO difficult omg omg omg omg just dont take this course. he is chill though

Prof Myers is very caring and is passionate about sustainable investing. I did learn a lot in this class, though I don't feel it is widely applicable to the world of finance (at least not yet). He is a tough grader, and the course load was pretty heavy for a 2000 level class.

I rlly dont understand the hate with him--100% take him. I didn't mind about cold calling and attendance. great job explaining concepts, making it easy for me to practice questions at home and prep for the exams. 4 HWs + a few easy connect hws + 2 exams. Don't take his class if you sit in the back and not listen. HIGHLY REC THIS PROF

I found his lectures engaging and entertaining 
he lets each student pick how they are being graded (weight) 
this course does not require that much: weekly connect hw, 4 large hw assignments, midterm, final 
he is a VERY hard grader so I would reccomend making tests your lowest weight
Best professor ever!

David Myers is probably the worst professor at Northeastern. His lectures are completely USELESS if you don't have a strong understanding of Calculus and Linear Algebra. His tests are EXTREMELY hard (the average for the midterm was a 56%) and his lectures are outstandingly boring. The homework assignments are also kinda hard. AVOID HIM AT ALL COST!

Overall nice professor. Everything is graded on a curve so he sometimes takes off points and can't explain why he took them off. If you go to office hours and show him that you are trying you will do well.

Really heavy work loads, and difficult homework. The textbook is expensive.

He wears hilarious outfit every single class and doesn't even care about his students.

Exams (2 midterm and 1 final) are really tough

THE WORST PROFESSOR IN NORTHEASTERN EVER!!!!!! 

There were 4 big assignments for this course and all really really difficult and non-related to the lecture. Even though he will teach you how to do the homework but still really teasing and time-consuming. If you are willing to take all the risks that I said, wish you GOOD LUCK :)

Myers assumes students already have sustainability/finance knowledge when students often don't have one or the other. Course content is fine but exams are 90% irrelevant to what he taught in class. He also lied to students about what will be on exam. HARD GRADER. Doesn't help review. If you don't need to take this class, save yourself the trouble.

By far worst finance professor I ever had. Does not care about students and lectures are a waste of time. Barely does any review or test prep before exams to help students succeed. Makes exams confusing to the point where I start to question if he even wants his students to succeed.
I would not recommend him to my worst enemy
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Extremely difficult class made much more difficult by confusing lectures. Talks in circles and fails to answer questions. Doesn't finish a sentence without cold calling. Super unclear in assignments and lectures. Not just me, everybody in my class is absolutely lost. He is very caring and humorous, and wants to help (but doesn't)

I took Myers for his Sustainability in Finance class. He's very knowledgeable but the class is unreasonably hard. He's an extremely tough grader (10% off for one spelling mistake), gives confusing feedback, he makes the class purposely difficult. Even after going to office hours and spending literally hours on projects, most people only got a B-

Professor Myers made a very challenging class fun and easy to understand. He is always making jokes during class to keep the lectures lighthearted and will explain concepts in different ways to get students to understand. Tests are very difficult and the homeworks are long, but if you show up and put in the work you'll get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were mostly conceptual and led by student participation (completely unrelated to the math-based homework) making exam prep difficult. This class might be a good overview if already very familiar with the topic but was confusing and not the best introductory course. That being said, Myers is a great guy who clearly cares about his students.

Professor myers is a humorous man, but veers off the learning material far too often, and it seems like he teaches us with the assumption that we know most concepts and simply need review, when in reality we are learning these for the first time.

I have never had a professor at Northeastern that was this willing to help outside of class. But, make sure you come to class prepared to pay attention, as the material can get tricky and it's important that you know how to do the class problems for the exam. Lectures are interesting, and professor Myers tries to make the material comprehensive.

Great professor, amazing lecturer. Really accessible and open to questions. Allows you to choose the portfolio weights of your grades and then curves it. Attendance is mandatory, though he teaches so well that it doesn't feel like a burden. The topic is really difficult but professor myers really makes it as easy to comprehend as possible.

One of my favorite professors will go above and beyond to help you. He has the best attitude in a teacher that I have ever experienced not just in college. He is a knowledgeable, kind and understanding individual who genuinely wants to help all of his students. But his exams are hard and you will be pressed for time.

Myers makes up half of his material which makes it impossible to study outside of his subpar notes and unclear lectures. He assumes a level of financial savvy for all students in this class when it is an entry level class. He's a cool dude and very personable but needs to provide clearer lessons and instruction for the material that he designed.

I really liked Professor Myers for Investments. He's funny and engaging if you participate. He makes an effort to learn everyone's names and faces in a class of ~35 people. He's approachable outside of class if you need extra help with homeworks. The lectures can be a bit dull but that's more of the topic's fault than David's.

Professor Myers really cared about his students and gave lots of flexibility in terms of attendance and participation. The 4 HW assignments can be time-consuming, but if you go to his office hour that'll help a lot. He does talk a little too slow, but if you turn the recordings to 1.5x speed then his lectures will be super informative and helpful.

One of the best professors i have had during my 4+ years at NEU. As a finance major, I appreciate professor Myers's teaching approach: he uses real-time data/ trends/ news in the homework which gives a great perspective on how to use what we learn to the real world. An expert in his field. Highly suggest taking any finance class with him!!!

Great prof. Took investments with him. A lot of emphasis on class-participation. The best part is that you can set the grading weights depending on your strengths. The 4 excel homeworks can be a little challenging.

Prof Myers is very passionate about sustainability - He tries to add humor / personal touches to his lectures, but they are still slow, consist almost entirely of class participation, and don't follow the slides. I enjoyed going to class, but I'm not sure what I really learned. HWs are unrelated to the lectures, and exams are difficult. Opted P/F

Prof Myers is pretty straight forward. Midterm and final are easy if you understand the basic concepts he emphasizes in class. You will do well in this class if you attend office hours for the homework and practice the Connects before the midterm/final
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is a great guy and super kind. He will help you greatly if you go to office hours. He also lets you weight the tests and assignments to a different weight. However, his lectures absolutely suck. They are boring and no one is following along. I HIGHLY recommend that you take another professor or wait for another semester for another professor

Myers is legit one of my favorite profs and I hate finance. Homework is not difficult or time consuming at all, for the Excel stock project homeworks you can go to office hours and he will help a ton. I didn't like him until I went to office hours, and he helped me immensely in the class. The 2 exams are just Connect homeworks, with different #s.

I'll start by saying that he is a very nice and smart man. However, he cannot teach for his life. He knows all of the course material very well (even if he doesn't make his own slides), but cannot convey it effectively at all. 100 minutes of his class feels like 300; he just drones on and on while not actually saying much. Would be wise to avoid.

Unlike other sessions, we didn't do trading game. Do all the work on your own. Funny guy, talk about the industry a lot, brought up hot topics in real world in the lecture. To do well, study textbook yourself and ask him questions regarding the homework!! His lecture is not so related to the homework problems which he uses as a resource for exams

Homework: CONNCET + 4 assignments (not too hard but you need to ask questions, he well tell you exact how to do it). Note: he said CONNECT is the best resource for review but you don't see all problems unless you attempted 4 times to uncover all hidden ones. Midterms questions are similar to CONNECT homework, but he WILL adjust them to be tricky

reviews.comment: Not a lot of homework but you need to read the textbook in order to be prepared for the midterm and final. If you don't read the book you will be a little lost in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The final average of all his sections combined was a 64, so you be the judge? He doesn't make his own powerpoints and he makes really dumb jokes that he expects you to remember because he'll call on you randomly to finish them sometimes.

I probably failed this class but Professor Myers is a cool dude. I like his bow ties and he's a nice person. He doesn't do a lot of prep for exams but he has a system where you can choose your own weights for grades!

I can't say enough good things about Prof. Chung. She cares deeply about the subject, and she's always taking time to listen to students and improve her lectures. Almost every class went the full because she had so much to share. You can tell she puts a lot of effort into making sure her students are getting the best education she can provide.

Professor Myo is one of the most genuinely caring professors I've ever had. She pushes you to think critically and back up your ideas with solid evidence. She is also incredibly supportive and attentive to students. If you want a class where you'll actually grow, be challenged, and feel seen as a person, I would recommend taking her course.
Professor Myo is so nice! I really like her classes!

Professor Myo is by far one of the most caring, understanding professors. I have taken three classes with her, and she breaks down information into simple terms and gives clear expectations. She is super understanding and flexible about group projects and deadlines. Could not recommend her enough.

Prof. Chung creates a supportive learning environment where every student feels valued and encouraged to excel. Her clear explanations and willingness to provide extra assistance outside of class greatly contributed to my understanding of the material. I would definitely recommend Prof. Chung!

She's not only incredibly nice and helpful to students but also very understanding, often granting extensions with valid excuses. Even if exams are closed-book, closed-note, and in-person, they aren't very difficult. She also provides generous extra credit opportunities, up to 7 points per semester, so there's no need to stress about low grades.

She is very difficult, assumes that you are an accountant with all the knowledge in the world, expects participation and effort beyond a normal degree and if you don't participate it effects your grade

Dr. Chung is one of best professors I have had. I have never felt more cared for and respected as a student. Her lecture brings the information across without being boring. Something I found very effective is her method of having a student repeat what we learnt last class. ALL of the students she had absolutely adore her!

Prof. Chung is artful in the way she teaches and breaks down concepts. More so, she is an amazing storyteller. She is fair and has a great sense of humor (although not explicit at first). Once, she brought homemade Squid Game waffles to class and made us play for grade points - only to tell us it was April Fools. 
Best. Professor. Ever.
would not take agian, u can learn nothing in his class, every grade is unclear, and no any grade criteria,

Professor is available outside of class but is hypocritical, mood is totally unpredictable, and clearly has favorites. Grading is unclear and harsh, learned absolutely nothing in this class. Take a different professor or class entirely. Tons of work and projects that provide no benefit whatsoever. Would not take again.

Professor Muscolino is a really nice and supportive professor who genuinely cares about his students, the class is very group project dependent and theres a lot of homework but hes an easy grader and is understanding about late submissions. Overall really funny and kind.
I think I'm getting an A-, but I learned absolutely nothing in this class lol. He is just all over the place and so disorganized. No exams tho.

He does not give clear instructions on rubrics of assignments, so you might get surprise points taken off. He does not write any of it down or explain it, so you have to guess. He also does not teach and just yaps in class. Also bad at organization; the slides he posts are not listed with the chapter they cover but as random numbers.
He gives pop quizzes but they are not hard at all. He is a very generous grader and a very nice guy. He also has great humor.

Fully asynch course but if you needed help getting points, you just imessage or call him. He cares less about the work and more about your success so if you communicate often, interact with the canvas page (he tracks clicks and time on it for participation) you will do well. He really cares about the outcome of his students!

He's a nice guy but it was so hard to read him. It seemed like he was a different person everyday. He was hypocritical. He showed up 30 minutes late one day but scolded students if they showed up 5 minutes late. Super unclear expectations! He said we did amazing on a project, then gave us a terrible grade.

horrible teacher. Avoid at all costs, I dont think he knows what hes actually teaching. You will not learn anything from this class. Use ur tuition towards another class, not this. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

Awesome professor! Definitely make sure to get a good group in the beginning of the semester for the simulation. The class is super interesting and interactive. He is very accessible outside of class and always there to answer questions if you have any. The content is difficult, but Prof. Muscolino makes it fun.

He's a nice guy, but if you're not the biggest fan of group work do not take this class. Literally every assignment is a group assignment except for the connect homeworks. The assignments can be long and complex. There are two presentations, a midterm and a final, both online.
Teacher is very responsive and knowledgable on the markets. Easy class but some assignments are very time consuming so plan accordingly. Lots of busy work.

Wonderful man and professor. The class is engaging, and Professor Muscolino does a good job integrating current news and events into behavioral finance concepts. Participation matters and group assignments and presentations are the norm. Find a good group of students and take ownership of the casework for specific companies, and you will have fun!

Overall a good professor. In BUSN1101 you work with the same group for the entire semester on one project, so if you get a bad group that can screw you. But overall really nice and funny guy, he genuinley cares about how his students do.

Professor Muscolino is a wonderful person and a great professor. With the right amount of outside effort and interest I think most people can perform well in the class. He's always accessible outside of class, and genuinely wants you to succeed as a human as well as a student. The course has group projects which are fun and informative. He's great!

Course not required for busn major & not useful, filled with fluff. Demo days were stressful, required hours of prep. Prof was unclear about expectations, lacked organization with his teaching, seems chill but would grade harshly on easy hw's. When asked for feedback he could not give me good reasons either. Group you end up with matters a lot!
