reviews.comment: Professor Hanser is a nice guy who clearly cares about stats. However, he isn't the best at teaching students and expects you to learn a whole coding language on your own. I was lost for much of the class but still managed to get a good grade.

Doesn't really care about grades and rather if you know the content. It is a very unorganized class with one midterm on the syllabus not taking place and a rushed group project. Classes are him facilitating students teaching others where he would create groups and have them present in class. It is an easy class but just needs a lot of self-teaching
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: HE really teach nothing, im totally confused about the syllabus and test policy. On the syllabus there are going to be 2 midterms, but he only gives one.

I was so confused during this class. He makes you use r coding for the entire course, which is really hard if you don't have any prior knowledge on it cause he never really explains how to use it. He doesn't teach you any material, he just makes the students teach the homework problems to the class which sucks cause no one knows what they're doing.

This man makes us code but barely explains how to use RStudio. When we ask him how we are supposed to do this when he won't explain how to use the program, he just says to struggle with it and email him with questions. He doesn't explain the homework problems, he makes other kids present them which takes forever and wastes all the class time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I had Hanser for stats and was confused literally the entire time. Everyone I talked to was just as lost. He uses R coding for a lot of the class, but didn't teach it at all so when we had to code on the midterm we had no idea how because he literally didn't teach us. The grade is based on 1 quiz, midterm, final, participation, and a few homeworks.
Just take the class you will not get a better professor I promise you. This is not bluff I see you doing your professor research just end it here and call it a day I am saving you time.

3 quiz (lowest drop), 2 midterm, 1 final, 3 part group project, HW every sunday but easy & multiple tries. Attendance matters. Sweet professor — explains well, cares abt students, helpful. Quiz/midterm are straightforward just study. Gives good study material. A is achievable w/ decent effort but i messed up on a midterm so i got A-. Take her!!

Professor O'Kelly is extremely passionate about what she teaches and cares for her students, I loved the class towards the beginning of the semester, but the pace of the class became much faster when we got to more complex concepts...There's hw due every Sunday night, and there are quizzes in between midterms (she drops the lowest quiz)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Peggy is really kind and shows a lot of care for her students. Her explanations always break things down in really simple ways that are easy to understand. This was easily my favorite class this semester despite it being an 8 am. The 8 am part is kinda rough, but honestly I think if there is a professor worth taking that early it's definitely her.

I would die for her, quizzes are more exam "quizzam" as she calls em but like super fair where nothing is blindside but you should def know if you paid attention. Textbook lowkey doesn't matter if you can follow lectures and in class assignments. Show up only on lectures and solid 60 guarantee on any quiz TwT.

Don't take Acct 1209 asynch in a half summer class if you plan on doing anything else during those months. Condensing this regular class into 2x speed and offering it online seems nice in theory, however by the detailed math nature of the class, in-class Q/A time and days to study/learn the concepts is just missed in this format : (
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lectures go by really slow and makes concepts harder than they are. Doesn't curve anything but will drop your lowest quiz score (only 4). Read the textbook and pray that's enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love Prof. Peggy! The class itself is difficult (content-heavy and fast-paced), and my top recommendation is that you read the textbook before class lectures. Do practice problems as much as possible; that'll help most with quizzes and exams. Peggy is so sweet and extremely helpful with answering questions. Difficult class, but great professor!

Well-spoken, knowledgeable teacher who cares about her students and will take the requisite time to explain things personally. Lots of office hours, TA office hours, and stays after class. I found reading the chapter before class very helpful but I know a lot of people who didn't and still did well in the class. Would take again.

Professor O'Kelly's ACC1201 class is challenging but rewarding. She holds you accountable, but provides great resources. I found unstuck study really helpful for exam prep. Overall, a tough but worthwhile class.

Peggy O'Kelly was easily one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern. She is understanding of students' outside circumstances and makes herself easily available for help. The content of the course is difficult but she clearly outlines expectations and ways to succeed in her class. She genuinely wants her students to succeed.
Peggy is a great accounting teacher. FR2 is a pretty heavy course, but the exams/quizzes are easy if you can work through in class examples and the homework.

peggy was undoubtedly the best professor i've had at NU. im not math/finance-savvy but peggy held my hand and worked with me privately to make sure i succeeded as best i could. she is extremely supportive+a good prof. if you miss a lecture, you will fall behind. take good notes, and study the worksheets given in class bc its identical to the tests
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: FR2 is just hard. She's a great teacher and was very clear for what you need to know for the test. The class is very tough as it is the final acct class but it is rewarding to finish with her. The Project, Participation and HW grade act as a curve for your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor is really kind and she cares a lot about her students, however she's not a great teacher but her slides are good. The quizzes are really hard and long, so were the midterm and the final but there's a big curve.

Took her for 1201. there are 3 quizzes + 1 midterm + 1 final. ALL of that with homework due every Sunday and a 2 part group project. On top - attendance is marked and class participation matters. All exams are in person. She is a good teacher if you can keep up . You will miss homework at least one with no chances regrade.

Professor O'Kelly was the lecturer (not facilitator) for my online accounting class and was really sweet. I wish she was the facilitator (Annie Witte) as she was pretty brutal/condescending/would almost go out of her way to not help.
I failed ACCT 1201 the first time I took it, I got an A with Prof O'Kelly and it didn't even feel like trying. Amazing. 5 stars.

Lowkey a harder professor, but the best one you will receive. You need to know the information taught in the class for future classes. She also won't let you slack off so be prepared for her class. Class is curved a little bit and extra credit is offered.
Great teacher but the class was pretty difficult. She gives you a lot of resources to study and makes efficient use of class time.

ALOT of individual work, but I'm usually fine with that. However, she doesn't reall prepare you for the tests because they are always questioned weirdly, when you studied your ass off for them. She a nice person, but she talks rlly slow in class so context seems 1000x harder. I def think she could've prepared us alot better with practice questions.

Professor O'Kelly was a very good teacher and offers a lot of outside help. The class material is difficult and it is not a easy class, but it is explained well and there is lots of materials provided to help.

Professor O'Kelly was kind and caring. I left the class feeling like I learned a lot. She taught the material we needed for the exams, and didn't make us memorize ratios/ parts of the course we didn't need to know

There are many assignments and a lot of midterms and quizzes. She gives you the opportunity to receive good grades, but mainly if you study on your own and independently learn the topic. Her in class lectures are sometimes very brief and confusing. Overall amazing teacher and very patient. Goes out of her way to help a student if they need it.

There's a reason why there are so many great reviews of her. If I could have taken her for every single accounting class, I would've. I've never understood material the way I did when I took her class. Love her!!

I don't think I would have passed with any other professor. She is an extremely caring person and truly puts effort into every student. Her classes are a positive environment, and she will always be available to help you. She turned a relatively difficult class into a great learning experience. Love you peggy

peggy is so so sweet!! she is an amazing lecturer and explains complicated concepts super well. she is available outside of class to help and explain in depth. she held extra office hours before each exam. the material and tests are hard but fair and there is a participation grade too. no graded hw, but def do it for practice! 12/10 recommend!!

i love peggy!! she was so sweet and absolutely amazing at explaining concepts when we were confused. every class, she'd take the time to check in with almost every student as while we were doing the in-class problems. i genuinely learned so much. she had her funny moments too, a queen

Truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She's very responsive to her emails, and makes it a point to ensure the whole class knows both her and the TAs have office hours. She happily takes time to respond to any questions in class. Very organized. Homework is due weekly, and is through the texbook. Absolutely loved her!!
Very understanding and knowledgeable teacher. Grading standards are clear, and preparation for exams is done really well. One of my favorite accounting professors hands down.

Professor O'Kelly's class was so enjoyable and informative. She has a ton of experience in accounting and it definitely shows through her lectures. She is a sweet, caring woman that really wants to see her students succeed and will take the time to make sure that students really understand important concepts in the course, truly a great professor

She is such a great professor. She inspired me to add a concentration in accounting to my major. She is so understanding and really wants to see her students succeed. She loves participation and fosters a safe talking environment.

Professor Peggy cares about her students. I personally dislike accounting, but having her didn't make it worse. I'd recommend. Accessible outside of class. When we were remote, our homework was due at 11:59PM on Saturday, thus not promoting a healthy school/life balance, which I really didn't appreciate. Other than that, only good things to say!

Great teacher. Really brings up the value of our school. Responds to emails quickly, understanding of different situations, and truly cares about her students. 1 homework assignment a week in two parts, but really helps learn and is just like the quizzes and midterms. Love her! If you want a good environment to learn online and in person, she's it!

Peggy is amazing. You have to buy a classpack which has all the slides and is way better than the textbook. Homework is very manageable. Only one group project, which isn't too hard. Lectures are very helpful and she will remember your name and answer your questions. Must take!

I currently have professor Kelly and she's honestly one of the sweetest teachers I've met. You can tell she really cares about both her job and the students. The class itself also isn't hard. As long as you follow the lectures, do the worksheets that we do in class anyway, and the required homework assignments, you should be able to get a good grad
I really enjoyed taking the class with Peggy. I find her to be very inspirational and a great teacher! She has made me want to pursue accounting!

I had professor O'Kelly for Financial Accounting and she was amazing. Accounting can be difficult to learn for the first time and she does a great job communicating complex topics and making sure you are prepared for the exams. You have to work for an A, but it's definitely possible if you show up and do the work
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Don't take her class. Tough grader.

She puts up videos and her TA's are amazing they reply instantly. It's a good introductory course to fin acct. I suggest taking it online as it pushes you to actually learn but at the same time have the confidence of support from your TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Peggy is very caring and accommodating with her office hours. She even offers extra help if you are willing to learn. I took 2 courses with her and absolutely she wants her students to succeed and offers her best! Thank You Professor Peggy!

The tests in the class are difficult. Results aren't great, but I understood the material. Never really had to use the textbook because everything outside of the textbook could be used and were more helpful. Prof and TAs weren't very helpful. I recommend taking another prof.

Financial accounting is the most difficult class I've had at Northeastern, but I'm glad I took it with Peggy O'Kelly. She's an excellent teacher who makes you appreciate the topic, helps you learn, extends generous office hours, and offers lots of material to study from. Still, don't expect accounting to be easy, even with a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor O'Kelly is the best professor I have had at Northeastern thus far! She is very articulate and clear in her lectures, and makes it a point to solidify our understanding with worksheets in class and Connect homework outside of class. She is helpful with office hours and she's extremely nice. Her tests and grading is fair!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was a great professor. She knew what she was doing and explained things well and really wants you to pass. She gives you a lot of optional things to practice with which is really helpful for the final. Her class is top notch.
It was a fairly easy class but not taking anything away from the professor. was recommended by a friend am glad i took her class. explains well and comes prepared.

Best professor I've had at NU. Take her class! She teaches in a way that makes the material so much more understandable than it is in the textbook. Go to her office hours and homework help sessions if you are struggling and she will focus on the areas that you are struggling with. Focus on her class problems to do well on tests.

Peggy is the best accounting teacher there is! She really knows the information inside out and is extremely helpful. All the accounting sections learn the same thing and have the same types of quizzestests, but there is no question that she teaches the material the best. She is the most professional teacher I've ever had! Definitely recommend!

Accounting shouldn't be taken online, and Professor O'Kelly herself seems very uncomfortable with the format. That said, it's laid out fairly well, with reminders for all the homework that needs to be completed, etc etc. Her lectures don't fully cover the homework you are expected to complete, and you have to do online research on your own to do it
She's an amazing accounting teacher! Loved her class. Takes things step by step and gives examples to follow each lecture.
Professor O'Kelly has a great teaching style! I felt like I was learning the material well in class and then having that knowledge reinforced by the online work was really helpful.
quiz and exam are hard

She's absolutely wonderful! Explains things clearly and her in-class lectures and exercises are so helpful. She doesn't put anything surprising on her tests and quizzes. If you put forth the effort you should do pretty well.
Best professor I have had at Northeastern. Her classes are interesting and easy to sit through. You have to take accounting you should absolutely take it with her.
Best professor in acct department. Very clear and helpful. Three exams and four quizs (drop the lowest one probably). Just come to class and do the hw problems you should be fine.
she is a charming person and a very helpful professor
She is a good techer, her explanations are clear, I don't even need to use a textbook! I like this class, it is realtively easy for me

One of the best teachers I have ever had I would recommend her to anyone! she is so clear in the way that she teaches and breaks the class up between problem sets and lecture. She really cares about her students understanding the material. I never used the textbook and still got an A. She's the best!!

She is a good teacher, but you have to try in the class. There are online homeworks and online quizzes every week, which wasn't that bad. The midterm and final were all right, but you absolutely had to study. We also had 2 "Problem Sets" that are just problem packets. I would recommend her.

Don't get tricked into thinking this is an easy A. While the homework is pretty straightforward and easy, the midterm/exams completely were a stark surprise... I mean since it's online you tend to slack but people getting below 70% on the exams were pretty much the norm.. Not an easy A

Great professor who is very knowledgeable in her subject. Accounting is not something fun to me, but she made class interesting with handouts. Connect Assignments are challenging, but she makes the "Check My Work" button available, so that you can check your answers as many times as you want. Tests and quizzes are challenging.

Great professor, best one I had last semester. Very passionate about accounting, explains all the topics very thoroughly and prepares handouts for each lesson to practice what went over during the class. Go to class and pay attention to what she says, and you shouldn't have problems with the material. Takes attendance, so don't skip the classes.
outstanding
great teacher recommendable if you go to class your fine.

Pay Attention and you'll do fine. Not an easy subject,and if you fall behind its EXTREMELY hard to get back up to speed. Not a class to take if your looking for an easy grade. Tough grader on tests/quizzes, never gives a curve or extra credit. Requires a good deal of outside studying to keep up. She knows the material better than any other teacher.
Do the work and pay attention in class and it is an easy class.  She is very clear and cares about her students.

I had her for Managerial Accounting. Her lectures are a bit dry but I liked the class exercises. She hands out exercise papers and gives time during class to do them. And then you go over it. It helped me learn a lot.

Professor O'Kelly is awesome, and anyone who says otherwise is jaded by a bad grade. She very clearly lays out complicated material and offers office hours all the time to help anyone who needs it. She is genuinely interested in helping her students learn and is highly recommended.

Comes across as fake (I see right past her smile) and makes you feel uncomfortable to ask questions.  Also, unclear as to her expectations.  Her explanations are good but tacky.  Clearly rehearses before class and she often makes mistakes on the board which is evidence of her studying her examples without understanding them.
Reads her power point way too much and doesnt work enough problems. I can read the powerpoint myself.  Really nice, but could be so much better if she actually did problems in class and not read.
Great professor, highly recommend. I put in little to no effort and was able to understand all of the material and get an A.

she's not jaded like most profs. im probably getting a C+ in this class and i still like her(class avg is about a b+). don't fall behind on reading if it's a summer class. she'll go the extra mile for you, ex: she customized an explanation for me on her own time and gave it to me the next class. the material is challenging, but you should take her.

Very Clear. Perfect amount of hw, follow the syllabus and it's easy  to keep on top of it. Quizzes/Tests are similar enough to class exercises, no curve balls there. Extremely helpful, extremely nice, and makes sure you know the TA so that resource is available as well.
Clear and concise

Probably the most happiest professor I've seen at northeastern. She loves to teach, extremely friendly, and helpful. The class is much harder than Intermediate accounting 1, so be prepared to do a lot of work. She always curves. Two exams, 1 final, participation, quizzes.

Professor O' Kelly is a very helpful, crystal clear professor. Her mood in class is always positive, encouraging students to participate and making them comfortable asking questions. She also reminds the free tutoring sessions offered by the ACCT department. She also gives quizzes regularly, making sure no one falls behind.
Had her for both financial and managerial accounting.  Very good professor, nice person.  Explains topics very clearly.
Honestly one of the best classes I've taken at Northeastern solely because of Prof O'Kelly. She is very clear, always willing to help, and makes the material interesting.

Very good. Recommended! She is the best accounting teacher at Northeastern University. Very clear and concise. You just need a good logic and you'll be fine. Practice the exercises though, this will help you a lot in the quizzes and exams!

Lectures are clear and concise.  Homework assignments do not take long to complete and helps a lot with understanding.  Reading the textbook before class helps, but she explains everything so well that you'll still understand it even if you don't read.  Reading the text helps with tests though, which are not hard if you study a little bit.

Best prof ive had so far. She really wants you to succeed and is very understanding. I enjoyed going to class and she taught the material very effectively and simplified things. Quizzes and tests were challenging but if you go to class, keep up on the HW, and follow the review sheets and sessions she gives, you will do great in the class.

SO easy, but incredibly boring. You will definitely get a good grade, but you have to be prepared for excruciatingly long, dull lectures.  She always had us do practice problems in class, and gave us 20 min to work them through... and then would work through them completely on the board...so its like doing the same problem twice and its painful.

did not learn anything from this professor- taught all the material to myself... has a nice personality but doesnt seem interested in helping studetnts succeed. you really have to pay attention in class and even if you do its still hard to understand the material.

Prof. O'Kelly is so nice! She is willing to help you out as much as you need. She really wants you to do well in the class, and explains concepts very well. Exams are fair. Work hard and you'll get an A.
Best Professor at Northeastern. Goes beyond just teaching the textbook, makes class interesting and legitmately cares about making sure you're learning what you need to know. She ROCKS!

She's a good teacher. She gives good explainations and she really is concerned about your best interests. However, her Group Field Project (Group Project) is almost a waste of time because its a lot of work and its only worth 10% of your grade.
She's an excellent professor; this is the second time I've had her. Exams are fair, reviews are comprehensive, and she's just a great professor. Highly recommended.

BEST professor at northeastern (and not just because she was easy on the eyes)... ONLY O'Kelly could make auditing interesting. I had NO experience with auditing. O'Kelly's awesome!
Fabulous professor. Learned a lot and it wasn't difficult at all!

She is a very nice person and very fair grader. It's not the easiest class but everything she requires can be done. I ended up with a pretty good grade and I didn't do well on everything so just show up for class and try your best and she will make sure you get a good grade.
awesome prof, she relays her information very clearly.  really nice lady, respects hard workers and made accounting somewhat interesting
Great teacher, easy to understand and very helpful. Take her class if you have the chance.

Fairly good class.  Class is not too dificult, however O'Kelly doesn't make it easier.She is one of those professors who simply just reads out of the book,well in her case a powerpoint presentation.Doesn't articulate on much.Her TA is this french man who speaks very poor English so that doesn'help.
She's pretty good. She's not super easy. but if you keep up with the work you'll get a pretty good grade.

She is a good teacher but the way she teaches was more in a presentation format just going by he PowerPoint slides and not really using the book. Plus she only gives 2 quizzes so you don't have much to work with if you do poorly.  I was not satisfied.

She is simple and plain, a great teacher, If you want to learn, take this class, just read, do your work and pay attention and you will do fine.  I have no idea, why that guy on the bottom wrote that about her, maybe he never went to class. I got an A
Peggy is very bubbly which is great for 8AM class when everyone is tired.  Really knows the material and teaches it well. Burps alot.
Easy, plain and simple, watch out for her misbuttoned top though.

Great Professor, a lot of enthusiasm about the subject. He is quite funny, if you have an extremely closed and PC mind you might not enjoy his humor, I did. If you put a decent effort in to watching the films and the few assignments, you will reep the benefits.

I was worried that the professor had passed away due to his lack of participation and lack of feedback. This class was taken in an online format, and while the content was good, but the professor was clearly not interested. You're more or less on your own.

It was a good class, sometimes interesting. His knowledge in the field kinda made the class a bit more fun BUT he is not a good professor at all. Rude and very deceiving. If you can avoid him, then do so. You don't want to waste your time nor ruin your university life.
Amazing teacher.  Intellectually stimulating while fun and interesting. Amazing class.

D'agati loves to tach and is really great at it.  If you think the topic of his course sounds interesting than it will be.  He is extremely knowledgable so you feel like you are listening to an encyclopedia.  His classwork isn't hard if you pay attention and enjoy the topic he just makes you critically think... which is never a bad thing!

Phil is great. Don't take model un if you don't want to participate in model un, but if you do (and you should!), you'll like him. Everybody does. Can't speak for his other classes, but I assume they're fun, because he's a good guy. Highly recommended.

Great instructor. Whole class seemed to like lectures/discussions.  Course on Politics of the Middle East. He adapted class to events of Arab Spring as they took place. Best class I had this semester.  Assignments were fair, but hard to keep track of.  Lectures were casual and interactive. Obviously knew a lot about the subject.
Attended for MUN course. Made sarcastic political comments, don't really care about progress.

He's a nice guy; answers all questions and explains things thorougly. Take home final; in class midterm; map quiz. TA's send around an attendance sheet each class. Gives extra credit if you do Model UN. I wouldn't go out of my way to take another class with him, but was glad to have him for IR compared to other options!

One of the best Profs I've had.  Exams are take-home, attendance is not mandatory,  everything you need to write for notes is clearly said twice.  He will answer any question, if he does not know he will admit it and have an answer for you next class.  A true class act with a sense of humor.
Nice professor, rather easy class but found it interesting. Only had 2 takehome exams and a paper

Is this a joke? How can he be rated so high? Worst professor I ever had! Difficult to deal with, set in his own ways, not willing to conform to the needs of students, rude. Don't take his class again!
Good to listen to if your interested in politics, understands students because he is young and logical in assignments

He's really nice. He gives alot of Homework questions which consist of 20% of the final grade. He explains the material using different techniques which is good. But the course is hard tho and u need to work hard.

Excellent teacher.  Circuits is hard at first, but he goes over the material well and reviews before the start of each lecture.  His office hours are extremely helpful and he is really nice and willing to help.

He is the best out of the 4+ professors that teach Linear Circuits which is a very difficult course.  He is extremely willing to help, take advantage of his office hours.  Don't worry if you don't understand the examples the first time, just ask questions and you will get it.
he is extremely helpful, respectable, knowledgeable, and a very good person. take with him.

Excellet professor and person!!!
Prof Serafim is great. He is really smart, he really knows his stuff. One of the smartest professors I have had.  The class was kind of hard but it is scaled a lot.
Best Professor I've ever had.

This professor is THE best professor I have had. This class is in his research area, so that helps a lot! He comes to class with NO notes and derives everything from his head, 99% right. He's a little tough on the grading, but generous with his scaling. He gives practical examples, which are key!

He's alright,nothing spectacular.Once in a blue moon he'll make a joke or two.The class is tough material,but his tests are very reasonable.As long as you practice all of the HW problems before each test, you'll do fine.Buying the answers to the HW online helped save lots of time for other classes.
Pretty good teacher overall. Nothing spectacular but nothing to complain about. Gave extensions when HW was difficult. Fair grader.

Difficult to listen to. Gives terrible in class notes. Willing to answer questions if you can follow his lecture enough to ask them. Needs to explain material in different ways to make up for where the book is lacking. He's a nice guy, but it's a hard course; you may need a tutor.

He is an excellent teacher for a hard class.  You really have to put in the hours for the homework in this class, and go to class every day.  Your grade is based on homework, 2 midterms and the final.  Grades are scaled at the end.  Be careful, he writes his V's like U's.
This person is more than a genuis! He knows everything about what he teaches. I think Northeastern is very very lucky to have him on their faculty
One of the best professors at NU. Clear and not very hard. A+. Highly Recommended

Extremely unapproachable. Quizzes are super unpredictable and her grading is as well. Rarely if ever gives points back after poor grading. Youll learn, but your grade wont reflect how much you know. Studying is rarely effective. Boring lectures off of powerpoints that have such little info on them theyre useless outside of class. Freshmen AVOID.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took Professor Strauss's class back in fall 2012 and in retrospect she was the worst professor I have ever had in my 5 years at Northeastern. Made my first semester of college a stressful nightmare. I graduated with a 3.9 so don't believe those people who tell you to "apply yourself" the quizzes were on random things she thought you should know.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Strauss means well, I'm sure she does. But in a class where all of her students were freshmen, she consistently failed to outline what she was asking for in our papers and let our grades suffer as a result. To be fair, a pretty hefty curve is applied at the end, but don't rely on that curve. Good luck if you have her! (you'll need it)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Strauss is unbelievably  hard and does not care about her students. She is very rude and thinks so highly of herself that she does not see that her students have no idea what she is talking about. She expects graduate level work from freshmen and sophomores. No matter how hard you study, you will not do well unless you can literally read her mind.

Don't get me wrong, Professor Strauss is very accomplished and she has so much knowledge to share. I just think as someone as informed as her, she expects too much from her students, most of whom are freshman. As a result, some of the material she goes over, is very hard to follow. She genuinely wants you to learn and understand the material.

Took her Cancer Biology Inquiries class. Heh.   There's no point of studying for her quizzes, because you'll not do well anyways. Her powerpoint notes are next to useless (and so are your own notes), other than learning definitions and staring at graphs/images/tables which confuse you even more. Lectures are beyond boring. Time stops, I swear.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This is a hard class. That said, if you truly apply yourself and put in your best effort, you can get an A. Strauss is there to help you, but she will not like it if you do not care about the subject material. If you try hard, you can succeed.  Also, do not underestimate the level of detail she requires for her quizzes.

This is my favorite class I've taken all year.  I learned so much in Strauss's class and was always interested in the material. That being said, this class is not for the faint of heart. Strauss is a tough grader who expects "graduate level" work from her freshman students.  The high expectations are met with high reward, as you will learn so much.

Professor Strauss is the worst professor I have ever had. Her lectures are long and confusing while  her powerpoint slides are utterly useless as they make no sense without explanation. There are 3 books required for this course and so far, we haven't used any of them yet.
The worst professor I've ever had. Completely arbitrary grading system. The material is interesting, don't get me wrong. She just enjoys screwing her students.
She is very unclear and unhelpful. Also rude

Avoid this class. I doesn't matter if you think you can just study hard or that you had a background in the material before. She cant teach, she doesnt want to clarify, and shes extremely unfair when it comes to grading.

While she is a very smart bichemist she is a terrible teacher. She is unclear when she answers questions and her powerpoints do not make sense. If you have to take this class, you will need a good tutor. You can do well in this class as long as you work really hard and do work outside of class to understand material.

Quite possibly the worst professor I have ever had. Took Inquiries with her last year and after two semesters at Northeastern can say she is ridiculous. She thinks she helps when she only confuses you more, the quizzes are impossible (I did better when I DIDN'T study because the questions are so off topic) and she really does not know how to teach

I have actually never had a more ridiculous teacher. She does not help you in the slightest bit if you don't understand something. If you're thinking about taking her class, just don't. It's so much work just to get a mediocre grade, esp. compared to the rest of the Inquiries classes. She teaches complex graduate level info to entering freshman.
Awful. Doesn't help when you ask questions.  You never know what her quizzes are on.  She teaches grad level stuff to freshmen.

Yes, Phyllis is demanding, and has high expectations. For this reason, however, she is one of the only professors you will actually LEARN ANYTHING from. Fantastic professor, extremely encouraging, motivating, passionate, and dedicated. There is no getting around slacking off, but if you put the work in, you will be fine.

If you want to learn about her stupid zebrafish, take this class. If you want to learn anything of any value at all towards furthering your education, drop out right now. You will learn nothing and only be frustrated and annoyed.
BIOU409? Run as fast away from this class as possible if she is your teacher
I got an A in her class...and I still think she is the worst teacher I have ever and will ever have. Not one person complained about their grades...they complained about her.

The worst part about her classes are the fact that they are filled with the annoying kids who are used to getting straight A's in high school and complain non-stop once they realize that, in order to get a good grade in her class, they actually have to work.  As long as you pay attention and take notes in her class, you're fine.
she really should just be assigned to her lab and leave the teaching to someone who knows how teach and is more professional overall

three words:opinionated, rude, and degrading. All of your grades, quizzes and essays, are based only on her opinion of who she thinks you are. She will call you stupid in class, embarrass you in front of everyone, and provide no means of help.  Don't take this class.I read all the bad comments about her and took the class anyways, my biggest regret
Has no business teaching.

had her freshman year for bio409 n she isnt difficult as long as you pay attention to her lectures, take down everything she SAYS not only whats written on the board and study the slides over and over again. the book was useless and so general i knew more from AP bio. but you can learn a lot if you DO try and understand what she's looking for tests

If I do not get into Medical School this women will be responsible.  Spent more time studying for her impossible 10 minute long quizzes than I did for Organic Chemistry.  Did much better in orgo.  She grades on a curve.  If every student got a perfect 100 in the class she would make every one's grade a B- on principle.   I seriously don't recommend

So if a question asks two specific things you better answer them and then add 5 more ambiguous things. Class avg is all over the chart, will quiz on anything she feels like, pretty much two slides out of a week of notes. Grading is eratic and grading on papers is tweaked to create the perfect bell curve.  Take another advanced elective if possible.

This class had extremely high expectations. Instead, there is nothing where you can learn from when Phyllis provides confusing lectures. She expects the class to follow a logic which is incomprehehsible. When I study harder for each test, my grade dimishes in a downward spiral. I am a bio major, and this is my worst class.

Professor Strauss grades quizzes based on her expectations for the class average.  She doesnt care if you get an answer right or wrong, she just takes off points if other people in the class already got good grades.  It doesnt make any sense at all.  You can get lucky on a quiz though if you put some kind of phrase that is burned into her mind.

She is so ridiculous.  On our first quiz the class average was a 76 and she told us that was too high.  She says one thing but means another.  She expects specific answers for vague questions.  Points are deducted if you cannot read her mind on what she REALLY means behind her test questions.
No Comments

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. The prof hardly knows what he is talking about, will circle around the same topic for 30+ mins, uses chatgpt for slides (if he even uses slides). You're graded on 5 scene responses and 5 tests. 90+ page readings, no study guides. If you're taking this for NU path, think again. This class was hardly about film or music.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Prof is a cool guy, but needs to get his act together. He will explain one concept or assignment 5 times and you still will not understand what he's talking about. One time he asked us for feedback on the course, we said fewer 50+ page readings before each class, and he got mad at us. 5/80 people participated in this class and it was sad.

I feel bad bc bro seems cool, but he needs to get it together. He will explain an assignment 5 times and you still won't understand what he wants from you bc he is so unclear when he talks. He asked for feedback on the class once and when we said fewer 50+ page readings, he got mad at us. 5/80 people participated in class. It was sorta sad.

This class isn't hard and prof is cool, but he needs to get it together. He will describe an assignment 5 times and you still won't understand what he wants from you bc everything he says is unclear. He also asked us for feedback, we said fewer 50+ page readings for every class, and he got mad at us. 5/80 people participated in class discussions.

This class is graded on 5 scene responses and 5 MCQ tests for the most part, and this is based on really long readings. You can claude the readings and everything, and still succeed, however if you don't want a headache-- don't take him. Not worth it unless there's a specific requirement he can satisfy.

if u think this is an easy A for NU path course, youre wrong. there are 5 tests, 5 scene responses, 3 projects, and readings with 100+ pages every night. the tests are based off of the 100+ pages, but had no study guides prepared for the 3 of the tests. gradings can be nit picky to the point of adding decimals. oh and attendance is mandatory
The lecture is one big discussion, and no material is taught. Test material is not discussed in class, and I was teaching myself. 90+ page readings for homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: None of the terms for test 1 were defined in class. Doesn't take feedback well and rather blames the learning style rather than teaching style. Insane for a 1000 level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
For a Film Music class, he really doesn't focus very much on the intersection of film and music. He has a background in music which shows, but otherwise makes up for his lack of knowledge/teaching skill by assigning way too much reading.

If I wanted to learn about African poetry and drumming, I'd have taken a class in that. I wanted Film Music. :/
easy A take if u need elective, mostly entirely group projects but no test or quizzes

I really did not enjoy experience design with him. He based a lot of his class around his own work in music, which is not related to design. Overall the class was very disorganized and he was very unclear all around. Even when students voiced concerns to him directly. The class had to write to the department about our concerns as well
Matt is amazing, his classes are engaging and very enjoyable, I highly recommend taking his courses if you're looking for an elective.

Wonderful professor who is spirited, a great communicator, and creates a really collaborative environment. I had so much fun in this class and got to know my classmates due to the structure so well. He is a bit of a tough grader but gives really good feedback (minus bad handwriting) but is always willing to answer questions!

Professor Pitchford is a great professor with a great personality. The class material was interesting and up to date with current issues, making the discussed information feel truly valuable. Professor Pitchford created a welcoming atmosphere for participation and encouraged collaboration with other classmates, making our classroom very connected.

TAKETHISCLASS. Taught by a grad student, not Matt. You only see him on online video lectures. I'm not great with public speaking; this class definitely helped. Daily speeches every day. It was inspiring to hear other's talk about their experiences. People complained, vented, talked about their favorite book. Everything. I will miss this class.

This class was super easy. I learned a lot, and anyone could as long as they put effort into speeches and show up to class. However, he does not teach the class. You watch online lectures from him as homework (10-15 mins), but the class itself is taught by a grad student. Easy A as long as you put in effort, and the grad student was super nice.

The professor never showed up to class, it's taught by a grad student. Easy class but I didn't learn anything. The grad student is very nice. Grades are easy. As long as you show up you'll get an A. You would have to try to get a bad grade, and even then, I don't think you could do it.

This class was very interesting, but not difficult. He taught the concepts of speaking in interesting ways. TA gives good feedback on speeches. Grading isn't too tough, good amount of speech assignments, some reflections, and easy 3 question untimed quizzes based on the lectures. Very nice guy, fun class.

Social Movement Comm was a very thought-provoking course. Each class was a discussion about a homework reading. He encourages participation and creates a non-judgmental atmosphere for students to share. He's fun to listen to and approachable with questions. The course has lots of writing for hw assignments but most of them are short and low-stakes.

Really, really amazing prof! Hope to take classes from him in the future, can't recommend him enough! Always so knowledgable, passionate, and engaging. Classes involve a lot of casual partner/class discussions;  prof makes sure everyone's heard. Homework/bigger assignments and tests are totally easy, just show up and take good notes.

I LOVEEEE DR P!!! This was my fav class all year (as a stem major). He made everyone feel so understood and cared for. Participation matters but this was the least intimidating class ever and so enjoyable, even as a quiet student. Course content was relevant and interesting, though there's a lot of reading. Would def take classes with him again

Matt Pitchford is a great professor. His class is very fun and students are prompted to participate and engage in discussion. Speeches require preparation, but as long as you don't stand with your hands in your pockets and read off a sheet of paper you will do just fine. Absolutely recommend.

Fantastic professor. Definitely take his class. He gives students a comfortable class environment to overcome nerves when speaking in front of an audience. Students give short 1-2 minute speeches daily regarding a random topic which is amazing practice. All of the speech prompts are clear and you are able to pick topics you are passionate about.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I'd recommend social movement communication to everyone. He was such an easy teacher and grader and so clear and straight forward and I learned so much from the class.

just a public speaking class, he made us do different type of presentations. speaking exercises with partners most of the time and the final is a Pros and cons debate where you speak for like 5 minutes

kindest and easiest prof i've ever had. his lectures are interesting but if you just study the notes he provides for each chapter before the test you will do fine. decent amount of busywork, but def worth it. highly recommend.

love Prof. Piao. had him for an 8am and was actually excited to go because he was great. He managed to be very engaging, even that early in the morning. Homework heavy for grades but they are easy to do well on. tests are easy if you do practice tests. Easy A
love this guy he so nice

Genuinely so sweet, works office hours around if students need it, and wants students to succeed. Heavy hw but it is easy to get 100% on. For each of 15 ch's, 1 pre-lecture vid, 1 learning curve, 1 20Q hw. Gives practice exams for each chapter to review concepts and exam is very similar. You'll learn a lot and likely end w an A if you do the work.

Pr. Piao's class had lots of easy homework assignments that made up 40% of our grade. Tests were kinda difficult but manageable. His lectures were boring but he was very caring and enthusiastic about the class. I'd recommend! Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Most of your grade is made up by homework so as long as you do that you have an automatic A in the class. Three tests, each 10% each, and if you do the chapter review questions before the exam you're golden. The tests are super easy, so nothing to stress about. Although boring sometimes, Dr. Piao is so so nice and wholesome, tries to make class fun

Dr. Piao is simply an incredible professor. His slides are gorgeous, he's a good lecturer, a fair grader, and he's very understanding. He teaches at a reasonable pace and will always make his grading criteria very clear. He'll also go over tests with you in great detail if you go to office hours. Northeastern's lucky to have him.

take micro with him. no final and you only have 3 tests (which altogether still count less than the homework assignments). He assigns a lot of work but its pretty easy to get done so most people will have 98-100% in homework assignment grades which will save your grade for any score on the exams. Hes also very nice and always responds to emails.
GOAT, will take his class again if possible. Interesting class and easy grader.
He is the goat. Genuinely such a kind, communicative, and caring professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Goat. Fav prof at NEU and I've had some great ones

Professor Piao was amazing for Macro during Summer 1. Ton of work; however, he gave time to do so. Unlimited attempts on most of the Macmillan assignments. Lots of mini projects and sometimes the peer reviews would not pop up until last minute, likely due to errors from Canvas. Great professor that gives full marks for completion of assignments.

Dr. Piao is a great professor! His lectures were sometimes long, however, he brings in great examples to try and keep us engaged. There are many assignments and mini-projects, but easy grade boosters. Tests are online and every similar to the practice exams. The final was semi-open note. He is accessible outside of class and very understanding!!

He puts so, so much effort into his presentations and lectures. The class is pretty easy but there's a lot of busy work in Achieve. This professor is so accommodating and cares about students. I regret not getting to know him more. Class material is pretty boring but he tries to bring in fun examples. Take him!!!
Legend, awesome guy.
The absolute GOAT! Caring, intelligent, and passionate, take his class!

Offers tons of office hours and extra help. Tests aren't super difficult and have a semester group project that helps get your grade up. Really willing to help out students and super nice. He also answers emails really often and is very flexible.

Professor Piao is a great guy who clearly cares deeply about his work. The amount of effort he puts in his slideshows are crazy and his lectures are straightforward and easy to follow. Sometimes the homework can be hard and if you are not a fan of multiple choice tests then I would avoid, but other than that his teaching style is great
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very caring professor who wants you to understand the material. Relies on slideshows so just show up to class
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took econ 2316 with him before and econ4691 information economics and game theory this semester but it was not on the list. Professor Piao was very helpful during office hours and was extremely generous on grading exams. Like, he only took 1 point out of 5 even you got more than half of your answers wrong. Highly recommended.

3 exams (noncumulative) add up to 55% of total grade. The rest is a group project and biweekly assignment. Very accessible after class and willing to help. Exams are very manageable, and the questions are derived from biweekly homework questions. If you are answering the homework questions easily, this class should be easy most of the time.
Love him. Extremely nice guy.
Tests were very much difficult. homework only before tests and one group project. Seemed very disorganized and wasn't that helpful. However, he's very kind and truly tries his best.

professor piao is v nice and flexible! had issues with my group mates and he was very understanding and dropped one of my grades for the group project. very funny and charismatic guy. you could probably get away with not going to lectures if you read the slides or are familiar with material. practice quizzes will have problems that are on tests!!!
Tests were extremely difficult, not much homework.

Professor Piao is honestly a really kind guy. I've never made a review on here before but he's definitely my favorite professor I've had so far and I hope I can take another class with him. His teaching style is really great, he is funny and you can tell he really cares about getting students to actually understand the material, overall I recommend
He's a G
Great professor but a heavy workload, however, as long as you do it, full marks are given
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Piao is always available if you email him and super understanding.
Very nice professor, he is good at teaching.
Really nice guy who knows what he's talking about. The class was very easy, I did not do anything outside of class besides homework.
Best prof ever!!!!!Easy classes, fair grading, can't expect anything better!

Very kind person who helps you through email, office hours,in person, etc. He might be nervous at times, but he really is a kindhearted soul that want to help all his students pass with nothing less than a A. Get this man and your on your way to nothing less than an 4.0 freshman year.
Great man!
Took online course. Really well structured by the professor. I'd definitely take another class with him.
great prof - no textbook because he created own cases and saved us money. Gave quizzes that meant we kept up with learning. He added jokes to entertain

Great professor. Attendance not mandotory but will be good if you go to class in order to do fine on quizzes. The quizzes make the most point and the final is mix of all. You use minitab and there is also an assignment from that.

Disregard the rating below. He is a great prof!! He covers material at a manageable pace & takes it a step at a time. Offers 6 tests and 1 final (cumulative), drops the lowest test, & 2 are take home. Go to class, study his notes (which he puts online), and you'll be fine. Best part: he didn't follow the textbook so that was $120 back in my pocket.

Terrible professor. Was not consistant with exam difficulty and graded on a strange curve that no one could understand. We learned different material than all the other classes of the same name and what we did learn had to have been self taught because this guy could not teach. He was very unclear in everything and should never teach again.

She reminded me of an elementary school teacher/mom and tried to be inspirational. Was a picky grader (esp with the outlines) and even speeches that we generally thought were fine she would have criticism over (you should speak reaally slow). Listening to other people's stories was interesting though. Be prepared for possible trauma dumps.

Professor P seems very sweet at first but can get a bit cold later in the semester. She does have clear favorites where she gives 100s to every time and everyone else is left to the A/B range. Overall a low stress class if you enjoy public speaking. No homework ever but you do need to make sure you practice your stories.
Professor P is amazing. By far the best professor I've had.

She seems caring, however, the grading feels subjective. Would say we did well, but then the rubric and grade would say otherwise. Graded very harshly for minor mistakes and did not account for the effort put in. I thought this would be a fun comm elective and only took this as an open elective but wish I had taken a class that fulfilled my major.

Idk why everyone loves this prof so much. I truly hate being mean, but this class (Storytelling) was an absolute waste of time. Wouldve been a fun club, but thousands of dollars just to learn one or two things and still actually struggle to get what should be an easy A? Nah. She is definitely nice and eccentric, but gets oddly cold. Be warned!

Prof P is amazing! Very caring, motivational, and respectful to her students! Her class was very fun to attend and really helped my public speaking skills. I hated pubic speaking and was very bad at it but Prof P told me to believe in myself and after one bad performance, I did really well! My confidence level definitely grew in this class!!

Prof. P is an incredible woman! She is so full of life, light, and joy. If you're willing to put in the effort and be vulnerable, this class is so so therapeutic and an easy/fun A. She is super caring and loving. Has been a real support for me throughout college (long after our course got over) and is easily my most favorite professor. Take her!

Love Prof. P, she is so caring and thoughtful. I grew as a speaker and my confidence in general. I loved going to class and I was able to learn so much about my classmates. However, final grades were a bit arbitrary. She isnt clear on the criteria for your final grade and didnt seem to always stick to the way the syllabus laid out the grading.

I loathe public speaking and I learned a TON from her. I got really close to everyone because of how open and honest we all had to be. She has continued to be supportive outside the classroom and is incredibly kind. *(PS - this can also be taken as a public speaking req if you ask A. Chin - definitely take this for it! It's MUCH better)

I loved Prof P but I felt that the course lacked structure. That being said, I wholehearted recommend this class. Prof P is willing to put the work in to help you develop your speaking and storytelling ability. She makes certain to maintain a respectful and encouraging space to do so.

Prof P is the most amazing professor you'll ever have. She cares about her students and really wants you to succeed! You must be open to challenging yourself though. You'll have to make speeches about hard topics and be open about stories you want to tell, but it's the best way to become more comfortable with public speaking.

Prof Picillo is an angel! She truly loves and respects her students, and she really wants you to succeed. Her feedback is valuable and well thought out so that it actually helps you. She's always available outside of class and truly wants to help you, not just with class stuff, but also with any issues you may have personally. TAKE HER CLASSES

NOT AN EASY A. An easy A- but she doesn't just give anyone and A, despite how much of a improvement you may have on your performance or how much you follow the syllabus. You'd have to be an amazing speaker before you get to this class I guess. Her grading seems a bit arbitrary but she's nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Miss P is a goddess! the most encouraging woman i have ever met. she is an amazing professor and an easy grader, she just wants you to thrive

I took Presentation, Style & Professional Communication with Professor Picillo and absolutely loved her. She is hilarious, passionate, and always makes class fun by singing and encouraging students to get creative with projects. Learned a lot from her and would take another course with her again in a heartbeat.

Piccillo is the woman! She dances and sings! She grades fairly hard for no reason, but really cares about the students and works to make us better.  We had so much fun in this class: I'll never forget it! I would recommend anyone take her Oral Interp Class, but I heard that the Public Speaking can be a bit tedious (mostly due to the subject matter)
Awesome! Awesome! Awesome! She really knows what she is talking about and has a great style of teaching to go along with her entertaining personality. Take her classes.

class is always entertaining like she is. enthusiastic and has lots of public speaking/teaching experience. lectures can get boring and repititive. best class time is spent doing speeches/receiving feedback. one of my favorite professors

A fantastic teacher, dynamic, fun, and full of energy.  She's always willing to talk to you about any questions or problems, she is extremely engaging and obviously cares about all of her students.  Without a doubt the best professor I've had at Northeastern, she's managed to make Public Speaking an exciting and challenging class.

Public Speaking is never fun, but you don't actually have to give that many speeches.  I took Speech in highschool and did more work than I did in this class.  She's very energetic and outgoing, and every other class she'll do this weird leg kick as she twists her body and make a noise like "waaah!" or say "whoa!", it kept me awake and laughing.

Great teacher, great woman. I seek out classes that Ms. P is teaching. Whether or not you are enjoying the material, you enjoy her as a person and (unlike my other classes) I actually dont mind getting out of bed for this one. She keeps everything interesting, lively, upbeat, and most importantly, even the most dull is FUN with this professor.
One of the best professors at the School.  Every Comm student should take a class with Ms. P.
She is my favorite professor as of now. Really nice, and ready to help you. but really, work to earn her respect. Don't get behind!

Very fun, energetic, crazy. She is hilarious but very serious about her classes- you will learn alot but you also will be challenged. V&A has some very hard exams, but if you practice speaking you'll be fine. Presentation, Style, and Communication is also easy if you practice and rehearse. Just about the best Comm prof I've had, period.

If you don't want to get better at public speaking don't take the class.  You do have to prove to her that you can improve, and actually work.  It can be simple and easy, you just have to make it that way.  She's very impactful, and truely cares about students.  She is a little crazy, but it's what makes her so great.
She's reaaaally out there. Be careful...she seems like an easy grader but she's not. Even if the class seems easy it probably wont be with her.
Amazing professor. I hated the idea of public speaking but she is incredibly helpful and supportive. Assignments are clear. Fair grader. Awesome personality.

She's awesome.  She's very nice, a little intimidating at first, but she's great.  Very supportive and really tries to be positive even if you suck.  I hate public speaking, but i'd take the class again.
Awesome class, excellent teacher, really interesting.  Tough grader but absolutely worth the work, won't be bored, won't fall asleep, take anything she teaches, you won't be sorry!

I had Susan Picillo for my Voice and Articulation as well as my public speaking class and she was easily one of the best professors I have had.  Very interactive and outgoing so it's hard to fall asleep in her class.  You can tell she loves her job and loves to teach.  Overall awesome experience where I learned a lot.  Hard work though.

Professor Picillo is very honest, and very willing to help with not only your progression as a public speaker, but also your personal adaptation to college. She understands public speaking is the nation's #1 fear, and empathetically helps people use their nervous energy in a positive way. She offers a comfortable atmosphere full of valuable info.
great teacher, easy class would highly recomend her. great person with a great heart.
So funny. She is one of the best teacher's I've ever had. Very willing to help and is very understanding. Her grading is a little difficult but I learned ALOT in her class (and had a good time)

Best teacher ever i loved her. she is so funny and theatrical and loves to do different voices. she also really knows her stuff. really fun to have i def recommend her for any class. does tend to pick faves but doesnt affect your grade
The speeches were easy to write. Just like doing a paper. Overcoming my bad speech habits were hard. She notices ALL of them, too...
very difficult as a public speaking teacher; very critical.  but, ultimately, a helpful and honest professor.
She also teaches Public Speaking, Oral Interpretation of Literature and Voice & Articulation.  SHE'S GREAT. Always helpful and really wants you to learn! THANKS PROF. P!

Professor Pichler was great but with a full time work and tons on quizzes, homework & tests it was a lot for part time students. She is tough grader and does not give points even if you do some partial work on your exams. Overall, a course that is needed to graduate so need to take it.

Dont be fooled by the serious personality... If you study you can 100% get an A. read the lecture notes and take the practice quizzes. Easy A if you do both. PHD in economic engineering from Stanford... its worth paying attnention because she actually teaches a lot of interesting topics in addition to what will be on tests.

On wednesday you go over the home work and what not and then on thursday you have a quiz, but the kicker is that you use the first hour to review. BORING. BORING BORING.

Great teacher for math, second best i ever had. Incredibly boring if you have a decent handle on the subject already but if you have any questions at all he goes over everything so thoroughly that the only way you could fail would be to skip or ignore him. tests are very fair and gives plenty of quizzes to keep your grade up, must be lazy to fail

The only reason i didn't get an A in this class was kuz I was a freshmen and didn't realize I actually cared about grades, so i never did anything and got a B+. The material teaches itself it's really easy and I did most of it in high school, he's just there to test you. He does a really good job considering he's always ****.
nice guy, very helpful especially when you email him. class is boring, and the assignment are mostly easy. the final is much more challenging than the midterm, as i learned the hard way.

Porter is your average math teacher - kinda weird/kinda boring but nice. The material is easy and the homework is all online. There is a weekly quiz that is pretty easy.(He uses your highest 8 out of 11 quiz scores). Sometimes he talks really slow and it's annoying. He's not so bad.

Horrible...What kind of teacher actually refuses to go over a problem a student needs help with? If it were up to him I would have no idea what was going on in class...Thank god for the help on the coursecompass site!
Nice guy! Hard grader! Boring Class! Overall if you manage to apply any type of effort...an easy 'A'!

You will learn investments the way Professor Porter wants it to be taught. That includes his own opinions that may not always be 100% accurate. Regardless, he isn't THAT bad. You can get an A on group projects if you understand the material and what he is asking for. Exams are fine. Lots of opportunities for extra credit.

Gary has a good personality, but his teaching methods aren't effective, nor is his grading style. Canvas can be confusing, he can be confusing. He does offer some flexibility with how your tests are weighted, and (at least for me) the final was optional. I would avoid this class and him unless you like to figure things out for yourself.

Please listen to the reviews and DO NOT take this class. He will not give you a good grade on anything unless you do everything PERFECTLY the way he thinks it should be. The lectures are very confusing and he just is not a good teacher. Avoid this class if you can.

Terrible

Not a great professor. He has a very hard time connecting with the students and actually teaching them. This guy has done a lot of research and is very accomplished, but can't really convey the information in a way that makes the class feel meaningful.

Too many lectures, too tough of a grader, distant from helping students, very poor and non-detailed feedback. You can show up to every class and pay attention and study and it may not make a difference.

toughest grader in the world. Doesnt care if you get the correct answers, he will grade you based on HIS answers even if yours are correct. This is the worst professor I have EVER had. He's never worked outside of academia and if you disagree with his investment theories/opinions he will heavily penalize you on your assignments. Not respectful, grade you based on the impression, you never know what he wants in the answer

It's not easy to do well on the exams because you have to know what he is looking for, no what is "right". The 5 Group projects are difficult and time-consuming. There's a lot of extra credit opportunities, but you could probably do better with another prof.

Overall really like the guy. Very interesting to talk to during office hours. Tests are hard but if you pay attention in class and go to each one you'll be fine. Group projects are lengthy and time-consuming but they help you learn the material. A lot of opportunities for extra credit as well. Would certainly take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do your share of the work and go to class because most exam questions come from lecture topics. He gives you plenty of chances for extra credit both from small assignments and from test questions. There are 5 or 6 major papers but as long as you do what he tells you you'll get an A on them, and they are group assignments not individual.

reviews.comment: Porter is all around a great teacher, but you have to come to class. reviews.comment: Professor Porter is one of the better instructors at Northeastern. Book is good for getting extra information but listening to lectures again through blackboard is a better way to study.

A pure academic through and through. Dude lectures and tests you on what he says. You're better off reading a transcript of his lectures than studying the text book or online resources. If you struggle with lecture based classes that have no visuals you should not take Porter.

reviews.comment: great professor

his lesson is hard to understand. you'll mess up cuz he doesn't follow text book. Too many assignments (2 short essays per week and 6 very long very hard papers )
avoid

really long assignments

I took CS5100 in Summer 2020. After starting work, I realized how much this course helped me. I still use what I learned, especially when working with AI. The class is challenging, but you learn a lot and gain skills you can apply in real situations. If you're going into tech or anything involving AI, take this class.

Course materials are copied from online blogs.
Exam feedback is vague, with no clear point deductions.
Lectures are unhelpful.
In Spring 2025, final project and exam grades were delayed until the university deadline, with no prior communication.

It is not an easy class as there were lots of readings, coding exercises, and quizzes but through that I learnt a lot. Professor Prasad is a nice person to work with.

If you want to take the class, be prepared! It requires knowledge on Java and RPC and your life will be easier if you brush up your knowledge before class.

reviews.comment:
All the negative reviews are spot on. I never leave reviews on professors, but making an exception as he is the worst professor I have had over the course of 4 years of undergrad + 2 years of grad. Detailing everything wrong with this course would take far more than 350 characters.

This professor is a complete embarrassment to Northeastern. Avoid.

Worst professor experience! Uses Paint for explanations, promised 2 weeks for an assignment, then gave only 5 days. Just shows textbook pages while teaching. Wouldn't take his course again, even for free. Surprising for a reputable university like Northeastern to have such low-quality professors.. YouTube offers much better content for free.

Do not take this class if you want clarity on due dates or a structured course.  Assignments were given on a whim and you would just see that a project has been assigned and is due in 10 days.  No prior communication on assignment/due dates. Grading was slow and very minimal feedback was given on mistakes. Very poorly structured. Interesting topic.

Foundations of AI required a lot of effort. It was worth it because participation and preparation were extremely helpful as they helped the professor gauge our overall understanding. He was always much more interested in making sure to help me understand the topics than he was in scrutinizing grades. I found the grading to be lenient and fair.

reviews.comment:
Professor Saripalli is a knowledgeable man and his classes helped me understand the core of the subject.
This subject has indeed helped me in my interviews and caused a lasting impact on me.

No office hours. Impossible to reach. Learn more from TAs...

Give *very* vague comments on your tests. Even if you try to ask, no explanations. Not fair at all.

The reviews here are very strange. As a new student, I was tricked by these 'good' reviews. I realized later anyone can put a review here... Thus, better to refer to *TRACE*.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: A great course that provides ample opportunity to learn and grasp the fundamentals. The assignments although somewhat challenging, definitely stimulate the right chords. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I gained a lot from this course teaching by Prasad. The professor will also answered our questions attentively. This course is challenging as well as fulfilling.

reviews.comment: Worst class I took at NU. Prof reads straight from text and calls it lecture, assignments are plagiarized from student projects at UCB. Virtually impossible to reach professor. Despite the positive reviews here, note that Saripalli has a rating of 2.8/5.0 (dept mean=4.3/5.0) on TRACE, NU's internal review board. Make of that what you will.

Lectures are pointless. No slides. Straight pdf textbook reader. Not good at explaining things.

Homework, projects, and readings are very time-consuming but not that rewarding. Most of the questions are open-ended. 

I feel like I am taking two classes instead of one. Not worth the time.

reviews.comment: I  enjoyed taking Mr Saripalli's class - he is knowledgeable and has a ton of experience in the industry. He brilliantly translates technical concepts into real-world examples, which helps understand tough topic. I learned a lot in this class. It's a ton of work, so I wouldn't encourage taking his class with another tough class.

Professor Saripalli is a very caring person and always takes students' feedback seriously. His class is heavy in reading and assignments but you can learn a lot after completing them. I found the content he included in lectures useful in working environment as well which is a big plus.

Dr Saripalli is very passionate about the subject matter and caring toward the students. The lectures, homework and exams are all focused on facilitating student learning. There's quite a bit of reading, and the course touches on many different topics and tools. But he is flexible about the workload and happy to adjust based on student feedback.

The course is awesome and well structured. Pace is easy even though it seems overwhelming in the beginning. Prof is very accommodating and is open to communication with students. Overall, I learnt alot about the subject coming out of the class than I had before taking this class.

The textbook is well chosen. It covers most of the key concepts of distributed systems. If you take a look at MIT 6.824, the syllabus is very similar. Is 6650 the most interactive course at NEU? Probably not. However, it's informative enough. I highly recommend future students to take this course. In the meantime, use MIT 6.824 as a reference.

reviews.comment: I 100% regret taking his class. He only reads from PDFs and does not explain anything in detail. He was never available during the exams to answer any doubts, everything was left to the TAs. Be prepared to be bombarded by random assignments and schedule changes.

I really enjoyed taking cs5100 the foundations of artificial intelligence course. The professor is really nice in explaining everything clearly to the students, making the concepts more intuitive. The textbook is straightforward and I have learned a lot from doing the homework. The overall structure of the course is well organized.

Knowledgeable and enthusiastic professor!
Have taken CS5100 FAI in Spring 2022 and it was a really good learning experience for me personally.
It was an online class and attendance was not mandatory, programming assignments were lengthy but you got to learn a lot!
Would definitely take other subjects under the Professor.

Awful class. Lectures are basically read-alouds from the textbook, while assignments are mostly ripped from 8-year old MOOCs. Avoid avoid avoid!

Prof. really cares about his students and is very approachable!
