reviews.comment: The professor is very nice, he gives us examples in class and is eager to help students who are having trouble with their studies. Also, the assignments are graded in detail. Courseworks are slightly difficult, but many references can be found for assignments, so the grade is not tough to get.
Although I could not match my learning with his teaching style, assignments, difficulty, helpful nature, and approachability, all these factors were good for me. I learnt a lot during this class.

I took Fundamentals of computer networking under professor Saripalli. The classes were well organised and the professor was able to clarify any questions we have even if its out of textbook content. A good knowledge about the subject is required for this and the professor was the epitome of knowledge in this subject. The assignments were good.

I took Foundations of Artificial Intelligence under professor Prasad. He is extensively knowledgeable and delivers quality content. The lectures were based chronologically so that there is no disconnection between each lectures. Weekly assignments made us apply class lectures concepts to practical applications. The final project is resume worthy.

I took the Foundations of Artificial Intelligence Summer-2 course under Prof. Saripalli. He is part of the industry in the same field and hence has knowledge about latest R&D. His classes were fun to attend with his occasional humor and cool AI videos. The assignments were lengthy but had interesting questions that made you think. Overall, awesome.
Amazing professor! He teaches the course content with high clarity and is well organized!

Professor Saripalli is very patient and considerate. I found his method of teaching swift yet comfortable. During the course, he took great efforts to firm our understanding of concepts. He is kind and cares for his students a lot. He also responds quickly to emails. He is a great Professor and I would definitely recommend him for CS 5100!!
He's a real gem, don't be fooled by first impression. He is really very knowledgeable and connected to the industry. He will make you work for it, but it would be totally worth it.

reviews.comment: Tried to like him. Materials are heavily borrowed from everywhere, classes are just textbook reading, does not give enough instructions to TAs which means students suffer from haphazard requirement changes and unexpected point deduction. reviews.comment: Prof Prakash really cares about his classes and wants everyone to do well!!  He really wants feedback and to improve his class/ the teaching.  Pretty easy A and there is also extra credit chances if you go to class.  Def one of the best upper level econ elecs to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Day 1 was intimidating but in a good way. Prof. Prakash didn't even introduce himself, he jumped straight into a challenging assignment on a real socio-economic problem. Set high standards immediately, but you can tell he genuinely cares about students and wants them to succeed. Tough, but in a motivating way. Can't wait to see how this sem ends!

Professor Prakash made this class truly special. He cared deeply about us, often checked in, and shared real-world policy stories that made learning engaging. He was always supportive, even outside of class. His kindness, insight, and passion for teaching made him one of the most inspiring instructors I've ever had.

Professor Prakash made this class so special. He actually cared about us, always checked in, and shared cool stories from his real-life policy work. He made learning feel real and fun. Honestly, he's the nicest and most inspiring instructor I have ever had. He also was willing to help us beyond classroom.

I joined this class unsure of what to expect. At first, I feared it might be boring, but I was so wrong. The course's strong connection to real-world challenges in development economics made it fascinating. What truly made it special was Professor Prakash—new to Northeastern, yet the best and most caring & knowledgeable professor I've had!

This class is entirely him presenting his own research, which is hyper-specific and doesn't teach about the field as a whole. Is basically all on South Asia; disappointing that a course on development Econ hasn't mentioned LatAm once. Grading criteria is not super clear and is only done by the TA who also gives limited feedback

Professor Prakash is very sweet but does not teach the subject. He treats class as a time to talk about his research projects. While some do have to do with Developmental Econ, they do not give you a good understanding of the subject. He also has everyone say something at least once per class. Waste of money

FINA1209 was an easy class and an easy A. Assignments throughout the week, but you could finish the Canvas ones easily in one sitting in less than an hour. MyPearson assignments twice a week with ~15-20 questions, not hard. Midterm and final with a course project throughout the semester. Did not grade harshly and easily accessible outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: This Professor is lazy and doesn't care about you unless if it makes him look good in front of his superiors. He is extreme with deadlines, and is a tough grader, although his entire class is just copy pasted content. Do not recommend him at all.
HARD test!! Tons of materials and a close-book test. that is killing me. He does not have a attendance sheet but I believe he takes attendance on his own. Avoid.
Good feedback on business plan. Large project that counts for 30% of the grade, so make sure you put in the effort and you should be fine.

Study the questions given at the back of the textbook, More or less the same level given on tests. Go to office hours and TA hours. Not Hard, but if you put in effort you will do well. Don't be discouraged by the material

BUSN 1101 is one of, if not the most, hated class by DMSB students. Provost was alright, but the curriculum of the class was terrible. It wasn't assigned by him, but I don't feel like he helped us with the tough class. The tests are brutally difficult, so make sure to study a ton. The group TJX project was extremely tough as well.

Very helpful throughout the TJX project and seems to really care about students. Tests for this class are of average difficult to begin with, but he lays out clearly what is on each test which makes it easy.  Laid back overall. Would definitely take his class again.

He is a really nice guy and a good teacher.  He makes the class enjoyable and is a great help (the class is not fun to take in the first place).  He is basically told what to teach and how to teach it from the head of the department, so he has no choice but to teach the information.  He does a good job of it nonetheless. Beware of the TJX project!

overall a great professor. He is super clear with how he wants the semester long group project and is willing to help you every step of the way through. He makes himself available and works with your schedule - definitely goes out of his way for students. Tests aren't too tough as long as you put in a good amount of studying time.

Amazing professor for BUSN 1101. He keeps your attention and shows enthusiasm in class, and his lectures are very clear. Always asks students if they have any questions and always willing to help. He gives very good feedback. Just hand in your work on time and show effort. Tests are based on slides. One of if not the best professor I've had so far.
Great professor! Powerpoints were long, but he explains really well. I was in a really small class which helped a lot probably. If you understand the homework you'll be fine on the exams.
Clueless. DO NOT TAKE INV WITH HIM. He does not prepare for class at all and overall is just a horrible teacher.
He does not know what he is doing, the class is a totally useless.

Horrible, he wouldn't even let us print the powerpoint slides ahead of time to make notes on them. His tests aren't horrible- but his "lectures" for the full class time is him reading his powerpoint slides that he won't let us have ahead of time. Did I mention he couldn't answer some of the problems in the book on the spot? DO NOT take this prof.

are you kidding me?  he's not stubborn.  Finance is difficult no matter who teaches it.  It's a ton of material to squeeze in.  Aplia does SUCK, but not really the prof's fault.  I thought he was nice and willing to help students.  He worked with general class opinion on how course should continue. Tests were a lot easier than they could have been.
prepare to teach yourself this course
good professor.  helpful, especially if you go to his office hours.  tough material.

Please just stay away if you can. Going to class is basically pointless, unless you can filter out his talking and concentrate on powerpoints. Finance is not an easy subject and I can assure you he does not make things easier. Is very stubborn, gives the wrong answer half the time, and is not receptive at all. Avoid, avoid, avoid.

Prof. Prideaux was a good lecturer and explained concepts well. He writes lecture notes on the board, and I'd suggest copying down everything, as it'll help you with HW and studying for exams. I'd also suggest doing Lesson Exercises to study. Final exam is worth 40% of grade. Office hours aren't super helpful unless you have specific questions.

Lectures mostly consists of him copying the notes posted on canvas onto the board. Gives a lot of practice problems and practice tests. He will not look up to see if students have questions so be sure to politely interrupt if you need clarification. He is very nice and willing to re-explain, but not super engaging
Good guy, lectures not very interesting or that helpful, as someone else said its just the textbook.

Finn is a chill person and occasionally funny. MATH1365 is a relatively easy course, hence as long as you follow all the notes posted, you should be good. All he does in class is copy his notes onto the board but he is willing to explain and go over things again if you ask him. He is overall a really nice person but a horrible professor.

I definitely didn't expect Finn to be a good professor since he didn't seem to be super interested in teaching this semester, but he definitely taught us the required course material for the class. Course does require a solid basis in algebra and calculus- something he'll tell you first day.

reviews.comment: Finn is a really nice guy, he always made time for me at office hours and answered all my questions, and he was always lenient on the grading if you talk to him after you get your quiz back. But in class the lecture is super boring and he's just copying his notes onto the board so you never learn anything. I would avoid the class if you can.

One of the most boring people Ive met, and not just when it comes to math. The material we go over in class is not reflected in the exams, as they are so much harder than what we learn. He lectures the entire class without giving any chance for us to do in-class practice. I would avoid him if possible.
Quizzes are the only way that you are graded. Constantly had to go back and reteach lectures. Displayed little to no enthusiasm to teach the material. Lectures for the entire period.

His lectures are usually simple to follow, but he messes up a lot and has to go back and re-do parts the following class quite often. Grades are only quiz-based, and the final is 40% of our grade. He does a really bad job of explaining concepts in lectures but elaborates more at office hours (2 hours long). He counts participation at office hours.

reviews.comment: I had taken Calc1&2 before and took HL Math in high school but the way this professor taught was absolutely horrid. It was obvious he was smart but his teaching style made math the most life-sucking thing on this planet.

Professor Garg does not know how to simplify complicated course content for students to learn. Somehow, professor Garg manages to make simple concepts more complicated than they actually are, beating the purpose of a professor. Professors are supposed to make things easier to understand, not harder. She even confuses herself sometimes.

Professor Garg has been one of my favorite teachers since the moment she started the first class with, "What is your favorite avenger?" The class requires you to listen and take notes on lectures at home so you are able to practice problems and gain help in class. This format is definitely unusual at first but is one that truly helps in learning.

Overall she should be the last option you pick. She talks really fast, and everything she says only confuses students. I only passed by studying the practice tests which that are very similar to the test. Study those profusely and you'll pass.That being said it is a class where you learn on your own. Horrible teacher!

Priya is an excellent teacher who teaches the material thoroughly in class. She's eager to help and study guides are key to succeeding since test questions are modeled after it. Attendance isn't mandatory but show up to class and pay attention and all you'll have to do is the connect homework outside of class. Took it in summer, still manageable.

Worst teacher at UMass Boston. DO NOT EVER TAKE!!!! She will move so fast that you don't know what is happening and then she will test you over it. Almost my entire class failed test 1 and she blamed us for that after the test.

I would not take her if this is your first time taking Accounting. She stressed me out completely and it's a fast class. I'm not a numbers person so for me this class was hard in general but her attitude at times does not help. Help one on one is was more helpful her attitude is pretty rude at times unless she likes you and you pick up it up fast

The class was okay. Prof Garg was TBA at first. The professor will go through many problems, but it won't guarantee that those will be on the test(s). She does curve the grades. Wasn't too helpful, but good enough. Textbook used for problems only. Exam related to problems, not the homework, so can't tell what will be on the tests.

Priya is ALWAYS willing to help struggling students and gives very involved yet fair tests. The problem with intelligent professors is that they assume that everyone is as smart as them. This was the main issue with Priya. Finance is a difficult course inherently, coupled with Priya's innate understanding makes it a challenge but not impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She's kind of all over the place when it comes to canvas and speaking, but I think she improved the way she taught since the bad ratings on here before because the school told her to. Exams were easy. Assignments were easy. I didn't really have a problem.
she lowk wasn't that bad.
If you have her switch immediately you will suffer.

Class discussions matter. However, if you provide a point that conflicts with her opinions, it will be met with extreme condescension. Just another awful professor who's become overly comfortable with tenure. She does not care whether you're struggling, even if you attend her office hours. Save your time and your GPA.

Tests are hard. To pass them, you have to read and memorize the textbook chapters because what's taught in class isn't on the exam. A LOT of group projects. Attendance and participation mandatory. If you miss a day, you have to do makeup assignments. She wants you to do makeup assignments for the days you missed even if you weren't yet enrolled!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

Also you have to do 3-4 presentations total in the class and multiple papers. She's also extremely condescending when she talks to you. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS.

She makes you memorize all the case studies & it gets really heavy for exams. Participation and attendance counts and if you miss class you have to do makeup assignments. Lockdown browser on exams. MANY projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Attendance is mandatory and participation matters. This course is lecture heavy and most of the time, she isn't clear about her grade breakdown.

This teacher was pretty unclear with assignment guidelines and grading criteria. She changed a few assignment instructions and the Syllabus over a month after the class started. The projects and papers required weeks worth of either research or time spent reading. You will have to show up at every class and give 100% to every assignment to get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I would not recommend.

Starts each class with a quiz that has poorly worded questions. The highest grade she gives on an assignment is a 94, if not lower. I don't really feel like I learned anything from her lectures. There are a decent amount of group projects with no clear grading guidelines. Don't take this professor if you're trying to protect your GPA.

Professor Puffer is a great choice if you actually want to learn. She brings up personal stories or examples not discussed in the textbook. Exams are definitely hard (averages were around 70). Make sure to stay on top of the reading and dont leave everything until the last minute and participate a lot in class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Poorly worded questions on tests. First exam average 67 and median 68 without any curve. Weird personality and teaching style. Would not recommend anyone to take this teacher. Spends too much time promoting her literature. Overall, This class is a waste of time and I haven't learned anything in the course after multiple weeks.

Her class is led with little to no structure. While attendance is mandatory, most classes are pointless and wasted on going over useless topics. She is a hard grader and isn't clear on test questions, which makes the exams super confusing. Average for the first test was a 67% and she refuses to curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is pretty weird teacher honestly. Her tests are poorly formatted, with confusing wording. The first exam average was a 67, which she was proud of because it meant "she wrote a good test." And she refused to put a curve on it and was very defensive when we tried to say the content made no sense. Most of my class is grinding to get a B now.
Quite odd teacher. and not a good teacher. I don't understand how she has gotten to her position.

There's no way possible others that commented had this teacher. This class is completely useless and I have learned absolutely nothing. The professor should have been an English teacher because she  grades papers by grammatical errors. Exams are insane as well. I'm an A student and I worked my heart out on this class to get a B. Terrible teacher...
Extremely nice teacher. Passionate about subject. Teaching irrelevant to tests. Tough grader. Cannot skip this class. If you can, avoid.
She was a very good professor and brought real world and interesting topics to the class discussions. She loves group projects. Make sure you participate and go to class.

It was largely a discussion based class: I didn't find Prof. Puffer to be good at leading the discussion, it was somewhat halted.  She was quite disorganized too, and didn't give clear instructions for the work to be handed in.  The content covered was good.
I agree, she loves the international students! Not a difficult class. Speak up!
I enjoyed having her as my teacher...until she started to grade things. She gives all te international students better grades than the American. Kinda odd at times...
Extremely nice woman; gets very excited about teaching anything. Loves international cultures. Not a difficult class if you show up, do the readings, and speak up during class.
A little bit odd, yet very friendly and dedicated.
She is an easy professor, but I deffinitely would not recommend taking a class with her. Classes feel like they take forever to get through. She is a little odd overall.
No Comments

She is a little odd. but she is a good professor. She really enjoys what she is doing and makes the class interesting. However, she can assign you projects outside of class that are not feasible in terms of time.
Professor Puffer is one of the best professors in the grad school program. She is nice, makes class very interesting, and she even plays in a rock band!
Professor Puffer is a nice person. Her class is very interesting. In her lectures she uses videos, readings, presentations, guest speakers, etc.
Awesome professor overall. If you read the books assigned and put in some effort its a very easy class. Would heavily recommend taking this class with Purinton.

I took him for Hist of Technology as well and would recommend him for 2211 to anyone, Prof. Purinton teaches it very enthusiastically and makes it very manageable. He's also very responsive over email and easy to reach for office hours. Great guy if you get to know him!

One of the best professors I have ever had. He has a genuinely contagious enthusiasm about the material, which makes the whole class a million times better. He is friendly and always willing to chat with students and provide extra help. Grading was fair and if you keep up with the work you can def get a good grade.

Professor Purinton was truly one of the best teachers I have ever had. He is so intentional with his teachings and enthusiastic, which made me actually want to learn. He was also always accommodating and flexible with office hours. Definitely take his classes.

He is a great lecturer who is very engaging and passionate. Lots of reading between the textbook and required books, which makes the class a lot of busy work, but not too difficult. The TA will take points of quizzes with little explanation, but the class is good.
Awesome prof but TA was such an annoying grader

Super interesting guy and is super enthusiastic. Very knowledgeable and shares a lot of personal experience. Very interesting and engaging lectures. Tests are fair but book sort answers are kind of graded strictly. Also maps quizzes suck but don't count for much of the grade. Very forgiving and wants you to get a good grade and learn the material.

Really chill professor, has interesting lectures, and its really clear what you need to study for in advance of the module quizzes. Papers are easy and straightforward as well, TA grades nicely. Put a little effort in the class and you'll succeed and enjoy it. Will definitely take another class of his in the future!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor truly cares about teaching the material and makes each lecture interesting. The class is easy, just lectures and group projects and a few quizzes and papers
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Pls take this class. its actually the best thing ever he's so funny and interested in what he's teaching. each week usually consists of 2 lectures and 1 group project which everyone always gets full points in. you also have a quiz (on paper) and an essay due at the end of each module, they are easy and the essay is simple if you follow the criteria
Great guy and overall easy to follow

great lectures, passionate about the material, students and their work. easy grader, just put effort into papers, projects and quizzes for full marks. attendance is required but fairly easy. offers an extra credit papers for a sizeable grade boost. highly recommend for any history class
great professor, very passionate about his work and his students, super easy grader, attention counts but i would 100% take another class with him. can't recommend him enough
The undisputed goat of the NEU history department. Loves what he does, cares about his students, and is by no means a harsh grader. He's also a beer historian. Rly cool.
Best professor I've had! I would highly recommend taking a class with him. He's so passionate and interesting, it really engages the class.

Proffesor Purinton's very nice. The lectures for me were very boring but still somewhat insightful. Easy class, he lays it out very clearly. You have a 1500 word essay around every month but were fine. Hes good - don't stress easy class.

Lots of quizzes (but no midterm or final) and lots of papers. His Ta was a harsh grader when it came to the papers, which was annoying. lectures are interesting and fun. he really cares about his students and what he teaches. Just do well on the papers!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor- clearly enjoyed teaching the content of the course and gave a lot of interesting supplemental material. There were some issues with clarity of instructions on certain assignments, and the TA graded most of the work. Lots of reading, but really interesting lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great prof

Purinton is caring, funny, and passionate. World hist. covers a vast span of subjects, making it difficult to teach, but he handles every subject with care. The TA graded everything, but none of it was ever overly challenging, and even though he doesn't grade, still takes care to get to know students personally.

Lovely professor, very important foundation for the world since 1945 that encourages your own exploration on the topic. Really easy to talk to, fun in class, GET READY TO READ. Books are nice though. Always positive, energy is infectious considering that it was a 9:15am

The professor is a very nice guy. All required readings are provided so no need to spend $$. The class materials are made by a different professor and he is not fully versed in it. However, all the grading is done by the TA who, in my course, was absolutely horrendous. Professor did not give feedback for any assignment.
Condescending and lacks basic human empathy
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors ever! He is so passionate about the material - it amazes me how he is able to come to class every day so obviously excited to teach. He is such an interesting guy and so fun to listen to, I genuinely looked forward to going to his class every day. Not a super hard class, but I still felt like I learned so much.

I thoroughly enjoyed reading every assigned book and he gave plenty of time to complete them. His lectures are engaging and bubbly and he is the only teacher I had this semester that took the time to learn all the students' names. The map tests may be tedious to study for but the knowledge gained from knowing world geography is insurmountable.

Favorite professor I've had so far. Comes to class with energy, loves talking to students, and is genuinely passionate about the material. Our class got cancelled once and I was upset about it. He's super engaging and fair about the workload. Contrary to a review I just saw, as a woman I've found him unbiased. Happily offers book/movie recs. 11/10.

Prof Purinton is point blank period amazing. Very easy to talk to, love the discussions we have in class and the fact that he encourages students to lead them. The essays are very reasonable as are all the assignments. Took this freshman year and was a class that I never felt anxious about. He cares about his students and overall is just 10/10.

Took this class an an elective as an engineering student and he was definitely able to keep my attention during class and make things interesting. A few papers through the year and a quiz after every unit, but not bad at all. Would highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Purinton is my favorite professor at Northeastern. The class was super engaging, and it is not hard to get an A if you do all of the required reading. There are 4 (short) books that are assigned, and about a chapter a week from the textbook. I will definitely be taking more history classes just to have him as a prof. Super interesting class!

Professor Purinton is one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern. He has an endless passion for teaching, and truly knows and cares about the material he teaches you. Professor Purinton assigns interesting homework content (readings, podcasts, movies, etc). It is easy to do well on his assignments, and he earnestly wants you to do well.
Very nice professor, however you will be reading and writing a LOT of papers. Despite this he is a very kind guy, and he supports you in every way!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class was really easy as long as you do your work. It's mostly reading based (textbook and novels). The reading felt a bit extra to me, but the quizzes were easy (open notes) and there were only a few papers. Lenient grader and really understanding. Definitely a lot of work though. He's really passionate about what he teaches and it's obvious.
Great guy, really understanding, nice and funny. Would 100% recommend.

"The world since 1945" course- Really fun teacher, really understanding. Super excited about what he teaches. The books you read are so worth it and great. Learned so much in this course about the world
SO SWEET! Just do the readings and you'll do well. Hilarious, understanding, young, and relatable. Loves beer.
Maybe not the most engaging professor in world, but demands people to talk in class. Take-home midterm, DO YOUR READINGS! The online/class quizzes are easy if you do the readings!

Top notch class, top notch professor. This was one of the few classes I truly felt engaged and interested by the content. Professor Prokosch is a nice, engaging guy. I mean he even gave out gift cards for answering questions. Excellent professor. The best I've had here.

Mark is great. The class has 3 exams which are MCQ (one is during finals week but is not a final). He gives study guides for his exams. If you study they are not difficult. Super easy to reach & is willing to clarify things if you do not understand. He also gives free points on all of the exams & shows you 1 MCQ with answer at end of every lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved this class and changed my major to psyc after

Professor will often let you out early. Lectures all had bonus freebie questions that were on the test, so go to class to get free points! Prokosch was a caring and understanding guy and his lectures were usually pretty interesting/entertaining. Fun class to take if you have an interest in psych, though tests are a lot of memorization.
Hard tests. But very very nice person

legit goat - lots of reading. lots of writing. totally worth it. Finally felt confident as a student and a writer thanks to him. I would highly recommend this class and prof. prokosch. He was also nice enough to write a letter of rec for me for grad school, so maybe I'm biased, but I asked him for a reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Did not enjoy this class—way too much work than required, and Prokosch can be unnecessarily harsh

Professor Prokosch was the best. I emailed him a dozen times during the semester, and he replied within 20 minutes every time. Lectures were entertaining, exams were fair, in-class work was actually enjoyable, quizzes were basically free (open note), and the paper was easy, given his example paper. Take him. Best professor I have taken by far.

His lectures were not mandatory but he gave you extra information about the tests in the lectures and they were very interesting. He was always chatting it up before class and just such a nice guy. Take him if you can!

Professor Prokosch is the best professor I've had at this school. I never wanted to miss a lecture because they were genuinely so interesting. I loved learning and engaging with the course material. I could not recommend a better teacher for this course!

His passion is very clear when he's lecturing, which makes lectures so engaging. There's no homework, but you have all semester to get 5 psych study credits and a long paper. He's a super nice guy and approachable if you have any questions. I truly enjoyed attending this class.

I was skeptical of his ratings but he's deserving. I learned more than expected and enjoyed being in class. Good notes are key, as in-class exams are most of the grade. He's solid across the board and one of my favorite professors. 

Bottom line: Professor Prokosch should teach a class on how to teach.

Professor Prokosch is an amazing professor! The class is pretty easy and all the lecture slides are posted in advance. He gives more information in class that will be on exams but attendance is not taken directly. No homework and the exams are all multiple choice.
Cool guy, I enjoyed attending his lectures even though they aren't mandatory. Very clear grading criteria and straightforward tests
Great guy. Classic Dad figure and you can tell he wants his students to succeed. Exams are easy if you use his study guides, which are very clear.

The BEST PROFESSOR EVER. Lecture based so you don't have to buy the textbook, but seriously lecture based. Every question was from lecture, and he would even sprinkle jokes he made during class onto the exam. Super helpful and was the most accommodating person I've ever met. The only reason I loved the class was because of his teaching style 10/10

Prof Prokosch was hands down the best professor I've had at NU so far! Attendance isn't mandatory, but I enjoyed going to the class. The quiz and exam questions, for the most part, are right there on the slides. Reading the textbook could help but it's not required to do well in the class! He often lets class out early and cracks jokes in the class

Professor Prokosch is the absolute best professor I have EVER had at Northeastern. He is incredibly personable and the best ‘dad figure' you could have for a college class. I felt incredibly safe coming to class - he is so nice and encouraging. He is pretty lenient in his grading too. I would literally pay to take a class with him again.

Here's the bottom line: everybody here at Northeastern looking for a psychology elective knows to take Professor Prokosch, and everyone who needs to do their capstone course in psych knows to try to get in one of his seminars. Ask anyone in the know - he is goated.

He is a good professor. He gives 4 paper over the semester which are due at different times. You can start them whenever. He does not give good feedback at all. He copied the comments he wrote for me and said the exact same thing to my friend. He does not offer extra credit so do well on the exams. Just be mindful if you are willing to do that.

Really nice, chill prof- lectures are very clear and easy to follow, along with an overview of work/course load  Good availability outside of class and always open to questions/discussions during class. Only slight downside is that (at least for psyc 1101) you were graded mainly on big exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Prokosch is awesome. Only lectures but he makes them interesting, and lots of case studies & videos. Be aware not all information is on the slides. Quizzes are online and open note, exams are not but study guides are provided. 20% of the grade is basically a gimme, he also gives free points on tests and quizzes.

Mark is the guy who has sat down with me to help me prepare for graduate school. He has guided me in becoming a more skilled and independent academic researcher. I feel incredibly fortunate to be in his class and benefit from his teachings. He is a fabulous teacher and a gem of a human being. Take classes with him, talk to him, let him be a light,

He's pretty funny and good lecturer imo. If you go to class and take notes you should do fine on exams, which are lockdown browser and in class. He also gives a couple freebies for the exams and has a couple take home quizzes. I'd take his class again in a heartbeat

Such a funny professor, genuinely looked forward to his lectures. Lectures may be long but he does not just read off of slides, there is in-class practice and interesting videos to switch things up. I'm not sure if he still does this, but when I took the class he would give a freebie answer to a future test question at the end of each lecture!

Dr. Prokosch is absolutely amazing. He gives free pointers on test and even gives you test answers classes before the exam. His quizzes are online and take home but you do have 3 exams on lockdown browser. A great guy with so much passion for Psychology.

Amazing professor, made me so motivated about his course and the actual content was easy to pick up if you paid attention in class. Exams were all multiple choice and again, if you paid attention in class you'd be fine.
Would take this class again if I could, you really only need to show up and study the slides that he gives you to pass the class or the final.
hes very funny and sweet. gives 4 or 5 lockdown browser exams. and a couple of take-home online quizzes.

Literally the best professor ever. I had Mark last semester and he was phenomenal. He is a down to earth and funny guy and make even a boring lecture engaging. If you go to class and take basic notes you will pretty much be all set for tests. Quizzes are open note and you can use google. Taking another class with him next semester.

Easy to do well in and class was extremely engaging. He gives study guides at the beginning of the unit, so study with those. He also gives free exams questions just for going to class and the online 'quizzes' basically are the same questions as the exam. Go to class (they're not recorded), use the study guide & quizzes and you'll get an A+

Mark was my favorite teacher last semester. He is hilarious and super nice. His exams are clear cut from the lectures so if you take good notes you are all set. The only assignments he gives are at home quizzes, one big paper due at the end of sem, and research participation. 3 big exams, the last one is the final and it is not cumulative!
actually goat- great personality and engaging lectures. exams are online and mcq, and a final essay. taking his classes again next sem- take if can

Best professor ever! Mark is extremely personable with students and wants everyone to do great. He is very accessible outside of class. His lectures are very entertaining and straight-forward. His exams are very fair. Graded by three exams and four open-book quizzes. Gave everyone a 100% on Quiz 4 just because. Very kind and would recommend.

Mark is goated. Best professor I have had at Northeastern, and this is my last class before graduation. Lots of papers, but grades leniently and gives helpful feedback to improve future papers. It's a good vibe in the classroom with a mix of lectures and presentations from students. Take social psych so you can take this seminar!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: This professor is fantastic! you can tell that he actually loves teaching psych which makes his lectures much more interesting. i will say that this class is all memorization so if you struggle with that i might suggest something else.

I'm a psych major and he reaffirmed that I'm in the right field. He's super laid back and his lectures are amazing. Oddly like listening to a documentary. He does use Lockdown browser and in-class exams, but his study guides are really helpful and he releases them early, and there is a final paper about psych disorders which is pretty fun and easy.

Such a king! He is so funny and really is engaging during his lectures. He makes class interesting with videos and he has many different ways to bring your grade up through the semester. He is flexible and understanding with deadlines and he is very easy to reach outside of class. TAKE MARK HES GREAT!!!

This man is my favorite professor ever. He is so funny and genuinely cares about each of his students. His quizzes and exams are all online and relatively easy if studied for, I wanna take every class he teaches in the future.
I freaking love Mark. Take his class.

Hands down the best course I have taken at Northeastern. All coursework was difficult but intellectually stimulating. We wrote 7 papers, did a group presentation, had class participation (graded), and wrote a long research proposal. Mark gave great feedback and was a great lecturer. I recommend. Took during summer so may be different from regular.

Mark helped me fall in love with psychology. He was enthusiastic and helped me stay attentive and really absorb the information presented during class. Take good notes and spend sufficient time studying, and the quizzes and tests are fair. I learned so much and was able to draw so many connections between the course material and my own life.

Love this man. He's so funny and makes social psych so interesting to learn about. Genuinely learned a lot of applicable stuff from the class. Tests are pretty intuitive and easy to study for; he sometimes gives a free point or two. You don't need the textbook for the tests; just do the study guide and you're gold.

Please protect this man. He is a gem. This is my second time taking him, and he didn't disappoint. I learned a ton though social psychology is pretty intuitive. There were four exams and four papers. He grades very leniently, and exams are based on lectures. Pretty much every class he came to talk to me to see how I was doing. Protect this man.

Professor Prokosch is hands down one of the best professors I've had. He is warm and charismatic and makes the class an enjoyable place to be. There are three exams (taken via lockdown browser) and four papers, in addition to class discussion. I highly recommend the class!

I absolutely love him, He has a good personality and makes class fun, he has very easy exams, all multiple choice (lockdown browser, though), and he gives freebies after every class. gives extra credit (gave everyone a 100 on our quiz just cause)
take. his. class. he was such a blessing

AMAZING!!! This is definitely a heavy course but this professor makes it so engaging and interesting. This class has greatly improved my confidence in public speaking and my writing! Take him if you have the chance!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Amazing, he is so funny and engaging. I loved his class. The course is graded through tests and quizzes only (in-person on lockdown browser).

Dr. Prokosch is excellent!! He is a very funny and engaging guy, which is great since the lectures are long and have a ton of content in them, including a lot of videos. There are only 3 exams (no cumulative final!) and 4 open-note quizzes, but he is very generous with giving out exam questions beforehand. Overall he's great and I would recommend!!

Professor Prokosch made me fall in love with psychology. He made his lectures interesting and fun. But this class is very lecture heavy, i would recommend going to all classes so you dont miss out on anything, because the 3 exams are all based on the lecture only. The classes get kinda long, but hes a good lecturer and is also very understanding

He gives out one freebie for every class that you attend (by the time for the next exam you have 8-9 exam questions). Half of the exam questions come from the quizzes he posts so if you just knew the quizzes and the freebies you would get a 50% on the exam minimum. His lectures are entertaining and he tries to be personable with students.
loved this man. He mad class engaging and made me want to go. class was supposed to be 1.5 hours but he usually let us out early

You get no homework, your only homework is to read the respected chapters (you don't really need them), all quizzes are open book/open note (worth 25% of grade), 3 exams including final exam ( only goes over everything after exam 2 and 75% of final grade).

Prof Prokosh was honestly such a an amazing professor I loved attending his lectures and he taught the material super super well. Its very lecture/note heavy so make sure to always take notes during lectures but he also has all the material on canvas. The exams are pretty standard but it does require a good amount of studying.

Absolutely love Professor Prokosch. Perfect balance between charismatic and incredibly intelligent -- lectures are engaging and relevant to the test material. He's a caring and passionate professor who really knows what he's talking about. Will be looking out for more classes taught by him!

Professor Prokosch is the best! Intro to psych was a pretty boring class but he is hilarious and genuinely cares about his students. If you attend class, he gives out freebie questions that will be on the next exam and if you take notes and listen to what he says, then his exams are very easy. I would highly recommend his classes.

I am in this class now and felt compelled to post a quick rating. I once was an aspiring computer science major, but he changed my interest. I will now be taking psych classes with a focus on memory systems. If you are wavering on choosing a class where he is a professor, know that you are in good hands. Fair, interesting, and enthusiastic.

Best Professor I have had at Northeastern and I'm a third year Business major. Everything tested on is from lectures so show up! His lessons are interesting and include videos so it's not boring. Professor Prokosch is a very funny guy and very fair when it comes to grading. No homework, take home quizzes, and three exams that are noncumulative.

I can say without question this was the best psychology course I have taken. The coursework is engaging, at times intensive in the early semester with lots of papers due weekly, but manageable. And I have to give a major shout-out to Mark - he is a wonderful, caring professor. This a highly recommended capstone course with a gem of a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Prokosch was incredible! I genuinely enjoyed going to his classes and switched from biology to BNS because of him. He genuinely cares about his students. Grades are completely based on four take-home quizzes and three in person exams but there are bonus points on all of them and as long as you go to lecture it's pretty hard not to get an A.

I highly recommend taking 1101 with Prof. Prokosch. It's a pretty easy course, with straightforward grading. Exam questions are based on lecture material only so if you show up to class and take good notes, you should do fine. And he is a very good lecturer so it's a win-win. I took it as an elective and decided to minor in psych thanks to him!

Grades on 3 exams and 4 quizzes. Quizzes are very easy to get 100% on, and all of the exams are multiple choice only. He's a great guy and makes learning fun and engaging. I would definitely recommend.

I love Mark! Favorite class this semester. Grade is 3 in-class online exams and 4 take-home open-note quizzes - all multiple choice, no homework. Go to lecture!!! He tells you exactly what you'll need to know for exams. Very little time outside of class required, just review notes every now and then and look over his study guides before each exam.

He is a favorite of mine and I highly recommended taking this class. Quizzes can be difficult but are open-book. Exam questions come straight from his lectures so it's important to be in class. His lectures are top-notch. He is smart, funny, and engaging. Just a great overall class.

Prof. Prokosch gives amazing lectures and he's super funny & entertaining but don't take this course if you're expecting something easy, tests are very hard & require a TON of studying content he covers in his lectures. He's straight forward in his expectations but for a 1000 level class, I would have expected this is to be a lot easier.

Professor Prokosch is my favorite professor at Northeastern so far. He's really funny and engages with his students, which keeps the lecture interesting. Also not hard to get an A if you just take notes in class and read them before the exam. Exams are always multiple choice and quizzes are take home and online.
The whole class was based on quizzes and exams, there was no homework. That being said, the quizzes were open note and the exams were not very difficult

Honestly, he is an outstanding professor, and I would recommend him to anyone that wants to take psychology. My section was later in the day, but that didn't matter because of how enjoyable he made the class.
Psych ended up being my favorite class because of this man, entertaining, fun, tries to get everyone involved, and makes it impossible not to pay attention.

I was kind of nervous to take this course during summer 2 semester but it really was not bad at all. Mark is clearly passionate about what he teaches and cares a lot about his students. The class itself was also super easy, I didn't open the textbook once and rarely had to study outside of class.
This was such an interesting and well taught class. The professor explained things very well and used real world examples to help us better understand them.

I really loved everything about this class. I ended up enjoying psychology way more than I thought as a math major. He gave really informative, entertaining lectures (including him accidentally falling off a table while trying to describe mirror neurons). The quizzes and exams were pretty much based on his lectures so focus your efforts there.
Professor Prokosch is a great lecturer, and the content is super interesting.  It's an easy class and it lays a good foundation for psych.

Mark is great! He's super friendly and makes his lectures engaging and funny. My only complaint is that he doesn't always acknowledge the social issues behind some of the psych topics. The course is pretty easy with pretty easy exams and online quizzes being the only grades. I never once read the textbook and was totally fine.

I had Professor Prokosch for foundations and now the social psychology seminar. He is my favorite professor by far. He makes coming to class an enjoyable experience. Class time was mostly divided into lectures and group presentations. Coursework is somewhat challenging, but he provides good feedback, and is flexible when personal issues come up.

I think he was a great professor, I always enjoyed his lectures a lot. There was three exams in total that were worth 25% each and then the rest were open book quizzes. Even though I only got a B I still really enjoyed his class and him as a professor. I hope I can take a class with him in the future!

Mark has great charisma, and he makes lectures interesting. Class is only lectures and quizzes are all multiple choice, which makes it a bit boring (but what else should you expect from an intro class). He takes questions for quizzes from AP, so you can easily find them online on places such as Quizlet.

Mark was what excellent teaching is all about. Informative, entertaining, caring, & inspiring. I loved learning about psychology through his lectures and discussion. If you show up to class and take good notes, you should be fine. I also went to virtual office hours before exams, where he gave strong hints about the exam content, so do that!

This class was a wonderful capstone experience for me. The coursework was manageable with 7 relatively heavy papers, 2 presentations, and class participation. I learned a good amount and Mark really helped me excel in the course. Good feedback, always chill, and was willing to be flexible when necessary.

Excellent professor, interesting class. It's important to attend class because most of the grade it based on exam questions from lectures (including videos and class discussion). Speaking of lectures, his are exceptional. Engaging and informative. I actually liked showing up for class every day. Def my favorite professor of the semester. Recommend.

A simple class, he really just wants to give you the information you need to succeed. Read the textbook and listen to his lectures for an A. Use the study guide prior to exams. He's very nice and tries to keep lecture engaging with jokes etc.

Honestly, if you have a chance to take him just do it. He had 3 quizzes throughout the semester and you take all of them at home. (plus the highest quiz is doubled). You have 3 exams only and honestly they are 50 multiple-question tests so if you just take notes you are fine. He made the final exam online. The best prof I have ever had.

Honestly one of the best psychology professors I've had. I took this class in my first year (I'm a third-year now) and remembered this class when talking about it with a friend of mine. Go to class, do some light review before tests, and you'll get an A. He gives pretty good study guides, too, so studying for tests is easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This guy is exceptional. He is funny, personable, and his lectures are top rate. You should take this course and take it with professor Prokosch. I was in the Explorers program and his class made me decide to major in behavioral neuroscience. Attend class, take notes, review your quizzes, and you should do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took the summer seminar and there was tons of reading and writing in a short period of time, but it was a capstone course. And Mark was a great professor and really gave me confidence in improving my academic writing. Just be prepared to devote lots of time outside of class to do most of the coursework.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Prokosch was exceptional. The coursework was entirely quizzes and exams, but his lectures were the primary source material and they were way above average, even when the classes lasted 3+ hours. On the last day of Zoom lectures, he even used a potato filter which was totally hilarious and educational simultaneously. Recommended for sure!

Really interesting seminar. Mark was very reasonable in the amount of work we must do for a capstone course. He gave some really interesting lectures and there was a good amount of student presentations. I liked the final project that was a grant proposal-type project. And he was nice enough to write me a letter of recommendation based on my work.

Mark is the perfect professor. Kind, intelligent, and inspiring. The seminar was a great prep for graduate school, and he was willing to write a letter of recommendation for me. The course mainly involved lots of reading and papers, but we also got to present a topic of our choice and we were exposed to writing a grant proposal as a final project.

Professor Prokosch was great. He made every day a joy to be in his class. I really learned so much that I feel is relatable to my life. Lectures were always interesting and there was always an opportunity to ask questions and to have some discussion. Exams and quizzes were straight from lecture. Study guides were super helpful. Awesome class!

Loved this guy. The course wall fully lecture-based, but those lectures were always entertaining and informative. All exams and quizzes were open-note and the study guides were really helpful. Great man, great course. Great elective.

I was a huge fan of Professor Prokosch. I enjoyed my time in class and thought the quizzes and exams were very reasonable. I would recommend his class to anyone. He was funny, engaging, and really nice.

I loved everything about this class. Mark always gave really interesting lectures with lots of supplemental videos and anecdotes. There was always some element of discussion and exams and quizzes were straightforward and always based on lectures rather than the textbook. Even though I took it fully remote, I always felt engaged and interested.

My favorite course at Northeastern. Professor Prokosch was great. He was funny and engaging. Never got bored during his lectures. There were three open-note quizzes and three exams. Study guides were very helpful. This elective led me to change my major to psychology!

There were lots of weekly readings and papers, but I guess that's expected in a capstone course. Through it all Mark made it really easy for me to want to do my best. His class actually gave me a platform to explore research interests that inspired me to look into a few master's programs. I highly recommend the seminar.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: To be honest, this is one of the most enjoyable and useful classes I have ever taken at Northeastern. Mark was an incredible professor. He has a voice of a professional narrator which never failed to keep my attention. The lectures were very engaging and the coursework was manageable. Recommended to all those taking Foundations of Psychology.
My favorite class of the semester and my favorite professor. 3 exams, 4 online quizzes, very interesting lectures. Professor Prokosch exceeded expectations.
Excellent professor. Excellent class. Highly recommend.

Professor Prokosch is an amazing professor. He can relate to who he is teaching and makes the content really interesting. We get to see a lot of real-world applications by watching case studies. We also can ask a lot of questions. He is really kind and passionate about psychology. 3 exams, 4 quizzes. Lectures are posted online.

HE IS THE BEST! Super helpful, very knowledgable, great communications skills, always available, it was a great pleasure to be in his class. I highly recommend taking Seminar course with Mark Prokosch!

Mark Prokosch is an amazing professor. He knows how to explain the material clearly and thoroughly while also making it extremely interesting. He has an amazing sense of humor and is overall just a really good guy. Highly recommend taking this class with him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Prokosch is extremely knowledgeable and supportive. He is quick in responding to e-mails, it was very important in times like these. He is a quick grader and provides the most in-depth descriptive feedback for each submitted work. Overall, he is the BEST!

Mark is the best. ever. I am so glad I took his course. He is very passionate about what he teaches, always willing to help/answer questions, and he tries to make class fun. Its very easy to motivate yourself to be in class when you can tell your professor wants to be there, too. Highly recommended.

Easily one of the best professors I've ever had, if you get the chance to take his class, please do. An incredibly kind, caring, and intelligent professor who gives amazing lectures. If you do the work and listen to lectures, the class is an easy A and you learn a lot of information. Cannot say enough good things about him!

Such an interesting class and a wonderful professor. Took it during covid so the exams and quizzes were all online and open-note so it was a pretty easy A. It was an elective course, but probably my favorite. Prokosch is great. Witty and engaging lectures even via Zoom.
Exams and quizzes were all open book!! Quizzes werent timed but exams were so be warned.

I really can't say enough good things about Professor Prokosch. I took the class over the summer and each class session was like 3 hours long, but class time went by relatively quickly because Prokosch is really entertaining when he lectures and there's a good amount of class discussion. I also felt like I learned a lot. Definitely recommend him.

This was honestly one of the best classes Ive taken in college, and Professor Prokosch is a huge reason why. I learned so much about not only psychology but myself as well. His lectures are very captivating and class goes by very quickly. Ill definitely be taking more psych classes in the future because of him. Highly recommend.

Professor Prokosch is the perfect college professor. He is extremely knowledgable and will answer any question outside of lecture material. Knows how to be funny (quirky humor) to engage his students. Extremely easy A so long as you know all information on the study guides - tests do not have any surprises. You will learn a lot too!

Super funny and such a nice guy. Lectures are interesting and he breaks them up with short videos that make them fly by. Only grades are a few online MC quizzes and MC tests, both are super easy if you follow his study guides. Attendance is not mandatory or needed and neither is the textbook.

This is my favorite class and favorite professor I have taken so far in college. Prokosch is a relly outstanding presenter. Super charismatic, smart, and fun. I really loved everything about this class and the lectures. Totally recommend him.

Mark is fantastic. I always found myself looking forward to coming to his class! There are 3 exams (2 midterm, 1 final) and none of them are cumulative. Quizzes are all online and open note. Very easy A if you take notes on the lectures and fill out the study guides he gives. Exams never stray from the study guide content.
YOU SHOULD TAKE THIS CLASS WITH MARK FOR SURE

Mark is a great professor who makes class engaging and exciting. Even though he does not take attendance, I find myself excited to go to his class. His tests are a bit dense, but extremely straightforward if you study your lecture notes. Also, do not buy the textbook. It was expensive and I did not open it once.

Amazing professor and an easy A guaranteed. It might seem like theres a lot of material but he gives a study guide for each exam, just study those and youll be fine. 25%*3 tests on lecture material + 25% online quizzes on textbook readings (quizlet has all the answers)

Prof. Prokosch was great. If you take the class over the summer, be prepared for long lectures, but he makes them super interesting and uses a lot of videos etc. Make sure to go to class, tests are worth 75% of the grade and the material is entirely covered in class. there is also a service-learning requirement of 6hrs (you take psych experiments)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: He said he ran the class like a graduate course, which was intimating at first, but then I realized that it was geared towards preparing me for graduate school. We read a lot of articles across the field of social psych and had to do group presentations and write several papers. But Mark was a fair grader and gave good feedback. Highly recommend.

Professor Prokosch was wonderful and I truly enjoyed his class. The structure of lectures and the provided study guides were extremely accessible and helped me learn. Very smart guy. I appreciated his humor, his openness to questions, and his ability to make lectures both informative and engaging. I would happily take another class with him.

Professor Prokosch is amazing. He's certainly the best professor I've had so far (I'm in my fourth year). I really learned so much in his class. He's very helpful outside of class, and his lectures are super engaging. I switched my minor to psychology because of him.

Love him! He's funny and super nice! His lectures are not too heavy and break down lecture presentations w/ interesting short videos/docus. Some online quizzes that are open books which are easy. His tests are MC and very easy if you follow his study guide! Attendance not mandatory. Got a FBI guest speaker to come which was so cool! don't need book

Mark is an amazing professor. I have learned a lot about research in social psychology. He provides helpful feedback on papers and sets a comfortable atmosphere for learning. The seminar format allows for student-led learning rather than simply being lectured to, which has helped me to feel more confident in my presentation skills. He is top notch!

Mark is amazing. He was accessible outside of class, very caring, and absolutely hilarious. He tries to make the content as fun as possible. Assignments are based on almost weekly papers, which were sometimes very annoying, and class presentations. As long as you show up to class, put in effort into your papers, and do as he asks, you'll get an A.

He's great! He's very nice, makes dad jokes, makes a point to not cut students off even when someone's story goes on for a while. Pretty clear about what the tests were on, but they were online open note so while some questions were tricky, you could figure it out. The homework seems intimidating but it's simple and easy and fairly graded. 10/10
Prokosch is phenomenal.

Professor Prokosch is an excellent lecturer! Almost all of the things on his tests came from notes we took in class, so you don't really need to read the textbook, unless you want to clarify topics. He is funny and includes lots of videos in his lectures to make it interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Mark is a very nice guy and his lectures cover pretty much everything on the test. There really isn't any need to read the textbook as long as you read the power points. There are some questions on the test that are based on videos you can only view if you go to class. Overall, very approachable and nice guy whose lectures are interesting.

Professor Prokosch is one of my favorite teachers. He's a genuinely wonderful person, & he's a great teacher who is passionate about the subject. Always willing to offer help, answer questions in class, & understand when deadlines need to shift to accommodate that stressful week or two when tests/quizzes/etc are overwhelming. 10/10 recommend.
Man I loved this class. He's my most favorite professor I've had.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Mark is a very chill professor, gives study guides for tests which are all multiple choice. Some questions are on videos discussed in lecture which are not posted to blackboard, but besides that it's an easy class.

I actually looked forward to going to class because the professor was such a great lecturer and an interesting guy. He posts his lecture slides online before each class, but you definitely need to go to class to do well on the tests.
The best intro course I have ever taken in any subject area. Professor Prokosch  is simply the best.
Makes an intro psych class interesting and personalized.

Attendence isn't mandatory, but if you don't want to read the book just go and take notes  because you won't need to get the book and he asks questions that come directly from the videos we watch in class. Honestly, just do not get the book and go to class, he even gives you study guides that you only really need the lecture slides to fill out

He's very friendly and interested in the topic, but he expects students to memorize EVERYTHING he says in lectures and makes no attempt to clarify which parts are the most important. Your entire grade is based on 3 tests that are extremely hard and the questions are very specific. It's almost impossible to get an A, but he's still a good teacher.
Not only he's a very passionate about the class, he's incredibly hilarious. He will definitely make you interested in psychology. Went into this class thinking I'll hate it but I absolutely loved it.
READ THE BOOK!

I appreciated his enthusiasm and that he included a lot of current topics in his lectures.  I would have preferred to have more than just 3 exams to base our grade on, but at least he was willing to give extra credit. He's the best professor I've had.

I had heard that I should take intro psych with Professor Prokosch.  I'm glad I did.  He is really interesting and I actually looked forward to his lectures. He also has a super dry sense of humor.  Also, one class he fell off a table - sort of on purpose - to help us remember what the hippocampus does. Highly recommend.
Prokosch is an awesome professor. Definitely need to come to class and take good notes.  I'm thinking about majoring in psychology thanks to him.

He is the best professor I have ever had in my 5 years at Northeastern. I'm about to graduate and his course really inspired me to pursue graduate school in psychology when I was initially unsure if it was for me.

The professor is great, but didn't really get to know him much because I didn't really get to interact with him. You come to a lecture, sit a lecture (pretty interesting), and do 3 exams within the semester. Hard to get an A though, really got to study--no make up tests.
Lectures were incredibly interesting, tests were confusingly worded. Hard to get an A since there are only three grades per semester.

He is a really good professor. His lectures are very clear and funny and though they are sometimes boring, the slideshows are all on blackboard and its easy to catch up. He gives study guides for every test. He also has the most adorable new baby that he talks about during his lectures about developmental psychology. Take this class!

My favorite class the semester I took it. His lectures are entertaining and easy to follow, and tests were all multiple choice and fairly easy as long as you studied. I only remember using the text book once though, so I'd suggest saving your money there. Otherwise, take this class!!!

He's a cool guy and a great teacher. His lectures are interesting, especially the videos. He explains the material well and with humor. He assigns reading from the textbook, but just focus on the lecture slides, and you'll do well.

He's pretty good. I like his lecture style. He explains concepts pretty clearly with (sometimes funny) examples. It's good that he posts the slides before class so that you can print them and bring them to class. He plays people's song requests and drinks cappuccino every class lol. Only thing I don't like about this class is that the MCQs exams.

i agree w/ the general consensus over his helpfulness and clarity; he is great.  HOWEVER, this is no regard an easy class! Test avgs (so far we've taken 3 of 4) are a 75 and he doesn't gives curves or extra credit. The 4 papers make up 20% and are all easy 100%.  Still, the grade of an avg student gets a C+/B-...not typical for a intro psych course

Posts slides. Classes are VERY interesting and easy to follow. Always funny and sometimes says anecdotes...Exams are all MCQs. Study the slides and your notes VERY well and you'll get an A. Focus on the videos he shows in class because he asks about them in his exams.

The best professor I've had by far. He makes everything so clear and he is also hilarious. His slides are all up on blackboard but attend class to watch the videos as they will show up on exams. I would take another class with him in a heartbeat. He is the best!!!!

Great at teaching. As clear as can be dealing with a lot of information to cover in a relatively short amount of time. Easy to understand said information. Attendance to class almost paramount to getting good grades as he does a better job than the textbooks explaining.

Riccardo is an amazing professor who cares about his students, and is even more than crystal clear, although much of the material may cross with CS2510 it is well worth the clarification, and his lectures are well supported and enjoyable.
Great teacher. Very helpful outside of class and puts up lecture notes on every lecture so you never have to write anything down! Looks and sounds like Jeremy from www.purepwnage.com.

Straight forward teacher.  Wants everybody to do well.  Homeworks are slightly challenging but not impossible, just requires a bit of thinking.  Kind of unorganized at times.  Exams covers most of what is given in the notes.  Allows for a 2 sided "cheat-sheet" on mid&final exams. Put in some effort for a good grade.
wears all black; energetic

A lot of people will gravitate towards the online version of this class due to the in-person option with Pavlu having an 8-hour exam. I will give you a fair warning and say do not take this class with Marko Puljic. His grading criteria is non-existent, therefore get ready get flunked by the final project just because. Waste of money and time
you are better off using ChatGPT

HW solutions shown during lecture or have nothing to do with weekly topics. If you're confused, asking him for help leads to a 45+ min rant where you're insulted and leave more confused than you started. Many students have filed academic disputes for his insane grading of the final project. Please AVOID AT ALL COSTS!

Please don't take this class. Prof. Puljic will not give you any clear expectations or advice on how to excel in this class, and while the actual assignments are not too awful, if just a bit time consuming, the final project was graded so inconsistently and dropped my grade significantly. Multiple people in my class filed complaints against him.

Expectations are unclear or not provided. Most assignments have a vague rubric and submission requirements are never stated. Possibly as a result, grading is extremely inconsistent and often harsh. During lectures, the professor is either unhelpful or explicitly provides solutions. There is no middle ground where the material is properly taught.

Absolute waste of time and money - doesn't teach concepts well and instead yells at you for not knowing the stuff when reached out for doubts. Passes racist comments quite often and says that is a joke where he comes from. Very harsh grading and often behaves very arrogant. No clear rubric for grading and almost always the grading is unfair.

I can confidently say that Prof. Puljic is one of the most apathetic professors I have ever had the displeasure of taking in my educational career. Never in my life a class became easier once I decided to break away from his recitations and start studying with resources. For those who are considering taking him, you have been warned
Don't recommend, will yell at you when asking questions and unorganized

Homework due 8pm, no regrade on final despite a 50 avg. midterm was 60 avg and no curves. Teaching is a bit too unstructured and test questions can be ambiguous. He is passionate though. If you genuinely care about AI and want to put in the work though, you'll probably do fine.

I recommend starting assignments early. He was a passionate lecturer who definitely showed enthusiasm for the content. This class didn't have exams previously, but they are a new addition this semester. They were graded harshly, with little room for partial credit. The mean for the midterm was a 60, while the mean for the final was a 50.

Genuinely the best one of the best professors I've had. Prof Raj is so willing to make this course the best it can be, and it's clear he wants all his students to learn and pass. He gives so many resources, is active on campuswire (similar to piazza), and really takes feedback seriously. Also great at teaching, would recommend to take
Nice guy but not the best at teaching. He spends way too much time talking about stuff unrelated to the course content

Easily the most well-organized online resources of any Khoury class, and most caring prof. as well. This guy genuinely loves what he does, and it shows in his lectures, in&out of class interactions with students, and how accessible he is. It also seems he's been factoring in student feedback and adjusting the course. Thank you prof venkat🙏.

Prof. Raj is just an all-around nice guy, cares about his students, and is passionate about his work. Prior reviews show that his class used to be different, but as he mentioned in our final class, he heavily values student feedback, and it is evident that things are different now. Be sure to get started on the HWs early and attend his lectures.

Professor Venkat has, by far, the best online resources of any course I've taken. Also very interactive lectures where he really wants students to participate and ask questions. You can schedule 1-1 with him even outside of office hours. He offers 2 pathways for the final so you can choose what fits your learning style. Best professor at Khoury.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Raj was hands down one of my favorite professors I've had at Northeastern. He is very knowledgable and clearly passionate about his work. He takes the time to clearly explain and walk students through lectures, and wont hesitate to put the lecture on hold to clarify things.

I really really enjoyed the class and lecture. Prof. Venkat is so nice and really makes you think in lecture but you have to pay 100% attention to really learn. His homeworks aren't terrible but they're quite confusing, he also has a pretty tough grading policy so you will need to go to office hours a lot to make sure you're on the right track.
Loved this guy, really cared about people learning very entertaining lectures. Harsh on deadlines but homeworks weren't too hard.

Took it over the summer and really enjoyed it! Professor is very knowledgeable and fun to talk to. Assignments are straightforward, Final Group Project is a lot of work, no exams, TAs & OH are very helpful. He has well-written notes on all the topics, and even though attendance isn't mandated, please go to class! It's very enjoyable : )
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took this class during the summer and it went really well. We only had 3 assignments and one group project which is reasonable for summer semester. Lectures are pretty engaging and he is quite available to help out in anyway. For homework's I would recommend starting earlier, just because they can take some time.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: he is actually the GOAT and i can't understand why he was rated so low. he is one of the best profs i've had at khoury: easy to follow lectures (just show up), an ability to break down complex topics to make it seem so easy, and genuine care for students and passion for education. if you're planning to take CS4100 there's no better guy than raj!
He is a great professor for FAI, would enjoy taking up his class once again
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great Professor, very interesting lectures and course content. You could tell he cared about his students and wanted to provide the best learning environment! Would highly recommend.

Unreasonable homework amount and timeline. Strange sense of "fair", doesn't allow extra credit because that's "unfair" to students with a job that do not have the time (funny, isn't the whole idea of extra credit just sacrificing extra time to boost your grade?). A TA even said he has no idea on a homework problem.

Professor Rajagopal Venkatesaramani's lectures are highly effective in enhancing understanding. He also asks well-thought-out questions that deepen understanding and often provide a fresh perspective on the concepts. Reviewing the notes beforehand is beneficial, and both the professor and TA are approachable for any clarifications.
Unclear grading standards
