Raj is hands down a top professor I've ever had. His lectures are engaging and he has an inspirational passion for teaching. He invents hours of the day to help you with any challenges you face. If you know the material already, you still have the rare opportunity to work with a truly dedicated educator. The negative reviews are frankly absurd.

I don't understand the point of having such ambiguous Assignments and neither the TAs nor the professor cares enough to throw some light on the doubts students have. If I were to go back in time, I would have had definitely not taken this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please don't waste your time and money taking this course.

Pretty generous with the homework by combining the third and fourth one for us. Gave a lot of help outside class and even helped my group beyond the requested time. Takes feedback very well and I really respect it.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very unclear and inconsistent grading and TAs don't even have the basic knowledge to help other students out.
Absolutely useless course content, won't learn anything you don't already know
No use taking this course whatsoever, TAs don't know anything to help you out. If you want to learn take it from a different professor or learn it online which is going to be a lot better.

If you would like to learn atleast the basics of AI, please don't consider taking the course under this professor at all. Absolute waste of time and money. Instead you can watch a few youtube videos from a Stanford Professor which is exactly what he teaches in the class with the exact words, jokes and class interactions from the videos.
Very good professor, obviously cares a lot about students. Office hours were helpful.

It's almost disheartening for me to see all of these bad reviews for Professor Raj because he has truly been the single most inspiring and caring Professor that I've had in Khoury. Even though he's a good lecturer, his true strength lies in his office hours and helping those that take the effort to reach out to him. Take the effort to get help.

He is one of the most caring professors I have had and truly cares about your learning experience and not just the grade. His course material is designed to build your foundation and open up avenues to solve problems in multiple ways in the future. If participate wholeheartedly, you will gain a lot from his class and won't be disappointed.

Good professor, had well-constructed lectures and clearly presented the topics. The assignments were tough but they teach you a lot. They are appropriately sized and manageable. Make sure to attend the presentations as they are both very useful and necessary since he graded attendance through random pop quizzes (were super easy). Highly recommend!
if you want to gain useful knowledge in AI, you should choose other professor
Think twice before taking his class.

Very caring professor who is passionate about AI. Grades kindly and is very empathetic towards his students. He stayed with me way past his office hours just to help me understand a concept I was struggling with. He makes a couple mistakes in lecture, and the pop quizzes are unnecessary, but he is there to support your learning!
bad quiz setting, difficult homework, don't take his lecture
very kind and approachable

He is actually one of the best professors I've had at northeastern. He is so kind and caring and SO affirming. You never feel bad asking a question and he makes concepts easier despite the algorithms being so complicated.

His lectures are good. Unorganized though. For our most recent midterm, he made the midterm earlier and created lied about the reason, stating that the course was ahead of schedule, which is false as we are on schedule per the syllabus. He made the exam early just so they have more time to grade, which is very detrimental to students.

I'm 3 weeks into his class but I can already tell why he's rated so highly. Great at explaining, very approachable, breaks down a difficult class into easily understandable sections. Also love how affirmative he is when we ask questions, it makes the process of attending his class so much more enjoyable.
Great lecturer considering how boring the material is and incredibly willing to help in OH!

Raj is the goat at ALGO!!!
The most difficult part of the class are the exams, HackerRanks on HW's, and writing proofs.
Very slow and thorough lectures. Is accepting of students questions during and after lectures.
He also was a co-author of the discrete textbook, and has over 7,000 citations.

Raj was an amazing professor! I was very nervous before taking Algorithms, however, he made things much easier. He's an amazing lecturer. He answers every single question to make sure students understand what's going on, and his office hours were amazing. He's also very smart, with over 7000 citations I believe. I can't recommend him enough!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Really nice and empathetic and good at explaining
The best professor I have ever studied under and definitely the best course structure.
Amazing lectures! Starts from the basics and builds up as the lecture progresses.
A great professor. Very approachable and extremely patient.

One of the best professors in the CS department. His lectures are absolutely amazing. He stops the lecture to answer any student's doubt no matter how trivial it is with the same enthusiasm as he teaches. You will definitely learn a lot in his class.

Enthusiastic and dedicated towards teaching. He explains every concept with detail and takes a lot of efforts to make it understandable to each and every student. For a change, I like going to his classes. Assignments are difficult but midterms and quizzes are on bit easy side.  Grading is fair. Overall, I recommend him without any doubt!!
great pofessor
excellent prof

This is one of the best prof. you have to take course under his guidance. Excellent teaching and explanation. He takes efforts from his side to help the students. Which I haven?t seen in other prof. Assignments are tough , quizzes are ok. Grading is fair, totally how you performed in the coursework.
He teaches very well. Great Guy!!!! HomeworkAssignments are way to tough. Examzzz are cool....!!! Final Project was very innovative and technically challenged....!!

Great guy! Class was a little slow moving at times, but that's really Fell's problem. If you put a decent effort in, you'll get an easy A and learn a lot. Some of the written HW was difficult, but everything else was very fair.
Great guy and great teaching. Always available for extra help. This class does require a lot of work, but overall it was easy.

Raj is a tough professor, but you will learn a great deal in his courses. He is a nice guy, and willing to help those who need it.  Grading was fair overall. I usually enjoyed coming to class, which is strange.
Was a tough class for me but Raj did a great job presenting it.  Always willing to put in the extra time to make sure students understand the material.  Very organized classes.
The Homeworks were at times overly difficult when compared with in class amterial.  Exams were usually easier than HW.
Class can be boring. He teaches wierd concepts. Does give out A's alot though and you can get extensions on stuff easily
Raj is a nice person who cares very much about whether a person is learning.  He also focuses on effort for those who don't get the grades but try hard.  I would take another class with him.
The Raj! Really nice guy, and will give you an A for effort. Unfortunately, he rarely quizzes on what's covered. Somewhat easy course, though.

If you are looking for an easy class take anything with this professor. He is super sweet and cares about his students a lot, but he is not fully organized when it comes to his class material... The assignments are easy as long as you read the instructions, and he grades super easy as well.

Professor Martinez is a wonderful person and genuinely cares about everyone in his class. He displays his passion for teaching everyday he comes to class and is willing to change his methods to make people learn better. He makes learning fun and wants to see everyone thrive.
Horrible. Doesn't know what he's talking about.  Disorganized.  Students could teach the class much better than he can easily.  I thought my professors would impress me at NU

I was actually in CRIM6202, Grad Criminology, but I believe it was a new course for him. 
Pros: personable, encourages peer discussions, choose some interesting readings, was receptive to (most) student comments
Cons: severely disorganized, students taught most of the class, he was often all over the place, sometimes un-provoking lectures
Too slow. Teaches more sociology in a criminology class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Although Prof. Martinez's lectures were very full and he read most of it directly off the slides, the information was valid and interesting, and his passion for the content was very visible. He was a very personable guy, as we talked after class often and made a point to get to know his students.

This man is absolutely ridiculous. He did not teach anything, all he did was repeat what was on the slide and then ask us what we thought about it/what it means. He once asked what influenza was. The TA gave all our feedback, so the class probably would've been better if he wasn't there. I didn't listen to the reviews, but trust me. Don't do it.

Genuinely the worst teacher I have ever had in my entire life, and I have had some bad ones. I am mad I had to pay tuition to sit in this torture class twice a week and I did not learn a single thing. He does not know what he is talking about and will make you go insane. He would take 20 minutes to say two words, which was endless pain.
The man does not even know what he is teaching.  Awful professor DO NOT TAKE.
He doesn't know the material. Can't answer a single question asked by students. Lacks common sense. DON'T TAKE HIS CLASS.

I have honestly never had a worse professor. He can't answer the most basic questions about exams he wrote or questions about the data that he's presenting, gives students a ton of attitude, and spends more time talking about the club than about sociology. Save your money, he's not worth it. I'm amazed Northeastern hired such an apathetic professor

80-90% of the time, I felt like he didn't understand what he was teaching. He asks questions but when we can't answer them, he just moves on and we don't get an answer. He also doesn't answer questions that the students ask. IMPOSSIBLE to get help from, it seems like it's all going in one ear and out the other. Really seems unqualified to teach.

I could teach his class better than he could. He reads off of a powerpoint, doesn't explain concepts, spends about twenty minutes each class talking about "the club" and learning how to pronounce last names. Avoid him.

He is a terrible teacher. Does not seem at all interested in actually teaching, fell asleep in class one time, sits in the back of the room while students teach the class FOR him and plays with his phone. Won't even answer questions about the topic. AVOID this professor at all costs and save your tuition money!

Martinez is one of the most disorganized professors. He is always all over the place and uses the class time to learn how to correctly pronounce students last names. The class is pointless. He is also rude/condescending to some students and easy/nice to others.

nicest professor I've had. This class wasn't hard to get a good grade in, but it was difficult to actually learn/understand the material. She sometimes got confused by her notes during her lectures and then assigned homework that she didn't know how to do. Let us correct quizzes and get extensions when needed.

Prof. Carrier is amazing. Her lectures and homework prepare you perfectly for the four quizzes she gives for the semester (no tests/final). She cares deeply about her students and is definitely one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern (especially in the cheme department).

The nicest prof. I've ever had. Her lectures are pretty clear and the homework prepares you well for tests. Only con was that she was extremely disorganized, but she is a very sweet person and understanding with extensions, which made up for it. Allowed test corrections for half credit, which I know helped a lot of people.
Learn from his lecture slides a lot!

Professor Reagle was my favorite teacher I've had. He had very clear expectations and was good at reminding students about them. The readings could be long but very interesting, and at first the tech work feels tedious but is also pretty interesting and can definitely be beneficial in the future! He was a hard grader, but fair & gave good feedback.

Dr. Reagle is an amazing and intelligent professor. The class is not easy, and he is a difficult grader, but the environment and topics are exciting. I would take this class and any other one by him again. I learned so much, and he always has the best examples to lock in the information. This class is what college is about!

Reagle is very smart and a tough grader. There is only one exam and its in the middle of the sem for dig age comm and it is unfairly difficult. If you do well on reading responses and the final essay you should be fine but he is a tough grader. If you follow his directions very closely you will do well otherwise you should NOT take his course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Reagle showed his enthusiasm for the course. He is knowledgeable and enjoys what he does. He makes it difficult for students to share the enjoyment. Prof Reagle graded everything way too intensely for a gen ed course. It sucked a lot of the joy out of the work, knowing that you won't be properly rewarded for your efforts, as As are rare.

Prof. Reagle is a really nice professor and is very passionate about the course. It's high-level course so it won't be an easy A, but he makes the material interesting to learn so you'll want to participate. You'll be reading and writing a lot, but it's not unbearable. He is very flexible about word-count and essay topics. I recommend this course!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I thoroughly enjoyed Professor Reagle's class. Always has great examples, very easy to follow. I definitely recommend taking this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Very intelligent and inspiring. Cares about his students. I learnt a lot in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Teaches real world concepts that are actually useful.

Professor Reagle is one of the most straightforward professors I've ever had. He definitely does things his way but he explains exactly what he wants from his students and helps you figure it out along the way. In my experience, those who do not like him as a professor didn't put effort into the class. It definitely will not be easy but he's fair.

Id never take this professor again. Grade was basically based on 1 test. He gave me a 50 & when I went to him and he said "well that is right but I wanted this specific answer I talked about a month ago" for the whole test. No points back, 79.86% in the class, wouldn't round to a B-. Participated more 2nd half, got lower part. grade. Makes no sense
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The class itself is pretty basic, but due to the fact that it's a required Comm class Reagle makes it much more enjoyable than it typicaly would be. As long as you participate in class and read most of the required readings you will get a great grade. He is also super nice and understanding if you try to approach him after class.

If you need to take Orgo 1, please take it with Sherbo. She was genuinely so sweet and wanted everyone to succeed. She let us use a notecard for all exams and gave lots of extra credit opportunities- I think I ended the class with a 105%. Her exams were fair; she's not trying to trick you. Lectures were clear. I wish she taught orgo 2!
Professor Sherbo teaches the content really well and makes it very easy to do well in her class. Definitely recommend taking her for orgo 1
Amazing teacher! Best teacher I ever had at Northeastern.

Absolutely amazing professor. She's a great grader, her lectures are very clear and easy to follow. Gives plenty of office hours if you need the extra help, and she actually cares about her students. Would 100% take her again if she taught orgo 2.

Easiest professor I've had an Northeastern. The orgo 1 course material is already so easy, but she explains it really well. Class moved very slow so if you're interested in orgo be ready to be patient. DO HER EXTRA CREDIT AND PROBLEM SETS! I ended with a 107% in the class and only had to get a 52% for an A+. She always posts lecture notes

AMAZING chem professor I'm so sad she doesn't teach orgo 2. She's super generous with grading, lectures are very clear and slower paced, exams are super straightforward. She is very open to helping students outside of class. Lets you bring a notecard for exams and only assignments are Activ problem sets. BEST orgo prof at northeastern by far!

Class is EXTREMELY structured and organized. She tells you every testable topic and question type and makes the content very understandable. Also allows index card during exam. Attendance is measured by live, in-class questions. MINE the extra credit, pay attention, and ask questions when you need it, and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Literally the best professor I've had in the chem department. Lectures are super clear and paced appropriately, exams are what you expect (and based on the lectures) and her extra credit problem sets really help your grade. I would 100% take orgo 2 with her if she taught it.

she's genuinely so sweet and caring and makes Orgo so easy. Participation is online so you don't have to be there in perosn and she always posts her annotated notes online. Also gives so much extra credit. Exams are straightforward so as long as you understand the homework you'll get 100% on the exams. Genuinely I think I ended with a 103%
Really enjoyed her class, loved the lectures with the skeleton slides. Easy to understand, and her tests were good too. The homework was good too, all practice problems.

She is probably one of the best chem profs at Northeastern. She cares sooo much about her students and wants them all to succeed. I wish the tests weren't weighted so heavy but she lets you bring in a flashcard and she is always available for extra help
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best chemistry teacher ive ever had

Very effective professor for a difficult course. Lectures were direct and to the point. Class time was used very effectively, lectures contained a lot of useful information, and there are more than enough office hours to discuss any questions. Professor Sherbo is very approachable and kind. Overall, a difficult class taught by a great professor.

Prof Sherbo did an amazing job at teaching o chem, she let us use a note card for the exams so she never emphasized memorization and instead wanted us to understand things. She had lots of office hours and always made time to answer any questions you had. The exams were straight forward and she goes over what topics will be covered very clearly.

Please avoid this professor, she doesn't know how to teach and is quite sadistic. 
All her lectures are taught in a single monotonous tone. During the group project presentation, she made sure to criticise and put people on the spot even if they did fairly well. 
The exams also are only around an hour and each question has a lot of sub questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof. Ali is quite disrespectful to students. Will outright ignore questions and provides unclear feedback. Spent almost 10 minutes shaming a group presentation, way beyond normal criticism. Treats graduate students like children, and has boring lectures. I'm fairly sure she doesn't care about students success. Avoid it you can

Update 2025: Still really awful. The tone of her lectures are still monotonous. Entire one hour class sounds like a long loud sentence. She has no interest in you actually learning the concepts. Her ONLY care is to "hit into the next module". Grading: you'll lose points for unspoken "rules" and odd reasons. Exams + HW during breaks. Do not take.

This course is tough. I do not like the professor way of teaching, the material is really hard to understand. She treat the students as a kids in school. The course is ok but her behaviour with student made the student avoid her classes.

Prof Ali does a fair job, but speaks in monotone. It can be hard to pay attention in class so make sure to follow through her slides at the same time because they're fairly detailed. She provides at least one free online textbook for Arena that was pretty useful. Didn't mind the class but didn't retain much afterwards either.

Participation is super important in her class but if you speak up, you will be fine. Tests are writing intensive but not bad, cheat sheet allowed. Prof. Stewart is very knowledgeable in her field and you can really learn a lot. Although she gives a lot of homework, it's predictable and easy. Love her!

She is a great professor and I had a great experience in her class. Lectures could be long sometimes but majority of them had useful examples to really help you understand marketing. Tests were long but as long as you answered thoroughly you would be solid. If you take a class with her make sure to participate it really helps.

Professor Stewart genuinely cares for her students, as long as you care for her class. PARTICIPATE a lot, and you will do well. She might feel strict at first, but she is very understanding. You get cheat sheets for the midterm and final (which can be computer generated). Marketing simulation and presentation are easy if your team is good.

Great professor, i learned a lot, attendance mandatory and a lot of homework. but if you go to class and listen to lectures you are fine. she knows sooo much and is very inspirational, thought about foing into marketing thanks to her.

Holy shit, what an awful teacher. I am not one to write bad reviews, but between her boring, repetitive lectures, to the most unhelpful feedback, and moving grading scale, she took what could have been such a fun, interesting class to dreadful, frustrating few hours.

This course was one of the most rewarding I've taken. You work with a real client to improve their advertising strategy, and it's great experience to add to your resume. Professor Stewart is supportive, gives helpful feedback, and ties all course materials back to the client work. She genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed.

Rachel is a highly knowledgeable professor who brings expertise, enthusiasm, and real-world insight to the classroom. She explains complex concepts clearly and creates an engaging, supportive environment that encourages critical thinking. Her thoughtful approach and openness to feedback made the course both impactful and memorable.

I really, really do not understand the negative reviews. Granted, most of the negative reviews are for her other class but for Intro to Marketing she was AMAZING. I really learned so much in this course. There's def homework but its pretty easy. I highly reccomend my queen rachel.

The professor is very passionate but it comes to a fault. The workload is heavy you'll need to spend 8+ hours a week on this class alone. Additionally, be prepared to ARGUE for your grade. You will do her feedback to a T and she will still give you a 30%. She's always movi ng the goal post. If you can avoid her, please do!

These reviews are bit dramatic, but more or less the same in terms of heavy workloads and  contradictory feedback taking away from the value of the course. Client project shouldn't be as dragged on with diff parts as it is-period. Too much emphasis on experiential learning when we get that thru coop. Good person, room for improvement as professor.

Despite detailed peer reviews on non-contributing teammates, she ignored our feedback, questioned why we didn't raise issues (when we had), and blamed us instead of addressing issues. Even if you go above and beyond directions, she'll still find faults. She claimed we missed parts SHE overlooked. Take her class at the risk of your sanity.

Just take another professor. This entire class is dedicated to a group project and involves more work than any other class I've taken at NU (maybe several classes combined). Unless you can read her mind, the work you submit will never be up to her standards. Be prepared to be scrutinized, even after you follow her advice. She is super degrading.

She assigns too many group projects. Her homework is readings and videos of material that is already covered in class. Take another professor who can teach the subject with more sympathy for your time. I spent 8+ hours a week on this class, literally working on this class every single day of the semester to get her "deliverables" in on time.

Do not take this class. There are other better, and less work heavy classes. All you do is your group project and there are multiple quizzes, project deliverables, required tracked videos, and presentations due every week. I am so overwhelmed in this class and she often makes really weird, kind of insensitive jokes. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS PLS.

Professor Stewart is horrible. The work load that she requires is more than that of my other 3 classes. I spend multiple hours each day on work and she is an extremely tough grader and will nitpick on things that she advised you on. She tries to act funny in class but it never quite lands and she consistently pronounces more ethnic names wrong.
Don't take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Inconsiderate and intolerant. Probably the worst professor at Northeastern and doesn't understand students are taking more than just her class. For your own mental health, avoid her at all costs. Terrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: RUN AWAY DO NOT TAKE HER. THIS IS MY FIRST TIME DOING RATE MY PROFESSOR AND IT IS BECAUSE OF HER. THIS ONE CLASS WITH GIVE ME WORKLOAD EQUIVALENT TO ALL MY OTHER CLASS COMBINE. SHE IS THE WORST PROFESSOR EVER. GIVE OUT UNCLEAR INSTRUCTION ABOUT ASSIGNMENT. WHENEVER YOU DIDN'T MEET HER STANDARD SHE WILL DEDUCT GRADE DUE TO PROFESSIONISM.

I have two issues, the course and the professor. I want to start with Professor Stewart's ignorance, nobody's perfect granted, but I cannot respect someone who makes simple mistakes whether it is misgendering someone or mixing up the names of minority students. The course feels too tedious for an intro to marketing class but the content is useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Makes an intro class unnecessarily difficult. Quizzes and multiple assignments per week that sometimes get too much to handle. You do not know your grade the entire semester so you are kind of in the dark until the last minute. Midterm and Final are extremely long with barely enough time to complete. Save yourself and go with another professor.

FANTASTIC, fun, textbook essential (to a degree) teacher. I am baffled at the negative reviews here, I don't now how one could get anything but an A range grade besides just not trying. I was weary of the criticism going in, however at every stop possible Rachel demonstrated a conscious push for improvement. If you care, you will thrive.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Prof. Stewart was very harsh. Most of the projects are competitions between peers. She tends to only give negative feedback and is not helpful when you ask for help. She gets upset and is rude to students when they have questions. The attendance rules are too strict and she doesn't excuse anything. The content was enjoyable, class was not.

She is a great professor, really knowledgable and super understanding. She wants to give students A's. She assigns a lot of hw, but it's not difficult. The group project is pretty demanding, but otherwise a manageable course. Would recommend her class.

Boring lectures but passionate, has a final group presentation where your grade is partly evaluated by your peers for some reason. Many homework's but easy to get A's. Tests are a bunch of tiny case studies and are graded harshly and subjectively.

I liked the material in this class, and Prof. Stewart is very passionate about marketing, but it was so much more stressful than it should have been. Two major assignments are based on competition between classmates, like part of the final is graded based on rankings from your peers. I've never had a professor/teacher run a class like this.

Outlined directly in her syllabus, getting up in class to use the restroom is "rude" and does not permit students to go. Material is competition based and you rank classmates' presentations and get graded accordingly. Her midterm/final are open response answers which she grades arbitrarily with no rubric depending on if she likes you or not.

Do not take her. She never really helps you and just tells you to look at past examples. Her self written tests make no sense and you're not allowed to look at your laptops in a class where you need to take notes.

Rachel Stewart was so far one of my worst professors that I have had at Northeastern University. Outside of tests, her assignments are all essentially competition based and it almost fosters a sense of resentment against your classmates. She also emphasizes participation despite being very judgemental. Would write more, but I do not like her at all

Fun class, hard professor. Prof Stewart only gives negative feedback, so I always felt stressed out by this class. There's also no way of seeing your grade before the class ends. Prof was slightly offensive to me and other teammates, and incredibly unprofessional in terms of the way she handled email communications. This class is fun... just beware

One of my better professors at Northeastern. She is big on lecture participation, but the lectures are easy to understand so it is not hard to give opinions on the topics covered. Final grades are curved. She is very knowledgable about marketing and takes student feedback. Downsides are group work, and tests are based heavily on the textbook.

Professor Stewart was by far one of my favorite professors I had during my time at NU. I was sad to have met her only during my senior year because I would have loved to spend more time with her and pick her brain as she has a wealth of knowledge about the marketing world. I highly recommend her and any classes she's offering! Gained so much!

She has fun lectures if you like marketing. Like to involve the class in group discussions. Be ready to learn all about loreal. If u do not like marketing and its a requirement only then u will not like it. There is some reading on team building which is such a waste, and exams seem a waste.

Stewart was at times visibly irritated with students participating and at times correcting her, her exams are practically purely textbook and application. she does mention she changes the amount of exams in or out of class and the amount of chapters depending on semester so it can be different for future classes. Just read and know terms

has great lectures and you can tell she cares about marketing however you don't know your grade the entire semester and makes you cram a project in two weeks that no other marketing professor does. i enjoyed the class but there's odd things she does. don't even get me started on having to be ranked and graded by your peers on your final project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class ended up being a ridiculous amount of work. There is so much textbook reading and its all just pointless terms that are common sense. Exams are difficult and you have to do the reading to be prepared. The professor can also be somewhat rude and sassy to students. She also expects classes to be conducted "like a business meeting"

Wierd class dynamic. If she sees students are all collectively writing notes on a slide she is teaching, she will skip to the next one. I do not know if she is attempting to encourage us to read the textbook more, but just really is odd behavior. This class also does extra work compared to other ones.

What was the point of going to class? Attendance was mandatory but the exams were based on the textbooks. I never felt like I got any real guidance or knowledge from lectures that I couldn't get from the book, and the exams blew me out of the water simply because I couldn't fit 10000 terms into my brain.

Not a fan of Professor Stewart. Her teaching style is not effective, and she has a tendency to be dismissive and even condescending toward students. The textbook and lectures contain next to no insightful information, and the exams are poorly written. The group client project is interesting, but not worth the busy work and dozens of due dates.

Professor Stewart is one of the better professors I've had at Northeastern. She is very knowledgeable about marketing and makes learning interesting. Textbook reading is pretty light and lectures are not boring. Grades based on quizzes and a big group project that is great experience for a marketing major. Easy A if you keep up with the material.

Professor Stewart is an amazing person and extremely knowledgeable within marketing. Her assignments are straightforward, and it feels like you're actually learning something rather than just doing busy work. Her lectures actually teach you things and are enjoyable to attend. Relatively easy to get an A in this class. Take her if you can!

Rachel Stewart is easily one of the best professors at Northeastern. I had the pleasure of having her for 2 classes (Intro to Marketing and Ad and Brand) and would take her again. Her lectures are always engaging and brings real world discussions to the textbook material. She also cares about her students a lot and is always open to feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Rachel was by far my favorite professor at Northeastern. She is not only a great teacher she is also extremely passionate about what she teaches and has great industry experience. She manages to keep the class engaging while providing you with the material that actually matters towards future marketing success.

Professor Stewart is by far the most amazing prof Ive had in college so far. Her excitement about the subject matter is nothing like Ive seen from any other prof. I typically do not like going to class but prof Stewart made each session so enjoyable. She is super accessible and always willing to discuss any of your concerns.

Professor Stewart is awesome! The whole course is full of exciting, fun projects. All projects tie strongly into what is taught in class so it gives a chance to practice the theory. If you love ads, you will love this class. She brings funny, cool ads to class all the time. She's also very understanding. The class is very group project heavy

Rachel is a pretty good professor as far as sharing the information goes, but it ends about there. She handles feedback really poorly, and gets defensive if you ask for clarification. Seems nice at first, but if she decides she doesn't like you, you're screwed. She has an extreme superiority complex and makes what should be a fun class brutal.

She mostly does a good job, but tends to rely on textbook provided slides more than her own input, of which she actually has a good amount. Class is heavily based on doing assignments with a group, but its very easy and manageable while still helpful. However, she does not respond well to feedback and has a hard time taking blame or making changes.

Very chill professor, she's funny and the classes go by quickly because she always encourages people to talk in class and give their own opinions/examples. You don't learn too much from lectures, but read the textbook and you'll be fine.

Very interesting professor, encourages class discussion (participation is a huge chunk of the grade), average grader, easy class. You don't need to listen in class at all as long as you read the textbook before each test, but even if you do listen in class you HAVE TO read the textbook to do well on the tests. Loved this class, never dreaded it.
I took an online class with him and the material was very helpful, nothing too strenuous. Whenever I had questions, I would email and he would respond very quickly. Would recommend.

One of those types of phil professors who has a tremendous ego and tries to make his class the most important one by giving you a bunch of meaningless assignments. And if you miss 1 of 70 assignments, you are automatically dropped a letter grade. Also makes you write an essay to propose using a laptop in class, so he is that kinda pretentious

Hopefully this is informational. Personally, the class is great with respect to learning philosophical values and understanding how to ask deeper questions. Having said that, the overall design of the course needs Massive reworking, I'm sorry but 55+ graded assignments and not passing ONE socratic memo gives you a A-... lol make it make sense?
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Ricks is very well-spoken and gave very thought-provoking lectures. While you do have to read a lot and pay attention to the due dates of every assignment, getting an A in this class is very achievable, as he allows rewrites for many assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Ricks was the best professor I ever had and was an inspiration for my academic career and life. I imagine the negative reviews on here are due to the well-known fact that professors with high expectations and rigorous courses struggle to be uniformly popular "crowd-pleasers". But if your goal is to learn and grow, Ricks is your man.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Inspirational

reviews.comment:
You can complete every assignment and still fail this course. One mistake causes the assignment to be marked as incomplete. You have limited opportunities to re submit assignments.

Attend every class and be VERY careful with deadlines. Missing one assignment can block you from ever getting an A in the course. And, you will have to read a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Vance, you make me so sad
I do believe this class is bad
His grading rubric fills me with woe
No matter how hard you try it will not show
Pass or fail causes me to ail

Unless you love philosophy,
stick to biology
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Vance is a tough grader who interprets things very critically and literally. Some might take this negatively, but his feedback is very useful, and an A is very achievable. He allows students to redo some assignments and is easily approachable. The class discussions and the course readings are very interesting and engaging.
Odd grader. He gives a lot of leniency to extensions and redos on assignments, and the lectures are sometimes interesting. But his grading system leaves more to be desired.

Let me preface: if you are looking for an easy A, do NOT take this class. If you are looking to think critically, challenge your ideas, and actually learn something, DO take this class. Vance is amazing, but you need to put the work in and be a person who enjoys philosophy to succeed. My only con is that grading system is very flawed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: ive had professor ricks for a few classes and the negative reviews are exaggerating. he really cares about his students and tries his best to make the class engaging. there's a lot of assignments but if you read the rubric it's pretty easy to pass them all and he's pretty flexible about extensions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Tbh he was not THAT bad, just a ton of readings and writing. His grading system is really bad, based on random pass/fails. You forget one guideline in an assignment, you fail and could possibly get a significantly lower grade. However you do get some redo opportunities. Busy busy work. He is a good guy, interesting, but avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Strange grading system; if you fail or get an incomplete on one assignment (despite attempting it), your grade will drop 1 or 2 letter grades. He offers pretty good feedback and you can easily get extensions for most assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the worst grading system i've ever encountered. everything is pass/fail, including the concluding assignment, and you will fail if you forget to include just one guideline. he gets 2 stars out of pity.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Avoid if possible. Cold calls on students asking question after question. Every class you must get with group of students and do an assignment based on lecture. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lectures are long and monotonous. His grading system is horrendous. Assignments are a held to a high standard pass/fail, and then made into your grade with a strange chart. You must strictly follow instructions, and even though its a philosophy class there is not much room for expression of your own ideas, especially if they clash with his.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He was good and interactive. Very possible to get a good grade.

Professor Ricks cares about his students and is passionate about philosophy. He explores a lot of interesting topics in the course and (at least in my class) fosters a positive class discussion each day. Everything is pass/fail and failing a large assignment could drop your grade a large amount, so make sure you put maximum effort in.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Imo, he wasn't as bad as the others were saying. It seemed like he was trying. At the beginning of class, he does announcements like open coop positions, upcoming speakers nearby, etc. There's lots of readings, though you could skim. He tries getting engagement and asks the class questions, but no one answers which is sad. Everything is pass/fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This teacher is completely incompetent and just yaps the entire class without teaching anything. He does not encourage participation well and is generally extremely boring and rude towards students comments. The assignments are unrelated to the lectures. He targets people who he doesn't like and the grading system is completely flawed.

His rubrics, syllabus, and canvas are all dysfunctional to determine grading. He gives a pass or fail and nothing in between, which is illogical. He fails for petty mistakes. Thus, even if you completed the assignment to the best of your ability you might fail the assignment and get a zero for a minor mistake. AVOID his class.

Let me preface this by saying that Professor Ricks is a kind person, and the class itself covers important topics. But, by god - his grading system is preposterous.

I had an A up until the final essay - which had lots of requirements (which I checked many many times I fulfilled). The assignment is pass or fail. If you 'fail' you drop 2 grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Ricks cultivated an excellent learning environment. Fostering engaged class discussion while maintaining a relaxed & open classroom is an impressive feat, and Vance did this excellently. There's a lot of reading, but few assignments which are kindly graded. Overall, if you like philosophy & don't mind reading, Vance is a wonderful prof.
Very knowledgable, but sometimes seems to talk down at students. Also has a weird grading system, so be warned.

Everyone claims that he's a tough grader, but I haven't had a single problem by just checking the requirements for the pieces, it's really not that hard. Readings are assigned twice weekly but only take about 30ish minutes to get through if you're efficient. Lectures are pretty interesting and engaging, don't be intimidated by the reviews.
Tough grader and tedious homework

Do NOT take this class. This professor is genuinely awful - his class is lecture heavy and he has low IQ when it comes to understanding what other students are saying in class. He fails pretty much everyone and his comments on why you failed aren't substantive. Avoid the pain of dealing with this guy, the class is honestly a huge waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: tough grader. follow the rubric. lots of reading. long boring lectures

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Vance fails almost every student in the class for minor mistakes on assignments. He takes forever to grade. reviews.comment: Class was interesting but not worth the work. Don't use this to fulfill NUPath credits if you need to. Takes away from actual classes

reviews.comment: So nice and easy to learn from! Amazing professor and credibly knowledgeable. I would recommend to anyone!
Great prof clear grading and very accessible

One of the best finance professors at NEU. Lectures are clear and well-organized. He cares his students. Weekly quizzes make up 80% of the grade, and the final is just three quizzes' worth of material. You can drop three lowest quizzes and homework score.

Best finance professor at Northeastern. Prof. Herron really cares about his students and goes the extra mile. Quick grade turnarounds, stays after class, held extra office hours. Also very knowledgeable about finance in general.

Prof. Herron is the GOAT. Very unique but effective teaching style. Assignments can be a bit tough but are some of the most interesting assignments I've done in college. Grading can be sometimes a bit unclear, but if you put in a decent amount of work you will be more than fine. Great person and teacher overall - would take again for any class.
Professor Herron is honestly one of the best professors ive had in Northeasters. He knows what hes talking about and makes complex concepts super easy to understand.

Professor Herron is truly amazing at teaching and as a person. He cared and tried to understand the mental health problems I was having(anxiety, depression and adhd led to skipping classes, etc.) He ccommodated me by allowing me to attend thru zoom and supporting me instead of replying dismissively or not believing me like my other professors.

He is a nice and carrying guy, but his grading of cases and test is rather harsh. Furthermore, his tests are really difficult at least for FINA4320. Most annoying thing is he assumes you know all the concepts in previous classes and the homework doesn't really help you learn.

Richard is truly passionate about Corporate Finance. All assignments are worth 15% except Final, which is 30%. He really cares about the subject and goes above and beyond to share real life examples which is really helpful. He is an easy grader (all my tests and projects are 95+). His tests are easy and as long as you study, you'll do well.
I only hear great things about Professor Mirek!!
The GOAT. He teaches well. Class is a little hard but I rock with homie.

Nicely designed course, scope to increase difficulty level. Professor is good in teaching and helpful. You have a scope to choose exciting class project.
One of the best Professors at Northeastern University.

He is great professor, his style of teaching involves solving problem in class and exploring almost every suggestionsolutions proposed by students for a particular problem.  He is very approachable.   Definitely worth taking his class.
Cool, solves your queries, extremely helpful, easily approachable
Great Professor. Very good at explaining stuff and in clearing doubts

Decent professor, however, I would not recommend taking this class online with Professor Steere. His instructions are highly ambiguous and can be interpreted in multiple ways. I rarely leave rate my prof reviews, but I need everyone to know not to take a class with this prof. Will take any excuse to take points off your grade. Never budges on anything, difficult to reach outside of class, and super stubborn.

Completely inaccessible by email so if you take class online good luck. In life you will encounter professors who are seemingly rude for the fun of it and that is this guy. Avoid at all costs. He has 0 teaching skills, expects everyone to be on class just to talk straight up nonsense for 1 hour. Exams are very hard and group project instructions are unclear. I guarantee you'll do better with any other professor.

I LOVE Professor Steere. Although he may seem like a tough professor, he really cares about each of his students. He is also a fun guy who just wants the best for you; although this means that he will push you and possibly stop you in the middle of a presentation - it is completely worth it.

I highly do not recommend Prof. Steere. He is by far the meanest professor Northeastern has ever had. His lectures are boring and have nothing to do with the exam. If you want a good grade do not take him.

reviews.comment: Professor Steere is an inspiring professor if you show up to class ready to engage and participate. Challenge yourself and you will be rewarded, young grasshoppers.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: If you don't show up, you wont pass. Difficult and unclear grading criteria, not very approachable and nitpicks on EVERYTHING. god forbid u say "um" in his class he will flame you in front of everyone. difficult grader, but you'll learn a lot about presentation and get more comfortable w it in his class. recommend the class, not the professor.

Had ORGB with professor Steere. His demeanor can be a bit offputting since he's a bit serious but the discussion and course material was actually very interesting to me. Don't miss classes or be late. He'll write you up for that asap

reviews.comment: Be on time, show respect for Prof. S and participate. He is a super hard grader, but if you put in the work you'll get the grade you deserve.

reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Steere's Leadership Seminar was an excellent senior course. Through case studies and in-class discussions, Prof. Steere shows the many different aspects of leadership. It always felt like Steere really cared about the entire class, and even met with us individually to discuss careers, resumes, etc.

worse professor at Northeastern, AVOID!! There are 3 hard exams and 1 big group project. Instructions for the project are not clear and if he doesn't like your project he might make you do it all over again at the end of the semester.

He is a pretty good professor, the toughest thing about the class is all the group presentations and the business plan but that's unavoidable. Class discussions are fun and interesting. Tests are pretty tough but they're the same for all sections. You do need to study everything and put time and effort into the project to get an A. It is doable.

In order to do well on tests, you need to read. He teaches very little besides presentation skills. Inspirational because he gives one liners that make you think about what you're doing. Just an e-mail away.

Expect 2-3 homework and reading assignments a week but he's a brilliant professor. Work is mangeable and really worthwhile. Whalen was an awesome Cornerstone 1 & 2 prof! It can be a lot of homework, but after this class I feel really prepared and confident to study engineering.

reviews.comment: Very intelligent, conscientious, caring guy. He wants to see you succeed in his course and is always available the same day, usually already in FYELIC. Professor Whalen is a great teacher, but is a harder teacher compared to the other cornerstone professors. You will have many group projects in and out of class that are pretty time intensive, so make sure to work ahead of time if possible. reviews.comment: Whalen is super knowledgeable and knows his stuff. Gives more HW than the rest of the 1501 teachers but it's nice because it's tools you need to learn anyway. Great guy and very accessible outside of class. (Also his projects are cooler than all the other classes)
One of the best professors at Northeastern

hes a nice guy, is extremely boring. he cares outside of class but is easily the hardest 1501 prof. 
the first half of this class is pretty easy, where u submit a weekly coding assignment.
the other is ALL group projects, done outside of class. good luck if you're busy!
make sure you read all the requirements for asgmnts. and study a little b4tests

It is an easy A because there is plenty of grades, and tests/quizzes are easy if you study a little. Make sure you know people in the class.

The lectures themselves feel pointless, and they kind of are because the concepts are complicated, and it's hard to teach them. He does an okay job lecturing, but they are boring. He's a nice guy, especially if you get on his good side, but I don't think he's as amazing as people say. His homework and class load is the hardest of all the 1501 profs

The professor is teaching things that are not really in his element, but he doesn't do a bad job of it, considering the content of this course is kind of nonsensical. You'll probably enjoy this class if you had experience, but might struggle if you are a complete beginner.

Professor Whalen is SO NICE and so helpful during office hours! The class is project-based and focuses on robotics/coding; you'll be fine if you get a good group. However, there are a lot of assignments and he covers the material very quickly, so it can feel overwhelming, rushed, and time-consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Whalen does not teach coding very well, so learning C++ for anyone who has never coded is very difficult. For people who have coded, the class is easy. Don't treat it like a joke and you'll be fine. It takes more time out of your day than you want, but none of it is particularly difficult and the group work is actually fun. Prof is nice
Really nice guy and super helpful during office hours. Be ready for lots of homework assignments and group projects.

Great guy and good teacher.  Very smart at what he does, but he also assumes everyone else has a background with computer science prior to the class, so there is a decent amount of learning and work to do if you don't know anything.

Whalen is a super nice guy. His cornerstone focuses a good bit on coding and robotics, so if it's not your think, he may not be the best. Even if you don't love it, it's not like you have to become a coder for this class, just follow along with what he does and it should be simple enough. Cornerstone is really group work heavy.

Professor Whalen is amazing! He posts all the lecture content online, and his canvas is extremely well organized. He is always available for help outside of class, and is an extremely fair grader. You can tell he cares about both what he's teaching and the students. He's very responsive to student feedback. Best Cornerstone Professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I would give Professor Whalen my firstborn child if he asked. he is simply the best, lots of material but teaches it well and gives assignments that really help you learn. his lectures are always sprinkled with jokes and are never boring. go to office hours! he is extremely helpful and just a fun person to talk to

Professor Whalen is pretty great. He definitely knows what he's talking about and is pretty good at explaining things. Make sure you go to FYELIC for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Whalen is easily the best Cornerstone 1 and 2 professor in the department. He is super knowledgeable about what he's teaching and is super respectful and patient when students don't initially understand something. Teaches in a way that makes completely new concepts very easy to understand and is pretty clear with grading.

As long as you make somewhat of an effort in this class, it is easy to get an A. Whalen has been my favorite professor this semester, and is very easy to understand. He gives plenty of grades and is a really easy grader. He has apparently been at Northeastern for most of his life and seems like he just wants to help people.

Super nice guy who's engaging and knowledgeable about the material. He's very helpful when you ask questions and understanding. Take advantage of the engineering center!!

He assigns a lot of work

Show up to class, pay attention, do your homework the day or two days before and you will get an A. It helps if you have taken coding in the past but it is still manageable.

Whalen is just amazing. Had him for both 1110 and 1111, and would take his class again if I was a MechE. Yes, there are a lot of assignments and they take a while but they're very straightforward, he is completely willing to help if you ask, and coming in with little/no knowledge of coding, it was honestly so helpful. He's the man. Probably the best professor in the engineering department.  If you don't have him, I actually feel bad for you
Easily the best professor you will ever have !!!
Great professor.  You should take this class with him without doubt.

The guy is a decent professor, but he simply can't comprehend how repetitive and useless his enormous assignments are. Whalen is one of the best professors to have as an incoming freshman.  He's incredibly nice, and makes a huge effort to know all of his students. He gives a lot of work, but it's all applicable and interesting.  His discussions are really helpful and make engineering really seem like an interesting field to join.
Probably the best teacher that I have had in college! His lesson plans are well thought out and thorough. All of the tests and homework were very fair. I truly looked forward to going to class!

Whalen is so amazing. He gives a hefty amount of work, and layers projects on top of each other, but in reality it's not much of a burden. He is incredibly sweet and approachable. After completing all the work, which can be a lot at times, I learned a lot and felt like my time was not wasted.
Awesome and very clear teacher. Has a good background and understanding of C++ as well as MATLAB though a MechE.
Whalen is a fantastic teacher for Engineering Design. Definitely go to class or you'll miss a lot, and the pumpkin drop is awesome!

Prof Whalen gives a lot of work but isn't that hard of a grader. He wants to see everyone do well and understand the key topics. He tends to focus towards mechanical engineering. His pumpkin drop is an awesome project.
Gives WAY too much work. Way more than other classes. You will be up all night in snell at least once a week because of him. Having said that, the class is a fairly easy A.

Amazing professor. Be good in class and he'll be great with you! He will help you when you want it and is fair in grading. I would take another class with him definitely. Nice guy, good grades in class.
Very cool professor. We had so much fun in class.
This guy is the reason why I lift my family and came to America.Iam serious ! he is very smart , easy going , the class and material are very intersting and helpful.Take with him with no doubt !

Great teacher.  I had him for Engineering Design, and signed up for him again for Engineering Computations. Show up to class, pay attention, and do the homework, and you will do fine on the finals/ projects.

Great professor.  I knew nothing about programming going in but came out with an A in the class.  Most lab assignments are easy enough to understand and quizzes are graded pretty leniently.  The lecture days can be a little slow but they're always balanced out with practice programming assignments to help you undersand the material.
learned a lot of programming skills. really nice guy and willing to help. quizzes are straight forward and he is an easy grader.
The best teacher I have ever had.. if you had the chance to take with him, DO IT!!

Most organized professor I've ever had. Don't stress about handouts and notes, it's all on blackboard! Assignments are not too hard but expect to get a couple at a time. Almost always available for office hours and email responses. Quizzes are straight forward.

My favorite professor so far! Class has one lab day, lectures, and then a quiz every week. He is very organized, puts everything up on blackboard in case you lose it, and sticks to the syllabus. His lectures are clear and  always give you what you need to know for the upcoming lab. I had never programmed before but I still did awesome in the class.

wow. papa w's is the man. great teachers, teaches u everything u need to know for a GOOD intro to engineering. heads up you WILL have 6 projects at one time or another in the semester, but deal with it. gotta love prof. whalen
best teacher ever, exciting class, really laid back, good amount of work but all interesting.

he is the best
awesome teacher, the best. my favorite prof here so far. one of the few classes that can hold my attention.

good guy
Everything is straightforward and grading is fair.  At time the class is flooded with work, but the work is interesting at least.
Not a hard class, but he explains everything thoroughly, so even if the material is rough, you'll understand it before time is up.
great professor

Very good teacher. He gives a good amount of work, but if you do everything he asks for you will be graded fairly. Tests and quizes are straight from his lessons and powerpoints (which he posts online) so if you go to class and do your work you will get an A.
the best

Clear, easy grader, nice guy.  The tests come pretty much straight off the powerpoints.
fun projects awesome teacher... ull b lucky to have him
one of the best professors
Best professor ever, you want him as a teacher
whalen is the man!!!

whalen's the man

This class is really easy. Youhave to do any reading because his tests are exactly what your inclass notes he gives you. He's a funny guy and i'd take his class if you want an easy A.

talks gibberish, doesn't understand the language he's supposed to be teaching.  changes the subject when you ask a question rather than admit he doesn't know.  not hot, i don't know what you idiots are talking about.

really good teacher. Very fun and approachable.

Good.  Makes the subject interesting and explains it very well.  Tests are medium difficulty. Does require 5 page paper.  Very knowledgeable on Unix, many years experiance.
Very good teacher. Hope I get him again.Not the easiest of subjects but he makes it understandable.

he was a good enough professor and gave so much leeway to get an a that you would have to try to get under a 100 in this class. however, the schedule he released homeworks on made it so that there was only 3 weeks to do the entire final project, which stressed me out big time. he also pushes generative ai a LOT so be mindful of that
Rush was great and cared about his students and our success.

Rush is amazing, the class is super easy, there are no tests, just skills which are like quizzes you take outside of class, but you can retake them if you do bad and it's not letter based its just if you meet expectations or not. Homework isn't bad Aswell!

Was anxious going into this class with no experience, but Prof Sangs does a wonderful job at breaking things down and answering all questions. He has a very positive attitude during lectures making it a very fun and enjoyable class. Grading is straight forward and fair, just go to class and pay attention.

Rush is AMAZING! Despite CS2000 being a hot mess in terms of organization, grading, expectations, and communication, the actual content of his lectures are some of the best around. Super knowledgeable yet down-to-earth. Feels like just another student. 

Go to office hours! He's a super interesting dude and will remember you on campus.
Rush is a good professor but with such a big class he goes very fast and isn't too helpful. He wants the best for you but isn't the best at teaching to beginners.

take a later section of the class. he's really kind but i had a friend in the second section of the class and she says he was never organized to give the lecture, often making mistakes; meanwhile i had the last section and it was extremely smooth sailing. the class is super online heavy so don't be scared to be on the discord all the time

Rush does a great job at helping you work through problems without giving away answers, which I believe is very effective for learning cs. Class itself was not difficult and he always gave readings to do before class that would help. The labs were fun and helpful, and end of class seemed rushed but overall it was organized and not stressful.
