reviews.comment: u learn so much with the sacrifice of ur health, dignity, social life. ive pulled like 8 all nighters for this class in like 2 weeks and skipped the gym and have been getting fat. she makes learning unenjoyable.

Yes this class is very very hard.
Yes it is harder than other sections.
BUT...
KSG is amazing. She teaches very well and is always available for external help if needed.
KSG is not the problem, YOU are, do not take this class if you arent ready for it.
Out of all stacked cornerstones, this one has the most meaning and the final project is rewarding

KSG IS NOT DESERVING OF THIS HATE!

Take this class to:
feel what its like to hve a killer work ethic
do the professional engring design process
know what it means to b a REAL engineer

KSG preaches sustainability--that's what all of our assignments, lectures and service learning are about. And then she goes as requires us to print some 300 page reports just for it to be a rough draft. Make it make sense. This class does not make sense.

DON'T BE FOOLED BY THE GOOD RATINGS. Genuinely you will regret taking this class. You will see other professors give out assignments that take a third of the time she does and give much better grades. Your GPA will suffer. The time I spent for all my classes last semester per week is less than the amount of time I spend in this class alone

The class is tough, and it certainly has its ups and downs, but after this course, you'll be ready to take on engineering, and it prepares you well. It was typical to spend 10+ hours a week on work, but she and the TAs were helpful and understanding. Group projects can be rough, but build camaraderie, and your group becomes like a family.

Be prepared to lose parts of yourself to complete this class. There is no reason for the assignments to be so difficult or time consuming. Course content is far more than 8 credits. Take any professor but her.

This professor is unorganized, unhelpful, and unclear in lectures. They don't explain concepts well and dismiss student questions. Grading feels arbitrary, and feedback is nonexistent. If you need help, don't expect much. Avoid if possible—your learning experience will suffer.

Way too much work compared to other the other classes. This is the only teacher where you have to write memos each week that are about 20 pages. There extra exams and extra assignments that other classes dont have to do. Also she cant teach at all and her assignments are outdated and confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: KSG is passionate, but not great teacher. lectures feel useless when you get to homework assignments. Assignments are tedious. Group work is a HUGE part of the course, unless you have a good group, you're screwed. Homework instructions (or lack thereof) tend to be contradicting. Taking stacked is doable but very time consuming.
Terribly mean, expects way too much out of students insane amount of work per week.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: All the positive rating are self glaze. Dont be fooled. 😭😭😭

These glowing reviews feel suspicious—no college student is out here saying, "She really sets you up for success as an engineer." Let's be real, KSG probably wrote them herself. Trust me, take the warning: avoid this class if you value your time and sanity.

Have fun learning C+, Solidworks, AutoCAD, Sparkfun, woodwork, and 3D printing all on your own! No point of even going to class nothing of value is taught. Assignments are busy work and provide little to no value to your education.

This whole class is unreasonable, unclear, and outdated. TAs specifically are unprofessional and unhelpful, especially Dante. Dante is one of the rudest and egotistical TAs. He doesn't grade assignments until a month later and provides no helpful support for group projects. KSG as well, unprofessional communication.

I didn't know I was signing up for a community service course. If you enjoy spending your little to no free time aside from assignments making a museum exhibit for the children's museum, teaching stem at elementary schools 40 minutes away from northeastern, and writing ethics papers, then this is the class for you! If not, avoid KSG at all cost.

I'm in a conference room with 4 of my friends and we have As in the class. We all felt compelled to say as engineering majors that this is the worst class we have taken at Northeastern. Two of us were valedictorians. 

Outdated assignments, unnecessary harsh grading from TAs on said assignments, and incompetent team members on group projects.

This class is basically self-taught. Professors and TAs just read off slides and offer little help. Assignments are unclear, grading is harsh, and you lose points for minor things like naming your file wrong. On top of that, you're forced to buy a $150 Top Hat subscription just to access the course materials. Avoid if possible.

I'm not done with the class but so many of my friends and I think this is the worst professor we've had in college so far. We have busy work with writing useless memos and get graded down for arbitrary reasons. The assignments are useless and don't help at all. 

The assignments are old and have terrible directions. Don't take her!

This is more of a writing class than a engineering class. I would say that I spent more time writing in this class than I did in first year writing. Every assignment and milestone of the group project essentially requires you to write an essay on what you did. Pure busy work.

Cornerstone Stack is a heavy workload, no doubt. Unless you don't value your social life, avoid taking it with KSG. You'll spend 10+ hours a day with your group, and you don't get to pick your teammates—if they don't pull their weight, you're stuck. Choose another professor if you want any chance at balance.

Don't take this class, the assignments are old and one of them wasn't even bothered to be updated and said Fall 2018. 

They reuse old assignments with terrible instructions and the TAs are like just hard graders for 0 reason on assignments that are just unclear and terrible. 

My friends in Bala and Hertz don't have half the workload I have.

I have taken over 15 college classes in high school and 14 APs. When I say this class is useless in building actual skill sets across programming and general engineering, it is an understatement. 

The assignments are outdated by MULTIPLE years and have the worst, most dogshit instructions I've ever seen that tanks your grade. 

Save yourself ong.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Unprofessional teaching. Assignmets have instructions that are 10 pages long. Assignments are very unclear and hard to follow. Office hours are not helpful. A lot of busy work such as service learning, memo writing for each assignment, and peer reviews for group projects. Horrible time consuming class. Do not take stacked with KSG.

KSG is a very nice and enthusiastic professor but not a good fit for Cornerstones. Her area of expertise is clearly outside general engineering, so she sometimes makes small mistakes in her teaching, and in general it's not easy to learn from her directly. The work is tedious and you must follow instructions exactly even without understanding them.
This was the best class I have ever taken! KSG is a wonderful professor and is very considerate of her students. Stacked is so much work but entirely worth it. Take the class if you want to learn!

An amazing professor who willing to help you no matter what. Class is a lot of work, but if you time yourself right it won't be as bad as you think. TA also make the difference, but the class will genuinely teach you a lot.
Great professor!! If you put in the work, you'll get great results.

KSG was an amazing cornerstone teacher, and while the homework can be tough, especially if it is your first time coding like me, it is well worth the effort and her class was one of the few courses where I genuinely felt like I walked away knowing more. She is very enthusiastic about the world of engineering and you will be inspired to continue!
KSG is the best..TJ is also the greatest TA you'll ever have

KSG was one of the best professors I have had here at Northeastern. She is super caring and accessible, proving she really cares about what she does. The class does have a lot of work but it does help you access as an engineer. The final project was long and tough but we all really enjoyed it and it proved to us what we are really capable of
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Stacked Cornerstone was a beast but KSG was a great professor. Be prepared to put in A LOT of work, especially on the final project. KSG is super accessible outside of class for help on homework and other things. Only thing is that I wish that assignments were graded faster so we could fix mistakes before we turned the next ones in.

KSG is AMAZING. If you take stacked cornerstone, it will be a lot of work. There is a lot of content in the class so be ready to put in the work. But, KSG is there with you every step of the way and genuinely cares about your success. She is kind, caring, very intelligent, and makes the class extremely enjoyable. I could not recommend her more.

I LOVED KSG! She seems tough at first, and stacked cornerstone can be overwhelming, but trust me KSG is the push you need as an engineer. She is really good for setting you up for success as an engineer. I love her and the way she teaches first-year engineering; just try in the class and I promise your efforts will be worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Stacked cornerstone is SO much work but so rewarding. She expects a lot out of you and you have to be willing to put in an INSANE amount of work but she is also an amazing professor and the best ever

KSG is a great professor and person but this class assigns so much work under the guise of two 4-credit classes. It is incredibly good for resume-building however and I would recommend taking Stacked Cornerstone if you can manage your time well.

GOAT. KSG was a very enthusiastic teacher for this course. I love listening to her put little anecdotes into her lectures relating to the course material. You could really tell how much the topic meant to her and it made the class more enjoyable and engaging. I was intellectually challenged but am now inspired to find a job in the energy field.

She was a very nice and caring professor. The books and materials were definitely very interesting. However, instructions on homework and project could have been more clearly explained. Homework assignments were not graded in time as well, which makes preparing for exams harder.

KSG is one of the best professors I will ever have. There are two group projects over the semester along with four individual assignments a week so get ready to do a lot of work. However, she is a great person that always offers extra help - you just have to ask. I would definitely take this class again, she truly was amazing!

Okay, I don't hate her at all. I think she's a genuinely nice person and she cares about her students and clearly wants us all to succeed. Compared to the other stacked professor, KSG is 10 times harder and you will hate your life and her for the whole semester. But for me I would still take her again bc I learned SO much. (but it was SO hard)
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: KSG was easily my favorite professor this semester. The homework she gives can be a LOT, but if you put your mind to it then it all works out. Shes also pretty lenient on grading, and the group projects are great resume builders. Cant recommend this course enough.!

KSG was a great teacher who facilitates a warm and welcoming learning environment. She was endlessly respectful, inclusive and knowledgeable about her teachings. Her course was fun, comprehensive, and well organized. I really loved that she brought in a ton of guest speakers to enhance what we were learning.

KSG is the best teacher I've had. Her class is difficult, with a lot of hw, but it definitely helps you learn. She teaches more in depth (and at a faster pace) than other engineering professors and always shows respect and care for her students. Lots of individual work and even more group work, including the final project. Highly recommend her!

KSG is a solid professor. A little strict and makes you work for it, but is very clear and concise during lectures. Respects all the students and her class is actually quite enjoyable (if you like engineering).

KSG is an amazing professor. She is very engaging and all of her teaching is practical, as she wants her students to learn hands-on. Lots of difficult HW, but it is all helpful and relevant, and she offers lots of resources and office hours. Also lots of groupwork, for which she offers anonymous feedback and accountability. Great first year course.

KSG is able to teach in such a way that motivated students to do really well. Even though she has very strict rubrics, they lay down the foundation of being a good engineer. One of the best teachers I have ever had, but my opinion may be biased because the content of the course is also something I enjoyed more than anything I've ever taken before.

I took stacked cornerstone with her. KSG is very tough and expects a lot, but she is helpful and my favorite teacher by far. As a female, having her made me feel empowered. 100% would take any engineering class with her again. She is brilliant and you will learn more than any other cornerstone professor could teach, from feedback I have heard.

KSG is really tough in terms of the amount of work you need to do, but her grading is actually really lenient. Follow the rubrics as they tell you to and you'll get a great grade. I took stacked cornerstone and I remember a lot of what we had to learn. Her office is almost always open, so go to office hours if you have a problem!

KSG is an incredible teacher who knows how to teach this course (stacked cornerstone) effectively. Be prepared to WORK, however. This class will consume your time and procrastinating will not work. Some of the assignments will seem pointless, but they will make you a good worker. The rubrics are all very clear, follow them you will get a 100!

KSG is a phenomenal professor. You can tell she loves teaching the class and is ready to help kids succeed. She gives you just enough help to get you on the right track but leaves out just enough to still make you develop the solution yourself. I loved her approach to teaching and think any student who tries in her class will enjoy it.

KSG is an incredible teacher. While she is strict in a lot of ways, you find yourself really wanting to make sure that you are giving her the work you are best capable of giving. She is an extraordinary communicator, she has plenty of jokes and information in spades, and she is amiable like no one else. Just show her respect she gives it back.

One of the most intelligent professors I have ever had. She assigns an unbelievable amount of work, but if you follow through it is worth it in the end. Never thought I could learn so much about CAD, Solidworks, C++, Arduino, etc. in such a short amount of time. Take this course for a challenge, and if you are driven.

reviews.comment: This was part of the cornerstone class. Don't take this if your're not ready to put in hours of work. You will learn a LOT about coding and CAD in a short time and will be expected to do some extremely hard projects. She expects a lot from you but in the end it will all be worth it. Her expectations are clear and is always there to help.
Gem of a human being, I learned so much in her class.

Overly strict, very moody, comes off as mean. She loves reminding you that she is in charge and is superior to you. Do your best to avoid.  This direct quote sums her up pretty well: "If you do everything perfect in my class you will get a B. You need to go above and beyond to earn an A."
Very good professor, lectures are engaging. Just that there is a lot of work, group work to be specific...
Almost the entire class is group projects. A lot of work. Huge long term projects.

Do not take this professor. She thinks that by being strict the quality of her teaching is superior, but it's not. You will be putting in hours and hours to get a lower grade than peers who have another professor, and you'll get out with the same amount of knowledge. Very unlikable, very moody, with unrealistic expectations.

Professor Schulte is a good professor but she's very strict and a harsh grader. Her grading difficulty likes to change over time, however. She was harsh with some grades but lenient with others. Try really hard and she'll respect you.

This teacher is the hardest grader I have ever had in my life. She is very moody. Directions are very unclear at times. She never lets you forget that she is your superior. Very controlling and unpleasant. I do not recommend enrolling in any of her classes.

She could be helpful, if you ask for her help. I wouldn't recommend her for anyone seeking a good grade. Very harsh grader and expects too much from her students. her grading sometimes could be unfair, it really depends on her mood.

She is a very nice person. Expects a lot from students and can be a harsh grader. Just make sure you follow all of the requirements and go ask her if you don't know what she wants. Her directions can be a bit unclear. Overall she is just trying to prepare you for the "real world."

she can be very helpful if you ask, but is a very tough grader sometimes. You have to work really hard to get an A. But i do recommend her, you end up more prepared than if you take it with other teachers.

I already knew the concepts in retrospect due to economic video games. However there is so much vocabulary to remember and apply. So get ready to read. Homeworks are mad long, some times even 40 multiple choice questions and would take 3 hours if only off reading the online textbook. The Simulations are long but they are fun. Trytospeakonceperclass

reviews.comment: He is a great professor and also the clas is structured well, It's hard to do bad as long as you are involved. Grades are curved too! You can expect to learn a lot and enjoy the class. He is super passionate and informative.

Professor Schulman is very passionate about his job. The work is VERY heavy with material and our quiz averages were in the 60s before the curve. His grading dynamic made it impossible to not do well which I quite enjoyed; it's very forgiving. Like another reviewer said, it's very hard to score get an A, but hard to get below a B.

He is a good person, he is also very knowledgable in supply chain. There were several guest speakers who attended and talked about what they do in supply chain. However, his lectures have heavily detailed material. My class did poorly on all quizzes and tests, but he does curve. This class is hard to fail but even more difficult to get an A.

Really liked this class. Theres a lot of material to learn and attendance is important. However, you really do learn a lot. The professor also really cares about students. If you put in effort and he sees that you will see results. Lectures can at times be kind of boring and long. Overall, pretty good class though.

Loved taking Bio Project Lab with Professor Schlichting. He was helpful and accessible for the group projects and made sure he was checking in with each of the groups and keeping us on track with time. Nice grader and gave good feedback on assignments.

reviews.comment: This man is lit would take any class with him again. Made being in class from 7-9:50pm actually fun
Had him for 2301 during summer 1. Really great professor with 3 midterms and 1 final (one gets dropped). Would definitely take again!

Highly recommend taking a class with Dr. S. He is a great professor and is always willing to help. He makes it clear what is expected of you and offers guidance whenever you need it. I learned a lot in this class.

reviews.comment: Honestly, he's a good professor for this course (2301, not 2309) and he gives a fair workload. The homework assignments take about 10 minutes each and there are 1-2 per week. The lectures can get boring, but it is possible to self-study and still find success in the course. Take him, he's so much better of a choice compared to Henzy.

reviews.comment: Took his class Summer 1 w/exams online on Lockdown Browser. He posted all slides the day of lecture and truly wasn't a difficult class as long as you studied for ~1 week before the exam. 3 exams worth 50% with the lowest one dropped and 1 final worth 35%, the rest was HW based off completion. Did not need textbook bc slides summed up material.

reviews.comment: Absolutely phenomenal professor, he works extremely hard to make sure students understand exactly what he's looking for in every project completed. Grades fairly and is very passionate in his field. He is always happy to converse and learn more about students' personal lives and works hard to make the classroom an enjoyable space. Great professor!

Great prof! Cares about his students and is willing to help and answer all of the millions of questions first-time bio lab students have. Tries really hard to balance work out for students so that it is not all piling up at the end of the semester. Also super friendly and approachable; he's great to chat with and has an interesting background!
bro fell from grace

Worst professor of my entire life. He blames everything on chatGPT instead of taking accountability for his own mistakes. More than half of the class failed and he blamed it on AI.The highest score on the exam was an 83, and he still blamed it on AI

reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Schedlbauer is an excellent lecturer and I learned a lot from the class. However, his tests tend to include specifics that we did not necessarily discuss during class. He is very open to helping students as long as you talk to him. He assigns a lot of reading, and assignments throughout the week, but they are doable and most are not too difficult.
Seems like a great guy and really knows his stuff. Not like he really needed to know much to teach CS1100, but still. VERY clear in his lectures. ALSO HE'S SO GERMAN I LOVE IT.
It's clear that what he explains in class and homework is not so hard.

Great professor!! Knows a lot and is very good at articulating hard/complex topics to people with any background knowledge on the subject. Very personable and is by far one of the BEST professors at NU and the comp sci school!

The video lectures & Powerpoint slides can guide you very well through the lessons so that you don't need to go to class much. However, you can always go to class if you're feeling lost or confused about an assignment. His tone can be a little harsh when dealing w/ students. He knows a lot of information. Same class info w/ all professors of CS1100

If you have to take CS1100 for CJ or business or whatever, TAKE IT WITH HIM. He's the head of Information Sciences at Northeastern so very knowledgeable and helpful. The classes are the best time to do the homework because you have him and the TA to help you and then you don't have any outside work.
You don't have to wait long at all to hear back from the prof. He will help you by all means possible whenever you have questions.
Easy class, amazing teacher. Attendance is not really mandatory.

The professor gave good reading materials in every week and also videos were there to illustrate the reading material. The syllabus was comprehensive, covering R language, xml, HTML, web scraping, SQL, NoSQL DBMS. The professor is helpful and he wants his students to learn things and implement the same in the term project.

The first half of the syllabus is very easy.  Once you get into JavaScript, it becomes extremely difficult.  If you have no previous coding experience, you will find the second half of the class to be a challenge.  Quizzestests are difficult despite being allowed to use the internet, which is how I know the class material was too hard.

Great class, super interesting stuff. His lectures were regurgitations of his powerpoints, so I didn't go to class often. But the actual powerpoints were super detailed and helpful. Class was more for working on assignments and he did offer up help.
best teacher ever, lectures were super clear, easy to understand! (compared to other prof teaching the same class) would definitely recommend him!

He definitely knows how to build websites but doesnt communicate well with students. You can learn from the lectures but the assignments are almost guess and check until you get the right code. However, he does provide powerpoints for every topic which are extremely helpful.
Great teacher! Very clear and helpful! Has a good sense of humour too! Not amongst the easiest but his tough grading style will help you learn more. Would definitely recommend him!

This class is a practical way of getting in your science requirement. Solid use of your tuition dollars. The teacher is clear and concise, and the topics are useful and relevant to the digital era. If you follow directions, this is an easy A. You really have to try to do poorly in this class.

Excellent professor who is knowledgeable,helpful and challenges you to get you to be a better thinker.  Try the problems first and come prepared with questions or post questions online.  I highly recommend taking his class.
AMAZING professor!!! if you want to take a class he teaches work your schedule around to take his section! take his classes if you get the chance, you will NOT regret it!
Great, smart, enthusiastic teacher.
Great professor with solid knowledge on the subject.
He's a super great professor. He explains everything clearly and always tries his best to help students. His course is useful.
Great teacher! Tough but fair. Makes his expectations clear and attainable. Makes you want to work hard to do well. Learned a lot from him and his class. Take a class with him if you have a chance.

AMAZING teacher. I learned so much and I actually liked what I learned as well. He gives a lot of work and has a quiz every class but it's not bad at all if you keep up and go to class. He's one of the best professors I've had so far. Take his classes if you can!

Professor Schedlbauer worked as a systems analyst for many years, so he knows what he's talking about. He's very knowledgeable, and he wrote the book that is used in class. Easily one of the best professors in IS. He gives out a lot of homework and a substantial term project, but it's not too hard as long as you apply yourself.
Great Professor! Taught a lot. His assignments are time consuming, but most of them were useful. Wish he provided more comments on homework to help improve.

Prof S is the man! He is so so clear about what needs to be done and how to do it. He is really helpful and makes it very easy for even the most computer illiterate to get an A in this introductory CS course. I highly recommend the class, especially with Prof. S!

I want to put heavy emphasis on Prof. Schedlbauer's enthusiasm. He has enough energy to shake the laziest student. Among his strengths are, also, communications and clarity of teaching. I wish, though, he had fewer optional classes and utilized them to learn more concepts about Excel and Access.

He is an outstanding teacher. If you want to learn a lot of knowledge, he is one of the best in the field. His tests are online, so you have the ability to make a good study guide. His homeworks are a lot of work, but doable. If you want to learn and be challenged, then take this and aim for an A. If you want an EASY A, do not.
He expects a lot and grading can be tough but I definitely don't regret taking the class, and I wish I could have taken more classes with him. Much better than a lot of other professors in CCIS.
Great professor!

Awesome teacher. He goes over the basic things that you need to know for each homework in class without having to do the homework for you. He also tells you to find out how to do problems without the help but that's fine because in the real world, you have to figure everything out by yourself. Not required to attend 2nd class of week if hw is done.
Best professor there is. Wish all of them were like him
Great Professor! Extremely friendly . Always humorous. Really helpful during tests and quizes. I strongly recommend.

Great Professor! Very clear and helpful during class. Doesn't require too much work outside of class. Easily approachable and accessable outside of class. He makes the material interesting and loves what he does!
Nice guy, clearly knows his stuff, easy class if you show up and try and the excel and access labs are definitly practical.

One of the best professors at NU. Always, always willing to help and very clear. Friendly and funny, I would recommend Prof. Schedlbauer without a doubt. I've heard many students complain about their CS professor, but I highly doubt there would be any complaints about him. Easily accessible by email outside of class and fair grader. take his class!

Apart from the only useful IS class, Martin is an extremely amazing teacher. He is the rare kind where he can do and teach. He brings his real life experiences to the table and engages the class constantly.

Schedlbauer is an amazing professor and as long as you pay attention and do the problem sets, you will be all set. Word of advice: unlike most other classes, you CANNOT put off the term project until the last week. Stay on track. Anyways, he's great, glad to finally have a competent CS/IS professor. Also very friendly and funny.
Excellent professor.  Probably the best I have ever had.
No Comments

Clearly a very smart guy and knows his stuff when it comes to C++. His section for me was essentially a free A since it was all homework grades + attendance, no exams. He is incredibly intelligent and if you actually listen to his lectures as an early cs student you will learn a lot. Room was depressing since most ppl wouldnt pay attention to him

The least I've ever seen Piazza used in a CS class. C++ is essentially a less intense fundies 2 but in c++ not java. If you've taken OOD it will be easy. There's an autograder which is insanely useful, you know what you're getting on 90% of the assignments before you even submit. Attendance is a pain but not bad. No reason to not get an A.

I wish more professors taught the way he did. He knows exactly how to teach coding in a language that you may not be familiar with it. Assignments are not hard and he is very helpful with answering questions. Best professor.

I think the issue with this class is that it may be too easy for the first half and then explodes after the introduction of classes. Maybe the introduction of Programming in C++ 1 and 2 (splitting the class to two semesters) would be more beneficial for learning. Other than that lectures are a bit dry and attendance is even drier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Taking his class was the best choice I've ever made this year. He's been nice all the time!
Professor Cooper made C++ very enjoyable for me. The course wasn't too difficult and all the assignments were reasonable.

Seth was a great professor. Used replit to go over code in lecture so it was very collaborative. Homework was given once a week and the majority of them were easy to do in about an hour. The material was very easy to understand. Use the quizzes to ask any conceptual questions since he'll answer them in class.

Class mainly consisted of reading the textbook, taking a quiz about that material, then going over the same exact stuff in class. Iit would be more helpful to go over the content in class before the quiz instead of having to essentially learn everything outside of class.  Lectures were a bit dry, since everything was in the reading.
The lecture is bit boring, but the projects and labs were very fun. Seth is a very nice professor. This is a Easy A class.
This game engine course is the best course ever in NEU Khoury. Everyone can get a A if you do put some effort on learning C++ and enjoying game development.
Really fun course. learned a lot from him. Nice Professor!
While Seth was a knowledgeable and kind professor (gave extensions if necessary), lectures were honestly kind of boring and a lot of students would not be focused during class time.
Not at all understanding of special circumstances, his course was easy but I felt like all the grading was based on little mistakes that would trip you up and ruin you.

Maybe a nice guy, but is clearly qualified and accomplished. Makes it more frustrating, however, since he clearly does not seem to give much of a care to making a functional course. Frequent issues with his assignments, poor course content for asynchronous students, important info (often to resolve HW issues) disseminated late and/or poorly. 3/10.

Easy, but the most disorganized, boring, and dysfunctional course I've ever taken. Half the assignments had some sort of infuriating compatibility or testing issue. Course was basically not compatible on MacOS if you updated, so had to switch to windows. Trying to debug his ramshackled assignments could cause 100% CPU usage. Absolute waste of time.

Lectures are a tiny bit slow and flat, but he's always willing to answer questions and is generally nice and helpful. If you find it within yourself to pay full attention, then you'll have an easy time in this class.

Gives surprisingly high grades on homework. Not restricted on errors. Even though C++ is not easy to learn, his course is kinda easy to pass and doesn't require a decent background knowledge. The only thing you need is a little interest. Attendance is not required but recommended.
Very easy workload and super friendly. All you have to do is show up and sometimes write 500 words for the week. He is very easy to communicate with and is super into what he is teaching.

He was one of the best people at NU. His class was easy, but also really fun. He cares about his students and gives good feedback. Classes are small, so you make friends and get close to them and him! Highly recommend taking him

Great introductory class, interesting topics, fun writing exercises.
There are only three writing assignments for the year but they're quick and fun to write.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Stockman is one of the most caring and easy going professors I've ever met. Really the only thing to do in this class is to show up and get the few assignments you are given on time. He is very flexible with deadlines, allowing for extensions if you need. If you need to take this course, take it with him!

He is awful. He never explains how you are going to be graded and cuts off a huge portion of your grade when you miss one or two classes. He never answers his e-mails, and all he does in the class is talk about something that treats you like you have just started learning English.

Professor Stockman is very caring and laid back. Grading is based on participation and the few writing assignments that we had to do. There were also discussions due over the weekend, doesn't take too long. Very interesting class and discussions, would 100% recommend. DONT take this class if you aren't going to show up!!!!

Mr.Stockman is genuinely such a caring professor, he is very laid back and super funny. You will get an A if you show up to class and talk. There is 3 writing assignments the whole semester and they are all quick to knockout in an hour or two. I would highly recommend taking his class.

Prof Stockman is amazing! Very fun in class, seems to keep up with the times. Loves to talk to everyone, one of the best ENGW1111 teachers. Make sure you go to as many classes as you can, attendance is important.
Could not have asked for a better professor. Most easygoing and understanding guy ever. All you have to do is submit your work and participate and it's an automatic A

Professor Stockman is the best professor at this university. Every class is amazing. You cannot take a better professor than him for first year-writing!!! The class is easy but extremely interesting (he managed to make first-year writing fun). Please take him you won't regret it.
Only Facts- his classes are small, full of discussions, regular and simple assignments, individual-based, and engaging. He is a hidden gem, take him if you want an easy A with a lot of fun!

As long as you show up to class and show an interest in the material you will pass. He is a great professor, and really works to engage the students. He gives thoughtful assignments and will not waste your time. I really liked him, and would definitely take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best professor! He is really engaged in class and he cares a lot about the students. Gives great feedback and is not a hard grader. just make sure you actually show up to class
Hes literally the best. Class was easy and always fun. As long as you do the work, you will do well in the class. You MUST take a class with him. One of my all time favorites.

Professor Stockman was awesome. The class was so fun and enjoyable because of his personality. He's also very understanding. Participation and attendance matters. He doesn't give you a grade until the semester is over so that may be a problem for some as you can't really know how well you're doing. I don't see why I wouldn't get an A though.

He is super funny and inspirational. There are only like three or four essays throughout the semester and he cares a lot about participation. Also there is a blog you have to write every week, which is pretty easy.

Stockman is literally the best professor I have had at Northeastern. He wants you to focus on actually learning rather than grades! His class is an easy A! Just come to class, it is discussion based so be ready to participate, and do everything the syllabus says. It may be a service learning course so be ready to spend about 2 hours a week on it.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great Professor, provides feedback and always encourages you to experiment with challenging topics.  Amazing industry experiences through her classes - a great mentor!

Professor Hema Seshadri has a supportive and clear teaching style that made complex topics easy to understand. She explains advanced ideas in a practical way and gives thoughtful feedback that helped our team improve, think clearly, and confidently present our work.
Excellent Course with excellent professor. Learn a lot and give you good grade.
Challenged me a lot

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: chill professor but the exams were challenging and feedback was limited.

Prof Aldatmaz is one of the best finance professors I've ever had. His lectures are clear, engaging, and make complex financial concepts much easier to understand. The class is definitely challenging, and the exams are tough, but his grading is very fair. Thanks to the curve, I ended up with a better grade than expected.

Worst professor I've ever taken in my life. So hard to understand and skips around questions. Gives no insights on what to expect for exams & some questions aren't anything near what we learned in class. If you ask him a question he is super unclear on purpose. Only lets you review exams for one class period. He has to scale because everyone fails.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really liked the professor, he was great at explaining the concepts and kept it simple and easy to understand. I would take this professor for sure again if he teaches another class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Aldatmaz was the best Finance professor I have had so far. I wish that I had gone to class more, provides real value, breaks down the concepts so well. He curves really well too, he curves it in a way that the median grade in the class is a b+. Homeworks every week but really doable. highly reccomend taking him for financial management

He is one of the best in Northeastern. I wanna take more classes from him but couldn't find any. If you attend his classes you will have no problem in the exam. He basically ask the same questions in the exam that he solved in the class.

This is my professor at Northeastern. Honestly, the material isn't that difficult, the average is 60 percent  because people don't attend class and then blame the professor. He goes over a lot of practice problems in class, and they're often harder than the questions on the actual exams. If you understand those, you'll have no trouble on the test.

LOVE this professor. Hes so helpful and caring. He genuinely cares about his students and is great at explaining the concepts.  The exams are very fair and he does teach everything on the exam, anyone that says they are hard clearly doesnt go to class. One thing I will say is that if you miss class you will fall behind.

Grades harshly even though he says he doesn't, comes off passive aggressive at times (even when answering students' questions), doesn't allow multiple chances or corrections on HW (even tho the q's are completely different than what he has on his slides), and got mad when the class had a 60% average on BOTH midterms (obvi his fault not ours).
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Although his exams are tough he is doing curve. He express material perfectly, giving real life examples all the time. If you're planning to work on finance area you need to take a class from him!

He is very kind and does a good job of explaining the material. He is happy to go over homework/practice problems. His tests are incredibly difficult (although he will tell you they are very easy). Very heavy on difficult multiple choice questions.
Run!! this is the worst professor I have taken at Northeastern. He doesn't curve, his class is very test heavy, and anything he covers in class in never on the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very nice guy, genuinely cares about his students, but does not really know how to teach. Half his class would fail the exams and he was shocked about it. Grade is basically only midterms and final and the exams are not easy.

Grade is 85% tests, 2 midterms and a final - however he curves the mean to a B+ (which makes sense cause the means are roughly failing grades). Doesn't take attendance but it's hard to catch up if you miss class (especially the class before a test because he gives out a lot of info on what they entail). Very nice tho so def recommend

Really enjoyable semester with Professor Aldatmaz. Participation is key to success, as he covers many important practice problems in class. Grading is very fair through the curved exams. It is clear he cares about his students and makes an effort to prepare them for future courses.

He a good teacher but doesn't give a study guide to help u prepare for the test. The concepts in this class are challenging and he does a great job explaining them with practice problems. His classes are def boring and very lecture-heavy so it's really tempting to skip, but don't because you won't learn anything and will be screwed for the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Serdar is a great professor, he explains things very clearly and makes sure that everyone understands the content. This class is pretty conceptually challenging so it is up to you to make an effort to participate and learn, but he explains Finance better than any other professor I have had.

Class can be boring at times because it's pretty much all lectures, but he's a great professor.  He does a great job explaining the material.  I learned a lot.  Grade is split up into two case studies, two problem sets, midterm, final, and participation.  Midterm is 20% of the grade and final is 35%.  Case study and problem sets are group work.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best class ever. Truly. No notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Mark is a passionate engineer, and is very practical in his teaching of students. There is a fair amount of homework, and a lot of coding material covered that should be taught in a different class. His tests are not particularly difficult, but time is a huge factor. Group project is to create a functioning game - fun, but a lot of work.
Nice guy, honest, not much work. Class would be great but lectures are very boring and frequent.

He's a nice guy, but pretty busy as he's also a CAMD professor and runs the 3D printer lab. Likes to do a game based group project every year as opposed to spaghetti bridges or whatever, fun idea but be sure to leave yourself some time as you're actually expected to build a game that works. Likes to bounce to different topics (CAD, C++) each week.

The TA ended up doing all the grading and would arbitrarily take off points for things not listed on the rubric. I'm a 4.0 student and I genuinely thought I was going to get a B in this class. Brandon would also randomly not show up to  class and not inform us. Most lectures were him ranting. Brandon is super nice but the class is so disorganized.

Brandon was a very interesting person to meet. He had a great deal of knowledge about games and related things, which made them very cool to talk with during discussions. Group projects were pretty interesting, and he was there to give good feedback. Definitely would take another class with them if given the chance.
easy A, just come to class (or have someone else give attendance code) and do the group projects

So far, the easiest professor and class I have taken at Northeastern. We are only graded on group projects and attedance, but he does not post the group projects grades on canvas. We do not know our grade until it is final, however this class is hard to fail. You cannot fail a project unless you just never come to class and do not do it.

Such a caring professor, checking everyone at the beginning of the class. In his class, you are free to share anything you want to talk about related to games. He is also very enthusiastic about games, and he is very knowledgeable, even about some very small game industries he knows their histories very well. 
It is also a very chill and fun class.

If you enjoy talking about video games, as well as current news and society, you will probably like this class. Brandon is a great professor and you will learn a lot IF you show up, pay attention, and participate. You will get nothing out of this class if you don't participate, but you will get a lot of out this class if you do. Long Live Jet Wenga
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Like others have said, Brandon does talk a lot about politics. Admittedly this may be a downside if you consider yourself on the right side of the political spectrum. If you don't mind that, Brandon has a blast of a class that can be funny, weird, and ridiculous all at once. Very chill class, and generally a very easy A.

Brandon's class was incredibly disorganized and held on Discord, due dates weren't specified, conversations always turned into shallow political rants, discussions were very one-sided. Students still didn't know game design basics by the end of the semester as there was never a course plan. Take someone else if you're passionate about making games!

Awesome professor who cares about us, and just wants us to have fun, we play and make games in class. Always an accessible person, always courteous and only cares that we do well. However, Brandon is VERY politically biased, which may or may not be bad depending on who you are. If you disagree, don't speak up, it's clear he hates conservatives

Class is called "Games and Society" but it's less game, and more society. Definitely the type of person to use games as a vehicle for political agenda, given how many rants in the class are all about politics rather that other aspects of society. TA is snide as hell, too. If you actually like games, stay away.

Brandon is the best professor I've ever met. He looks just like a college student, super hot and hilarious too. The class is kind of easy, just put effort into the essays, show up to class, and pay attention. He often brings games to class and let us play. Super accessible outside of class too. Will take his class every semester if I can.
Professor Seo is caring and funny. She learns everyones names and wants you to do well. If you do the reviews she posts for quizzes and exams you will do good.

Sumi is the most caring, passionate, hilarious professor I have ever had. Her class time is always used effectively, and she posts EXTREMELY detailed notes to Canvas, so even if you don't go to every class, you have all the material you need. If you have the opportunity to take a course with her, do not hesitate to do so!

She moves through topics very quickly but she posts all her lecture notes after class, which I have found very helpful for my understanding. Attendance is not mandatory, however, I recommend coming to classes prior to quizzes and exams as she often drops many hints during these lectures.
Best online and in class resources + notes. Every quiz / test was exactly like the review. Super helpful office hours and always funny in class.

She's a nice professor. Super sweet, cares about her students and the class. But I found that she has a heavy accent, and for many times I was having hard time understanding her. So be careful taking her class if you are not a native speaker.
Amazing professor. She is excellent at what she does and is great at explaining it. She provides resources for quizzes and tests that prepare you well and grades very nicely. Highly recommend.

Sweetest prof I've had so far. She remembers students' names and is a fair grader. She posts complete lecture notes and lots of practice exams. There is no homework and she has a great sense of humor. The class is very easy but beware of Quiz 2…

Professor Seo seems like a very nice lady but her teaching style just doesn't work for me. The class is too lecture heavy, and she doesn't really explain things well. However, she is GREAT with her online resources. I ended up skipping pretty much the entire semester and teaching myself the course and did well because she posts everything you need.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: My biggest regret in college was not taking calc 3 with her the next semester. Actual queen behavior every time I walked in that classroom she's literally an icon

Sumi is amazing! This is the only math class I've ever gotten an 100% in. Quizzes and tests are basically the same as the practice ones she provides. She is super sweet and likes to be silly in class. She also tries to learn everyone's name in class. Definitely take her for calc 3 if u can!

This professor is simply amazing! Sumi is the best professor I've ever had, and she truly cares about her students. She posts quiz and test reviews that make studying easier and more straight forward. She always makes sure that you know what to expect on quizzes and exams and as long as you study, you'll do great!
Sweetest professor ever! Loved her lectures, even at 8 am.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's really amazing and she makes sure to know everyone's name. Lecture may move a little fast but all her notes are posted online. Really accessible outside of class and gives so many resources to perform well on quizzes and tests.

SHE IS THE BEST I'LL MISS HER DEARLY. Super accessible outside class. Quiz every week but posts lots of supplemental material to help prepare. Her lectures move really fast and sometimes she's hard to follow, but her notes are very organized, and her handwriting is perfect. She's also super funny
She is so rushed in all her class sessions, has too much material to sort through, and confuses people because of it. But she has great online resources, so many skip class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Good vibes and engaging lecturer.

Such a kind and sweet professor! She's very organized and provides students with notes on each chapter. Her exams and quizzes are fairly straightforward and she makes sure to post practice exams beforehand. She's always happy and knows how to radiate positivity.

If you don't go to the lecture's you're bound to fail. Although her Canvas notes are clear, she covers so much content in class that you need to have explained to you. Quizzes every week, lowest two dropped. However, she 100% gives you resources to perform on the tests, word for word, I got a 99.5% on the final after an 87% on the midterm

Professor Seo is great! She is the best math professor I have had so far at Northeastern. Hew lectures are very clear and easy to understand and really help to prepare your for quizzes and test. Study guides are also very helpful for exam prep and her grading criteria is very clear. Would highly recommend.
she's great and super efficient at teaching

She is amazing. The lecture notes, practice exams/quizzes, extra practice she provides prepare you well for this course. She is also just a good lecturer, doing many different examples to get the concepts across. Plus she is hilarious!! she has to tell at least one joke a class. This course wasn't too bad with her!
no

I would take Prof Seo for every math class if I could. Made exam/quiz reviews that made studying easy. She is a very nice grader and gives credit wherever she can. She's very funny and wants you to do well. Sometimes the lectures could get a bit fast-paced but you won't fall behind if you review her notes after class.

She is so great! She posts all her (very detailed) notes online and has a lot of office hours. She makes lectures really funny, and she is a SUPER easy grader on tests and quizzes, it is easy to get a good grade even if you think you didn't do great. She does go very fast with lectures though and I wish she gave more examples for each concept

Prof. Seo is an amazing teacher and a kind individual. She does her absolute best to do as many practice questions in class as possible and tells you exactly what to expect for the quizzes. Beware that you can't just skip and expect to do well since the class is so lecture-heavy. She posts lecture notes but does not record the lectures.

Amazing professor, loved her classes. Her note guides are super helpful and allowed me to get good grades on the quizzes during class time. She does have a somewhat strong accent, but it is understandable and have recommended her to all of my friends.

Only downside is she doesn't give you notes on what you did wrong. Other than that she's a great caring prof. took time to learn names, and is very clear about what will and won't be on tests. Quizzes are every week but they are really easy if you pay attention. If you can't understand accents be a little cautious. Big ball of energy and loves math

Professor Seo is one of my favorite professors I've had at Northeastern. She is very fun and takes the time to learn everyone's names. Calc 3 at 8am would be so much worse if she wasn't such a burst of energy and fun, as well as covering the material very concisely and clearly. She is a great professor and I actually understand the topics we cover.
great professor, clear concepts, lectures can go too fast-paced sometimes though. overall, I love her, she has silly fun humour, and I would take a class with her again.

I had never taken a stats class before, but she simplified the concepts super well. Most of her quizzes & exams mimic the lecture notes heavily. I recommend going to every lecture because falling behind a relying on the book is not ideal. Make sure to ask questions and show up to office hours if you need any help, she is always super accessible!

Professor Seo is a great professor! Her lectures are clear, and we went over a lot of example problems in class which are helpful for learning the material. She also gives out practice quizzes/tests which are very similar to the exam questions, so you can most likely get good grades in the class if you just do those.

Professor Seo has easily been one of the best teachers/professors I have ever had in my life. She really cares about what she is teaching and takes the time to answer your questions. If you study hard outside of class and keep up with the material you will do great. I have never enjoyed a math class this much until now!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She loves to teach and you can absolutely tell. It's a hard class and she talks fast, but if you do all the assigned (optional) homework problems (the online textbook is extremely useful, make sure you have access to the linked videos) and review the problems from the lectures then you should be fine. She explains the steps for problems very well.

Was not happy I had to take calc 3 at 8 am but Professor Seo is a shot of espresso. Did not have any issues with understanding the material due to the charisma and simplicity of her lectures. Office hours are extremely helpful and she always carefully outlines what's going to be on tests and quizzes.
Excellent and very clear. Recommend highly.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Told us clearly what would be on tests/quizzes which made it easy but I just did not like her teaching style. Didn't explain what/why she was doing before starting so it was hard to follow and she moves really fast. She rarely understood the questions people asked. Nice person and wants students to do well but I wouldn't take again.
Love Dr Seo with all my heart, truly amazing for Calc III

Dr. Seo is funny, and her lectures are super helpful. There are weekly quizzes and 2 Exams but she has tons of study materials and will make time for you if you need it. The lectures move really fast so make sure to grasp what you're learning and watch youtube videos if you need. Highly recommend, she is one of the best professors for this course.

I would take all my math classes with her if I could. The tests are pretty difficult, but she makes the time to slow down and really answer questions to make sure the whole class understands everything. She's also genuinely funny sometimes and learns our names which rare in big classes like this.

She genuinely cares about her students and that they are learning. Would make an effort to learn everyone's names and is always accessible outside of class. As long as you do the homework and show up to class you will do well. Her lectures are clear and concise, and her office hours are very helpful. Amazing professor all around.

I actually love Dr. Seo. I showed up every day, raised my hand to every question, and it culminated in both a ton of learning and a great relationship with Dr. Seo. I never really went to office hours as any missed lectures there are videos by Professor Massey. Just participate and she'll notice you. She also works to get everyone's name.

She's just awesome. Makes a really boring and dense class like Calc 3 entertaining with her anecdotes and jokes. Sometimes it can be hard to understand what she's saying due to her accent, but it's not enough to get in the way of learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Seo is the best. I started this course VERY overwhelmed, but her lectures are clear, and her office hours were very useful. She cares a lot and will try very hard to make sure you understand the material. She can notice when students get stressed and cracks jokes to relieve the pressure. Oh, and her notes are beautiful!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's a super queen
Prof Seo is a great teacher. She is invested in teaching her students. Her examples in class are very clear and she gives good study material for exams.

Sumi is great prof and makes things very easy with good quiz and test reviews. While she does a good job covering everything, she goes very very fast oftentimes and a lot of the work needed to succeed is from outside studying. Overall, Sumi is great for Calc 3 since its arguably the strangest math in the calc series
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Seo is a great mathematics professor. She outlines things very well and teaches you exactly what you need to know to grasp the concept. I had her for Calc 3 and will have her again for Linear Algebra in the Fall. Definitely try and take your math classes with her! Will be worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor! Lectures are always clear and she lets you know what you need to know for tests! If you do the homework, you're almost guaranteed an A.

Sumi isn't necessarily a bad teacher. She knows her material and is very adept at teaching it. Yet, the classes she teaches are difficult and the pace at which she moves is extremely quick. At most times, it's hard to keep up and while she encourages students to ask questions, she doesn't give them enough time to think about it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Sumi Seo is AMAZING! She is a very nice lady and knows how to keep the lectures interesting. Highly recommend for any math class.
She's the truth

Professor Seo is the best math professor I've had at Northeastern University. Her lectures do a great job of explaining hard to understand math concepts and she does many examples to make sure her students comprehend the material. Class does require some out of class studying to do well on quizzes and tests but is an easy A otherwise.

This is the second class I've had Seo for and I like her a lot. She is usually very clear about what she wants you to know and what you will be graded on. She goes pretty fast, so if you don't have time to go to extra help or learn by working through things, this may not be for you. But I still regard as a very solid choice. Responds to emails well
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Sumi is a caring and friendly person. She is always willing to help.

Fantastic professor. I had her for Calc 3 and her lectures were amazing. She's willing to answer any questions, or meet outside of class. Grading was based only on quizzes, the two exams, and the final, so you have to stay on top of the material. Easiest way to do that is by showing up. She keeps lectures interesting and leaves time to take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She was a great professor who was glad to help students. Her class was not hard and she's a easy grader.

Professor Seo is clearly a very smart teacher, qualified mathematically. She is definitely enthusiastic about her subject. At first I was shocked at the fast pace of the class and a bit struggling with her accent but I learned after a few weeks. Lectures were mostly some instruction and lots of problems (examples). Go to her office hours help!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Seo was a great professor, I would really recommend taking Calc 3 with her, as long as you do the homework and quiz/exam reviews you should be well prepared.

I took Calculus two my first semester of college with Sumi, and it was an amazing introduction to college classes. Sumi is an amazing teachers who explains things in a way I could understand. She also pretty much tells you what's going to be on the quizzes and tests. Just pay attention in class, which she makes sure you do, and you'll be fine.
Very nice professor, teaches decently hard material very well. Class requires effort, but you learn a lot and aren't graded harshly.
UNDOUBTEDLY, the best professor in NEU.

Her tests are not so easy, but her reviews are very helpful.  She is accessible and very helpful if you go to her office hours.  Professor Seo explains concepts very clearly. She has an accent, and makes jokes that she learns from her son. But these, I think, make the class more fun! I would take Calc 3 from her as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Seo is funny but her accent is sometimes hard to understand. She takes attendance everyday, and if you do not come to class you will miss something important. She does plenty of examples in class and really looks for participation from her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She is honestly the best professor i had in Northeastern. I took her for Both calculus 2 and 3 and she was just amazing! She gives you Quiz Reviews which are AMAZING. She is honestly the best. Don't think twice if you have the chance to take a calc class with her.
She is a fun and well versed teacher who knows what shes talking about.  She's a good prof, but not as good as the others.  Switch out if you can.

Sumi was definitely the nicest professor I've ever had. She made an effort to know all of her students by name. Go to her office hours if you need help. She gave pretty straightforward lectures. Her pace can be fast at times and she doesn't always explain the material, but regurgitating the formulas on the tests will serve you just fine.
Best math professor ever!!
Great teacher, occasional nuggets of humor make every lecture worth it. Accent/English not perfect, but makes things more interesting in my opinion
her notes are really good
Great teacher. Her notes are crystal clear, just make sure she sees you when you raise your hand

She goes pretty fast and can be a bit hard to understand at times. She gives REALLY helpful reviews before every test and midterm. You're almost guaranteed an A as long you pay attention and do the reviews.

One of the BEST teachers I have ever had. Sit in the FRONT row, makes a 40 person class seem like it's 12 (and you get to know her betterinteract more during lectures. DO IT). She speaks a bit fast sometimes, but you get used to it and she repeats it if you don't understand. Quiz every week, hw is studying GREAT PROF! I would take again. 1010

If you are a math minded person she is incredibly clear. If you aren't then she can sometimes be a little confusing. But Sumi is very willing and happy to answer questions. She also wants to make sure that everyone understands the material. If you study the sample quizzes she puts on Blackboard then the in class quizzes are easy.

I love the way she teaches. All the resources such as class notes, old exams, and practice exams are uploaded and you could use them to prepare your exams. She also held extra office hours on Sunday before exams for those who were not able to come during week days. She is awesome!!

Probably one of the hardest professors to understand.  One can deal with the accent but she goes so quickly that it's impossible to comprehend words and keep up at the same time.  Honestly, don't ask questions in her class, because she won't understand what you're asking and as a result will think you're an idiot for the rest of class.
she is a GREAT teacher, that's all I have to say.
Best math teacher ever! I would take calculus III from her if possible. Easy to approach and really helpful during office hours.
She is the best. her quizzes are too easy. She gives really helpful reviews before every single quiz and midterm. FOCUS ON HER REVIEWS and u surly will get an A.

Professor Sumi is one of the few teachers who actually care about how their students perform in class, she is really approachable and always asks her students to go to her office hours when they don't understand something. She explains material really well, just pay attention..

She's definitely not the clearest teacher out there. Here quizzes come from the homework. The key to the class is to go to her office hours. She does the problems that will be on the quiz and is always willing to help.

The course material is hard and she can be difficult to understand sometimes, but she knows what she's talking about and she really cares about her students and wants them to do well.  She is extremely approachable and will ask you to come to her office hours if she thinks it will help you.  Sit in the front because she speaks softly sometimes.
She is so hard to understand. Quizzes were easy once she told us all the questions were from the hw. But the exam was so hard. Average was a 67.

Sumi is a very helpful teacher. She knows every student by first name and is always willing to help in her office hours. She is not to good at explaining but her quizzes are pretty easy. The problems she puts on quizzes all come from the homeworks. Overall she's a pretty nice person.
way too fast
Super friendly dude, I feel like his lectures are boring but he teaches well. Homework and exams are related to what you learn in lecture, overall a good professor.

Prof. Singhal's amazing and hilarious. Workload is manageable and the class is pretty easy if you just pay attention or look at his notes. My only critique with the class was that it was more coding heavy rather than math (unlike the other classes), which could be conflicting if you are learning data science concepts on top of Python.

This class does what it should. Introduce us to DS without making us worry about a grade. It is an intro class and we were introduced to the basics of DS and ML. Not sure how other have complaints. Me and my friends absolutely loved the class and the energy.

Very knowledgable professor. You get up to 5 points of extra credit for each homework if you submit it 2 days early. Also various opportunities for extra credit throughout the semester. The class has one math midterm, but it isn't worth that much and labs and homework have a clear grading policy.

Very nice guy. His class is pretty easy, as he offers many extra credit opportunities.  However, I don't feel like I learned that much in this class. Not very information-heavy. More CS than math-based in comparison to other professors.
excellent professor that gave out a lot of extra credit. if you know at least a little bit of python and do the extra credit it's very hard to get a bad grade in his class. very funny and memorable
Plenty of extra credit opportunities. I loved doing the project, it helped me understand the material and work in a group. Professor is caring and ready to help.
The class is very easy and there are plenty of extra credit opportunities. It was fun to understand the underlying concept of large language models. Sometimes i felt the lectures were boring
absolute goat professor, had him in spring for CY2550 and now DS3000 for fall and ended both classes with over 100%. love you king mohit!!!

DS3000 is easy, lots of homework but its mostly busy work. Lab assignments are long and annoying but very doable. Very nice professor and always willing to help. Study the math section on ur own and its not too hard. Math exam is exactly like practice exam, very straightforward and easy linear algebra. Final project is very short and not that hard.
Really good professor. I really liked the way he teaches and he cares about students as well.
The professor is hilarious; however, sometimes the classes can be a bit hard to follow. He cares for the students. I wish the late submission penalty was not that strict.
fairly strict and passive agressive. lectures often hard to follow (mainly in the mathematics part of class)
This guy is chill af. You really dont need to ever go to class, he just spends it yapping. But pretty easy class, cool dude.
All around just a stand up guy. Super kind and always down to help. However he will NOT ENTERTAIN ANY EMAILS past the time was due!

There's so much lack of clarity in any and all forms of communication from this professor. You could write him an email, make a Piazza post, or send regrade requests about something with five distinct concerns and he'll only address one of them. Just absolutely no clarity and terrible communicator in general. Feels like he doesn't care.

Overall class is quite easy if you pay attention to class and review before exams. No pop up quizes. One to two projects per month. I think lecture wise is fine, not really engaging but not bad. Enjoyed learning the content.
Very funny professor, but when it comes to teaching, its not much.
I didn't learn much here because the professor made the course way too easy.
While an easy teacher, if you really want to learn you should take someone else. Realistically, you won't learn anything.

I took this course to learn more about Data Science but ended up not really learning anything. He does his lectures from Jupyter Notebooks, so going to class isn't even needed. He is a very nice guy, but he doesn't really add anything beyond what is in the Jupyter Notebook in his lectures.

I don't understand why others are saying stuff like "Resent the haters" when they give an honest review. But in my opinion, you don't need a professor for this course, especially in the way Prof. Singhal taught the course. This is nothing against the person Prof. Singhal is, but the course/teaching style isn't conductive of an interesting lecture.

The professor is a great person and has decent humor, but his lectures aren't much more than a jupyter notebook. It doesn't make sense to come to class because the lecutres don't add on anything besides whats already in the notebook. In other classes, you might code alongside the professor, but in this class, you merely look at code already written

Professor Singhal truly cares about his students. His lectures are engaging, and he ensures all material is accessible outside class. He regularly asks for student feedback to improve the course. I also enjoyed the homeworks, which applied lecture concepts to fun topics like Pokémon. I highly recommend taking DS3000 with Professor Singhal!

I took this course to learn more about Data Science but ended up not really learning anything. He does his lectures from Jupyter Notebooks, so going to class isn't even needed. He is a very nice guy, but he doesn't really add anything beyond what is in the Jupyter Notebook in his lectures.
Funny professor, lectures could be a bit dry at times, but professor did his best to explain the content and was always able to answer follow up questions.

This class was the easiest class ive taken so far at Northeastern. All grades are based on 7 projects which are just longer homework assignments that are very clearly guided by the directions and 1 midterm. The midterm was super easy (review/cheat sheet helped). Lectures are boring but attendance isn't mandatory so just fade.

Prof. Singhal is an OK speaker with a reddit user's humor -- definitely not everyone's cup of tea, including mine. Lectures are long and quite boring, but attendance is pretty much mandatory since he'll give random unannounced assignments that count toward participation. Beware of MANY small assignments and extremely poor email communication.

Professor is relaxed and well organized. His class is very structured with assignments (homework and labs) consistently due -heavy workload. Homework can always be completed by reviewing lecture content in Jupyter Notebooks. My only complaint is that there are frequently "pop" in-class assignments, and due dates often collide the same night.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Mohit was a very nice, funny, caring professor. Highly recommend him for this class. That being said, he is not a good lecturer. He had jupyter notebooks for us to follow, which was nice, but actually going to class was kind of useless. When he draws on the board its not organized well and he also repeats himself a lot. But, great guy.

She is very chill and she makes you go outside a lot on fieldtrips and outside of class time for the projects but overall, the projects aren't bad, homework wasn't bad, classes can be boring, you won't know your grade until the end.

She's honestly a very sweet and caring person. She gives a lot of great feedback, and her class actually taught me a lot. She takes forever to grade, but I feel like if you converse with her a lot, she will give you a better grade on the essays. It's kind of content-heavy, though, and there are a lot of field trips.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You will grow as a writer in this course and the projects are very interesting. Be prepared to separate from the traditional five paragraph essay you were used to in high school. Carolyn is helpful and always available to give feedback and help students after class. If you have to take writing at Northeastern, take Carolyn you will not regret it!
It's 2 and a half months into the semester and we have no grades back yet

Professor Sirois is really nice and will always offer advice to guide you to writing better portfolios. The material is interesting and the classes not too hard. If you show up and make a bit of effort to write all the assignments, it's not hard to get a good grade.  I would definitely recommend her for first year writing.

Mrs. Sirois without a doubt cares for her students and makes sure the assignments are beneficial to us as students and interesting. She allows room for your own creativity and personality in the writing assignments which makes it unlike regular writing classes. I really enjoyed this class and her as a professor!

Professor Siriois significantly helped me improve my writing. She is very nice, helpful, and understanding towards students. The class content is interesting and ranges greatly, which keeps you engaged. She is willing to meet with you if you need help with anything and will always find a time that works for you.

Professor Sirois has been one of the best professor I have had a Northeastern. Pr. Sirois is very helpful. She will make the time to meet with you if you have need extra help. The projects in this class are very interesting and fun. If you put the effort and time to your work you will likely do well in this class.
Great Professor;  Assignments are straightforward and as long as you put the time into your assignments, you can definitely see yourself in the 'A' scale.

Ms Sirois was one of the best English professors I have ever had, dating back through high school. She will go out of her way to find extra time to meet with you and makes sure you understand the material.
