She's a great teacher, and very approachable.  She reiterates anything and everything and wants to make sure we learn the information in front of us!

Lectures are a bit boring (I'm just not interested in the topics as much) but he's a great teacher. Super nice and is actually interested in the students' lives. Everything is open notes/internet and the final is a group paper. There's one presentation all year but the rest is casual group work.
he was just the best class was very enjoyable and the topics are closely related with whats happening in the world today I just loved being in that lecture

So so kind and passionate about what he's teaching. Midterm was open internet, final was a group essay. Participation isn't required, neither is attendance, but most people go because he's so nice. Only thing is you don't need the textbook at all.

Professor Spitulnik is by far the sweetest person I have ever met. He is extremely passionate about his job and loves talking about his very own experience in healthcare. I love Professor Spitnulnik so much and would take this class in a heartbeat. He loves talking to his students. I cannot recommend him enough, he is so caring.

he was the most laid back professor I had. attendance was not mandatory, but participation was encouraged. some people went the whole semester without participating. only one midterm, open EVERYTHING (even google). a final paper and a presentation but it should be easy as long as you know what you're saying. 1000/10 I recommend!!

He gives personal examples of the topics you learn about in class, to help you better understand the topic. You do 2 big group projects, but you're allowed to pick your group members. The midterm is open everything, this even includes the internet. The final is a 12-14 page, but you work on it in your groups. You should definitely take his class!

He is a really great guy, easy A if you just participate. All assignments are in groups and they all get 100's. Midterm is online and open note/can use internet. The lowest exam score for my class was like a 90. Final is a 12-14 page paper that you work on in groups of three so its not much work, better than an exam. Take him if you can.

A king. He truly cares about not only what he teaches, but his students. His lectures are super long, but you can't help but admire his work. He is so sweet. You will learn healthcare for real, and his homework and class work are pretty reasonable.

Prof. Spitulnik is a very nice guy and easy going. There's group work every week, but it's uncomplicated and always graded as 100%. Every class has a presentation lecture which can be boring. Easy A though.

If you're taking American Healthcare Systems I highly recommend taking this Prof! He's so nice and generous. The lectures are quite long but still interesting to listen to. The grading is mostly based on discussion posts and group work and a midterm and final paper, but it is fairly easy to do.
Great professor and very kind, really cares about teaching and his students. His class was very easy and the grades consisted of simple things. Highly recommend taking this course if you can.

Pretty cool dude. Super nice and knows a lot of people through his experience. Material is pretty interesting although his lectures get a bit boring at times. Lots of group work and very manageable coursework with one midterm and one final paper with a few group assignments throughout. By far best option for PHTH 1260.

We did a lot of class discussions but the grading is very light. He is passionate about what he talks about and can explain topics using specific examples which is helpful. The lectures can get long and sometimes a little boring but overall the material is interesting and he is able to explain any questions.

Jay is the best professor ever. So lenient, understanding and gets intimate about his life at times. A very easy A, would take him a million times again. Two papers and some small homeworks along the way, super manageable and content is interesting.

Jay is an amazing person/professor. His lectures are genuinely interesting and he always contributes by adding his own personal experiences. Attendance is a sign in sheet. He is extremely lenient with due dates and such. Not many assignments, but an easy A. 100% Recommend, he is AMAZING!!!!
The class is a bit boring because the content is so straightforward but he's a great professor. An easy A if you show up, he takes attendance every class.

Dr. Jay gives us group project with real life organization who needs project management help. Sometimes, the company is looking for hands for their clinical trial based projects/data analysis projects and HINF 6215 students are there to help these organization by working together to solve real life problems related to Project Management (PM).

reviews.comment: If you want to learn something in class - don't take it with him. If you want a chill time - go ahead.
Dude's an OG and keeps class really chill. Super easy for a capstone course
For being a capstone, this course was pretty chill. If you're looking for an easy senior semester take spector! All we had was half page case studies due every class, a final, and a group project.

As in most of my online classes, the professors don't do the grading - the instructors do. My instructor was tough and there is a lot of writing in this course (managing people and organizations). Even though I averaged an 88.9, and my instructor recommended me to be scaled to an A-, it didn't happen. Beware the trick questions in the quizzes.
Best professor I have had at Neu!
Best professor I have had at NEU, if you get the chance take this guy he's amazing. Class discussions are interesting, he's funny and he's also a chilled guy.
This man is hilarious. The class is not particularily interesting but Spector makes it easy and somewhat enjoyable. Take this class if you wanna kick back and chill on reddit. Sup.

TAKE THIS CLASS if you are a senior wanting an easy strategy professor. Incredibly easy grader, and minimal assignments. I assumed I would be spending a lot of time on this class, however without studying I got 100% on both the midterm and final. EASIEST CLASS EVER.

Prof Spector has a great sense of humor which makes this class alot better than it should be. Does a good job lecturing, and is very fair in terms of grading. Definitely recommend taking this class with him!

Not a horrible professor, overall pretty good at leading discussions. However, he was often confusing about assignments and would tell us multiple times that he would email us to clairify things, etc. but never once did that. He also took way to long to grade the 4pg papers that we submitted mid semester, so we ended up never getting those back.

At the end of the semester, I still feel like we didn't get into deeper discussions in class, nor do I feel that I got to know the professor too well. He dismissed the last few weeks' assignments so that we could work on papers, but I would rather have discussed prominent figures of the '60s and worked on the paper, I don't know, on my own time?

Not sure if this professor is qualified to teach a 501 strategy class...class was very basic and filled with oversimplified lectures. Did not learn much but the class was easy. 2 cases, 1 test, and the business simulation was all there to it. The professor was a funny guy but was condescending to students sometimes. He should not be teaching STRT..

Easily one of the worst teachers.  Spent too much time on useless stuff such as how to add video links to powerpoint slides, how to rip dvd's etc.  Too eager to dismiss class ahead aroung halftime. Does not read papers, does not respond to mails.

Really funny guy, the cases were interesting. Quizzes on the reading almost every other class, but he drops the lowest one of the nine he gives. N/A

Really nice guy, class was fun.  Do not buy the textbook, you don't need it.  I had no textbook and guessed on every quiz and the lowest grade I got was an 80, real simple stuff.  His competency level has increased since org behavior 3 years ago.

Class is fun and interesting. Presents material in a simple way and you learn through class discussion so the more you put into preparation the more you will get out of it. Overall one of the better classes and prof's at NU.
Very competent

If you want to listen to boring and oversimplified lectures from a really nice guy that is occasionally humorous than Professor Spector is your guy! Bottomline... the course materials($200) are much too expensive for a Professor that doesn't use them and puts your to sleep.

I took Spector after reviewing his reviews on this website to discover his complete incompetency in teaching a level 501 class.I spend $80 for the textbook that we never used, $50 for the classpact that I barely read, and $70 for the end of the year simulation to learn NOTHING.This class was a waste of my time and money.
Great class very interactive. Def. show up, mostly watch movies and chat about 1950's US. Good guy all around. Will def. try and understand your point.

Organizational Behavior. It was an easy class. One class project: start your own business. Quizzes at the beginning of class everytime a chapter is due. Very laid-back class. Wouldn't mind taking one of his classes again.
He is a great professor, being so relzxed. Opened to students' opinions
No Comments
He is a great professor. He got sense of humor. I enjoy the class so much.

I love this man.  He is really amazing.  Great teacher, knows his stuff, looooved his class, always joking about things, involved, open notes tests, class actually interesting, fun group project, easy grader, all around amazing professer.  I wish he taught other subjects.

This is one of the most infuriating professors you'll ever have. She doesn't listen to others and doesn't proofread anything she posts. She also grades super slow & isn't flexible at all. reviews.comment: Professor S-G is very knowledgable and truly cares about her students. If you are having any trouble she will make the time and clarify any concerns you may have in her class. She really wants all her students to learn and enjoy the class as much as she does. I recommend her!

Professor S-G is a lovely woman who has a passion for what she teaches and it shows. Like any class, it can get tiring, but she gives breaks and changes things up. Professor S-G is very passionate about teaching and nutrition. Slides that are irrelevant to quizzes are marked at the bottom, so you don't waste time studying unimportant material. Kandarp is a great professor and knows a lot about corporate finance. His lectures are good and he does use real world examples. Exams really challenge you and are very difficult. Final exam was extremely conceptual and tested your understanding of what was taught in class.

Professor Kandarp is extremely kind, patient, and knowledgeable. His lectures can be long but are engaging and teach the material well (10-minute breaks in the class period also help). Beware his tests are very difficult, but fairly curved in the end.

Prof Srinivasan is very knowledgable and a very good lecturer. He is very good at bringing real-life examples in his lectures. However, his exams are very hard and require out-of-the-box thinking, which is not existent in the connect assignments or the practice exams. The midterm was way harder than the practice exam.

Professor Srinivasan was a great teacher. The tests are based on lecture material; however, textbook insights and the in-chapter problems are extremely helpful if you want to excel. He cares about his students and does his best to help them succeed. His focus is on learning. If you leave this class without learning...it's on you.

Kandarp is super knowledgeable and passionate about sharing his expertise with his students. His exams are quite difficult but fairly curved. Fairly lecture-heavy but very engaging. Be prepared to work on multiple group projects throughout the semester.

Great professor! class time is always organized and he knows his stuff. The group projects are a little annoying as there's 4 of them and if you have a bad group you need to stick with them for the whole semester. Exams are tough but if you put the work in, they're not impossible. Always available for questions and course material was challenging.

Great Professor. Clearly very passionate about what he teaches and always was available (office hours/after class). Made sure the class understood the concept before moving on and had a "warm calling" list to make participation easier. Exams were way too difficult and ended up being curved 30+ points which seemed unproductive.

reviews.comment: Professor is knowledgeable but his tests are too heavy. Final average was 65% but he curves it in the end. Take him if you're willing to commit !
Interesting and knowledgable. If you're interested in finance, take him.

He's really nice and is passionate about what he teaches. Don't listen to other people saying this class is hard, I spent an average of 30 min a week outside of class on it. As long as you go to class and pay attention you will get a good grade, especially because he curves at the end.

He purposely makes the class hard and said "GPA should not be a priority, want students to lose the fear of failure so exams will be hard." He Includes content not covered in class and does not provide feedback for exams. The class average is in the 70s. Smart professor but don't take him if you want to do well. A lot of students dropped too.

I definitely learned a lot in this class, especially as someone that isn't super interested in finance. Prof Srinivasan was great at making the material understandable and went at a good pace for the entire class. The tests were hard, which is the only thing bringing down my rating, but he curves the class average to a B+ to offset it.

He is a great professor because he explains complex concepts quite well. However, do not expect an easy A in this class. He will make you work a lot as he makes the grading scale harder and his tests are also more difficult compared to other professors.

This was the hardest class. I do think the professor was not terrible and he was caring if you needed extra help. BUT the lectures were so long, boring, and hard to follow. Each class was a 50 slide powerpoint, impossible to write everything down and he does not upload the powerpoints till the end of the week=not helpful. Exams were IMPOSSIBLE!

Finance is tough especially when you're first getting into it. Professor Srinivasan does a really great job of breaking it down into digestible pieces. This course is tough, but it's going to be like that with any professor.  Professor Srinivasan is really great about drawing connections and making them easier to understand.

If you don't attend classes and don't stay updated with the class concepts, he isn't the guy for you but if you're genuinely interested in finance, trust me he's going to make the subject so much more interesting for you. Tests are exactly the concepts he teaches in class except the last 2 questions. He also curves to a B+.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: MY BEST PROFESSOR AT NORTHEASTERN SO FAR. If you put in the effort, you're going to excel in his class. Goes over every concept in detail and ensures that every person understands it. Tests are not very tough if you prepare from his slides, but the last 2 questions are made challenging intentionally. However, he curves the class average to a B+.

I usually don't write reviews, but he's literally the worst. I never attend class because his lectures are terrible and unhelpful, and his tests are actually impossible. I'M NOT EXAGGERATING. Mans is more concerned about maintaining a low class average than actually teaching us the material. Save yourself and take this course with someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

His teaching style is incredibly uninspiring, and his ability to use technology is worse than my 85 year old grandmother. I would've changed professors if any other times fit my schedule, and I knew this by the second class of the semester.

The class was fine on campus but, online the class was much more difficult. Paying attention in class is crucial. He does curve the final grade, but tests averages was significantly lowered online. reviews.comment: his lectures are never boring. he always takes the time to make sure everyone understands. exams can be tough as he focuses a lot on accuracy rather than basic understanding of concepts. however, you will learn a LOT in this class and plus he curves final grades to a B+ average. highly recommend

Kandarp is by far the best professor I've had at Northeastern. If you learn through clear notes and organized examples, he's your guy. He writes everything on the board, reiterates important concepts, and always relates the material to real world examples. Exceptional at explaining things, extremely kind, and curves the class to a B+. Take him!

The course itself is challenging; however, professor Srinivasan curves grades to a B+ average. Few assignments, just pay attention and you will do great. Really knows how to teach concepts and real-world experience. Would definitely take again.

reviews.comment: I think about Dee Spencer once a week and am grateful to have been in her class. She is caring but a tough grader. It comes from a place of wanting her students to succeed and she helped me grow in and out of the classroom. I love Dee!
This course feels like. it was structured to be deliberately difficult for no good reason

She cares very deeply about her students and their performance. You have to pay attention and attend lectures in order to do well. She goes incredibly fast at the beginning of the semester, so you have to do a good amount of studying/self-teaching at the beginning.

She's a nice person, but her class is very tough and you need to put in many hours outside of the classroom. I found myself sacrificing grades in other classes just to get a decent grade on exams. Tests are taken on canvas which I found annoying and if math isn't your thing or if you haven't taken stats before, I wouldn't take her class.

She is a great person but her class is hard unless you have countless hours to put into the class or you are already familiar with stats. The math isn't hard, it's the conceptual stuff that she is extremely nitpicky with on tests yet she glosses over that when she is teaching you in class. Her tests are too dense for the class time and impossible.

Lectures are chaotic, and the tests barely relate to what's taught, leaving students confused and unprepared. Feedback on work is minimal, offering no real guidance for improvement. Questions in class are often ignored or poorly addressed. Overall, this course feels disjointed and unnecessarily difficult

She was a great professor who made Stats such an easy class, even though I had it at 8am. As long as you pay attention in class and take nots she will love you, and provide really great help. Honestly this was such an easy class and she was very nice.

An amazing professor who makes learning fun and truly does care about you as a student. I felt like I learned a lot throughout this course and had fun while doing it. Would take a class with her again 100%!

Attendance is mandatory every class. She cold calls but it helps make you stay on top of your work. If you do all your homework and practice problems you'll be fine. You need to put time aside outside of class to be successful. I think her teaching style takes time to get used to but overall I learned a lot from her class.

Professor Denise is a very participation and anti lecture type. ofteacher. her class was very engaging. You always had to be prepared to know the answer and understand the content. it is a very fast paced class but I really enjoyed taking her class. Math is not my strong suit and i was able to succeed in this class thank you to her.

From other professors at Northeastern, she takes some adjusting to. You must hold yourself accountable for assignments as they're due at 9am. She has no forgiveness for late/missing work. I didn't do well on the first exam, but I learned  and studied harder for the 2nd and 3rd exams. If you put in the work and come to class you'll do fine.
Best professor EVER!! she made a 3 and 1/2 statistics class interesting and fun. I wish I could take more classes with her.

Spencer is hard but she's so nice.  It's true that she actually cares about students, which is unusual. The cold calling took some getting used to but it gets everyone talking and asking questions. Once you get used to it, it's less stressful. It helps that she is really funny. Claas was never boring.

Professor Spencer is the best ! Tests are difficult but she provides lots of resources and is very accessible. Read the slides, participate, do the practice problems and you will do well. She genuinely cares about her students and wants to see them succeed, one of the best professors I've had at NU.

1st exam was tough, only slides as resources. For 2,3,4, practice and solutions were given. but 2nd exam had a bad study-to-grade ratio. Each unit felt like a different class. The 3rd unit was the best. The 4th unit was disorganized. while u do learn, it becomes ur life. class success felt manufactured. but prof tries to accommodate and cares

She is amazing! She took over our class last semester after our professor had to step down and managed to reteach us everything we hadn't understood the first 3 weeks of class in a single week. She talked to us about how we could move forward and cared about our opinions and then met with ppl who struggled with the material to encourage and help us

LOVE HER!  My favorite professor! She's really passionate about statistics and about students. She prepares you well for the exams. We do problems with partners during class and she gives extra study problems and answer keys. She says to study a little bit every day and you'll nail it.  Best advice ever!  And pay close attention to her slide!

im so happy someone finally left a medicore review. IF YOU ARE NOT CONFIDENT IN UR MATH ABILITIES, TAKE ANOTHER PROF! i joined her class because of all the good reviews but i regretted it. hw is hard. exams dont relate to class concepts. some1 can be so good at a subject they forget others aren't -- players aren't always coaches
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: As much as Prof. Spencer is caring and enthusiastic about Statistics, she puts too much onus on students to learn. Lectures are way fast-paced, and every class is in preparation of the next exam, even if we just had one. Exams formatted different than HWs and exercises too. She'd be good in a more advance class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Could not agree more with the positive reviews written below. I took her class this semester, and let me just say her class was on the more difficult end. But if you put in the effort, you can definitely achieve an A. Prof dee is really understanding and as long as you try, cant see why you can't achieve a good score. Recommend her!

I saw another review refer to Professor Spencer as "mom-like" and I think that is accurate. She cares about her students and is very encouraging. She really wants her students to succeed. However, this class is not an easy A. Be ready for cold-calling every class, late homeworks are not accepted, and the first Exam was rough for a lot of the class.

I personally enjoyed the teaching style and cold calling because it improves class morale and engagement. You really have to attend lecture, understand the slides, complete HW, complete extra practice problems. Exam 1 was rough but it gets better and everything evens out by the end of the semester.She really cares about her students.

This is the hardest class I've taken but she is the best professor I've had. She cares about you like a mom and is only tough on you to push you to succeed. I hate math but she makes lectures engaging and cold calls but it helped me learn so much. You will not find a more dedicated, caring, sweet, and honest professor. The very best NU offers.

She's very mom-like. She is funny caring and super patient (answers every question before moving on), encouraging (always says "great question!"), and creates a strong class community (we always interact with her and each other).  She holds everyone accountable to be their best (no phones, be on time, stay focused, treat each other respectfully).

Professor Spencer is my favorite professor at Northeastern, and business statistics is by far my favorite class. I absolutely hate math but she is incredible at motivating students. I have never learned so much in a class as I have as this one. She meets with students individually who are not doing well, and adjusts course based on student needs.

Arguably one the best teachers I have had at Northeastern (and in my academic career). Professor Spencer is a true gem in a slowly deteriorating era of educators that go "above and beyond" for their students. Her class is difficult no doubt - but if you are willing to put in the work and use all of the many resources she provides, you can do well!

One of the only classes I've actually learned in and been very engaged in. Prof Spencer is very caring and makes classes engaging and makes sure no one is confused or left behind. She always encourages questions and explains content well. Yes it is a lot of work at times and the tests are a bit difficult, but I think I've learned a lot.

Best professor! Provides constant encouragement & help. Very clear explanations.  Class participation is huge.  Tells you what will be hard & what will be easy, & exactly what to study to succeed.  Lots of practice examples for every topic.  Take her if you really want to understand statistics & you want a professor who really pushes you to learn.

I love her! She is an amazing professor with a huge heart.  Her classes are always really interactive. She calls on EVERYONE during every class to keep you involved and engaged. I thought I would hate stats but love it because of her. She provides tons of extra help, extra credit, and opportunities to improve your grade throughout the semester.

Dr. Spencer was the best professor I've had at Northeastern so far. She is caring and always willing to help you. Effort and participation matters a lot. Her class is really hard especially in the summer, but she knows it is hard and has a lot of measures to help you do well even if you're struggling. If you put in the work, it works out. Love her

Professor Spencer is by far the best professor I have ever had. Lectures are clear and concise, she prepares you for the homework which is very straightforward. The exams are very easy in my opinion because Professor Spencer provides us with so many example problems during lecture that we all go through together. She is so sweet, lucky to take her.

Professor Denise is the best professor I have ever had. But her exams are really difficult, mainly focusing on conceptual questions which you will definitely be thrown away by. You will find yourself getting more used to her unique exam style by seeing continuous improvements. she provides many extra credit opportunities in class.
Really good teacher, I found myself paying attention even thought statistics doesn't interest me.

One of the best professors I have ever had.  She truly wants all of her students to succeed.  Although cold calling was scary at first, it definitely helped me to understand the material and come prepared to class.  Would highly recommend taking Professor Spencer because she teaches real-world examples and will prepare you for the exams.

Her tests are hard, her teaching is amazing and interesting. Her worksheets are amazing and prepare you well for the test, put in the work to do all the practice problems and easy A. The reason why I got an A-? I didn't do practice problems for one test and failed. However, her class was the most amazing class I've ever had. She also gives extra pt

She Is really amazing professor, the best professor I've had so far. She genuinely cares for her students and her class is extremely engaging. Her class is a bit hard, but if you're engaging with the class, you'll do well.

Take statistics with Professor Spencer! She is SO ENGAGING! She is funny and can make any topic really interesting. I love her class. And she has the patience of a saint. She uses tons of real life examples and will answer 100 questions to make sure everyone understands before she goes on to the next topic. My favorite professor so far!

I love Prof Spencer. She is funny and patient, and explains things clearly. She really cares about us and wants us to learn. She encourages us to ask questions and make mistakes. Her class is a very safe environment. I would take every class with her if I could.

I wish every professor taught as well as she does. I waited for a year to get into her class and it was worth it. She makes a difficult subject accessible and relatable. She makes everyone participate, so if you want to hide, take another professor!

Really great teacher who genuinely cares about her students! I learned a ton! I was terrified at first, because she cold calls everyone, but I ended up really liking it because she keeps everyone engaged and the time goes by so fast.

reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Svokos provides you good feedback to improve the papers. If you go with her flow of feedback, any students will do great. She makes you to create an outline for paper which is really helpful. She cares for students those who wants to do well and help them to get succeed.

Ok Svetlana, sorry to do this to you girl. She's nice and all and has a nice smile --sometimes she smiles at random things though, a little weird-- but teaching ain't her thing. Her group projects are so difficult and her grading is wack. I mean, my friend and I turned in identicle homework and got different grades :/ ok... Chegg teaches better.
The best professor I have ever had. I learned so much from this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Svetlana is a great teacher! Come to class, do all projects and exams and it's almost a guaranteed A.

Worst professor i've ever had. Often yells at students who ask questions. Grading is very intense and way to over the top for working professionals who have full-time jobs. The content covered is not relevant for real world working. Her lectures are made way more complicated than they need to be. I almost left Northeastern because of this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This is the worst professor I have ever had in my life. Her lectures are EXTREMELY boring and she has no TA's or office hours. She gets REALLY UPSET when you ask her any questions. She humiliates students sometimes if they ask too many questions, or if they have a hard time with SPSS (software we use in class) and need help. I got zero help.

She is tough, but what you would expect for graduate level work. Don't act like a victim and make sure you listen in class. If you are focused and work hard, she is great. She doesn't have time for bull. Bad reviews are most likely from people who can't respect the cultural differences and who don't want to put in the hard/extra work.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She isn't the worst professor you could have, but you don't want her. 6 projects and 3 tests in this class. The projects start out easy and get A LOT harder. Tests on the other hand are pretty hard, but you get a cheat sheet for all of em. YOU CAN PUT ANYTHING ON THEM SHE DOESN'T CHECK*. Homework is easy. You can get an A, but she won't help you.

I would say Professor Todorova is a knowledgeable professor. However, I would not recommend her to any starter of statistics. Her heavy Russian accents pose a big problem for you if you haven't learned anything about stats before. Assignments are CHALLENGING but POSSIBLE to get through if you do your work on class well and go over stuff regularly.

As mentioned before she has a thick accent, but you do get used to it. This is not an easy class, so keep that in mind. There's lots of HW, both individual and group projects dealing with Excel and SPSS. Also, Tests are difficult unless you have a solid grasp of the concepts. It seems like she has improved since the previous comments but not much.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Svetlana is one of the worst professors I've had. She has a thick accent (you get used to it eventually), but her teaching style is awful. Will sometimes get mad at students who don't know what to do, especially with computer programs. Many projects, some in groups. The only upside is she allows cheat sheets on tests. Avoid!

Todorova is a great Statistics professor. Though it is true she has a strong accent, it is by no means hard to understand her. Tests are really easy as long as you do the classwork and multiple choice pre-test. There is a lot of homework but it is easy and important to learn.
dont choose this teacher. worthless teaching method and heavy accent makes the class unnecessarily difficult. She also is never available outside of class: no email replies, no office hours.
Would definitely take her again! One of the coolest professor at neu
One of my best professors. A lot of projects, but they're enjoyable. Her classes are interesting and engaging. I recommended her!
Great teacher really cares about her students. It is hard to get an A but I felt that I learned a lot.
Professor Todorova was one of my favorite teachers I had this semester. Class is easy as long as you go to class. Also she lets you make a cheat sheet. I recommend taking her.

She really won't help if you havent had any stats before. She has a daily thick accent and gets very aggravated when people ask questions. She also goes through the material too quickly. Your best bet is to write everything down and try and learn and understand it afterwards.

She's very nice with pretty Bulgarian accent. Stats may get a bit difficult, but she teaches before we have to do the homework. She covers the material in detail. 3 midterms, 2 individual projects and a final.  The group projects are extremely easy. Pay attention, take notes and you'll get an A.

If you want to take this class then be prepare to translate English to English because you need to re-read the question many time to be able to understand what is she talking about, and sometimes you won't understand it even if you've already read it again and again. Assign project that is not clear, and you haven't learnt about the material before

Most unclear and unhelpful professor I've ever had. Homework, confusing group projects, and individual projects are due almost every week. Professor can be very rude to students who are having trouble understanding material. Do not take this class if you aren't willing to go home and teach yourself 100% of the material by yourself.

Best professor at NEU. She gives a lot of projects that help you to understand Stat. She really wants you to do well. Very strict when it comes to attendance, which is a good thing since it is hard to miss a class without falling behind. Overall she is a teacher with good intentions and I recommend her.
Prof. Todorova  is awesome  She goes over all necessary materials in class and provides a lot of examples. I would highly recommend her to anyone.

You're probably better off self-studying for this class. She goes through all of the problems with limited explanation and not much care for the students' understanding of the concepts. The language barrier makes it difficult to answer questions and communicate the material.  All of the homework each week is graded for accuracy.

Teaches off the slides on her powerpoints, you get just as much out of it by reading the textbook, if not more. Tests are easy if you know the material, she never tries to trick you on anything. It would be helpful if she understoodspoke English better. The language barrier makes it hard to ask questions, as she just is not personable.

Swasey is extremely knowledgeable in this field and will help you if you want to learn. In general, participation is really all that matters. If you find a way to speak in his class once or twice with something valuable he will give you a good score regardless of how you test. You write how you participate on a flashcard and he notes it.

Hardest course I've taken at NEU but also the most rewarding. Rick KNOWS what he teaches and has experience to back it. He moves quickly but genuinely cares. If you actually want to learn and are willing to put in a LOT of hours, then please take him. If you want an easy GPA booster, then avoid. Participation matters (30%). Tbh I recommend Rick.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you like having your grade come down to the midterm and final, take him. Boring lectures, he doesn't use textbooks, and tough grader. He is very knowledgeable in the world of finance, just does not do a good job reiterating his info to students. STAY CLEAR!

The BEST FINANCE PROFESSOR AT NORTHEASTERN! He will make you work for a good grade in his Investment Banking class and makes it clear that participation matters! You learn so much more here than in most finance classes at NEU. If you can participate and are willing to work SUPER hard, take his class (if not, then don't take it -will drop your GPA)

Best professor I've taken at Northeastern. On day 1he will tell you that if you are taking his Investment Banking course, be prepared to put in the hours required from a banker. Class is pretty tough but very very rewarding. The man genuinely cares for everyone and would go out of his way to help you.

Great prof but be prepared to participate. Midterm and final are not too difficult. Many case studies and one should be prepared to give their opinion often so have strong capital markets / corporate finance background.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: His learning technique his much more hands than other classes but I learn best from doing so this was perfect for me. He expects a lot but if you show a genuine effort than he will work with you to make sure you understand the material. He really does care about his students and is one of my favorite professors thus far.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Get ready to teach yourself all the way through this class. Doesn't cover any textbook material in class yet tests and quizzes are based on textbook material. Wouldn't show up to class at all if participation wasn't counted as the lectures are entirely unrelated to anything graded. Easily worst professor I've had the displeasure of having at NEU.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Did not touch textbook all semester. Heavy on case studies and participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Greatest professor I have had at Northeastern. Teaches from the prospective of the real world. Class participation is VERY important. Also, he gives you all the material that is going to be on each exam before you take it so there is no excuse not to do well. If you plan on having a future in finance, there no better professor to take than Swasey.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Overall I really enjoyed this class. Lectures were very relaxed and casual, and prof would often go on tangents. Participation matters in this class so make sure to speak often. He taught a lot of life lessons and course did not really follow textbook, but as long as you study what he talks about in class (take notes) you will do fine on exams.

Professor Swasey is extremely bright and makes every lecture enjoyable. The class structure/grading criteria are vague. However, those who participate regularly and are willing to put in extra work will succeed. You will learn a ton. I highly recommend Professor Swasey; he is the best teacher I've had in my four years at Northeastern (by a mile).

Nice guy, has good anecdotes about the industry. Enjoyed attending class (mandatory).  Tests are hugely unfair in terms of grading.  Even if you know the material extremely well, there's an element of luck to what he includes on the test. Would not have taken the class with him if I had known his approach to mid-terms and finals.

Think he is a good professor. You get a solid knowledge of corporate finance in this class and if you do your stuff and participate, you can also get a good great. Test are not easy, you need to know your stuff and be able to solve problems under time pressure. I would recommend.

One of the hardest classes I've taken at NU. Harsh grader. Poor management of class time, spends a lot of time going off on tangents and giving life lessons. He doesn't teach anything from the textbook so we're on our own for the homework (which is graded weird, hard to do well)  One takeaway is that you will learn a lot about company valuation.

Very funny and entertaining guy. He has been trying to restructure course for MBA students . Class discussion great but not easy for the subject matter. Difficult to absorb and get into at least for me. I screwed up on my quizzes. So I take the blame. Just wish we had more class time not fair to students or professor. NEU needs to Change The TIME.
Exams were not taken from class content but from the book content.

Swasey is tough but if you take his class you will know your stuff.  He is better for the real world than any other finance professor because he covers cases like on the job.  Be ready to participate and get called on without warning. All in all he's a character and a genuine nice guy who is looking to have his students actually learn the material.

Swasey has more first hand experience than any other finance teacher I've had.  Tough grader and expects a lot, but he doesn't just sit there teaching out of the book, he uses cases and excel (used in the real world, you clowns) to show, step by step, how valuations, forecasts, etc are performed.  Awesome guy, must take for Corporate Finance

He is a tough teacher - knows his stuff but if you aren't a finance major or really interested in the subject, not the teacher for you. He is unlike the other teachers - does not test on formulas, just spreadsheets and the thinking behind formulas, so if you don't understand the material 110%, you will not do as well

This guy knows his finance but it is a very hard class. You must participate all the time and he will call you out if you don't speak a lot. He is always willing to explain things which is nice. Also, Some of his tests and quizzes are super easy and others are impossibly hard. Nothing is consistent with this guy.
Amazing professor! He may not not teach exactly what is in the book, but you end up learning a lot!

Uses a diff calculator than everyone else. Grades very hard and exams ar eimpossible. You might as well guess on the multiple choice. He is a funny guy but not alot of learning is done because he is not clear at all.

Prof Swasey has a lot of experience in the finance world. He really drives real world examples in his class and neglects the textbook. This is very frustrating when aplias are due and you have no idea how to do them. His exams usually consist of one large analysis problem and a few multiple choice, but he prepares you for these in class.
Terrific professor who truly cares about his students. Be curious, ask relevant questions, and you will learn a lot.

Personally, I've never been more satisfied with a grade of a B. This guy taught so many great life lessons that I will remember for years to come. He made me try my hardest in this class and even though I still got a B, I was still happy cause of what I learned.

You learn a lot in this class about real world finance.  You really need to understand the concepts to do well.  He gives you the calculations portion of the exam, but asks you conceptual questions.  Look at every number and ask yourself 3 questions..What does it mean?  What happens if it changes?  Why do I need it? ..Overall great professor.

Difficult professor, does not  use the book at all, but still requires you to complete Aplia assignments(all book based).  Places a large portion of grading on attendance and tardiness.  Shows favoritism towards certain students based on non-academic factors.

Probably my favorite teacher that i've had so far. He is very tough and expects a lot from his students. If you don't like getting put on the spot, get used to it. He doesn't let anyone sit in the back and pretend to listen. I would only recommend this class if you are wiling to give some serious effort

Good luck! Extremely funny and very intelligent, but a difficult professor. You will learn a lot, but at the expense of your grade. You will not use the book the entire semester and he only teaches you via cases; do not expect lesson plans or slides. I wouldn't completely recommend since I don't like his teaching style, but you will learn a lot

Swasey is probably the best teacher i have ever had at NU. He knows exactly what he is talking about and really quizes you in class on the topics. Theres a lot of book work and he doesnt curve any of the grades so if you arent willing to work hardi dont recommend taking his class. He is really personable and takes time to get to know his students.

Anyone who says he isn't a good teacher or that he his hard, welcome to college, your here to learn.  Teaching personal values? Great, maybe if more people looked at life like this guy does we would all be better off. By far the best teacher ive ever had and i kick myself for not taking 301 with him, will take another class with him!

Tough class. Professor holds high expectations. Uses realistic examples, addresses real-world issues, and respects constructive student opinions. Certainly experienced. If you're not prepared to work hard at this point in the Finance curriculum, then you're probably not fit to get a B anyway.
Great Teacher!! Puts a lot of onus on the student to learn. You really get out what you put in. Teaches you a lot about personal finance, and truly cares about his students.

very interesting professor but hard on students. during the first half of the semester you have to write a summary of one or two chapters of the book for each class, if you do all of them you'll get to have them with you for the midterm. PARTICIPATE. no final.

Avoid him if you can. Felt more like a personal finance class than a corporate finance class. Poorly utilizes class time, he has used classes many times to teach personal values or something unrelated to finance. He has the worst grading system ever, you will not get a good grade even if you work hard...provides no transparency in grades at all.

Very very difficult class. As a teacher, I didn't learn a lot but as a person, he's a real cool guy and I liked him a lot. I personally didn't learn that much as hard as I worked and you REALLY have to be a finance guru to get anything out of it or else expect to get a B at the best. He considers a B a good grade so expect to work HARD for it!
The best professor in the university by a mile, excellent course activites and teaching methods.

best teacher ive had so far, definately 301 with him. difficult subject but he explains it well and will repeat as much as you need. cares for you to do well and has a good sense of humor. this is the only class i have never skipped in my 2 years here so far

Professor Swasey is one of the few professors I know who takes a valued interest in both the material he teaches, and more so the students he teaches. His classes are engaging and energetic, as is his personality. The class really isn't as hard as everyone says it is, he will give you the questions before the test.

Amazing professor.  Extremely intelligent and cares about his students.  If you have to take finance, take it with swasey for sure.  I wouldn't have made it in this class with any other professor.  I learned so much more than the basic concepts of the course.  Highly recommended!

Easily the hardest/most fulfilling class I've ever taken. His philosophy- "teach the student, not the class." I walked away with an incredible understanding of finance. Very helpful. Completely worth it ONLY if you hope to gain a deep understanding of finance. Otherwise, you will never make it.
he has you do busy work instead of synthesizing material. this can be a big waste of time at moments...

If you want to understand how to valuate companies or really learn corporate finance take this class. If you are not willing to work hard then stay away...it is ALOT of work. He is funny and tell stories in class. Usually picks on students and forces you to answer questions.

One of the toughtest professors at NU.  If you are a slacker or looking for a 'easy' course, STAY AWAY.  Its one of those classes that you truely do not appreciate until AFTER you graduate and enter the workforce, you will be so glad you took his class because he makes you work so hard and truely CHALLENGE your mind.

He teaches based on real life experiences and situations, which can be very beneficial but the hw's are out of the textbook which he doesn't really cover in class. He does move fast, but will always stop for questions. His tests are very fair and in this class you get as much as you put in. If your willing to work and want to learn take his class!

Came into the class very excited with high expectations because i had heard he was great. really didnt like him, he teaches things way to fast and doesnt even gives you time to ask questions. tests long, hard and really make you think. haven't learned much about corporate finance, did learn about personal finance.

Swasey's outlines are time consuming, and his test questions can make you think. But he lets you bring your outlines and notes into the exams. He teaches you to apply knowledge not just regurgitate it. If I could, I would take every finance course with Swasey.
At first I didn't like him, but soon realized he is a very understanding guy. He does give alot of work and his tests are hard but he is a very fair grader.  I learned tons.

Swases an excellent professor. He does not just read out of the book but gives you insight into how decisions will affect the value of companies.  The tools you learn will stay with you through all areas of business.  His tests are tough but help you grasp the subject matter.

Tons of work, although really its just reading the chapters which isnt really thaaaaaaaat hard.  Makes you learn.  Didnt know how to value a company before the class and will now feel confident in a biz situation.  finance majors take his class to be challenged. non finance majors stay away.

Can't speak for him at a grad level but I've had him for two undergraduate level courses and was very impressed. Lots of work, but the bottom line is that YOU LEARN. When I first had him I didn't want to like him but now he is one of my favorites and possibly the best finance prof.

Get ready for a boat load of work! He is a very very hard teacher, alot of work and hard to keep up with but you will learn alot of finance, how to think and how to analyze. Great teacher but an obscene amount of work.

Had him for FIN U314(Mgmt Fin Inst) as well. Best FIN professor @ NEU.He teaches you how to think (vs.just read),analyze,and reason.His tests are hard,tons of work,discussions,but it's productive & worth your $.Great humor & cynicism,too.U'll learn a ton.

I took the first finance class and it was completely hard. He teaches the class as if everyone was a finance major. According to him, he "generally gives out low grades". Helpful if your a finance major. LOADS OF WORK! BEWARE.

Bottom line, Swasey cannot run a classroom well. He preaches learning through discussion, but fails to focus the discussion and fails to challenege students. It's a waste of your time and more importantly, a waste of your $.

He makes you do homework and think in class.  I am an average student & I thought I was honestly going to fail the class by the way students described it to me. If you have a little motivation and are willing to learn then it is honestly not hard at all.
Doesn't give out A's too often. Sets the bar too high.
AMAZING

Good guy, makes lectures interesting but they can get confusing so you need to pay attention. Tests come straight off the homework, as long as you take a look at the assignments before the test you'll have no problem. Highly recommend.

John Swain gets it.  He presents physics in a fun, upbeat way that makes non-physics college students enjoy it.  He's a character and he's lectures are entertaining.  If you try a little bit you'll get an A.  I appreciate physics more bc he didn't shove it down my throat, he made it fun.
Really great instructor. If you study from the problem sets and take good notes you are sure to pass.
Great Professor: kind, understanding, need to know the basics but no trick questions. Makes the material easy to understand. Very fair and promotes real life work like collaboration

My favorite professor I've had so far! He had such enthusiasm and made a lot of things that could have been boring very interesting. He could be a bit confusing at times, but always went back to go over things we weren't clear on. His exams were very fair and easy as long as you study from the problem sets he provided. Awesome guy, learned a lot.

Professor Swain is the best teacher I've had at Northeastern. Ridiculously knowledgeable, hilarious, and very helpful. Lectures go off on tangents but they are always interesting, and if you don't understand something in the lecture he will gladly meet you anytime to help you. Loves the subject and genuinely wants his students to learn and do well.

A really fantastic person who wants his students to not only do well but also enjoy the subject matter. caution: he mixes a very divergent mindset with occasional convergence to the main ideas and some analysis. If you haven't learned where to pay attention and take notes, you will only be catching about half of the information presented in class.

fun guy, class easy to get through, very smart but terrible class if you want to learn physics-had to have someone else teach me the material-he says dont worry about your grade he'll curve but his curve brought my grade down so be careful

Very entertaining professor. He tells great stories and keeps you awake in class for the most part. Unfortunately, his teaching method is not all that effective and the tests can be hard if you didnt understand the material. Gives very generous curves tho.

Halarious guy, it's more of a physics class than astronomy though, His tests are kinda hard, he says he tries to make them easy, but he's kinda off the deep end, He means well and wil help you, and i only went to class like 6 times all semester and did well, plus he's the most entertaining person in the world.

He's zany and spontaneous, like a mad scientist, and usually has good stories, so it's fun to watch. He's not an effective teacher, unfortunately. His lectures are very hard to follow. The tests are pretty tricky, but he gives you a very generous curve. Do not take this course if you want to actually LEARN physics.

He is a nice guy and pretty strange. He says that he doesn't try to trick you but then has tests with a bunch of tricky questions. He wasn't there for either of the review sessions and I felt really unprepared for the tests. Still, a really easy class that you don't really have to go to, and believe me a lot of people skip.

Swain is AMAZING.  he's energetic, fun, and knows what he's talking about.  He's a great teacher, doesn't use notes, tells funny/interesting stories, and you'd have to be a total sped to fail the class.  no homework. attendence isn't manditory, and he gives you take home final/midterms.

He is INSANE (but in a good way)...take his class if you like to laugh.  He throws chalk, electrocutes himself, ad does lots of other crazy things.  He makes class interesting (though he doesn't talk about much astronomy...it's mostly physics).  He doesn't make us do calculations though.  Also, he stops teaching after about 45 minutes of class time

Astronomy.  Great lecture class.  Everyone shows up to class every day because he's such a good teacher.  4 multiple choice tests and throws away the worst.  It is very hard to dose off in this class.  He has so much energy, tells great stories relating to the class, and does fun experiments and stuff.

great prof.way entertaining & really wants u to understand physics from a different perspective than you've probably ever been taught before. he goes a little slow but asks for class feedback on how "slow" he's going.. ppl just let him continue for the most part. he is probably one of the smartest guys ive ever but most impt he wants u to do well.

Haha great guy, it prob **** for class every day, wears black shirts every day cuz he knows hes going to spill coffee on it and doesnt want it to be noticable. Not a particularly great teacher, kinda confusing, but he really wants everyone to do well so he scales everything and basically gives points away.
Great elective, easy class, great teacher, dont even need the book
Swain is a great professor. While the subject was boring, his off-topic ramblings were great. His classes are definately worth taking.
Great teacher. Gets a little side tracked and takes a little time to get used to. You are guaranteed a good laugh every class. Class was definitely worth going to.

Most useless proffessor ever.  Obviously knows a lot, but can't teach for his life. Fortunately, his tests are incredibly easy and he really wants everyone to do well. Funny, goes off on random tangents, but hasnt taught me anything during the whole semester.  If you want an education...dont take Physics with him

Probably the best teacher I've had in college. Enthusiastic and always available. Any guy who has a show on Discovery Canada must at least have some idea of what he's talking about. Different from the mundane professors that NU calls the "rest of the physics department".

this guy was nuts.  astronomy was a lot different than what i thought it would... i dont think he told us once where the planets were.  but he did shock himself a lot.  plus i never went to class and got an a.  just go before exams... and make sure you memorize the practice one... the final was the exact same as the review one.
He is the coolest professor EVER.  He makes everything so easy to learn...and he has to be one of the smartest guys ive ever met.

Professor Swain is an excellent Astronomy professor. He teaches a lot about baxic physics concepts, more than actual astronomy topics, so if you have already taken a physics course, you will be all set. He is very funny and wants all of his students to get A's.
Easy class, went to it about 5 times, gives u a review test with most of the same questions.  Hes a funny crazy guy.  very intelligent

My favorite professor.  Hilarious man who is extremely intelligent.  Doesn't teach you anything you're SUPPOSED to learn, but you learn tons of other useless things.  Reviews for the tests are easy, and it's not hard to get an A.
great guy! wants everybody to get As!!

Professor Swain was my favorite professor this semester.  He is nice, fun, VERY VERY helpful, and a genuinely good teacher.  This class was challenging, but he made what could have been a terrible class very bearable.  He really wants his students to do well, and he makes himself very available.

Good teacher, made boring stuff somewhat interesting.  As a guy he's real nice and does all sorts of interesting stuff all over the world, the only bad part is all this stuff often keeps him from showing up to class.

John Swain is the best professor I've had in all my college experience. He is hilarious, he's good-looking, and he is very smart and a great professor. Any class he teaches, Astronomy or Physics or whatever else, make sure you get Swain!
Great teacher. Knows how to make a boring class fun!! I loved having him!!

Swain knows what he's talking about, and goes out of his way to help you get an A. He's really interesting and funny, but has a habit of going off on ridiculous tangents, and sometimes skips class (even on test days) to go to Switzerland or Argentina.

Professor Swain is the best physics teacher I have ever had.  Plus he is a hotty (for a science teacher).  If you need to take a science elective, make sure you get Prof. Swain.  He will make you laugh.
Prof. Swain is one of the greatest teachers I have ever encountered in my college career.  He is not only a terrific professor, but he is also the most renowned hispanic physicist in the world.
No Comments
made my physics requirement great. very funny guy. pluys he's famous, he works for nasa and has been on the discovery channel in canada about 30 times.  his experiments are great.
Made my least fave subject physics fun.  Interesting lectures and demonstrations
Terrible professor who could not communicate the course material properly. Luckily for ME430 you just need to do the CAD assignments to pass and the tutorial is given online

Moon is the man. I learned so much in his computer aided design class. He assigns a lot of HW but gives clear guidelines. Does not grade ruthlessly like other professors and gives you extra time if needed. Ive never learned so much in a class in my life. I went from knowing zero CAD to being about to create mechanisms from a quick glimpse.
one of the best professors I have had!
He is very young, but he does know his stuff and presents it clearly. Very approachable and shows genuine concern for students.
Take him, you won't regret it.

I wrote his first review and have since had him again. The extra semester of teaching experience seems to have helped him become a much better professor. His lectures are easier to follow, he explains material better, and his course is actually a challenge instead of an easy A where I didn't actually learn.
I had him for Statics, he is overall a good teacher and knows the material. Everything on the exams is clearly gone over in class. Test and grades are very fair.

I had a difficult time understanding the concepts because he was not clear when teaching the material. He would go very fast without giving much explanation and would not repeat himself. If anyone asked him a question, he would say, "I already taught you that." I went to office hours and he wasn't any more helpful there. Would recommend avoiding.

Prof. Moon is a very good person. He is eager to help students, and more than willing to go the extra mile. He clearly cared a lot about this course, and that was appreciated. I enjoyed his teaching style and found him very effective.
He is a nice guy and has a firm grasp of the material. He is also very accessible for help outside of the class.
Did his best to make a very dry  subject understandable and interesting.
He is available for help outside of class. I was having trouble to keep up with the class initially and he was always willing to help me out.
Good professor. Teaches clearly and covers everything you need for the tests.

Very unclear lectures with tons of mistakes in example problems. Would recommend avoiding if possible. It was his first year so he may improve. Also the class is a joke. I learned almost nothing that wasn't covered in physics 1. Easy A though.

This was his first time ever teaching. He is very young and means well. Unfortunately he is very boring, not clear in his explanations, and makes a lot of mistakes while demonstrating concepts in class.

Andre Switala is very knowledgable! He knows a lot about the subject and is more than willing to answer any questions you may have. With that being said he is a very tough grader and his tests require you to put the work in. If you are one of those people who like to slack on the studying I would not recommend taking his class.

Switala is definitely a dedicated instructor and a knowledgible macro-economist, though a harsh grader from some students' perspective. if u seriously take his lectures, u'll find them helpful. Besides,he's willingto provide with extra info.about things he's teaching.those who complained should study harder than accusing him of being harsh ongrade

Andre is a terribly boring teacher.  His tests are extremely difficult because they are 10-15 multiple choice then 2-3 open response worth 30ish points each and he gives very little partial credit on the open response. Only reason to take this class is if you feel like going to 3 classes for tests and teaching yourself the material because he wont.

Andre is rigid academician, while a good instructor and a nice person to communicate with.From the way he teaches, you'll learn to work hard to earn grades and to think like an economist. Besides he's pretty dedicated, providing with all materials students may need, like sample exams, online problem solving. good professor!

Professor Switala is a knowledgable, smart, cool and really responsible instructor. Well prepared prior to each class;expressive in analyzing and explaining economic problems. He makes himself all time available during his office hour and is committed to answering students' question. Exams r not that hard, as long as you pay attention to his lectur

AVOID SWITALA FOR MACRO! his exams are extremely difficult, and the lectures  are very boring. He is a very smart guy, but a veryyy hard teacher. He says that he curves everything at the end, but trust me, he really doesnt. this class killed my gpa.

Cool guy, very knowledgeable.  That said, his tests are extremely hard and that's really the only grade.  His grammar isn't that great but you could do much worse in the economics department in terms of english proficiency.  Take if you want a class where you only show up for tests, don't take if you're bad at tests.

Switala is a decent professor, it's nice that he doesn't care about attendance because his classes aren't that helpful. As long as you do the reading each week it shouldn't be too bad. His midterms and finals are very difficult though and he scales them. During class his lectures are very dry, as is economics though.
Great teacher, knows his stuff when it comes to singing. Definitely recommend. Put some work into learning your pieces and you get an A. So simple.
SUPERB teacher!

Not a difficult class / professor, however studying sources outside of the class is crucial. Watch youtube lectures. Was late often, unsure if attendance was actually mandatory, still unsure

You will be spending 15+ in office hours weekly, hope that your TAs can help if not too bad. He delayed our midterm because he was 20+ minutes late to class giving five minutes heads up. His grading system is horrific, he enjoys hiding things in the syllabus that can make or break your grade and never elaborating it. Please take any other course.

The professor shows up late, 10+ minutes after the first week is over. Never really explains anything, and reads off the slides. Full of empty promises and tells students that tests are similar to hw, but in actuality have very little in common with the hw. Writing emails to him is like trying to reach customer support on Steam: takes days to reply

Chill professor, a bit hard to understand at times and not all of the content covered in the lectures is needed for you to be successful in the labs. As long as you understand the lab content you'll be fine for the midterm/final.

I cannot even begin to fathom what the hiring committee was smoking when they decided to have Shazli teach robotics. He does not teach. Not a good prof, speaks with an accent so sometimes hard to understand
for the most part he reads off slides and adds a little info of his own, not great for an intro level course however

reviews.comment: Doesn't give us any homework and then gives us quizzes. Literally no structure to this class and is taught super poorly.

This class genuinely doesn't make sense. We have no homework assigned to us, but we have quizzes and a final? I've never taken an engineering class which assess students without giving them any practice. The only study material we have is the presentations which are unclear and do not have nearly enough practice.

Prof. Shazli was exceptionally disorganized on Canvas. His lectures were dry and hard to follow. The labs we did were not the same ones that other sections of the class did, and they had almost no instructions. The TAs were not given any more resources so they were basically useless meaning you had to rely on classmates for help. Do not recommend.

Professor Moattari is definitely one of my favorite professors! He is super funny, passionate about the course, and wants everyone to do well. There are a few kind of boring assignments but overall the class is very easy to get a good grade in. The tests are also super similar to the study guide he gives so as long as you do them you will do well!
Great guy, very enthusiastic, fun to listen to in class. Relatively low workload, and study guides are very clear.

Professor Moattari is one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern. He cares about his work and his students and wants to challenge you to learn. His class is inspirational and knowledgeable and worth the amount of work you put in for how much you get out of it.

the course is a lot of work, graded by a good amount of assignments, but he is a pretty fair grader. there are three papers, one presentation, a debate, and two times where you lead discussions, so be prepared to talk. but hes so cute i love him!!!!!!

Class was mostly discussion-based and not lecture-heavy, which was nice. The grading criteria were not clear, especially since I got points deducted for things not included in the rubric. Seems like a nice guy who is passionate about the subject, but comes off blunt at times.

A fantastic professor, and great person. Always there to help. Don't buy the book, you won't use it at all. Too bad he's leaving after Spring of 2013. This is your last chance to have him, make sure you take his class. I wouldn't be able to imagine taking this course with other professors, it would be way too boring.

Awesome guy with very dry, almost cynical, humor. Sometimes people don't pick up on it which makes it awkward. He's not always entirely clear but will be quick to help out. He's an easier grader than average. Can definitely recommend him.
he's awesome, definitely take his intro to marketing class!
Swain is a good guy.  The material is soooo boring but he does a decent job making it bearable.  If you don;t like Swain you're probably a terible person.

WE LOVED RESEARCH! AND SWAIN! The stuff is hard to say the least but he is very entertaining and caring. Whoever said it was boring must be a miserable hater who is failing. The last month we worked in class on our project - very helpful.

MOST BORING CLASS EVER. most boring professor ever... this class was absolutely painful... i would not recommend it to anyone except that it is a requirement for marketing majors . professor swain is SO boring its painful. he is also so wordy... the whole course could be taught in a lesson and he takes a whole semester. AWFUL

I enjoyed his class. I had a lot of work experience coming in and it was easy to tell that this is one of those guys that "gets it." He skips the fluff and gets right to the tools that you can actually use.

I love P. Swain.  My favorite professor in SMG. He makes a really boring subject interesting.  He is really light hearted and easily approachable.  If you can take his class, I highly recommend it. I love him.

He covers a lot of material, but he provides enough examples to make it understandable and interesting. I learned sooo much in this class and would love to take another Swain class. Very helpful 1 on 1. The book is alright (not great). Excellent overall.
what can be said...entertaining, offbeat, and you learn more than the law allows. lecture notes are keepers. gold star for swain.

Swain was extremely organized and presented /"difficult/" material in a user-friendly manner. This course has already helped me make better marketing decisions at my company. Excellent Professor, excellent course!

Best prof I/'ve had at SMG, and that/'s saying a lot. Awesome. Makes the brain hurt, but in a good way. Great sense of humor, if you pay attention. There are classes set aside for practice; omg the exams are hard!

Pr swain is the man! Cares a lot about the class. Material is hard, but its the real deal -wish it was required b4 core. He's VERY good at responding to emails and helping after class. Some real boneheads in class (what's new in MK?), ask same questions over and over...Swain has patience of Job. Wish there was another class.

Swain thinks hes very fun but he's very dull.  He doesn't teach you anything rather starts to quietly lecture to you about mathematical concepts that he assumes you know but never takes the time to explain.  He will teach you in his office hours but if you want to learn something in class goodluck cuz he'll just go off on a tagent about submarines

Nice guy but I did not like this class. Not only was the material bad enough but he didn't teach very well. He kept going off in tangents in every single class. At one point he started talking about his diarrhea and the class had to tell him to stop! If only his tests were as "laid back" as he was, but they're tough and u gotta know ur stuff!
awesome professor

This class teaches how to use data and statistical tools to backup of your BS.

great teacher, material is what makes class dull but this professor makes it as enjoyable as it possibly can be.. very compassionate and really cares for his students and how they perform.. always available for help.. truly a great person and professor
Really tries to make his classes amusing.  The problem is that the material is just horrid!
Lots of weird stories to explain the concepts. Knows how to relate to students.
