reviews.comment: Awesome as a Person :)
Great prof and a great course to take

From my opinion, he is one of the best Prof. in the CS department. I took his CS6140(machine learning), and will be his TA for CS5800(algorithms). He can explain very complex and difficult concepts clearly, in a human language.  Homework is tough, you have to implement very thing on your own. If you don't want waste your money, go to him.
Alg. & D.S. was easy enough if you've programmed before, but be prepared for work if you haven't. He does seem to explain the subject well, however.
Taught very well, but his grading methods are a bit harsh and also his exams have no time limit, i.e. you can sit in the classroom anywhere from 1 hr to 10 hrs.
Good
He is good

Great professor, perfect balance of learning and grading. I got lots of opportunities to practice what I learned with modern tech stacks, fair grading standards. I learned systematically about full stack web development with essential skills for nowadays SDE, I got interviews after took this course.

He just reads the PPT and shows no enthusiasm in classes. There is no difference if you just learn it yourself on Youtube. 
He used to give easy grades to students but NOW everything just changed. His Quizs and Exams become difficult and hard to achieve grades.

Course was a letdown. The midterm was packed with way too many MCQs, impossible to finish in time. The TA's grading is super harsh. Attendance is mandatory, so you have to show up even though lectures don't help much with the exams. If you care about your GPA, time, or tuition, I'd strongly recommend avoiding this class.

Everything changes in 2025, it is the most horrible and hard course I‘ve taken. You need 6-8hours for weekly assignment, midterm and quizes' mean are always lower than 70%. What makes it better? in final week, here is a project and final exam waiting for you. Class attending is required, but here is no credits for it.

His ux class is good!
CSYE 7280

I thoroughly enjoyed my time in the course as it provided ample opportunities for me to enhance my knowledge base. The class activities were instrumental in laying a strong foundation for me. The professor's provision of supplementary sources and articles served as invaluable resources for deepening my understanding of the subject matter.

I had a wonderful time during the course. There were a number of class activities which helped build my foundation. The professor would share additional sources and articles which helped me build a deeper understanding.

Classes are pretty straight forward. Its little hard to for beginners, but eventually one can built a career out of this course. Professor covers all the front end related topics that are currently used in the industry and keeps updating the course syllabus for every two semesters.
Very good

Easy grader. You will get an A without any effort. The TA's handle the class and the lab. The professor teaches word to word from tutorialspoint  (reads the slides). If you want to learn something, don't take this course. Or take the course and get an easy A :)
soooo much writing and reading
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: took history of information, shes a great inspiring voice and obviously very smart. only thing is that her class is tough and dense, and sometimes it feels a little overwhelming, and that she doesn't reply back to emails super quick. other than that, she is a great teacher. super engaged with the work she does, witty and very funny too

I took her graduate Museums and Exhibits course (not the course I marked), and it was certainly challenging, with a significant workload, but she is an engaging and supportive professor. She is excellent at teaching, assigns relevant readings, and asks for and implements feedback. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Definitely a "you get out of it what you put into it" class! There is a lot of reading (~150 pages/week) and writing (~500-1k words/week) for the class. Dr. Cain is super passionate and engaging when she lectures-- she clearly cares about her students. She gives great feedback on papers. Go to office hours for help if you're lost or behind!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Cain is awesome. Its a lot of work but she works just as hard. I learned more in 2 classes with her than almost all of my classes at northeastern. If you're a history major or minor definitely take her class. If you're any other major consider it as an elective. If you want to learn and work hard this class is worth it.
The lectures were incredibly interesting and engaging. The readings were a bit long and there were papers and quizzes after each module (approx 1 per month) but it wasn't too bad.

I'm an engineering major and I was dreading having to take a history class to fulfill NUpath, but Professor Cain totally changed how I felt about the class. She was so engaging and her lectures were memorable. The reading can be quite heavy. Papers were kind of annoying each week but didn't take long to write(600 words).

Easily the best professor I've had at Northeastern. She's smart and engaging, and the lectures are incredibly interesting. The weekly readings and assignments are long, so you need to work hard to succeed, but you'll learn a ton. A lot of class participation, but she really gets to know her students and leads good discussions. Great TAs as well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. One of the best, by far. She covers a lot of material but is fair in her grading and clear. She knows her history, wants you to learn, but you need to put in the work. Shout out to her TAs as well--always willing to help. Excellent class, interesting material, and fantastic professor.
Awesome lady. Loves her material and is very knowledgable and enthusiastic on it. She's engaging and captivating, encouraging class discussion which helps you retain material really well.

I wasn't expecting to have a discussion and group project heavy class on latin america culture so I really didn't like this class. He also assigns at-least 5 hour long documentaries that are truly difficult to understand and pages of readings a week which classes are only based on. Not worth it if you are truly interested in latin culture.
Such a great and funny guy. He's very understanding and basically gives you an A as long as you show up to class.
Amazing class and professor, if you need to take this class/ a class with Prof, do it with no hesitation!

Prof. Voionmaa is the epitome of a laidback prof. Show up to class to get a least an A-, and participate twice to get an A. He just wants his students to show interest in the material. Super easy grader, too.

If you do all of the discussion posts and diary entries, and it is clear you put effort in you will get an A! This professor truly cares. He also wants you to give your true opinion on films without trying to be "correct" which I really appreciate.

Hands down one of my favorite professors - I loved that the entire class was in Spanish and without being rude or annoying about it, he really enforced Spanish speaking only. We read a lot of cool pieces in this class and also got to work on cool projects. 100% take this class if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great professor, very nice class, go to 80% of class, do your homework (not much) and you will get an A!

This class is an easy A. 5 quizzes, only 3 count. I got a 100 on the first 3, so I didn't have to pay attention in class after that. Midterm and final are essays, and he is a very easy grader. He is really nice, and the class is somewhat interesting, plus it fulfills an NU Core requirement, so you should take this class!
A great, easy class. He has enormous passion towards what his teaching and I absolutely enjoyed his class. Would recommend to anyone, but you should be interested in it as well.
Prof Vido has explained the topics with ease. Also very funny professor

I took CS 5004 with Prof Vido last summer. He is the best CS professor I have ever had. I liked how he teaches by example and tries to engage the class with what he is teaching. He is funny, very caring, and kind professor.
I will defiantly take any class he is teaching.
Professor Vidoje was one of the best CS teachers I ever had. If you plan on taking OOD, GET THIS MAN! OOD is a very hard class in itself. However, Professor Vidoje makes learning OOD concepts easier.

CS 5010 was a hard class but Prof Vido made it great! I heard Dr. Shesh was the standard teacher for this class so I was afraid Prof Vido wouldn't do a good job, but he did fantastic and was very knowledgeable. Made the constant bombardment of assignments from PDP manageable. Make sure to attend all his lectures, they're very useful!

fundies 2, my bad scores are just me bombing exams still passed though, he's a very nice guy who sometimes seemed irritated with students but that happens to everyone in the fundies course as it approaches the end. I honestly don't really think it matters who you pick professor since its all the same classroom but he's the best for advice I hear
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Fundies 2 is tuff! Very big leap from Fundies 1. There are a few games and some very complicated homeworks that will take a while. Exams are difficult, but that's just because all coding under a time constraint is stressful.

A great professor for those who have trouble paying attention in lectures, Vidoje is able to keep you engaged while also thoroughly explaining code. He does well to explore the process of problem-solving in code along with us and makes the students feel involved, and his fun demeanor while going through the process really helps to engage the class.

Vido is an amazing professor: he's an engaging lecturer and is super funny. My issue with Vido is more so because of how he and the other profs manage CS2510 rather than his lectures themselves. CS2510 is a lot of work b/c of how HWs are graded and the flipped classroom model, but Vido himself does a great job of conveying the material.

Such a great professor. OOD is such a heavy class in terms of workload and difficulties, but Vidoje always keeps lectures as light and engaging as possible and always shows the real life applications of the material. Vidoje is a super understanding and very accessible professor. One of the few professors that actually have a sense of humor!
vido is the sweetest ever. if you're struggling he will genuinely do whatever he can to help. and he's funny too - lectures were actually entertaining, even at 8 am. can't recommend him enough.

Vido is an amazing professor! He's very caring and takes time to ensure everyone is understanding the material well. He can occasionally trip himself up, but he's very funny and detailed in his teaching. Definitely the best choice for fundies 2. Also very understanding of circumstances and willing to work with students.
Vidoje is the goat. He's super funny, really caring and inspirational (tells his students a lot about his personal experience in the CS field), and is a great teacher. 10/10 would take again
You can tell that this professor really cares about his students doing well. He makes his lectures really interesting and easy to understand even if the stuff we were learning could be difficult.
Vido is an amazing professor and probably one of the best teachers I've ever had. He is very patient, and approachable, and you would be lucky to get a class taught by him.

Vido's lectures and lecture notes/videos are awesome, but you will have to do some experimenting to figure stuff out. Fundies is very partner oriented so the speed in which you do HW is all about you and your partner, but he gives you all the tools to do it. The dad jokes are a good break from the heavy CS subjects. Can't go wrong with Vido
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great professor for a challenging class!
I loved VIdo so much. He honestly cares so much and made me want to care about a summer online class. He actually felt like a real person and interacted with us as equals. 10/10 would recommend

Great professor. Couldn't have asked for someone better. He really cares about his students and creates an awesome learning environment. One of the things he does best is explain applications to real world coding.
Vido is an amazing professor--He made the homeworks so much more understandable and was very helpful in lecture and outside of class. He is also a really funny anc chill guy!
Vido codes along in lecture which is a big plus, he gives really good tips about the homework and explains content well. Would definitely take him again over other professors for this class.
Vido was a great professor. Had him for Object Oriented Design, which is already a very difficult course, but he made it bearable.

One of the best CS profs at Northeastern. His lectures are understandable and easy to pay attention to, and he teaches exactly what we need to know without making it overly complicated. He's also very funny and nice, and he offered extra office hours to his students during a particularly hard assignment once.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Vidoje is the best professor I've ever had. He clearly wants everyone to understand the concepts well, and he has a great sense of humor

I had Vido for OOD (CS3500) this semester which I attended partly online and in person. Unlike my experience with other CS professors, the content in his lectures actually helped a lot on the homeworks. He is a very straightforward lecturer and breaks things down so they are super easy to understand. Also he has a fun personality to keep me engaged

Very good professor who knows what he's talking about. Content might not come naturally to everyone, but Vido and the TAs will help you get a 100 on assignments if you do your work and ask questions. Very entertaining guy and a fun class when it could be brutal with another professor.
Good professor just rushes through everything but you'll learn more from him than another professor. Take him to get an A, or get as close to an A as possible.

He is a good presenter. He seems to want everyone get A so that he loose the grading and deadline very often. He also skip loads of good content in lecture on website to make the lecture easy. He sometime even goes through prototype of the homework answer in class. But everyone is happy because of that.
This is a great introductory class. Not super hard and very willing to help you if you don't understand.

Vido is a professor who cares that you learn and understand the material and will take time to explain a concept. The lectures are 3 hours long and he does what he can to be entertaining and bring real world details into the lecture material. He's funny, cares about his students, and grounds the material in examples you will utilize at future job.
Vido is a great guy. You can tell he cares for the students. He also tries his best to make the lectures entertaining and doesn't just stand up and talk.

You won't get many java skills from the lecture because it is more about design pattern. Vido is good at keeping the materials interesting. The grading was largely depending on homework. Make sure you understand what you are supposed to do. Test your code thoroughly because the self-eval was killing.

Vido does a great job of explaining complex topics very simply. If you're confused about anything just reach out to him via email and he will make time for you, and alternatively ask him questions in class and he will do a fine job of answering them.

Hes a great professor! When I needed help he was patient and spent a lot of time helping me. Class is not hard, show up and keep up with the work and its an easy A. 2 big tests that are 60% of grade (which you can redo once). Homework is easy and 14%, 2 take home tests, and a few quizzes that you can complete till the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests? Not many--Would take again

reviews.comment: You will not be taught in this course, and you will not always be graded fairly.  She takes points off, even if your answers match hers, with no explanation and zero feedback.  It's just random.  She also does not release exam results, so you will never know what questions you missed, meaning you never know what concepts you need to work on.
A lot of reading and very little teaching
Doesn't give good instructions on assignments. Text doesn't align with assignments. Doesn't help clarify issues, problems or questions. If you can, take this class with another Professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Super nice guy and enjoys what he is teaching. Very passionate. The material is really difficult though if you have never been exposed to so many analytical techniques. Exams are so hard. Take this only if it is required.
Great teacher

Really nice professor but blows through examples with almost no explanation of the core concepts. Very helpful during office hours but lectures are very tough to follow. Even for a full semester class I felt like the pace was way too fast. I'd recommend him as a tutor for this class if you have extra questions but not the teaching professor.

Honestly if you don't like this professor and you think he's as awful as some of these people think you really don't belong in college.  It's the truth, he is the most helpful and caring teacher Northeastern has! His tests do challenge you to think but if you prepare for them and do the practice problems you should be able to get an A.  JUST TRY!!!
The reason I changed majors
always willing to help but you need to take the initiative. really teaches students how to think for themself and really understand a problem. one of the nicest prof. at northeastern

Vouros was a very nice guy. However, in my opinion he was a very poor teacher. I did not benifit from his teaching style but that is not to say others will not. I just don't find that doing problems without engaging the students is helpful. Oh yea, and the snort has got to go...
not a great class, very boring. The tests are only easy if you go to his reviews, if you don't, they are impossible. Studying teh book does not help

Vouros is such a great guy. He is a bit difficult to understand at first because of his accent, but his willingness to help students overcomes that barrier. Go to extra review sessions and speak with him every chance you get. GREAT GREAT GUY!!

Best genetics professor at Northeastern! Unlimited attempts on homework so you'll always do well, and exam questions are really similar to the homework as well. He records all his lectures and gives hints to exam answers in class. Also does a lot of practice problems in class. Overall he's super chill and really wants his students to do well!

I would highly, highly recommend taking genetics and molecular biology with Dr. Vollmer! His expectations are very clear and he is super organized. If you pay attention in class and do the homework (unlimited attempts) you will do great! He does not try to trick you on exams and even drops some hints in the lectures. He is very kind and funny.

Prof. V moves very fast and his lectures can be confusing, but his section is much easier than other genetics sections. No final paper, 90% is an A, quizzes with unlimited attempts are worth 1/4 of your grade, and exams are straightforward. All lectures are on Zoom and recorded, but you can get by with just reading the slides.
aweful

My favorite class at NU! Learned a lot, but the class felt difficult due to the amount of in-depth material. There were four 50-60 MC question exams (lockdown browser) and hw quizzes on each chapter. Lectures were recorded, but don't miss out because he will point out exam questions. Great class, great professor, just don't fall behind on material!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His class is very much lecture-based. He also has problemsets which can be frustrating but relate almost directly to the exam. It can be dull at times if you don't find the topic interesting. But, he lectures understandably and gives opportunities to discuss confusion or Qs with him or his TAs outside of class. 90%+ is an A which is very attainable

He's an okay professor. Goes through 60 slides way too quickly and barely explains. Tests are pretty similar to problem sets and he's pretty clear about what is on the test during lecture, but do not miss lectures or it's pretty easy to fall behind. TA's were most helpful, but he was horrible at explaining things and would not clarify or slow down
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I liked Professor Vollmer! He was really nice - just go to class and do the problem sets and you'll do well on the exams. Lectures are important to go to because he makes it obvious what he's most interested in and what he'll test you on the most. Sometimes it can feel dull like he's just reading off slides, but overall I liked the class.

Professor Vollmer definitely listened to the feedback of this previous semesters. The class is now graded on in class mc 4 exams and problems for each lecture. Each 20%. The exams were quite literally questions stolen from the problem sets. It was pretty lecture heavy though and he talks really fast. Not the best, but prob best genetics prof at neu

Graded on only 4 tests and cannot go back on Q's. Have to study for days in advance for these tests. However, a 90 is an A and one of the tests gets counted twice. You have to know everything on the slideshows so I would recommend quizlets. He, from what I've heard, the best genetics prof at NEU so even if he isn't the best, I would still take.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: oy vey. prepare to study hours outside of class. grade made up of 4 ~60 MC, online, lockdown browser, timed tests where you cant go back to previous Qs. vollmer is loyal to his teaching strategies... he provides a lot of materials online. lectures are dense (40-60 slides) and you are expected to know evrythng. talks fast, uses advanced terminology
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is the worst professor I've had here. He just reads off the slides and goes through 50 in one class period and will still let us out 10 minutes early because he doesn't explain anything. He is so condescending and doesn't tell you the correct things to study for the exams. Only graded on 4 lockdown browser exams and can't go back on questions.

One of my favorite professors at NEU! Very accommodating to the pandemic by double counting our best exam score. Extremely smart and knows what he's talking about. Sometimes he can talk very quickly during lectures but I did'nt see this as a real issue. Tells you what a good amount of the questions on the exam are going to be, verbatim.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Grade was solely based on 4 exams, but he literally tells you what half the questions are going to be before the exam. Also puts up practice quizzes that are DIRECTLY correlated with exam. Not the most enthusiastic, but is more than adequate in terms of making it not too hard to get an A. He also counts an A as a 90, not 93/94.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: 4 midterms on the most insignificant facts, so memorize every little detail. For online exams, we have to use a lockdown browser where we can't double-check our answers. He breezes over core concepts in to talk about his coral research and reads off the powerpoint directly. Type of class where you teach yourself the material with practice problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Nice guy. I felt comfortable going to his OH & asking questions. Assigns too many practice problems from the book (MUST DO to do well on test). It felt overwhelming. The lecture before a test he'd give away specific things that'd be on the test(record those lectures bcuz he says them quickly). Tests were MC but still difficult. No grade scaling.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class is really interesting and the textbook is a necessity. The worst part of the class is Vollmer. He seems uninterested in the material and is belittling. He acts like the class isn't worth his time, and the students should worship the ground he walks on. You have to work really hard in this class, and his attitude doesn't motivate students.

Vollmer definitely knows his stuff, but IMO he wasn't very clear in lectures. He went kinda fast in his presentations, and his tests are much harder than they should be. You'll definitely have to work for it, but I studied pretty crazily for this class and ended up with only a mediocre grade. Maybe I was missing something, but I'm glad I'm finished

Overall a good class. Powerpoints are very clear and easy to follow. The tests were manageable as long as you knew all of the material on the slides and worked some problems from the book. Vollmer is a cool guy he's not out to trick you on tests just read carefully.

Extremely clear and helpful with course material even though he works out of the Nahant Marine Bio facility so office hours can be random. Provdes some examples in lecture which keeps interest up. Personally I didn't do as well as I would've liked in this class but that's entirely my fault; Vollmer gives you the opportunity to learn and do well

Super nice guy, helps you out if you need it, and is very clear. Course material is hard, but he presents in a clear manner. Final is cut and paste from prior exams. He dropped the lowest exam grade for us. Also doesn't believe in A-, so anything above a 90 is an A.

Really nice guy, doesn't mess with you.  It's a hard subject so it is a hard class but it's totally manageable if you read the textbook and just do your work.  He's a nice grader, and when I took it he dropped the lowest exam grade (there were four) and the final was taken DIRECTLY (as in VERBATIM) from the first exams.

Good guy. Makes the class very accommodating for all students, yet throughout the semester averages were low. Basically if you slack off, you will not do well. If you do the assigned problems and read the book, you will do great. Pick this guy's brain about genetic alteration, and other modern issues, he is a great resource.

I've had two other professors in the bio department and he's the best so far. I have him for Genetics (BIO301). He doesn't bust your chops. He uses slides so everything is pretty straight foward but you still have to read the book for clarity. It seems like he's a new professor. His tests are pretty thorough but he's always available after class and during office hours (twice a week). Plus he's pretty young and cute for a professor ;)

Volaitis was fairly disorganized for this cognition course and constantly switched her train of thought mid-sentence making her lectures nearly incomprehensible. She will ALWAYS drop 2-9 questions off each exam because they questions are terribly ambiguous (this is the reason I did well). Take Cognition with another professor and learn something.

took psycholinguistic course and seminar with her and she is a great professor. i learned alot from her classes. she is very willing to provide help. i did not have trouble getting As from her courses. just go to your classes and study for your exams and you will be fine.
She's a sweetie.  Not the most incredibly interesting but it's easy to do well and she really does cover a lot of important stuff for the Linguistics major.

Very nice woman. Her lectures are Powerpoints which she puts on Blackboard. If you skim through the book to clarify, you're fine. A little boring, but she takes attendance randomly, so you might as well go. Her tests are pretty easy, very little homework.

Decent professor. She takes attendance randomly so if you want those points, show up. Make sure you read the book because nearly all of her powerpoints, which she posts on Blackboard, are directly from there. Exams are pretty straightforward and there is little homework. Pretty average class.
Very unorganized.  Boring lectures.  Relatively easy tests/assignments.  Takes attendence.

Art students who needs a science requirement, DONT take this class. Despite being a senior researcher at Harvard Smithsonian, this professor's extremely incompetent, cannot lecture at all, gets almost ALL inclass equations wrong, and never puts anything she teaches in class on the test. She would rather spend time singing astronomy songs than teach

not a fun class at all. boring lectures everyday and then hard tests. dont use the book, only grades based off of 3 tests and 3 quizzes. not a good class to take, learned almost nothing about astronomy.

The class could be a lot harder than it actually is. You can afford to miss a few classes and be okay. Take notes on the PPs and textbook for all the tests. Grading scale is curved and you can drop the lowest grade. Although Vrtilek isn't a very good professor, she's very knowledgeable about astro, but cannot communicate it very well.

Horrible. She is completely useless, doesn't respond to e-mails, and does not know how to teach a class AT ALL. The "textbook" was pointless and she didn't even use it ever. Honestly, do not take her class. She does not let students make up tests and does not know how to teach a well structured class. Get out while you can!!

do NOT take her class unless you absolutley have to. there must be easier science classes out there that will fill the NU core if you're in a major outside of physics. she's a nice woman, but my god, she cannot teach students who aren't harvard-level (her e-mail is at harvard). oh, and the textbook is only 80 pages, so have fun trying to learn it y

Terrible.  Terrible.  Terrible.  Don't bother.  People actually left class during it because it was so useless to be there.  But if you like science songs, i guess you might enjoy it.  Please don't put yourself through it.

More work than grad school. 600 page readings weekly.  Weekly Quiz answers are rediculously similar and impossible to ace.  Weekly Discussion criteria impossible to meet.  Grades harder than any professor I've seen.  200 level class harder than grad level classes.  Run far away from this class.  He sucks the fun from an interesting class

Absolutey great professor!...wish he would come back and teach here at NU...i gotta admit, his lectures were a bit boring, but class activities were fun and his tests weren't that bad. Social movements rock!!!;)
Stanislav is a really sweet dude, and I'm glad I got to have him as a professor, and I wish he would come back to boston and visit.
Stas is definitely one of my favorite NU professors. It's too bad that he's gone because I would of loved to take more classes with him. Such a great guy.

stas is one of the best professors in the sociology deptartment at NU.  he is extremely knowledgeable. his lectures are informative, interesting, and usually pretty funny.  he is understanding and helpful with assignments.  awesome dude all around. boston will miss him.
Really fun class!  Stas is great, he tells stories and most of his lectures are really interesting.  He's a Russian punk rocker with a star of David tattoo around his elbow--awesome.
great professor and knows his stuff. one of the better classes i've taken here at NU
Certain classes of his can be tough.  I thought he was interesting and one of the better teachers here at neu.
stas is an overall nice guy but can often say things that are offensive without meaning to.  some interesting classes, some not so much.

He was a really great professor- as long as you go to class and take notes, his tests are so easy...not a hard grader and is a nice guy overall- helpful if you go to office hours and is simpathetic about grading

This class is cool, but I thought it would be better.  Classes are hit or miss by each day. Either it is really interesting or it is just plain boring.  Stas is good at what he does, but likes to put down socialogy majors which is kind of disheartening even though i am not one.

Anyone who knows punk rock knows this guy is a poseur. He's prestentious as well as arrogant. Makes many generalized statements. Furthermore, his multiple choice tests don't test you on the material but on your sociological background.

I have had Stas for 4 different classes unintentionally but have learned a considerable amount from all.(Soc Theory,Problems,Psychology and Violence)He is good at mixing his material with personal stories and tries to make it as interesting as he can but does not accomplish his goal all of the time.
Young,interesting knows his social problems, kind of a tough grader beacuse hes trying to prove himself as an instructor. Good class. dont regret taking it at all.
He is a really cool professor, just be ready to talk, he will sit there in silence until someone answers the question he asked.  Not an easy class, but really interesting.
how many many other professors have crass tattoos?  this guy rocks and really has an amazing grasp of social theory, very interesting class but not easy.

This guy is probably my favorite teacher this semester.  He's a young punk rocker activist, which definately makes the class pretty cool. I think his lectures are interesting, and he really seems to know his stuff and how to explain it to the class well.
Pretty cool, young, punk rocker teacher.  You need to pay attention to everything he says in class.  Classes are very long and boring.
this guy is an idiot, TA on a power trip, not only is he an annoying dork but he tests u on **** he doesnt explain and soooo much reading
He's A big dork but a pretty easy teacher. Assigns book but you don't actually have to do the readings, classes are pretty interesting.
beautiful slides; too much information
subtle humor

good stuff

Difficult material but lenient grading.

I stopped going to class because she read verbatim from the powerpoints she made (available to download online), of which half of the slides were occupied by pictures of galaxies and other things that you can just as easily find on google images.  This was not my major, but I was excited to take this class.. she skips around from thought to thought

I stopped going to class because I could learn more just looking at her power point presentation online.  She might actually know something but can't do Her own math problems in class.

CANNOT UNDERSTAND ONE THING SHE SAYS! She continually shows pictures of her daughter for no reason. 150 people show up to class on test days, 15 people on every other day. She is no help at all and how has no idea what is going on.  She refers to blackboard as whiteboard...
Don't have to go to class. Tests are ridiculously hard, but are curved a lot. Class is a joke.

Intro to Astronomy was a joke. She did not teach it like an intro class at all! Slideshows were at least 80 slides each which were filled with completely useless information. Open book/open note exam were impossible to pass. Do not take this course if you want to fulfill a core requirement because it will only lower your GPA!

Worst professor at Northeastern. She has no idea how to teach a class, speeds through the notes, and most of the stuff on exams isn't stuff covered in class. ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE.  There can be no worse experience than this.  Don't take this class.  The class average is a 44%. DONT TAKE ANYTHING SHE TEACHES.  EVER.  OR SUFFER.

Her class is like one long joke without a structured point. One of the most awkward academic experiences I've had in my career; students openly laugh and mock her and she seems to either put up with it or not understand it's true intent.  Importantly, she curves the tests that everyone technically fails. A total joke.

Steve is great! He is into what he teaches. Hw is time consuming for some weeks and the TA grades them. Looks like we got a different TA she is nice and chill pretty easy with grading but like people said the TA does matter in this course since they handle big part of the grades. No final and exams are fair though some questions were too specific

Professor Warren's lectures are actually enjoyable to sit through and he has a unique sense of humor. HW can take some time, and there is a no electronics policy in class. Exams are not too bad... I was quite surprised by the ratings here - my experience this Spring has been positive. There is a new TA. She is nice and sweet and fair with grading.

This class was fine, but exclusively dependent on group work. Having a group that does not participate and will not help with assignments makes the class challenging, and there is no accountability. Prof does not seem to care or understand that students grades are suffering because the syllabus only focuses on group work. also this was comm2700

Professor Warren is a great teacher and is enthusiastic about the content. There are weekly cases that can be a little tedious to do and are graded by the TA. The TA grades relatively strictly which is why his rating is so low. The tests are decent but he does sometimes throw in questions that have no correlation to the content.

His rating is lower then it should be, I understand if you took this for NUpath and thought it was going to be a breeze why you feel a way. Lots of readings but they are interesting if you like sports. The TA makes the class harder then it should be, takes points off for stuff not on the rubric. Steven is great and his lectures are very interesting

The exams are all mcq but there are some crazy specific case studies making it quite difficult. That being said, he does provide an alright study guide and there was no final.

Professor Warren himself is fine. The class is terrible. The TA is super strict, professor warren is never in class half the time. The tests are a nightmare, the tests never reflect the study guides, and the study guides never reflect the class material. Sometimes he will throw things onto the test that you have never seen before just to screw you.

Lectures were alright but  boring at times. Tests are difficult, sometimes very obscure to what we learnt in class. Weekly cases are very time-consuming. HW was incredibly tedious and time consuming. Don't recommend taking it as an elective or NU path, but I could see it being good if your major is comms or sports focused. Actually liked Steve, but he was hands off with grading The TA was a ridiculously harsh grader and the course relied on remembering obscure details for tests and assignments.

Warren gives good lectures, but the TA, assignments, and exams make this an unpleasant class.

He only ever shows up to one of the classes out of the week and has the TA lead the second one which is discussion based. Homework takes forever and really is not helpful. The TA is a really hard graded for no reason and overall useless. If you are looking for just a fun class to take don't take this one literally take anything else.

Weekly homework takes 3+ hours and feels like busywork. The TA grades harshly and rarely gives full credit. The class could be fun but it's boring. Not a chill elective. reviews.comment: Gives assignments due night of class that take 2+ hours. A lot of time commitment for an elective. Not receptive to feedback.
He's my goat, the best professor at NEU. He literally would let us go on 30min walks mid lecture because "people think better when they walk". If you have an option to take him, please do

Professor Wang is extremely passionate regarding what he teaches, and keeps class time engaging with thought-provoking group discussions. The final average is graded on few assignments and participation, but he is very lenient with attendance. If he is teaching a course you are anticipating to take, definitely take his class

Very good professor! Lectures are very interesting and he tries to make it very engaging and participative. Assignments are very straightforward with clear grading criteria and graded quite leniently. He initiates very interesting discussions on ethics and is very good at asking questions that make you retrospect. Overall, amazing experience!

Such a kind prof! I took his class summer in-person. The lectures and in-class discussions are very interesting! Attendance is graded, but you are allowed to miss a lot of days. Every assignment is allowed to be turned in 2 days late before points are taken off. There is 1 homework, paper, and a 5-minute presentation. A very fun class, I recommend!
Overall very chill class, grades very leniently and gives you a bunch of absences and opportunities for extra credit, highly recommend!
Great prof, very fun to be in class with. He's flexible and allows several absences, and has extra credit opportunities to earn extra points, late days, or absent days. Highly recommend.

Amazing professor - I've learned so much from this class. Each week is dedicated towards a specific topic, and it is presented in an engaging way with lots of class discussion. You can really tell he cares about philosophy and his students, with constant check-ins on homework and kindly granted extensions.   Definitely would recommend!!!

Great professor! Classes are almost exclusively discussion based, which I really liked. He gives very little homework and structures his classes so that they're very engaging with few lectures. It is obvious that he cares about his students and is very receptive to feedback. Overall, his Tech and Human Values class was my favorite of the semester!

Great professor. As long as you pay attention to the rubric and formats he mentions during class, it's a chill class. One homework per two weeks and a final paper determines most grades. He's super chill, and participating in discussions with him during classes is fun.

Wonderful guy. First year teaching, and he has it all down. Incredibly understanding, very open to feedback, genuienly works on making class more fun, better, and engaging. Class is genuinely interesting with many in class discussions. Truly cares about the subject and hopes that he can make his students interested. Nothing but respect for him.

Professor Wang's class was great. Every class included group discussions on interesting topics in tech and society. And Professor Wang is inviting and encourages a diversity of perspectives on every topic. There's a few papers throughout the semester but as long as you write your arguments in logical form and actually try, you'll do well.

Take Professor Ward's guitar class! He genuinely cares about all of his students and wants to see them succeed. However, there are a lot of in-class performances that were anxiety-inducing, and I found that they took away from the fun of learning the guitar.
There is nothing bad I could say about Professor Ward. He genuinely is so sweet, willing to teach, and makes learning the guitar so fun and easy. Please take this class, he's the best!

Professor Ward's class has been one of my favorites so far at Northeastern. He's so encouraging and truly wants everyone to succeed in his class. Not a tough grader per se but you do have to put the effort into practicing to do well.

Mr. Ward is the best teacher I have had at Northeastern University! He is so involved and truly wants all of his students to succeed and fall in love with the material/music in general. Such a wonderful teacher and an even better person. If you have the ability to take one of his classes, you must!

Great professor! Super encouraging and respectful to students of all skill levels. He's incredibly good at breaking things down. I took him for a summer class but I feel like I've learned so much in 7 weeks.
legendary
Terrific. He really knows his stuff, and he's incredibly kind.
Willing to work with students who needed extra help, gave some extra credit/allowed corrections on the midterm, brought pizza to the final exam, very sarcastic and funny!

I took Mr. Ward's guitar class during summer and it's such a fun course. There wasn't a lot of assignments, it was two in-class performance, one video recording, a one page long music theory quiz, and an online final. Strongly recommanded to take, especially if you have music background. But even if not, he starts teaching from leaning the notes.

I am 100% convinced that Robert Ward is the best professor at Northeastern. This man cares so much about his students. In our guitar class, we had a wide range of skill levels yet he kept the class at a pace that worked for everyone. Please take a class with him if you have the chance.

One of the most relaxed and effective learning environments Ive ever been in If youre a music student, your life will benefit greatly from having this guy as a professor. He cares about making sure his students actually LEARN the material more than he cares about grades. Put in your honest best and hell make sure your grade reflects it.

Professor Ward is one of the coolest professors I've ever had. He cares about his students, and genuinely wants us to succeed in all that we do. Effort is absolutely the most important part of the class - do the best you can and he'll make sure you succeed.

He is so passionate about the classical guitar - it really rubs off on his students.  He is very patient, at times it even feels like this class is moving too slowly.  He is funny and his class is very welcoming.  He makes students comfortable playing in front of the class even if they make mistakes, no one is worried about being judged in his room
Ward is an awesome teacher. He really helps every student learn how to play guitar and have a lot of fun. As long as you show up and try, it's a guaranteed A.

Professor Ward is a very talented classical guitarist who loves to pass on knowledge to his students. His Music Theory 2 course is very hands-on, with little actual theory, and lots of composition. Students present their songs/jingles/ads/etc. very frequently so you can't be shy with him, he will call you out. Overall an easy course and a great guy
He is the best!!!! He always encourages his students! Very patient! I enjoyed every single class that I attended! if u have an opportunity to take his class - do it!!! U'll never regret it!!!
Professor Ward was one of the best, nicest professors ive had at northeastern. really nice and wants you to do well in the class. lets you make up your answers on tests to help boost your grade

He was an awful teacher. I think I actually know less about music  after taking this class. He wastes tons of time and is a useless teacher in intro to music. He said that this is not his normal class and that is a good thing. He demands that you attend every single class and then wastes your time the whole semester. Not worth the easy grade!

awesome teacher. class material is somewhat difficult but if you don't understand it, talk to him about it and he'll definitely help you. he really cares about his students and wants them to do well. love this class! :]

Awesome teacher. True renaissance man. Easy tests. Paper as final exam. All we do is listen to music and watch old paintings on slides. Most ppl just doze off and sleep in the back. Very chill class and interesting. Very fun guy. Awesome class. Recommended. If you want an A, take this course!

Ward is easy and really fun. He usually spends the first part of class visiting and getting to know the students. The class I took was attendance mandatory, but I'm not sure if all his classes are. He's lax on tardiness.

He is a great teacher! He really cares about his students and making sure that people understand the material (he'll let you go back and fix problems you messed up on the test and get credit for it because he wants you to know the material). He is very knowledgeable and defintely one of the best professor's I have had at Northeastern

I love this teacher! He's very interesting and the music we listen to in class is awesome! You learn alot about composers like Motzart and Beethoven. Participate and it'll be a fun class! He's a super nice guy and I recommend him! Very relaxing class! i'll be taking him again soon!

He was a really nice guy and will help the people that try.  It was an easy class for me, but I knew a lot of the material before we started.  If you have to take this class, make sure it is with him.  From what I hear he's the best of the theory teachers.

Took this class and didn't know how to play guitar before ...  After I knew how to jam. Amazing professor. Received an A in the class. Material is easy if you practice. This is a classical guitar class but he does teach you chords and some blues scales.

Professor Ward is great. He grades easily, assigns one chapter of the book per week (it only seems a lot if you end up doing the whole chapter the night before), and for the most part keeps you awake in class. If you don't understand he tries his best to clear up the confusion. If you know how to do the homework you can get an easy A on the tests.
Plowed through the material and was not clear. Very nice man, but the class was a big ball of confusion for me.
Nice guy, boring lectures. Listened to classical music for three months. Tests on book. Personal opinion essays are most of grade. Take home midterm and final, both essays.
incredibly boring class, he just turns on classical music and we listen. Nice guy tho, and pretty easy.
Interesting class, really nice guy, great guitar player
Great teacher, very helpful. Knows his stuff

Great teacher, very passionate.  Really makes you think about issues.
Terribly boring classes that would make anyone fall asleep; very unclear; if you're not a music student you will HATE this class
professor ward is a really nice guy, however, his classes put me to sleep like no other. painfully boring lectures and ridiculous assignments. i don't recommend him!
Nice guy, likes his music, interesting assignments. I actually learned something in this class

Final was very reasonable and curved.

He solely does example problems in lectures which was very helpful but I also had to learn a lot on my own. Final was ok since he did problems that were pretty much the same as the exam.

genuinely one of the best professors ive ever had in my life. cares so so much about his students and genuinely believes in everyone. his lectures are very fast paced but cover a lot of useful information. midterms are super easy and if you do the homework, it should be easy. do not mistake his feedback as rude, he is being honest as possible !!
He is definitely intimidating at first but its clear he cares about his students and seeing them succeed. He goes out of his way to help a lot. I definitely recommend.

He can be tough and frank about what's required to pass and whether or not you have a good shot. But he cares so much about helping students succeed. He provides lots of resources to hellp you and his office hours are amazing. Additionally, he allows retakes for up to an 85 on the first two midterms.

While a little intimidating at first, he cares so so much about seeing all of his students succeed. Hosts cram sessions before exams and weekly larger office hours with practice material. Goes through A TON of practice problems as a way of teaching so be prepared but its so helpful because they are so similar to what is on the exam.

His tests are very heavy, but if you do poorly he would usually let you replace your lowest test grade with your final test grade. His lectures are spent mostly on going over examples, but his office hours are a great way to get build a connection and review any material you struggle with. He even does cram session pre test to help the students!

reviews.comment: Knowledgeable on subject and clearly explains material as well as its practical application. Weekly quizzes are easy as he always gives a very similar example right before the exam to make sure you are refreshed on the topic. Cares a lot about students learning success
Good professor who clearly explains the material, could focus more on theory but I would definetly take his class again.
attend lectures, read book and look at homework prior to class would be helpful. Quizzes are comparable to homework. Definitely go to his office hour and ask questions, nice professor to talk to.

KT is a very kind man and cares s lot about his students success. But beware, his class is tough and you will need to put a lot of time into preparing for his quizzes and tests. Be prepared for some curve ball questions as well

john really cares about his students and will always be ready to help you out especially outside of class hours. ive taken two of his classes so far and the work is genuinely so easy i just think the other raters don't like the strict mandatory attendance policy (which is in all design classes btw)
A great professor!
Great professor! The workload is good, and overall, I learned a lot from this class!

Such a boring class, takes himself way to seriously, assigns too much work, absences are counted as unexcused unless you warn him TWO WEEKS in advance, and 3 unexcused absences is a fail. There are also two tests, a midterm and a final, and he doesn't help with learning software or anything of value

He is a really passionate professor and a sweet guy, but his organizational skills make the class frustrating. He doesn't use canvas so assignments are sent by email, making the class hard to follow. The way the course is graded you do not know your grade until end of semester, which makes the class a bit stressful. Overall the class is really fun!

He is past his prime as a professor, he is an amazing lecturer, and it's a fun class, but he grades unfairly, and you don't know your grade until the last day of class. If 2 people have the same answer on an exam, one may get graded harshly, and the other may do well. He's also not too tech-savvy, which makes it harder to complete assignments.

reviews.comment: I took negotiations with him and LOVED him. His lectures are super entertaining, most classes you get paired up and get to do a real negotiation. I learned so so so much, class wasn't too hard at all, and he's so so nice. Highly recommend this class with him!

I took Professor Wertheim's negotiation class in the Fall of 2023 and still use the skills I developed almost two years later. Professor Wertheim is an incredibly caring and supportive man that is very knowledgable in his field. I urge everyone to experience at least one of his classes if you have the opportunity to do so. You will not regret it.

Professor Wertheim is one of the most well-respected professors at Northeastern! The class consists of weekly negotiation sessions, as well as a few assignments and open-book quizzes. I learned so much from this class and I will be sure to apply it into future negotiations. I wish he taught more courses, as I would sign up immediately!
fun lecture + wholesome professor, you learn a lot of negotiation skills, weekly negotiation sessions with peers

Without a doubt one of my favorite professors at NU. His lectures are practically stand up comedy sets and its even better if you have a class group that is just as involved. Just really try to do your best because your negotiation skills at the end of the day are dependent on your own effort in class/with work - make it worthwhile!!

My favorite professor at NU and my most memorable class. He is hilarious and makes class interesting. You negotiate every class but so worth it. Average homework is around 2hrs/week. Please take him if you can! If you try and apply what you learn in class, you'll do good.

Best professor and best class taken at Northeastern. Average hw is about 1.5hrs/week, and the quiz is open notes. If you do what he asks, and reflect, you'll be fine. Extremely interactive class, negotiating every week. You learn a lot.

Wertheim is the best professor I have ever had hands-down. He cares so much about his students and puts SO much time into giving feedback to each and every person. Class was SO valuable, fun and I learned so much. I left this class feeling so much more able and confident. Would recommend and retake any day of my life.

Great class, even better professor. Professor Wertheim gives very clear instructions and feedback that its almost hard to not do well in his class. Attendance/preparation is very important as you will be doing mock negotiations every week. He makes lectures so interesting that you wont want to miss one anyways
One of the nicest professors ever, he wants everyone to succeed, it feels like. Loves in class participation.

Wertheim is truly a great professor. I learned so much about how to negotiate in his class and I thought he did a really great job. There is quite a bit of out of class work and each class requires about an hour's preparation. But for what you gain from it it's worth it. He really is a great professor.

This is the best professor for the best class I have had the pleasure of attending. Professor Wertheim actually pulls off the amazing feat of making class useful, worthwhile, and fun. There's a lot of writing, but it's interesting. Take this class. You will learn more, and have more fun, than any other class you have taken. By far.
Excellent, most fun I have had in any class. Amazingly made me happy to wake up at 8:00 on Saturdays. If going into anything related with sales, it is a must!!

Fantastic professor, Negotiation is probably the best course I've taken in my entire collegiate career.  Really made learning the course hands on and a 4 hour class in the middle of August fly by.  He has a dry sense of humor and will poke fun at you if you deserve it, but always light-heartedly.  Everyone should take this course with this guy.
Great professor, takes a while to get used to him, but I learned so much
made 3 1/2 hours of class twice a week slightly less suicide worthy. Slightly hard grader...
Heavy workload but at the end it pays off. I learned a lot.
Prof. uses what he claims to be the "socratic method," but actually tends to mislead students with his questions.
Professor Weng is amazing. His lectures were very informative, and all the prep leading up to the final exam tied together all we had learned about accounting.

Prof Weng is amazing! super kind and eager to teach (even at 8am!). However: required online textbook for HW/quiz costs $100+, need financial calculator (buy used!), homework takes FOREVER (spent 3.5hrs on ONE question), and he sometimes answers what he thinks you asked vs your actual question (likely language barrier). Still worth it!

Funny energetic clear teacher, very understanding i had 93.98 / 100 overall at the end of the semester and he was kind enough to review my grade and bump it up to 94.12 for an A. Attendance is taken by a sheet you sign at the start of every class. Drops your worst hw / quizz

He is the sweetest professor ever. Will go over the TA's grading and give you more points. Offers extra credit and says "I need an excuse to give you the points". He is always there if you have questions outside of class. Made a mock exam. I got an A- bc I did not pay attention in class so my test grades were eh. Go to class + pay attention = A+

The cutest human being ever!! A very caring professor and only wants the best for his students. His lectures were boring at times, but at 8am he had a lot of energy and was passionate while teaching. Accounting itself is a hard topic, so I would suggest taking it with Weng. All quizzes and homework is online.

Professor Weng was an amazing professor. He taught his class in a very well-structured manner, making it easy for students to follow along. He gives several extra credit opportunities to help students improve their grade, and his homework is very similar to the quizzes. If you want a professor who cares for his students, I highly recommend him.

Could not recommend Pr. Weng enough. Genuinely such a great professor who wants u to succeed. His teaching methods were effective. Quizzes were online, similar to the homeworks. Midterm 2 was giving by the coordinator, so more difficult. Overall, he gave us many resources and extra credit opportunities. Hope to cross paths with him again!!

Prof Weng was by far my best professor this semester. I even switched my major to accounting after taking his class. Despite having an 8 am with him, he was always energetic, always lenient with grades, and gave EC. The quizzes and tests were not challenging if you studied a reasonable amount and did your homework. 
Great prof and even better guy!

my best professor this semester. he genuinely cares about his students grades, provides tons of practice questions, and his canvas is perfectly organized. syllabus is clear from day 1, drops lowest quiz and hw grades, curves if needed, and cheat sheets are allowed. quizzes were online in class. if it wasnt a 9:15 id go every time. HIGHLY recommend!

Literally the cutest, he helps so much and gives so many resources for his students. I totally recommend him to everyone for their first accounting class. So nice and easy with grading, he made me actually like accounting.
So kind and genuinely wants his students to learn! Very easily accesible outside of class and has office hours.

Professor Liwei cares about his students and wants us all to succeed. He provides study guides for midterms/final, extra practice problems, and is always available for office hours. Even though I took this class at 8 am, Professor Liwei was always enthusastic and eager to teach. I would highly recommend to take ACCT1201 with him.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor who really wants his students to do well in the class. Had extra credit opportunities and curved quizzes when needed. He makes it clear what's going to be on the midterm and final and gives a lot of practice for both. Asks for feedback to make sure the timing for homeworks and the length of quizzes is doable. I recommend!

By far the best professor. He requires attendance, but even if he did not have this requirement, you should attend his every single class anyway, because accounting will be much easier if you listen to his class. His class was very early, but that is not his fault--that is the school's arrangement. His class is very easy to follow and understand.

He is great. I want to take his other classes. Attendance is required, but he offers 4 times of absences. However, I attended all, because ACCT1201 is a common class that offers the same course resources and requirements by all teachers and what makes a huge difference is his great teaching. If you don't attend class, you lose this huge benefit.
Mr. Weng taught so well and so clearly! Best professor I have ever had!

Professor Weng's lectures are very clear and easy to understand, with a well-organized structure. I am a computer science major, but I was able to fully grasp accounting concepts. Highly recommend his class!

She is genuinely so kind and gets to know each student. Her lectures are really interesting and I loved them. My advice is just attend every class and take notes but the material is worth learning and projects help with your grade too.

she's nice and lectures are good, she includes videos and examples to help our learning. it's definitely not an easy A, tests are challenging and u need to study. she does love when people participate and lowkey likes those ppl more, so idk if i would take her again lol

Professor Weaver is well respected for good reason! She condenses so much important information into a semester that I am sure I will recall for the rest of my life. If you review your textbook+class notes to fill in the study guides for her exams then you will do well. Macmillian practice questions are very helpful! Just show up, listen, engage!
Super nice. Super average. My AP psych course in high school was exacly the same.

love dr. weaver. she doesn't just lecture; she shows videos, provides examples, facilitates class discussions, and brought in toys one day. exams can be tricky, but study and talk to her in office hours and she's very understanding. gives extra credit too. fits are fire every time. answers emails quickly. would def take again.

i love dr. weaver - she was my favorite professor this year. I enjoyed going to her class and it went by so quick. she is so funny as well and has great style. She really engages the class but doesn't force it. best prof ever at NU

reviews.comment: Had her for summer 1. Great professor, and easy to understand lectures. Diverse assignments and educated on inclusive psychology. Had quizzes every week, no final. Assigned readings were very interesting and thought-provoking and accompanied the class discussions nicely. Content of the course really makes you think of how short our lifespan is.

Teacher is very approachable and always available during office hours, but not a class for an easy A. There are 3 tests that are 60% of the grade so if you do bad on 1 test it is almost impossible to still get an A. Also there are weekly quizzes, so once the semester starts to get busy it is hard to keep up every week.

Her lectures are great, and she's a great person but the class is quite difficult. Do not take this class if you want an easy A. 3 exams are worth 60% of your grade and quizzes are 20%. Wouldn't recommend unless you're good with tests.
Lowkey chill teacher, but don't take her under any circumstances if you are looking for an easy A bc u want to rizz up.

Professor Weaver is an awesome professor whose lectors are very interesting and engaging, she allows for good class participation and takes the time to individually know her students. 10/10 highly recommend her.

reviews.comment: Professor Weaver is very passionate and her lectures are engaging. All of her assigned readings are interesting and class activities complimented them very well. I always leave her class feeling motivated and inspired.

Professor Weaver is amazing. She is clearly very passionate about her job and really enjoys teaching us the content. She is also very funny and respectful. Her lectures are interesting and she is always available when needed. Her exams can be hard for people who are not that good with MC but overall an easy class.
Professor Weaver is a great, engaging professor. I attended every class because her lectures were never boring and easy to digest.

Professor Weaver is a great teacher and truly cares about her students. Her lectures were always super engaging with great examples and class activities to make sure that we understood the information. She also does a great job answering questions from students. Her quizzes are all open-note and for exams, it's very important to read the textbook.

Dr. Weaver is an engaging professor who always managed to make the class content interesting. 50% of the grade is based off of the midterm and the final, which you need to review lectures and the textbook for. The textbook is extremely helpful and easy to read, making this class easy to do well in if you understand the readings.

reviews.comment: I loved this professor's class, she shows up every day ready to teach and is always trying to engage her students in the material. I would highly recommend her to anyone who is looking for an inspirational professor.

I think, for a 1000-level course, it is a lot of work for what it is. He has unclear grading criteria and waits till the last minute to put in some grades. Also, he does make sure to add his opinion on topics. Take it if you have to but not as an elective.

There are 4 major assignments that you need to complete by the end of the semester, most are pretty easy. Definitely recommend his class!

Professor Wells is an amazing professor and sparked an interest in Philosophy for me. Every class has a 15-20 page reading. As you annotated it, you don't have to participate in class. There are few assignments, and grading is easy. He gives so many chances for good grades, as long as you show up and try at least a little you will do well.

Mark's lectures are engaging and easy to follow along with. The rubric for the class is clear, and you get unlimited attempts on all four major assignments. He's very down-to-earth and connects well with students.

reviews.comment: There is a lot of reading for this class but overall this class became my favorite not because of the material but the professors he's wonderful very understanding and  helpful. he makes the class discussions the best and supper enjoyable.

Prof was funny and made class fun. There are lots of discussions during class!
Mark is by far the best professor l've had so far. I looked forward to class every day due to his funny yet passionate classes that were a place to learn. He wants his students to pass!

I never thought I would enjoy a philosophy class, but I'm really glad I was required to take this one. It is a great eye-opener to disparities in healthcare and he helped us develop our argumentative skills for when some of us have to make these decisions in the future. Professor Well's passion for the subject also drove the class. I recommend!

One of my favorite parts of the classes was the engaging hypotheticals he asked, as if we were moral judges of the subject at hand. I took War and Peace with him, and although a serious topic that has a lot of taboo pieces to it, the class provides an extremely in-depth view and it is definitely the class I've learned the most in so far.

Professor Wells loves to make an impact on students and strives to make them think deeply about their views on ethics. He creates a welcoming class environment and lectures well. Highly recommend Wells, especially if you're a philosophy major/have an interest in philosophy. I took a 2nd class with them & loved it

Professor Wells is an awesome teacher! I had him for the summer semester and honestly wish I got to experience the full semester with him. A truly passionate, caring, and intelligent individual. Research Ethics offers simple content but challenging writing assignments. Mark is extremely helpful in office hours. If you're stuck, go to office hours. Cannot stress how much office hours help. Philosophy is hard, even introductory philosophy. Go to office hours and he will help so much.

Wells is obviously very knowledgeable and passionate about what he's teaching which makes his classes very enjoyable and interesting but he is very unclear when it comes to grading and gives virtually no feedback. Prof. Wells runs a somewhat difficult class, but he seems to genuinely want to help you master the information if you reach out. Professor Wells is clearly very knowledgeable and passionate about the course material (of which there is a LOT of). Amazing professor! I really enjoyed his class. The discussions are always fun & engaging. - roh

It was his first year teaching and he did a great job! Engaged with the students & made a simple marketing class more interesting. In a course that is heavy on boring and monotonous material such as citations, rhetorical techniques, and professional revision his lectures made class time fun and engaging. If given the choice between him at 8 am and another professor at a more convenient time, I would chose him 10 time out of 10. He is also a very kind and understanding grader.

I took this class, Advanced Writing, online with Dr. White. Due dates were always clear, and he was great at being accommodating and catering to students. He responds quickly and grades fairly. Not a stressful class. It is kind of a lot of work but I'm not mad about it.

reviews.comment: Too confused to know what is going on!!!

It was definitely "work" and he expected good writing - but as someone who expected to hate a Technical writing course, I was pleasantly surprised. Professor is a 10/10 - workload is more than you might want from a non-technical course, but it felt justified in the end.

Had Dr. White my first semester freshman year, and just looked back on the blog project we wrote! To this day, he is by far the best and most understanding professor I have ever had. As long as you put in the effort, you will definitely get an A. Super entertaining and engaging class.

Prof. White was amazing. He truly cares about his students and whether they learn, and really wants you to succeed. He allows you to explore your own passions, gives great feedback, and is always willing to help you. All in all, I have no complaints with Dr. White, I really enjoyed his class and learned a lot and would take his class again.

Dr. White was an awesome teacher! Class was really conversational, sometimes a bit heavy on the reading but the assignments were really good and interesting. Cares what students have to say- one time we all hated an assignment and he actually modified it according to our feedback, and made it so much better. 3 big projects, pretty easy grader!

Highly recommended! Great professor. He's a really nice guy, gives reasonable amount of work. He would like for you to participate, but does not make you speak in front of the whole class if you're uncomfortable. We watched a couple of movies. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN. attendance matters though.

Easy A course, 2 papers for the full semester accompanied by two presentations which took me 20 minutes each to make. Course opens your perspective on gathering and analysing sources while emphasising the influence of different perspectives on research. Great easy A course, don't take anyone else for ADW!

I had him about 2 semesters ago but I still remember the class pretty well. Max is an awesome professor. He really gets the students engaged in the class and he always had a lot of good feedback for essays. Also, we only had 4 assignments, totally manageable. I highly recommend taking his class if you're fortunate enough to get that chance.

Max was an awesome teacher.  HIGHLY recommend.  He was always very understanding and was very laid back.  I was never truly that interested in writing (was actually rather poor at it), but max makes a challenging course understandable and clear.  He actually assists with your improvement.

Chillest teacher I have. Max requires only three 5 page papers over the semester, while some professors require one almost every class. He edits your drafts extensively and gives as much help as needed. Freshman english sucks but Max makes it as fun as he can with movies and his humor.
Great teacher. Basically a genius. It's a lot of work but so are all writing classes. If you try hard you'll get an A. We probably watched 3 movies and two tv episodes. Take this professor.

It was an eye-opening class, got me to think alot. Max was always really helpful and cool, made everyone feel very at ease to speak whatever they felt like. Just four manageable papers and thats it, mixed with appropriate movies. A very enjoyable class, highely recommended.
Very thought provoking lectures.  Really a fun class, he organizes it well.
Nice guy.  Keeps class short and tries to make it interesting with personal anecdotes. Makes it clear he hates the book that is used--you don't use it at all.  Don't buy it. He is very laid back.

Easy and down to earth. He gives good feedback on work and tries to make class short when he can and tries to keep it interesting. Just change you writing based on his feedback and you will do fine. He also helps you out by making assignments more manageable and not too long. I recommend him.
It sometimes seemed like he was learning the material the day before, but overall a nice guy who put up with our class of buttholes.  Four essays that were graded pretty easily, overall a nice guy
I really think that any combination of 26 letters in the English language fail to comprehend the awfulness exhibited by this person
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor white cares so genuinely about student education and engagement. The material is really interesting and I still reference the texts we used in other classes Ive had since. Shes more than willing to talk to people as they need who really want to make the most out of their learning. Stay engaged in discussions and youll love the class!
no ppt, no blackboard writing. I dont know what she was talking about after a whole sem

She is amazing ! You can learn a lot from her experiences. She keeps it very real and sticks to the point ! if you are a no-nonsense student like I am, the I highly recommend you take her class! Lots to learn !
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She has been harsh on criticizing my post because my written English, and point out something (quotation words that I don't know) which I didn't do. This course is about career development not English writing. Without criticizing, there isn't any constructive advice provided. Disappointing!
Professor White is gifted in engaging with students in the class. Her examples of personal branding were enlightening.

This class is chock full of substantive information that you will use, not only throughout your educational career, but throughout your life. Prof. White has developed tools that, week by week, take you on a journey to Strategically Plan for your future. This class was a wonderful use of my time and I highly recommend taking it ON GROUND.

Professor White is gifted in engaging with students and getting us pumped about the course. the class exercises are  an eye opener; the further along you go in the course, the more things about work and personalities just make sense.  Glad I took this class.
Her energy is great and definitely helps to change people's life. She is a kind of life couch, very candid and thoughtful.

Dr. Letterman White lectures are engaging and her in-class exercises are very helpful and interesting. Her course is really fun and interactive. She really does care about her students, and demonstrates a commitment to helping each of her students grow and succeed. Loved her class!
loved Professor White. He's extremely clear and overall a great teacher. He is a practicing economist so he really knows his stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Great professor. doesn't skip steps. makes sure everyone understands the concepts. treat students equally. take him!!!

Great Professor! Highly recommended. He really tries to be funny in class and its just hilarious. Very fair grader too. His tests are clear and if you study a couple of days ahead you will do fine. He also gives breaks in between classes and you just dont fall asleep.  I would take his class again.

Great Professor in a weak department.  Good lecturer who uses a chalkboard.  The class is structured well and he will make sure people are caught up when writing examples. DO NOT buy the textbook, he makes far more sense than it does.   Basically, there are about 20 analytical question formats you will learn, and then study a few case studies.
