Difficult course all-round, and be ready to work hard! No matter what you will learn a lot and if you are an economic major, senior seminar should be very easy! I recommend that this course with him, just be prepared to work hard!!!

Econometrics class was a very intimidating class, but the professor is very clear in explaining everything. He is open to any suggestions on improving the class. He will not test you on a topic which he didn't discuss in class. Note taking and homework is vital to excelling in class. Grading is very fair. Made review sessions before exams.
Easily my favorite professor at Northeastern. Micro-Theory can be a hard subject, but Dr. White is an excellent teacher. Also he's hilarious. Take him for Micro-Theory trust me!
He is honestly just looking to help you learn the material. I found him pretty funny, definitely one of the nicest teachers I've ever had.

Very nice professor. Attending classes is not compulsory but his classes are very useful. Zero textbook use. Quizzes are very fair and are 100% similar to the homework. You should definitely take this class with him.

The best economics professor at Northeastern. He is so clear, has a lot of real world experience, and is extremely witty. The class isn't easy, but his tests are very fair and you can do well if you really focus on the homeworks. Don't you dare take micro theory with anybody else!!

I thought Laura was an amazing teacher. Although I did not do overly well in the class, I have a great understanding of the course. She is a hard grader, but she is fair. She teaches very thoroughly and I wish I had her for every class.

She does not believe in partial credit, one midterm worth 35% of your grade and a final worth 40%. Sticks to writing notes on the board the whole class and questions on quizzes and tests are verbatim from what she writes on the board all class. Does not deviate from her lecture notes and does not use the text book. Aviod
I would not reccomend, she is unclear, and an unfair graded avoid if you can!!!!
Very bad teacher.  Also not a consistent grader among students in the class.  I would not recommend her.

Attend every lecture, please. The lectures have a lot of information and he does a great time explaining it deeply during class instruction. Midterm and final are alright (no practice exams for both), but he does post a study guide on Piazza (if you write and memorize all of those information, you should be fine). Hws/projects are heavy.

I loved Christos lectures. They were some of the best lectures I have attended at Northeastern as a CS Student. His slides are definitely tailored to in person but are still usable and provided for use at home. Homeworks were generally quick but the projects definitely took some time. Probably the most I have ever actually learned from a course.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Worst class I have taken in CS. On Piazza replies to peoples questions with sarcasm. If you run into a bug on a project, the TA and HIM will not give you help. I went from an A to D+ in two projects because I ran into one bug at the start, and they would not help me in office hours. It was partner work.

The homework ramp up as projects get worse

Christo is the GOAT. His lecturing skills far exceed most other professors, even after he taught the same thing three times that day. He is very helpful, answers your questions, and is fairly active on Piazza. Christo is definitely passionate about networks and it shows in lecture. Highly recommend his class
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: CS 2550 ,ok he is a great professor, a funny professor, but for this class I dont recommend you (if you are not a cs major or you are a minor cs) to take class CS2550, its cybersecurity . that means you are doing things like a hacker. i took this class when it just opened to students. 4 projects 2 papers (2000 words) 5 pop quiz, 2 exams
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Inspirational--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors. Difficult course, even if you do well in it, but you learn a ton and have fun doing it.

Networks with Christo is one of the coolest classes I've ever taken. His projects are fun to do (be prepared to work hard though!), the lectures are engaging, and he explains things well. I'd take this class again in a heartbeat if I could.

He's clearly one of the most inspiring professors I've ever met in Northeastern. His lecture is well-prepared with details, and you can download the slides as well. You can ask tons of questions on piazza and he will reply you with a lot of information in that. Lots of work to do in his class, but if you work hard, it will pay off.
One of the best profs at Northeastern
Great Teacher

Nice guy, but avoid this class. Too much reading/ case studies. Grading is inconsistent - might get an A on one assignment, and a C on an assignment of same/ better quality -really makes no sense. Feedback does not support grade. Barely teaches - you learn more from other students. No exams, just many presentations and case studies.

Prof. does basically nothing in the course. You have to study alone with the text book and the online questions. Seems like an online class. Lectures are unecessary. The level is quite low so you learn only the basics, critical thinking or up to date topics are left out.

I hope you like teaching yourself Econ. Prof. contributed nothing but publisher ppt slides and homeworks. He puts no effort into his class. May as well have been an online only course. Curves final grades. All learning comes from reading the text. Though friendly, added no value. Worthless lectures. REGRET REGRET REGRET REGRET.

rating is for sustainability. class consists of 6 case studies, and group projects. Class seems easy but he curves final grades to make it harder for students to get anything above a B+.. tends to give out random grades without explaining why

Knowledgable, but not a good teacher.  The professor usually tried to waste between 30-60 min of class time with random thoughts about nothing. 90% of learning came from simply reading the text. The prof. added no value and was often very unclear about assignments.  When somebody asked a question, he rarely was able to provide a clear answer.

Took him for the required Macroeconomics class for an MBA.  The exams were tough and the class was definitely a substantial amount of work.  However, he was a very fair grader in the end as long as you put the effort into the class assignments.

I'm a MBA student and on the first day of class he said something about active learning, BS if you ask me.  His texts are canned and ppoints are also canned. Boring, no active learning at all. Totally no in touch with student's interest.
This economics teacher was completely out of tune with the present economy. He was teaching to the 1980 economy. I think he still thought Ronald Reagan was president.

I don't usually post anything online, but felt the need to save other students from ever having to take Professor Whitfield's class. Prof. W is very unprofessional. He's the worst teacher I have ever had. Don't expect to learn anything, you will have to teach yourself. He will not answer questions, only refer you to your classmates for help. Awful!

Maybe it's an undergraduate issue, but at the graduate level, he's an amazing professor! Very thorough and helpful. Econ is most certainly not my strong suit, but he's making the class very approachable!
I don't understand the other peoples' comments either. He is a very nice guy, a good teacher and assign a fair work load...I'd recommend taking him for Economics

Don't know what the fuss is with the other people's comments. Perhaps he's different with undergrads but my experience is that he's a nice guy & a pretty good teacher too. He explained the concepts well and set relevant work in class tests and 2 exams as well as a presentation/paper. The text book is good thought fairly basic

Expect to do everything on your own. When you ask questions he doesn't give clear answers (but he is willing to spend a lot of time trying to explain). The tests tend to have questions that you never learned in class and he refuses to drop them b/c he'll give "half-credit." Just...expect long hours in the library teaching yourself.
Nice guy but I can read teh book myself and learn as much.

What a joke, you will learn nothing from this teacher.  If you ask him a question in class he refers you to other students for an answer.  Nice guy who probably knows a lot about finance but just cannot teach to save his life.  Save yourself from a painful semester and avoid at all costs... even death.

Are you kidding me?  This guy is a complete idiot - and that's not an UNDER STATEMENT.  When asked questions that he does not have the answer to: "I don't know, it just how it is done."  WARNING: if you are not self sufficient and need a professor who teaches, DO NOT TAKE HIM!  He does not teach; he only gives TONS of HW.
Not easy.  he makes you work on your own to do well.  He won't go over things in the book if you ask stupid questions BUT if you study and do the reading he is very helpful

His tests are very hard, doesn't help you out when you have a questions, refers you to the TA Lee. Everyday we just go over HW in class. You don't learn anything in class. Tests are open book because he knows you will fail it wasn't open book. Highly don't take Whitfield if you plan on getting a good grade.

Are you kidding me? I pay 40K a year, for by far the worst professor that I have ever had at Northeastern. Prof Whitfield clearly does not know how to teach, nor is he helpful to students when you ask him a question. Take any other Finance prof BUT DO NOT TAKE WHITFIELD!! That is if you plan on passing. And no he doesn't curve!
No Comments
The worst teacher i have ever had. When you ask him a question in class, his answer..i dont know. do not take his class

he's a nice guy and trys to make class interesting but if you are looking for an easy class stay clear...he doesn't really teach and expects you to learn the material on your own...his tests are all open book however they are timed and not easy at all
A girl in the class once asked him a question from the homework, after a long pause he replied "yeah you uh better find someone to explain that to you"... enough said

He doesn't teach the class he just makes the students go over the problems that he assigned the previous night.  He doesn't know how to use a TI-83 even though the applications are required for tests.  Huge homework assignments collected for very little of overall grade.  Run the other way on this guy!

Whitfield is a horrible professor, he doesn't teach at all. In class he just goes over HW. If you have to take this class, take it with a different professor, unless you don't mind teaching yourself from a book.
No Comments
Fun teacher. (HLTH2200)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had Matt for Basic Clinical Skills and he is amazing! He is definitely a yapper but he does such a great job of explaining things. He is very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about the subject. The class itself wasn't particularly challenging, but the skills and the connections I made were very valuable.

Matt is the best! He's one out of three amazing instructors for this class and imo, my favorite. He runs the lab portion of the EMT training program, and he's great at explaining everything in detail. Overall, he's a really chill guy and is always open to chatting about the field or anything beyond.

Genuinely one of the most invested professors and so easy to talk to. He gives advice that is meant to help you beyond the classroom because he's so experienced in his field. You can tell he actually likes to teach and wants to be there.
had wolfe for 3 classes and he's one of the most humble and caring professors i've ever met. truly a wonderful person. very easy grader and coursework is pretty light

I feel his class wasn't esay, but he is an easy guy. Go and talk to him is extremely helpful, and it's a way to get an A. GOOD class, a lot of discussions and readings. Overall, excellent! I finally got an A...

Easy class, but you have to read and you have to go to class. you lose points on your final grade for every class you miss. no quizzes or exams and no final, but 2 papers. reading groups every wednesday. and you need to do volunteer work. good class tho. useful for those going into education, just fun for those not interested in education.

I wasn't sure going in, but I ended up loving the class. His classes were varied, so it was never boring. He's a great teacher, very understanding. Make sure to check spelling and grammar before turning anything it to him.

A really cool professor.  He's very down to earth and structures his class like a discussion group more than a traditional classroom, which is great.  Also he schedules things nicely and it breaks up the three hours very effectively.  3 papers, one was longer, but he grades fairly.

AMAZING teacher. Real fun, and swears a lot. Easy grader, and pays attention to each student. Papers are easy. His son has Cerebal Palsy, and he brings him in to talk to the class, that was fun. Class is well structured: movies, mini lectures, LOTS of group activities, and discussions. Never boring. HIGHLY reccommended!!!
Write 3 essays or 2 essays and 1 presentation all semester.  Keeps a 3 hour class moving pretty well and he's not too boring.  It's a really easy class.

your grade is mostly 2 group projects and 2 essays , her lectures are very boring and its mostly just students and her doing pointless debates, the class is also very very very long, but overall this was an easy NU path class and the movies were cool, just the readings are long and boring, grades are hidden as well
You have to learn how to write differently

Three hours of nothing.She talked for a semester, and I learned nothing from her and everything from the readings. (Also she clearly doesn't like sci fi, she didn't know how Luke's hand got cut off in Star Wars, and called Kirk "Kurt".) Why teach if you don't know/care about sci fi? Didn't feel like a film, philosophy, or religion class. :(

Was expecting a chill elective to watch films, and was instead met with dense lectures and films about religion. Assignments weren't difficult but felt pointless. She doesn't want to see her students succeed. Minimal interactions with her but were all abysmal. Hasn't updated her lectures since COVID... let that sink in.

A take-home exam referenced a book; when my friend asked where the link to this book was located in Canvas, Sheila refused to say because it was "unfair." My friend checked probably 12x for it. Why is knowing where a link is located in Canvas more important than the book's contents. Put checks and balances into academia to correct stupid thinking.

Was marketed at a Labeled as a Philosophy Film class turns out its a religion class about only about Christianity and only has western movies, which is disappointing. Anyone looking for a chill class to watch movies DO NOT TAKE. You watch the movies outside of class and spend 4 hours discussing them.

The films we watched were pretty cool, she will turn you into a sci-fi fan. I thought our class discussions were always so interesting to just sit back and listen to, we really discuss a lot of topics such as religion, philosophy, technology, etc. She was so knowledgable as well on a lot of topics, would def take a course with her again.

lecture lecture lecture. makes lots of typos/unclear instructions on assignments that she over explains the hell out of. movies are eh, lots of group projects/participation. not a good class to take in your fifth year of school

Solid professor, I don't understand some of the more negative reviews. Very responsive and she gives plenty of time between assignments. This class is a rough class if you procrastinate I learned that the hard way haha, but grades fairly and the final project was fun
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The classes were 3 and a half hours long and sucked the life out of me. The classes are very lecture heavy, she monologues the whole time. You're meant to watch the movies outside of class and do a lot reading. She also has a very strict late policy and is a tough grader. She didn't grant me my accommodations. Would not recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Was great to talk to after class if you had adjacent interests to the class material. However, she is very repetitive of points she makes week-to-week in lectures and often goes on monologues that are difficult to pay attention to and prevent continuous student engagement. Be ready to do a group project that spans the whole semester.
Does the bare minimum to help students outside of class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really easy class, and interesting at points, but the hour long lectures that each class opened with were not only irrelevant but also painful to sit through. Shes honestly really nice but every week she'll basically just reword what she said the week before. I'd recommend the class if you have the ability to just zone out for all her talking

She's intelligent and nice but I never thought I'd pay someone so much money to take all of the enjoyment out of watching movies. No assignment is too much work by itself, but all of the assignments together are an absurd burden for the students and instructor. Wouldn't take again.

The professor is very knowledgable. Outside of class, marvelous person to have a chat with, but in class the course is tedious. The assignments are graded with strict attention to detail so you need to give it your entire focus. Would have given a 5 if it was just about grading the person, but class wise it's a 3 for me, making it a 4 overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Winborne is pretty blunt and dry. The class is about 3 hours or so long so be ready for that but it is ridiculously easy. You watch pretty good movies for 90% of the classes. The lectures before and after are really boring but the work is minuscule, Easy A if you show up.

Class was pitched and written as a Philosophical class when in realty it's a boring, bland, religion class. Ms. Wilborne more than certainly knows her stuff, but the 1-2 hour monotone lectures are just as interesting as they sound. Sprinkle in a bit of 2017 liberal propaganda and you have this class.
You get to watch movies a lot which is great. She talks for a very long time and is very boring though.

Would not recommend this class. She's incredibly knowledgable and that shows, but lectures are boring and miserable. Watching movies is nice, but I didn't enjoy writing about them and the topics we covered in class were unclear and boring.  She's really nice and helpful, I just didn't like her lectures.

You watch really good movies and have two write two essays on pretty interesting topics. Although her lectures are pretty brutal and long. Take this class if you dont really want to do work (other than the two papers and presentation).

One of the most boring classes I took. The movies we watched were good for the most part, yet the hour or two of lecture makes you want to die. Her teaching style is so rudimentary that you'll wonder if she is actually a human or just a robot reading from a script. Her comments and reasons for grading are loose and based seemingly on nothing.

This is an excellent class and Sheila Winborne is an excellent professor. The content is very thought-provoking, and taking this class over the summer was a great decision. Movies all summer! Only downside is that she tends to lecture for a while. Listen, remain engaged, and do the work (2 papers, and choice for final project) and it's an easy A.

Professor Winborne is one the most knowledgable professors that I have had to date. I have been impressed with how diverse her knowledge base is. She makes the class very thought-provoking by incorporating society, religion, sociology, and even psychology. I would recommend this class to anyone.

IF ENGLISH IS NOT YOUR FIRST LANGUAGE STAY AWAY. IF ENGLISH IS YOUR FIRST LANGUAGE GET READY TO BE GRADED HARSHLY. KEEP IN MIND THIS IS NOT A RELIGION CLASS IT IS AN ENGLISH CLASS!!!. AND I am not even joking, when I say that she thought it was necessary to teach us about spell-check on word!!! ALSO SHE WILL PUT YOU UNDER SCRUTINY ON EVERY CITATION

Very easy, but very boring. The professor is not very articulate in her lectures, and class discussion is strained at best. Watched classic films, but if it was a short film then the rest of class was miserable. Very easy, only 2 papers and a presentation, and one worksheet per class. Very easy.
One of the least stimulating professors and courses I've taken at Northeastern. Easy grade, but absolutely miserable whenever you're *not* watching a film.

Sheila is awesome. She's really passionate about apocalyptic discussion and they movies shown in class are great. That class is really long, which sucks but the course work isn't demanding and there are no exams! She is super friendly and very approachable. Great class!

Melissa is a great first year professor. She doesn't grade you based on your writing but rather if you completed the assignment and actually put effort into it. There are a lot of papers but at max it was 4-5 hours worth of work per week. The one thing that's annoying is that extra credit is mandatory to get an A but they're pretty small.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: attendance is mandatory, assignments are graded on completion. Good teacher, useful lectures.

This teacher is very good. While some lectures can be long and repetitive, most of the info given is beneficial. The class is contract grading which makes it easier and the instructor gives a good amount of feedback on all papers and really wants the students to improve their writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I honestly have no idea how there are any bad reviews. She was a great prof, used the grading contract so it's more about effort than subjective grading, and there's clear outlines on what needs to be accomplished for each assignment. Heavy on peer review. I really enjoyed it, would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing. She wants to see you succeed and her grading contract is easy to follow. She cares about her students deeply.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: This woman talks about absolutely nothing for the entire class and then threatens to lower your grade if you don't pay attention. DO NOT TAKE HER!!!!

I'm genuinely surprised by the bad reviews here. I took AWD in the Tech Professions with Melissa and I was originally scared because I hate writing. She was a superb professor, and her course got me excited to write. She used Contract Grading, which means you just have to turn stuff in complete to get a good grade. Revision days were helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor, quite a bit of work is assigned but the professor is determined to see you do well and will assist you if you reach out to her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I saw the bad reviews so I was nervous about taking her class, but Melissa was an awesome prof. She was so helpful with questions on assignments and she gave feedback on every draft so you knew what you had to change for the final. Very accommodating and accessible outside of class. Yes, AWD is a lot of work, but I thought her grading was fair.

Melissa cares for education & it comes through when teaching. She is a bit verbose but explains things really well. Her examples are specifically picked to cater to class needs. She made citations interesting (wild!) & I always got good feedback on my projects. Her grading is fair, if a bit tough. She's good if you want to learn & don't mind work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: No relation between effort put in and grade. The projects I spent no time on were the ones I got the best grade on. She did not know enough about engineering to adequately grade any paper. At the end I wished I had much spent less time on the class and more time on other classes where I could learn something.
The teacher is very nice and know her stuff about writing. However, grading is very tough and it becomes frustrating half way throughout the semester.

At some point in the semester you may begin to wonder whether this is a class or a psychological experiment designed to make students off themselves. However, if you get through it and participate you will learn a lot. If you're looking to cruise through AWD, Melissa is not the instructor for you.

Extremely hard grader. She blabbles on and on about useless things. Most of her assignments were useless and I did not benefit from them in any way.  The course description was also not accurate.  She does not communicate clearly and grades too harshly.

Easily one of the worst teachers I have had in college. She paces back and forth the entire class which so frustrating. She also gives so much busy work its ridiculous. Course description was for Business Writing and none of the writing assignments were beneficial to being a business major. She is an extremely harsh grader as well. AVOID HER!

Bad experience with Sarah Woodside as my ORBG professor. Took the class async during Summer I, and had a few key issues with her. She was very unresponsive and often required multiple emails to get a hold of. She is late with grading and subjective with how she evaluates work against her own rubric, specifically for writing assignments. More…

I think this woman is my all time favorite professor. She will redirect you rather than telling you you're wrong. The class format is fun, we have simulation negotiations every other class. I have gotten to know everyone bc of this & shes never put me on the spot. Very chill interesting class, def recommend it.
Great course, very informative and applicable content. She is very nice and cares about her students.

Prof. Woodside has a nuanced understanding of course concepts, and her lectures are extremely theory heavy. Be prepared to know minute details for exams/projects. Class moves quickly. She has clear evaluation criteria but is a tough grader w/very specific expectations. She is personable and fosters a friendly, positive classroom environment.

Woodside is one of the best professors I've ever had. She is incredibly respectful of students' needs and accommodating to those who are struggling. Her lectures and the textbook complement each other well without being overwhelming. She gives great feedback on papers and makes expectations clear. You will learn a lot from her. I recommend 100%.

I really enjoyed this class and thought Wolfgang was a decent teacher. I highly recommend reading the textbook and doing practice in it as I did that and I think thats why I thought the class was super easy while it seems like a lot of people thought it was hard. Would be nice if we learned a little about actually using a database in bigger pro.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor. Extremely intuitive to follow and everything in the course builds off of the intuition he lays out for you. If you want an easy A I highly recommend, if you want a harder course that you may learn more in take Mark Fontenot(something like that). Cutoff for an A was only a 73 so if you put in some effort it is yours.

Fantastic professor. Lectures are very interesting and easy to follow. Not a lot of homework and course is capped with a group project which is fun but too simple and you don't gain a lot of knowledge from it. Tests are kind of hard but it's graded on a very heavy curve so it's easy to do well on them. People rating him low just didn't go to class.

very unclear what final would even be one as he neglected to answer piazza in a timely manner for 3 day timespan before final. I am telling anyone reading this right now do not take this guy. I dont care if this is your only section take a different class. Do not take this guy. @Wolfgang 16 x 1.5 = 24 not like 33 or whatever that was

Actually awful and the worst experience I've had a northeastern. All my professors have been great but he by far is the worst of all and doesnt even compare to my worst before that. I would rather take a Graduate course than this BS. Lied about exam length, project grading rubic magically changes based on group size despite that never being stated.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: wow. bad idea.

Power tripping professor, lies about exam length (claims final had 1.5x the questions, in reality had far more). You will suffer on the exams, which have a 60 range average. You will suffer in this course. AVOID. AVOID. AVOID.

Just took the final exam. Bro said it would be 1.5x the length of the other exams (16 questions) and it was 38 (not 1.5x). Honestly just a really bad professsor overall and a lowlife you shouldn't take. Hope he losses his job ngl
This class was light work honestly yall just gotta get good

He is an incredibly difficult professor. You will get the subject matter beaten into you by the end of the year. Tests are 60% of your grade, and everything is on a curve, meaning you don't know your grade until the end of the year. Take only if it's your only hard class, I took it with OOD, my best test 23/41. If you have him, GL.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: AVOID AT ALL COSTS FOR THIS COURSE AND TAKE ANY OTHER PROF. Actually hated this guy and his grading

Overall, fine class. The other sections of databases are liked better and people learn way more(I've heard good things about someone named Mark) but Wolfgang is fine imo. Lectures are a bit slow and hard to follow unless you're a zombie but lecture slides are helpful. Tests are fine if you go to class. Not a fan of him reading slides during class.

Undoubtedly a polarizing professor that may come off as just a harsh grader at first, but the truth is he wants his students to succeed by providing them with more content than other database lecture classes. Always available outside of class to answer lingering questions. VERY hard exams.

2 midterms and 1 final exam 50% of your grade, ON PAPER, in 2025. Can't believe that there is AI taking jobs and we at Northeastern University are out here taking SQL and Database theory ON PAPER. Just a pure ego decision to make us take exams on paper. Please complain about this course and avoid until later on if you can in hopes of change.
HE IS AMAZING! I give him 7/5. But rmf only gives max of 5/5 so the two extra point is overflow.
Bro decided to give us 1 hour to write 16 different sql queries by hand. Majority of the class did not finish. Avoid him please.

A lot harder than the other DB design professors at Northeastern in terms of content and pacing. Grades on participation (penalizes quiet, more introverted learners with anxiety). Exams are a large part of the grade and very hard. Responds to emails late and only had office hours once a week for half an hour very early in the morning.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Heavy on tests and homework is really difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable teacher, clearly understands database design quite well. He explains things too technically, but can clear things up if asked. Very willing to help outside of class. Would reccomend this class if interested in working with databases.
Excellent professor, relatively easy material and not as hard as people make it seem. Go to class, study the homework and quizzes, and you'll ace the tests.

Wright makes her tests somewhat difficult but she makes sure students are well prepared with practice problems and a study guide. She is a fair grader for tests, and projects giving as much credit as possible. Cengage hw was more time consuming as the class progressed.

She is a great lecturer! Inspired me to change my concentration to accounting. She's always enthusiastic and makes everything clear even though some concepts are hard to understand. She only teaches what you need to know. If you do what she asks, you will be fine. Homework every week but not bad. Definitely would take her class again

Nicole Wright is an amazing financial accounting teacher. The class is very easy as long as you show up and pay attention. Tests and quizzes are much easier than other accounting professors and she is very passionate about the subject. Definitely would highly recommend her.
Made accounting very exciting and a great person in general
Daniel is a wonderful guy and makes complicated systems so simple!
So terrible so much textbook reading
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Amazing class! Professor Wu always came prepared with clear and concise lectures. Tough grader, but as long as you go to all the lectures it's an ez A.
Very helpful materials and is available outside of class! Also had a very helpful TA!
Very knowledgable and smart. Helped me get to where I wanted in my skill set. 10/10 would take again! :)

MKTG2209 online. Will never give you a higher grade than a 96 on HW/assignments making it very difficult to stay at an A, grades harshly especially on HW @ end of sem. So much busy work for a class of non-DMSB majors, more than any of my actual major classes this semester. If you take this, make sure to do well on quizzes and final group project.

Believes one can't score higher than a 96... So you won't be able to get a 100% on anything except his quizzes. The course's grading is well balanced, but homework is somewhat long and you need to be extremely detailed to do well. Somewhat flexible with extensions, but not the best.

This class may be an easy A, but it is unbearable to spend that much time in the room with Wright. If you want someone who laughs at his own jokes, who cares only to hear his voice, who will not teach you anything because he is so self-obsessed, go right ahead and take this class. Otherwise, seek out any other marketing class. You'll thank me.
He's a good professor, very enthusiastic about marketing as well. Class isn't too hard either, he's a pretty easy grader and goes out of his way to harp on the important stuff. Definitely recommended

He makes the class interesting and tries to help out. He is also willing to help outside of class. if zou miss his class he gets angry and takes attendace.. He is somewhat easy. some of this tests are hard and some are easy

I do not like him because he thinks he i the only one to know the truth and makes you feel stupid if you think differently. Class is interesting and the tests are fair. The online simulation is a very important part of the grade so make sure you do well on it.

Wright is very knowledgable and enthusiastic about the subject and makes class interesting with lots of open discussion. He is a tough grader on the case write-ups and holds everyone to extremely high standards on all assignments and class participation. Be sure to come to class prepared because he will not be afraid to make an example out of you.
Great guy who knows what he is talking about. Crystal clear on what is going to be on the test and makes the class fun.
Extremely nice, very helpful, entertaining, obviously cares about marketing and the kids a lot. Makes you aware of marketing in the news.

Great Professor! Really funny and helpful. You don't need to buy the book for intro to marketing, you never use it and the tests are based completely on his slides, really easy if you study them. Class participation is important. Really nice teacher, definitely take his class

I don't like him. I went to him during office hours and he was essentially useless. Is a HARD grader on case write-ups which account for 40% of your grade. He loves the slides he posts and expects you to use them, even if you don't believe in them. Final project is wicked hard but really makes you learn.
outstanding professor with a sense of humor. Liked his class very much, and participation/attendance counts 20%, which makes his class more buzzing. i am interested in Marketing now more than ever.
Great Professor!  I learned a lot about Marketing and it was interesting as well!  He tells extremely funny stories to relate the material to real life experiences!

If you are interested in a marketing career, try to take graduate level classes with him. Otherwise, stay away!  Expects you to use fancy long terms to describe processes and strategies that don't really have any substance or meaning. I felt like I was in a liberal arts class where the Prof. is trying to make something out of nothing!

Great class and dedicated Professor.  He expects work from you, but its worth it and very interesting.  I've him for two of my marketing classes and I'm always engaged and interested in the material.  He works hard to keep us updated with the latest marketing news and trends.  very real world!

Prof Wright is very knowledgeable and had interesting lectures. There are not a lot of assigments so the ones you do have you really have to do well on. Homework just consists of reading cases for class discussion. The group term project is pretty extensive and you dont get to pick your group!

Great Prof. Watch out for tests. Learn the slides by memory and the class is super easy. Team project is really easy as long as you meet early in the semester. Great intro to marketing class to take. Really funny at times.

Prof. Wright is an awesome prof.!! He is also a funny nice guy and very helpful.  He makes this class very easy but your walk away learning a lot.  No tests, just case write-ups and a group presentation. This class is definitely worth taking with him.

He was ok - a little strange. Tough grader given the fact that AFTER he turns graded assignments back he tells you how he wanted the assignment to be done. You'll learn a lot from the cases but he is not always clear on how he wants things to be done. Be careful...
Very entertaining. Class participation is a huge part of your grade. He grades tough on the case studies. No tests.

Probably the most interesting class I've been in.  The assignments were fun to do and I definitely learned from them.  Other than the fact he gets a lil too excited over marketing, he's a good professor.

what an awesome professor!!! he was by far the best one ever!  Very relatable, understanding, and gives great notes.  He makes marketing very interesting for what it's worth.. def take him if you have the chance!

such a great professor!  he shares his work experience, plus examples and visuals aplenty.  makes the class interesting by getting the class involved with fun exercises and interesting points of view.  group projects and very fair tests.  by far the best marketing prof at NU!
No Comments
No Comments

He is always willing to help and he shares a lot of his work experiences. No exams, 2 papers, group projects.  He goes over the cases and discuss the answers to the questions in class but does not provide a print out of them.
impolite, unfair, no love

Such a great teacher. She is really loves history and it shows in the way she teaches. She captivates the classroom and has a great sense of humor, by far my favorite teacher. She is so sweet and intelligent, and doesnt look down on any of her students. love her.
had to correct her many times because her facts were not correct.
she is realy nice and helpful

I LOVE Ms.Wyka!!! She is one of the best I've had and made me love history. She is so intelligent and interesting and quite fair. She jokes around and makes class a pleasure. She will give exta help too and basically tell you what you need to do to do well on papers. :) :) I lovvveee her.
good teacher...interesting
No Comments

I had to double check that the Professor's name was correct because I couldn't believe the ratings. This class is such a waste of time. Professor Wang is probably too bored to take this class seriously, and it shows. You learn a bunch of outdated tech and buzzwords that won't get you anywhere in the real world. Complete waste of time.

very subjective grader and the lectures are impossible to pay attention to/learn from. somehow i managed to get a 82 on the final studying two days before/95 in the class after barely paying attention or learning anything all semester so take that as you will.

Wang is a sweet, caring, and funny guy. The class is incredibly boring (for me) and the lectures don't help with that, but that isn't his fault. There is one exam (on paper) and it's exactly like the study guide he provides, along with weekly quizzes based off of the text book and three group projects. He is a light grader and wants success for us!

Good teacher, but an extremely boring subject. The class feels obsolete. The grading is clear for the most part. He assigns weekly open book quizzes where you can find all the answers in the textbook. All other assignments were manageable. However, his participation grading is inconsistent and changes as the semester goes. Luckily, it's only 10%
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The professor assigns an overwhelming amount of reading, yet only covers a small fraction of it in class. Exams and quizzes are based on the readings rather than lectures, so success in this course depends entirely on independent study. That said, he is a nice guy!
Aced the class! The exam was tough, even for open book, but I managed to pull through. The final project was fun.

I came to this course with a limited background in programming due to my field. I spent considerable time and effort, and it proved rewarding. The instructor shared all course materials and codes, which was very helpful for learning and review. I gained valuable insights into data mining and machine learning, and I am pleased with my final grade.

Professor Wang is passionate about the course and very knowledgeable about information systems. His lectures were well organized and he tried to make them exciting. He's caring, encouraging, and fair. The Excel and SQL assignments were actually fun. Overall, I truly enjoyed this course.
This professor is amazing. No joke, lectures are interesting, and his grading seems fair. Not gonna complain.

This teacher is super nice and tries to keep class engaged. Lectures are long and kind of boring but he tries to add in videos to switch it up. Info on PowerPoint slides isn't always in the textbook. There are online quizzes after each chapter based on the reading on canvas. There are a couple group projects that aren't bad and 1 exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is great. The class is completely lecture based which can get boring but the information itself is interesting and the projects are fun and easy.
This professor is very good, and his homework's are very easy, also the test is very easy, so u can get an A easily!
Good professor, great lecture.

Prof. Wang's course covers a wide scope of topics but he helped apply real-world company examples and topics to contextualize them. He is knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the topics. Most importantly, he cares about students.

Try hard & you will do well. I didn't care much about this class and GENUINELY don't think I deserved to pass but I believe he curved it and now I am. Has a thick accent but I didn't find it too hard to understand. Everyone was very skeptical at first and complained, but was comfortable at the end. He just a chill guy; patient and kind.

Avoid at all costs! Very difficult to understand because of his accent and lectures are unengaging-he just talks to the board with no acknowledgement of the class. His grading is awful as well because he grades people's tests differently meaning you could get the same answer as someone else and get different points.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: chill guy, has an accent that is hard to understand initially but you get used to it. Class itself is not hard if you just show up and take notes. was always willing to make time for office hours and work around when you are free. cumulative final but pretty much is most of the stuff from later chapters (14-15)
I would take another professor because every other stats test is online and you can use laptops and this one is straight paper but he's a good teacher and explains things well

You're really on your own with this professor. Classes are just downloading files and importing into python with little to no explanation of actual concepts. Tests aren't too hard if you do the homework. Class is just a waste of time, though.

AVOID. You will come out of this class having learned nothing. Good intentions, but outrageously terrible professor. He has a hard time describing any concept and his syllabus is all over the place. He does not entirely understand the material and classes are a drag. Do not waste your tuition dollars on this guy. Do not take this class.

AVOID. Nice guy, but horrible teacher. Did not learn a single thing and exams are worth majority of your grade. Exams on paper. Lectures are long, boring, confusing. Strong accent and language barrier. Willing to answer questions but his responses are barely helpful. Does not give exam feedback just an X mark.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor is very caring. He cares about the success of his students. He is easily available. He is very knowledgeable. What you learn is very practical, and he summarizes all the information you learn in class to what actually matters. It is very clear what to study and how to get a good grade. One of the best I have had at Northeastern.
Prof talked highly of himself. He never realized the class was barley engaged. Tests were all on canvas, reasoning with him was hard and he never cared for office hours.

He does many examples in class that are helpful for hw/in-class work. However, they aren't always relevant to tests and quizzes. All of the tests and quizzes are online, and there isn't a lot of homework (as long as you're efficient in class). His accent is hard to understand, but you'll adapt. He genuinely cares about the success of his students.

Grading was homework 40%, mid-term 30%, cumulative final 30%. You'll have to do a lot of self-study because he didn't really take the time to explain the python coding we did. Exams consist of statistics problems that he never went over in class and 1 coding question. He does allow cheat sheets for his exams so definitely take advantage of that
No rubric for grading assignments. Don't take this Professor for any course.
waste time!  waste money

He is one of the best professors I ever had at Northeastern University. The lecture contains lots of new concepts which means it's a bit lecture heavy, but he always tries to explain it in great detail and makes sure everyone follows him.
Highly recommend! I don't know where bad comments come from.
He's really nice and understanding. Doesn't get annoyed if you have to ask him to explain things multiple times. Would def take his class again

Even though he has a really bad accent in English, and the grade of the course is only divided into 3 parts, which is problem set 1, 2, and a take-home final exam. The grades he gave were HIGHER than other profs! (As the average grade of the 1st assignment was 88 and I got 100 points. The average of other sections taught by Chris was only 60%.)

Xiaoping is easily the worst prof I've ever had. His accent makes classes difficult to understand and it is hard to see his writing. Concepts that take little time to understand are drawn out to unnecessary lengths and participation is rarely encouraged. You'll wish you took the AP exam after having Liu. DON'T TAKE HIS CLASSES.

Hes a very nice guy but he can be very hard to understand at times and I found other stats classes learning way more than we were because of the slow pace of the class. Tests are worth 85% of your grade. Would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Exam is 85% of the grade so get ready to study for the tests. Final is cumulative, which is 15 chapters. He is very, very, very bad at English and lacks of professional communication both written and oral. This makes his lectures to be extremely monotonous and confusing > skip classes. Self-studying is the key for the course. Easy grader though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: For the most part, homework and exams are fairly easy. Just be careful with the final exam. The final exam will get you if you don't pay attention. Practice with the handouts and review the powerpoints. Online quizzes.

He's a current professor at Central Connecticut State University now. But besides that, very kind and helpful person. Gives good feedback about anything you may ask. Quizzes and tests are easy, all online but in person. Final week of class is a group presentation.

Really caring professor but he grades the group project and participation very harshly. Tests aren't too bad - you get a cheat sheet and he drops the lowest but they're not exactly easy to study for. Easy to do well (B+ to A-) but challenging to get an A. Overall a very kind and knowledgeable professor.

Professor Ling is super easy going and great at teaching. His classes are lecture style with slideshows that accompany textbook chapters, so if you miss a class you can just catch up by reading the book and looking over the slides. He is very understanding and I would definitely rec him if you are registering for marketing.
easy class great professor easy tests overall great

If you ever have to take intro to marketing, he's the professor to go with. He is a clear grader and has very explanatory questions and papers. He is very understanding and easily accessible. I dont think he has been in NEU long but if he stays, I am sure he will gain lots of recognition amongst students.

Prof liu isn't a bad teacher but his lectures are so boring I feel like I'm going to fall asleep. His tests are not too bad if you study but he made the final impossible and everyone I know bombed it, but he gave a fat curve. Overall it isn't hard to get a good grade since the hws/assignments are easy.

Professor Liu cares a lot about his students! It is important to attend lectures (attendance is worth 10% of your grade). Tests were overall very reasonable (final more difficult than midterms). Easy weekly homework points and one short project at the end of the semester. I would definitely recommend and would take another one of his courses!
Good teacher, generous grader, and cared that students succeeded. Lectures are dry but that is to be expected from profit analysis
Kelvin is a nice professor and the class is pretty easy if you attend classes and pay attention. He's very helpful and is a nice grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor. Really responsive to emails and questions from students. Very nice guy. If you don't get bored by the lectures and actually study, you will do well in this class.

This professor wasn't the most exciting, but he taught the material effectively. I didn't have a great time learning but I did usually come out of class knowing what was going on. As long as you study and show up for most classes I think you can do pretty well. His study guides and reviews before tests are very helpful for studying.

Disagree with most of the ratings, Prof. Liu was friendly, caring and was available if you asked for help. Going to class is important, and people tend not to go, which is why many don't do well. Go to class, participate and ask for help when needed and you'll get an easy A.
He's a pretty good professor and FR2 with him was pretty easy honestly. Just pay attention and most of the tests are identical to the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he is your typical lecturer, though he doesn't even lecture by PowerPoint presentations. He lectures by Word Documents. Very dry course regardless of the professor, but he will make it much worse.

He's your most basic lecturer professor out there. If you can do well in class where the professor just reads notes at you and you have to teach yourself, then he's not bad. Doesn't seem to really care about the class or students very much, seems like he's more of a research guy. Exams questions aren't from the notes and he doesn't give enough time

Don't agree with previous reviews. Prof Liu is actually really efficient and effective with his lectures. Sure, they're a bit heavy in content but not a minute is wasted in class. He's thorough with the concepts and his in class handouts really set you up for success as long as you supplement it with the textbook questions as practice. Amazing guy!

He puts the most minimal effort into class. He takes all lecture directly from the textbook and does not directly teach us half of what we are tested on. He also says that the textbook is not required but if you do not do the homework from the textbook you don't have enough practice problems to succeed. I'd avoid him at least in the hybrid format.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Not a bad person, but the way he teaches and his exams are different. Multiple choice and open response,Lots of in class excercises, the exams are more difficult, powerpoint lectures but they are blank prior to class and  if you don't attend you will never know the steps to the problems, won't post the finished version online,avoid if not acct majo
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He doesn't teach much but gives you lots of questions to do in class. He skips steps because he thought everyone understand. He  should change the way he teach. Students might like him or hate him.

I don't know why people giving him poor rating, I think he is a very good professor, he explained the material clearly, has a organized logic for his teaching. Exam could be difficult, but if you follow his lecture, you would be fine.
I had a very tough time with him he makes a complicated subject even harder avoid if you can
His accent really gets in the way of understanding Good guy bad at teaaching so your grade suffers try to avoid him if you can

Nice teacher. Class is sometimes a little bit confusing, but if you follow you'll be ok. Do not buy the textbook because you won't use it. He has a classpac that is straight forward, well done and inexpensive.
One of my favorite professors. Easy class if you are good in accounting. DOn't buy the textbook!
This guy is the man, he comes to every class with a vest on ready to go. He gives a lot of examples and knows his stuff.

Worst professor I've had at Northeastern. He makes everything hard to understand, when it is actually quite simple. His TA grades everything, and he doesn't post the answers to the exmaples in class or answers from previous test for you to review. When you ask him a question, he gives you a possibility of answers, and leaves you confused.
Awesome professor.  I had no problem with his accent, gives a lot of examples in class so there is no excuse for not doing well.  Cool guy.

This guy is the MAN. He's awesome, super clear and gives a million examples in class, plus time to do them in class. Don't listen to the rest of the comments, his accent is fine (by no means the worst at NU) and you really have to put NO effort in to not get at least a B. It was an amazing class, I'd recommend it to everyone for Managerial.
The accent was so hard to understand and was also hard to understand the answers when you asked him a question.

Started out the year on a great foot. Really enjoyed the class and Kelvin. As the semester progressed, the class became much more tedious and Kelvin didn't seem he had a great handle of the material. Cases are annoying, but he provides ALOT of practice for tests, which are pretty easy. Overall, nice guy and easy class!

Good professor--really nice, I felt sufficiently prepared for the tests, and he didn't make the subject hard to understand.  Managerial is generally easier than Financial Acct. so that probably helped too. Would recommend! :)
She was one of the sweetest professors I've ever had. I somehow learned a lot and got a decent grade, even though I was going through a really rough time.
very nice teaching style, but seems Unwilling to supervise master's students

Professor Lin is a well-respected researcher and is clearly an expert in her field. Despite this, she is also a very caring professor who will take the time outside of class to help her students. Note that EECE7205 is a PhD level course and content moves quickly. The workload is manageable but be careful not to fall behind.

I'm glad I get to be the first to review Dr. Shelly. She's a little stale while lecturing, but clear on what she expects, and gets her point across. She's an easy grader, and very polite! She teaches off the book, so you're never lost and always have a reference. Final project is a doozy though! 10/10 professor.

Lecture heavy class and attendance matters (uses Top Hat). Somewhat ambiguous feedback, but provides a clear, in-depth outline for deliverables, so if you follow that you likely will do fine. 2 easy quizzes (20 questions each) and you are allowed a cheat sheet. As long as you stay on top of the assignments and deliverables, you'll get a good grade.

Took her for Marketing Research. The class itself is hard, so its not all on her. Although she gives good feedback, she contradicts herself in the next deliverables. She likes it when you participate and doesnt cold call. One Midterm, but you get a cheat sheet, no final either.

Took for MKTG 3401. The project is 40% of your grade and she gives HORRIBLE feedback. She constantly contradicted herself and was just overall a bad professor. Wouldn't take her. Save yourself the headache!

There's so much information presented, literally thousands of slides and they're just repetitive and bland. You can honestly read the slides and teach yourself, the only reason I came to class was for the attendance grade. The simulation is stupid asf too, my team and I did everything right and still ended up in last place. This class sucked !

You only have a few assignments so try to get your best grade on every one.The quizzes are tedious and sometimes the questions aren't as easy as you think. She's also a really tough grader for some weird reason. Also in class if you say the wrong answer she'll make a face as if you're stupid. Really annoying voice too, she's just bad overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super boring professor, every class is a lecture and she just reads off of like 50 slides that are just repetitive asf. Doesn't really feel like you're learning and there's barely any interaction or excitement in the class so it's easy to doze off. Attendance is mandatory and she's strict about it. By the end of the semester nobody even showed up.

1. She reads off her slides which is posted on canvas anyway. Attendance is compulsory and you learn nothing.
2. Her grading is extremely weird. For similar quality hws, I got three very different grades. 
3. Her quizzes have 5 multiple choice questions worth 10% of your total grade. If you even getting one question wrong, you get a 80%.

Weird professor, doesn't seem like she likes teaching at all. Her exam was open notes, but i really don't care about that. She taught SPSS, which is something she doesn't really seem to have a good grasp on. Confusing and useless lectures. meh
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She has open note tests, so you really just have to pay attention in class so you understand the material but no memorization is required. Probably the best into to marketing professor, I'd definitely recommend taking her if you want an easy class. The group project took about 1 hour of work a week outside of class but, minimal homework.

I was doing relatively well during the whole semester, and she dropped my grade after the final. She's an extremely harsh grader and seems like she doesn't want to give out high grades, even to deserving students. I wouldn't recommend taking a course with her.
Do not take this class if you want a good GPA. Take a marketing class with someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was probably the worst class I took at Northeastern and this professor was truly horrible. She was inconsiderate and seemed to enjoy giving students low grades. She made it extremely difficult to succeed in her class, and I would not recommend it to anyone.

Professor Yadin is great! She's very kind, flexible, and accessible outside of class. She makes good use of class time and grades fairly. Exams use lockdown browser but are open note so print your notes and bring them to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would not recommend this professor for marketing. She is a harsh grader, and will often give you 4.9/5 on assignments, and even then you're graded on so few assignments. Her classes consist of her just rereading the slides. She makes it more difficult than it should be to get an A, and any other marketing professor will give you an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Yadin is absolutely the best! She is super nice, flexible, and knowledgeable. She also tries her best to make classes engaging. Tests and quizzes are very fair as well. Show up to lectures, participate, and complete all assignments, and you'll do great!

She is actually very understanding and wants students to succeed. After the first two exams, she gave a feedback survey on lectures, teaching, and exams. Exams are reasonable and open note, but rushed; practice exams help. Homework is completion-based, group project helpful, extra credit available, and effort counts toward your grade.

The worst teacher I have ever had. Awful teaching method. Terrible grading approach. My friends at previous university of this professor (North Carolina State Uni) also had very bad experiences with her. The main reason why this professor came to Northeastern University was that there were so many complaints against her at the previous university.

Her class is awful. she is not recommended at all. Homework takes forever and is very hard, long and kind of useless. The textbook is totally vague and confusing!! Despite all of these, the grading is a disaster!!!
Tough professor, with no flexibility at all.

Professor Wang is an ok professor, though you go through abt 50 slides within a 2 hour period 2x a week. He usually warns you about pop quizzes beforehand. He rarely gives homework and doesn't do practice programming during class. Midterm and final were hard, but his final project is easy. Straightforward, easy to reach out to, responds quick.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Unorganized prof, scattered slides. Wasted semester; no new knowledge if you've taken an intro to deep learning course. Mostly shares personal opinions and irrelevant knowledge. Not technical at all for an "ADVANCES in deep learning" class. Easy course because he doesn't care at all. The TAs do all the work. Save your time and money. HARD PASS.
The professor is really chill. Midterm and final exams are very easy (open-book). The grading was okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: FINA3303 was amazing with the prof. Jang! Her lectures were deep, engaging, and intellectually rewarding. Exams were fair but challenging. Also provides pratice exam. Since her unexpected leave, the replacement was diaster: cut the interesting parts, replaced them with dry concepts, and tests only on tiny details no one cares. Missed her lectures.

I loved her class! I am by no means any finance genius but she truly did care about my success and was always available during her office hours. Her tests were tough but she curves grades at the end of the semester! As long as you come to class and put the work in you will do great!

I took Prof Jang's FINA3303 class and she's very knowledgeable and a caring professor but it's such a difficult class! Be sure to study hard and go to her office hours. She's very generous with grading overall which is appreciated!

She's a super nice person, but her exams are hard in the way that it's super conceptual and challenging. She's a great person, but I just couldn't find a way to do well in her class despite visiting her in office hours and studying forever.
I would totally recommend her class. Not only did I enjoy her teaching in FINA2201, but I also chose to take her Investments class the following semester. She's awesome

Really great professor! Course content was extremely clear. Slides had all the information you needed to master for exams. Her exams were fair and based off of the many in class practice problems we worked through together. She also provides practice tests before exams that reflect the difficulty of the actual test.

The professor is extremely nice and responsive to emails. I took it as an asynchronous class, but the lectures were explained well, and it was easy to follow. The only issue was that the group project was annoying to do asynchronously, but other than that, it was a good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took her FINA3301 class. It was 3 exams, 2 group projects, and some hw assignments. Practice exams are helpful; the exams aren't too bad (Canvas in-person exams). Attendance is mandatory (3 absences allowed) and lectures are pretty boring (mostly reading off slides) but overall not a bad experience. Group work is very tedious

Her FINA 3301 class was good. She is the type of lecturer who understands students, she is flexible with deadlines, allows a few absences, and is chill in general. Lectures are on the dry end but occasionally says a decent joke or two. The final exam is tough.
Hard tests, but she gives good study guides. She wants to see you do well, funny at times and nice overall. Enjoyed having her be a proffesor.

Definitely take her if you can! She can be hard to understand sometimes and her tests aren't super consistent with the material but theres a huge curve and shes so sweet/caring! One of the better finance professors at Northeastern

10/10! Very based and will cold call you and make make a joke or two if you get the answer wrong but really cares about her students. Overall good at teaching, took her for Finance 2201 really not that much to be covered but she makes it interesting and def would take her if you can.

Very sweet and caring prof. She makes sure you understand the topics before moving on. She makes jokes here and there and will also ask about you. Has a slight accent, but you can understand her fine. Overall, would take her again.

Class is mostly her reading through the slides– usually rushes through the examples without giving much time for you to do it yourself. But it's really easy to fall behind on the material if you don't attend class and try to follow along with examples. She wants you to do well and gives good practice tests before assessments, plus extra credit!

She cares about her students and is very forgiving. She wants to see everyone do well. That being said she is all over the place, never consistent and sometimes hard to follow. She does make class virtual a lot and takes a lot of student feedback. Unfair final exam.
Shiawee Yang is a great professor who is very forgiving. The class is easy if you put in a little effort and pay attention. Homework, case studies, and exams were graded very reasonably.

Extremely fair professor. Assignments, tests, and project expectations are clear and she is forgivng about COVID circumstances. Not the most exciting class, but if you do the work you will learn and do well.

Honestly, S. Yang might be a good person but she is, unfortunately, not a great professor. And I think the problem with her Real Estate finance class is that it is INCREDIBLY boring and terms-heavy. She just throws huge financial tables and Real Estate rules/terms at you without making sure the class is at least somewhat interesting or interactive.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Yang is a great teacher and imparts years of wisdom and knowledge through lectures and group projects. Be ready to do lots of research on your location of choice to invest in. The project requires an in depth view on a RE market. Tests are fair, with plenty of review and time for questions before. Would absolutely take again!

Prof Yang is definitely not a great professor. However, if you're very interested in real estate investment then this class is a must take. The 2 major topics you cover (fin. analysis and mortgages) are broken down into such depth that you will be prepared to enter real world real estate investment after taking the class. Not bad tests if you study

Two exams and we could pick one to TAKE HOME! Projects is no biggie. Two case studies. Everybody got full credit. Thinking about a good class? its right here. Made my life much easier.  She is very nice professor. give lame jokes that only her laugh.. But  willing to help. And importantly. she does not want to fail you!
The China Trip was one of the best experiences of my life. Prof. Yang is very cool and extrememly knowledgable.
The book sucks but he explains things fairly well. Study on your own and you will do fine. He is absolutely hilarious though which always makes class fun.

Class was mad easy, as long as you can do simple math formulas and understand fairly basic concepts you should get an easy A.  The project is a cakewalk, and there really isn't any hw, plus she gives you bonus points.  Don't listen to any of the other comments, as long as you're not a complete idiot you should be able to cruise to an A.

so he is okay, don't expect to understand anything he says. be prepared to study, and do some of the homework. the final is worth like half of your grade and its cumulative and NOT easy. calc 2 is not easy and he will not make it easy but he does try.
Very nice guy, but just a completely horrible teacher. Expect to barely pass unless you know everything already

There is no homework in this class only different sections to the final project that have due dates.  But she is very very understanding as far as getting extensions, I think my group got extensions on almost every section.  Her final test did have new material.she allowed extra credit work for them.  She gave extra credit worth over 20 pts, yeahh!

While Professor Yang is friendly and kind to his students, he is not a comprehensible teacher. He tries to explain things the best he can, but it is still not clear. The textbook was completely useless. He only has you come to him for help if you are failing the class.

DO NOT TAKE CLASS WITH PROFESSOR YANG!!! She is unfair and biased. Her final was completely unfair and had all material that was new and hadn't been reviewed. The class was interesting but she is not a good professor! She is difficult to understand and her method of teaching is very poor. Her way of grading is unjust and screws you over!!!!

Such a funny prof..not afraid to make fun of the class but never in a mean way.  I actually didn't mind going to class.  He's really willing to help you out if you have a problem too.  Able to be talked out of taking quizzes as well.
Yang is the absolute man! cannot beleive how funny he is, without even trying...made every class worth while and is pretty good at making sure you know your stuff.  i love this guy

Difficult to understand. Laughs at herself in this haunting tone frequently. I was looking forward to this class and was highly disappointed. She expects you to study every single thing for the tests. Screwed me on my participation grade and no test scaling. DON'T TAKE HER! SHE IS SATANS TEACHER SENT TO EARTH FROM HELL TO RUIN GPA's!
Shiawee was one of my favorites.  If you ask her questions she will answer, you just have to put in the effort to ask.  Somehow was able to handle a class of 100 for upper level subject matter.

I went to every class, read every peice of material, studied for midterm and final, and was tested on things I had never seen before.  Half the final was new to me.  She is terribly unorganized, an airhead (if you've never met an Asian airhead and want to,  take this class).  She couldn't teach and wasted just about half of each class reviewing
i was really looking forward to this class, but was greatly disappointed. she was not helpful, difficult to understand, and does not know how to effectively teach. stay away from this woman!!

This was one of the worst teachers ever.  She was out for two weeks and assured us that certain material would not be on the final and it was.  I went into the final with a strong A and ended up with a B-.  Good class/ horrible teacher... learned nothing!

Professor Su is the best! She's very caring and very passionate about nutrition. The class is heavy on group work, but it is not overwhelming with work and very manageable. I highly recommend this class!

Professor Su is SO nice and caring. You can tell how passionate she is about nutrition. The amount of information can be a little much if you fall behind but she provides really good study guides for each quiz and the final, which you can make a cheat-sheet for. I'd absolutely recommend her, you won't find someone more accommodating and kind.

Professor Su is an amazing professor!! She truly cares about her students and keeps lectures very engaging which made going to class easy and enjoyable. The class assignments were super useful in immersing yourself in the material and allowed some personal connection too. I would take any class with Professor Su again if I had the opportunity to!

Yeemay is an amazing professor!! She is very passionate about her teaching and clearly cares about each and every student. She will make an effort to get to know each student and improve their nutrition through in class examples and lecture content. There were multiple opportunities to improve your grade and would def recommend this professor!

Shes super nice and easy to connect with. Her tests are very hard. She had to make them open notes, but they typically take the entire hour. She cares about what she teaches and is an easy grader (other than tests). Probably one of the most excellent professors I have met. If tests don't stress you out, I definitely would take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Su was a great professor she was very transparent on quiz and test content. Her lectures were personal and interesting and she applied all of the content to real life situations. I thoroughly enjoyed her class and wish she taught more.

Cannot say enough kind words about Professor Su. Really cares for her students and wants to make her class the least stressful for her students while making sure they are still learning. Is so thoughtful and understanding of students' wellbeing. Everything I have learned about my health I owe to professor su!

Professor Su is the best professor I have had at Northeastern. Her teaching style makes the material fun and easy to understand, and her lectures are based off of the textbook. The textbook is NOT difficult to understand. As long as you are engaged in class, you will do incredibly well! Lots of ways to get points/grades! Highly recommend to all

Professor Yeemay is one of my favorite professors at Northeastern. She is very knowledgeable and makes learning fun and interactive. She really cares about her students and wants them to learn about the importance of nutrition. Her class is very easy and doable. Just read the textbook and pay attention and you'll do great. She is the best!!!
