reviews.comment: Professor Su is one of the best professors I have had at Northeastern. She truly cares about the health, wellbeing, and success of all of her students and creates an inclusive environment among her class. She brings so much of knowledge to our class and uses her past experiences to apply the knowledge we are learning in class. Highly Recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: One of my favorite classes ever at Northeastern!! Makes learning very fun and applicable to clinical situations. Professor Miller is such a true wealth of knowledge and experiences. It has been such a pleasure to in her course! Very chill and relaxed, but you are guaranteed to do well!

When I decided to come to Northeastern, I hoped for knowledgeable professors who were passionate about the subjects they taught. Professor Su is just that. She is extremely knowledgable about Nutrition, with a lot of experience in the field as well. She is sure to emphasize how the information is relevant within the real world. She is outstanding!

Professor Su is very passionate about what she teaches, but her lecture slides come straight from the textbook and aren't very helpful. If you want to do well, read the textbook and take good notes, since her tests are often open note. She's really caring and wants all her students to do well. Overall one of my favorite professors this semester.

This class was made up of many grades so it was easy to redeem yourself. The way that the class is taught is not ideal, as Prof. Su uses slides from the textbook but just passes through them or talks about other topics during class time. I do not feel that I learned a lot from her teaching so just rely on reading the textbook.

Professor Roi is an exceptionally humble and knowledgeable instructor. His lectures and notes demonstrate remarkable conceptual depth and clarity, covering each topic with comprehensive detail. The course materials alone are sufficient for solid interview preparation, as they emphasize both theoretical understanding and practical application.
Really loved lectures in mathematics behind the algorithms. A big fan of Prof's paper and pen test. He is considerate when it comes to giving grades.
The materials used by Professor Roi were top notch. If you are interested in learning ML from the mathematical foundation behind the algorithms to implementing them, you would love his classes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The lectures by this professor are very insightful! The homework assignments help a lot with understanding the current topics and concepts being taught. Spend a lot of time really understanding each concept in depth to succeed in the course. I really liked the class. It was very enjoyable with a fun project opportunity at the end.
Project was really cool and he was very chill with the requirements. Very interesting and practical class!!

The three hour lectures were a bit boring but the slides were very useful for the exam. The exams are a bit tricky as they depend on understanding the materials really well. Also, never said no to an extension for me.

Roi Yehoshua is an excellent instructor who explains concepts clearly, starting from the basics and covering detailed topics. His assignments and projects effectively reinforce learning, and his fair grading rewards effort. For those willing to study, the course is manageable. I'd happily take another class with him!
The professor was clear with his concepts and was always readily available to answer questions. Also, the assignments and exams were based on practical questions.

reviews.comment: I have taken a course of Large Language models which helped me in securing a Co-op.

Professor Roi is one of the best instructors I've had! His Introduction to Data Management and Processing (IDMP) class was challenging but rewarding. He makes complex topics like SQL, NoSQL, and data modeling easy to understand and engaging. His clear teaching style and willingness to help students made a huge impact on my skills. Highly recommend!

I took this course as part of my third semester as it's a core course for msds, the course contents are excellent and helped me get more detailed knowledge on the concepts of unsupervised machine learning, the materials provided covered key math behind the algorithms and I am referring to those materials an year later (2024) post my graduation.

He is very considerate towards students. Although his classes can be challenging, he is always eager to help students understand the material. The concepts taught are particularly useful for the final project. Additionally, he offers valuable advice for the project and is generous when grading.
The course content combines theory and practice well. The mathematical derivation of the algorithm and the implementation of the code are both included.

The professor does not teach very well, reads mostly from powerpoints, homeworks are good for learning but you have to self teach everything. Unclear grading standards. Interrupts during final presentations and was not very nice. Would not recommend.

He's pretty chill in grading; homework, exams, and final project. Homeworks get tougher further into the semester. Exams are long and tricky but fun. He mostly asks things he has mentioned in the ppt but you will have to connect the dots. You'll enjoy the lecture if you participate otherwise not so much.

reviews.comment: I was worried taking DS5110 with Professor Yehoshua when I read his other reviews, but he is extremely knowledgeable in the field of DS. His lectures are very thorough and explain the material clearly. Class consisted of 4 homework assignments, two exams, and a project. His exams and homeworks were very fair and closely resembled lectures.

reviews.comment: I find his lectures really helpful because every algorithm is taught from scratch, with the foundational math behind it. I am a fan of pen-and-paper tests, so even his exams are quite fun for me.

This professor is horrible, he doesn't care about his students in the slightest. Not only does he not prepare you for the exams at all, he grades them very harshly. Trust me when I say do no take a course with this professor. The only way you could possibly succeed is if you have previously learned the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Prof. Yehoshua's class, as I felt it did a great job preparing us for writing code in the real world. Assignments were difficult at times, but because it was so heavily emphasized to not only get the code to work but to also write efficient algorithms, I believe I truly improved as a programmer.
Dog shit teacher. Teacher skipped the whole first week of class. Often canceled class 5 minutes before class.

Worst professor in terms of teaching and have a high level of difficulty for its exams. Does not curve the grade and most people end up with B+. He never used to attend his office hours and would disregard the question when asked. Horrible experience didn't learn anything and would never take a class under this professor again.

His presentation materials are really good. But he is not a good teacher. Mid term and final exams are handwritten (Theoretical questions, Not a practical oriented course). Problem sets (Assignments) are lengthy have less weightage. Most of the grade is from mid terms and final project. His grading is very tough.

reviews.comment: (Fall 2022) The professor is interested in the subject, but the material is not taught effectively. He is not that accessible outside class.

reviews.comment: Awful professor. Lectures are dry and the material is made unnecessarily difficult. Exams are pen and paper (yes, in a data science course) and focused on the math/theory behind algorithms as opposed to actually implementing them. Avoid at all costs if you want to actually learn.
Avoid this professor at all cost
Very clearly does not care about his students.

An interesting course made awful. Monotonous classes with little to no interaction. The assignments are not related to the final exam at all. Also, he makes sure that he is the one grading projects and exams. Doesn't respond to mails and inaccessible after class. The only good thing about this professor is he considers assignment deadline requests.

One of the worst professors at the university. Inaccessible after class times, boring lectures, and little to no interest in the class itself. It would be okay if he were a teacher for an elective, but he is a teacher for a required class for the EECE major. Absolutely unacceptable.

Lectures are extremely dry, and it's impossible to pay attention for more than 1/4 of the class. Homeworks are incredibly difficult if you don't have prior experience, and even with it grading policy is still ambiguous and overly strict. Tests also are overly challenging, with almost no way to prepare for them. Avoid this professor at all costs.

The professor reads lectures straight off the board and has little to no expression of eagerness to teach while lecturing. I did not go to class after the first couple of weeks as I saw no benefit when I could just read the slides he posted onto canvass. The only good side of this professor was that he gave extensions to hw whenever I asked.

The absolute embarrassing excuse of a professor.  Doesn't understand school policy, and changes the syllabus last minute. Cancels class last minute. Disrespectful to students goes on his phone while students are presenting their projects. Doesn't attend his own office hours.. the list goes on

Homework assignments took hours each to be worth little compared to exams and the final project. Lectures were pretty dry. Grading guidelines were immensely vague and subjective on all assignments and the final project. I came into this course with a year of experience in Java OOP, and found it difficult to maintain my B+ for most of the semester.
It felt more like a refresher course rather than a intro class. The only way this class will be somewhat easy is if you're proficient in coding already and understanding concepts beforehand.

Lectures were so stale with him just reading off the slides and then telling you to code, which with no prior experience was already difficult enough. The homework did not help with the test material almost at all and despite the average at around a D there was no curve. The only kids in the class who didn't struggly had prior experience.

Almost nothing is explained and gone through in class, the only way you can know what's going on is having in-depth prior knowledge. The problem sets do nothing to increase understanding of the topic, and the professor seems very disinterested in actually being there.  As a result of this class I have changed my major to avoid future cs classes.

Tests make no sense. The only kids who are doing well in the class are those who have background experience. Lectures are soo boring and only half the class shows up to them. You can tell he doesn't want to be there.

reviews.comment: Prof teaches well, you just need to go through recordings again and you will be good. Decent knowledge gained in supervised learning. Understands students and helps with deadlines. Plagiarism is strict no. Assignments are of moderate difficulty
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

He fills tests with lengthy calculations done by-hand to make them difficult, instead of actually testing the subject matter knowledge. He was unresponsive via emails and Piazza, and for how bad this class was, he was incredibly nitpicky with his project grading.

pros: 1) Homeworks are easy. 2) No mandatory attendance. cons: 1)He just reads through his ppt slides. His classes are not interactive and he keeps a boring face throughout his lecture. 2)Tough grader. Don't expect any curves. 3) Exams are lengthy. 4)He won't respond to any emails.

Class is fine, very, VERY easy, lectures are great. MAKE SURE your Final Project team is good. But be sure to read instead of skimming or expect to lose tons of points (sometimes a % of your grade!) on completely random, arbitrary things

Class is OK, videos can be long but the requirements aren't much each week, class def depends on your final project group. reviews.comment:
Extremely heavy workload. Expect to have a major project due every 2 weeks, on top of tedious course modules due every week. And on top of that, a final project which has an extremely long rubric of items, while you are forced to work in a team of only 3.

Also, the professor comes off as really pretentious in his assignments i.e. smile emoji spam.

THIS MAN IS A LEGEND. The lecture videos are so well done, and he is passionate and ready to help outside of class. If you want to make games as a hobby, or are pursuing the major, start by taking a course with this guy. ++

So much homework. SUPER HEAVY WORKLOAD!!! Sometimes one homework was not due and he already released another one. Homework has extremely long instructions. Takes up to 24 hours to finish. Submission's a pain in the ass. Does learn a lot and make a lot of projects but none are useful unless you tryna be a game programmer.

Avoid unless super interested in Unity/Games. DO NOT take HCI with him if you actually want to go into UI/UX+already have experience working with clients. This class is only helpful for students who are minimally interested in UX design because he doesn't teach industry-standard tools. He teaches the design process as if there's only one way to do it and uses Axure for the course and not Figma

Took him during the summer for the summer classes in Seattle, can be a bit condescending at times but can be funny. This class is based off of a group project so if you get a crappy team, be prepared to do all of the work yourself, get a good team, this class will be a breeze.

Sarcastic, condescending, and spends a disproportionate amount of class time expressing disappointment and frustration at students.  It would be better for everyone if the professor could maintain a level head and positive attitude, and put more effort into understanding why students are not enjoying the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Yildirim is the GOAT, and easily one of the most respected and beloved professors in Khoury. I've gone back to his lecture notes to prep for interviews, since he does an excellent job of explaining things effectively + concisely. If you're going to take DS3000, make sure you take it with Caglar!

Cared a lot about students and put a lot of effort to make sure even the people who could not make it to live lectures be able to understand the materials and participate with other students for group projects. Well organized lectures and materials, inclusive environment. I'd take all classes with him if he were teaching them! Highly recommend. <3

Without a doubt, one of the best classes I have taken! Prof is super friendly and loves Harry Potter! Course is extremely well structured and everything is laid on the table in the first class. Gives ample time to complete the big assignments and encourages class participation. He's very responsive to questions and makes sure the load is balanced.

The Professor did an AMAZING job curating online course content. He had prerecorded lectures with accompanying notebooks that could be watched at the students convenience. On alternating class days there were (very) short lab activities. He was also easily accessible, and sent out weekly correspondences reminding us of upcoming activities.

Brilliant, funny, and clear professor. You almost felt sad for him - he was enthusiastic beyond belief but the long class and intro level material meant noone was paying attention by the end. You can work on a cool ML project come the end of the class as well, and the class is usually taken just when you want projects for your resume. 100% take him

Quizzes are amazing, can help with grade. Homework assignments are straight forward, Can Be Done. No in-class tests and no final exam, but there is a final group project. Project is mainly stats- and presentation-based. There's also in-class assignments, so that gets you to class, but they're 10% in total. Great professor, major hogwarts fan.

Calgar's great! No exams. The few homeworks, in-class exercises, and quizzes were all doable. He offers extra credit, really listens to the class, and is understanding if assignments or quizzes are missed or need extensions. Would highly recommend.

Professor Man is amazing, she is always available to help outside of class and highly recommends that you go to her office hours so she can teach you one-on-one. Do homework after every class, even if it's not mandatory. Do practice quizzes and final exams to prepare for the actual one. You will be successful in her classes.

Lectures were very fast and hard to follow. I definitely had to teach myself almost all of the material. Class is based on 6 tests(lowest dropped) and 1 final. Do all of the homework and practice tests posted to help you. Definitely recommend going to office hours by her and the TAs.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was nice but her teaching method wasn't the most effective. Lectures were run through quite quickly. She uploads note sheets from both her lectures and other professors' notes, as well as practice exams beforehand which are probably the most useful thing to study from as they were similar to the actual exams in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mandy is a really sweet professor. Unfortunately though, she goes through lecture super fast and doesn't save any time for questions. Quizzes were easy and short; the lowest one is dropped... but the final is worth 40% of your final grade.

Professor Levendis is the most kind and caring prof ive had, he really cares about his students participating. Grades very fairly - I will miss having him as my prof. It is easy to get an A in this class since exams are open note, just make sure to use the textbook and slides.
Great personality and caring attitude. Coursework is too much textbook based and less practical knowledge.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

She even gave her home number during finals for people to call anytime if they had questions. Going to class is a must. Missing a class can set you back.  Definitely take Zhang!!!

Prof. Zhang was great.  She really wants you to understand the information so she will go out of her way to make sure you understand.  She even gave us her home number to call her if we had questions before the final.  As long as you put in the effort and ask for help you will get an A.

She is very organized and class is very fast paced. She is very clear and will go over everything until you understand it. Accounting is a hard subject, but she tries to make it as easy as possible. Gives 2 tests and a lot of homework, and a group project.  The final exam was so ridiculously hard, and it counts for 25%. Still I highly recommend!

i loved this class. just go to class and listen and you can pass. very structured and fast paced. very clear and has no problem backtracking if you don't understand. This is her first semester at NEU. you do have a little bit of homework online and on blackboard but not hard at all. overall i would highly recommend this class with her.

(Physics) His passion, adaptability, and genuine care for students creates an engaging learning environment. He adjusts his teaching to meet us where we are. His willingness to listen and reflect makes him stand out. He's transformed me into an active participant when I typically don't speak in class. I wish professors adopted his teaching style!

If you are a continuing education student who is decades past your last math class and not in a mathematical field you will have difficulty passing this class. Feed back on final paper was belittling to say the least but I did get an apology. Many in class dropped by third week. Professor makes the assumption math is all anyone should do. I MO

Took his class during the summer. He let you know from day one what was expected. LOT'S of homework (mostly bc it was a summer course and we had to crunch so much in). However, always there to help. Also, if something came up he was reasonable for extensions, etc. Great guy.
Very good at teaching the material. Highly recommend taking the class with him as you will learns lot

Possibly one of the best professors I've had so far. He knows his stuff and is genuinely interested in the performance of his students. He's also pretty funny. Best guy to have for Mechanics, hands down.
Best professor so far

The most engaging professor I had this term, and overall one of the 3 best professors I've ever had at Northeastern. He challenges students. Also, as a STEM education expert, he does research in how students best learn these topics, which means he is super good at teaching them.
His lecture is fun and straightforward.

Prof Jung is great and definitely the best professor for Material Science! His lectures are engaging and he is very passionate about the course. He explains things well and has a sense of humor. The workload for the class is light and the exams are very similar to the homework. I would definitely recommend his class.

He is very knowledgeable and fun.
The grade is very straightforward if you attend lectures and do homeworks.
Decent professor who teaches relatively well. Can be a bit hard to understand at times. If you attend class and pay attention, you should have no problem getting a decent grade.
He's good if you are already smart and know things, as he expects you to have prior information in the back of your head at all times. He's not super helpful outside class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Super boring class with non-exam related class materials, very hard to understand his lecture and feel no clear logical line, he seems to hurry to finish his job task without any patience to his students.

I really liked prof jung, he was super clear with whats on the tests and it was EXACTLY like the HW assignments. Lectures can be boring but I blame the content, he was sorta funny sometimes. Not super organized- sends out textbook reading the night before but I never did it anyway. Lots of memorization but with effort this is an easy A.
Definitely the worst professor at Northeastern!!!
No patience to students and hurry to drive student out of office

Course slides are super dry, feel no enthusiasm from him, he really needs to improve his teaching skill and communication skills, rather than no meaningful life experience and bad jokes during classes. Respecting others can earn others' respect.
Trying to learn by yourself through online materials, he cannot directly answer your questions, be patient!

Hes power points are super boring so half of the class is on their phones. He does have a language barrier and wont understand your question. He gives no extra problems to practice except homework thats completely unrelated to Midterms. Also hes very picky to wording and writing style. He turned an easy course into a really hard one
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very bad teaching skills... hard to understand and communicate with him.
Best professor ever! Love Yung Joon a ton he teaches a ton
He is a very mean teacher and no enthusiasm for this course, if I can select another course, I will not take this course.

He's a great guy and is enthusiastic about the course, but not a great teacher. His lectures are dry and he just runs through his powerpoints. He also does a bad job at giving feedback, never posting anything on blackboard. However, he does let students do exam corrections for points back. Not the worst, but be ready to learn from the textbook.
He is one of the worst professor in northeastern, do not join his group as the volunteer or intern because he will teach you nothing, really bad atttude to students.
He goes off track a lot but it's pretty entertaining. He's got an accent but it's easily understandable. You have to study outside of class to do well but his powerpoints are pretty comprehensive.

The worst teacher ever. Extremely unhelpful during office hours. He rushes you out of his office. If you are wondering about a specific question, he will not work with you. Just grabs the test out of your hands and says "this is wrong answer". and if you try to point specific things out he just says "send me email". extremely unhelpful
The way he teaches the class should be more focused on doing example problems, and less about anecdotes of when he was in the army in korea.

Nice enough guy and cares about his students, but very bad at teaching the material. Wastes time and gets distracted telling his students about "life" in class, instead of material science. Because of this, homework questions are often completely unrelated to anything he talks about during lectures.

One of those professors that knows a lot about the subject he is teaching but can't communicate it efficiently to students. Gives lectures on bare minimum material, and then expect students to solve way more complicated problems and questions on quizzes and tests

One of the worst profs I've ever had. Class structure is terrible. Rambles and doesn't go over how to do problems in class, and then you see those problems in homework and tests. Doesn't ever post the correct answers for exams even though they make new ones every year, so you can never see the proper way to solve problems you got wrong.

Nice guy, I enjoyed his enthusiasm during class. Sometimes a little difficult to understand, so reading the textbook before class or at least skimming it will make things much clearer. He really cares about students doing well.

I hated this guy. his jokes are SO stupid. absolutely useless teacher, his class is absolutely boring, attendance is not mandatory. doesnt teach. talks about the same stuff over and over again. gets distracted almost every 5 minutes. did not learn anything in that class. conclusion: not funny, useless, boring, sucks at teaching. but chill

Overall good teacher. Funny personality, and enthusiastic about the subject. Likes to get students involved but unfortunately a boring subject is a boring subject. Lectures often match up to homework but if you go to office hours he is very helpful with the labs as well as the homework. Flexible teacher, and willing to accomodate students
No Comments

Pretty solid teacher, he speaks with a Korean accent but is very easy to understand. Nice guy, willing to help you out and very understanding. Prepare well for the Tests because they were departmentalized, not class specific.

LOVED Professor Zaff!! Interesting lectures, helpful during office hours, and encourages thought provoking questions during class. My only critique is the requirement to talk during class, but other than that, no complaints.
lots and lots of work for a 1 credit and is graded on attendance.... but every resource she offers is super helpful and really prepares you for co-op.

She's a co-op coordinator but wow goes above and beyond to help you out. She's so great at her job and she really wants you to succeed and get the job you want. She's always available to meet and talk with you too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: please buy her coffee

Use Google Docs or Microsoft Word for this class. Take notes on everything, helps with the assessments and she gives out a lot of very good information. Very smart professor and will help you understand the material at all times.

Course material is not hard, at all if you read the textbooks. A lot of debatable questions from her lectures. Her office hours are on Zoom, on Tuesday afternoon. I would actually recommend going to her office hours.
It might get boring from time to time, but be interactive. She's a nice, lovely person.

READ THE TEXTBOOK! That's the most crucial way to understand and will 100% help with class discussions. Other than that, take notes, memorize it, and sign up for a Zoom office hours meeting with her to help with clarification. 

This shouldn't be a challenging class at all.

I would recommend creating a friendship with her, she's fabulous. 

She's so quick at running. Always had a fun time doing a morning run with my professor.
gets interactive very quick, good lecturer
so inspirational

If you have to take International Business & Global Responsibility in Northeastern University London (either if you're some type of business major, finance major, or elective), PLEASE REQUEST HER TO BE YOUR PROFESSOR!!! SHE'S THE SWEETEST PROFESSOR EVER! Go to her office hours to get a more better understanding of the material. She's a gem.

She's a nice and amazing professor. She sends weekly emails (very important to read them) and very informative. If you read the textbook ahead of the lecture and preview the lecture slides, you will be so well off in the class. Participate in the class discussions.

This class was a lot more difficult than I was expexting especially for a 1000 level class. I'm a music tech major in my first year, and this definitely was not a great start to my major. I'm considering changing majors after taking this class.
Way too harsh of a grader for a level 1000 class. Will ruin your gpa.
Took the fun out of music

If you're looking for an easy A, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. I was hoping to have a fun time making music, it was extremely Physics heavy and harshly graded, especially for a 1000 level class. If you are thinking of taking this class as an elective, just don't. It won't be fun and it will just kill your gpa (and I'm a Mech E).
Great professor. Very knowledgeable but not very forgiving or understanding. Lectures are interesting

One of the best professors I have had, super passionate and knowledgable about audio engineering and music tech. Always willing to spend time outside of class to help you out, and his lectures are always interesting and never dry (on topics where they usually are).
Very nice professor, helpful for many occasions outside class.

Had him for MUST 1220, Intro to Music Tech. He comes from an engineering background so the early chapters are very science and physics heavy, which can be hard for music students. He's extremely enthusiastic and knowledgeable, but sometimes hard to follow. The class is alot of hard material, but he is a very lenient grader.

explains concepts in a really long winded way, i found that the students in my class would learn from the videos and lecture notes he posts on canvas (really useful btw), but hes really chill and respects feedback in class, quizzes every week but they aren't bad at all

explains simple concepts in really long winded and complicated ways. ended up not showing up IRL after the first month except for quizzes and finals. uploads videos and lecture notes and practice work on canvas which are more useful than the lectures. but hes super chill and answers emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He struggled to explain complex concepts clearly, and his grading system, was limited to quizzes and finals. An issue was the lack of formula sheets, which other course sections used. We were unaware these were allowed, leaving us to use outside resources. On quiz days, he made things worse by delivering long, irrelevant lectures before the test.

He was a good prof for calc. I never took calc before so I was worried, but overall I did well. the quizzes are identical to practice and his office hours are helpful. he is a bit awkward though, kind of reminds me of a teenager.

He is good at explaining content and the practice quizzes are pretty much identical to the actual quizzes. Final was difficult, but was curved. As long as you go to class and do the practice you will be fine

She is very intelligent and knows her stuff. She is a great lecturer as she explains things into great detail. She can be condescending at times, but really wants her students to understand the material. Her exams are difficult as they aren't based on her lectures. They are based on your knowledge and how well you know different processes.

Literally the worst teacher. There is no doubt that she is very intelligent, but she does not know how to teach. Specifically, she does not teach in a way that attempts to make sense to students, and makes units far more difficult than they need to be. Her lectures are so confusing and impossible to follow. Exams are extremely difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I am an honors student and I struggle in her classes greatly. Her tests are formatted to trick her students and she seems to be apathetic to students who struggle or don't understand the content right away. She doesn't test her students on their knowledge, but rather expects them to know the answers to things she never actually explained. TERRIBLE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She reads off the slides. She is clearly knowledgeable about the subject material but is not able to translate what we have learned in class to the exams. When a lot of the kids get a question wrong in class, she nods and then moves on without explaining it. Find another professor if possible, if not, good luck because it's not going to be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I know of at least 6 people out of 60 that dropped her class. I think I'm pretty middle of the road for NU, and I couldn't get above a 62 on her exams. Teaching style was ineffective and her tests are made to trick you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This was the worse professor I ever had at NEU. Lectures are not clear or organized and it is very hard to follow. The pace is very quick and does not allow time to repeat material. She is not helpful when students are struggling with material. I am an honors student and have done very well in all classes but hers. I would not recommend her.

Made relatively simple concepts much more difficult than they needed to be. Lectures were unclear and exams were made to trick you-even with the study guides. Few students enjoyed and did well in class. If you take a class with her, good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The high difficulty of Neurobiology did not match up with Prof. Zee's ability to teach. Was confusing far too much of the time, and straight up stopped giving out helpful homework/out-of-class assignments by the end of the semester (when she said she would post them). In-class TopHat average of 50% correctness and D+ average on tests doesn't work.

Extremely intellectually stimulating course. I have learned SO MUCH.  Dr. Zee is articulate in lecture and has a deep understanding of the material. I think she is great at teaching.   The problem is she is terrible at designing test questions. I think sometimes she tries to trick you or asks a confusing question.

While she is an incredibly organized and helpful professor who is well respected by students, her teaching this semester was not very helpful. Her lectures were packed with information and her tests were made to trick you, which is unnecessary for a basic level course.

STUDY! If you read the case studies, pay attention to the lectures (easier said than done),  participate in top hat and study everything, you will pass. It's not a class you can slack off in, but it's not impossible either. Go to her if you are confused about something and ask in a polite way. She can have a bit of a 'tude.
Tough class, but the information is interesting and she updates you with what the newest research is. If you study enough, you'll do fine.

By far the worst professor I have had at NEU. Psychobio is fairly easy when taught properly. Sadly, Zee is an absolutely terrible professor. She makes everything infinitely more complicated than what it needs to be. I actively don't listen to her in class because she is so confusing. Instead I watched lectures online from other professors.

Her powerpoints were the most confusing thing ever-very random and PACKED with information. She rambles (very fast) and lacked organization. Definitely needed to read over the pwrpnts before tests multiple times. Thing that saved me was the study guides- most information on test is from the study guide so make sure you look at them

Jade Zee is just not cut out for teaching. Her style of speech is scattered and it seems she is perpetually confused. Her sentence phrasings leads transfers very little information and only leaves one confused. The lack of a text in Neurobio leaves you unable to teach yourself. Very nice lady, but would not recommend her as a teacher.
voice puts you to sleep. Her powerpoints do not add much to the class. Her tests are ard and mostly based on the biology aspects of class

Animal Behavior sounds interesting but Zee made it so boring. She was quite disorganized in her methods and answered questions unclearly, sometimes not answering them at all. Also, she doesn't realize neurobio is not a prereq, so she talks about hormones, etc. without properly explaining. You'll do fine if you go to class and take notes.

Third class with her.  The best teacher i've had by far.  Extremely helpful, always answers questions, ppts are online.  She makes study guides for her tests which are super helpful, but she likes to make you think so tests are not easy.  Take this with her if you want to learn a lot, but be prepared to put the work in.
Professor Zee is a very nice woman. She is extremely helpful and lays out clearly what will be on the exams. If you pay attention in class and study then you will be fine.

Jade is a very nice lady, but her class made me want to literally fall asleep. I did several times. Class really wasn't necessary if you are at all capable of teaching yourself material off of powerpoint slides. I barely attended class after the 2nd exam, taught myself the slides and had a peer tutor, and got a 93% on the final exam.

Seriously. Jade is a GREAT teacher and is incredibly knowledgeable in her field. Her tests are challenging but if you put the time in you can get an A. The questions are not rocket science and the concepts are not difficult. She spells everything out in powerpoints. Psych majors beware: if you can't do bio stay away.

Do not take a class with this professor and avoid all interaction if possible.  No class structure, imcomprehensible handouts, 5th grade projects, grades papers 3 months after assigned, unecessarily hard exams and will argue with you until she is out of breath. She may be knowledgeable but is not helpful or clear. The worst class I have ever taken.

Her exam questions are designed to really make you think but she omits questions if most of the class gets it wrong, which is VERY generous. I got a C on the first exam, went to her office and looked it over to see what I got wrong and why, and the exam after I got an A. She's overall a great professor who will help you if you ask.

smart but awful at teaching. There is no textbook so you must go to class, pay attention, and take good notes. Because it was her first semester teaching when I took the class she did not  post PPT slides until the day of class. She is unable to answer questions that are slightly off the topic she is discussing. Exams were pretty difficult.

I am a biology major and I think that Professor Zee is WONDERFUL.  She is difficult, but she knows what she is talking about and she is very interested in what she is teaching.  It is difficult for a psychology class.. but actually a pretty easy class if you are taking it for your biology major.

She's not a good professor. She knows a lot, but she isn't good at teaching. There's no textbook, its all lecture based, so you MUST go to class. Take good notes, they'll be all you have to study from. She covers a LOT of material, VERY quickly, and you'll be expected to know it ALL. Choose another professor if possible.

Very tough professor, but very thorough. She's very interested and knowledgable in the subject matter and genuinely wants to see her students understand the material and succeed in the course. just be prepared for her exams, they're pretty hard and count for most of the grade.

Tough teacher but very good. Test are hard because she goes much more in depth than the other Psychobiology teachers. Read all of her power points and any videos that she posts cause it will be on the exam. She is very nice and is willing to help you if you reach out.

Great teacher! Passionate and very knowledgeable about subject. Lectures are dynamic and interactive. Have to admit I did not do all readings (still got by), but the books were well chosen.  I liked the expert pro and con debate on controversial topics. Grading is fair and feedback detailed and excellent.  Go out of your way to take this Prof!

Course and professor made my semester. I would wake up early and walk through a noreaster to take professor zernicke again. Made me think and write at higher level. Still using knowledge from the class in conversations with friends/family and in assessing daily events.

Best prof ever! Took his presidency course. Encyclopedic knowledge, dynamic and funny. Challenges students to be analytical, document their assertions with evidence and authority. Has gift for generating conversations that enlighten, inspire and allow divergent political views.  Wants you to learn and commits himself to it. Completely awesome!
Real nice guy but the subject sucks. Goes ahead on lectures even if you have not had a test on previous material yet.

Goes by David not Edward, so that right there is confusing. He's a nice guy and gives a good first impression, but his lectures are long and boring and it is difficult to stay focused. Does not give tests back, see him privately to get feedback. Rarely does practice problems in class. Two parts to quizzes, individual and group. 3 tests total.
Very nice and funny man, but his lectures will kill you of boredom. Show all work and units to get credit.

He looks like a nice guy from afar, but when you need something (like HELP or an EXPLANATION) he is useless. Textbook and PowerPoint reader all classes. Monotone voice, makes you want to doze off or not go to class. Avoid him.
Best teacher ever!
Interesting teacher, always ready for class. Involve students in the discussions. A midterm and Final fairly easy that counts for 40%. 4 Quizzes devided into a individual and group part. I recommend!

If you go to office hours things make a lot more sense. He is eager to help. Frequently calls on people in class if they look like they aren't paying attention or look confused. I would take this class again. Gives a lot of homework, but also a lot of opportunities to have the highest grade possible. Tests are hard, have to work a lot for an A.

He's upfront with you about what to expect from him, saying he enjoys picking on students. I felt discouraged from asking questions and I  frankly didn't want to go to his class. His lectures seemed to contradict readings which made tests difficult. Being a part time professor, he was hardly ever available for help.

Prof. Beg is a great teacher who mostly teaches by example.  For every chapter he gives a short 10 multiple choice quiz which basically just makes sure you read the chapter before coming to class.  He loves to teach by example and does demonstration problems in many classes.  Lastly, 25% get an A, 50% get a B, and 25% get a C at the end.

The absolute worst teacher I have ever had. I would avoid at all costs. He is incredibly rude and condecending towards students. He creates a very aggressive atmosphere. Always making fun of student who are not in the accounting concentration. He rarely taught material, and was a tough grader. He is never on campus to help students.

Zeshawn was a super nice man, I really liked him and he was a good professor and really wanted you to succeed. He was funny and made you pay attention in class. Beware that he does his class on a curve though, so I ended up with a poor grade but especially if you're good at accounting, you'll be fine taking him.

Very enthusiastic about the subject & has a good experience but unorganized in class and explanations are unclear. Gives little to no assistance after class (TA has no office hours) and is incredibly condescending towards people who do not choose his career path of choice.

Pros: Attendance is not mandatory, he is enthusiastic about the subject, class is graded on a curve (25% of students will get A's, 25% will get C's)  Cons: Relies on the homework to teach students the material. Tests are much harder than the material he ever taught in class  Would not recommend.

Zeshawn is my favorite professor at NEU. He was always willing to help you outside of class, even on unrelated material. You have to work for your grade, but he curves so 25% of the class gets an A. Tests are difficult and all MC, but Connect and Learnsmart help. Case studies were fair and helped my grade. Would definitely recommend, so helpful.

Willing to listen to students needs. Will answer questions. Makes himself available. If you want an A you will need to put in some effort. Not a teacher who tries to purposefully fail his students. Gives you every opportunity to succeed. Turn in all of your assignments and study for the tests and you should be fine. Would definitely take him again.
I had to study on my own to get an A.

Grade aside, I probably learned the most in the class than anything at NEU so far. He actually tries to make us critical thinkers, not just memorizers. Would like if he made it less embarrassing to be wrong in class. Most things are on paper so you barely use excel, but that helped to learn the concepts 20x better than friends with other professors

One of the best Professors I have taken so far, the class is a really easy class as long as you attend and listen, he makes it hard not to understand. Did not feel rushed at all and we finished the course material before thanksgiving. There was one final project (semester long) and 3 exams no final. Take this Professor!

I thought taking this class at 4:30 would suck, but it was my favorite class this semester. He explains everything very well and makes it easy to understand. I had no problems aside from some hard times with my group for the project, but he is very understanding and always has his door open to help. He is probably my favorite professor, take him!

Great professor, funny guy. The class isn't too hard, barely any grades besides the test. Final project, no final exam, besides that there are a couple weekly homeworks and assignments related to the final project, and that's it. Definitely take this professor.

Professor Zaarour's lectures were the highlight of my day. He is so engaging, never teaches off slides, tells interesting stories, and gives good life advice. We finished learning material weeks before other 2301 sections but the class did not feel rushed at all. There were 3 exams each worth 20%, homework worth 20%, and a group project worth 20%.
His lectures explain the class material very well, and if you pay attention in class, you will easily be able to get an A- or A in the class.

Was really excited to take this class as the prof is rated so highly. Unfortunately I wouldn't recommend his class online as it's so test heavy and he doesn't actually teach the lectures (they are by someone else) therefore the tests aren't very clear as to what will be on it/what to study for.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Doesn't remotely deserve the high ratings he gets on here. Closed note lockdown browser + webcam exams that are pretty hard because there's so much content and such little time to study. Bro doesn't even film his own lectures, he uses other professors. The lecture videos, PowerPoint's and the PowerPoint slides he uploads are always different.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the nicest and coolest teachers I've had. Class was always chill. As long as you go to class and pay attention and do the homeworks, you'll be absolutely fine on the tests. There's no final, just a semester-long group project that is very laid back and interesting, and it has a final presentation at the end of the semester.

Simply one of the best supply chain professors at NEU, the three-hour lecture seems grueling, but he does such a great job keeping everyone engaged. 3 Exams that are 60% of the total grade. The questions are based off the textbook and his PowerPoints. The rest of the assignments are also manageable. Great professor, highly recommend.

Literally one of the best profs I've had. His lectures are so engaging and he doesn't teach off slides. He prepares you really well for his tests and homework. There is a textbook, but you don't need it - just show up to class. His instructions are always very clear and he responds super quick and is accessible outside of class.
Such a great professor. He cold calls on people but it's actually very helpful for learning the material. He's also very funny, and he bakes really great cookies.

if you genuinely want to learn then he will be the best professor you have ever had 
if you like to get by using chat and sitting in class doing other work on your computer - do not take his class 
weekly homework assignment (not that bad most of the time), 3 tests, group project, no final exam!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Zaarour was a great professor and always knew what he was talking about. The tests were fairly difficult but we were prepared well. No final exam.

This is my second time having Professor Zaarour and I have nothing but great things to say about him. He is a true husky having gone to Northeastern and received several degrees. His tests are fair if you complete the homework, and the group project is not too bad. I wish he taught more classes! A final perk is he provides cookies on the last day!

Such a great professor!! I was nervous at the beginning of the sem because he does like to cold call a bunch, but genuinely a really nice guy and he does a great job of preparing you for the tests. No final exam, just a group project but it isn't much work. He also made us a bunch of cookies to celebrate after our last exam

He clearly understands stats and wants his students to as well. He does a good job of explaining the concepts behind the formulas and works hard to prepare you for the exams. He's also a really funny dude if you to talk to him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a great professor. Very easy exams as long as you pay attention in class and do the HW everything will be easy. He does a lot of review in class to allow for success in the exams. Made us cookies at the end of our semester. Very good at explaining things. Biggest thing that really helped my success was the fact that he gave us breaks!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super nice, funny, flexible, easy A teacher. Always ties material to current events and you always feel smarter leaving the classroom. Exams have NO surprises: exactly from textbook and practice problems in class (some even online). He made cookies for us and responded to emails faster than my own mom. Would 100% take again.

Professor Zaarour is amazing! I took the three hour version of SCHM2301, and provided us breaks when we needed them, and always had an engaging lecture. There are three exams, a group project, a simulation and homework. He only teaches Supply Chain in the Spring, so definitely wait to take him then! Lastly, he answers emails very quickly.

Best teacher at northeastern for supply chain. I was in a three hour long class with him every monday and he managed to make that miserable timeslot the most engaged I've ever been in a class in my life. I learned a lot in this class. He is always accessible outside of class and is super funny. Take him if you can!

By far, one of the BEST Professors I have ever had!! He is extremely intelligent, very helpful, funny, caring and you can tell that he loves what he does and is very good at it. I wish there were more Professors like Professor Zaarour!!!  Absolutely Awesome!! Highly recommend
Great professor. Very fair in terms of grading and very responsive.

He is amazing! The lectures were interesting and he is absolutely hilarious. He always encouraged people to participate but never put anyone on the spot. Exams are very fair, just study the slides and exercises he gives and you'll be fine. Homeworks are graded to completion. There are two group projects, both easy to complete. 100% recommend!

Avoid taking statistics class as he heavily relies on midterms and finals to determine your grade.While he responds to texts he doesn't provide clear answers. His exams differ from lectures and homework, and there's no exam review or guide.There's no partial credit or opportunity to show working either. Homework is graded unfairly as assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing, funny professor. So easy to contact for help or info. Case study project seems daunting, but it's way easier than you think, just listen to his suggestions. Exams are not bad. You definitely have to study, but the information/concepts on the test are all on the slides and he gives you practice problems that are very similar to on the test.

Professor Zaarour even though very accessible outside of class made my learning experience tough. For someone who struggles with math having methodology in the solved hw to figure out my errors is essential. It was very disappointing to see that this aspect was missing when trying to prepare for exams. Overall 3 cause he could easily do better
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This prof really had such a good relationship with students. He makes lengthy equations extremely easy to understand. He really wants you to understand the reasoning behind the math which is extremely helpful and his exams are very straightforward and easy as long as you go to class and do the homework. Overall amazing prof def take him if you can.

He's a great teacher and he truly wants his students to understand the material. If you've already taken stats you don't need to take this class, but it's a good refresher if you forgot it. The Hw is pretty easy if you go to class, and the tests are pretty easy if you do the hw. No final test, just a final project.

Tests are hard and even if you study they are still confusing. Weird grading scale with little feedback. Graded on very few things. One test grade based off a video game with no rubric so you don't even know how you did.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A wonderful course! If you follow him in classes, assignments and exams are easy. He has a good memory, so he probably knows who is not in attendance. The classes are pretty interesting, including reality cases in life.

His expectations and feedback were extremely vague. You may think you did super well on a project and then get back a totally different grade. The extra credit is a lot of work but helped me a lot so definitely do that. His lectures and classes were interesting however so if you do not care about your grade or spend hours working, he is great.

Professor Zaarour was very straightforward. His tests were exactly what you went over in class so there were no surprises but the tests were still the right amount of challenging to make sure you do the homework and pay attention. Unfortunately he doesn't take effort into consideration and is very grade-focused.

Pretty disappointed in this class despite good reviews. Nizar is harsh and gives minimal and unhelpful feedback. He get angry at students for not understanding which made people not want to ask questions. Directions are also very unclear and not well articulated. Grades based on tests and a group project. Easy if you have taken statistics before.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures are so confusing... He repeats several things again and again before the most important part of that chapter. He responses to emails really fast. My suggestion to the course is rely on the textbook instead of his lectures, ask him questions if you got confused

The structure of the class was straightforward, but the instructions were sometimes unclear. It took detailed emails for our class to be sure that our assignment and projects were completed the way it was intended to. VERY fast responding to emails. reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took this course as part of the NUstart Program in the fall semester. Tests are straightforward as long as you keep up with lectures and readings from the textbook. reviews.comment: Best teacher I ever had!

reviews.comment: Prof Z is an amazing professor! He makes subjects that might not be so exciting, relevant and easy to understand. Lectures are very interactive and lively which is such a plus in those long classes.

AMAAAAZING PROFESSOR. literally the best professor in northeastern and would most definitely take his class again.

One of the best professor in Northeaster. He is truly a Husky.
Zaarour is the best ! Phenomenal professor !

Supercool Prof.

he's amazing

amazing. unbelievably amazing. clear, understading, extremely intelligent, extremely helpful, extremely hot and extremely fun.

Thank god i waited till this semester to take stats ... I never thought anyone can make this class interesting, but i was wrong.  Amazing professor and always willing to help

reviews.comment: Professor Liao is a very caring and smart professor. His lectures are very insightful, but can run on.  He has many in-class activities and encourages everyone to participate. Attendance is mandatory, and not participating will hurt your grade. Overall, he is a great professor.
Amazing professor, amazing person who actually cares about his students. I wish more educators were like him.

Prof. Liao is the best choices for ORGB! Although he has an accent, he is very caring, very inspiring, and always wants his students to do their best in his class. He understands that high GPA is important for his students and as long as you put a decent amount of effort in, he will fairly award your hard work!

Very friendly and caring professor. He expected a lot from students, but he was always very good with feedback and communication. Lots of discussion based classes and the professor was always enthusiastic about the topic.

Professor Liao is one of the most caring and kind professors at NEU. It can be difficult to understand him at times due to his accent but his classes are extremely engaging and fun. Very caring and respectful professor. Many interesting class discussion, but he'll not force anyone to speak. Many group work, and test is hard, but he will curve the grade so no worry. bro does not gaf

she is perfect! Would take class with her again 100% really caring!

The only way to get a good grade is to pretend you like her, suck up, and do EXACTLY what she says she likes in papers and homeworks.

WORST TEACHER EVER!!! All she does is talk. She ask the class questions and then doesn't let you answer them and then she gets mad because no one is talking. Something isn't connected right in her head. 6 weeks into the class and she still didn't know students names. And there were only 16 of us in the class.
Didn't understand how to answer people's questions. Talks all class, usually off-topic and considers this discussion, although she's the only one talking. Very vague.

She was my ONLY good professor all semester. She is a bit weird, but she has such a passion for writing, and if you make an argument that you are remotely interested in your writing, she'll take it. She finally taught me to write successfully. Kind of a lot of work, but I learned something.

Pretty much the worst teacher I have ever had!  Provides no assistance in class with writing assigngments, and gets extremely upset when people ask questions.  Also, RIDICULOUSLY RUDE!!  Can't believe our tuition dollars actually pay this woman to be a professor.  I would drop the class immediately!!

She has the inability to hear what the student is concerned with.  Don’t bother conferencing with her because she will rip you a new one for not already knowing.  She expects you to be capable of professional level work without proper instructions, but at least you have an option of B++ and if you try really hard you could get an A--. GOOD LUCK!

Previous raters of this professor obviously failed the class and are poor writers.  The professor attempts to inspire an appreciation for literature.  She will not write your paper for you; however she does offer ample comments.  If you keep those comments in mind on successive drafts and assignments you will do well in the class.

She definately thinks she is the "Bees Knees." LOL.  She doesn't shower regularly, wears clothes that are too small for her, doesn't brush her hair etc.    All she does is talk about how great she is. Wishes she went to Harvard instead of a state school! She is a Bull---- artist!

loves to listen to her own voice, wont answer ?s or teach, for that matter. makes class close eyes and "vote" on stupid things. VERY UNCLEAR, calls on you if she remembers your name (not likely), makes you invent cons to perform for the class. thinks she's so wordly, says "in any case" and smacks her lips till you go insane. avoid the torture!!!!!!

Worst Teacher ever. If have her, switch out. She does not give directions on how to write the paper. Until AFTER you have handed it in. Pointless to ask questions: 1. she doesn't answer the q. and 2. she confuses you more. Switch Out!

Confused and confusing.  Forgets which classes she has taught which information.  Contradicts herself with alarming regularity.  Goes off on tangents and never returns to her point.  Seems to think of herself as the lofty professor who must enlighten her lowly students.  Wastes time.  Answers her own rhetorical questions.  Ignores raised hands.

If you have to take Advanced writing for business, choose her! Her section is the easiest one, hands down. NO PAPERS TO WRITE. Assignments leave you lots of place for creativity and fun. Do your work and you'll get an A!

TAKE HER CLASS! Erica is a very nice and funny teacher. It is easy to get an A. Her class is really relax. She makes funny jokes. As long as you do as she requires, which are really clear, you will get a high grade easily.
Class based on the amount of time and work you put it.  You can get most things done in class.
Awesome class
Great teacher for Advanced Writing in the Tech. Take her class!

I know I'm in the minority, but I didn't enjoy having Erica as a professor. I felt her lectures and discussions were very heavily influenced by her own personal opinions. She also seemed somewhat condescending. I will say that she is very willing to help, however, and certainly passionate.
I have never experienced a better English Professor. Take her!

Erica has been my favorite writing teacher ever. She really encourages you to find your own voice, and if that means tying things OTHER than writing into your work, then so be it. She is very lenient with grading, and really cares about connecting with her students. Take her!!!
You will not find a better prof for advanced writing.  she is great!
E money!  Whats there to say besides the fact that she is Da Bomb.  If you can have her as a prof... DO IT.  Nuff said.  (you'll learn stuff and have fun in a chill classroom setting)

Erica has a smile that could make a senile old man bite his tongue. She once touched an angry python and it sang a beautiful melody. The lady actually managed to turn lead into gold (yea, we're talking freaking alchemy here). So yea, she's legit, take her class. O and she's straight edge, which is just weird :-/

Erica is an AMAZING teacher.  I put off taking English until my senior year because my freshman English class traumatized me - and I loved this class! She is great at helping you go into your field even if it isn't hers! I highly recommend waiting for her section to open before taking any English requirement. Comments below are complete BS...

Zilleruelo is an amazing professor.  I absolutely loved her class. She is very skilled at helping her students understand the topics at hand. She runs an easy going classroom, where all students are accountable. I would highly recommend her to anyone interested in taking the courses she teaches.

By far the best english teacher i've ever had. Always willing to help students with their papers. Easy to understand and wants her students to do well in the class. Highly recommend taking her class if available
she is the best teacher ever . you really understand a llot. I really think she is the best english professor
AMAZING TEACHER! Highly recommended!
She relaly lets you go into your field of study, and is happy to learn about what you are studying. She is very understanding and is always willing to help. A in the class
Very nice professor, clear about assignments and helps you out if you need it.

I had professor Zupanc for my Biology Capstone course. The professor made little effort to connect or demonstrate clear expectations to the students despite being a harsh grader and not giving feedback. I reached out to him three times during the semester to set up office hours and ask questions and he never responded.

Zupanc was horrible. Worst BNS professor yet, not only was he mind numbingly boring, he was consistently harsh in his feedback to students, politically incorrect, and we had back to back exams at the end of the semester. Could never follow what we were actually learning nor the theme of the class. Thought he was a sweet old man, I was wrong.

The lectures were impossible to follow and were incredibly disorganized. A vast majority of the time in class was spent listening to student presentations. Be prepared to self-teach from the textbook. The professor wrote his own textbook, which feeds into the lack of overarching theme for the course. 

Do not take this course if you can avoid it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Graded only on 4 tests, one of which includes the final. If you go to lectures and study off slides, tests will be easy. Stressful in the idea that every test question is worth about 1% of your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: His exams are easy as long as you study the content he goes over in the lectures and he doesn't give homework. However, your grade is based on only a few tests so there are no opportunities to bring up your grade outside of testing. Also, he doesn't use a textbook so you need to attend class to learn the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Zupanc was one of the best professors I had at Northeastern. Your grade is based on 4 tests, in which each question is worth 1 percent of your grade but he does provide you with some extra credit questions on your final exam and he does make sure that his students do indeed understand the content before moving on to the next slide.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: HORRIBLE teacher... He has no idea what he's doing and waits until the last minute to fail students. Very inconsiderate professor and can't teach for his life. Your grade in the class is determined by 4 tests and every Question you get wrong is a point off your final grade. He puts in 0 effort for his students. Transfer out if you have him.

Had him spring2020 and it was the easiest class I've taken at Northeastern so far. No homework, only had to study for exams that were multiple choice. If you paid attention during lectures and reviewed the slides before exams there were really no surprises. He is nice to the students that show engagement, so I suggest sitting up front and asking qs
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very inconsiderate and unnecessarily difficult professor. He can't teach and isn't willing to put in effort for his students. Don't take him.
no textbook required which is nice but class grade is determined by 4 tests. Super nice guy though.

Course is graded on three 20 q multiple choice midterms and a 40 q final - every question you get wrong is a point off your final %. Pretty much all of the questions come right off his lecture slides which are posted on Blackboard. He speaks pretty quietly with a thick accent so if you want to actually get anything out of the lecture, sit up front.

What a great guy. Best neuroscience class at Northeastern. He strikes a great balance between history of the topic and what is known today. He engages his students and really takes into consideration their thoughts and feedback. Take notes in class and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He was fine. Our 4 writing projects were: a podcast, a short "essay", poems, and a reflectional letter. DON'T take him if you want to get better at writing - he graded 3/4 projects in the last week and gave you an A if you're semi-competent. I learned nothing in this class, but attendance is mandatory which lowkey built a funny class community.

I really liked Professor Zuch. He was caring and genuinely seemed interested in what he was teaching. I will say, though, that he doesn't grade assignments in a timely manner. We do have thorough and helpful peer reviews, but it was hard to tell what my grade was throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It was a chill class, take it online if you can.

While the professor is a nice person, I found this class to be mundane. Attendance was mandatory, but lectures felt like they did not improve my writing. I often wondered what the point of class was.

The professor also does not grade the writing assignments until the end of the semester. Students should get feedback earlier so we can grow.

Every single student got an A minus.  If that's your MO, great, but considering the amount of effort I put in in hopes of a regular A, this was absolutely not cool.  Nothing was graded until the literal last second - an hour before final grades were due.  In a writing class, you need feedback, and even when I asked for some I didn't get any.

Dr. Zuch is a great teacher and is very straightforward about what he expects out of writing assignments. Great guy to talk to and is very clear about not want to making this course an obstacle for your other studies.
He's awesome, very clear about what he wants and expects. Which isn't particularly much to begin with. Real nice guy and he spoon feeds you information.

Had Zuch for Online Advance Writing in the Disciplines for Summer 2. He was terrific! Very clear and the class structure was perfect and very manageable. You have to put the effort in to get a high grade, but he is VERY fair and truly cares.

If you have a chance, take his class! I switched into his class a week into the semester because my old college writing teach was horrible. I've never been a fan of English class but this man really made me learn and get excited about the material. By far the most interesting intro class I've ever had. Highly recommended!!!

Great teacher and great guy.  His class is very interactive and he really helps you to improve your writing.  He makes it really easy to get a good grade on his final papers if you work on it.  He's also a very understanding grader and very understanding with extensions.  Definitely try to get into his class!!!

Really nice guy! It's sad that he refuses to read his reviews on here because he gets some pretty great ones. He's pretty relaxed and easy to talk to. There's a fair amount of work, but that's the nature with any Intro to College Writing course at Northeastern. I switched into his class and I'm SO happy I did.

Mr. Zuch is a nice and understanding guy. Classes are intellectual and provide insights for paper topics. Had great experience, very understanding and allows paper extensions with a legitimate excuse. Even gave a few classes off during the semster and watched movies!

Mr. Zuch is the nicest man in the world. He allowed me to turn in several papers late due to printer problems or sickness and he is willing to sit down with you and explain the directions for an assignment again if you don't understand something. He is patient, thoughtful and genuinely cares about his students!

Mr. Zuch did an excellent job. The class was engaging and dynamic. Multiple trips to the MFA were interesting. There really was not an overwhelming amount of work. We wrote a lot but it is a writing class so it made sense. All in all I enjoyed the course.

He's awesome. Laid back, but makes the class interesting nonetheless. No pressure on students, open to discussions and available for help. Funny sometimes. I'm not sure he's a hard grader or not, cuz I don't think I try hard enough, but I do get A's
great prof

Really good guy. One of the best teachers I've had. I really liked what he was about. Something due almost every class just to keep you writing, but it's alright. He let me write a 60 page story about my life on a 5-7 page assignment and I got an A-. Peer editing is big. He gives really helpful grading comments on the bigger assignments.

College Writing was a lot of work but Prof. Zuch really made it much better. I heard horror stories about other college writing teachers but he is great teacher and a nice guy. You don't find that all that often. Very Fair; take him if you can!
He is smart and interesting. The class is difficult but you learn a lot. This class relies heavily on peer editing so hopefully you sit next to someone who doesn't write like a 5th grader.

Makes you think, easy to talk to for help. Very laid back and understanding. Class was fun and interesting. Tends to fall behind. Work isn’t difficult but when everything gets backed up it is a bit overwhelming

i hate english, but it is my favorite class at NEU so far. he doesnt test you on your reading, he cares what you though t of it more. he makes you think about it, and he ahs the best approach in teaching (besides not grading the short assigments is not fair, because they are assigned every single class), a lot of writing, but it helps you even more
nice guy, easy to get a B, difficult to get A

Great guy and fun class! This actually turned out to be one of my favorite classes because it was so laid back and I felt like I could speak my mind. He is a HARD grader but just write what you think might sound good and then get ideas from peer editing!
great professor

Pointless. he makes yuo read the dumbest crap and write papers on useless junk. he gave me a U. so i took the class over with another teacher in the summer while having a full time job and 2 other classes, and i got an A-. Prof. Zuch is a waste of time
Makes class fun. Entertaining and invested in class conversations. Interested in hearing everyones thoughts and ideas. Great teacher

A very humorous and nice guy.  Honestly, what I thought would be my least favorite class turned out to be one of my favorites because he made class fun and interesting.  You write CONSTANTLY, but if you express interest in the class, then he'll be more than willing to help you, and I think he considers that when he grades the papers. :)
No Comments

Very nice guy. He will take time to meet with you should you have any questions or comments about the class. Easy enough. Make sure that you stay up on the readings though. Overall a nice class to take if your schedule permits.

really nice and really helpful.  definatley a really good teacher.  just keep up with the reading and the writing and you'll do fine.  he is very fair, and one of my best professors.  he makes the stuff interesting, and I like going to the class.  If you keep up with the papers you get an A, or...
